161013.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
161013.value: Marine subtidal gastropods (snails) are diverse and abundant components of many sea-bottom communities. In addition to their high biodiversity, these animals encompass a broad array of feeding modes and can be found at several trophic levels within a marine ecosystem. However, the contribution of gastropods to trophic transfer, along with how changes in their assemblages affect community structure within soft-bottom marine ecosystems are virtually unknown, especially in productive tropical and subtropical environments. Apart from trophic relationships, field-based observations on the growth of subtidal gastropods are also limited. Since gastropods serve as important food sources for other marine species, including crabs and fish, the lack of such growth data may preclude the accurate estimation in modelling of ecosystem production for resource management purposes. While there are techniques in food-web and growth studies using stable isotopes and fatty acid profiles, investigations are limited to only a few gastropod species. A combination of such techniques has not been widely used to examine trophodynamics and growth patterns within marine gastropod assemblages. The aim of this research is to combine three assimilation-based methods of stable isotope analysis, fatty acid profiling and fatty acid-specific stable isotope analysis, to investigate trophic relationships of subtidal gastropod assemblages in different environmental regimes in subtropical Hong Kong. Further, this thrust will include internal growth band examination and oxygen isotope analysis of the incremental growth scenarios of dominant gastropod species within these assemblages. The novelty of the proposed approach is to link ecological with paleontological methods for analysis of trophic and growth information in complex subtropical marine ecosystems. Data obtained from the proposed study will offer further insight into the functioning of marine gastropods within subtidal ecosystems in the subtropics. An understanding of growth and trophic linkages in gastropod food webs is also essential for developing ecological models for the sustainable management of such highly productive ecosystems, which are important habitats for many species of commercial value.

161013.label: Realisation of objectives
161013.value: All four research objectives were 100% achieved according to the study plan through field collection and laboratory analysis of data in two, instead of three (due to budget reduction with approval from RGC), contrasting marine environments in subtropical Hong Kong. Details of the achievements per research objective are highlighted as follows: 1. Compare the relative importance of various carbon sources in gastropod assemblages with contrasting subtropical environments Using carbon stable isotope (13C/12C) to analyze dominant gastropods, their potential food sources (particulate organic matter (POM), sediment organic matter (SOM), and polychaetes) and predators (primarily crustaceans) collected in the two contrasting subtidal environments: oceanic Mirs Bay on the east and estuarine Urmston Road on the west of Hong Kong, the research findings showed that gastropods of different feeding types relied on different carbon food sources and/or origins. The stable isotope mixing model results revealed that for the filter feeding gastropod species under analysis, the major carbon source was from POM; for the omnivorous species, this was a mixture of POM, SOM and polychaetes; and for the carnivorous species, this was primarily other gastropods. The results of the δ13C values also found that the basal food sources of POM and SOM from estuarine Urmston Road were more 13C depleted than that from oceanic Mirs Bay, suggesting that carbon sources may contain plant material derived from terrestrial origins via the Pearl River discharge rather than from marine origins, whereas this was the opposite in Mirs Bay. A similar picture was observed in δ13C values from the gastropod and other species under study. A wider range of δ13C values was also noted in SOM analyzed from Mirs Bay in winter, which was possibly due to the unconsolidated nature of seabed sediment at this offshore site caused by strong winter monsoon as compared to that from relatively protected Urmston Road. As a complement to 13C/12C stable isotope determination, fatty acid profile analysis of the gastropod species under study provided additional insight into the basal carbon food sources. The results of their fatty acid profiles showed that the filter feeding gastropod species relied on a mixture of fungi and algae in POM as the food sources. However, the omnivorous gastropod species consumed a wider range of food sources, including diatoms, dinoflagellates and zooplankton. With more long-chained fatty acids found in the carnivorous gastropod species under analysis, this reflected that its diet contained higher trophic level organisms rather than POM or SOM. 2. Elucidate the trophic position and growth pattern of key gastropod species in such assemblages Using nitrogen (13N/15N) stable isotope analysis, the trophic position of the key gastropod species under study could be identified, as compared their potential food sources and predators. The results showed that both the omnivorous and carnivorous gastropod species had higher δ15N values than that of the filter feeding counterpart, confirming the higher trophic position of the former than the latter. The results from the mixing model on the stable isotope data also reflected a similar picture. Using oxygen (18O/16O) stable isotope analysis, the growth pattern of key gastropod species under study was determined. As a proxy for reflecting temperature changes and ambient seawater composition, the periodicity of δ18O profile data obtained from the shell of the gastropods in the study areas revealed that these specimens were one to two years old at the time of sampling. Among these three gastropod species, the filter feeding species was found to register a faster summer growth in shell length than the other two, and specimens obtained from Urmston Road appeared to be more 18O depleted than that from Mirs Bay. In contrast, a reverse pattern was noted for the carnivorous species, in which the specimen analyzed from Mirs Bay was more 18O depleted than that from Urmston Road. Such difference in δ18O values may indicate the contrasting environments between the two study areas, where Urmston Road experiences relatively lower salinity and dissolved oxygen, and higher suspended solids than Mirs Bay in summer. It also appeared that different gastropod species can grow well under different hydrological conditions. In this case, the filter feeding species may be more adaptable to thrive in estuarine Urmston Road whereas the carnivorous one in oceanic Mirs Bay. 3. Identify dietary shifts, if any, in these gastropod assemblages due to seasonal changes or hypoxic events A comparison of results of stable isotope values and fatty acid data in the gastropod species under analysis did not reveal significant statistical difference obtained from summer and winter samples in both study areas. Hence, from the data at hand, dietary shift appeared not apparent for the gastropod species under study. This could be due to the ample availability of basal carbon food sources in the subtidal environment in both Mirs Bay and Urmston Road. The subtidal conditions could be more stable than intertidal environment, in which basal carbon food sources in summer may be different from that in winter due to weather changes, e.g., seagrass detritus on intertidal shore in Hong Kong can serve as a major carbon source for many organisms in winter because of the lack of other carbon sources at that time. 4. Evaluate the usefulness of this combined trophic and growth analysis approach in the study of gastropod assemblages in subtropical environments for resource management purpose The combined trophic and growth analysis approach researched in the study of gastropod assemblages has provided a strong scientific basis to further understand the trophic relationship of this diverse group of marine organisms with their potential food sources and predators. Subtidal crustaceans (mostly crabs) and demersal fish, which are valuable resources in the marine ecosystems, can rely on gastropods as their food sources. Hence, such data generated from this combined approach using 12C/13C, 13N/15N and 18O/16O stable isotopes, together with fatty acid profiling, will provide valuable input information in the trophic modelling of ecosystem production for resource management purposes.

161013.label: Major findings and research outcome
161013.value: The major findings of this research include the following: (1) the dominant gastropod species in Hong Kong waters differ in different hydrographical conditions, in terms of their feeding types and origins of their basal carbon food sources, (2) trophic relationship between subtidal gastropod assemblages and potential food sources and predators can be complex, although dietary shift is not apparent between seasons because of relatively stable environment as compared to intertidal areas, (3) in-situ age and growth of gastropod species can be determined using 18O/16O stable isotope analysis, which has a wider application than its original use in paleontological study of climate change in fossil records of organisms with carbonate shell structure, and (4) the combined approach using 12C/13C, 13N/15N and 18O/16O stable isotopes, together with fatty acid profiling, can provide valuable input information in the trophic modelling of ecosystem production for resource management purposes. The major outcomes from this research are that apart from publication of part of the study findings in top-tiered (top 10% in Marine and Freshwater Biology) international journal (see details in Section 8), the results have confirmed the usefulness of the combined stable isotope and fatty acid profiling method in marine ecological studies in elucidating trophic relationships within subtropical subtidal ecosystems. As such research in subtropical or tropical waters is relatively less available, this study can serve as a template for further investigations, so as to form the basis for modelling of ecosystem production for resource management purposes in the long term.

161013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
161013.value: Further field data can be obtained from other key components of the subtropical marine ecosystems, so as to create a comprehensive data basis on their trophic relationship and growth performance using this combined study approach as depicted in Section 5.3.

However, the contribution of gastropods to trophic transfer and how changes in their assemblages affect community structure within soft-bottom marine ecosystems are virtually unknown, especially in productive tropical/subtropical environments. Apart from trophic relationships, field-based observations on the growth of subtidal gastropods are also limited. Since gastropods serve as important food sources for other marine species, including crabs and fish, the lack of such growth data may preclude the accurate estimation in modelling of ecosystem production for resource management purposes. This research combined different stable isotope and fatty acid profiling techniques to elucidate trophic relationships and growth estimation of subtidal gastropod assemblages in different environmental regimes in subtropical Hong Kong. 189713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
189713.value: 進入二十一世紀，人們對燃料及各種化學製品的需求不斷增加。過度開發、全球變暖、以及化石資源的匱乏，又對我們僅存的地球資源發起嚴峻的挑戰。因此，研究開發新型可持續的創新技術以滿足化工行業的需求勢在必行。通過改善已有的工藝過程或者對廢物資源重新挖掘再利用，增加產出，成為解決有限資源難題的一條重要出路。 琥珀酸（Succinic acid , SA）是一種重要的平臺化合物，可用於生產表面活性劑，石油燃料，抗生素，蛋白質骨架物質，維生素等。鑒於它的工業重要性，琥珀酸被美國能源部認定為是最近十年裡最具有潛力的十二種化合物之一。琥珀酸可以用琥珀酸放線桿菌（Actinobacillus succinogenes）來發酵生產。值得一提的是，琥珀酸合成的同時能夠固定CO2，使得這一工藝綠色可行。然而，琥珀酸放線桿菌生產琥珀酸的產量較低，成本過高，達不到工業化的要求。此外，細菌的發酵需要添加堿溶液以維持發酵環境的中性。發酵產物主要以琥珀酸鹽的行式存在。這成為細菌發酵法生產琥珀酸的另一個主要缺陷。這是由於在發酵後處理時需要將琥珀酸鹽進一步轉變為琥珀酸，增加了生產成本。對大規模生產而言，既不經濟又不實用。 聚羥基脂肪酸酯（Polyhydroxyalkanoates, PHAs）作為可替代不可降解的化石衍生塑膠的一類聚合物，它具有生物可降解性、耐用性，應用前景廣闊。聚羥基脂肪酸酯可以用再生能源進行生產。它是一類最具有應用前景的生物可降解塑膠之一。微生物能夠以其他可再生能源為原料，在細胞內以顆粒的形式貯存聚羥基脂肪酸酯作為能源。聚羥基脂肪酸酯具有生物相容性，生物可降解性，耐受一定程度的高溫等良好性能。然而，目前這類生物聚合物多採用高成本、非可再生的原料合成，這限制了其工業化應用的潛力。 本研究計畫旨在運用已經建立的遺傳工程方法，通過生物代謝工程技術改造解脂酵母（arrowia lipolytica），使其同時生產琥珀酸和聚羥基脂肪酸酯。我們借助代謝工程改變Y. lipolytica的代謝途徑，使細胞產生更多的用於降解食品廢棄物的酶，以較高的產率和產量同時生產琥珀酸和聚羥基脂肪酸酯。接下來，我們擬以甘油和脂肪酸為碳源，在偏酸環境下聯產琥珀酸與聚羥基脂肪酸酯。發酵結束後，從發酵液中直接回收琥珀酸。 本研究提出了一項新的食品廢棄物再利用的方案。這非常有利於未來的生物基-經濟的發展。通過再利用無價值的食物廢品生產高附加值的化合物，開發新型工藝過程，對增加香港的競爭力和財富也是大有裨益。

189713.label: Realisation of objectives
189713.value: Project objectives 1 & 2 have been achieved. Research activities in relation to project objectives that were carried out are stated below. Part I. Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) Production Scope of investigation undertaken Experimental work has been conducted to bioengineer Y. lipolytica using established methods of genetic engineering, so it can produce PHAs by fermentation using triolein as substrate. Varied length of 3-hydroxy-acyl-CoAs are serial intermediates of the β-oxidation cycle involved in the degradation of fatty acids which can be derived from lipids by hydrolysis that can be used as substrates for PHA biosynthesis by PHA synthase. The gene encoding PHA synthase was introduced into the Yarrowia yeast by genome integration to ensure its expression steadily. In this study, PHA synthase gene (phaC1) of Pseudomonas aeruginosa that can synthesize mid-length PHAs was chosen. As the codon usage of the native phaC1 sequence differs from that preferred by Y. lipolytica, a de novo codon optimized version of the gene (OphaC1) was designed and synthesized. The peroxisomal targeting signal-1 (PTS1) that is essential for targeting to peroxisomes was added onto the C-terminal of PHA synthase to ensure its proper expression in the peroxisome. The “yeast expression cassettes” based on vectors of pINA1312 and pINA1292 were constructed by inserting phaC1and OphaC1 onto the vectors and digested by restricted enzyme NotI. It can integrate into the genome using zeta sequence above it, thus PHA synthase gene (phaC1/ OphaC1) can be expressed stably in recombined yeast cells. Results achieved In this way, the recombined yeast of Y. lipolytica can utilize triolein which is one of the representative triglyceride (TAGs) to produce PHA. It yields as high as 5.0% PHA（wt% DCW）with 40 g/L DCW (dried cell weight) with 72 hours in flask scale fermentation. Problems encountered Low Transformation Efficiency of PhaC1 cassettes into Y. lipolitica Polh During the early stage of this project, low transformation efficiency of PhaC1 cassettes into Y. lipolitica Polh was encountered. Transformants were selected by plating onto YNBDcas. YNBDcas contained 0.67% (w/v) yeast nitrogen base (without amino acids and with ammonium sulphate), 2% (w/v) dextrose, 0.2% casamino acid. Transformants can be appeared after 2 days for the nondefective vector (pINA 1312) and longer time (around 5 to 15 days) for defective vector (pINA1292). Solutions It was difficult to get transformants, therefore, segment cassettes derived from mono-copies vectors signed no. 1, 3, 5 were chosen for transformation test during the following round of operation. Special attentions were paid in the three of the following aspects: 1) The humidity of the agar surface was evaporated in 37oC incubator for 8-10 h to make the fresh selective plate well-dried. 2) The quantity of the segments cassettes was elevated by increasing its concentrations. In details, plenty of vectors were extracted and digested by NotI in a bigger system/volume and collected in a relative small volume. 3) The concentrations of component cells for electroporation were as high as possible. Several transformants appeared after the electroporation and incubation when we modified the procedure. The size of clones in these three plates were different. Part II. Succinic acid Production Scope of investigation undertaken Succinic acid is another project objective which can be produced by genetic engineered Y. lipolytica. Pathway engineering of TCA cycle was done to block the conversion of SA into fumaric acid through gene knockout strategy and succinic acid would be accumulated. Succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) catalyzes the conversion of SA to fumaric acid. Therefore, sdhE, an important subunit of SDH was knocked out by homologous recombination of URA3 marker onto the sdhE locus of genome. In this way, the recombined yeast of Y. lipolytica can acquire the ability to produce SA. Metabolic engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for the production of succinate 1. sdh gene deletion from Po1f Subunits of sdhA, sdhB, sdhC, sdhE were chosen for gene deletion separately. However, due to unknown reason, the ratios of non-homologous recombination are quite high. Almost all the transformants are false positive. After verification of many transformants, a candidate positive one derived from sdhE gene deletion aroused. It was confirmed both by selective plate and diagnostic PCR. Fermentation was taken using this transformant named Po1fe. 2. Succinate fermentation of engineered strain Po1fe The engineered strain Po1fe, along with Po1f, was fermented in rich media containing varied concentration of glucose or glycerol as carbon sources. It turns out that glycerol is the proper substrate which can yields more biomass and thus higher SA. Fermentation was done under conditions with different dissolved oxygen by changing the culture volumes and with/without baffles, and using different fermentation media containing rich or minimal components. 2.1 SA fermentation under varied dissolved oxygen Part II. Succinic acid Production Previous study showed that the production of SA by engineered Yarrowia depends on an additional limitation of oxygen. The effect of oxygen injection into the medium was studied in 500-mL shaking flasks with and without baffles and with volumes of 50, 100, and 150 mL. In our study, SA fermentation of P01fe strain was taken in 300-mL shaking flasks with and without baffles and with volumes of 30, 50, 60, 80 and 100 mL, using YPG culture containing 10 g/L yeast extract, 20 g/L tryptone, 20 g/L glycerol. Results from HPLC showed that byproducts such as acetate and pyruvate (<1 g/L) were produced. Therefore, genetic modification strategies will be proposed and implemented in order to reduce the content of acetate by-product. Problems encountered Difficulty in knocking down the SDH genes to accumulate succinic acid Succinate is a vital intermediate for TCA cycle, which is very important for cell metabolism and cell growth. SDH complex consists of four subunits named sdhA, sdhB, sdhC and sdhD. Subunits of sdhA and sdhB encode the flavoprotein subunit and the iron-sulfur protein subunit that catalyze succinate reduction to fumarate, and sdhC and sdhD are typically two hydrophobic membrane anchor subunits. sdhE is another component which is required for the flavinylation and activation of SDH. Therefore, knocking down anyone of these subunits will make SDH inactivated. Deletion cassettes of independent subunits were constructed separately using Gibson methods. Then the whole deletion cassette (nucleotide size of 3.4 kb) was amplified using primers up and down and transformed into Po1f (MatA, leu2-270, ura3-302, xpr2-322, axp-2) by LiAc method. Some colonies arrived onto the selected plate (containing 0.67%YNB, 0.2% casamino acids and 5% glycerol) after 30 hours’ incubation at 29 oC. Verification of these transformants was done by diagnostic PCR with a pair of locus-specific primers. However, after serials of verification, it can only be confirmed that the deletion cassette is indeed integrated into the genome of Yarrowia Po1f, but not onto the correct locus of SDH, which means that sdh gene maybe still retain onto the genome, SDH compounds was not knocked out. Solutions Experiments were repeated by transforming gene deletion cassettes of different subunits of SDH. Finally, one positive transformants derived from sdhE subunit deletion was obtained. After verification and fermentation, it proved to produce 5 g/L SA.

189713.label: Major findings and research outcome
189713.value: Medium-chain-length polyhydroxyalkanoates (mcl-PHAs) production: The unconventional yeast Yarrowia lipolytica has excellent lipid/fatty acid catabolism and anabolism capacity depending of the mode of culture. Nevertheless, it cannot naturally synthesize PHA, as it does not express an intrinsic PHA synthase. Here, we constructed a genetically modified strain of Y. lipolytica by heterologously expressing PhaC1 gene from P. aeruginosa PAO1 with a PTS1 peroxisomal signal. When in single copy, the codon optimized PhaC1 allowed the synthesis of 0.205% DCW of PHA after 72 h cultivation in YNBD medium containing 0.1% oleic acid. By using a multi-copy integration strategy, PHA content increased to 2.84% DCW when the concentration of oleic acid in YNBD was 1.0%. Furthermore, when the recombinant yeast was grown in the medium containing triolein, PHA accumulated up to 5.0% DCW with as high as 21.9 g/L DCW, which represented 1.11 g/L in the culture. Our results demonstrated the potential use of Y. lipolytica as a promising microbial cell factory for PHA production using food waste, which contains lipids and other essential nutrients. Succinic acid production: Robust succinic acid production by an engineered yeast Y. lipolytica from crude glycerol without pre-treatment was demonstrated. Diversion of metabolic flow from tricarboxylic acid cycle led to the success in generating a succinic acid producer Yarrowia lipolytica PGC01003. The fermentation media and conditions were optimised, which resulted in 43 g L-1 succinic acid production from crude glycerol. By using the fed-batch strategy in 2.5 L fermenter, up to 160 g L-1 SA was yielded, indicating the great industrial potential. Inactivation of SDH5 in Y. lipolytica Po1f led to succinic acid accumulation and secretion significantly. To our best knowledge, this is the highest titer obtained in fermentation on succinic acid production. In addition, the performance of batch and fed-batch fermentation showed high tolerance and yield on biodiesel byproduct crude glycerol. All these results indicated that PGC01003 is a promising microbial factorial cell for the highly efficient strategy solving the environmental problem in connection with the production of value-added product. Co-production of PHA and SA: Several newly constructed PHA and SA co-producing Y. lipolytica strains was constructed by integrating mcl-PHA biosynthesis cassettes into SA producing strain PGC11505. These strains yield comparable SA titers with strain PGC11505, whereas varied contents of mcl-PHA were produced. The best PHA & SA co-producing strain can produce 11.7 g/L SA and 6.28 g/L CDW, with 0.217 wt% mcl-PHA.

189713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
189713.value: Results from the fermentative SA study confirmed that the engineered Y. lipolytica with inactivation of Sdh5 would produce SA, in which significant amount of acetic acid was accumulated in the fermentation broth. Whereas, the wild type Y. lipolytica strain does not accumulate acetic acid. Therefore, the potential further development would lead to explore a novel metabolic engineering strategy for blocking the acetate formation pathways in SA fermentation by Y. lipolytica. This proposal will focus on metabolic evolution of Y. lipolytica mutants for SA production. Fermentation process optimization in 2-L bench-top bioreactor will be performed in order to identify the effect of aeration, substrate and carbon to nitrogen ratio on SA production. Our aim is to redirect Y. lipolytica lipid metabolism toward the SA production as a valuable lipid-derived compound.

189713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
189713.value: Results from this study successfully demonstrated the simultaneous co-production of SA and PHAs using bioengineered yeast Y. lipolytica. Metabolic engineering was applied to alter the metabolic pathways of Y. lipolytica in such a way that more enzymes can be produced to degrade the food waste, at the same time, to produce SA and PHAs at higher productivity and yield. Fermentations using acidic medium consisting glycerol and fatty acids as carbon sources were studied for co-production of SA and PHAs. The results from this study provide an innovative food valorisation solution, which could contribute to a future bio-based economy. It also enhances Hong Kong’s competitiveness and wealth by promoting research and development of novel processes for chemical production based on renewable and no-cost feedstocks, such as crude glycerol which is an abundant by-product generated in the growing biodiesel industry.

189813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
189813.value: 小核糖核蛋白顆粒（snRNP）是一種多聚体的RNA-蛋白復合物，它在真核細胞中能作用于RNA剪接，並生成用於翻譯成蛋白的信使RNA（mRNA）。SnRNP的生物合成途徑是一個多步驟的反應，這個反應是由稱之爲“运动神经元存活”（Survival of Motor Neuron, SMN）復合物的蛋白機器所調控。SMN的減少或功能喪失將會引起脊髓性肌肉萎縮症（Spinal Muscular Atrophy, SMA) - 一種會引起幼兒死亡的重要常染色体隐性遗传性疾病。SMN復合物包含了SMN以及另外八種蛋白Gemin2-8和Unrip。在先前的研究中，我們已經發現Gemin5作爲RNA結合蛋白可以識別富含U的snRNA（UsnRNA) - snRNP的主要組成部分。儘管SMN復合物中了解得最多的特徵功能是snRNP剪接，許多證據顯示SMN復合物也參與到核糖核蛋白（RNP）的生物合成。最近，我們證實果蠅裏Gemin5的同源蛋白rigor mortis（Rig）能夠高親和及特異性地結合UsnRNA，且Rig的減少會消弱snRNP的生物合成。Rig首先被確認作用于果蠅幼蟲的發育過程中，並隨著SMN蛋白在特定的細胞器—U bodies—中富集。U bodies是UsnRNA的剪接和儲存位點，它總是固定地和另外一個具有mRNA降解、基因沉默和翻譯抑制的RNA顆粒，稱P bodie的分離域關聯在一起。除了發現Rig和人類Gemin5有類似RNA結合能力以外，我們更進一步通過採用高通量測序方法確認一個全新的RNA分類，轉運RNA（tRNA），與Rig有相互作用，並且Rig/tRNA的這種相互作用是直接和特異的。tRNA是蛋白合成的主要組成部分，它包含在選擇壓力誘導的基因調控通路中，因此，我們預測Rig和SMN復合物在U bodies和P bodies的相互作用中扮演著重要的角色。在這個提案中，主要問題是我們計劃去闡述Rig是如何與它的RNA以及如Gemin5這樣的蛋白伴侶發生相互作用，以及Rig在選擇壓力下對於U/P bodies生物合成過程中的重要性。爲此，我們將著重Rig的生化特徵，以及研究果蠅的Rig和SMN復合物。我們相信此發現將會有助於進一步理解Rig和SMN復合物於其它RNP的生化合成通路，並為探索SMA的另類病理機制帶來一線曙光。

189813.label: Realisation of objectives
189813.value: We have achieved both objectives in this project. For objective 1, we expressed and purified recombinant Rig protein from insect cell and performed the RNA and protein binding. We found that Rig binds to U1 and U4 snRNAs but not U4∆snRNA with specificity and high affinity. Moreover, Rig knockdown cells showed reduction of snRNP assembly activity, which is similar to human Gemin5. In addition, Rig can bind to recombinant SmB/D3 heterodimers with high affinity and specificity. Therefore, in terms of the RNA and protein binding, Rigor mortis behaves the same as human Gemin5. In this study, we further looked into the localization of Rig in the ovary of Drosophila where Rig was shown to be highly expressed. Intriguingly, we found that Rig localized in the granules called U body with U2snRNA under stress conditions. For objective 2, we identified tRNA as a novel RNA binding partner of Rig using RNA immunoprecipitation followed by RNA sequencing and demonstrated that the binding was specific and with high affinity. Using RNA mapping techniques, we identified both TC loop and D loop as the recognition components of Rig. Nevertheless, in-vitro RNA binding indicated that neither of them can bind Rig individually. In three dimensional structure, intriguingly, both structural domains are in close proximity, indicating that they may form the scaffold for protein interaction. Our study also demonstrated that Rig functions in facilitating the tRNA cleavage and tRF production using Northern blot analysis. Finally, using immunofluorescence and fluorescence in-situ hybridization techniques, we showed that both Rig and tRNA were not co-localized in cell under stress. Overall, the result of this project demonstrated that the properties of Rig were the same as human Gemin5 in the context of RNA, protein binding and snRNP biogenesis. Moreover, we further provided insight of Rig’s other function in Drosophila such as facilitating stress-induced tRNA fragment production. In addition we demonstrated the localization of Rig in stress granules in the ovary of drosophila during stress. These results indeed open up a new direction to study Rig/Gemin5 in neuromuscular disease since stress has been showed to play significant roles in neurodegeneration.

189813.label: Major findings and research outcome
189813.value: The major findings of this project was the identification of tRNA as a novel RNA binding partner of Rig, which was showed to involve in UsnRNP biogenesis and related to the pathogenic gene SMN in spinal muscular atrophy (SMA). We characterized biochemically the interaction between Rig and tRNA, mapped their interaction domain, and studied the functional roles of Rig in stress-induced tRNA fragment biogenesis. These result was presented in RNA meeting (C:9.1) and the manuscript is under preparation (C:8.3). Since RNA techniques and skills such as RNA sequencing, transcriptome analysis, RNA mapping and fluorescence in-situ hybridization techniques were developed in this project, it provided excellent opportunities to facilitate the collaboration with scientists outside my universities including HKU and Cornell University, USA, leading to two publications (C:8.1 and C:8.2) in peer-reviewed journals and one poster (C:9.2) in RNA meeting, California, USA.

189813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
189813.value: Transfer RNA is one of the abundant RNAs in cell. Increasing evidence of other functional roles of tRNA in addition to translation has been found in recent year, particular in stress response of cell. Rigor mortis is the orthologue of human Gemin5 which is the important component of SMN complex, a pathogenic protein that causes neuromuscular disease Spinal Muscular Atrophy. In our study, we linked these two components together and open up a new direction to investigate the pathogenesis of SMA or other neurodegeneration diseases. We can use Drosophila as the model to further study the functional roles of Rig in neuronal development as well as developing therapeutic approach to treat neurodegenerative disease.

189813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
189813.value: Rigor mortis (Rig) is the orthologue of human Gemin5 which is the important component of SMN complex, a pathogenic protein that causes neuromuscular disease, Spinal Muscular Atrophy. In this study, we identified tRNA as the novel RNA binding partner of Rig and further characterized its functional role in stress-induced tRNA fragment (tRF) biogenesis, a process that is responsive to cell stress and very important in pathogenesis of neurodegenerative disease and neuronal development. Our results provided further insight of additional function of Rig and its modulation in tRF production that may cause the onset of neurodegeneration, and opened up a new direction for scientists to investigate and develop the therapeutic in future.

190213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
190213.value: A field’s state of paradigm development plays a critical role in shaping how research is both conducted and applied. Chinese management research can be considered an early stage area using Kuhn’s framework for paradigm development, as it is a fairly new line of academic inquiry. For example, the China-focused journal Management and Organization Review was first published in 2005, and only recently included in the Journal Citation Reports. This study will benchmark the methodological rigor of Chinese management research against the broader domain of management studies. Two main outcomes are expected from this analysis. First, it will contribute to the ongoing research stream that addresses knowledge creation by universities. A better understanding of knowledge creation processes can help the downstream activity of transmitting this knowledge to end users – i.e., both university students and practitioners who are interested in optimizing the management of Chinese firms and their partners. Second, findings will help to benchmark the methodological rigor of Chinese management studies relative to other management articles. In turn, these comparisons can provide Chinese management scholars important insights about the design of new research projects, which should facilitate their likelihood of successful publication. The paradigm development framework asserts that early stage areas are less likely to have a consensus view on either theory or methods. As a result, methodological factors are more likely to be based on idiosyncratic decisions made by authors and reviewers. Such inconsistencies would make it more difficult to synthesize findings across studies, and would also create uncertainty for prospective authors regarding the design of new studies. Consequently, methodological inconsistencies can be a major barrier to both the development and application of new knowledge. The current proposal will assess the magnitude of these issues through a comparison of research design attributes for China-focused and more general management topics. Study data will be based on a content analysis of articles published in key management journals between 2000 and 2011. This time window allows comparison of earlier and more recent articles, across journals with varying specialist and generalist orientations. We will identify all China-focused articles in these journals, and then evaluate whether emerging research topics are held to a different methodological standard. The choice of methodological factors was derived from an analogous research stream on methodology in entrepreneurship research. 字段的状态范式的发展起着至关重要的作用，在塑造研究如何进行应用。中国管理研究可以被认为是早期面积用库恩的框架范式发展，因为它是一个相当新的学术探究线。例如，专注中国期刊管理与组织评论首次出版于2005年，直到最近才包括期刊引证报告。这项研究将基准中国管理研究对更广泛领域的管理研究方法严谨。从这样的分析预期的两个主要成果。首先，这将有助于正在进行的研究流，解决大学知识创造。知识创造过程，可以帮助更好地了解这方面的知识传输给最终用户的下游活动的 - 也就是说，大学生和有兴趣的中国公司和合作伙伴优化管理的从业者。其次，调查结果将有助于基准相对于其他管理方面的文章，中国管理研究方法严谨。反过来，这些比较可以提供中国管理学者的重要见解，新的研究项目的设计，这应该有利于他们的成功出版的可能性。 范式发展框架断言早期领域，无论是理论​​或方法上达成一致意见，不太可能。因此，方法的因素更可能是基于由作者和审稿人的特质决定的。这种不一致将使它更难以合成整个研究的结果，而且也将创造不确定性，未来的作者就设计新的研究。因此，方法不一致的开发和应用新知识的一个主要障碍。目前的建议将专注于中国的，更普遍的管理课题研究设计属性的比较通过对这些问题的严重程度进行评估。 研究数据将内容分析的基础上在关键的管理学期刊发表的文章，在2000年和2011年之间。这个时间窗口允许更早，更近的文章相比较，跨不同的专家和通才方向的期刊。我们将确定所有专注于中国在这些刊物上的文章，然后评估是否持有新兴的研究课题，以不同的方法标准。来自创业研究一个类似的研究方法论的流的选择方法的因素。

190213.label: Major findings and research outcome
190213.value: Methodological reviews provide a valuable diagnostic aid for researchers: Whether framed around an entire subspecialty (e.g., Crook, et al., 2010; Hitt, Boyd & Li, 2004) or around a specific methodological topic (e.g., Boyd, et al., 2005a), such reviews can help to identify both best practices and opportunities for refinement. Chinese management research is a rapidly growing management specialty. This work is important on several fronts, not only for China’s prominence in the global economy, but also for the opportunity to challenge and extend theories framed around Western business models. In findings largely consistent with Kuhn’s paradigm development framework, we find numerous differences in methodological practices for China based studies, and also that many of these differences decline over time. These patterns are consistent with a subspecialty that is rapidly advancing. Going forward, we have identified a number of avenues for both authors and reviewers to emphasize. We also recommend a number of recent essays on how the field of management overall can improve methodological rigor (e.g., Aguinis & Edwards, 2015; Starbuck, 2016).

190213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
190213.value: Chinese management research is considered to be an emerging field, using Kuhn's paradigm development framework. An emerging field is expected to be characterized by exploratory research, with limited consensus as to research topics and methodologies. Based on a content analysis of empirical management articles, this research supports the argument that Chinese management research is indeed a very young subspecialty. However, longitudinal comparisons demonstrate that this area is rapidly becoming more sophisticated. Based on the findings of this content analysis, normative guidelines are developed for future scholars.

190413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
190413.value: Motivated by a real-world application, the proposed project will consider a supply chain with one distribution center (DC) and multiple retailers which face exogenous stochastic demands. The retailers replenish their stock from the DC, which in turn replenishes from an external source. The supply chain is operated under installation-stock based (or semi-decentralized) control. Linear purchasing costs will be considered, but the DC must order either none or at least as much as a minimum order quantity (MOQ). The objective is to minimize the costs for ordering, for capital tied up in the supply chain, and for not providing an adequate customer service. In the actual application, the distribution requirement planning framework (DRP) was suggested for the system inventory control. DRP is a time-phased replenishment approach in which orders are generated periodically, based on demand forecasts over the leadtime, inventory and outstanding order status. The concepts and logic used are similar to those of material requirements planning (MRP), yet their connections with multi-echelon inventory models are different. Safety stocks are used to cope with uncertainties. The safety stock at each location is determined according to the forecasting errors over the (average) leadtime and certain service level requirement. Clearly, this logic is based on the simple-location setting, the solution of which is hence far from optimal. Only a few studies have provided results that can be used to determine the safety stocks in the DRP framework. However, they do not consider the MOQ. The primary purpose of the proposed study is to develop implementable procedures that on one hand, incorporate the MOQ, and on the other, can help improve the performance of DRP. The contribution lies in the effort towards bridging the gap between multi-echelon inventory theory and the DRP practice. 基於一個具體應用項目的需要，我們認為有必要對一個配送中心（DC）及若干零售商造成的 配送供應鏈系統進行理論研究。該系統的主要特征是，DC在向供應商訂貨時，面臨一個最低訂貨量的要求。研究目標是對此系統提供一套評價與優化方法。 現有的方法 基本上是基於單一供應點系統，利用安全庫存作為補償預測誤差的緩沖器。 在多級配送供應鏈系統應用中，配送需求計劃方法（DRP）是較常採用的技術。（DRP是物料需求計劃方法MRP的延伸。） 但是，在DRP下， 單一供應點系統庫存計劃 方法被直接移植過來。另外，這些方法無考慮最低訂貨量的存在。本研究旨在填補這一理論研究空白。

190413.label: Realisation of objectives
190413.value: Two stipulated objectives have been fulfilled. To prepare for analyzing the multi-echelon system, we started with a single location model. We first adopt a heuristic policy which is specified by two parameters. Applying a discrete time Markov chain approach, we compute the system cost and optimize this heuristic policy under the long-run average cost criterion. We also consider a simpler one-parameter policy, the so-called S policy, which is a special case of our proposed policy. Numerical experiments show the two proposed heuristics perform well in comparison with other developed policies in the literature. Then, we moved to the multi-echelon system: the one-warehouse multi-retailer distribution system, in which any inventory replenishment at each location incurs a fixed-plusvariable cost and takes a constant lead time. The optimal policy is unknown and even if it exists, must be extremely complicated. We have identified an easy-to-compute heuristic policy within the class of modified echelon (r, Q) policies that does not require an integer-ratio property or a synchronized, nested ordering property, yet has certain performance bounds. Those bounds are easy to compute, using which we show that the proposed modified echelon (r, Q) heuristic policy is asymptotically optimal as a pair of system parameters is scaled up. The results can readily be extended to handle the system with MOQ requirements.

190413.label: Major findings and research outcome
190413.value: For the single location system with an MOQ requirement, the proposed heuristic policy which is specified by two parameters and its special case, the so-called S policy, have been analysed. Through an intensive numerical study, the key findings are: 1) both policies perform well in comparison with other developed policies in the literature; and 2) the S policy also performs well and is compatible with our general heuristic policy. A major model building block in supply chain is the one-warehouse multi-retailer distribution system, in which any inventory replenishment at each location incurs a fixed-plusvariable cost and takes a constant lead time. Analysis of such a system is a notoriously challenging problem. By identifying an easy-to-compute heuristic policy within the class of modified echelon (r, Q) policies, we have developed performance bounds which are also easy to compute, using which we show that the proposed modified echelon (r, Q) heuristic policy is asymptotically optimal as a pair of system parameters is scaled up, e.g., when the number of retailers becomes large. In numerical experiments our proposed heuristic has shown near optimal performance and tends to outperform the benchmark heuristic policy studied in the literature. The analysis can relatively easily be extended to incorporate MOQ requirements.

Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
190413.value: Motivated by a real-world application, the proposed project considers a supply chain with one distribution center (DC) and multiple retailers (inventory holding locations) which face exogenous stochastic demands. The retailers replenish their stock from the DC, which in turn replenishes from an external source. The supply chain is operated under installation-stock based (or semi-decentralized) control. The DC must order either none or at least as much as a minimum order quantity (MOQ), and so is each retailer. The objective is to minimize the costs for ordering, for capital tied up in the supply chain, and for not providing an adequate customer service. We adopt the one-warehouse multi-retailer distribution system as a stylised model. The optimal policy is unknown and even if it exists, must be extremely complicated. We have identified an easy-to-compute heuristic policy within the class of modified echelon fixed reorder point and lot-size policies which are easy to compute and implement. We further show that the proposed modified echelon heuristic policy is asymptotically optimal as a pair of system parameters is scaled up, e.g., when the number of retailers becomes large. This indicates that our proposed simple heuristic is a good approximation.

190813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
190813.value: Imitative products, known as Shanzhai (山寨) in China, are evident and pervasive around the global market. Different from counterfeit products, the perceived legality of such products is elusive because alleged similarities between innovative and imitative products are generally hard to define. The proposed research aims to investigate the impact of imitative products on the innovation incentive and profitability of an innovator in the presence of the strategic consumer behavior. Specifically, we propose a game-theoretical model which captures the dynamic interaction between an innovator and an imitator in a two-period framework. After choosing the innovation and quality levels of its new product, the innovator dynamically sets a price for each selling period. No binding commitments about future price can be ex ante made. While acting as a monopolist in the first period, the innovator faces competitive entry of the imitator in the second one. The imitator, if decides to enter, clones the innovation invented by the innovator and at the same time determines the quality level of its imitative product. The imitator also reacts to the innovator’s product and pricing strategies by setting a competitive price. All consumers arrive at the outset and strategically make trade-offs between present versus future consumptions. They also compare the benefits of buying from the innovator against that from the imitator. We plan to investigate how the threat of imitative products affects the intertemporal pricing strategies of an innovator facing strategic customers, as compared to myopic ones. In addition, we will explore whether the existence of imitative products is socially desirable. The research results will provide relevant implications for innovating firms and policy makers regarding how to deal with the threat of imitative activities. 仿冒品，即俗稱的山寨產品，已在全球市場上廣泛的存在。不同於以往意義上的假貨，此類產品的合法性不甚明朗，因為一般來說很難界定出創新產品和仿冒產品之間所謂的相似性。本研究基於對策略消費者行為的考量，探討了仿冒品對創新者的自主創新動力及其盈利所產生的影響。 爲了建立創新者與仿冒者之間的動態相互作用，我們構建了一個兩階段博弈模型。首先，于第一階段，創新者确定其新產品的創新程度及質量水平，然后动態地在每一階段進行產品定價。在定價的過程中，創新者沒有能力去承諾其產品在未來的價格。作為第一階段的寡頭賣家，創新者在第二階段可能會面臨來自仿冒者的競爭壓力。當仿冒者決定要進入市場的時候，他會針對創新者所創造的新產品進行模仿，并同時確定其所生產的仿冒品的質量水平。另外，仿冒者還要根據創新者的產品及其定價策略來選擇他的市場競爭價格。 假設消費者都已在最初即存在於市場，他們會策略性的權衡當下和未來的消費， 並且比較購買創新品與仿冒品所帶來的不同效益。本研究計劃以消費者的遠見或短時行为為基礎，探究仿冒品是如何影響創新者的動態定價策略，以及仿冒品的出現是否合乎整個社會的意願。研究結果將會為創新型企業及政策制定者提供針對仿冒品的相關管理啟示。

190813.label: Realisation of objectives
190813.value: The objectives have been achieved through the construction and analysis of game-theoretic models. Specifically, we start with building a two-period model to analyze the dynamic interactions among an innovator, an imitator, and potential customers. In this model, the innovator introduces a brand new product in the first period. After choosing the quality level of product, the innovator dynamically sets a price for each selling period. No binding commitments about future price can be ex ante made. While acting as a monopolist in the first period, the innovator faces competitive entry of the imitator in the second one. The imitator, if decides to enter, clone the innovation and determine the quality level of the imitative product. Meanwhile, the imitator also reacts to the innovator’s product and pricing strategies by setting a competitive price. Consumers are heterogeneous in their marginal value of quality. All of them arrive at the outset and strategically make trade-offs between present versus future consumption. In anticipation of the imitative entry, consumers also compare the benefits of buying from the innovator against that from the imitator. We start with the analysis of the innovator’s decisions as a monopolist, and then discuss its best strategy in the face of a potential imitative entry. Based on the equilibrium of such a three-party game, we are able to achieve the objectives of this projects.

190813.label: Major findings and research outcome
190813.value: Under the threat of imitative entry, the literature predominantly suggests that innovating firms should take serious actions to deter imitative competitors and prevent their profit pools from being diluted. On the contrary, and counterintuitively, this project finds that it may be better off for an innovator to tolerate imitative entry. In particular, we show that an innovator may possibly benefit from the emergence of imitative products in the market situation where the innovator prefers to only serve the high-end customers with the efficient quality level as soon as the product is launched, but such a strategy is infeasible due to the problem of time inconsistency. The time inconsistency occurs when the innovator’s original strategy of not offering a markdown to tackle the low-end customers in some future period is inconsistent with what is preferred when that future period arrives. Anticipating that it is economically rational for the innovator to cut down the price to also serve the low-end customers in the future period, the high-end consumers will strategically delay the adoption in order to pursue a higher surplus. The original strategy thus cannot persist. To ensure that its strategy is time-consistent, the innovator has to bear a damage on profitability by taking one of the four possible actions: (1) distorting the quality level upwards such that serving the low-end consumers is lossmaking; (2) awaiting the high-end customers to adopt at a later stage; (3) distorting the quality downwards to serve all customers simultaneously; (4) distorting the quality downwards to intertemporally price discriminate the customers. The result of our analysis indicates that the inefficiency caused by the problem of time inconsistency can be resolved by the emergence of imitative products. Furthermore, we find that, under certain conditions, the existence of imitative products is socially desirable. These research findings provide useful implications for innovating firms and policy makers on how to better react to the threat of imitative activities. We are currently refining the exposition of the results and preparing to publish the outcome in a top journal.

190813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
190813.value: Some issues are potentially relevant and deserve further development. For example, the impact of imitation on the innovator’s choice of innovation level is not examined in this project. Innovators may be able to deter the imitative entry by increasing the innovation level, as it is evident that a higher innovation level often yields a higher imitation cost or slows down the imitation process. However, since the result of the current research project suggests that a higher innovation level may weaken innovators’ ability to efficiently extract the consumers’ utilities under certain circumstances, it is not clear whether the extra expenditure on R&D is desirable. While intricate, this issue may possibly be explored by incorporating the innovation level into the innovator’s objective function as a decision variable. Another direction for further research is to investigate the possible coordination between the innovator and imitator. Our result shows that under certain circumstances beating the imitative entry is not as good as partnering with it. However, the implementation of cooperation means that the original firm should reveal more advanced technology and private information to the exclusive firm, which often concerns brand-name managers. This calls for an investigation into the issues on contract design.

190813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
190813.value: This research project shows that our views on the economic impact of imitative entry will shift if we consider the dynamic influence of consumers’ rational choice over time. Why is it relevant to consider such an influence? Most innovative products are durable in nature. In selling durable goods, a monopolist may offer subsequent markdowns to further penetrate the market. Anticipating such price discounts, consumers may make trade-offs between present versus future consumption. As conjectured by Nobel laureate Ronald Coase, this rational consumer behavior may cause the seller to lose the monopoly pricing power. Additionally, there is inevitably a lag between the times when innovative and imitative products are on the market and available to customers. This temporal lag implies that besides focusing the decision on whether and when to adopt a newly launched innovative product, consumers may at the same time anticipate imitative entries and patiently wait until an acceptable alternative within their budget range is available. This study conceptualizes the dynamic interplay of the imitation problem and provides explanations on why being imitated can have a silver lining for innovating firms from a novel perspective.

191113.label: Project Objectives
191113.value: To examine distributors’ responses to favorably unfair rewards in a channel relationship. In particular, we investigate the role of favorable unfairness in enhancing a distributor’s short-term performance and decreasing its trust in the supplier, respectively. To delineate three affects—pleasure, guilt, and suspicion of manufacturer goodwill—as mediators of the linkage between favorable unfairness and performance and trust. To examine the contingency effect of procedural fairness on the effects of favorable unfairness. We argue that as another salient aspect of fairness, procedural fairness ameliorates the impact of unfairness on a distributor’s short-term performance and trust. 191113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
191113.value: In today’s hypercompetitive market, firms know that they must better motivate their distributors, especially in emerging countries, such as China, with complex distribution channels. However, firms that tend to leverage rewards to galvanize their distributors often face the quandary of what constitutes a truly motivating reward. For example, suppose you are a manufacturer considering a reward for a distributor that just met its performance target as prespecified in the contract. You can deliver the 10% rebate as a reward specified in the contract or, alternatively, offer a better-than-contract 15% rebate. Which reward rate will be more motivating for the distributor? The fair one as specified in the contract or the favorably (albeit unfair) larger one? Conventional wisdom dictates that the larger the reward, the more the distributor will be motivated, regardless of whether the reward exceeds the fair level (i.e., according to the contract). Firms in many industries use rewards far beyond their fair level to gain distributors’ compliance (Beijing Business Today 2012). However, a large body of fairness research suggests that unfairness, even in a favorable manner, can “poison” the relationship between a firm and its distributor (Samaha, Palmatier, and Dant 2011). Although research indicates both pros and cons in doling out favorable but unfair rewards to firms’ distributors, few studies have provided details on the underlying mechanisms for distributor reactions. To fill this gap in the marketing channel governance literature, this research aims to investigate the effects of firms’ favorably unfair rewards on distributors. We propose differential effects on distributors’ performance and trust by delineating the distinct mechanisms involved. Favorably unfair rewards can boost short-term performance to a larger extent than fair ones because of the pleasant surprise and guilt triggered, but such rewards may impair long-term trust because of suspicions of manufacturer goodwill. In addition, we attempt to examine the moderating role of procedure fairness, another important aspect of fairness, on these effects. By adding this dimension, we provide a more complete picture of distributor responses to a favorably unfair reward. To test our study hypotheses, we undertake a series of field experiments. The findings will not only contribute to an in-depth understanding of fairness perspectives in channel relationships but also provide important implications for firms in designing effective reward systems. 在当今竞争激烈的市场，公司知道必须更好地激励他们的经销商，尤其在像中国这样的营销渠道复杂的新兴国家。然而，想利用奖励激励经销商的公司，经常面对怎样构成一个真正有效奖励的困境。例如，假设你是一个制造商，你考虑提供一个奖励给达到协议中预设目标的经销商。你可以提供协议中已设定的10%回扣作为奖励，或者，提供一个比协议中更好的15%的回扣。哪一种奖励能更好地激励经销商呢？是协议中规定好的公平奖励，还是更好（虽然不公平）更多的奖励？ 传统智慧指出，越多的奖励越能激励经销商，无论奖励是否超过公平水平（例如根据协议预设）。很多行业的公司使用远超出公平水平的奖励去争取经销商的合作（北京现代商报，2012）。然而，许多对公平的研究提出，即使是有利的不公平，也会“毒害”公司和经销商之间的关系（Samaha, Palmatier, and Dant 2011）。 尽管研究指出了发放有利但不公平的奖励给经销商带来的好处和坏处，但很少有研究提供了有关经销商如何对这种奖励反应的潜在机制。为了弥补渠道管理文献的空缺，本研究旨在研究公司提供经销商有利但不公平奖励的效果。我们假设这种奖励对经销商业绩和信任产生的效果不同。有利的不公平奖励相比公平奖励，可以很大程度上激励短期业绩，因为经销商有意外的惊喜并且可以触发内疚。但是，由于怀疑制造商的信誉，这样的奖励也可能损害长期的信任。另外，我们尝试去考察程序公平性的调节作用，另一个有关公平的重要方面。通过附加这些衡量标准，我们更加复杂地描绘了经销商对有利但不公平奖励的反应。 为了检验实验中的假设，我们将进行了一系列现场试验。研究的发现将不仅更深入地了解渠道关系中的公正性，也为公司提供了有关设计奖励系统的重要启示。

191613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
191613.value: Mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets provide consumers with ubiquitous access to internet, thus consumers can browse for products and make a purchase anywhere and anytime through wireless networks. Moreover, in the increasingly advertising-filled multi-channel environment, consumers are exposed to more than one advertising message from a marketer through different channels and various devices. According to a recent report (Marinsoftware 2012), the average click-through rate is the highest through smartphones (4.1%), followed by tablets (3.1%) and PCs (2.4%). However, the same report shows the average conversion rate is the lowest through smartphones (2.0%), followed by tablets (4.9%) and PCs (5.2%). This report suggests that consumers in general tend to click advertising more frequently through mobile devices while they tend to complete their transactions more frequently through PCs. Hence, any analysis where the mobile advertising is the only one getting the credit for click-throughs or where the PC-based online advertising is the only one getting the credit for conversions, remains incomplete and flawed. Instead, one needs to look at how online and mobile advertising work together by measuring the impact of their interdependence on click-throughs and conversions. While much of the attention in academic research and in the press has been on examining user behavioral differences in the mobile channel versus traditional channels, we believe that important benefits lie in customized means of communicating any brand messages to customers made available through these mobile channels and devices. While prior work has studied the impact of online and mobile advertising separately, the integrated value of the online and mobile advertising has remained unquantified. This project contributes by producing the first study that analyzes the relationship between online and mobile advertising to examine how this interaction between online and mobile advertising leads to click-throughs and conversion rates. This project not only employs an econometric method to estimate the model using an archival data set but also conducts a randomized field experiment to further validate our empirical results. We have secured collaboration with an advertising network company and an e-book service company based in South Korea to collect an advertising-level transaction data set and also to execute a randomized field experiment. To the extent that consumers use both PCs and mobile devices seamlessly in their searches and purchases, the increasing size of the mobile internet may have profound implications for the future direction of mobile economy.

191613.label: Realisation of objectives
191613.value: We have successfully achieved three objectives stated above. Regarding the first objective, our results demonstrate that a mix of web and mobile display advertising triggers more clicks and conversions and higher sales amounts than web or mobile ads alone. Regarding the second objective, we build an econometric model to estimate the causal effects of cross-channel interdependence between web and mobile advertising at the individual user level in the context of e-books. We isolate the effect of synergy between web and mobile advertising from the effects of higher advertising exposures, endogenous channel selection, potential confounding variables with carry-over effects, day of the week effects, and consumer heterogeneity. Regarding the third objective, we design and execute a randomized field experiment to estimate the causal effects of cross-channel interdependence between web and mobile advertising at the individual user level in the context of e-books.

191613.label: Major findings and research outcome
191613.value: Our results demonstrate positive cross-channel synergies between web and mobile ads with respect to click-throughs and conversions. After controlling for the total amount of advertising exposures, a mix of web and mobile display ads results in more frequent clicks and purchases and higher sales amounts than exposures to either web ads or mobile ads only. To summarize, our results demonstrate that web and mobile advertising work together and affect each other, such that clicks and conversions increase when consumers view the same ad on both channels compared to when consumers view an ad on only one channel. Our principal results are consistent with results from a series of robustness checks, including the quadratic regression model, the long term effects of advertising model, and sub-sample analyses according to product popularity. In particular, we find that stronger complementarity effects exist on conversions and sales amounts for popular products than less popular products; this finding represents evidence of “blockbuster effects” rather than “long tail effects” in our context. Based on the experiment results, we present policy simulation results on the optimal level of web and mobile advertising. Specifically, we examine the profit-maximizing rates of web and mobile advertising impressions when channel-specific costs-per-impression are given to the advertiser. We also examine the maximum amount an advertiser should pay for mobile impressions for any given ratio of web-to-mobile impressions. Insights into such questions can provide useful guidelines for marketers who make resource allocation decisions between web and mobile advertising channels.

191613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
191613.value: Data availability issues suggest that some caution is warranted in interpreting our key findings. Our data on mobile advertising cannot distinguish advertising that appeared on smartphones from advertising that appeared on tablets. Future research should examine the interdependence among web, tablet, and smartphone advertising. In addition, our analysis assumes that all clicks are intentional. Some mobile clicks may be accidental, due to small screen sizes. Future research should model the interdependence between web and mobile advertising by designing a strategy for screening out accidental clicks. Notwithstanding these limitations, our analysis demonstrates that web and mobile display advertising work better together than separately. To the extent that consumers use both desktops and mobile devices seamlessly in their searches and purchases, the increasing size of the mobile internet may have profound implications for the future direction of the mobile economy.

191613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
191613.value: This paper demonstrates that positive cross-channel synergy exists between web and mobile ads in terms of click-throughs, conversions and sales amounts. Web and mobile advertising work synergistically and affect each other in a positive way. Hence, advertising budget allocation decisions for one channel must consider the synergistic effects on the other channel. This study has direct implications for decisions related to the allocation of advertising dollars between channels. Budget allocation for digital marketing and related decision-making in organizations is often siloed by channel. Hence, our results related to cross-channel advertising synergy provide useful guidelines for marketers who make resource allocation decisions between web and mobile advertising channels. Therefore, this study is directly related to the issue of digital attribution, which is considered the holy grail of digital marketing today. In today’s complex multi-channel environment in which a variety of digital media influence a sale, attribution becomes substantially more difficult and important. Many organizations continue to use a “last click” attribution model, even though many other customer touch points may influence a sale. Models based on last click or first click fail to enable a full understanding of the multi-channel influences on conversions and will generate misleading insights.

192213.label: Project Title(Chinese)
192213.value: 習慣及非拋利率平價之迷：理論及實證

192213.label: Project Objectives
192213.value: One of the main objective of this project is to develop a tractable, equilibrium international asset pricing model that has potentials to explain the joint empirical facts of multiple term structures of interest rates and exchange rates. We build our model in a continuous-time framework in which many key techniques to solve and estimate dynamic models are well-developed in the literature of term structures. Based on the theoretical model developed, some rigorous econometric analyses will be carried out. The full-fledged estimation enables us to fully assess the model’s performance in explaining empirical data. We estimate the model by using data on good-specific consumption, term structures for different currencies, e.g., LIBOR and Swap rates, and exchange rates. Our empirical exercises also yield the model-implied realization of the state variables, habits. Thus, We can investigate the characteristics of the dynamics of the habits, e.g., whether and in what extent they can be explained by the macroeconomic variables. This clearly brings out much more of the economics than the calibration-simulation methods commonly employed in this literature. Another related empirical regularity in the term structures is the expectation hypothesis. We can also investigate this puzzle for different currencies with the same model. Our rigorous empirical methods enable us to test and evaluate the importance of different specifications of the model on the dynamics of inflation and consumption growth.

192213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
192213.value: Currency exchange market has the largest daily trading volume among all financial markets. Yet, it has a very robust empirical regularity, known as uncovered interest parity (UIP) puzzle. That is a currency with relatively high interest rate tends to appreciate in short term. This is the empirical foundation for the practice of carry trade. It is until recently that equilibrium asset pricing models are able to explain this puzzle. These recent models include habit formation of Campbell and Cochrane (1999) and long-run risks of Bansal and Yaron (2004). As pointed out by Fama (1984), any potential explanation of this puzzle requires the risk premium to be stochastic. Habit formation models the time-varying risk prices by preferences shock that is perfectly correlated with the consumption shock, whereas long-run risks model achieves this by a joint assumption on recursive preferences and stochastic growth rate and volatility of consumption. However, there is one major issue for both models; they have difficulty to extend into multi-agent settings due to an aggregation issue. In the single-agent setting, this aggregation issue is circumvented because the representative agent’s optimal consumption is the same as exogenous consumption. This convenience is broken in a multi-agent setting. This is why most of the international versions of both models are built by simply putting several (typical two) closed economies together. There are no interactions among the closed economies. Another issue is that both models suffer some degree of intractability. The original habit formation model has to rely on numerical solution and the long-run risks model has to use log-linear approximations. In this project, based on the success of these two models, we intend to propose a model with preferences shock and stochastic volatility of consumption growth but without the aggregation issue. The model has potential to explain the UIP puzzle because it has many important features that are shown to be important by the extensive studies of the UIP puzzle. In addition, our model enjoys closed-form solutions. This enables us to conduct rigorous empirical investigations, e.g., likelihood based estimation and test, on asset pricing issues. In contrast to the common practice in this literature, a calibration-simulation is usually used to show the model’s ability to explain the empirical regularities. This method not only is less rigorous but also offers less details on the economics. Our empirical studies should shed new light on the implications of UIP puzzle and other empirical regularities. 在所有金融市場中，日成交量最大的市場即為外匯市場。然而，外匯市場擁有一個十分穩健的實證規律，稱之為非拋利率平價( UIP )之迷。該實證規律表明，相對利率較高的貨幣在短期內趨於升值，而這也成為套息交易的實證基礎。隨著研究的發展，直到近期，均衡定價模型才被用來解釋該現象，如Campbell和Cochrane (1999)的習慣形成模型及Bansal和Yaron (2004)的長期風險模型等。正如Fama(1984)所指，任何對該現象的可能解釋都要求其模型中風險溢價是隨機的。習慣形成模型採用與消費衝擊完全相關的偏好衝擊來對時變的風險價格進行建模，而長期風險模型則採用了遞歸效用函數及消費的增長和波動均為隨機的假定。 然而，兩種模型均有一個主要不足，即由於加總問題的存在，模型難以被擴展到多代理人設定。在單一代理人設定中，由於代理人的最優消費即為外生給定的總消費，該加總問題並不存在，而在多代理人設定中，該問題即顯現出來。這也是為什麼將這兩類模型拓展到國際範疇之後的模型，往往只是幾個(一般兩個)封閉經濟體的簡單加和，而各個封閉經濟體之間並沒有任何交互的原因。另外一個不足是，兩類模型都存在易用性問題。習慣形成模型依賴於數值解，而長期風險模型則依賴於對數線性化。 基於以上兩種模型的成功之處，本項目中，我們希望提出一個具備偏好衝擊和隨機的消費增長波動率兩項特性，但不存在加總問題的模型。該模型具備解釋非拋利率平價之迷的潛質，因為它擁有許多被大量研究證實能解釋該現象的重要特徵。同時，我們的模型有解析解。因此，有別於現在文獻中通用的校驗和模擬的方法，我們能夠進行更加嚴格的實證分析，如基於似然函數的估計及檢驗等，來考查模型對經濟現象的解釋能力並對經濟規律進行更加細緻的刻畫。我們的實證模型可以對非拋利率平價之迷和其他實證規律帶來新的解讀。

192313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
192313.value: Sensitivity estimation is about estimating the derivatives of an expectation with respect to some parameters. It is one of the most important problems in simulation, which finds applications in a wide range of areas in operations research such as gradient-based simulation optimization and hedging parameter estimation of financial securities. Among various Monte Carlo methods for sensitivity estimation, the pathwise method is usually preferred due to its small variance. However, the pathwise method is not applicable when the integrand is discontinuous. Conditional Monte Carlo (CMC) is a useful simulation technique in handling the discontinuity of the integrands. Conditioning on an appropriate random vector, CMC removes the discontinuity by taking a conditional expectation, and thus enables the use of the pathwise method. However, effective use of CMC relies on an appropriate selection of the conditioning random vector. In many practical applications, this selection is problem dependent, and could be difficult in some practical cases. In this project, we propose to view CMC from a new perspective. Instead of selecting a conditioning random vector, we construct a one-to-one mapping and then employ the change-of-variable technique. By doing so, we expect to obtain new insights for CMC. The change-of-variable approach may lead to new estimators of sensitivity for cases where it is not clear how to apply traditional CMC. This project aims to investigate in detail the connection between the proposed change-of-variable approach and the traditional CMC. It is expected that the output of this project may help academic researchers better understand the traditional CMC technique, and provide practitioners with viable new estimators in various application domains. 敏感度估計是隨機仿真中的一個重要問題，主要是關於如何估計一個概率期望對於某些參數的導數。它在運籌學里有廣泛應用，包括基於仿真的優化問題和金融衍生品的風險係數估計。在各種蒙特卡洛仿真方法之中，路徑分析方法（pathwise method）通常因為其更低的方差而表現優於其他方法。然而，當需要求期望的隨機函數不連續的時候，路徑分析方法是不適用的。 當需要求期望的隨機函數不連續的時候，條件蒙特卡洛（conditional Monte Carlo）是一種解決方法。取定一個合適的條件隨機向量之後，條件蒙特卡洛可以把函數中的不連續點消除，從而使得路徑分析方法適用。然而，條件蒙特卡洛的有效應用依賴于選取合適的條件隨機向量。在一些現實應用中，合適的條件隨機向量選取並不容易。 在這個研究項目里，我們從一個新的角度去分析條件蒙特卡洛。有別於選擇條件隨機向量，我們構造一個一一對應并從變量替換的角度去分析條件蒙特卡洛方法。通過這個新的角度，我們對條件蒙特卡洛將有新的理解并獲得新的估計敏感度的方法。這個項目將主要研究傳統的條件蒙特卡洛方法與變量替換方法之間的聯繫。我們期待項目的成果將有助於深入理解條件蒙特卡洛方法，使之更有效應用於現實問題當中。

192313.label: Realisation of objectives
192313.value: In this project, we have successfully achieved the project objectives, details of which are provided as follows. Regarding Objectives 1-3, we have develop a change-of-variables (CoV) framework for conditional Monte Carlo (CMC) and show that conventional CMC can be viewed as a special case for the developed framework. On the theoretical side, we establish a theory for the proposed CoV framework by using geometric measure theory, in particular, area and co-area formulas of Hausdorff measure theory. We show that under a set of regularity conditions CoV estimators are unbiased for the quantity being estimated. The proposed CoV estimators have very clear form and are easy to implement. To compare the conventional CMC and the proposed CoV in Objective 4, we discuss in greater detail the implications of the regularity conditions imposed for the CoV framework in practical applications and show that for two important applications, namely, Greek estimation for options with discontinuous payoffs and gradient estimation of chance constrained programs, these conditions are satisfied. We also provide examples where the CoV estimators can be derived while it is not clear how to apply conventional CMC estimators. Regarding Objective 5 on the potential applications of the proposed CoV framework, we consider the problems of Greek estimation and gradient estimation of chance constrained programs. We show that the CoV framework can be applied for these applications. It turns out that the proposed CoV estimators may significantly outperform existing estimators in many cases. During the investigation of its application to Greek estimation, we also found that the proposed CoV approach has a strong connection with the PI's ongoing work on importance sampling for option Greeks with discontinuous payoffs, which was mainly supported by a GRF grant CityU 145610. In the context of estimating sensitivities of the options with discontinuous payoffs, both methods aim to smooth the discontinuities in expectations or integrals, making the sensitivity analysis easier. A major difference is that IS works with the probability measures and relies on change of measures, while CoV works with the integral and relies on a one-to-one mapping and the corresponding change-of-variables. This insightful comparison helps us better understand these two methods.

192313.label: Major findings and research outcome
192313.value: We summarize the major findings of the project as follows. 1. We develop a change-of-variables (CoV) framework for conditional Monte Carlo (CMC), which is an important technique in stochastic simulation, especially in sensitivity estimation and variance reduction. We illustrate that traditional CMC can be viewed as a special case of the proposed CoV framework. 2. By applying tools in geometric measure theory, we establish a theory that justify the proposed CoV estimator under a set of regularity conditions. We discuss the implications of these regularity conditions in practical applications. 3. The proposed CoV framework leads to new estimators for some cases in which it is not clear hot the conventional CMC can be applied. It also turns out that for cases where both CoV estimators and existing estimators are both applicable, the CoV ones usually have much smaller variances. This highlights the practical relevance of the proposed CoV approach. 4. We study two applications of the proposed CoV framework, including Greek estimation for options with discontinuous payoffs, and gradient estimation of chance constrained programs. For these applications we show that the proposed CoV estimator may significantly outperform existing estimators. 5. We find a connection between the CoV approach and an ongoing work of the PI on importance sampling (IS) for Greek estimation for options with discontinuous payoffs. Both methods aim to smooth the discontinuities in expectations or integrals, making the sensitivity analysis easier, while a difference is that IS works with the probability measures and relies on change of measures, while CoV works with the integral and relies on a one-to-one mapping and the corresponding change-of-variables. This insightful comparison helps us better understand these two methods. Research outcomes of the project include two papers. The major one is titled "Conditional Monte Carlo: A Change-of-Variables Approach", a joint paper with my former PhD student Guiyun Feng. The first version of this paper was reviewed by Operations Research, but unfortunately got rejected, with one of the main reasons being that the theory for the CoV approach involves too heavy mathematical machinery. A revised version of the paper is currently under review with Mathematics of Operations Research. A second paper is the one titled "Importance sampling for options Greeks with discontinuous payoffs", which was published in INFORMS Journal on Computing, a high-qualify journal in our field.

192313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
192313.value: One of the drawbacks of the proposed CoV approach is that it requires knowing the conditional transition density functions for the underlying models. While this is often not a problem for some applications such as Greek estimation for financial options, there are some applications transition densities are not known. A potential improvement is on the development of CoV estimators without knowing density information. In general, this might require some numerical techniques to approximate the density functions. This is a future research direction that we are still working on.

192313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
192313.value: In this project, we have proposed a change-of-variables (CoV) framework for conditional Monte Carlo (CMC), a well known simulation technique with important applications in sensitivity analysis and variance reduction. The CoV framework can be viewed as a generalization of the conventional CMC technique. We show that the proposed CoV approach may lead to new estimators for some cases where it is not clear how to apply conventional CMC. On the theoretical side, we develop a theory to justify the CoV approach, and discuss in detail the implications of the regularity conditions required. On the practical side, we apply the CoV approach to two applications, including Greek estimation of options with discontinuous payoffs, and gradient estimation of chance constrained programs. The former helps risk manager to estimate risks of financial options, thus facilitate better hedging strategies for the options. The latter may serve as an important tool in estimating a chance constrained program's (CCP) gradient that plays an important role in gradient-based optimization for CCPs that find a wide range of business and engineering applications.
