192513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
192513.value: Smartphones, handheld personal computers, have exploded to become a daily part of our lives. With the growing sophisticated and multifunctional capability of smartphones, people are becoming increasingly dependent to their smartphones not only for interpersonal communication through voice or text, but also as a tool for instant news, online gaming, online shopping, and social networking. For the majority of individuals, the use of mobile devices is a normal and routine part of everyday life. However, for some users, they look at their phones’ menu screens, news, email and apps throughout the day. The failure to control an overwhelming impulse to check their phones pervades their lives and results in negative consequences. In recent years, studies on the compulsive use of mobile phones have started to appear in the literature, particularly from psychiatrists, psychologists and social psychologists. However, existing studies tend to be exploratory in nature. For instance, most studies focused on demographics and personality traits of mobile phone users, as well as dimensions and measurement instruments of compulsive use of mobile phones. Some researchers addressed diagnoses, symptom management and treatment strategies for compulsive mobile phone use. However, theory-guided studies on the development of compulsive mobile phone uses are relativedly rare. There is little understanding of the process of compulsive behavior, as well as the variables affecting its enactment. Furthermore, the theoretical understanding of compulsive use of technologies is lacking in the IS literature. Therefore, this research project aims at enriching existing IS literature on compulsive use of technologies by proposing a research model that explains the development of compulsive use of smartphones. Specifically, we propose a research model to explain how positive and negative reinforcements drive compulsive smartphone use. We will test the research model using an online survey of active smartphone users. Important theoretical and practical contributions are expected from this study. On the theoretical side, this research project addressing compulsive use of technologies will enrich existing IS literature by augmenting our knowledge of typical system usage. Particularly, our result will illustrate how the key underlying mechanisms of compulsive use (i.e., positive and negative reinforcements) operate together to drive compulsive smartphone use. On the practical side, this empirical investigation is timely to enhance our understanding of the problematic usage of smartphones, a seemingly universal phenomenon. The results will help clinicians, educators, and parents to develop possible counter-measures against compulsive use of smartphones. 作為一種手持個人電腦，智能手機的爆發式增長已使其成為我們日常生活的一部分。隨著其性能的日益精細化和多功能化，人們越來越依賴他們的智能手機。他們不僅通過它進行聲音和文字間的人際交流，而且將其作為即時新聞、網路遊戲、網路購物以及社會交往的一種工具。對於一部分人來説，使用手機只是他們常規生活的一部分。然而，對另外一部分不少的用戶來說，他們隨時都在查看手機功能表、新聞、郵件和各種應用。這種無法控制自己的衝動而不自覺的查看手機的行為嚴重影響他們的整個生活並將導致不良後果。 近幾年，學者們對於手機強迫使用的研究已經開始出現在一些文獻裡，這很多都是出自精神病學家、心理學家，以及社會心理學家的研究。然而，現存的研究在本質上往往屬於探索性研究。例如，絕大多數研究都集中在手機使用者的人口統計學變數和個性特徵方面，以及強迫性使用的維度和測量上。另外一些學者增加了對手機強迫使用的診斷、症狀管理以及治療策略的研究。然而，建基於理論模型的強迫性手機使用研究相對較少。 對於對強迫性使用技術的行爲，我們對它的發生過程及其發生因素所知甚少。此外，在資訊系統領域也缺乏對於技術的強迫性使用的理論理解。因此，本研究專案旨在提出一個解釋智能手機強迫性使用的發展研究模型，從而對於強迫性使用技術的這種行爲研究在現有文獻上作出新貢獻。具體來說，我們提出一種解釋如何從正負兩面強化推動智能手機強迫性使用的研究模型。我們將使用一項關於活躍智能手機用戶的線上調查進行研究模型的測試。預計這項研究會在理論和實踐方面帶來重要貢獻。在理論方面，該研究項目對技術的強迫性使用進行的探討將會充實典型系統使用的知識從而豐富現有的文獻。特別是，我們的結果將會說明強迫性使用的關鍵潛在機制（即正面和負面的強化作用）如何操作和共同推動智能手機的強迫性使用。從實踐方面來講，這一實證調查是非常及時的，並且將會加強了我們對於智能手機的異常使用這個看似普遍但實際上嚴重的現象之瞭解。研究的結果將對醫生、教育者以及家長提供幫助，讓他們能更有效地針對智能手機的強迫性使用採取可行的應對措施。

192813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
192813.value: This project examines the repair of buyers’ perceptions of suppliers’ trustworthiness upon supply chain disruptions. Recovery from supply chain disruptions is critical for inter-organizational relationship management. Based on justice theory, we propose that trustworthiness (the ability, benevolence, and integrity of a trustee) can be repaired through installing distributive, procedural, and interactional justice between the parties. In addition, based on causal attribution theory, we propose that the effectiveness of employing justice approaches for trust repair is based on the severity of the supply chain disruptions caused by suppliers and market uncertainty. We will empirically test our propositions through a sample of manufacturing firms in China. The results of this project carry important theoretical and managerial implications for how supply chain members can repair trust.This project will help buyers understand supplier defections and provide researchers with a foundation for future systematic investigation on trust repair. 此項目研究供應鏈斷裂後采購商對供應商信任的修復。前人在研究中提出在信任修復中，信任者必須感知到被信任一方有補救措施，因為信任是基於期待被信任一方會采取期望的行動(Dirks et al. 2009)。基於公平理論，我們提出信任的修復（包括被信任者的能力，善意和正直）可以在分配，過程，和交互公平中實現。基於歸因理論，我們進一步提出運用公平機制的有效性受到引發供應鏈斷裂的主要歸因，原因的可控性及穩定性的影響。我們將用制造行業的企業來驗證我們的假設。此項目的結果對於供應鏈各成員的信任修復有重大的理論和實踐意義。

192813.label: Realisation of objectives
192813.value: All four objectives have been fully achieved. Objective 1: To conceptualize trust repair as a multi-facet construct and identify the components that contribute to repair of perceptions of the buyers' trustworthiness We conceptualized trust as a multi-facet construct and identified the components that contribute to repair of perceptions of the buyers’ trustworthiness, i.e., competence, benevolence and integrity. Specially, we define competence as the skills, capabilities, and characteristics that allow a supplier to have influence in buyer-supplier relationships, benevolence as the extent to which a supplier is believed to exhibit kindness, aside from an egocentric profit motive, and integrity as the buyer's perception that the supplier adheres to a set of ethical principles that the buyer finds acceptable. We argue that unmet expectations (due to disruptions) could alter the belief in the supplier’s competence, benevolence, and integrity and thus be the source of trust damage. Objective 2: To investigate the effects of three justice dimensions (i.e., procedure, interactional, and distributional fairness) across different aspects of trustworthiness According to organizational justice theory, the use of fairness procedures, the experience of fair interactional process, and the delivery of fair outcomes has a variety of positive effects in organizations. We posit that justice perceptions are antecedents to trust due to the fact that justice can be evaluated in terms of adherence to rules. The three justice dimensions examined are procedure, interactional, and distributional justice. Procedural justice refers to perceived fairness of the procedures employed by the suppliers to resolve supply chain disruptions. Interactional justice refers to buyers’ perceptions of the fairness of interpersonal treatment received during the enactment of disruption resolution decisions and procedures. Distributive justice concerns the perceived fairness of the outcomes buyers receive. The following hypotheses are proposed and empirically tested to investigate the effects of justice approaches on trust repair. H1: Procedural justice in the disruption resolution process is positively related to the repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ (a) ability, (b) benevolence, and (c) integrity. H2: Interactional justice in the disruption resolution process is positively related to the repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ benevolence. H3: Distributional justice in the disruption resolution process is positively related to the repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ (a) ability, (b) benevolence, and (c) integrity. H4: Procedural justice in the disruption resolution process is more effective than interactional and distributive justice to repair the perceptions of suppliers’ (a) ability, (b) benevolence, and (c) integrity. Objective 3: To examine substantive means of influencing attributions in the wake of a decline in trust According to the causal attribution theory, when negative events such as supply chain disruptions occurred, trustors perceive disconfirming evidence regarding their trusting beliefs, which causes trustors to identify such negative outcomes’ causes. Drawing on causal attribution theory, we conduct a more detailed analysis on repairing trust with organizational justice approaches. In order to understand the effectiveness of organizational justice in repair trust from disruption, it is critical to consider how disruptions occurred in the first place as different reasons of negative events are likely to be associated with different interpretations. We focus on the causes of supply chain disruptions by suppliers and by the environmental factors that neither suppliers nor buyers have control over. Particularly, disruptions can be attributed to suppliers’ shirking and cutting corners, or to external environment such as weather or traffic conditions. Note that external inducements can be particularly pervasive in the marketing channels, where the operational environment of inter-organizational relationships is characterized with market demand volatility, currency exchange risks and constant changes in regulations. In sum, we propose three potential causes of supply chain disruptions—the severity of the supply chain disruptions caused by suppliers, market uncertainty and opportunism. Objective 4: To examine how these attributions interact with trust repair approaches After the trustors determine the outcomes’ causes, trustors assess the causes along three primary, continuous attribution dimensions: (a) locus of causality, stating the extent to which causes are a function of internal (i.e., by trustors), relational (i.e., by interactions between trustors and trustees), or external (i.e., by trustees or by the situation) determinants; (b) stability, stating the degree to which causes are perceived to either fluctuate or remain relatively constant; and (c) controllability, stating the degree of volitional control trustees or other actors have over the outcomes. Regarding the locus of causality, the perceptions of disruptions caused by suppliers can be perceived as either relational or external to buyers. On the other hand, market uncertainty is clearly an external cause. In relation to the stability, depending on the explicit perceptions of the suppliers’ causing the disruptions, competence and integrity might be perceived as a constant capacity whereas benevolence is perceived as more variable. With regard to controllability, opportunism is typically considered an internal and controllable act of the organization or employees of the organization. In particular, we propose the following hypotheses to investigate how the causal attributions interact with trust repair approaches. H1: Perceived degree of disruptions caused by suppliers strengthens the effects of procedural justice in the disruption resolution process on repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ (a) competence, (b) benevolence, and (c) integrity. H2: Perceived degree of disruptions caused by suppliers strengthens the effects of interactional justice in the disruption resolution process on repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ benevolence. H3: Perceived degree of disruptions caused by suppliers strengthens the effects of distributive justice in the disruption resolution process on repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ (b) benevolence, and (c) integrity H4: Market uncertainty strengthens the effects of procedural justice in the disruption resolution process on repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ (a) competence, (b) benevolence, and (c) integrity. H5: Market uncertainty strengthens the effects of interactional justice in the disruption resolution process on repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ benevolence. H6: Market uncertainty strengthens the effects of distributive justice in the disruption resolution process on repair of the perceptions of suppliers’ (a) competence (b) benevolence, and (c) integrity. H7: The positive effect of a buyer’s use of collaboration on trust repair is strengthened more by supplier salesperson opportunism than by supplier firm opportunism. H8: The positive effect of tolerance on trust repair is strengthened more by supplier salesperson opportunism than by supplier firm opportunism. H9: A buyer’s use of aggression has a less negative effect on trust repair under supplier firm opportunism than under supplier salesperson opportunism.

192813.label: Major findings and research outcome
192813.value: This project has four major findings. 1. We find that trust can be repaired, yet the justice “lever” to push depends on which dimension of trust to repair. Procedural justice is the most effective mechanism (followed by distributive justice and interactional justice) to recoup the damage to buyers’ trust in the suppliers’ ability, benevolence, and integrity. Less important, relative to these two trust dimensions, is the interpersonal aspect (interactional justice). Conversely, relative to the benevolence dimension, interactional dimension (along with the other two), was important. The findings and research outcome are shown in the paper published at Journal of Operations Management. 2. Second, we find trust repair can lead to continuity intention. In particular, mitigating damaged ability is the most powerful precursor (followed by recuperating damaged integrity) for locking in future business. Conversely, the mitigation of damaged benevolence is not found to affect future business intentions. The findings and research outcome are shown in the paper published at Journal of Operations Management. 3. We find the some evidence of the moderating effects of disruption severity and market uncertainty. With regard to repair of perceived suppliers’ honesty, perceived degree of disruptions caused by suppliers weakens the relationship between distributive justice and on perceived honesty gap. With regard to repair of perceived suppliers’ competence, perceived degree of disruptions caused by suppliers negatively moderates the relationship between procedural justice and perceived expertise gap. Furthermore, with regard to repair of perceived suppliers’ benevolence, perceived degree of disruptions caused by suppliers wakens the positive effect of procedural justice on perceived benevolence gap. We also find that market uncertainty negatively moderates the relationship between interactional justice and perceived benevolence gap. The findings and research outcome are shown in the working paper. 4. We find that opportunism is a particular important moderator and that supplier salesperson and supplier firm opportunism differentially affect the efficacies of justice approaches on trust repair. Specifically, collaboration is effective at improving trust under both types of opportunism, although its efficacy is maximized under salesperson opportunism. Aggression hurts trust repair under both types of opportunism, but worse under firm opportunism. Tolerance, on the other hand, can effectively improve trust under salesperson opportunism but not under firm opportunism. The findings and research outcome are shown in the paper under review.

192813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
192813.value: We find that the damaged trust can be repaired through the recovery actions of suppliers. Does this suggest that suppliers could use resilient processes and well-developed contingency plans as an additional competitive lever in the wake of disruptions? Two major future research directions are offered below. 1. It would be quite interesting to examine mitigating trust damage in varying disruption situations (e.g., short vs. long duration, isolated vs. widespread). Studying the nuances of the buyer–supplier relationship (e.g., strategic partner vs. arms-length supplier) and damaged trust mitigation could also be enlightening. 2. The service recovery research has provided a rich understanding of how to recover from service failures at the end consumer level. Further development of the project can make a holistic, systematic adaptation of the rich body of knowledge on service recovery to the supply chain disruption context. Follow-up studies will be conducted. In particular, in a study in progress we develop a more nuanced theorizing relative to the role of causal attributions in supply chain disruption repair. We argue that buyers’ perceptions of suppliers’ violations are an indispensable harbinger of a successful chain disruption repair.

192813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
192813.value: Extant literature only offers scarce evidence and limited guidance on how trust can be repaired after the occurrence of negative incidents. The theoretical significance of this project is demonstrated by the theory integration on trust, service recovery, organizational justice and attribution theory. In doing so, this projects culminates in insights for a variety of future scholarly endeavors. We propose and empirically confirm that the damage to buyers’ trust caused by supplier-induced disruptions can be lessened through suppliers’ selective use of appropriate justice approaches. The moderating effects of casual attributions (i.e., the severity of the supply chain disruptions caused by suppliers, market uncertainty and opportunism) on the relationships between justice approaches and trust repair are also scrutinized. Practically, this project indicates that if organizational resources are scarce, firms should center their damaged trust mitigation resource investments accordingly because the procedural justice was identified as the single biggest driver of damaged trust mitigation on all three dimensions. Firms should also consider opportunism and the severity of the supply chain disruptions caused by suppliers when they recuperate the damaged relationship with exchange partners. Collectively, these findings solidify the premise that damaged trust mitigation should follow a systemic and multi-dimensional process.

193213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
193213.value: 近些年，雖然許多市場研究公司（例如渾水研究公司和香櫞公司）投入很多資源來調查在北美資本市場公開上市的中國公司可能的財務欺詐，但其市場反應卻十分消極。然而，他們指出那些市場研究公司提出的證據和研究方法是有問題的。儘管專注於統計分析結構化的財政和市場行為數據，傳統的審計實踐在很大程度上忽略了文本信息，包括但不限於新聞報導和各種社交媒體的內容。從那些非結構化的在線內容中識別和檢測“有效信息的線索”是一個巨大的挑戰，但如果處理得當也包含著很大的機會。 然而，由于各種潛在的相關商業信息數量龐大，種類繁多，給股東們和數據分析師帶來了認知負荷。據我們所知，現在還沒有檢測商業信息欺詐和驗證公司的市場研究報告准確性的系統的有效的測量方法。因此，在該項目中我們提出的一般研究問題是：我們如何保護金融市場的完整性通過（1）評估金融欺詐索賠的可信度，（2）設計一個能夠自動發現欺詐行爲的分析框架，（3）精確檢測和預測金融詐騙。我們在第一手資料研究和第二手資料研究的基礎上提出了一個概念性的研究框架，目的是預測一個企業的欺詐風險。我們將開發一個原型系統來實現這個框架。我們的信息來源包括財務報表，國家工商行政管理總局文件（包括審計報告），美國證券交易委員會提交的文件，以及新聞發布會，社交網絡數據，私人風險投資公司數據，網上的新聞和研究，等等，這些非結構化數據以及結構性金融信息將會被送入這個原型系統。年度間的數據變化關系也將被考慮到可信度評估中。這個系統的核心實現技術包括分類，潛文本挖掘，語言分析，孤立點檢測，和時間序列分析。 該項目對現有文獻的貢獻是通過提出一個分析框架實現信用評價過程的自動化。這個分析框架整合各種視角的重要線索或者信號和對商業欺詐檢測執行準確的預測模塊。我們將建立一個原型框架，並且證實了它既是有效的和也是高效的。該原型框架的應用也在本項目中得到討論，這些應用主要包括提高證券交易傭金的決策效率， 幫助會計專業人士，個人以及風險投資公司辨別有欺詐行為的公司。

193213.label: Realisation of objectives
193213.value: The objectives in this project are all achieved. The first objective is to identify typical factors of companies’ financial fraud behaviour from unstructured online information and to propose a framework for assessing firms’ fraud risk. In order to capture the salient features from unstructured online information and to understand how users on social media platforms use language to express their opinions about a company’s operations and performances, we refer to the Systemic Functional Linguistics (SFL) theory. SFL argues that language is a system of choices/options that writers use to achieve certain goals. The meaning of a text is dependent on those choices within a language system. The term “systemic” views language as “a network of systems or interrelated sets of options for making meaning.” The term “functional” indicates that the approach is concerned with contextualized and practical uses. SFL theory includes three interrelated functions: ideational, interpersonal, and textual function. Ideational function states that language is about construing ideas. Interpersonal function refers to language as a medium for interaction, and it is the means for creating and maintaining our interpersonal relations. These two functions are weaved via the textual function, which determines how information is organized and presented to create a coherent flow of discourse. In other words, ideational and textual functions focus on the contents of messages, while interpersonal function deals with interaction structures. Grounded by Systemic Functional Linguistics theory, we develop a set of features such as sentiment features, emotion features, topic features, lexical weights features, and social network features. The ideational function can be represented by topics, sentiments, and emotions. We adopt Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), a widely used topic model, to extract thematic topics from social media data. Sentiment features include positive and negative polarities. In this study, we use the emotional categories defined in Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count dictionary to measure “assent,” “anxiety,” “anger,” “swear,” and “sadness” emotions. Textual function can be conceptualized into text genres. Genres can be distinguished by genre analysis using word frequencies based on corpus linguistics. We adopt a modified word frequency, term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), for genre classification. TF-IDF assumes that only terms with a high term frequency in a given document but a low document frequency in the whole collection of documents are important in classifying documents. TF-IDF scheme represents a collection of documents by document-term vectors, of which each element is the weight of a term in a document. Interpersonal function refers to the fact that “language is a medium of exchange between people”. It is generally represented by social interaction/structure that can be built through the reply-to relationships between messages. In this study, we track the number of Analysis reports (AR), the number of Breaking news (BN), and the number of StockTalk messages (SM) as well as the number of comments to those contents for each firm. In addition, we consider the number of distinctive authors who post AR and SM and the number of posts per author. Based on the above discussions, we propose in a text analytic framework including sentiment features, emotion features, topic features, lexical weights features, and social network features to predict corporate fraud using financial social media data. The second objective is to design the main structure of a prototype system that can be used to support automatic assessment of the company fraud risk, and to empower investors and data analysts with the heuristics for fraud detection. We propose three main components for the system. First, the system needs to periodically collect data from social media platforms, such as SeekingAlpha and Yahoo Finance, and automatically derive latent features such as those discussed in the study. Second, the latent social media features along with financial ratios (accessible via COMPUSTAT) and language-based features (that are obtainable from COMPUSTAT and SEC EDGAR databases) from the MD&A will feed into a machine learning module to classify fraudulent and non-fraudulent firms. Third, the final learned model can be used to monitor and predict the likelihood that a potential firm may involve in fraudulent behavior. We use Support Vector Machine (SVM) for fraud and non-fraud company data classification. SVM has been shown to be successful in working with large feature space and small sample set, and is capable to handle large sparse data. For comparison purposes, we also implement Logistic Regression (LR), Neural Networks (NN), and Decision Tree (DT) in this study. We use accuracy, recall, F1 score and the area under the ROC curve (AUC), which are standard information retrieval metrics, to mathematically evaluate the quality of trained classifiers. A 10-fold cross validation technique is employed to assess how the model results generalize to an independent test data. The input of our analytic framework are the features extracted from social media data. There are 2 sentiment features, 8 emotion features, and 11 social network features. Principal component analysis yields 127 lexical features. The LDA outputs 100 topic features. By data analysis, it can be seen that the SVM model achieves the best testing performance among all classifiers. By contrast, the LR model obtains the worst performance. Using prior-disclosure information from SeekingAlpha, we can predict fraud with a 75.50% accuracy in the test data set. According to the findings, we can develop a fraud detection warning system by closely monitoring and extracting useful features from the social media platform, thus reducing the time lag between financial misstatements and fraud disclosure.

193213.label: Major findings and research outcome
193213.value: Major findings: Financial social media platforms contains various information about a firm, including new product announcements, merger and acquisition, return on investment, and even conjectures about managements’ inside trading behaviours and other misconducts. This project extracts useful features from unstructured social media contents and develop a text analytic framework to automatically detect corporate fraud. By extensive analyses, it demonstrates the efficacy of the framework as well as the leading effects of social media content on early corporate fraud detection. This project also conducts an applicability check with four focus groups (each with three domain knowledge experts). It shows that major stakeholders in the financial industry feel that our approach is a helpful auxiliary tool, providing further evidence of the value of our framework. 193213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
193213.value: This project has several limitations. When extracting social media features, we captured only the centrality degree of the social interactions. The main reason is that there are no interactions between the focal firm itself and platform users on financial social media platforms such as SeekingAlpha. If we consider contents and comments released by official accounts of firms on Facebook or Twitter, other patterns of social network structure can be investigated, such as centrality, betweenness, and closeness. Note that if these social media platforms, such as SeekingAlpha, change its website design, we need to re-program the data crawl process in order to retrieve the latest data. Experts in the focus group study provided some interesting questions valuable for future research. They held that different corporate frauds have different impacts on investors, auditors, and regulators. Detecting and categorizing specific corporate frauds will be an interesting exercise. Domain knowledge experts also believed that supervision regime change could lead to establishment of new policies, which can have a significant influence on the effectiveness of fraud detection methods.

193213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
193213.value: This project proposes an analytic framework that taps into unstructured data from financial social media platforms to assess the risk of corporate fraud. The analytic framework is able to automatically assess the fraud probability of a firm. By data analysis, the performance of our framework exceeds baseline approaches using only financial ratios and language-based features respectively. The analysis findings demonstrate the value of financial social media data and serve as a proof of concept of using such data to complement traditional fraud detection methods. Our study serves as a proof of concept to develop a fraud detection system that can be used for early fraud detection and prevention. The system has the potential to significantly shorten the time lag from fraud inception to fraud disclosure. Three stakeholders, in particular, investors, audit firms, and government regulators and policy makers can benefit from such a system. Early fraud detection will help investors make informed investment decisions. For auditors, the new method will help them better assess the risk of material misstatement during their planning phase so as to reduce instances of fraudulent financial statements. For government regulators, an efficient and effective fraud detection system can help them focus primarily on suspicious ones.

193613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
193613.value: In current operations management literature, the variable cost is usually assumed to be a linear function of the order/production quantity. A linear variable cost is applicable to the retail industry, where products are ordered from the manufacturer. However, in the manufacturing industry where products are made, the linear variable cost assumption can be troublesome because the labor cost is not necessary a linear function of production quantity. The labor standards acts of many countries, including China and the US, state that employees who work overtime must be paid much more than their standard salary. Hence, the variable cost is a piece-wise linear convex function of the production quantity. Given this cost structure, manufacturers need to make their production, pricing and capacity investment decisions carefully to minimize their total cost or maximize their total profit over a long term planning horizon. We will investigate two models in this project and assume in both that the manufacturer faces stochastic demand. In the first model, the manufacturer dynamically coordinates its production and pricing decisions to maximize its total expected profit over a finite/infinite horizon. Our aim is to characterize the structure of the optimal production and pricing strategy in this model. As overtime work can increase supply, and price can decrease (or increase) demand, we hope to determine when overtime work is necessary, when price should play a role in adjusting the demand, and the interplay between these two effects. In the second model, the manufacturer dynamically adjusts its capacity by determining the number of employees and makes production decisions in each period to maximize its total expected profit over a finite/infinite horizon. In many industries, employees receive a basic weekly ( or monthly) salary, which must be paid even if they work fewer than 40 hours in a workweek. To reduce this fixed cost, some employers ask employees to work overtime rather than risk employing too many workers. This strategy explains why many workers are laid off in times of economic recession while those who remain employed are required to work overtime. We will characterize the optimal capacity adjustment and production strategy of this model. More specifically, we will examine the tradeoff between capacity adjustment and overtime work and try to find the balance between these two. We will also explore how this balance depends on the various costs in this system. 在当今运作管理的文献中，成本通常被假设为生产量的线性函数。这个假设在零售业中没有问题，因为货物是生产商那里进的。然而在生产产品的制造行业中，这个假设就有问题了。因为人力成本并不是生产量的线性函数。包括中国和美国在内的许多国家的劳动法规定加班需要付更高的工资。于是成本是生产量的 分段凸函数。 在这样的成本结构下，制造商们需要仔细的制定他们的生产，定价和生产容量投资策略来最小化长期成本或最大化长期利益。在这个项目里我们将研究两个模型并且假设这两个模型中制造商 的需求是随机的。在第一个模型中，制造商协调定价和生产量来最大化利润。我们的目标是刻画最优的生产和定价策略。既然加班可以增加供给，价格可以改变需求，我们要看一看什么时候用哪种方法，这两者的关系是什么样的。 在第二个模型中，制造商通过决定员工数量来调整生产容量，并且决定生产量来最大化长期利润。在许多行业中，雇主要付员工底薪。为了降低成本，雇主可能宁愿让员工加班也不愿雇太多的员工。这也解释了为什么在经济萧条的时候有的人失业，有的人却要加班。我们将刻画最优的生产容量调整和生产策略。我们将努力找到加班和员工数量这两者的平衡关系。并且研究这种关系如何取决于系统的参数。

193613.label: Realisation of objectives
193613.value: Objectives 1 and 3, most of objective 4 have been achieved. The optimal pricing and production policy has been carefully characterized, which is objective 1. Basing on our characterization, we propose an efficient and practically implementable algorithm whose close-to-optimal performance has been verified on extensive numerical studies, which is objective 3. Moreover, we are able to establish worst-case performance bounds on the performance of our heuristic policy, which is new to the literature for this setting of problems. Our study also provides managerial insights on when the firm should use the pricing tool to adjust demand and when the firm should ask the workers to work overtime to increase production for satisfying demand, which is most of objective 4. Originally, we only proposed to study joint pricing and inventory control problem with fixed and convex variable costs in this project. However, we find that the idea and methodology that we came up to solve this problem can also help us to solve the joint pricing and inventory control problem with fixed and concave variable costs. Therefore, we solved this problem as well. This achievement is beyond the scope of the project. Therefore, for Objectives 1 and 3, we actually achieved more than 100%. All of these results are included in our paper titled Joint Pricing and Inventory Control with Fixed and Convex or Concave Variable Production Costs. This paper is under review in Operations Research. A similar methodology developed in this project is applied to solve the price-adjust problem. Hence, the byproduct of this project is another paper titled Dynamic pricing for perishable products with fixed and convex variable price adjustment costs. We plan to submit it to Naval Research Logistics. When we wrote the proposal of this project with four objects. We proposed the duration of the project to be 36 months and a total funding of HKD76,2000. However, project duration was cut to 24 months, and the funding was cut to HKD 41,5000. Hence, we don't have sufficient funding and time to finish objective 2 though we did try our best and believe that capacity investment in this setting is an interesting problem that should be further explored.

193613.label: Major findings and research outcome
193613.value: When the fixed cost is zero, we find that this problem enjoys a well-structured optimal policy. There is a threshold on the initial inventory level below which we should produce and above which we should not produce. The optimal produce-up-to level is an increasing function of the initial inventory level. Moreover, it is either a straight line with slope 1 (produce the same constant) or a flat line (produce up to the same level) over each region. The optimal pricing policy is a multi-list-price policy in which the optimal price always decreases with the produce-up-to level. When the initial inventory decreases, the firm can adopt two strategies. The first is to increase the price to decrease demand, and the second is to use a more expensive source (order from a supplier with a higher unit cost or ask employees to work overtime) to push up the inventory level. One important finding is that it is never optimal for a firm to adopt both strategies at the same time. In other words, when the initial inventory level decreases, the price should remain at the same level until the capacity of the current source is exhausted, and should then increase only if the current source is at full capacity. When there is a positive fixed cost, the optimal inventory and pricing policy for the single-period problem is the same, except that there is a jump in the optimal produce-up-to level. However, the optimal policy for the multi-period problem with a fixed cost can be more complicated. To characterize its policy, we introduce a new concept, which is a generalization of the symmetric K-convexity and strong (K,c,q)-convexity. After careful characterization, we find several structural properties of the optimal policy and propose a practically implementable heuristic policy. This heuristic policy is no more complicated than the optimal policy for the single-period problem, but has a close-to-optimal performance. Moreover, we are able to establish a worst-case performance bound of this heuristic policy.

193613.value: Objective 2 needs to be further explored. When we make capacity investment decision, we should take into account the convex production cost which is caused by the overtime payment.

193613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
193613.value: Labor Standards Acts in most countries stipulate that employees must receive overtime pay at a rate that is much higher than their regular rate. Although it is costly for employers to ask employees to work overtime, it is no surprise that it is a common practice in many industries of those big manufacturing countries like China, US and Germany because of the labor shortage. This project helps these manufacturing firms to solve the labor shortage problem by providing an efficient and practically implementable production and pricing policy that can increase their revenue while reducing their cost over a long-term planning horizon. We believe that the policy and managerial insights derived in this project are useful for firms to make operational decisions, which can mitigate the labor shortage problem and improve the competitiveness of firms.

194513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
194513.value: 用戶參與是指用戶參與某個特定的商業活動（實體）的行為。例如，用戶參與某一次商業的營銷活動，或者用戶參與某種品牌的產品的持續購買。研究如何強化用戶參與具有重要的學術價值和商業價值（Webster and Ahuja 2006）。尤其在當前電子媒介發達的環境裏，此類研究更加值得學者的重視。這是因為，相較於傳統的強化用戶參與的方法，有越來越多的商家利用成熟的聯網軟體娛樂設施（例如：軟體游戲）來增強用戶參與和相關產品的品牌營銷（Lewis and Porter 2010）。例如，可口可樂公司於2012年十月份發佈了一款跨平臺的軟體游戲『螃蟹於企鵝』。這款游戲可以在iOS作業系統和Android作業系統上運行。通過吸引用戶玩這款游戲，可口可樂公司期望此舉能夠建立並維持消費者對可口可樂品牌的長期的用戶參與。毋庸置疑，目前許多的商家意識到軟體游戲可以提升對其產品（品牌）的用戶參與。諸如迪士尼公司發佈的軟體游戲『Where is my water？』，百事公司在『超級碗』賽季期間推出了簽到軟體游戲，還有奔馳公司推出的賽車游戲『SLS AMG』。這些游戲的不斷推出都說明了商家對利用軟體游戲提升用戶參與的興趣。然而，通過軟體游戲來強化用戶參與絕非易事。這裏，商家面臨的第一個挑戰就是如何設計一款能夠讓消費者願意玩的軟體游戲（Kirman et al. 2010）。最近的研究報告指出，約百分之八十五的用戶在第一次玩某款軟體游戲後就放棄了繼續玩的行為（Playnomics 2012）。同時，競爭激烈的軟體游戲市場領這個挑戰變的更加地困難。如果商家推出的軟體游戲不能夠吸引用戶參與來玩這款游戲，那麼商家將如何利用軟體游戲來強化消費者對其商業活動（實體）的用戶參與呢？因此，兩個亟待解決的問題是：如何提升並保持用戶對某個軟體游戲的用戶參與？有哪些軟體游戲的設計準則可以提升和保持用戶參與？ 在審閱了以前的研究文獻後，我們發現以前文獻的研究重點主要集中在分析並構建軟體游戲的用戶參與的概念。並沒有文獻研究如何從設計的視角來分析如何設計軟體游戲，以使其能夠強化用戶對軟體游戲的用戶參與。同時，之前的文獻也沒有分析軟體游戲的設計是如何影響用戶參與（O’Brien and Toms 2008）。在本研究項目裏，我們開創性地提出了兩個主要的構建軟體游戲的游戲要素。同時，我們提出了這兩個游戲要素影響軟體游戲的用戶參與的可能性（Hsu and Lu 2007）。這兩個游戲要素分別是：游戲的複雜性和游戲的熟悉性。游戲的複雜性指的是用戶在玩軟體游戲時，需要消耗認知能力的程度（Andres and Petersen 2002）。游戲的熟悉性指的是用戶熟悉游戲情境的程度（Lewis and Porter 2010）。一個軟體游戲是由這兩個主要的游戲要素構成的（Dickey 2005）。這兩個游戲要素的前者代表了用戶在玩游戲是所接受的認知能力方面的挑戰，而後者代表了用戶在玩游戲時減輕認知壓力的可能。從這一點來講，構建一套理論架構來理解如何有效地利用這兩種游戲要素來設計軟體游戲，進而強化用戶參與就顯得十分必要。同時，這個理論架構對指導商家設計出能夠強化用戶參與的軟體游戲有重要的現實意義。 在這個研究項目裏，我們主要基於『刺激-反應 理論』來開展一系列研究工作。本研究項目主要分為兩部分。第一部分將重點地審閱用戶參與的相關文獻和理論基礎。第二部分將著力於一系列研究工作來分析如何利用兩種主要的游戲要素構建出能夠強化用戶參與的軟體游戲。最後，根據這兩部分的實證結果，我們將重點總結出一攬子具有實踐意義的軟體游戲設計建議。這些建議可以為香港的商家（以及其他地區的商家）在利用軟體游戲強化用戶參與時保障軟體游戲的設計符合提升並保持用戶參與的需求。同時，我們提出的軟體游戲設計準則可以作為一種重要的營銷戰略工具為今後的研究和商業應用所使用。

194513.label: Realisation of objectives
194513.value: In 2014, the PI had conducted an extensive study of user game engagement as outlined in objective 1. Also, within the same year, a field experiment in the topic of user software gaming trial was conducted. In the field experiment, involving real consumers as gaming users, the PI and his collaborators studied the process in which users trial and evaluated (with amount of effort expended as a manifestation of engagement) a software game trial version. A manuscript was written in lieu of this field experiment. The manuscript was sent out to esteemed colleagues of the field for their comments. A suggestion was to conduct additional mini-test of theoretical assumption. The PI has collected the data on this and the analysis was ongoing. The PI expected the manuscript to be submitted for journal review in due course. Also, apply the knowledge gained from Objective 1, the PI conducted a follow-up study in the context of live-chat to understand how the artifact could be designed to facilitate seller-buyer communication and engagement (Objective 2). The study was subsequently submitted and accepted for publication in the Journal of Organizational Computing and Electronic Commerce. Also, applying the distilled knowledge from Objective 1 and Objective 2, the PI conducted another investigation to understand the psychological response to software game (Objective 3). The paper was currently under review in the Journal of the Management Information Systems. Not contented with the endeavors, the PI is currently expanding the research in two directions. First, a gaming company in mainland China was conducted and the company had started to share some of the gaming data with the PI. Second, a gaming application is still under initial development that allows the PI to study user gaming engagement under privacy concern.

194513.label: Major findings and research outcome
194513.value: The findings from the several studies could inform the design of game. Specifically, we learn that a game software that uses functional restriction (rather than time restriction) could produce a discerned psychological paradox between cognitive adsorption and self-control outcomes from product indulgence. Furthermore, relaxing time restriction do not induce consumers to expend more effort under the high functionality restriction condition but having high functionality restriction reduce the propensity to download (inertia) and the willingness to pay (outcome) even in the case of the relaxed time restriction. Nonetheless, the findings do suggest that increase engagement through perceived interactivity could increase individuals to transact and engage in commercial activities.

194513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
194513.value: Further works could be conducted to expand the boundaries of the findings distilled from the series of works under this project. For example, future studies could be conducted to understand the design of game beyond functional and time mechanisms, such as social mechanisms. Our study on live-chat does touch on this slightly by looking at the dyadic interaction of potential buyers and prospective retailers.

194513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
194513.value: Games should be designed to foster user engagement, which could heighten the inclination to transact (i.e., engage in commercial activities), and there are many ways in which they could be calibrated. In this research, we propose the considerations of the functional, temporal, and dyadic communication mechanisms.

194613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
194613.value: 作爲信息來源以及在綫合作的一種成功模式，Web 2.0 網站逐漸成爲網絡用戶自由貢獻知識的重要平台，並因此變得越來越重要。Web2.0網站的成功，引起了研究者對網站質量，尤其是相對來說未經協調的群體所創造的知識有效性（准確度）的關注。盡管大型Web 2.0網站呈現出了驚人的有效性，但如何達成高度有效性的問題並沒有得到解決。有些研究者指出，數目衆多的貢獻者能夠檢測並規避錯誤。同時，數據顯示，公共維基網站的編輯者數量與頁面數量的比例非常低，有時甚至達到1比40。由此表明，其他提高有效性的機制至關重要。本研究致力于解決這一問題，尤其關注在維基網站中提高知識有效性的機制。 此次持續兩年的研究，將利用內容分析法來觀測大型公共旅遊維基網站中發布的內容，以實證性地驗證一個提高知識有效性的模型。除此之外，此模型還涵蓋了貢獻類型（誰貢獻多少），知識構建階段（內容成熟度），知識類型（確定、單一視角的知識，不確定、多視角的知識，以及受偏好影響的知識）。基于所提模型的實證研究將分析維基內容（知識）的有效性，以及用于提高知識有效性的機制，例如排除不准確性，增加約束機制，或整合不同視角。通過內容分析，本研究將評估不同時期維基頁面上知識單元的質量，並對提高知識有效性的機制進行分類。 該研究致力于對知識整合理論，尤其是群體智慧作出貢獻，並對集體知識創造的其他應用模式提供見解。隨著中國Web2.0網站（比如超大型維基網站或信息交換平台）的飛速發展，本研究對中國Web2.0協作平台的構建具有重要的實踐意義。

194713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
194713.value: Research on internationalization or international diversification has recognized that firms operating in foreign countries face the liability of foreignness. To overcome such liability, firms must possess firm-specific advantage. Additionally, attaining organizational legitimacy in the host country also mitigates the liability of foreignness. Organizational legitimacy is defined as the acceptance of the organization by its environment, and is considered critical for organizational survival and success. Research has examined many factors that affect legitimacy; however, the role of language has remained unexplored. Interaction and interchange between corporate language and national language represent a critical challenge to international strategy and business theory and practice. Corporate language often reflects the language environment in a firm’s home country, but its use may converge/diverge with a host country’s language. Given that language serves as a primary means for a firm to present itself to its host country, and for the host country to make sense of the firm, we view corporate language as an important component in determining a firm’s legitimacy in a host country. Accordingly, our primary research question is to examine whether or not language convergence in a firm’s official documents would affect its legitimacy in the host country. We premise our arguments on communication accommodation theory in sociolinguistic research, which suggests that in accommodation a party may adapt his/her language during interactions in a complimentary manner in order to seek social approval from the other party or to promote cooperativeness between them, because such convergence in language will elicit a favorable perception and opinion. Such accommodation is especially relevant and useful for gaining legitimacy when one party intends to influence or convince the other party who has more resources and power or enjoy higher status. Drawing on insights from the study of organizational identity and image, we further posit that a firm’s organizational identity would affect its likelihood of accommodating its language use for others, and a firm’s organizational image would influence the relationship between communication accommodation and organizational legitimacy. Our research context is Hong Kong firms in mainland China. We are interested in examining if and how Hong Kong firms accommodate their language content and style for mainland China. The subtle relationships and perceptions between Hong Kong and mainland China offer an ideal, interesting study context for studying communication accommodation behaviors, including the interplay between corporate language and national language, on Hong Kong firms’ attainment of organizational legitimacy in mainland China. 國際化或國際多角化的研究已認識到企業要面對海外不利性。為了克服這不利性，企業必須具備企業優勢。此外，在東道國獲得組織認受性可以減輕海外不利性。組織認受性定義為組織被其環境所接受。這被認為是組織生存和成功的關鍵。目前研究已探討很多可影響認受性的因素，然而，語言的作用一直未被探討。企業語言和國家語言之間的互動與交流，代表國際戰略及業理論和實踐的一個重大挑戰。企業語言往往反映公司的本國語言環境，但它的使用可能與東道國的語言趨於會合或偏離。鑑於語言是作為公司面對東道國的主要渠道，也是東道國暸解公司的渠道，我們認為企業語言是影響公司在東道國認受性的一個重要部份。因此，我們主要研究的問題是探討公司官方文件的語言會合會否影響其在東道國的認受性。我們的論點是建基於社會語言學的交往調適理論。這理論表明在交往期間，一方可以調適他/她的語言，以尋求另一方的認可或促進他們之間的合作性，因為語言會合可引出有利的看法和意見。當一方有意影響或說服另一方，而另一方擁有更多資源和權力或享有較高地位，這樣的交往對獲得認受性是特別相關和有用的。運用組織身份及形像的見解，我們進一步斷定，企業的組織身份會影響其調適語言的可能性，及其組織形像會影響交往調適和組織認受性之間的關係。我們的研究範圍是在中國大陸的香港公司。我們感興趣的是探討香港公司有否和如何調適它們在中國大陸的語言內容和風格。香港和大陸之間的微妙關係和看法提供了一個理想的，有趣的範圍以研究交往調適的行為。這包括企業語言及國家語言之間的相互作用，和香港公司在中國大陸獲得組織認受性。

194713.label: Realisation of objectives
194713.value: The objectives as listed in the research grant proposal have been successfully achieved. The funded research has helped develop a detailed theoretical framework that examines international divestment decision. We postulate that this decision is heavily influenced by organizational image and identity since the multinational firm wants to maintain its organiization legitimacy in the eyes of both internal and external stakeholders. This theoretical paper was published in Global Strategy Journal. Taking the ideas further, we conducted several related empirical papers along the line of image and identity, as well as legitmacy. The first paper examines how Chinese listed firms with different ownership, representing types of alternative governance, differ in occurrences in illegitimate or even illegal behaviors. These differences can be linked to firms’ identities, which differ significantly from who they were before China underwent rapid, drastic changes. This paper is under second R&R at Journal of Management. Another study, under review at Asia Pacific Journal of Management, examines how remuneration packages (pay, benfits and welfare) between types of firms affect employee productivity. Employing an organizatoinal identity perspective, we posit that foreign owned firms and state owned firms operatig in China possess distinct organizational identities, and what is legitimate in one type of firm becomes illegimtate in the other, and vice versa. The third paper explores how firm strategy and membership affect the market conceptualization of a firm. In essence, this should relate to organizational image that affects firm value. This paper is under second R&R at Strategic Entrepreneurship Journal. The funded research also led to a paper introducing the methodology of sentiment analysis (a type of text analytics) to the field of management. The paper, under review at Management Science, discusses this method in detail and examines how it can be a valuable methodology to analyze a large amount of unstructured textual data (a type of bid data) obtained from printed sources or social media. To illustrate this method clearly, we captured public sentiment from social media, and tested how public sentiment affects ownership percentage in international acquisitions. Furthermore, the funded research produced an empirical study, under review at Journal of International Business Studies, that examines if and how language accommodation affects a firm’s organizational legitimacy in the host environment. We premise our arguments on communication accommodation theory in sociolinguistics research. Accommodation is especially relevant for gaining legitimacy when one side wants to establish an in-group social identity and gain social approval. We developed arguments that links communication accommodation, idenity, and legitimacy in a cohesive theoretical framework. We studied how Hong Kong firm’ language accommodation (both content and style) affect their organizational legitimacy in mainland China, and found strong results to support our main proposition. . This study has also successfully captured a large amount of textual data from printed documents and social media for this research and for additional studies in the future. We also introduced and made use of sentiment analysis to analyze the data, generating useful insights for our empirical testing. the dataset generated will be immensely useful for additional studies along these lines. The studies under the funded research shed useful light on language accommodation, identity and image, and legitmacy. For both theory advance and practice, the findings of these studies inform us how Hong Kong firms are able to establish and maintain organziational legitmacy in mainland China. a myarid of factors have been proposed in the popular press. Despite the relevance of those factors, language, an often ignored aspect in management, is found to be highly related to organiational legitimacy. This is an important aspect that many Hong Kong firms should pay attention to in their strategy and action.

194713.label: Major findings and research outcome
194713.value: Overall, the funded research has produced or helped spawn 6 papers that were published, under second revise-and-resubmit, or under review in various major international business and management journals. Some findings have also been presented in 4 international conferences including Strategic Management Society Annual Conference, Strategic Management Society Special Conference, Asia Academy of Management Conference, and Rice University's 7th Strategy Symposium on Emerging Markets. By and large, the research studies are able to provide strong support to the critical role of organization image and identity in management and organization research. In addition, we are able to establish the usefulness and impotance of communication accommodation in enhancing a firm’s organizational legitimacy in host environments, since accommodation facilitates social approval and in-group social identity. The linkages among communication accommodation, organizational identity and image, and organizational legitimacy are elucidated and examined through the series of studies conducted under the funded research. Moreover, the role of language is underexplored in the field of management and international business. Our research outcomes clearly demonstrate the importance and relevance of language in research and practice. Future research and practice will find such consideration of language, including corporate language and national language, useful especially in relation to identity and image, as well as organizational legitimacy. At the same time, the critical role of organizational image and identity is further established and applied in a myriad of settings, rendering these two constructs even more relevant to the study of management and international business. Moreover, we found that in terms of language accommodation, both language content (what a firm says) and language style (how a firm says) matter in gaining legitimacy. Moreover, the synchronization of language content and style (joint effect) is statistically strong and positive in its effect on organizational legitimacy. This finding provides interesting, important new insights to the study of corporate language as well as organizational legitimacy. In addition, although it has involved significant amounts of efforts in learning the methodology to help conduct the research, we also put together a paper introducing the methodology (sentiment analysis) to management researchers so that the field will be able to make use of the method in future research. Hence, the research outcomes from this funded research not only extend theory and explain business phenomena, but also introduce a highly useful tool to management researchers.

194713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
194713.value: 1. The use of sociolinguistics theory and examining the role of language in our studies, coupled with the emphasis on identity and image, demonstrate language should occupy a more central role in organizational studies. Since language is an important vehicle of communication for firms, research exploring the role of language, and how it links with image and identity, will be fruitful. Accordingly, related theories in sociolinguistics, can provide useful theoretical premises. 2. Attaining organizational legitimacy is crucial for firms. However, most studies did not measure the construct directly. Our research uses a new methodology, sentiment analysis, to capture this important construct. Future studies can use the method to shed more light on this important construct. 3. Text analytics opens up enormous opportunities for management researchers. Many previosuly hard-to-measure constructs can now be studied directly using archival textual data. Opinions, emotions, etc., becomes easier to study in future research. 4. Our research has spawned a new line of our inquiry recently. Studying the relationship between cultural mixing of Chinese top executives, hence affecting their identities, and firm strategy represents a fruitful endeavor. The first study in this line of research was presented in a recent conference at Rice University.

194713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
194713.value: We use language in our everyday lives, and so do firms. Language is used to communicate, and at the same time, the users of language is also evaluated by the listeners, including the content and style of language being used. Language relates to image and identity of firms, and so a firm that wants to establish itself as belonging to the same social group as that of the listeners will want to cover the same topics and adopt the same style of language in their communications with their targets. Doing so is likely to be appreciated by the other side. Such favorable reception will increase firm survival and success. In this regard, managers should know what things to say, as well as how to say things. Our research indicates that both are important considerations in affecting how firms are viewed by the audience. In our related studies focusing more on organizational image and identity, we learned that firms are expected to act, and will act, according to their organizational identity or image. Misalignment between firm strategy/action and their organizational image and identity will ensue negative outcomes. This line of inquiry will have useful relevance to future research and practice.

194913.label: Major findings and research outcome
194913.value: (1). We find a positive relation between volatility and trading frequency and a negative relation between volatility and trade size. Consistent with the prediction of the search-based theory, the relations are much stronger for illiquid and risky bonds. Furthermore, both liquidity and credit risk become more important in times of stress and their effects are reinforcing. Results strongly suggest that search frictions and credit risk are important factors driving the relation between volatility and trading activity in the corporate bond market. (2). We find that corporate bond returns are more predictable than stock returns, and the predictability tends to be higher for low-grade bonds and short-maturity bonds. A forward rate factor captures substantial variations in expected bond excess returns. Further more, liquidity factors and a bond's credit spread have predictive power on corporate bond excess returns. Combining these variables with traditional predictors significantly improves the performance of the predictive model for corporate bond returns.

194913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
194913.value: We will continuous to study the relations among market volatility, individual aggregated volatility, idiosyncratic volatility, bond return, and etc.

194913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
194913.value: There has been extensive research on the role of volume in financial markets and it has been shown that volume contains fundamental information about a security. In the financial market, volatility and volume are constantly monitored by practitioners who have a great deal of concern over trading risk, capital adequacy, price discovery and market quality. Despite a vast literature on the relation between volatility and trading activity, there are few studies on this issue in the fixed-income markets. In this project, we filled this gap. We provide the first comprehensive evidence for the price volatility and trading activity relation in the corporate bond market. This project also expands the current literature in several dimensions, such as (1). the contribution of non-informational factors to the relation between price volatility and trading activity; (2). the effects of liquidity and quality on the impact of trading on price volatility during different market conditions; (3). disentangle the effects of flight-to-quality and flight-to-liquidity and their interactions during the subprime crisis. And our analysis provides new insights on the roles of liquidity and credit quality in times of stress.

195413.value: 一个组织是否能够真正从专家系统的采纳中获益取决于员工探索性使用该系统各项功能以及最终使用系统的各项功能来支持所要解决的任务的程度。在信息系统的研究中，理解哪些因素能够真正促成员工创新性地使用系统是一个非常重要的话题，得到了研究者们的共同关注。虽然在过去的研究中，研究者们一致发现内部动机的重要作用，但是，他们将内部动机作为单一维度的构念来考虑。其实，内部动机的构念还包括另外一个重要的部分---基于价值规范的部分，也就是说让员工的个人兴趣粘附于组织目标上。因此，我们认为过去的研究对于内部动机对于员工创造性使用专家系统的研究是不完整的。与此同时，过去的研究也忽略了内部动机如何影响员工开创性使用系统的过程，尤其是员工的经验在实现企业价值的过程当中。考虑过程的重要是因为员工开创性使用过程的经验将会影响到他们的契约关系(engagement)，从而影响到最终的成果。因此，现有关于员工在认知需求中的经验对于开创性应用专家系统问题知道的很少。同时，内部动机，经验以及个人特征的交互作用也很少研究。从而，在实践中实践者们接受了很少的指导关于如何怎样的管理能够使得员工探索功能过程的过程更加方便，并且保证有足够的动机去挖掘这些功能从而开创性使用专家系统。 为了解决文献的不足，我们的研究试图探讨：1）内部动机的组成部分（即：享乐型和规范型的内部动机）以及系统探索过程中的使用者经验（即：心理授权）如何影响他们的创行性使用专家系统；2）心里授权如何交互影响内部动机从而导致使用者的探索性使用；3）内部动机和心里授权的作用如何受到动机方向的影响（即：促进导向和预防导向）。 基于心理学和信息系统领域相关文献，我们建立了理论研究模型。具体地说，我们提出最终变量(享乐型和规范型的内部动机)和过程变量（即：心理授权）分别阐释了专家系统的探索以及消费者如何投入到探索的过程中去，从而导致了员工探索性使用专家系统的各项功能。同时，我们主张心理授权将增强员工内部动机通过鼓励员工的投入。最终，我们认为促进导向能够增强员工内部动机和心理授权，而预防导向却阻碍内部动机和心理授权的探索性使用。为了检验动机，契约关系(engagement)，调节焦点（regulatory focus）以及探索性的结果，我们将开展一个长期的研究(longitudinal study)，我们将用6个月的时间搜集大约1000份企业员工的问卷来研究此问题。 我们获得的结果将会带来一些列的理论和实践的贡献。在理论贡献方面，我们的研究是第一次检验探索性使用动机，消费者的探索过程的使用经验以及动机方向的交互性影响在员工开创性使用专家系统功能作用。同时，我们的研究也是第一个研究来探索员工的心理授权直接，以及和系统探索的使用动机交互，影响专家系统创新性使用，从而对于现有的文献在理解员工如何开创性使用专家系统形成了很好的补充。除此之外，本研究也将给实践提供很大的启示，比如，我们的研究将指导管理者们如何通过管理员工的调节焦点（regulatory focus）从而引导员工如何更好地探索性，创新性地使用专家系统，从而有利于企业的创新性发展。

195413.label: Major findings and research outcome
195413.value: Users’ exploratory usage of enterprise systems plays a critical role in determining the extent to which an adopting organization can materialize the purported benefits of the system. As such, examining the antecedents of exploratory usage of ES is of great interest to researchers. In this study, we intend to explore how different components of intrinsic motivation (i.e., intrinsic hedonic and normative motivation) and what users experience in their system exploration process (i.e., psychological empowerment) jointly affect exploratory usage. Drawing upon motivation theories and the Regulatory Engagement Theory, we develop a research model that was tested by survey data. We found that a user’s intrinsic motivation is positively related to his/her exploratory usage. Specifically, a) Intrinsic hedonic motivation is positively related to exploratory usage of the system’s features. b) Intrinsic normative motivation is positively related to exploratory usage of the system’s features. Also, Psychological empowerment is positively related to exploratory usage. More importantly, a user’s psychological empowerment strengthens the effects of intrinsic motivation. Specifically, psychological empowerment strengthens the relationship between intrinsic hedonic motivation and exploratory usage of the system’s features, and it will also strengthens the relationship between intrinsic normative motivation and exploratory usage of the system’s features. Further, we found that regulatory focus moderates the effects of psychological empowerment.

195413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
195413.value: The results obtained have significant theoretical and practical implications. It will contribute to the ES literature by examining the direct and interaction effects of motivation for system exploration and users’ experience with the exploration process on employees’ innovative application of ES features. Specifically, considering both intrinsic hedonic and normative motivation allows us to have a more nuanced understanding of how different types of intrinsic motivation would affect exploratory usage of ES. Also, examining the effects of psychological empowerment will shed new light on our understanding of the critical factors leading to innovation application of ES, given the importance of process-related factors in an individual’s innovative pursuit. Furthermore, this study may be among the first to investigate how users’ psychological empowerment interacts with intrinsic motivation for system feature exploration, thus adding to much needed research on understanding mechanisms that facilitate employees to explore ES.

195413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
195413.value: This study will also contribute to the practice by offering guidelines on how to facilitate employees’ system exploration and how to reinforce the effects of employees’ intrinsic motivation and positive experiences.

195513.label: Realisation of objectives
195513.value: All research objectives had been addressed over the project reporting period. Specifically, with respect to Objective 1, we first examined whether related-party transactions (RPTs) are value-adding or value-destroying. The findings had been reported in a research paper, which was presented in an international accounting conference, namely the 36th Annual Congress of the European Accounting Association. The paper had been published in the 2015 issue of the Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting (JIFMA). Two related research papers (based on our examination on the tax and regulatory environment in China) had been generated during the research process. One paper had been published in another 2015 issue of the Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting (JIFMA), while the other paper has been presented at two international conferences in 2015, and is now ready for journal submission. With respect to Objective 2 (together with Objective 1), we collected data for analyses and generated a research paper. We presented the earlier drafts of the paper in international conferences during the last reporting period in order to solicit further comments and suggestions from other scholars around the world. Of particular note that we received overwhelming responses from conference participants and the research ideas were well recognized by various parties that two Best Paper Awards were finally received in association with the conferences we presented the papers. Section 11 gives details of these awards. Based on these comments and suggestions, we refined our model, compiled a full dataset of transfer pricing details of related-party transactions in China, and performed analyses to address the two research objectives. As specified in the research proposal, we believe that the pricing policy disclosure of related-party transactions provides incremental information contents to investors. The revised research paper incorporating all these changes had now been successfully published in the 2016 issue of the Journal of Accounting and Public Policy (JAPP). The results shall be of significant interests of various stakeholders who rely on the information disclosed by business enterprises. Section 6 provides a summary of the research papers produced in relation to the project objectives.

195513.label: Major findings and research outcome
195513.value: This project is the first to comprehensively examine whether related-party transaction is relevant for determining a firm’s value and convey incremental information contents to investors, referring to a unique, mandatory disclosure requirement of transfer pricing policies in China. Specifically, our research findings reveal the incremental content of pricing policy disclosure (over conventional income and amount of related-party transactions) and its usefulness to interpret a firm’s related-party transactions. Besides, we find that related-party sales increase firm value. However, this value enhancement disappears for firms with (i) a large percentage of parent directors, (ii) high government ownership, or (iii) tax avoidance incentives that often couple with management’s rent extraction activities. Below is the list of major findings. 1. Related-party sales improve firm value in general, but it is also found that corporate insiders use such intragroup sales to deprive value from minority shareholders. 2. Compared to the mere disclosure of amounts for related-party sales, the disclosure of transfer pricing methods provides incremental value relevant information beyond total sales. 3. Disclosure of transfer pricing details complements weak corporate governance mechanisms and improves the prediction of abnormal returns. 4. Firms choose to manage their taxable income upward (before a tax rate increment) between using a book-tax non-conforming manner and a book-tax conforming manner; where such choice depends on various financial reporting incentives, tunneling incentives, and ownership structure. 5. There is interplay between ownership structure and tax avoidance incentives in determining the economic consequences of related-party transactions. As for the research outcomes, a dataset of the details of related-party transactions including the amounts, types, pricing methods and pricing policies has been compiled. Besides, four research papers had been initiated throughout the project reporting period. Three papers had been published in the prestigious accounting and finance journals, namely two 2015 issues of the Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting and one 2016 issue of the Journal of Accounting and Public Policy. Another paper was also presented in the 2015 InstSIS/IAABR – PARIS International Multidisciplinary Academic Conferences in May 2015 as well as the 2015 Annual Symposium on Management and Social Sciences (ASMSS) in August 2015 (which is now under revision and will be ready for journal submission). Part C provides a brief description of these four research papers.

195513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
195513.value: Based on the dataset compiled (together with possibly further data collection), there could be more research projects generated. For example, whether the transfer pricing disclosure interacts with corporate social reporting incentives in affecting firm value could be examined. Besides, surveys on accounting practitioners, business leaders, and students about their perception and preference of the extent of transfer pricing disclosure could be done so as to have an in-depth understanding of the market demand and the interpretation of related-party transaction and its usefulness. We will continue exploring the possibility of conducting these projects and formulating research proposals, if feasible, as for further development of the research.

195513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
195513.value: Related-party transactions (RPTs) are common business transactions among group-affiliated companies. On one hand, these transactions can help the group to have better resources allocations and reduce transaction costs. On the other hand, RPTs are also used as a tool to manipulate earnings, to transfer profits to major shareholders, management, or other group companies. While prior evidence on the usefulness of RPTs is sparse, the mandatory disclosure requirement of the pricing policy used for RPTs in China provides us a rich setting to evaluate the usefulness of not only the amounts of RPTs executed but also the substance (i.e., the disclosure details) involved in the RPTs. We (1) empirically investigate the value relevance of RPTs that help address the superiority of RPT over conventional incomes in evaluating firms’ performance, and (2) examine the incremental information content of the disclosed transfer pricing method of RPTs. The findings of this study are important for researchers, accounting practitioners, and regulators and enable them to better understand the information contents of transactions with group-affiliated companies. The research findings on examining the disclosure details also help the standard-setting bodies to devise or revise effective disclosure requirements in improving the market efficiencies.

195913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
195913.value: This project proposes a theoretical analysis of the on-going developments in online commerce, with a specific focus on the software industry. Traditionally, software has been highly susceptible to digital piracy and the software industry has suffered billions of dollars in damage as a result. The latest change here is to the trend toward the offering of software as a form of service – the software as a service model (SaaS). Unlike the traditional software model, however, digital piracy can be controlled to this form of cloud-based setting. However, to deliver such a service requires the software vendors to invest heavily in the IT architecture that will be used to provide such services. The features provided in software products and services can either be vastly different or very similar. This opens up the opportunity to leverage the product/service mix through bundling. In fact, the current trend is for some vendors to continue to sell the traditional software while at the same time offering the same software as a service. This practice may suggest that rather than one form of software product dominating the industry, as is commonly believed, a combination of the software product and service could potentially co-exist. However, this development is relatively recent and many software vendors are contemplating what would be the best approach to addressing the issue. Hence, there is a need to understand how software vendors should offer their products and services in a market affected by digital piracy and network externalities. In this project, we seek to gain an understanding of the software vendor’s strategy when it comes to selling a software product and/or service when faced with digital piracy. Here, the software vendor must set both the software price and the piracy protection level. The consumer, in turn, will have the option to choose between the legal software product/service and the pirated software product or a combination of the different products and services. Network externalities and product compatibility issues can arise, which span the differences in firm requirements, and in the various versions of legal and pirated software. Our models allow us to gain more insight into how the growing convergence of the traditional software product with an IT-enabled SaaS would impact the market landscape, especially when digital piracy is a consideration. The results obtained from this project contribute to the existing knowledge base, which deals with the changing online business landscape. 本項目對不斷發展的電子商務進行了理論分析，並尤其著重於軟體產業。傳統上來說， 軟體業容易受到數碼盜版的影響，因而軟體產業曾遭受數以十億美元的損失。對此的最新改變是趨向於以服務的形式提供軟體——軟體即服務模式（Saas）。不同于傳統的軟體模式，用這種基於雲設置的形式，數碼盜版得以被控制。然而，為了提供這種服務，就要求軟體供應商對IT架構進行大規模投入，從而可以被用於提供這樣的服務。 軟體產品和服務所提供的功能既可以非常不同，也可以極為類似。這就為通過捆綁銷售，來操縱產品/服務的組合提供了可能。事實上，一些提供商的趨勢是，在販售傳統軟體的同時，以服務的形式提供同樣的軟體。這種實踐可能說明，不同於一般所認為的，由一種軟體產品的形式來主宰產業，軟體的產品與服務的組合可能同時存在。然而，這樣的發展趨勢相對來說時間還不長，很多軟體提供商還在思索解決該問題的最佳方案。因此，就需要理解在一個深受數碼盜版和網路外部性影響的市場上，軟體提供商該如何提供他們的產品和服務。 本項目中，我們試圖搞清在面臨數碼盜版問題時，軟體提供商以何種策略販售軟體產品。在此，軟體提供商必須同時決定軟體價格水準和對盜版的防護水準。而消費者，就可以從合法的軟體產品/服務、盜版的軟體產品、或者不同產品和服務組合中進行選擇。網路外部性和產品相容性的問題會擴大企業需求的不同、以及合法和盜版軟體不同版本間的差異性。我們的模型讓我們可以深入地瞭解，傳統軟體產品和和基於IT的Saas的融合，將會怎樣影響市場圖景，尤其是把數碼盜版的問題也納入考量時。本項目所得出的結論，對現有的應對線上商業圖景變化的知識庫進行了補充。

195913.label: Realisation of objectives
195913.value: We have achieved objective 1 and 2. We now have better ideas about the bundling strategy that should be adopted by a software vendor when they also offer a cloud based software product. We also have studied closely the impact of digital right management protection on the provision of both software product and software service. Specifically, under the presence of piracy, we find the mixed bundling strategy to be the selling strategy that leads to the highest profits as it offers the flexibility of internalizing the impact of software piracy. Pure bundling turns out to be the worst strategy in view of its lack of flexibility. When two products have complementary values, selling them individually could be as good as selling them using a mixed bundling strategy. Moreover, we have found that the optimal selling strategy actually results in positive piracy demand. The project has resulted two conference papers and one working paper. The working paper is currently under revision to be prepared for submission to a journal. The paper was previously submitted to a top-tier journal and received valuable comments from the reviewers. We did not fully achieve objective 3. Although we studied the problem under different market conditions, specifically with different piracy environments, we did not explicitly model the competition effect. I think it may have been overambitious in the initial planning to include competition effect as an issue that we want to study. This is because it requires a different approach to model the problem. Based on our assessment, such work will lead to a totally new project. Specifically, we would have to expand the current model setup to include another firm in the problem. this pose challenge in terms of solving the problem as we have used exhaustive numerical approach to solve the current problem. A more realistic approach is to model the whole problem from scratch, and include competition effect as one of the things that we want to study.
