195913.label: Major findings and research outcome
195913.value: When the complementary effect is not considered, our findings support the notion that piracy-tolerance strategy could lead to highest profits, but for different reasons to prior literature (Lahiri & Dey, 2013; Lahiri, 2012; Prasad & Mahajan, 2003). In general, MB has more flexibility to internalize the effect of piracy demand because of the multiple decisions involved with pricing and deterrence control. This flexibility allows the software vendor to derive the highest possible profits with this strategy. In PC and PB, the options are more limited and thus restrict the firm’s ability to realize higher profits. In a way, our findings share the same insights as Gopal and Gupta (2010): with bundling, even if piracy is higher, and can give higher profits. However, their results, termed phantom piracy, involve tradeoffs on the extent of individual product piracy. We considered this problem from the traditional product bundling perspective, and found that MB offers the greater profits, whereas PB, as suggested by Gopal and Gupta (2010), is the worse. When complementary effects are considered, PC converges to MB and yielding the highest profits. When the degree of complementarity becomes higher, PC is more likely to converge to MB. The intuition is that when two products have higher synergistics value, more and more consumers are likely to purchase the two products at the same time. In turn, this makes selling the “implict bundle” (consumers buyig both products) in PC similar to selling bundles in MB such that the consumers get “extra value” for buying the two prducts. Here, the extra value comes from using the two products together, whereas when the two products are independent, consumers gain by buying bundle under MB because they receive “price discounts”. This feature thus allows PC to enjoy the flexiblity seen in MB in which products are priced to tailor to the “bundle” segments and make selling products individuallly as good as selling with MB. Note that this outcome arises despite higher piracy demand outcome, which is a byproduct when the complemntary effect is higher.

195913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
195913.value: There are several ways that this work can be extended. First, we did not analyze the effect of network externality in this paper, which has been regarded as an important characteristic seen in software industry. Introducing such an effect would limit our ability to derive clear insights to our results. With our current model, we have been able to solve the problem exhaustively by using a numerical approach, which may not be the case once network externality is introduced. It is also not clear how our results would change after we introduced competition into the model. The current software industry is dominated by several major players. By extending the model to include multiple firms, it will allow us to gain further insights about the market outcome. Furthermore, we abstract the problem to only consider two products. In reality, the software vendor can offer multiple products, with different product and service sets. Future studies could consider such extensions.

195913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
195913.value: Given software is increasingly being sold as software service, this has huge implication to the software industry. One of the major impact is the software vendor will have a better control on the software piracy problem because now the users need to logon to the cloud system in order to use the software; but at the expense of higher cloud infrastructure cost. We consider a problem which a software vendor determine how the traditional software product and the new software service should be sold together (in terms of pricing). Given that there are two products, the software vendor can sell them separately (pure component), sell them together (pure bundle) or sell them separately and together (mixed bundling). We find mixed bundling is the best strategy because it allows the vendor to better accommodate the piracy problem. We also studied at the case which the two products can add value when used together. The final outcome is that pure component strategy will become more and more like mixed bundling strategy because most of the consumers will buy both products and they will not solely purchase software service. These results are driven by complex tradeoffs in pricing and piracy deterrence decisions.

196013.label: Major findings and research outcome
196013.value: Modeling Approaches: For the development of optimal inventory policy, we consider two cases: personalized pricing and dynamic pricing. For former, we model the case where the firm offers personalized prices to each customer segment; for latter, we model the case where the firm offers the same price to all customers. Note that internet commerce makes the personalized price possible. The NYOP option offered by Priceline.com is one of the examples. Moreover, comparing with traditional revenue management literature, we emphasis customer waiting for dynamic pricing strategy. Technical Results for Personalized Pricing: Note that carrying on customers in waiting leads to a dynamic program with an n+1 dimensional space state and an n dimensional decision space. In order to carry out optimality studies, we first establish the following technical results: 1), Fulfillment Priority: It is optimal to sell the product to segment i customers, all staying customers with higher WTPs should also be fulfilled. 2), Conversion of selling quantities: If it is optimal to sequentially fulfil customers from the largest WTP to the smallest WTP, it is possible to transform n selling quantities into one selling quantity which is the summation of the total selling quantities. Technical Results for Dynamic Pricing: We now move our focus to the case of dynamic pricing. Note that this is the traditional and widely adopted pricing strategy in industry and literature. In dynamic pricing, all customers are offered with the same selling price. This is particularly applicable in settings where the selling price is publicly announced by retailers. Differs from the traditional revenue management models, however, we allow the unfulfilled customers to screen and wait in the system. Comparing with personalized price, dynamic pricing model requires a joint decision of pricing and quantity. 1), If there is extra inventory, the optimal profit function grows higher as well because extra demand can be satisfied. 2) If there is extra inventory, the profit margin for the corresponding customer segment is higher and it leads to extra profits. With these results we have developed optimal policies for both personalized pricing strategy and dynamic pricing strategy. In this project, we have four papers. Among them, three have been published, one has been reviewed for two times. We believe that it will be published soon. Ending Note: Owing to my own negligence and the confusion of CityU internal system, I have cited CityU project code 9041969 in the past report. I am correcting this mistake for future communications.

196013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
196013.value: In one of our papers reviewing process, reviewers want us to explore the possibility to include the empirical evidence for customer screening and waiting behavior. Fortunately, we are able to obtain data from one of major fashion suppliers to tmall.com(天貓）, where it has a utility which allows customers maintain individual purchase profile prior future promotions. We are in the process of exploring the data and trying to reveal insights into our modeling and technical develop approaches.

196013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
196013.value: We start from establishing evidences of customer screening and waiting behavior. For rental cars, we personally play as a customer of ”Priceline.com”. We use other internet car rental companies to establish reference price and bid on Priceline.com. Priceline.com provides customers with a name- your-own-price (NYOP) option in addition to the regular fixed-price option. Taobao.com allows customers to negotiate for a price. As long as the service/product is still available, Priceline.com would continue the aforementioned matching procedure and allocate to appropriate customers based on the bids that they previously submitted. Moreover, for unsuccessful bids, Priceline.com would offer recommendations to customers and encourage them to increase their bids before the due time. The Priceline practice challenges an important argument adopted in the traditional literature that customers usually demonstrate a come-buy-and-leave behavior due to the transportation or monitoring cost. We document that this new customer behavior as customer screening and waiting. With personalized pricing and dynamic pricing strategy, we characterized optimal inventory and pricing policy.

196413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
196413.value: This project investigates the consequences of audit failures on engagement partners in the Chinese market, a market in which engagement partner names and personal data are publicly available. An audit failure occurs if engagement partners are implicated in the financial fraud discovered by securities regulators and consequently receive a regulatory penalty. We examine whether audit failures cause economic loss to engagement partners and adversely affect their career prospects. More specifically, we determine whether sanctioned partners lose existing clients, fail to gain IPO clients, charge lower audit fees, and are more likely to leave the audit profession after involvement in accounting fraud, compared with matched, non-sanctioned partners. Moreover, we investigate whether the effects of audit failures on engagement partners vary with their seniority and political connectedness. This project contributes to the auditing literature in two important ways. First, the findings of this project helps understand whether and how reputational mechanisms work in countries in which demand for high-quality audits is relatively weak and competition for audit services is high. Although the literature shows that, in developed markets, audit firms with tainted reputations incur economic loss (Weber et al., 2008; Skinner and Srinivasan, 2012), it is far from clear whether this is true in the Chinese market, where public companies are likely to avoid high-quality auditors (DeFond et al., 2000). Second, this study helps understand the determinants of audit quality at the individual auditor level. A growing literature examines individual audit quality, and shows that economic dependence, expertise, experience, and political affiliation may matter (Gul et al., 2012). However, evidence that reputational concerns may motivate individual auditors to improve audit quality is rare. Our work is timely amid the current policy debate in the US and other countries on whether the identity of engagement partners should be publicly disclosed. Proponents of the requirement to disclose engagement partner names argue that such disclosure will motivate auditors to improve audit quality out of personal reputational concern. Our findings can be useful to regulators in their assessment of this argument. 本项目的目的是研究审计失败给负责审计的合伙人带来的后果。因为在中国审计合伙人的姓名和个人背景资料是公开的，所以本研究将基于中国的数据。如果签字的合伙人被断定对客户的财务舞弊负有责任并因此受到监管机构处罚，我们就定义这个事件为审计失败。我们计划研究审计失败是否导致签字的合伙人遭受经济损失和/或导致签字的合伙人未来职业生涯受到不利的影响。具体地说，我们将研究审计失败是否导致签字合伙人失去现有客户、未来比较不能获得新上市客户、降低审计收费和更可能离开审计行业。我们还将研究审计失败导致的后果是否因为被处罚审计师的资格、地位和政治关系有有所不同。 本研究将对审计文献有两方面的贡献。第一，本研究将会增进对声誉机制是否在中国或其他类似国家起作用的理解。中国上市公司对高质量审计的需求不高，同时审计师对审计业务的竞争又异常激烈。这和西方国家的审计市场有所不同。虽然现有文献发现在发达的西方市场上（如日本和德国），声誉机制是起作用的。但是因为中国和西方市场不同，所以西方市场上的发现不一定能够直接应用到中国市场上。第二，本研究也会促进对个体合伙人激励机制的理解。最近的文献开始研究审计师个体差异如专业技能、经验和政治关系对审计质量的影响。但是对于声誉机制是否在个体审计师层面起作用的研究还是空白。 本研究也会对西方国家如美国和欧盟国家的政策制定有一定的启示。这些国家要么刚刚通过、要么正在讨论是否要求公开负责每个具体审计客户的合伙人的身份。支持这个要求的人士认为这项要求会使得合伙人珍惜自己的声誉从而提高执业质量。本研究发现将有助于监管者衡量不同的论点。

196413.label: Major findings and research outcome
196413.value: In this project, we extend the literature by examining whether reputational concerns motivate engagement partners to maintain high-quality services. To test the reputational effects, we rely on a large sample of engagement partners in China who receive regulatory sanctions for problematic audits and examine whether they sustain economic losses and improve audit quality in the post-sanction period. Our analyses are based on a sample of about 200 engagement partners who are sanctioned by the regulators in China for failing to detect or report accounting irregularities committed by their clients. Our major findings are as the followings. First, sanctioned partners tend to have a smaller portfolio of seasoned clients after they are sanctioned no matter we measure the portfolio size based on number of clients or total client assets. Second, sanctioned partners are less likely to attract IPO clients in the post-sanction period than in the pre-sanction period. These findings suggest that regulatory sanctions impair sanctioned partners’ ability to retain existing clients and/or attract new clients. Third, sanctioned partners are more likely to issue modified audit opinions in the post-sanction period. We also obtain some evidence that financial results audited by sanctioned partners in the post-sanction period are less likely to be restated downward. Collectively, these findings suggest that sanctioned partners improve their audit quality subsequent to regulatory sanctions. Our results show that the colleagues of the sanctioned partners are not adversely affected, that is, they do not experience a decline in the client portfolio size or, and also do not experience a change in audit quality. Hence, there is no evidence that the reputational damage to the sanctioned partners spills over to other partners of the same firm. We contribute to the auditing literature in two important ways. First, we provide clean evidence that reputation mechanism works to improve audit quality. Second, our work is among the earliest attempts to examine reputational mechanisms at the engagement partner level, and thus helps understand the determinants of engagement partners’ audit quality. Our work also contributes to the literature that examines the consequences of accounting fraud on individual economic agents. The extant studies provide evidence that the revelation of financial fraud impairs the reputation of economic agents such as corporate executives, outside directors, and financial analysts (Srinivasan, 2005; Fich and Shivdasani, 2007; Desai et al., 2008; Martin et al., 2015). We focus on another important economic agent, namely, external auditors.

196413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
196413.value: Regulators in many other markets including EU and the U.S. have recently adopted new regulations that require the disclosure of the identity of engagement partners. With the passage of the time, the data on engagement partners in those important markets will become available as a result of new regulatory initiatives. It will be interesting to examine whether the findings based on Chinese data can be extended to other, developed markets such as those in the EU or the U.S.

196413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
196413.value: This study examines the consequences of audit failures on engagement partners in the Chinese market in which engagement partners are required to identify themselves in the audit reports. An audit failure occurs if the engagement partner is implicit in the financial fraud discovered by securities regulators and consequently receives a regulatory penalty. We find that audit failures cause engagement partners to sustain economic losses, in that they experience a significant decline in the portfolio of seasoned clients and are less likely to attract IPO clients in the post-sanction period. As auditors face minimal litigation risk in China, these findings suggest that reputational mechanisms work to discipline partners for low-quality audits. We also obtain some evidence that audit partners improve their audit quality subsequent to regulatory sanctions.

196513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
196513.value: As a key dynamic in Chinese society that greatly affects business behaviors, guanxi (connections) significantly impacts company performance in addition to profitability, knowledge transfer initiatives, interfirm influence strategy, and opportunism. Despite an abundance of literature on business guanxi, most studies focus primarily on interpersonal guanxi, while largely ignoring interorganizational guanxi. The developmental process of interorganizational guanxi remains a black box, subject to widely varying interpretations. Moreover, our current understanding of the specific mechanisms that relate interorganizational guanxi to business exchange outcomes remains unclear. This study therefore intends to examine the driving forces, key ingredients, and performance implications of interorganizational guanxi. We first develop a interorganizational guanxi construct and its developmental process which typically involves three key elements: interpersonal ganqing (i.e., emotional attachment) and two types of interorganizational renqing (favor), namely collaborative communication efforts and business support. The new interorganizational guanxi construct, along with its two key aspects, ganqing and renqing, lay the foundation for further study of organizational relationships in a transitional economy such as that of China. Based on transaction cost analysis and resource dependence, we further construct and empirically test a research model that relates environmental dynamism and dependence to the developing mechanisms of interorganizational guanxi, which, in turn, affects exchange outcomes, such as trading partners’ strategic and financial performances. We are particularly interested in the asymmetric effect of the antecedents and performance implications of interorganizational guanxi from the dual perspective of a channel’s downstream and upstream (i.e., manufacturers and distributors). We test our model through an empirical, longitudinal examination of matched samples from Chinese manufacturers and distributors. Our parsimonious model of the developmental process of interorganizational guanxi provides revealing theoretical insights into the dynamic nature of the formation of interfirm relationships. For channel managers doing business in China, our study will provide a broader and deeper understanding of the driving forces behind interorganizational guanxi, which, in turn, will help them design effective strategies to achieve superior performance.

196513.label: Major findings and research outcome
196513.value: 1. The prevalence of personal connections in China, or guanxi, constitutes an institution that governs how people exchange favors. We explores the effects of the guanxi institution on interfirm relational ties,information sharing, and the acquisition of skills across firms. According to social network theory, the marginal benefit of interfirm relational ties on information sharing should decrease with the strength of ties; according to information overload theory, information sharing should have an inverted U-shaped effect on the acquisition of skills. Institutional theory further suggests that the links across these three constructs are subject to the influence of the guanxi institution. With data collected from 338 manufacturing companies, this study shows that the links differ across environments that have strong versus weak guanxi institutions. A strong guanxi institution generally promotes information sharing and skill acquisition, but it also has a dark side. 2. As a unique type of personal relationship between boundary spanners, guanxi (connection), in China involves interpersonal ganqing (emotional attachment) and two elements of exchange of favor between organizations: information favor and business support. We empirically test our model in the context of a cellular phone distribution network, which consists of one major Chinese cellular phone manufacturer and its 277 independent retailers. Our results show that environmental dynamism and interdependence significantly affect the frequency of boundary spanners’ interactions and the development of interpersonal ganqing between them, which subsequently influences interfirm favor exchanges and then interfirm conflicts. 3. Prior research on has drawn on multiple theories across disciplines, resulting in mixed findings. Our study uses meta-analysis by combining the three major theories of interorganizational trust (IOT), namely, transaction cost economics, social embeddedness theory, and resource dependence theory, to retheorize about these IOT relationships. Specifically, we consolidate 168 tests of IOT across theories and corroborate the additive predictive validity of each of the three theories and their combined explanations on IOT development. In particular, by combining IOT theories, we find an inverted U-shaped relationship between relationship duration and IOT; we also find an intertemporal link among the three IOT theories, and relationship duration as the spanning factor functions to moderate the IOT relationships across theories. These findings serve to reconcile prior conflicting findings and shed new light on IOT development. We conclude our meta-analysis by providing directions for future research. Fore more details, please refer the published papers listed in Part C

197213.value: 金融机构的公司治理及风险管理有价值吗? 来自金融危机中保险业的经验证据

197213.label: Co - Investigator(s)

rows: 1. To test how corporate governance and risk management affect the exposure to PRMBS at the onset of the crisis
2. To evaluate whether companies with a higher ex-ante exposure to ABS/PRMBS suffer higher losses on investment PRMBS and have poorer performance in the crisis
3. To investigate whether firms with substantial PRMBS exposure (and losses) lose market shares in product market

197213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
197213.value: The excessive risk-taking and subsequent huge losses sustained by many financial institutions (FIs) are regarded as an important reason for the 2007-2008 financial crisis. Whether this is due to the failure of corporate governance and risk management in FIs is a subject of many academic studies and is of important policy implications. Existing research has focused on examining this issue in banks and produced mixed results. In addition, though substantial exposure to risky subprime private residential mortgage-backed securities (PRMBS) by FIs is an important channel of risk-taking, direct evidence is surprisingly sparse due to the lack of data. Our proposal aims to fill this void by studying how corporate governance and risk management affect FIs’ investment in PRMBS using insurance companies that are the only type of FIs reporting detailed holding and transaction data on PRMBS. Insurance companies are also important because they hold about one-third of corporate bonds and invest heavily in securitized bonds, and they are perceived as risk management specialists. The insurance industry therefore serves as a unique setting within which to examine the above issues. Specifically, we examine whether firms with effective corporate governance and risk management engage in less risk-taking via PRMBS investments before the crisis, whether they are “smart” enough to start to offload PRMBS positions before onset of the crisis, whether the PRMBS holdings at the end of 2006 lead to more investment losses and lower firm performance in the crisis. We also examine whether effective corporate governance and risk management may result in a cost for firms in normal time by investing in less PRMBS and having a lower short-term profit before the crisis. Finally, we investigate whether the PRMBS investment has a spillover effect in the product market competition. We expect that firms with substantial PRMBS exposure (and losses) lose market shares through a lower underwriting capacity, tarnished reputation, and/ or the predatory behaviors by financially strong competitors. Our study contributes to the literature in several ways. First, unlike prior studies taking a black-box approach to FI risk-taking, we directly pinpoint PRMBS investments as a specific risk-taking mechanism. Second, it extends the inquiry on how corporate governance and risk management affect FIs’ risk-taking and performance into non-bank FIs. Third, it adds to the finance literature on the interaction between financial strength and product market competition. Our study has important policy implications and is of strong local relevance. 许多金融机构过度冒险并因此蒙受巨大的损失被认为是造成2007-2008年金融危机的重要原因。研究者一直关注这是否反映了金融机构在公司治理及风险管理方面的失败。现有的研究主要集中探讨银行业，并出现了不尽相同的结论。虽然许多人认为过度暴露于高风险的次级抵押贷款之中是金融机构冒险的一个重要方式，然而由于缺少合适的数据，支持这个结论的直接证据却非常地缺乏。我们的研究计划旨在利用那些有详细报告持有与交易私人住房按揭抵押证券(PRMBS)的保险公司的数据来研究公司治理与风险管理怎样影响金融机构对私人住房按揭抵押贷款的投资，以此来填补缺乏相关证据的空白。保险业是一个有趣而独特的研究场合是因为他们持有近三分之一的公司债券并大量投资于证券化的债券，而且他们也被认为是风险管理方面的专家。 具体来说，我们研究那些具有有效公司治理与风险管理的公司在危机前是否较少地参与私人住房按揭抵押贷款的投资，看在2006年底大量持有住房按揭抵押证券的公司在金融危机期间是否导致了更多的投资亏损以及更差的业绩表现。我们也研究住房按揭抵押证券投资对于产品市场竞争是否有一种溢出效应。我们预期那些较多持有住房按揭抵押证券（并且蒙受损失）的公司将因为较低的承保能力，受损的声誉，以及其他财力更加雄厚的竞争对手的掠夺行为而失去市场份额。 我们的研究对文献有几方面的贡献,其一,不同于之前的研究采用黑箱的方法研究金融机构的风险承担，我们表明投资于住房按揭抵押证券是一种冒险的方式。第二，它延伸了关于公司治理与风险管理是怎样影响金融机构风险承担与非银行金融机构业绩表现的研究。第三，我们的研究丰富了关于公司财务实力和产品市场竞争之间的相互作用的学文献。我们的研究具有重要的政策含义，对本地金融市场也有借鉴意义。

197213.label: Major findings and research outcome
197213.value: 1. Insurers with stronger risk management have lower asset-backed security (ABS) investment in the period leading up to the 2008 crisis, especially in life insurers that are not subject to mark-to-market accounting 2. Insurers with stronger risk management are less likely to hold ABS that bore high credit ratings before the crisis but subsequently experienced a large rating downgrade 3. The above effects are concentrated in property/casualty insurance companies that are governed by the mark-to-market reporting rule, but are absent in life insurance companies that are governed by the historical cost reporting rule 4. The results on corporate governance are mixed: firms invest less in ABS when the board of directors is more independents, or when firms have more female directors; firms invest more in ABS when there is high institutional ownership or a director has a banking background 5. Firms with a higher exposure to ABS suffer higher investment losses in the crisis 6. Firms with a substantial ABS exposure before the crisis exhibit a lower revenue growth in the crisis and depleted capital appears to be an underlying channel, but this negative relation is attenuated by strong risk management when financial regulation is mark-to-market reporting (note that the above not only has achieved the three originally set-out objectives, but also has gone beyond them by incorporating the analysis on the quality of ABS investment as proxied by rating downgrades. Please see below and Section C for more information)

197213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
197213.value: While we have retained the three research objectives set out at the onset of the project, we have followed the comments received and expanded the scope of the investigation by extending the analysis to the quality of ABS investment measured by subsequent rating changes in addition to the analysis of the level of ABS investment. As a result, the analysis is richer, deeper and more coherent. Going forward, we want to further refine the paper and submit it to a good finance journal for review.

197213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
197213.value: Excessive risk-taking and subsequent huge losses sustained by financial institutions (FIs) are an important reason for the 2008 financial crisis. Whether this reflects the failure of risk management is a subject of many academic studies and is of important policy implications. Existing research has focused on examining this issue in banks and produced mixed results on risk-taking via investment in assets backed Securities (ABS). Prior studies suffer from two limitations: a) banks’ investment in ABS is confounded by their loan securitization activities and so do not necessarily reflect active investment; b) there is no detailed data on banks’ ABS holdings. We fill this void by studying how risk management affect FIs’ investment in ABS using insurance companies that are the only type of FIs reporting detailed holding and transaction data on ABS and are among the largest groups of investors in ABS. Our analysis suggests that the efficacy of risk management in constraining risk-taking investment crucially hinges on financial regulation: risk management is only effective when financial reporting of investment is mark-to-market, and in that circumstance, risk management constrains risk-taking by shaping risk managers’ incentive to devotedly uncover risk and curb executives’ incentive to knowingly neglect identified risk.

198113.label: Project Title(Chinese)
198113.value: 中国公务员制度激励与改革之研究

198113.label: Project Objectives
198113.value: Build a database of China's senior officials' career paths and integrate it with the existing database of the county/city level officials' career paths.
rows: Build a database of China's senior officials' career paths and integrate it with the existing database of the county/city level officials' career paths.

198113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
198113.value: In this project, I propose to use a theoretical approach that is based on the recent development in the theory of incentives and mechanism design to formally examine the incentives of the government officials at various levels of the bureaucratic system. Assuming all economic agents pursue self-interests, I model explicitly both the officials' performance and rent-seeking behavior given the current tournament-like incentive scheme and ask, first, what is the best outcome under the tournament-type incentive scheme; and second, whether particular public sector reform proposals will improve upon that. A database of the career paths of China’s senior officials from 1990 to the present will be built. Predictions from the theory will be tested against the data. Finally, the model will enable the evaluations of some policy experiments currently conducted locally in China: relaxing the political tenure system and increasing open competition for government posts. Whether the observed outcomes from a local experiment can be generalized to the entire country requires a more theoretical approach to the problem. It is this gap that I intend to fill with this project. 此项研究将以经济学中的激励与机制设计为理论框架，探索中国的公务员制度对政府各级官员的激励效应。在假设所有官员最大化自身利益的前提下，我考虑现有体制下官员的寻租行为以及此行为的社会成本。此项研究致力于回答两个问题：在现有的制度框架下，什么样的奖惩办法从社会效率上看最优？目前正在讨论或局部试行的人事制度改革，如放松公务员终生制、引进公开招凭，能否达到提高效率的效率？我将把理论所预测的最优奖惩办法之下官员人事调动的模式与现有政府官员的升迁历史数据做对比，探索理论与现实之间的距离。

198113.label: Realisation of objectives
198113.value: I developed a model of China’s State Personnel Management System using the techniques from the theory of incentives and mechanism design. More specifically, I build on the seminal paper by Rosen (1986) and reinterpret his setting of a multi-stage sequential elimination contest as a tournament among Chinese bureaucrats for career advancement. I interpret the contestants as the bureaucrats, the stage of the contest as the rank of the position, the scale of prizes as the scale of salaries and the effort as the input to a production function that produces a local public good. In addition, my model adds three new features. First, I model the production of a public good at various bureaucratic ranks as a Leontief production technology in two inputs, effort and public fund entrusted to the incumbent bureaucrat. A bureaucrat who loses the promotion at his rank has the option to embezzle the public money that he has not used in the production. Second, I endow the bureaucrats with some private wealth at the beginning of their career. Along the way of promotion, they are able to exploit rents of their positions to grow their private wealth at an above-market rate. Third, due to the two aforementioned forms of corruption, I assume there is a corruption detection technology that with some probability each exiting (from the contest) bureaucrat would be subject to careful scrutiny and be punished had he been found to engage in either form of corruption during his career. The probability of detection is a policy variable that a social planner can set without cost and is interpreted as the magnitude of anti-corruption campaign. I characterize the optimal incentive scheme in terms of the wage scale to support a given amount of public good output. I also given conditions under which a social planner (with a particular social welfare function) will favor allowing corruption in the equilibrium than cracking down on corruption, even if fighting corruption per se is costless. I built a database of the career paths of all Chinese bureaucrats of ministerial rank and above. I designed codes that capture full information of each post that the bureaucrats have held. For example, each post is coded to have six attributes: system, level, province, work, position, and leader. The variable “system” refers to if the post is within the Chinese Communist Party’s (CCP) committee, its disciplinary committee, the People’s Congress, the government, the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), the military, other parties, institutions, state-owned enterprises and the judiciary. The “level” varies from center, province, to county and township. The variable “work” indicates industries, ranging from foreign relation, national defense, economic development, science and technology, industrial policies, united front to auditing, propaganda, and party building. The “position” refers to the political rank of the office, from the state (i.e. the top rank) to deputy township and sub-division officer. Finally, the dummy variable “leader” is 1 if the post is a leading post. The distinction of leading and non-leading posts, according to the legal interpretation of Article XVI of the Law by the National People’s Congress (NPC), is such that the leading posts “have organizational, management, decision-making or commanding functions”, whereas the non-leading posts do not. I collected about 200 Chinese bureaucrats’ history of posts, together with their year of birth, month of birth, ethnicity, place of birth, whether having a cadre family background, year that he joined the CCP, year that he started working, education, alma mater, and major. These data are all collected from the public domain and they can be made available to the fellow researchers through the RGC. I summarized some stylized facts from the data. In particular, one can estimate from the data the life cycle profile of career advancement of these politicians. But one needs to be cautious in interpreting it as mobility, since our sample, as it is, is highly selective. We are already looking at the small set of the successful bureaucrats. To estimate mobility, we need more comprehensive data of lower ranked officials. I tried looking for opportunities of collaboration with colleagues who have more comprehensive data, but so far have not been able to establish a confirmed project. The model of incentive provision outlined in the first paragraph has predictions on the wage scale, which is unfortunately unobserved. I searched for information about pay scales among the civil servants in China and found very little information. I then turned to China Population and Employment Statistics Yearbooks to find the number of employees at various rank of the government, and I also found the province-level salary budget for the administrative staff and the retired staff. But this evidence is not systematic enough to be used to test against the model prediction. In the end, I have decided that the paper is written mainly as a theory paper, providing a new perspective on the broad-brush picture of development. Finally, I gave several policy related discussion in the paper. I asked the question how the timing of the anti-corruption campaign is related to the parameters of the economic development. My model predicts that as bureaucrats get richer, the social planner would first choose a high anti-corruption stance (thinking China before the 80s), then gradually become more tolerant during the development process to leverage on the bureaucrats’ own vested interest to align their incentives. On the other hand, as the government function evolves and the rent-seeking opportunities shrink, the social planner would choose to crack down on corruption, as what the recent administration has done. Hopefully, my theory provides a new way to understand the function of corruption during the development process that is based on incentive provision.

198113.label: Major findings and research outcome
198113.value: The main research outcome is an academic paper entitled "A Model of Tournament Incentives and Corruption", coauthored with Bin Wang, a former PhD student who I hired as an RA for this project. The paper was presented in the First World Congress of Comparative Economics, the Levine-Mattozzi Group at the European University Institute. It is currently under review at the RAND Journal of Economics. In this paper, we develop a tractable tournament model that incorporates corruption to study the incentive provision to Chinese bureaucrats in a regionally decentralized authoritarian regime. We have two main findings. One, consistent with anecdotal evidence, the equilibrium wage schedule can appear low-powered when corruption income serves as an implicit reward. This stands in contrast to the prediction of the classical tournament model. Two, in an economy where resource is allocated by wealthy bureaucrats, a social planner optimally tolerates corruption to economize on the cost of incentives. As China moves towards a market-oriented economy, cracking down on corruption is a timely policy move.

198113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
198113.value: One can enrich the model along different dimensions. One direction is to explore the potential of collusion at various levels of government between the bureaucrats and their monitors. Another direction is to introduce risk and policy experimentation as choices of politicians and study the relationships between growth-enhancing policies, risks and political incentives.

198113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
198113.value: In this project, I ask the question what motivates the Chinese bureaucrats at various levels of the government to exert effort to remote economic growth. It is widely recognized that the Chinese politico-economic institution is characterized by a regionally decentralized authoritarian regime (Xu, 2011), in which bureaucrats compete against each other for promotion by fostering local economic growth. According to this argument, the labor contract of the Chinese bureaucrats resembles a tournament labor contract (Lazear and Rosen, 1981). The optimality of the tournament labor contract depends on the pay being convex in the rank of the position. However, anecdotal evidence suggests that the pay scale of the Chinese bureaucrats appears to be weak-powered. I propose a reconciliation of the seemingly weak-powered incentive with the effectiveness of the tournament labor contract by allowing for corruption. The ultimate prize of rising to the top the tournament is the security with which one can keep his corruption income accumulated along the way. In other words, in such a personnel management structure, corruption can serve an incentive purpose. The social planner, under certain circumstances, may even choose to tolerate some positive level of corruption to economize on the cost of incentive provision.

198213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
198213.value: The terrorist attack of 9/11, the Southeast Asian tsunami, and the earthquake in Sichuan and Japan are but a few prominent examples of exogenous shocks—sudden changes induced by external factors outside of any business firm’s control. Given the high frequency and accompanying significant impact (e.g., Toyota’s overnight loss of more than 70% of its sales pursuant to the recent earthquake in Japan) however, it is surprising to see that marketing research on exogenous shocks is still in its infancy. Few insights have been provided regarding the impact of, and firms’ response strategies to, exogenous shocks. This project seeks to help fill this gap. Specifically, this project revolves around the role of marketing assets (e.g., brand equity and customer equity) and marketing actions (e.g., advertising, promotional activities) in helping firms handle exogenous shocks. Integrating insights from studies of regional economic development, the resource-based view, and the marketing-finance interface, I develop a conceptual framework linking the occurrence of shocks and firms’ responses to their subsequent short- and long-term financial consequences. I expect the proximity to the shock to have significant impact on the short-term financial performance of a firm; however, this relationship is moderated by ex ante marketing assets the firm possesses. Short-term financial consequences, together with other firm-specific characteristics, determine a firm’s relative reliance on marketing actions in its strategic responses to the shock, in turn leading to differential long-term financial performance. I will then test the hypothesized linkages within the context of the terrorist attack against the United States on September 11, 2001, and its repercussions for the global airline industry. This context is chosen because 9/11 represents a prototypical exogenous shock that was beyond a firm’s control and significantly affected airline business across the globe. Due to its widespread impact, airline firms in different regions rely on a broad array of marketing and non-marketing actions to gain and maintain competitive advantages. The findings of this project will inform researchers and business practitioners about the role of marketing assets and marketing actions in helping firms respond to exogenous shocks and meaningfully advance the research on “shock management” in the marketing field. 外在突发性事件在本项目中被定义为由于那些不可被公司控制的因素引起的突然性的变化。近年来比较引人关注的例子包括美国9•11恐怖袭击，东南亚海啸，还有发生在四川和日本的大地震等等。这些突发性事件发生频率并不低，并且会给公司带来巨大的影响（比如说日本丰田公司在2011年3月的大地震后销售额短期急剧下降70%）。但我们很意外的看到，在市场营销领域，关于外在突发性事件对公司的影响以及公司的营销策略应对方面的研究还尚处于萌芽阶段。本项目正是试图要填补这项空白。 具体来讲，本项目的中心是研究营销资产（比如品牌资产和顾客资产）及营销行为（比如广告和其他促销行为）在帮助公司应对外在突发性事件中的作用。我在综合了区域发展理论，资源基础理论，以及营销-财务绩效关系等相关文献的基础上，建立了研究外在突发性事件和公司对由此带来的短期和长期影响的应对策略关系的理论框架。我认为公司与事件发生的接近度会对公司的短期财务绩效发生直接而显著的影响；但是，品牌资产会对这一关系产生调节作用。短期财务表现，和其它公司自身的特点一起，会决定一个公司在应对外在突发性事件中对营销战略的依赖度，而这一点又会影响公司的长期财务表现。 接下来我会用美国9•11恐怖袭击这一事件和它对整个航空业的冲击作为一个具体的例子来测试我的理论。我选择这一具体情境的原因是因为9•11事件是外在突发性事件的一个比较典型的代表，而且它的发生对整个航空业的冲击是不言而喻的。因为它的影响之重大，不同地区的航空业为保存及扩大自己的竞争优势采取了一系列以营销和非营销策略为基础的应对。这个项目的结论会帮助营销学者和实践者更好的认识品牌资产和品牌行为在公司应对外在突发事件中的作用。同时，我也希望，这个研究能够促进在市场营销领域“突发性事件研究”的整体发展。

198313.label: Major findings and research outcome
198313.value: Using both lab and online experiments, we find that: 1) When compared with non-creative consumers, creative consumers will have a faster satiation rate, 2) The effect of creativity on satiation is mediated by approach variety, 3) The effect of creativity on satiation is moderated by the extent to which the creative mindset is constrained, and 4) The effect of creativity on satiation is moderated by the cognitive-affective focus, such that creativity leads to a faster satiation rate for when consumers are cognitively focused than when they are affectively focused.

198313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
198313.value: Our research sheds light on several interesting future research directions. First, it would be interesting to examine different types of consumer products and whether the proposed effects still hold across product types. In addition, future research could further explore the potential moderators (e.g., cognitive load) on the effect of creativity on satiation rate. Next, future research could examine different types of creativity--such as situational-primed creativity versus chronic creativity--and whether, how, and why they might affect satiation rate.

198313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
198313.value: Existing research in satiation has mainly focused on how to reduce satiation while little attention has been paid to the positive mechanisms of satiation. Therefore, the purpose of this research is to explore effective ways to elevate the satiation rate. In this research, we examine the therapeutic effects of consumer creativity on satiation. In particular, we predict that creativity can elicit a divergent mindset that enables consumers to come up with novel ideas for consumption tasks. As a result, this type of divergent thinking may increase the heterogeneity of a consideration choice set, which will, in turn, accelerate the satiation rate. This research provides important insights for marketing managers, governmental organizations, and regulatory agencies.

198713.value: 嫌疑人的攻击性行为和警察的不礼貌行为:一个多层次的研究

198713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
198713.value: Workplace aggression has attracted considerable attention from organizational researchers (Glomb & Liao, 2003; Hershcovis & Barling, 2010; Hershcovis, Turner, Barling, Arnold, Dupre, Inness, LeBlanc, & Sivanatham, 2007). While prior research predominantly focused on aggression within the organizational boundary (e.g., between supervisor and subordinates), recently, researchers found that employees can also experience aggression from outsiders of their organization (e.g., customers) (e.g., Wang, Liao, Zhan, & Shi, 2011; Grandey, Dickter, & Sin, 2004). While our knowledge regarding how the aggressive behaviors from outsiders (e.g., customers) of the organization can influence employees’ behaviors is accumulating, the workplace aggression literature is still limited in that customers are only a subgroup of outsiders with whom employees are interacting. Police officers, for instance, interact with suspects as part of their job on a daily basis (Moston, Stephenson, & Williamson, 1992; Williamson, 1993). We argue that the nature of the interpersonal interaction between police officers and suspects differs substantially from that of the social interaction between employees and customers. Thus, examining the interaction between police officers and suspects can offer new insights in workplace aggression research. In our proposed research, we plan to explore (a) how police officers react to the aggressive behaviors from suspects and (b) the boundary conditions of the effect of suspect aggression on police officers’ reaction. Through the integration of conservation of resources with social learning theories, we developed a novel and multilevel theoretical model to address our research questions. Taking a more fine-grained approach to tie prediction and operationalization closely with theory, we propose to conduct series of field studies to explore the police-suspect interactions (using event-level observations). Our research contributes to the workplace aggression literature in the following ways. First, using conservation of resources theory, we proposed the spillover effect of workplace aggression on employee reactions which goes beyond what traditional social exchange theory can explain. Second, our research reveals that leader-member exchange, which has been considered as a desirable outcome resulting from supervisor-subordinate interactions, might potentially exacerbate employees’ dysfunctional reactions to workplace aggression. Third, our research examines workplace aggression and employee reactions at the event-level of analysis which helps make better causal inference in the aggression-reactions linkage. Last, our research not only sheds light on the general workplace aggression literature but also extends the aggression literature to a unique organizational context (i.e., police departments).

198813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
198813.value: Data on different entities (e.g. companies, countries or individuals) collected at a single time period are called cross-sectional data. Cross-sectional data can be used to study relationships among economic variables by studying differences across entities at a single period in time. It is useful to model cross-sectional observations as realizations of independent, identically distributed random variables. This assumption is satisfied if the entities are sampled by simple random sampling. A useful class of models for describing cross-sectional data is provided by linear regressions. In contrast to cross-sectional data, time series data are data for a single entity collected over a period of time (e.g. unemployment measures or exchange rates). Time series data can be used to study the evolution of economic variables over time and to forecast future values of those variables. It is useful to model an observed time series as a realization of a random process. More specifically, to allow for the unpredictable nature of future observations it is assumed that each observation is a realized value of a random variable. A useful class of models for describing the dynamics of a time series is provided by autoregressive (AR) processes. In practice, the parameters of an economic model are unknown and need to be estimated using actual data. The linear regression and AR models described herein are usually estimated by the method of ordinary least squares (OLS). In regression analysis, it is well known that the OLS estimator is inconsistent (may not be close to the true parameter values with high probability even when the data set is very large) for the regression parameters when the error term is correlated (linearly associated) with the explanatory variables in the regression. Similarly, in time series analysis, it is known that the OLS estimator is inconsistent for the AR parameters in an AR process with serially correlated errors. Under certain restrictions, a promising alternative to OLS is linear programming (LP) based estimators. Recent research show that these estimators can be superconsistent in the above mentioned situations and, hence, preferable to OLS. This project has two parts which relate to LP-based estimators and their applications in economics and finance. The first part concerns estimation and inference in a class of restricted linear regression models. The second part involves estimation and inference in a, for economics, recently introduced class of restricted nonlinear time series models.

198813.label: Realisation of objectives
198813.value: While the overall research objectives of the project have been achieved, objectives 1 and 2 are not yet fully realised (about 90% and 75% realised, respectively). More specifically, the part(s) to give conditions under which limiting distributional results can be obtained. While limiting (and also finite-sample) distributional results have been obtained for some important special cases, more general results are still work in progress. The main reason for this is unforeseen technical difficulties due to the generality of our assumptions (cf. Preve, 2015). It is important to recognise that the scope of the project is rather large as it not only covers investigating the robustness properties of linear programming-based estimators to different types of model misspecification (omitted variables, measurement errors, heavy-tailed variables, etc.) in both regression analysis and time series analysis, but also empirical applications of the theoretical findings. This research has already resulted in one publication in a major journal and preliminary but incomplete research is likely to generate at least one more published paper. For this reason, a grant period of two years (as initially proposed by the PI) would have been ideal.

198813.label: Major findings and research outcome
198813.value: Paper I: This paper studies robust estimation of the autoregressive (AR) parameter in a nonlinear, nonnegative AR model driven by nonnegative errors. It is shown that a linear programming estimator (LPE), considered by Nielsen and Shephard (2003) among others, remains consistent under severe model misspecification. Consequently, the LPE can be used to test for, and seek sources of, misspecification when a pure autoregression cannot satisfactorily describe the data generating process, and to isolate certain trend, seasonal or cyclical components. Simple and quite general conditions under which the LPE is strongly consistent in the presence of serially dependent, non-identically distributed or otherwise misspecified errors are given, and a brief review of the literature on LP-based estimators in nonnegative autoregression is presented. Finite-sample properties of the LPE are investigated in an extensive simulation study covering a wide range of model misspecifications. A small scale empirical study, employing a volatility proxy to model and forecast latent daily return volatility of three major stock market indexes, illustrates the potential usefulness of the LPE. Paper II: Recently there has been an increasing interest in models for nonnegative data. The purpose of this paper is to propose two types of estimators, certain extreme value and linear programming estimators, that can maintain sound statistical properties when one or more of the explanatory variables of a multiple regression model is correlated with the regression error, without the use of any instruments. This robustness to endogeneity is possible provided that the explanatory variables and, in general, also the explained variable are nonnegative. We establish strong consistency, finite-sample and asymptotic distributional results general enough to allow for both cross-sectional and time series regressions. Finite-sample properties of the proposed estimators are investigated in an extensive simulation study, and empirical examples from economics and finance illustrate their practical usefulness.

198813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
198813.value: Several extensions appear to be possible: First, to establish robustness results for some popular univariate nonlinear nonnegative time series models not covered by the established results. Second, to generalise our robustness results for univariate nonnegative autoregressions to multivariate nonnegative autoregressions. Third, in the context of multiple regression, to allow for time series regressors. These extensions are work in progress.

199013.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
199013.value: At a time of constant changes in technologies and consumer tastes, corporate growth opportunities, innovations for instance, tend to arise more or less independent of the firm's extant operations and have a good chance of becoming obsolete in the near future. We propose a model that incorporates these realistic features of growth opportunities which also generalize the assumptions about growth opportunities in traditional models, and analyze the firm's optimal investment and financing policies in this more general and realistic setting. Unlike a typical firm in the prior literature which can time the exercise of a growth option with ample freedom and therefore only invests in a growth opportunity when its profitability is sufficiently high, the firm facing innovative growth opportunities may be more constrained in timing the investment. Uncertain about when a growth opportunity will arrive and unwilling to lose it to obsolescence after its arrival, the firm may choose to exercise a growth option as long as there is modest profitability. This more aggressive investment policy implies that financing the investment with debt can be costly. Thus, the firm may want to use equity to finance the investment upfront and wait until its profitability is sufficiently high to restructure its capital with more debt, giving rise to a timing inconsistency between investment and debt financing. This timing inconsistency can offer new explanations to a number of empirical findings, such as firms’ tendency to finance growth opportunities with equity, especially among small and growth firms; leverage increases without capital expenditures; more pronounced stock underperformance after equity offerings than debt offerings; and prolonged debt conservatism. Importantly, the timing inconsistency is an endogenous choice of the firm based on general and realistic assumptions about innovative growth opportunities, and is not observed in traditional models where the firm is bound to have enough debt capacity to finance investment given that growth options are not subject to obsolescence and therefore are always exercised deep in the money. 在科技和消费者的喜好不断改变的时候，企业的发展机会，例如创新，往往会或多或少的独立于企业现存的运营，而且在不久后很有可能过时被淘汰。我们提出了一个模型，它包含了这些发展机会的现实特征，并且在更加普遍和现实的背景下分析了企业的最优投资、融资策略。 在已有文献中，典型的企业有足够的自由来安排增长期权的执行时间，并因此能够只投资于高利润的增长机会。与此不同的是，面对创新增长机会的企业在投资的实际掌握上受到更多限制。由于发展机会出现时机的不确定性，以及不愿意因为过时报废而错过机会，企业会在适度的盈利范围内执行一个增长期权。这个更激进的投资策略意味着利用债券融资是昂贵的。因此，企业可能会在一开始使用股权来融资。在企业有足够的盈利能力后重组资本结构，使其含有更多债务。这一点导致投资与债券融资在时间上的不一致。 这个时间上的不一致性能够解释很多实证结果，包括小型和增长型企业利用股权为增长机会融资；在没有资本支出时资金杠杆上升；发行股票比发行债券带来更明显的股价走低；以及长期的债务保守主义。重要的是，这一时间上的不一致性是在对创新机会更加宽泛及现实的假设下由企业做出的内源性选择。传统的模型并未观察到此不一致性。因为在传统模型中，考虑到增长期权并不受制于过时报废并因此总是能在深度实值时执行，企业总是拥有足够的借债能力来融资以进行投资。

199013.label: Realisation of objectives
199013.value: We successfully realized the objectives of this project. Our model features a randomly arriving growth opportunity with a probability to dissipate due to technology obsolescence or competition. This type of growth opportunities are more representative of the technology evolution process in the real world. Based on the model, we examine the optimal financing and investment behavior of a firm. We find interesting patterns of firm financing and investment policies that match a number of stylized facts in the corporate finance literature. Our model thus offers a number of explanations for these stylized facts based on realistic assumptions of technology advancement. Our paper thus establish important links between technology evolution with corporate finance and investment policies.

199013.label: Major findings and research outcome
199013.value: Under our model of randomly arriving and dissipating growth opportunities, we find that the firm will typically finance the exercise of the growth option with equity and may wait years before recapitalizing to a higher debt level. The lack of coordination between the timing of investment and debt financing helps explain a number of findings in the empirical literature, including violation of the financing pecking order, debt conservatism, apparent market timing of security issues, and more pronounced underperformance following equity issues than debt issues.

199013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
199013.value: The model may be further extended to include multiple growth opportunities and/or multiple restructuring options. However, a more complicated model could also blur important intuitions and mechanisms. We are comfortable with the current model but we stand ready for any challenges from our future referees.

199013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
199013.value: We use more realistic assumptions of growth opportunities and find optimal corporate financing and investment policies under these assumptions matching a number of stylized facts. Thus, we are able to explain some puzzling corporate financing and investment behaviors based on the randomness of technology innovation and obsolescence in the real world.

199113.label: Project Objectives
199113.value: To examine the SEC comment letter process in the IPO setting where all registrants are switching from private to public and thus have greater information asymmetry and incentives to hype their stocks. To explore how the offering price and proceeds change in response to the SEC comment letters in the IPO process. To develop a difference in differences research design to control for any unobservable characteristics of IPO issuers that remain constant over time, which helps to address the endogeneity problem in directly conducting the cross-sectional test of the association between the SEC comment letters and IPO under pricing. To provide evidence on whether SEC comment letters help to make sure that firms do not hype their stocks and reduce information asymmetry. To help the financial statement users and preparers to better understand the regulator’s oversight role in improving companies’ disclosures.

199113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
199113.value: This project intends to investigate how regulator’s oversight affects company’s information environment. I intend to provide evidence on the oversight role of the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) by looking at the effects of comment letters issued by the SEC in the process through which companies initially become public. The SEC exert their oversight role by issuing comment letters to the companies which they think need further improvement or clarifications. SEC comment letters (CLs) indicate the communication between SEC staff and registrants in the review process of required filings. The SEC provides filers with comments on their filings where they think that the filing could be further clarified or improved. The SEC’s objective is to make sure investors are provided with material information in order to make informed decisions – both when a company initially goes public and on a regular basis as it continues to release information to the general market. Therefore, the SEC is commenting on both quality and compliance of the disclosures. To sum up, SEC comment letters are intended to reduce information asymmetry and to make sure that firms do not hype their stocks. In the IPO setting, information asymmetry is very high because the IPO firms are fairly new. Additionally, the issuers tend to draw a too rosy picture of their stocks to get more proceeds when issuing IPOs. Given that information asymmetry and management hyping incentives are much greater in the IPO setting, it is advantageous to look at the role of SEC comment letters through looking at the IPO setting. I intend to examine whether SEC comment letters help to decrease information asymmetry and prevent the issuers from hyping their stocks. In order to test this, I intend to look at the revisions of offering price and proceeds after companies receive SEC comment letters in their IPO process. If issuers revise their offering price and proceeds upward more after the issuance of the SEC comment letters compared with before the issuance of the SEC comment letters, it is consistent with the assumption that the SEC helps to decrease information asymmetry. Comparatively, if issuers revise their offering price and proceeds downward more after the issuance of the SEC comment letters compared with before the issuance of the SEC comment letters, it indicates that the SEC exert their monitoring role by preventing the managers from hyping their stocks. 本研究旨在調查政策製定者的監督職能如何影響公司的信息環境。通過研究美國證券交易委員會（SEC）在公司首次公開招股（IPO）過程中所發出意見函之影響，本研究提供了關於SEC監督職能之證據。SEC向被認爲需要進一步改善之公司發出意見函，以發揮其監督作用。意見函爲SEC職員與註冊公司在所需文件審核過程中的溝通。SEC向註冊公司提出有關文件之改善意見。SEC的目標為，確保投資者在公司首次公開招股及其向市場持續公佈訊息的過程中獲得重要訊息以做出投資決策。因此，SEC會對披露的合法性及質素進行評論。總而言之，SEC意見函旨在減少資訊不對稱情況及防止公司炒作其股票。 新上市公司在IPO定價時衍生出高度的資訊不對稱。同時，發行人傾向于在IPO時描繪過於美好的前景，以募集更多資金。考慮到上述資訊不對稱及管理層炒作誘因，觀察IPO定價有助於研究SEC意見函之作用。本研究將檢驗SEC意見函是否有助於減少資訊不對稱及防止發行人炒作自身股票。爲了檢驗此假設，本研究將觀察IPO過程中公司收到SEC意見函後對發行價格和募集資金總額做出的修訂。相比意見函發出前，如果發行價格在發出後被修訂為更高，就與SEC有助減少資訊不對稱情況之假設一致。相反，如果修訂為更低，就表明SEC通過防止管理層炒作股票來履行監督職能。

199113.label: Realisation of objectives
199113.value: I have achieved all the research objectives in a paper “The oversight role of regulators: evidence from SEC comment letters in the IPO process”, published in Review of Accounting Studies in 2017. The results on how offering proceeds change in response to the SEC comment letters in the IPO process are similar to the price change results reported in the published version of the paper, but we did not report them in the published version of the paper following the reviewer’s comments issued during the revision process at Review of Accounting Studies. Below I more clearly explain how my co-author and I achieved the project objectives in more details. We identify 659 IPOs with available price revision data from the Securities Data Summary (SDC) US New Issues database for the period May 12, 2005, to Dec. 31, 2011. We count the number of comment letters regarding IPO S-1 and SB-2 filings sent between the SEC and the IPO firms from the initial IPO filing date to the final issue date. Among the 659 IPOs, 473 received at least one comment letter, while 186 received none. The mean (median) number of letters sent between the SEC and the firms is 6.744 (7.000). In multivariate tests, we first examine the relation between unsigned change in IPO offer price and number of comment letters. The results show that IPOs with more are more likely to make price revisions. Separate analyses reveal that IPO firms are more likely to reduce their offer price, if they receive comment letters. Consistent with these findings, we find a significant negative relation between signed price change and comment letters, suggesting that IPO issuers tend to reduce price if they receive comment letters. We also adopt an alternative measure of number of comment letters. Following Dechow, Lawrence, and Ryans (2016) and Ryans (2014), we identify comment letters that attract more investor attention by counting letters accessed by investors using SEC EDGAR request data. Empirically, we find a significant association between number of accessed comment letters and unsigned (as well as signed) percentage change in price. One might argue that IPOs that receive comment letters happen to be the ones that tend to reduce their price due to unobservable firm characteristics. We address this concern using a difference-in-differences (DID) research design. Results from the DID tests confirm our findings on the negative relation between comment letters and price revision. We provide additional evidence that comment letters constrain IPO firms’ stock hyping by identifying IPOs with greater hyping incentives and testing whether the comment letter effect is more intense for them. Specifically, we follow Lang and Lundholm (2000) to measure IPO hyping incentives using change in IPO firm disclosure frequency between six months prior to the announcement of the offering and the preceding six months. We find that SEC comment letters have a more pronounced effect in decreasing IPO offer price for issuers with greater hyping incentives, which corroborates our main conclusion. To illuminate how effective SEC oversight is at constraining manipulation of IPO offerings by issuers, we examine IPO long-run performance following the IPO issue date. If the SEC mitigates IPO hyping through the comment letters, we expect that overvaluation at the issue date for IPOs with more letters should be similar to IPOs with fewer. Empirically we find that IPOs with more comment letters actually outperform those with fewer in the long run, suggesting the SEC monitoring mitigates hyping. However, the outperformance of IPOs with more comment letters implies that the SEC monitoring may overcompensate for hyping. For example, the SEC may require excessively pessimistic disclosures. Or the SEC may have failed to comment on relevant issues for firms without comment letters.

199113.label: Major findings and research outcome
199113.value: This study investigates how regulatory oversight affects the price formation of initial public offerings (IPOs). We provide evidence on the oversight role of the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) by examining the effects of comment letters issued by the SEC in the process through which companies are initially listed. We find that IPO issuers reduce their offer price if they receive comment letters. The reduction in price from the IPO filing date to the final issue date is greater when the IPO firm has more correspondence with the SEC. The pricing impact of SEC comment letters is more pronounced for IPO issuers with greater hyping incentives. Moreover, we find that IPO firms that receive more comment letters have similar levels of underpricing and outperform over the long run after the issue date, compared with IPOs with fewer comment letters.

199113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
199113.value: The comment letter data investigated in this project could be used for other future potential projects examining the SEC's oversigt role.

199113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
199113.value: By taking advantage of the IPO setting, we investigate the monitoring role of the SEC during IPO price formation. This study indicates that the SEC mitigates IPO hyping. In particular, we examine how comment letters affect the change in proposed offer price during the IPO waiting period. We find that IPO issuers reduce their offering price if they receive comment letters. The reduction in price from the IPO filing date to the final issue date is greater when the IPO firm has more comment letter correspondence with the SEC. The pricing impact of the letters is more salient for IPO issuers with greater hyping incentives. Moreover, we find that IPO firms that receive more letters have similar levels of underpricing and outperform over the long run after the issue date, compared with IPOs with fewer letters. In summary, the evidence suggests that there is an improvement in IPO firms’ information environments after they respond to comment letters.

199213.label: Project Title(Chinese)
199213.value: 领导倦怠的結果﹕不当督导，自我监控，下属异常行为

199213.label: Project Objectives
199213.value: To investigate how supervisor emotional exhaustion is associated with abusive supervisory behavior, which affects subordinates’ deviance and performance. To test whether the effect of emotional exhaustion on abusive supervision is weaker when supervisors have higher levels of self-monitoring. To examine how supervisor self-monitoring regulates the indirect effect of supervisor emotional exhaustion on subordinates’ work-related behavior through abusive supervision.
rows: To investigate how supervisor emotional exhaustion is associated with abusive supervisory behavior, which affects subordinates’ deviance and performance.
To test whether the effect of emotional exhaustion on abusive supervision is weaker when supervisors have higher levels of self-monitoring.
To examine how supervisor self-monitoring regulates the indirect effect of supervisor emotional exhaustion on subordinates’ work-related behavior through abusive supervision.

199213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
199213.value: Emotional exhaustion, the core of burnout syndrome, reflects feelings of being overextended and depleted of one’s emotional and physical resources, and has an adverse impact on employees’ work attitude and behavior (Maslach, Schaufeli, & Leiter, 2001). Research has rarely focused on the effect of emotional exhaustion on supervisors who hold formal leadership positions in organizations (Knudsen, Ducharme, Roman, 2009). Very little is known about: (1) how supervisors react to exhaustion in their leadership toward subordinates; and (2) how subordinates react to exhausted supervisors. This research gap is surprising because emotional exhaustion is particularly salient in jobs that involve “people work” (Gardner, Fischer, & Hunt, 2009, p. 474) and impose substantial emotional demands—characteristic features of leadership positions (Maslach et al., 2001). Supervisors strongly influence subordinate performance and well-being, and shape organizational outcomes (e.g., Bass, 1985), thus it is critical to understand the role of emotional exhaustion in the leadership domain. Emotional exhaustion entails a reduced capacity for self-regulation (Baumeister, Muraven, & Tice, 2000). Such deprivation of self-regulatory resources is among the most proximal causes of hostile and aggressive behavior, preventing supervisors from effectively restraining abusive tendencies (DeWall, Baumeister, Stillman, & Gailliot, 2007). Based on insights from ego-depletion theories (Baumeister, 1998), we suggest that emotionally exhausted supervisors are more likely to abuse their subordinates only when they have low levels of self-monitoring. Moreover, a substantial body of work suggests that abusive supervision leads to subordinate deviance (e.g., Tepper, 2000). Our own studies (Xu, Huang, Lam, Miao, 2012; Walter, Lam, Van der Vegt, Huang, Miao, 2011) suggest that abusive supervision decreases subordinates’ subjective and objective work performance. Building on these studies, we propose a novel, multilevel model that posits: (1) supervisors’ emotional exhaustion may influence their abusive behavior; (2) subordinates may respond to their abusive supervisors by increasing deviance and decreasing performance; and (3) supervisors’ self-monitoring may function as a cross-level moderator, influencing the indirect effects of supervisor emotional exhaustion on subordinate work behavior through abusive supervision. We will examine these issues through a series of multimethod studies, combining laboratory experiments, longitudinal field surveys, and field-experiments. The project highlights the importance of supervisor emotional exhaustion on the leadership process, thereby aiding organizations’ efforts to confine the negative consequences of supervisor exhaustion and prevent them from cascading through the hierarchy and affecting organizations’ bottom lines. 领导倦怠的結果﹕不当督导，自我监控，下属异常行为 情绪耗竭—工作倦怠的核心症状，反映了一个人的情绪以及体力资源透支和耗尽的感受，并会对员工的工作态度及行为产生负面的影响(Maslach, Schaufeli, & Leiter, 2001)。过往的研究极少着眼于在企业中有正式领导地位的主管们的情绪耗竭(Knudsen, Ducharme, Roman, 2009)。我们对于（1）主管对于他们领导下属的耗竭如何做出反应；及（2）下属对于耗竭的主管如何做出反应所知甚少。这个研究空白让人惊讶，因为情绪耗竭的问题在含有“人力资源”及情绪要求的工种里尤其突出 (Gardner, Fischer, & Hunt, 2009, p. 474)，這都是领导岗位的典型特征(Maslach et al., 2001)。主管们会很大程度地影响下属的工作绩效及健康，并且能牵动企业的绩效表现(e.g., Bass, 1985)，所以理解情绪耗竭在领导才能邻域的作用是至关重要的。 情绪耗竭意味着自我调节能力的降低 (Baumeister, Muraven, & Tice, 2000)。这样的自我调节资源的缺乏是导致敌对的、好争斗的行为最直接的原因之一，并使得主管不能有效抑制不当行为倾向(DeWall, Baumeister, Stillman, & Gailliot, 2007)。根据对自我消逝(ego-depletion)理论(Baumeister, 1998) 的理解，我们提出只有在情绪耗竭的主管处于自我监控最低水平的时候，他们最有可能不当地(例如﹕謾罵、侮辱等)对待下属。此外，很多的过往研究指出不当督导会导致下属异常行为(e.g., Tepper, 2000)。我们自己的一系列研究(Xu, Huang, Lam, Miao, 2012; Walter, Lam, Van der Vegt, Huang, Miao, 2011)也显示出不当领导会降低下属的主观与客观工作绩效。在这些研究的基础上，我们提出一个全新的，多层次的研究模型，假设(1)主管的情绪耗竭会导致他们的不当领导行为；(2)下属会对这种不当领导行为做出异常行为及降低工作绩效的反应；(3) 主管的自我监控会是一个跨层次的调节变量，影响主管情绪耗竭通过不当督导最终导致下属相应的工作行为的非直接作用。 我们会通过一系列的多种研究方法，结合实验室实验，实地纵向问卷调查研究，以及企业现场实验来检验这些问题。这个研究项目强调了主管的情绪耗竭对于领导过程的重要性，因此能帮助企业将主管情绪耗竭的负面影响降低，并能有效防止这些情绪耗竭通过等级传递到企业的基层。

199213.label: Realisation of objectives
199213.value: Across three studies, we investigated how supervisor emotional exhaustion may influence their abusive supervisory behavior and how such supervisory behavior may mediate the relationship between supervisor emotional exhaustion and employee behavior. These investigations have satisfied both objectives 1 and 3. In addition, we further examined how the linkage of supervisor emotional exhaustion and his/her abusive behavior is moderated by other contingent factors (e.g., self-monitoring and subordinate performance). These investigations have satisfied objectives 2 and 3.
