469113.label: Major findings and research outcome
469113.value: Of the 600 study participants undergoing cardiac surgery, 83 (14%, 95% CI: 11% to 17%) experienced delirium in the intensive care unit (Lee 2017a, Lee 2017b). When classified into the different motor subtypes of delirium, the incidences of hyperactive (4%, 95% CI: 3% to 6%), hypoactive (4%, 95% CIL 3% to 6%) and mixed delirium (6%, 95% CI: 4% to 8%) were low (Lee 2017b). The proportion of motor subtypes of delirium (24 hyperactive, 26 hypoactive and 33 mixed) were relatively similar (29%, 31% and 40% respectively). After performing a logistic calibration of the externally validated and recalibrated PRE-DELIRIC model in six countries, there was acceptable moderate discrimination (AUROC 0.75, 95% CI: 0.72 to 0.79) and good calibration (P=0.99) properties with no significant over- or under-prediction intervals in the calibration belt (Lee et al. 2017a). In contrast, the Katznelson model had lower (fair) discrimination (AUROC 0.62, 95% CI: 0.58 to 0.66) but acceptable calibration (P=0.04) with no significant over- or under-prediction intervals in the calibration belt (Lee et al. 2017a). Decision curve analysis showed that the clinical usefulness of both models appeared limited in the clinical setting (Lee et al. 2017a). At a threshold probability of 10% and 20%, the net consequence of using the PREDELIRIC and Katznelson models were equivalent of a strategy that found 30 to 67 per 1000 patients and 4 to 47 per 1000 patients respectively, for prophylactic pharmacological intervention without over-treating compared with doing nothing. Therefore, we concluded that current models only predict the risk of ICU delirium with only fair to moderate accuracy that cannot be recommended for routine clinical use. We used fast-track failure (FTF) as a composite outcome of prolonged stay in ICU more than 48 hours, ICU readmission and 30-day mortality after cardiac surgery. It occurred in 88 (14.7%) patients (Lee 2017a, Lee 2017b). We found an association between delirium (all subtypes) and FTF (P = .048). Compared to patients without delirium, the risk of FTF was similar amongst the different motor subtypes; hyperactive delirium (RR 1.95; 95% CI, 0.96 to 3.94), hypoactive delirium (RR 2.79; 95% CI, 1.34 to 5.84) and mixed delirium (RR 2.55; 95% CI, 1.11 to 5.88) using a generalized estimating equation [Lee 2017b]. We concluded that differentiation of motor subtypes was unlikely to be clinically important for prognostication of FTF. As delirium is associated with poor outcomes, potential treatment strategies should address all subtypes equally [Lee et al. 2017b].

469113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
469113.value: We plan to conduct a long-term follow-up of the cohort of 600 patients up to 5 years to collect data on their mortality. The aim of the study is to determine the excess mortality associated with different motor subtype of delirium. Excess mortality is the difference between observed (all-cause) and expected mortality (from a comparable group from the Hong Kong general population). We will adjust for potential risk factors of observed and relative mortality using appropriate multivariate survival modelling. The study will identify which (if any) particular subtype delirium has the worse long-term prognosis.

469113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
469113.value: Delirium is a state of confusion in which the patient experiences incoherent thoughts and speech and, in extreme cases, can result in hallucinations. The syndrome can be further subdivided into “hypoactive”, “hyperactive” and “mixed” motor subtypes of delirium. This study estimated how common delirium occurred in an intensive care unit (ICU) after heart surgery. Many models were available to predict the risk of delirium but few had been compared directly with one another or been tested in an independent data set. How delirium affected one’s risk of fast-track failure (a composite outcome of prolonged stay in the ICU for more than 48 hours, readmission to ICU, and 30-day mortality) was also unclear. In a cohort of 600 adults undergoing cardiac surgery, one in seven patients experienced ICU delirium. Both recalibrated PRE-DELIRIC and Katznelson models for predicting the risk of ICU delirium had only fair to moderate accuracy, which was not good enough for recommending their use every day in the clinical setting. Patients with ICU delirium (irrespective of the motor subtype of delirium) were two to three times more likely to experience fast-track failure. Both drug and non-drug treatment strategies should address all motor subtypes of delirium equally.

469313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
469313.value: 腦和生殖器官表達基因（BRE）編碼了一個44kD的蛋白，這一蛋白通過調節蛋白的泛素化過程（ubiquitination），對DNA損傷修復和細胞存活具有重要的作用。BRE通過與不同的蛋白結合，形成多種不同的蛋白複合體，例如：BRISC, BRCA1-A 和 DISC蛋白複合體等。因此，BRE是一個具有多種功能的蛋白。我們以及其他的研究團隊已經證明BRE與多種類型的腫瘤的發生有關，如食管癌、肝細胞肝癌、肺癌、白血病以及卵巢腫瘤。在本研究計劃中，我們將集中研究BRE在小鼠胚胎發育和性腺發育中的重要作用。我們將採用Cre/lox技術敲除小鼠BRE基因的外顯子3，因為這一外顯子在5種BRE蛋白亞型中均有表達。我們將構建兩種BRE基因敲除小鼠，一種是他莫昔芬引導的BRE基因敲除小鼠(BREflox/floxRosaCre/+)，另外一種是生殖細胞特異性BRE基因敲除小鼠(BREflox/floxTNAPCre/+)。當雌性BRE flox/floxRosa+/+小鼠成功與雄性BREflox/floxRosaCre/+小鼠交配後，在胚胎發育至第5.5日（E5.5）時，我們將對懷孕小鼠進行他莫昔芬腹腔內注射，從而得到處於E9.5-16.5範圍內不同發育時期的BRE敲除小鼠胚胎和對照組小鼠胚胎。我們將抽取小鼠胚胎尾部或羊膜的DNA，並通過PCR的方法確定胚胎的基因型。另外，我們將通過常規組織學染色、western blotting 、免疫熒光、掃描電鏡、TUNEL和microarray等方法比較BRE基因敲除小鼠胚胎和對照組小鼠胚胎的差異。我們將確認BRE基因敲除是否影響小鼠胚胎形態發育和器官發生，尤其是對腦、心臟、腎臟、脾、肝、肌肉和生殖系統發育的影響。此外，我們還將研究BRE基因敲除對性腺發育的影響。小鼠原始生殖細胞表達組織非特異性鹼性磷酸酶（TNAP）以及BRE。因此，我們將構建BREflox/floxTNAPCre/+小鼠。利用這一基因敲除小鼠模型，我們主要研究BRE基因敲除對原始生殖細胞從卵黃囊遷移至生殖嵴這一過程的影響。同時，我們還將研究BRE基因敲除是否影響原始生殖細胞進一步發育和分化為卵巢或睾丸。本研究的結果將為研究BRE基因的正常功能提供新的方向，並為進一步研究BRE在多種腫瘤發生（尤其是睾丸腫瘤和卵巢腫瘤的發生）中的作用提供基礎。

469313.label: Realisation of objectives
469313.value: Objective One: Determine the role BRE gene plays in mouse embryo development, using time-inducible BRE null mutants. Our findings: In this projected we have generated BRE knockout newborn mice and embryos. To our great surprise there was no obvious phenotype in the live born mutant mice or morphology of the BRE mutant embryos. This is despite the fact that the BRE gene is highly conserved and as an adaptor molecule in the BRISC and BRCA-1A protein complex. We have discovered that the phenotype was not obvious unless the mutants were challenged. For example, we investigated the function of the Bre gene in satellite cells was during skeletal muscle regeneration. The tibialis anterior leg muscle was experimentally injured in Bre knockout mutant (BRE-KO) mice. It was established that the accompanying muscle regeneration was impaired as compared with their normal wild-type counterparts (BRE-WT). There were significantly fewer pax7+ satellite cells and smaller newly formed myofibers present in the injury sites of BRE-KO mice. Bre was required for satellite cell fusion and myofiber formation. The cell fusion index and average length of newly-formed BRE-KO myofibers were found to be significantly reduced as compared with BRE-WT myofibers. It is well established that satellite cells are highly invasive which confers on them the homing ability to reach the muscle injury sites. Hence, we tracked the migratory behavior of these cells using time-lapse microscopy. Image analysis revealed no difference in directionality of movement between BRE-KO and BRE-WT satellite cells but there was a significant decrease in the velocity of BRE-KO cell movement. Moreover, chemotactic migration assays indicated that BRE-KO satellite cells were significantly less responsive to chemoattractant SDF-1α than BRE-WT satellite cells. We also established that BRE normally protects CXCR4 from SDF-1α-induced degradation. In sum, BRE facilitates skeletal muscle regeneration by enhancing satellite cell motility, homing and fusion (These findings are reported in Xiao L-H and Lee KKH 2016). We have also insolated adult skin fibroblasts from the BRE mutant mice that we generated to conduct cellular studies. We used the fibroblasts to investigate the functional role of BRE in DNA repair and cellular senescence. We compared wild-type (WT) fibroblasts with BRE (-/-) fibroblasts at different cell passages and observed that the mutant fibroblasts entered replicative senescence earlier than the WT fibroblasts. With the use of gamma irradiation to induce DNA damage in fibroblasts, the percentage of SA-β-Gal(+) cells was significantly higher in BRE(-/-) fibroblasts compared with WT cells, suggesting that BRE is also associated with DNA damage-induced premature senescence. We also demonstrated that the gamma irradiation induced γ-H2AX foci, a DNA damage marker, persisted significantly longer in BRE(-/-) fibroblasts than in WT fibroblasts, confirming that the DNA repair process is impaired in the absence of BRE. In addition, the BRCA1-A complex recruitment and homologous recombination (HR)-dependent DNA repair process upon DNA damage were impaired in BRE(-/-) fibroblasts. Taken together, our results demonstrate a role for BRE in both replicative senescence and DNA damage-induced premature senescence (These results are reported in Shi et al, 2016). Objective Two: Elucidate the importance of the BRE gene in gonadogenesis, using germ cell-specific BRE null mutants. Our findings The BRE gene is highly expressed in the reproductive system and plays an important role in modulating DNA damage repair under stress response and pathological conditions. Folliculogenesis, a process that ovarian follicle develops into maturation, is closely associated with the interaction between somatic granulosa cell and oocyte. However, the regulatory role of BRE in follicular development is still undetermined. In this context, we found that BRE is normally expressed in the oocytes and granulosa cells from the primordial follicle stage. There was a reduction in follicles number of BRE mutant (BRE-/-) mice. It was attributed to increase the follicular atresia in ovaries, as a result of retarded follicular development. We also established that cell proliferation was inhibited, while apoptosis was markedly increased in the granulosa cells in the absence of BRE. In addition, expressions of γ-H2AX (marker for showing DNA double-strand breaks) and DNA damage-relevant genes are both upregulated in BRE-/- mice. In summary, these results suggest that the absence of BRE plus deficiency in DNA damage repair induced increased apoptosis in granulosa cells that in turn induces follicular atresia in BRE-/- mice (These results are reported in Yeung et al., 2017).

469313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
469313.value: In this project, our aim was to determine the role BRE gene plays in mouse embryo development, using a time-inducible BRE null mutants. Moreover, elucidate the importance of the BRE gene in gonadogenesis. We established that BRE was important for maintaining follicle development in the female mouse ovary. In the BRE mutant mice, the follicular cells that surround and support follicle development die prematurely resulting in an increase in follicle atresia. Overall, the absence of BRE expression did not affect the embryo or adult phenotypes –unless the animals were challenged. We found that when the skeletal muscles of BRE mutant mice were injured, they regenerated slower than normal mice. In addition, fibroblasts isolated from the BRE mutant mice entered into premature cellular senescence during culture significantly faster than wild-type fibroblasts.

469713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
469713.value: 研究目的: 本項目將研究Tet羥化酶介導羥甲基化修飾在小鼠未分化精原幹細胞發育及其衰老過程的作用以及調控。 研究背景: 精原幹細胞是一群位於睾丸的具有全能性的成體幹細胞。通過減數分裂, 精原幹細胞能夠分化成初級精母細胞和次級精母細胞, 最終形成精子, 以此同時通過自我增殖維持其未分化狀態。精原幹細胞對男性生殖至關重要, 任何發育缺陷都將可能遺傳給後代。事實上, 至少40%的不孕病例是由男性生精功能異常所導致。精原幹細胞不僅在生殖生物學也在再生醫學領域具有重要意義。最新研究顯示人源精原幹細胞有可能作為多能幹細胞的另一來源而運用於再生細胞療法。雖然近年來人類基因組學和細胞生物學的研究突飛猛進, 但對精原幹細胞發育調控的了解仍十分有限, 這是因為此領域研究主要關注基因表達水平的分析, 而表觀遺傳調控例如5-甲基胞嘧啶(5mc) 在細胞增殖和分化方面也起著很關鍵的作用。最近的研究顯示Tet羥化酶能夠將5mc轉變為5-羥甲基胞嘧啶(5hmc), 而這一過程在胚胎幹細胞發育以及神經乾細胞起著關鍵作用。這一表觀遺傳調控以及Tet蛋白對精原幹細胞乾性維持的作用尚不清楚。 研究介紹: 本課題組先前對小鼠精原幹細胞5hmc修飾豐度和Tet基因表達進行分析得出假說: 基因組的特定區域存在5hmc修飾的動態調控, 主要由Tet1和Tet3介導的這一調節和精原幹細胞的干性維持密切相關。現有結果顯示5hmc修飾豐度和未分化精原幹細胞密切相關, 同時其在相關區域的富集程度能夠參與靶基因的調節。本研究擬以這些前期研究結果和已建立的小鼠模型為基礎, 通過構建全基因組的5hmC修飾圖譜,揭示其在精原幹細胞自我增殖以及維持動態平衡過程中的功能和調控機制。 研究意義: 本開創性課題將填補對精原幹細胞Tet羥化酶介導羥甲基化修飾的表觀遺傳調控機制的研究空白。本研究將揭示5hmc修飾的調節基因和細胞通路,為精原幹細胞體外增殖和保存及男性不育治療和生殖干預開拓思路, 並為表觀遺傳調控在發育, 生殖和乾細胞領域帶來新的認識。

469713.label: Realisation of objectives
469713.value: The two major objectives have been largely addressed and led to novel findings, collaborations, and publications. With reference to objective 1, we established the pivot role of Tet-mediated DNA hydroxymethylation (5hmC) in germ cell and stem cell development (Publication 1, 4 and 5). We performed transcriptome and epigenome (5mC/5hmC) analysis during the onset of neonatal spermatogonia KIT transition. We showed PND5.5 germ cells exhibit a unique “hybrid” property as they retain stem cell niche response despite differentiation pathway activation. We then explored the developmental dynamics of DNA modifications in the forms of 5mC and 5hmC at the single-base resolution as well as the genome distribution of the main 5hmC enzyme TET3 in neonatal spermatogonia. Specially, we found 249 genes showing both mRNA expression and containing differential 5hmC site. Gene ontology analysis revealed that these genes fall into functional categories involved in spermatogenesis (e.g., Plzf, Foxo1, Ret and Kit) and cell adhesion. This suggested the potential biological roles of 5hmC in regulating gene expression during the KIT transition. Therefore, 5hmC serves as a genuine modulator of gene activation in SSC development, and the “reader” proteins of this epigenetic mark remain to be identified. The differential methylation regions (DMRs) identified were extremely enriched for binding motifs for ETV family. The role of ETV5 in SSC self-renewal has been established, but other ETV members expressed in early postnatal spermatogonia such as ETV4 might also play roles in SSC formation and differentiation. With the intriguing findings on normal germ cell development, we also examined the potential roles of demethylation dynamics in germ cell aging. We performed a comprehensive genomic analysis of young and aged SSCs including transcriptome, histone modifications, DNA methylome and DNA hydroxymethylome. Age-dependent 5mC and 5hmC alterations in SSCs were observed. In total, 239 promoters differentially methylated between the two groups, of which 81 gained methylation and 158 lost methylation in the older age group. A notable example is Sfi1, which is a key player for centrosome amplification and centrosome aberrations and has been implicated in the aged process. We also reported dynamic changes of DNA epigenetic marks also occur in mouse oocytes during natural and accelerated aging. associated with Tet3 over-expression and Tdg repression. The results suggest that DNA demethylation may be actively involved in germ cell aging. The data has been incorporated in our previous GRF project on long non-coding RNAs in male germ cell aging and led to the development of a public database (http://germage.cbiit.cuhk.edu.hk/). Taken together, the epigenetic maps we established provide important insights into the epigenetic regulation of germ cell development and serve as a valuable resource for subsequent studies (Collaboration with Monash University and Tdg KO model follow-up). For objective 2, we have identified enriched gene functions, pathways and regulators based on the genomic data obtained in objective 1. For SSC development, the top 1000 TET3 binding peaks was analyzed by Genomic Regions Enrichment of Annotations Tool (GREAT). We uncovered that genes with TET3 peaks near the TSS are significantly enriched in spermatogenesis, cell cycle, DNA repair processes and various signaling pathways such as RAS pathway and Fibroblast Growth Factor (FGF) pathway. Among these genes, Sirt1 and Tex14 showed a strikingly high enrichment of TET3. Sirt1 is crucial for pre-meiotic germ cell differentiation and production of hormones for reproduction. Tex14 acts as a stabilizer of intercellular bridge in spermatogonia, was also enriched. Other genes associated with spermatogenesis were identified, such as Piwil2, Golga3, Oct4, Bcl6 and Sohlh1. We also examined all the TET3-bound promoters and it further revealed significant enrichment in Wnt signaling pathway, including Axin1, rac1, fzd3, fzd6, Lgr4 and YWHAZ. Strikingly, we also identified peaks at the promoter of DNA base excision repair (BER) pathway genes (TDG, Pias2, Sumo3 and Sae1) and lysosome-related genes (Lamp1,Hexa, Smuf1,Cln3 and Atg7), which is consistent with a previous study that analyzed Tet3 binding site in brain. This implicates that the binding of Tet3 at these genes might be conserved among different cell types. In particular, the TDG-initiated base excision repair pathway is known to be critical for removal of 5caC from DNA during active demethylation . This implies the existence of a TET3-dependent regulatory feed-forward pathway for active, base excision repair-associated DNA demethylation through promoting the TDG expression. Interestingly, we observed that some binding sites of TET3-bound genes contain NRF1 binding motifs. NRF1 has been shown to cooperated with DNA methylation to directly regulate the expression of multiple germ cell-specific genes during germ cell development. As the binding transcription factor NRF1 depends on methylation levels, this suggest that NRF1 binds to its target gene after demethylation by TET3 to initiate transcription and gene expression during normal SSC development. The role of epigenetic landscape in germ cell aging was reflected by aberrant expression of genes associated with meiosis and TGF-beta signaling. Alteration of the alternative splicing has also been identified in aged SSC. Aged SSCs exhibited reduced H3K27me3 level across genes in Wnt and TGF-beta signaling. Similar to male germ cells, DNA demethylation marks were dynamically regulated in female germ cell aging, which is associated with Tet3 overexpression and Tdg repression. Despite TET3 appeared to be the major player in the demethylation pathway for male germline stem cell and female germ cells. We found TET1 was the major regulator in embryonic stem cells, and was regulated by microRNA-29b/Tet1 regulatory axis. The data suggested the unique epigenetic programming in germ cell development.

469713.label: Major findings and research outcome
469713.value: We have successfully revealed the genomic landscapes of demethylation marks, major regulators (Tet1/3) and signature pathways essential for the maintenance and development of spermatogonial stem cells. The findings provided an important foundation for studying female germ cells (oocytes) and adult stem cell (mMSC). Collectively, we have delivered: 1. Five publications (3 Accepted, 2 in review, 1 in preparation. The manuscript drafts are attached for reference in Part C) 2. Developed the first comprehensive lncRNA database for male germ cell aging (http://germage.cbiit.cuhk.edu.hk/). 3. Three international conferences presentations, and two local conference presentations. 4. Trained one Ph.D. student. One Ph.D. student in training. 5. Developed collaborations with industry and academic institutions (Part C) 6. Provided insights and data on aging and epigenetic regulation in germ cell development and successfully applied a CRF in 2016.

469713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
469713.value: The intriguing results in this study have provided an important foundation for focusing on specific aspects of active demethylation and other epigenetic regulations in germ cell development and aging. The results will led to the discovery of novel aging targets associated with male infertility/sub-fertility. We will focus on targets critical for SSC proliferation and differentiation. We are currently collaborating with chemists to develop small molecules to target the specific regulations identified in the objective 2. We hope the drug candidates will defer the aging impact on SSC and oocyte. Our publications and presentations have led to establishing new collaborations with other scientists. We have collaborated with Dr. Robin Hobbs at Monash Univerity to focus on the epigenetic targets identified in objective 1. We also collaborated with Prof. Pierre from France to determine the biological regulation of Tet proteins and RNA binding protein RBPs in spermatogonial stem cells. Both projects will apply for fundings from various grant resources.

469713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
469713.value: Cytosine represents one of the four nucleotides in DNA and its methylation status has been associated with transcriptional regulations of RNAs in mammals. It is believed that the critical stages in cellular development rely on dynamic changes of protein and RNA expression, which are regulated by unique DNA methylation or demethylation patterns. The mechanism underlying this is controversial and complex. Importantly, the exact landscape of DNA demethylation and remains largely elusive in male germ cell development and stem cell development. As new reports now suggest that Tet enzymes are responsible for generating intermediate demethylation intermediate (5hmC), we aim to identify and characterize the epigenetic landscape of Tet and 5hmC in spermatogonial stem cells and determine regulatory mechanisms and biological consequences associated with Tet-mediated 5hmC. Using sequencing technologies, we found 5hmC serves as a genuine modulator of gene activation in SSC development. The regulation could be regulated by small RNAs (microRNAs). We also examined the potential roles of demethylation dynamics in germ cell aging and reported dynamic changes of DNA epigenetic marks also occur in male and female germ cells. The results suggest that DNA demethylation may be actively involved in germ cell development and aging.

470413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
470413.value: 胰島β細胞功能衰竭是2型糖尿病（T2DM）的特徵之一，它是由慢性高血糖和高脂血症引發的。胰島β細胞功能衰竭最終會導致胰島素分泌不足和胰島β細胞凋亡。尤其是，當糖毒性和脂毒性等各種因素誘發胰島功能衰竭發展時，補償性的胰島β細胞胰島素分泌將會變得不足，而患2型糖尿病的風險也會增加。但是，高血糖和高血脂誘導胰島衰竭的具體機制還有待闡明。內質網（ER）是一種能夠感應和轉導細胞凋亡信號的重要細胞器。由各種代謝因子觸發的ER應激反應可以導致胰島功能障礙。有一種跨膜內質網蛋白就是這些代謝因子其中之一，它是類固醇調節元件結合蛋白（SREBP）。作為一種轉錄因子，SREBP可以調節各種組織和器官中的脂質代謝及細胞存活，而SREBP的活性是部分依賴於葡萄糖濃度的。 SREBP過度活躍會導致胰島生長遲緩，針對高血糖的失調性補償和胰島β細胞脂毒性，並最終造成顯性糖尿病。同時，在胰島中，脂肪酸通過脂肪酸受體的介導發揮著各種生理作用。 有益脂肪酸（例如不飽和脂肪酸ω-3脂肪酸）是部分通過減少胰島凋亡和改善胰島存活能力來可以防止脂毒性對胰島造成的毒害作用的。引人注意的是，新確定的一種不飽和脂肪酸的脂質受體，G蛋白偶聯受體120（GPR120），最近被認定是對葡萄糖體內平衡具有積極作用的（它本身是一種可以調控胰島素信號并具有抗炎功能的因子）。由於不飽和脂肪酸可以抑制SREBP信號，這個過程有可能是通過胰島中的GPR120來介導的，因此我們推測：胰島中GPR120是不飽和脂肪酸在胰島細胞中的受體，它可以調節胰島中β-arrestin2，SREBP信號，從而調節并維護胰島的分泌功能和結構，并有助於在糖尿病情況下血糖的控制。如果以上推斷得到證實，這個項目將確定GPR120為一種新的治療靶點，用於糾正2型糖尿病發展過程中的胰島功能障礙。

470413.label: Realisation of objectives
470413.value: Objective 1 has been fully addressed as stated in the last progress report and "Research Output" of Section 8 and 9 (see Publications and conference abstracts) in the current report. Briefly, we studied the expression and regulation of GPR120 at the gene and protein levels in islets isolated from the rats and mice as well as in the murine insulinoma cell lines (INS-1E cells and MIN6 cells) under glucotoxic and lipotoxic conditions. Our data indicate that GPR120 expression in islet β cells was decreased but increased under glucotoxic and lipotoxic conditions, respectively. Objectives 2 and 3 have also been fully addressed in this final report (see also Section 6.1. "Major findings and research outcome" of Research Outcome, Part B as well as attached publication and conference abstracts in Section 8 & 9 of Research Output, Part C. Briefly and firstly, we conclude that GPR120 activation with agonists, namely its natural agonist Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) and its synthetic agonist GSK137647 (GSK) has an insulinotropic influence on β cells with the involvement of calcium signalling; secondly, we conclude that GPR120 expression in β cells and GPR120-mediated insulinotropic effects are altered in obese-diabetic and diabetic states in distinct ways, and these alterations may be mediated by PPARγ. On the other hand, we generated a model of GPR120-knockout/LacZ knock-in (KO/KI) mice and we employed GPR120 agonists of natural DHA and selective GSK to elucidate GPR120 agonism-mediated protective effects on islet function and survival. Our results showed that LacZ was predominantly localized to pancreatic beta cells of the KO/KI mice. Meanwhile, these GPR120 activation-mediated protective effects were abolished in GPR120 knockdown cells and in islets isolated from GPR120 KO mice. Unfortunately, we have encountered difficulties in culturing and conducting the effects of GPR120 on beta-cell function under high-glucose and high-lipid conditions. The problem was complicated by the high cost of purchasing the human islets to repeat the experiments and generate useful data. Taken this issue into full consideration and for the sake of full utilisation of grant source as well as maximisation of the research output, we sought to explore the regulatory pathways potentially involved in the protective effects of GPR120 agonism against islet inflammation and dysfunction. Our substantial, albeit preliminary, data with GPR120 knockout and knockdown indicated that GPR120 activation is protective against beta-cell dysfunction, probably via the mediation of PDX1 expression and inhibition of islet inflammation, as a preventative and therapeutic target for obesity and diabetes; these preliminary data will be targeted for a new application of grant proposal and potential publications (see Section 6.2. 470413.label: Major findings and research outcome
470413.value: Given its anti-inflammatory effects in metabolic tissues, GPR120 is currently considered a pharmacological target for the management of obesity and type 2 diabetes. Whether resident GPR120 has a role in β-cell insulin secretion and inflammation remains controversial. Our major findings are briefly summarised as follows (see also attached publication and conference abstracts in Part C): 1. The present results demonstrate that GPR120 activation amplifies insulin secretion and induces Akt/ERK phosphorylation in rodent islets, INS-1E cells and/or diabetic mice, and that islet/β-cell GPR120 expression and its agonism-mediated effects on insulin secretion and Akt/ERK activation are differentially altered in obese nondiabetic (OND) and diabetic states, probably via the facilitation of PPARγ (see attached publication). 2. Our study findings are expected to: provide valuable insight into the GPR120 agonists being potential insulinotropic drugs for obesity-associated diabetes therapy; elucidate the underlying mechanisms for the differential insulin secretory responses to plasma FFAs between OND and diabetic patients; imply that manipulation of islet β-cell GPR120 may be an alternative mechanism for PPARγ agonists to prevent and treat obesity and obesity-related type 2 diabetes (see attached publication). 3. We further provide original, albeit preliminary, data that GPR120 regulates PDX1 expression to protect pancreatic beta-cell function via inhibition of NF-κB, JNK, and p38 MAPK activation and macrophage infiltration. These findings provide a plausible scientific basis for GPR120-mediated protective effects on islet dysfunction and inflammation (see attached conference abstracts).

470413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
470413.value: As reported in Section 5.3. (Re: Objective 4) and Section 6.1. (Point 3), we have now explored the potential mechanism-of-action of GRP120 in islet inflammation-mediated islet cell function and survival. In vitro and ex vivo treatments of MIN6 cells and islets isolated from wild-type (WT) mice with DHA and GSK restored PDX1 expression levels and beta-cell function via inhibiting palmitic acid-induced expression of proinflammatory chemokines and activation of NF-κB, JNK, and p38MAPK signaling pathways. However, these GPR120 activation-mediated protective effects were abolished in GPR120 knockdown (KD) cells and in isolated islets from GPR120 knockout (KO) mice. Moreover, GPR120 KO mice displayed glucose intolerance and insulin resistance relative to WT littermates. Furthermore, beta-cell functional related genes were decreased while inflammation was exacerbated in isolated islets with increased macrophages observed in GPR120 KO mice. These original, albeit preliminary, data will be further followed up and developed into a potential project for a new grant application as well as having publication potential (see attached conference abstracts).

470413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
470413.value: G-protein coupled receptor 120 (GPR120), AKA free fatty acid receptor 4 (FFA4), has been shown to act as an omega-3 unsaturated fatty acid sensor, and is involved in insulin sensitivity and anti-inflammation. However, the mechanism mediated by GPR120 in pancreatic beta cells is still unclear. In the present study, we aimed to explore the potential link between GPR120 and beta-cell function as well as the molecular mechanism involved. Our findings indicate that GPR120 activation, such as DHA stimulation, is beneficial to beta-cell insulin secretion via induction of Akt/ERK phosphorylation in rodent islets, INS-1E beta-cells and/or diabetic mice, and that GPR agonism-mediated effects on insulin secretion and Akt/ERK activation are differentially altered in obese nondiabetic and diabetic states. In addition, GPR120 regulates PDX1 expression to protect pancreatic beta-cell function and inflammation via inhibition of NF-κB, JNK, and p38 MAPK activation and macrophage infiltration.These study findings provide a plausible scientific basis for GPR120-mediated protective effects on islet dysfunction and inflammation. In light of the present results and previous findings, we propose a mechanism-of-action whereby GPR120 increases insulin secretion and mediates anti-inflammatory effects in pancreatic beta cells. We further propose that GPR120 activation with selective agonists could be pursued as a potential therapeutic target for obesity and obesity-related metabolic diseases, such as type 2 diabetes.

470513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
470513.value: Pre-eclampsia (PE) remains one of the leading causes of both maternal and perinatal mortality and morbidity, affecting 1.5-5% of pregnancies. Evidence from meta-analysis indicates that initiation of low-dose aspirin prophylaxis before 16 weeks of gestation would prevent the occurrence of PE in 50% of pregnancies. Recent studies also indicate that by combination of clinical, biochemical and ultrasonic markers measured at 11-13 weeks, up to 76% of all women who subsequently developed PE may be predicted for a 10% false positive rate (FPR). However further studies are needed to confirm the accuracy and generalisability. The determination of individual risk assumes that each biophysical and biochemical marker is correctly adjusted for the population under assessment, and that its measurement distribution is consistent with that assumed in the risk calculation models. Evidence from our own and other published studies indicate that markers are affected by ethnicity, maternal and pregnancy related factors. A failure to correctly adjust markers, especially those recently discovered markers such as placental growth factor (PlGF), will result in an incorrectly estimated risk and either reduced or increased FPRs and detection rates (DR) depending on the direction of the shift. We therefore propose to develop a PE prediction model for East Asian. Pregnant women who attend for routine first trimester Down syndrome screening between 11-13 weeks are invited for study. In addition to the standard Down syndrome risk assessment, we will determine maternal serum PlGF levels, maternal blood pressure and uterine arterial blood flow. Information collected will then be used to 1) derive East Asian specific marker adjustment models 2) assess the agreement between the level of adjusted markers and that predicted in PE and non PE pregnancies, and 3) assess the predictive ability of the our risk model to identify pregnancies in which PE occurred. A sample size of 1000 subjects would be required (α=0.05, β=0.9, number of independent variables=8, expected ‘r’ value of 0.1) to assess and derive adjustment models. The long term impact of the successful development of the prediction model, which could applicable to one-fifth of the world population, is reliable identification of high risk pregnant women who may benefit from low-dose aspirin prophylaxis, and hence reduction in the incidence of PE and its associated maternal and fetal complications. It would also allow further investigation on cost-effectiveness of the model, pathogenesis of PE, and identification of new biomarkers that may further improve the screening model. 470813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
470813.value: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) are multi-potent cells with low immunogenicity, MSCs have been widely used in the field of regenerative medicine for repairing various tissues. Administration of autologous MSCs have been shown to promote tissue repair in many disease conditions, but the use of autologous cells is hindered by the need of prolonged cell culture time and narrow time windows for their effective applications. Allogenic MSCs on the other hand, will be an ideal alternative source as they can be well-prepared in advance, banked and made readily available for use. We and others have showed that allogenic MSCs have the ability homing to the injured tissues and promoting tissue repair such as fracture healing. However the fate of the allogenic MSCs in vivo and their exact roles in tissue repair and regeneration are not yet clearly defined. The present proposal will investigate the optimal conditions of applying allogenic MSCs (locally or systemically) in promoting fracture healing and the fate of the transplanted cells in vivo, with four specific aims: (1) To define the optimal time for allogenic MSCs local administration following fracture. (2) To compare the effects of local administration of allogenic MSCs vs. autologous MSCs at the defined time on fracture healing in rats. (3) To study the immunogenic effects and the fate of allogenic MSCs in vivo. (4) To compare the effects of local vs. systemic vs. local/systemic combined administration of allogenic MSCs on fracture healing in rats. This study will help to understand the mechanisms of how allogenic MSCs work in vivo and shed light on developing a novel cell therapy strategy for promoting fracture healing using allogenic MSCs. 間充質幹細胞是一種可以分化為成骨細胞、成軟骨細胞、成脂細胞、成纖維細胞、肌腱細胞和成肌細胞的多能細胞。間充質幹細胞是一種具有低免疫原性的免疫豁免細胞，並已被廣泛應用于再生醫學來修復各種組織的損傷。儘管利用自體MSCs進行細胞治療的方法已經得到良好的建立和接受，但達到治療所需的量仍需要較長時間的培養，而有可能錯過最佳的治療時機，這些都限制了自體MSCs的廣泛應用。因此，可提前大量培養和儲存然後直接用於治療的同種異體MSCs成為理想的選擇。本研究主要是探究局部和全身供給異體間充質幹細胞對促進骨折癒合的主要相關問題，例如異體間充質幹細胞在進入體內的最佳時間點；在體內是否引起免疫源性的變化和主要功能作用; 如何使它們在組織修復過程中發揮最佳作用。研究內容：(1)利用建立好的股骨折大鼠模型，確立骨折後利用同種異體MSCs進行治療的最佳時間。(2)研究同種異體MSCs在體內的命運及免疫效應。(3)比較採用局部注射或系統注射分別對骨折癒合產生的治療效果。研究結果將有助於開發一種新的可以促進骨折癒合的細胞治療方法，並瞭解全身供給異體間充質幹細胞對機體的影響，將有助於減少骨折病人的痛苦和相關的高額社會成本。

470813.label: Major findings and research outcome
470813.value: This project started from 1 January 2014 and progresses very well accordingly to the planned research objectives. Among the 3 proposed research objectives, we have successfully completed all of them, the research activities related to the 3 objectives are summarized as following: 1. This study depicted the dynamic changes of circulating MSCs during systemic recruitment of MSCs during rat fracture healing, the finding provides insights for fracture healing biology. 2. Using rat fracture model and MSCs in vivo tracing techniques, we found that less than 3% injected Luc-cells remained at the fracture site in the MSCs injection groups at 5 weeks following the fracture, and the rest of injected Luc-cells disappeared. These findings provide critical information to develop allogenic MSC-based therapies and expedite for clinical applications. 3. The mechanical properties were significantly higher in the MSCs injection groups than those in the fibroblast and PBS groups, but no difference was found between the MSCs local and systemic injection groups. Immunohistochemistry and double immunofluorescence demonstrated that GFP-positive MSCs were present in the callus in the MSCs injection groups at 5 weeks after fracture, and some have differentiated into osteoblasts. Details of the findings can be found in the attached output report part (Part C, Section 8, attachment 24).

470813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
470813.value: The current study has address the key issues of allogenic MSCs local and systemic application in promoting fracture healing in normal and osteoporotic conditions, such as the fate and roles of the allogenic MSCs in vivo and how to apply them to maximize the repair processes. We found that both systemic and local administration of allogenic MSCs promoted fracture healing without any noticeable adverse effects. Some amount of allogenic MSCs could survive for 4-5 weeks but majority of them disappeared within 2 weeks. It is concluded that the use of allogenic MSCs for promoting fracture healing is safe and effective. The findings of this study will help to develop a novel cell therapy strategy using allogenic MSCs for promoting fracture healing, hence reduce the suffering of fracture patients and associated high social costs.

470913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
470913.value: Childhood obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) is a common condition and in Hong Kong the prevalence for OSA in children aged 6 to 13 years is 4.8%. In cross-sectional studies childhood OSA is associated with elevated blood pressure and even hypertension, but long-term follow-up studies are lacking. It is increasingly appreciated that many adult diseases stem from childhood, including conditions like hypertension and metabolic syndrome. While retrospective long term adult studies have shown this, none have examined the contribution of OSA, a potentially modifiable risk factor. Our research team has assembled a polysomnography quantified population-based paediatric sleep cohort in 2003, and therefore we are placed in an ideal position to follow these subjects prospectively to examine the nat¬ural history and consequences of OSA starting in early childhood. An interim follow-up was carried out at 4-year, and it was demonstrated that baseline OSA was an independent predictor of nocturnal systolic blood pressure at follow-up. Based on this established cohort with detailed documentation of clinical characteristics including demographic, anthropometric, blood pressure and sleep symptom questionnaire data, we plan to invite these subjects for repeat assessment to evaluate natural history and whether baseline OSA would predict cardiovascular adverse outcome, namely elevated blood pressure at 10-year follow-up. The data from this prospective study would contribute not only to an understanding of the cardiovascular consequences of childhood OSA, but may shed light on the relationship between childhood and early adulthood OSA. This is important public health information which may help to facilitate health care planning policy to combat burden related to OSA. Furthermore a better understanding of childhood risk fac¬tors for adult OSA and latent periods between ex¬posure to OSA and the development of adverse outcomes may provide essential evidence-based information regarding appropriate screening and intervention strategies. The aim of the present study is therefore to fill a critical gap in the scientific literature by answering the primary question, “Do children with OSA (compared to those without OSA) identified at age 6-13 years have abnormal blood pressure at 10-year follow-up?” Our secondary aims are to: (1) determine the natural history of OSA over a 10-year period and (2) evaluate factors associated with the development, resolution and persistence of OSA. We hypothesize that subjects with baseline OSA (compared to controls) are at increased risk of having abnormal blood pressure at 10-year follow-up. 童年阻塞性睡眠呼吸暫停（ OSA ）是一種常見的疾病。在本港六至十三歲兒童的OSA患病率是4.8％。在橫斷面研究中，童年OSA與血壓升高有關聯，但目前還未有相關的長期隨訪研究。雖然成人的回顧性研究顯示許多成人疾病，如高血壓和代謝綜合徵等都源於童年，但當中OSA是否一個可改變的危險因素卻未有定論。 我們的研究團隊在2003年已經組建了一個社區兒童睡眠群組，藉著跟蹤這個社區群組，我們可以前瞻性地探討童年OSA的自然史及其引發的後果。我們在群組成立後第四年進行了一次中期隨訪，數據顯示四年前的OSA是四年後夜間收縮壓的獨立預測因子。這個社區群組的臨床特徵，包括人口統計，人體測量，血壓以至睡眠症狀，我們都有詳細的記錄，於是我們計劃於2013年（第十年）邀請這些兒童進行一次重複測量，以進一步評估OSA的自然史和探討十年前的OSA是否與十年後的心血管不良後果（如血壓升高）有關。 這項前瞻性研究中的數據將不僅有助於了解童年OSA對心血管的影響，更可能揭示童年和成年OSA之間的關係。這重要公共衛生信息可能有助於促進有關的衛生保健政策的規劃。此外，研究得出的數據可讓我們更了解誘發成年OSA的童年風險因素以及OSA與其併發症之間的因果關係，從而為適當篩查和治療策略提供必要的證據。 因此，本研究的目的是要解答科學文獻中的疑問：「在6-13歲時確診患有睡眠呼吸暫停的兒童，10年後與那些當時確定沒有OSA的兒童相比，他們的血壓是否異常？」另外，我們還希望：（1）探討OSA超過10年的自然史及；（2）找尋與OSA演變的相關因素。我們推測10年前被確診患有睡眠呼吸暫停的兒童在10年後有血壓異常的風險會增加。

470913.label: Realisation of objectives
470913.value: A total of 243 (96 girls, mean ± SD age = 20.2y ± 1.9) subjects took part in this study. Ninety-six of them were found to have obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) at baseline visit, of whom 75 had mild disease and 21 had moderate-to-severe disease. The mean ± SD interval between baseline and follow-up visits is 10.4y ± 1.1. All subjects underwent anthropometric measurements, upper airway size assessment, overnight sleep study, 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, completed questionnaire survey and had blood taken for serum glucose, C-reactive protein and lipid profile at the follow-up visit. We were unable to achieve the planned sample size of 361 despite trying our very best to invite every member of the cohort to participate, and we had also provided travel allowance for their participation. The main reason for refusal was that they were not willing to stay overnight in hospital for sleep study, and or their busy schedule did not allow them to participate. We offered overnight home oximetry to replace the in-lab overnight sleep study but it did not improve recruitment. Nevertheless, we are still able to detect the association between baseline OSA severity and ambulatory blood pressure parameters at follow-up with the current sample size. Linear regression analyses were used to test for the associations between baseline OSA severity index and various parameters of ambulatory blood pressure (ABP) during daytime and nighttime while adjusting for covariates. The natural history of OSA from childhood to adulthood was also examined by comparing the OSA severities obtained from overnight sleep studies at baseline and at follow-up. The number and proportion of subjects who had (1) no OSA documented at both visits, (2) new onset OSA, (3) resolved OSA and (4) persistent OSA were determined. Correlates of change in OSA severity were identified by linear regression analysis, using change in obstructive apnoea hypopnoea index as the dependent variable. Predictors of development, resolution, and persistence of OSA were identified by logistic regression analyses.

470913.label: Major findings and research outcome
470913.value: Objective 1: Associations between childhood OSA severity and ABP in young adulthood OSA severity at baseline was associated with SBP at 10-year follow-up but not DBP. The 24-hour average SBP of baseline normal, mild and moderate-to-severe OSA groups were 112mmHg±9, 113mmHg±9 and 117mmHg±9 respectively (p=0.016). Analysing the ABP data separately for daytime and nighttime periods revealed that baseline OSA severity was only associated with nighttime systolic BP (p=0.002) but not daytime systolic BP (p=0.092). No significant between-group difference in BMI was found at 10-year follow-up. However, the more severe group also had a greater proportion of male subjects (p=0.043). Linear regression analysis revealed that baseline moderate-to-severe OSA, as defined by an obstructive apnoea hypopnoea index (OAHI) of >=5/h, is significantly associated with a greater nighttime systolic blood pressure [β(95%CI)=6.0mmHg(2.3–9.8), p=0.002], while adjusted for sex, parental history of hypertension, age, height and body mass index z score. On the other hand, nighttime diastolic, daytime systolic and daytime diastolic blood pressure were not associated with baseline OSA severity in both unadjusted and adjusted regression analyses (all p>0.05). Objective 2: Natural history of OSA The analysis revealed that subjects with more severe OSA at baseline had a higher OSA severity at 10-year follow-up. (p=0.003) Further analysis found that there were new onset OSA as well as resolution of OSA across the follow-up period. Among 147 participants who were classified as having no OSA at baseline, respectively 30 (20%) developed OSA regardless of severity at 10-year follow-up, leaving 117 participants who never had OSA from baseline to follow-up. Among 96 participants who had OSA (mild=75 or moderate-to-severe=21) at baseline, 66 (69%) [57 (76%) and 9 (43%) from mild and moderate-to-severe groups, respectively] had resolved OSA at 10-year follow-up, leaving 30 participants with persistent OSA from childhood to early adulthood. Objective 3: Factors associated with new-onset and resolution of OSA Multivariable logistic regression suggested that new-onset OSA, compared to no OSA at both visits, was associated with male sex [OR(95% CI)=6.5(2.0¬–27.1)], higher BMI z-score at follow-up [1.2(1.0–1.3)], and longer sleep latency at baseline [4.1(1.4–12.9)] and habitual snoring at both baseline and follow-up [7.8(2.0–32.4)]. New-onset of OSA was also associated with enlarged tonsils/adenoid [3.0(0.8–11.2)] although it was not statistically significant. On the other hand, baseline OAHI≥5/h [OR(95% CI)=0.2(0.1–0.7)] and BMI z score at follow-up [0.9(0.7–0.99)] were associated with significantly lower odds of OSA resolution.

470913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
470913.value: Childhood and adulthood OSA are believed to be distinct diseases with different causative factors. It is interesting to find that severe form of childhood OSA is more likely to persist to adulthood. Further research is needed to determine the linkage between childhood and adulthood OSA. It will also be interesting to conduct in-depth mechanistic investigations and longer-term follow-up to look into the potential differences between adult-onset and childhood-onset OSA. This cohort forms a platform from which further follow-up studies can be carried out, but of course response/willingness to take part will be a major issue. If funding is available, detailed assessment including sleep monitoring to take place at home can be an incentive for participation.

470913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
470913.value: This is the first longitudinal study involving a very well objectively characterised cohort of children and adolescents with and without OSA, and it confirms that childhood moderate-to-severe OSA is associated with higher nighttime systolic blood pressure in early adulthood. Our data also reveal the natural history of OSA from childhood to young adulthood. It is found that moderate-to-severe OSA in childhood is less likely to resolve spontaneously than milder disease. These findings implicate that early treatment should be given to children with moderate-to-severe disease in order to prevent possible long-term sequelae. Moreover, individuals with weight gain and persistent habitual snoring are at higher risk for adult-onset OSA and should be reassessed despite normal findings when they were younger during childhood. Males are at a higher risk of adult-onset OSA than females. All these findings help us to identify patients at higher risk for newly onset and persistent disease, enabling more individualized plan/pathway to be derived for the management of OSA.

471013.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
471013.value: Pyrrolizidine alkaloids (PAs) and PA N-oxides are widespread substances in plant kingdom, and about 600 PAs/PA N-oxides were identified in over 6,000 plants worldwide. More than half of naturally occurring PAs are hepatotoxic and may cause hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (HSOS) and liver cancer. Numerous PA poisoning cases are continuously reported because of consumption of PA-containing plants used for herbs, teas, and nutritional supplements, and PA-contaminated foodstuffs, including grain crops, honey and milk. PAs are pro-toxins and induce toxicity via metabolic activation to generate toxic pyrrolic metabolites, which are chemically reactive and react rapidly with cellular macromolecules to form pyrrole-protein adducts or pyrrole-DNA adducts leading to toxicity or tumorigenicity. Because of their instability, pyrrolic metabolites cannot be directly determined, and to date, there is no suitable method to definitively diagnose PA-induced toxicity and tumorigenicity. Our research group has been studying PA-induced hepatotoxicity and tumorigenicity for many years, and developed novel methods to determine pyrrole-protein and pyrrole-DNA adducts in laboratory animals. Recently for the first time we have determined blood pyrrole-protein adducts in HSOS patients exposed to PA-containing herbs. Therefore, we hypothesize that pyrrole-protein and pyrrole-DNA adducts can serve as potential biomarkers of PA-induced hepatotoxicity and tumorigenicity, respectively. Recently, we also found PA N-oxides-induced HSOS in human for the first time. Despite of high quantity in numerous plants, PA N-oxides are generally considered as much less toxic than their parent PAs and often ignored by both scientific research and regulatory sectors, and no proper precautions have been taken for risk of population exposure to PA N-oxides-containing/contaminated products. Therefore, the aims of this proposal are to 1) delineate the mechanism of PA N-oxides intoxication and compare hepatotoxic potency with their corresponding PAs; 2) further validate blood pyrrole-protein adducts as suitable biomarker for PA-/PA N-oxide-induced hepatotoxicity. Moreover, whether there is a correlation between formations of pyrrole-DNA and pyrrole-protein adducts will be evaluated, in order to provide information for future establishment of exposure risk prediction of different PAs/PA N-oxides-associated tumorigenicity. The significance of results obtained is to 1) develop feasible biomarker for diagnosing and assessing PA/PA N-oxide-induced hepatotoxicity; and 2) provide scientific evidences for understanding mechanisms and potential risk of PA N-oxides intoxication. The results will certainly benefit Hong Kong, Mainland China and global public health with better control and monitoring of exposure of PA/PA N-oxide-containing/contaminated plants and foodstuffs by extrapolation of knowledge gained from animal studies to human situation. 吡咯裏西啶生物鹼（PA）和其氮氧化物廣泛分佈在植物中。到目前為止，大約有600種PA以及PA氮氧化物在超過6000種植物中被發現。一半以上自然界存在的PA具有肝毒性，會引起肝竇阻塞綜合征以及肝癌。因服用含有PA的草藥，茶葉，營養補充劑以及被PA污染的食物而引起的PA中毒事件一直都有報導。PA是前體毒素，通過代謝產生具有毒性的吡咯類代謝產物而引起毒性。這種吡咯類代謝產物很活潑，可以與細胞大分子迅速結合產生吡咯-蛋白結合物或吡咯-DNA結合物，從而引起毒性或致癌性。由於吡咯類代謝產物的不穩定性，無法直接對它們進行監測。因此，到目前為止，臨床上還沒有合適的方法來明確診斷PA引起的肝毒以及肝癌。 本課題組已經從事PA毒性研究工作多年，在實驗動物模型上，建立了全新的測定吡咯-蛋白以及吡咯-DNA結合物的檢測方法。最近，我們在因服用含有PA的草藥而引發肝竇阻塞綜合征的病人血樣中檢測到了吡咯-蛋白結合物。因此，我們推斷吡咯-蛋白和吡咯-DNA結合物可以分別用作診斷PA引起的肝毒性以及致癌性的生物標誌物。並且，我們首次在臨床上發現了因服用PA氮氧化物引起的肝竇阻塞綜合征的病例。雖然在一些植物中PA氮氧化物的含量很高，但是一般認為PA氮氧化物的毒性比PA要小很多。因此PA氮氧化物的毒性並沒有引起科學研究機構以及監管部門的重視，至今仍沒有合適的措施來抵禦含有PA氮氧化物的產品的風險。 因此，此研究的目的包括：1）揭示PA氮氧化物的中毒機制並比較PA氮氧化物與相應 PA的毒性強弱；2）驗證血液中吡咯-蛋白結合物作為PA/PA氮氧化物引起的肝毒性生物標誌物的可行性。並且，進一步研究吡咯-DNA和吡咯-蛋白結合物之間相關性，為預測不同的PA和PA氮氧化物的致癌性提供理論基礎。本研究結果的重大意义包括：1）開發可行的生物標誌物來診斷並評價PA/PA氮氧化物引起的肝毒性；2）為揭示PA氮氧化物的毒性機制以及中毒的潛在風險提供科學依據。通過将實驗動物研究的結果轉化至臨床应用，从而更好的監管並控制PA和PA氮氧化物的中毒風險。這些結果無疑會讓香港，中國內地，以及全球的公共衛生行业得以受益。

471013.label: Realisation of objectives
471013.value: Both objectives have been well accomplished. Objective 1: Delineation of underlying mechanism of PA N-oxide intoxication We firstly tested herbs consumed by the 18 HSOS patients admitted in Zhongshan Hospital, Shanghai, China and confirmed that they all ingested a PA/PA N-oxide-containing herb called “Tusanqi”. We further identified that PA N-oxides were the only/predominant toxins in these herbs, revealing, for the first time, that PA N-oxides also induced HSOS in human. We further conducted mechanism study and delineated that PA N-oxide intoxication was due to its metabolic conversion into the corresponding PA followed by the same hepatic metabolic activation-mediated toxicity mechanism. The metabolic activation of PAs in the liver generated reactive metabolites, which interacted with proteins and DNAs to form pyrrole-protein and pyrrole-DNA adducts, leading to acute liver injury and chronic diseases such as liver fibrosis and liver cancer. In addition, we proved, for the first time, that hepatotoxicity was directly caused by the reactive metabolites rather than the PAs themselves, and also demonstrated that CYP enzymes and structural of PAs could significantly affect the metabolic activation and therefore result in different toxic potencies of hepatotoxicity caused by different PAs. Furthermore, hepatotoxic potency of PA N-oxide was found to be much less than that of the corresponding PA. We further investigated pharmacokinetic and toxicological profiles of PAs and PA N-oxides, and delineated that 1) all PAs had significantly greater oral absorption than that of the corresponding PA N-oxides, leading to significantly lower oral bioavailability of PA N-oxides, which was one of the reasons for less toxic potency of PA N-oxides; and 2) significant but not 100% biotransformation of PA N-oxides (~7-15%) by intestinal microbiota followed by hepatic CYP-mediated metabolism (~15-30%) to the corresponding PAs were the other reasons responsible for less toxic potency of PA N-oxides. The results obtained from Objective 1 formed a solid foundation for the further development of pyrrole-protein adducts as a comment and suitable biomarker of both PAs and PA N-oxides intoxication, as proposed in Objective 2, and has been well achieved. Objective 2: Validation of blood pyrrole-protein adducts as feasible biomarker of PAs/PA N-oxides intoxication Firstly, based on our previously developed qualitative method for identifying pyrrole-protein adducts, we developed a new qualitative and quantitative UHPLC-MS method for simultaneously determining and quantifying pyrrole-protein adducts in biological samples. For further validation and confirmation of the specificity and sensitivity of our developed biomarker for assessing PA/PA N-oxide-induced liver injury, we conducted a systematic study of this potential biomarker in animal (rats and mice) models using different dosage regimens with different PAs and PA N-oxides, including “Tusanqi” alkaloid extract. The results demonstrated that the level of pyrrole-protein adducts in both blood and liver correlated well with the dosage and liver toxicity, further confirming that the blood pyrrole-protein adducts can serve as a biomarker. Subsequently, using our well-developed UHPLC-MS method, we analysed blood samples of PA and/or PA N-oxide-induced HSOS patients and 162 healthy subjects in Zhongshan Hospital. Pyrrole-protein adducts were detected in blood of all PA and/or PA N-oxide-induced HSOS patients, but absent in all healthy controls. Our results confirmed the capability of blood pyrrole-protein adducts as a specific biomarker of PA/PA N-oxide-induced liver injury for clinical use.

471013.label: Major findings and research outcome
471013.value: PAs are one of the most significant groups of phytotoxins with overwhelming incidences of acute and prolonged hepatotoxicity. About 660 PAs and PA N-oxides were found in over 6,000 plants. Hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (HSOS) is a typical PA-induced hepatotoxicity. Yearly numerous incidences of PA poisoning cause significant impact on public health, due to non-deliberate consumption of PA-contaminated foodstuffs or use of PA-containing herbs. PA N-oxides often co-exist with PAs in plants, and quantities of PA N-oxides are nearly equal or even higher than their parent PAs in many plants. However, PA N-oxide-induced toxicity receives much less attention and whether PA N-oxide can also induce hepatotoxicity in human is unknown. Currently, there is no regulation for control of PA N-oxides in natural products and foods. Therefore, this project aimed and has well achieved the aforementioned two objectives. For the first time, we proved that PA N-oxides also induced hepatotoxicity in human (Paper 9). We delineated that the mechanism of PA N-oxide intoxication was due to its metabolic conversion into the corresponding PA followed by the same hepatic metabolic activation-mediated mechanism (Paper 1, 5; Abstract 1-2, 11, 15-16). Furthermore, we confirmed that hepatotoxic potency of PA N-oxides was much less than that of the corresponding PAs due to significantly lower oral bioavailability of PA N-oxides and uncompleted biotransformation of PA N-oxides to the corresponding PAs in the body (Abstract 15-16). Because both PAs and PA N-oxides underwent the same metabolic activation to generate same pyrrole-protein adducts, we developed a novel UHPLC-MS method for simultaneously determining and quantifying pyrrole-protein adducts in biological samples. After validation of the analytical method in animal and human biological specimens, we confirmed the specificity and suitability of blood pyrrole-protein adducts as a novel biomarker for confirmative diagnosis of PA/PA N-oxide-induced liver injury in human (Paper 2, 4, 9; Abstract 2, 4-9, 12-13). In addition, we developed novel UHPLC-MS method (Paper 6), immunoassay approach (Paper 8), and proteomic analysis (Paper 3) for measuring PAs/PA N-oxides in herbs, examining pyrrole-protein adducts in biological specimens, and identifying potential protein targets interacted with the reactive metabolites. We also developed UHPLC-MS method and successfully detected pyrrole-DNA adducts in liver samples of PA-treated animals, and demonstrated correlation of hepatic pyrrole-DNA adducts with dosage, pyrrole-protein adducts formation, and hepatotoxic potency, therefore, pyrrole-DNA adducts can also be developed as potential biomarker for the assessment of PA/PA N-oxide associated chronic liver injury (Paper 7; Abstract 10, 14).

471013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
471013.value: Our developed biomarker has been well received in Zhongshan Hospital, and become a common practice for confirmative diagnosis of P/PA N-oxide-induced HSOS in drug-induced-liver-injury (DILI) patients. Our collaborators in Zhongshan Hospital have suggested a guideline for more definitive diagnosis of PA-induced HSOS (Paper 2). Hopefully, with collaboration of physicians in Zhongshan and other Hospitals in China and Hong Kong, our developed biomarkers will be accepted for a routine clinical use for more appropriate diagnosis and risk assessment of PA/PA N-oxide intoxication in DILI patients in the near future. Our developed novel and well-received 1) UHPLC-MS method to measure PAs/PA N-oxides in natural products without the availability of reference standards; 2) immunoassay approach to identify the proteins interacted with the reactive metabolites of PAs; and 3) proteomic analysis to examine potential protein targets and pathways of PAs/PA N-oxides intoxication. Our developed pyrrole-DNA adducts have potential to be developed as specific biomarker for assessing PA/PA N-oxide-induced chronic diseases, such as liver cancer. The confirmation of PA N-oxide intoxication in human helps further understanding PA/PA N-oxide-induced hepatotoxicity, and provides scientific evidence for relevant authorities to estabolish more appopriate quality control and monitoring regulations for PA/PA N-oxide-containing/contaminated plants and foodstuffs in the future.

471013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
471013.value: The use of natural products, like herbs, has been rapidly growing worldwide. Unfortunately, their use may cause adverse effects/toxicities. Pyrrolizidine alkaloids (PAs) present in over 6,000 plants, are one of the most common causes of natural product poisonings. Numerous cases of PA-induced liver damage in human are reported yearly via consumption of PA-containing herbs and/or PA-contaminated foodstuffs. However, PA N-oxides are also present in PA-producing plants, and their contents are nearly equal or even higher than their parent PAs in many plants, but whether PA N-oxide can also induce liver toxicity in human is unknown. We have confirmed that both PAs and PA N-oxides could cause liver damage in human. We also developed a specific biomarker of PA/PA N-oxide intoxication. This biomarker can be used to test blood of patients to diagnose whether or not the liver injury is caused by the intake of PA/PA N-oxide-containing herbs and/or contaminated foods. Our findings can not only help clinical doctors to have a confirmative diagnosis of PA/PA N-oxide-induced liver injury in patients, but also provide scientific evidence for the government authorities to set up more appropriate regulations for the quality control of PA/PA N-oxide-containing herbs and/or contaminated foods.

471413.value: 鼻咽癌（ NPC ）是香港一個主要的醫療保健問題。這癌症在中國南部有不尋常的高發病率, 是中年勞動力人口中最普遍的癌症。系統性搜索驅動遺傳變異和了解其導致癌變的機制可促進開發腫瘤標誌和治療干預, 對控制這疾病非常重要。在最近的全轉錄組測序研究中，我們發現多個鼻咽癌特有的融合基因。其中在EBV陽性鼻咽癌細胞株C666-1和4/42(9.5％)原發腫瘤中, 我們發現嵌合染色體16q12.1上的UBR5和染色體8q22.3上的ZNF423的融合基因。這是首次在鼻咽癌發現的經常性基因重排。該UBR5-ZNF423融合基因產生由UBR5啟動子驅動含有ZNF423的C-末端EBF結合結構域的嵌合體融合蛋白。鼻咽癌細胞中UBR5-ZNF423蛋白的表達可能改變early B-cell factor（EBF）的轉錄因子功能。初步研究結果證明UBR5-ZNF423融合特異性siRNA對C666-1細胞的生存和細胞集落形成能力產生顯著的抑製作用。在NIH3T3細胞中UBR5-ZNF423的表達可增強其在軟瓊脂獨立增長和誘導裸鼠體內腫瘤形成能力。研究結果顯示UBR5-ZNF423融合基因是驅動遺傳變化和在部分鼻咽癌的形成發揮重要作用。這項目的目標是揭開UBR5-ZNF423融合基因的致癌特性和生物學意義，並確定其在鼻咽癌腫瘤發生中的作用。我們的目標是:（1）評估UBR5 ZNF423融合基因作為鼻咽癌的生物標誌物的的實用性及其臨床病理意義;（2）研究UBR5-ZNF423融合基因在鼻咽上皮細胞的致癌特性;（3）闡明UBR5-ZNF423轉化能力有關的分子機制。這研究將提高我們對UBR5-ZNF423在驅動鼻咽癌腫瘤癌變的認識。研究結果將提供一個重要的新生物標誌物，治療靶點和開發創新的治療策略，以控制這種致命的疾病。

471413.label: Realisation of objectives
471413.value: Through paired-end whole-transcriptome sequencing of a panel of EBV-associated NPC cell line and xenografts, we have discovered a number of novel fusion transcripts that may contribute to the tumorigenesis process. Among these potential oncogenic transcripts, a recurrent gene fusion of UBR5 on 8q22.3 and ZNF423 on 16q12.2 (UBR5-ZNF423) identified in primary NPCs and a cell line, C666-1. Integrated informatics analysis has further delineated the junction and whole sequence of this chimeric transcript, as well as the translocated chromosomal regions. This somatic gene rearrangement resulted in the overexpression of a fusion gene, UBR5-ZNF423 that was shown to encode a truncated ZNF423 protein containing an EBF binding region (ZNF domains 28-30). This gene arrangement results in the de novo expression of the truncated ZNF423 gene in NPC cells. To evaluate the prevalence of the fusion gene in primary tumors, a cohort of 144 EBV-positive NPC specimens from Hong Kong and Toronto were recruited for RT-PCR and FISH analysis. A total of 12 primary tumors (8.3%) from the patients with advanced disease harbored the UBR5-ZNF423 fusion transcripts (Chung et al, 2013). In addition, we also detected somatic alterations that may be associated with the oncogenic properties of UBR5-ZNF423 in our recent whole-exome (WES) and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) studies. In our ongoing WGS study, 3 new binding partners of ZNF423 including FAM19A4 (3p14.1), MIR5095 (16p21.1), and GPATCH8 (17q21.3). The expression of truncated ZNF423 transcripts encoding the EBF binding region was validated by RNAscope in-situ hybridization. Cloning and characterization of these novel ZNF423 fusion genes will further confirmed their oncogenic function in NPC. Among a cohort of 111 NPC tumors, 10 non-synonymous mutations (including frameshift and splicing mutations) of ZNF521 and EBFs, the paralog and inhibitory targets of ZNF423, were found in 7 patients (6.3%) with advance disease (Li et al., 2017). A somatic mutation of EBF2 was also detected in a new established EBV-positive xenografts (NPC47) derived from a recurrent NPC tumor. The findings indicate that disrupting the ZNF423/ZNF521-EBFs by either somatic mutation or structural alteration contributes the tumor development in a subset of NPC (>14%). The oncogenic properties of UBR5-ZNF423 were comprehensively elucidated in in vitro and in vivo in NPC models. We have demonstrated that knock-down of UBR5-ZNF423 expression by specific siRNAs significantly inhibited the cell proliferation and colon-forming ability of NPC cells. The potential role of UBR5-ZNF423 fusion gene in maintenance of cancer stem cells was supported by significantly reduction of sphere-forming capacities in the NPC cells treated with specific siRNAs. We have also constructed an 3xLacO-shRNA-UBR5-ZNF423 vector and established stably infected C666-1 cells. In the in vivo nude models, the inducible shRNA targeting UBR5-ZNF423 completely suppressed the tumor growth after IPTF treatment for 7 Days while rapid tumor growth was observed in the controls. No obvious weight loss or any side effects were observed in the treated mice. The findings suggest that UBR5-ZNF423 is a promising molecular target for development of new therapeutic strategies for a subset of NPC patients. The transforming ability of UBR5-ZNF423 was also investigated in the NIH3T3 fibroblasts. We found that the anchorage-independent growth in soft agar was significantly enhanced in the UBR5-ZNF423 expressing cells. Importantly, the UBR5-ZNF423 expressing NIH3T3 cells consistently generated the tumors in the nude mice. Similar to the RAS oncogene, UBR5-ZNF423 alone is able to induce tumorigenic transformation in this model. As prediction, we demonstrated that the UBR5-ZNF423 encodes a truncated ZNF423 protein containing an EBF binding region (ZNF domains 28-30) by Western blotting. The domains were also conserved in the newly identified ZNF423 fusions in our WGS study. Then, we have assessed the importance of the EBF binding in their transforming ability. In the C666-1 NPC cells, the co-localization of UBR5-ZNF423 and EBF3 proteins in the nucleus was detected. A panel of UBR5-ZNF423 clones with mutations in the 3 ZNF domains were constructed. All of these ZNF29-20 mutants are not able to bind the EBF3 protein in NPC and mouse fibrobliast cells. Importantly, the in vivo transforming ability of the mutants was significantly reduced in NIH3T3 cells. The finding implies that the UBR5-ZNF423 may transform the normal cell via binding and interfering EBF function. By cDNA microarray, RNA-seq and ChIP-PCR analysis, we have identified CDK6 and EVI1, the direct targets of EBF3, are also the critical effectors of this UBR5-ZNF423 fusion gene. The finding has further proven the role of the fusion gene in regulation of EBF3 downstream genes. As a paralog of ZNF423, ZNF521 is expressed in nasopharyngeal epithelial cells and binds to EBF via an EBF-binding region which is identical to that in UBR5-ZNF423 fusion protein. We have shown that ZNF521 interacted with EBFs and repressed CDK6 expression in NPC cells. Ectopic expression of wild type ZNF521 also significantly suppressed C666-1 cell growth. Importantly, we have proven that the UBR5-ZNF423 activated CDK6 transcription via interfering ZNF521-EBFs interaction. In the NPC cells harboring UBR5-ZNF423 fusion, knock down of CDK6 resulted in dramatic growth inhibition. The finding implies that CDK6 as a promising molecular target in the UBR5-ZNF423 driven tumors. We have worked with our collaborators to evaluate the in vitro and in vivo antitumor effects (e.g. LEE011) of clinical approved CDK4/6 inhibitor on NPC models. In this preclinical study, it is noted that the NPCs with UBR5-ZNF423 fusion (C666-1) or CCND1 amplification (HK1 & xeno-2117) were highly sensitive to the CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment. The effect of CDK4/6 inhibitor on growth inhibition was augmented when further combined with alpha-specific PI3K inhibitors in these NPC models ((Wong CH et al, under review). It is believed that the UBR5-ZNF423 fusion is a critical biomarker for the NPC patients responded to CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment in future clinical studies.

471413.label: Major findings and research outcome
471413.value: In this study, we have comprehensively characterized a UBR5-ZNF423 fusion gene that we were identify from our integrative informatics analysis of RNA-seq and genome sequencing of a panel of EBV-positive NPC tumor lines. The fusion gene was recurrently detected in 8.3% of primary tumors and enriched in the patients with advanced disease (Chung et al. 2013). In addition to UBR5, we also identified several novel partner genes (e.g. FAM19A4, GPATCH8) of ZNF423 fusion by whole genome sequencing. As well as UBR5-ZNF423, these fusions are predicted to encode a truncated ZNF423 protein with an EBF binding domain that might alter the function of its paralog (ZNF521) and binding proteins (EBFs). Somatic mutations of ZNF521 and EBFs were also found in 6.3% of 111 patients in our recent genome sequencing studies (Li et al., 2107). In summary, somatic alterations targeting ZNF423/ZNF521-EBF axis occurred in a subset of NPC patients (>14%) who are commonly with advanced disease. Through functional investigation, we have shown a potent in vivo transforming ability of UBR5-ZNF423 fusion in the NIH3T3 fibroblast cells. In the C666-1 NPC cells, knock-down of the fusion genes significantly suppressed the tumor growth and oncogenic properties (Chung et al. 2013). We also showed that targeting the fusion transcripts by an inducible specific shRNA was able to induce tumor remission in an in vivo NPC nude mice model. The findings suggested that ZNF423 fusions are promising therapeutic targets in this cancer. Our metastatic study has also revealed that the major function of the truncated ZNF423 proteins encoded by the fusion gene is activated CDK6 expression via interfering ZNF521-EBFs interaction in NPC cells. In the NPC cells expressing UBR5-ZNF423 fusion transcripts, knockdown of CDK6 by specific siRNA results in dramatic growth inhibition. A collaborative study also revealed that the UBR5-ZNF423 expressing NPC cells were sensitive to the treatment of clinical-approved CDK4/6 inhibitor (Wong et al, under review). The preclinical data indicate that the ZNF423 fusion is a critical biomarker for CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment in NPC patients.

471413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
471413.value: Based on our findings, we proposed to include UBR5-ZNF423 or other ZNF423 fusion as biomarkers for CDK4/6 inhibitors in the clinical study in NPC patients. We will also screen for the specific inhibitors for the truncated ZNF423 protein. In addition, we will further characterize the newly ZNF423 fusions identified from our whole genome sequencing study to elucidate their oncogenic properties in NPC cells. The potential role of EBFs in regulation of EBV latent and lytic genes will also explored in the EBV-positive NPC models.

471413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
471413.value: UBR5-ZNF423 is the first recurrent transforming fusion gene discovered in nasopharyngeal carcinoma, a common EBV-associated cancer in South China. With the RGC support, we have comprehensively characterized the oncogenic function of this fusion gene, unveiling its potential in development of new treatment for NPC patients. We have revealed the occurrence of the chimeric ZNF423 fusions and impaired ZNF423/ZNF521-EBFs axis in more than 14% of NPC patients. In both in vitro cell culture and in vivo nude mice system, the dramatic growth inhibitory effects via targeting the UBR5-ZNF423 fusion was clearly demonstrated. Our study also uncovered the major function of the fusion gene is activation of the oncogenic cell cycle regulator CDK6 through inhibiting the ZNF521-EBFs interaction. The finding implies that CDK6 is a potential molecular target in NPC with this fusion. Our recent collaborative preclinical study also showed antitumor effect of a clinical-approved CDK4/CDK6 inhibitor in this cancer. The findings supported the important role of chimeric ZNF423 fusion and CDK6 as new biomarker and molecular target for a subgroup of NPC. The work provides important information for development of effective targeting therapy in NPC patients.

471613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
471613.value: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is now the second most common cancer in Hong Kong with an incidence rate of 400 per 100,000. Rectal cancer accounts for 20-30% of these cases, where over half of all patients present at an advanced stage. Patients with ‘high risk’ rectal cancers (technically this means the presence of stage T3 or T4 tumors, lymph node metastasis, radiological evidence of tumor invasion of perirectal fat or mesorectal fascia) have an increased risk of recurrence despite modern surgical techniques. Concurrent use of 5-fluorouracil (5FU)- with radiotherapy (RT) before surgery is the current therapeutic standard for these patients. Despite this, the risk of recurrence remains high and thus there is a recent trend towards the intensification of pre-operative drug therapy. Two key strategies have shown promise in recent years: the use of oral capecitabine with RT (CRT), and the added use of multi-drug combinations before CRT. Randomized studies have now established capecitabine as a more convenient alternative radiosensitizer to intravenous 5FU. Although 2- or 3-drug combinations with 5FU, oxaliplatin (or irinotecan) and a monoclonal antibody are approved indications for metastatic CRC, the high costs of these antibodies and the reliance on biomarkers for selecting patients have limited the cost-effectiveness of this approach in Asia. Therefore, drug triplets consisting of oxaliplatin, 5FU and irinotecan - dubbed the ‘FOLFOXIRI’ or ‘FOLFIRINOX’ regimens – are now under intensive research. The FOLFOXIRI regimen is very promising in the neoadjuvant treatment of liver-only metastases in CRC, and thus it is timely to evaluate it as a pre-operative treatment for rectal cancer. The aim of this study is to improve the treatment of rectal cancer via a novel strategy of adding the ‘FOLFOXIRI’ regimen before pre-operative CRT. We hypothesize that this approach may improve treatment outcome compared with historic data in medically fit patients with high risk rectal cancer who require pre-operative CRT. Given the lower incidence of rectal cancer compared with colon cancer, historically, large phase III studies can only be realistically achieved in multicenter settings supported by multinational cooperative groups or the pharmaceutical companies. Therefore, we propose to conduct this phase II study at the Prince of Wales Hospital, where 40 patients will be recruited from all the referring centers within the New Territories East Cluster over 30 months. This pivotal study may establish in a new treatment option for high risk rectal cancer and provide the basis for future registration trials. 本研究的主要目的在於探究若在電療與手術前加入化療，是否可能改善高風險結直腸癌患者的預後情況。本研究大約會有40人參加，中心設於香港威爾斯親王醫院。治療分4階段進行. 階段1 – 按「FOLFOXIRI」用藥方案進行手術前靜脈注射化學治療. 階段2 – 手術前同時進行電療與卡培他濱口服化學治療. 階段3 – 手術. 階段4 – 手術後化學治療.

471713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
471713.value: There is a global epidemic of diabetes. Diabetes is characterized by impaired beta-cell function and presence of insulin resistance. Asian patients with diabetes often have impaired beta-cell function. Beta-cell function has been found to be the main determinant of progression to diabetes from pre-diabetes, though the factors that affect beta-cell function are not well understood. Identification of the factors associated with impaired beta-cell function can help empower future prevention efforts. Genetic factors are known to be associated with impaired beta-cell function, with several genetic variants identified to be associated with type 2 diabetes and impaired beta-cell function through genome-wide association studies. Recently, intra-uterine factors such as maternal hyperglycaemia have also been implicated in the development of diabetes, obesity and cardiometabolic traits in the offspring. In this project, we will utilize a well-characterized longitudinal birth cohort of 900 mother-offspring pairs, who have undergone detailed metabolic characterization, to identify the key clinical and genetic factors associated with impaired beta cell function in the offspring. We will obtain in the children genotype of a panel of genetic variants found to be associated with hyperglycaemia or markers of beta-cell function in recent genome-wide association studies, in order to examine their relevance in Chinese children. We will use traditional statistical analysis to identify clinical and genetic factors associated with impaired beta-cell function. In addition, we will also utilize a novel approach, structural equation modeling, to identify interactions between the clinical and genetic determinants of impaired beta-cell function. Finally, we plan to derive a risk prediction score for impaired beta-cell function using the combined clinical and genetic factors. 472113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
472113.value: Human papilloma virus vaccines have the potential to significantly reduce the problem of cervical cancer and a number of countries have recommended their routine administration. However high cost of vaccine has prevented its introduction into the National Immunisation Programmes of many low- and middle-income countries. In a previous pilot study, 40 female subjects received human papilloma virus vaccine by different routes of administration (intradermal, intramuscular), by different devices of administration (needle/syringe, PharmaJet device), by different dose (20% of full dose, full dose) and by different vaccine type (Cervarix®, Gardasil®). All subjects demonstrated a seroconversion (titer >=1:320) by Day 95 and although intradermally administered vaccine was more reactogenic than intramuscularly administered vaccine, the intradermal route was still tolerable. The planned dose-ranging study will compare human papilloma virus vaccine administered by two different routes (intra-muscularly and intradermally) in different doses (5% of full dose, 10% full dose, 20% of full dose, full dose) in healthy adults aged 20 to 26 years. The study aims to determine which reduced dose of vaccine given intradermally, should be used in a subsequent larger non-inferiority study comparing full dose intramuscular vaccine with reduced dose intradermal vaccine. 472413.label: Project Objectives
472413.value: There are 3 objectives in our study. We aim to investigate the role of the proposed pathways mediated by transcription factor NR4A2 in LPS-activated neonatal neutrophils. Objective 1: To validate the proposed signal cascade leading to LPS-induced upregulation of transcription factor NR4A2 mediated by TLR-4, p38MAPK and NF-kappa B.
