510513.label: Major findings and research outcome
510513.value: Personal cooling system (PCS), in the form of cooling garment, is an effective way to reduce body heat strain from the wearer. Commercially available cooling vests (Vests A and B) were evaluated across four selected fields (i.e. construction, outdoor cleaning and horticulture, kitchen work and work involved manual handling at the airport) in Hong Kong [1, 14, 15]. The first round of field studies identified a commercially available cooling vest (Vest B) that was highly rated and preferred by the workers. Then, laboratory testing of Vest B verified its effectiveness in reducing heat strain [12]. The second round of field studies further identified the shortcomings of Vest B, including easily staining color, short cooling time, heavy weight, inflexibility, a lack of industry-specific design, nondurable, and thick fabric with poor permeability [15]. Consequently, developing a tailor-made PCS for the construction industry was proposed [3]. Literature review and meta-analysis of PCS studies suggested to developing a hybrid cooling vest for construction workers [18]. Referring the prototype of Vest B and literature review, the research team designed and engineered a two-layer cooling vest with hybrid and portable cooling sources, i.e. a pair of ventilation fans and phase change material (PCM) cooling packs [3]. The PCS design comprehensively considers cooling effect, cooling duration, weight, mobility, comfort, visibility, safety, aesthetics and ergonomics [3, 11, 13]. The effectiveness and applicability of this PCS were examined in a series of thermal manikin tests, human wear trials in the laboratory and field studies [2, 4, 7, 8, 10, 13]. In the thermal manikin test, with combined cooling sources (i.e. PCM + Fan-on), the newly designed cooling vest has a much higher cooling power of 67–87 W than Vest B (51–58 W) [13]. Human wear trials in the laboratory found that the newly designed cooling vest significantly reduced heat strain during recovery period (heat storage reduced by 59%) and improved work performance (exercise duration extended by 52%) [4, 8, 10]. The results of field studies showed that subjective ratings of cooling effect, thermal comfort, wetness sensation, and fatigue recovery in the cooling condition ranged from 4 to 6 (seven-point Likert scale, the higher the better), suggesting a highly satisfactory level [2, 7]. In general, the cooling condition was rated significantly higher (the higher the better) than the control condition on all the subjective items (p < 0.05) [2, 7].

510513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
510513.value: In the present study, the effectiveness and applicability of the cooling intervention with the newly designed PCS in alleviating heat strain have been validated through laboratory experiments and field studies. A longitudinal study is needed in future studies to examine the long-term effects of the cooling intervention on preventing heat-related illnesses and safety accidents. Compared with cross-sectional research that analyses multiple variables at a given instance, longitudinal studies use continuous measures to follow-up on particular individuals over periods (that usually last for years). Longitudinal studies are designed to identify changes that a cooling intervention has induced in terms of the rate of heat-related injuries, as well as attitudes and behaviors towards heat-stress prevention. Personal protective equipment (PPE), e.g. safety helmet, boots, gloves, respirators and goggles, have been widely used in the construction industry. During hot summer, workers are sometimes unwilling to wear the PPE due to the unpleasant thermal sensation. Improvements and cooling techniques on the current PPE are imperative. This study developed a cooling garment for the construction industry, formulating a research framework for the development and evaluation of a PPE with proper cooling effect in future studies.

510513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
510513.value: Numerous previous studies examined the effectiveness of PCS in firefighting, sports events, military activities and hazmat operations. However, limited research focused on developing a cooling intervention with the PCS for the construction industry. In view of this, the current study designed and engineered a tailor-made personal cooling system (PCS) for construction based on scientific rigor and practical problem solving ability. The research combined comprehensive literature review, physical testing of PCS elements, laboratory experiments on thermal manikins and human subjects, and field studies. The special features of the newly designed PCS exhibit high cooling power and ergonomics properties in consideration of comfort, mobility, weight, aesthetics, visibility, and safety of construction workers. The PCS can be used on construction sites with confined space, elevated platforms, and uneven ground where installation of blowers and provision of cold water reservoir are usually impractical. The PCS has remarkable benefits in reducing body heat strain and improving work performance; thus, the well-being of construction workers will be improved. The convincing research findings enable both the academia and practitioners to improve work practice through developing an industry standard on applying an appropriate cooling intervention with the PCS in the construction industry.

511313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
511313.value: In spite of huge amount of research effort spent on metallic glasses (MGs) over the last two decades, the lack of new functional or structural applications is still a main hurdle for their further development. Since the discovery of the high activity of a metallic glass in the 1980s, a large number of studies have been conducted to investigate the catalytic properties of MGs. Nonetheless, there are still two major drawbacks for their catalytic applications, which include their low structural and chemical stability, and the low surface area of the as-quenched MGs. Most recently, among various catalytic applications, MGs have demonstrated promising results in wastewater treatment such as the degradation of azo dyes and the removal of organic substances. Although MG powders exhibit superior efficiency in degrading dyes compared to conventional crystalline powders, a novel MG material or structure which has a combination of high treatment capacity, high thermal and structural stability, high surface area, long working life, ease of reuse or recycling, and low operation cost is needed. With the rich research experience of the team on bulk MGs and the preliminary work on MGs for wastewater treatment, the project aims to further develop such a novel MG structure. Work will be firstly conducted to develop and synthesize a MG material with a combination of excellent activity, good structural and chemical stability and long working life by compositional design. Its mechanisms for the catalytic effect and the degradation of dyes will be analyzed. Since MG powders involve of agglomeration and clogging issues, the project team proposes that, in order to substantially increase the surface area, work will be done to synthesize micro MG wires of different sizes by the rotating-liquid melt-spinning method or drawing BMGs at their supercooled liquid regions. The wire will then be further woven into cellular structures, and porous structure on the surface of the wire-woven structure will be produced by surface treatment. It is envisaged that in addition to its promising catalytic properties, the structure will be of high mechanical strength and high cell density, which is very desirable due to its ease of operation, reuse or recycling. The proposed work is both of significant academic and practical value. The success of the project will have a major impact to the field of metallic glasses, and wastewater treatment for environmental protection. It is expected that this approach can also be applied to other catalytic applications. 在過去的二十年內，儘管對於非晶態合金一直有大量的研究，但是由於缺乏功能和結構方面的應用，非晶態合金並沒有能夠得到進一步的發展。同時，自從20世紀80年代發現非晶態合金的性能很活躍，大量的研究開始集中在它們的催化性能上。但是，非晶態合金作為催化劑有兩個主要的缺點，一個是它們的結構上和化學性能的不穩定，另一個是表面積太小。在各種催化應用中，非晶態合金最近在污水處理中的結果很好，包括偶氮染料的降解以及一些有機物的消除等。在染料降解中，儘管非晶態合金粉末比傳統晶體粉末有更好的效率，但是更需要一種能夠結合高處理能力、高熱穩定性、高結構穩定性、大表面積、長久工作壽命、易於回收再利用和低工作成本這些特點的新型非晶態材料或者結構。這也正是這個項目的目標，根據課題組在大塊非晶合金方面的豐富研究經驗以及目前對於非晶態合金在污水處理方面的工作，進一步研發這樣的新型非晶態合金結構。第一步的工作是通過改變成份來研究合成一種結合了高活躍性、穩定的結構和化學性以及長久的工作壽命的非晶態合金材料。同時分析研究它的催化降解染料的機理。接著，因為非晶態合金粉末會產生凝聚結塊的問題，所以課題組提出製備不同尺寸的微米級非晶態合金線來增加表面積。這些非晶態合金線可以通過旋轉液體熔融紡絲法或者在大塊非晶合金的過冷液相區抽絲。這些合金線會被進一步編織成蜂窩結構，同時表面也會被處理成多孔的結構。可以預計，這樣的結構，不僅僅具有非常好的催化性能，同時還會有很高的機械強度以及單元密度。這對於簡單的工作運行和回收再利用是非常需要的。這個課題有著重要的科研和實用價值。這個課題的成功將會給非晶態合金領域以及環境保護污水處理方面帶來重大的影響。同時，這個思路也很有希望可以用在別的催化應用上。

511313.label: Realisation of objectives
511313.value: Objective 1 (100% achieved) In this project, various Fe-based MG films and wires with enhanced degradation efficiency and working life were successfully synthesized. The MG glass ribbons and wires with different chemical compositions were fabricated by melt-spinning and melt-extraction methods. By chemical or electrochemical dealloying, novel MG films with tunable surface nanoporous structure were also synthesized. The degradation experiment results show that the chemical composition has great influence on the degradation efficiency of the MG films, i.e., the higher iron content, the stronger degradation capability. The results also show that Fe80B20 and Fe72Si2B20Nb6 MG films with porous surface exhibit superior degradation efficiency and working life than that of the bare MG ribbons and commercial pure iron powders. Objective 2 (100% achieved) The microstructures of the Fe-based MG films and MG films with nanoporous surface were characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), transmission electron microscope (TEM), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET). By using a UV spectrophotometer, the degradation efficiency and working life of the Fe-based MG films were systemically investigated. In addition, the effects of different degradation conditions including H2O2 concentration, sample dosage, initial dye concentration, solution PH and reaction temperature on the degradation efficiency were also determined. Objective 3 (100% achieved) The degradation mechanisms of the MG films in wastewater treatment were systematically investigated by studying the activation energy for the oxidative degradation of dye with the MG films. The degradation of dye in wastewater is controlled by thermally-activated process. A strong correlation between the surface-active area of the MG films and the degradation efficiency was also established. The high surface area and ultrasonic cavitation can provide more sites for catalytic reaction and thus result in superior degradation efficiency. Objective 4 (100% achieved) Flexible grid structure with uniform mesh was fabricated by plain weaving melt-extracted Fe80B20 MG micro-wires. Fabrication strategy of the glassy wire grids involves the melt-extraction method to prepare Fe-based MG micro-wires and the subsequent plain weaving of the glassy wires. By controlling the wire diameters, the mesh size of the wire-woven grid can be tuned conveniently.

511313.label: Major findings and research outcome
511313.value: (1) Nanoporous structures were introduced to the surface of Fe72Si2B20Nb6 MG ribbons by chemical treatment. The results show that etching treatment in an HF solution with a volume concentration of 20% for 40 min leads to a porous structure on the Fe72Si2B20Nb6 MG ribbons with a dramatic increase in the specific surface area by 25 times. The much higher specific surface area of the porous ribbons greatly improves the catalytic activity in the degradation of Direct Blue 15 when compared with as-spun metallic ribbons. The related work was published in Chemosphere 174 (2017) 76-81. (2) Fe80B20 MG ribbons with micro/nano size pits on the surface were fabricated by electrochemical etching treatment. The pit (pore) size can be easily tuned by the HCl concentration and potential. Without the application of ultrasounds, the Fe80B20 glassy ribbons with porous surface exhibit a slightly higher degradation performance when compared with the as-spun alloy. The reason is attributed to the higher specific surface area of the porous alloys. When ultrasounds are applied, the difference in catalytic activity between the porous and as-spun amorphous alloys is enlarged. The remarkably enhanced degradation rate is resulted from the improvement of ultrasonic cavitation promoted by the porous sample. The related work was accepted for publication in Corrosion Science. (2) 3D free-standing CuO nanowire array integrated with nanoporous CuO nanocomposite was also fabricated by dealloying Cu60Zr35Al5 glassy ribbon and the subsequent thermal oxidation. The nanocomposite presents a hierarchical nanostructure with a uniform nanowire array and open pore nanoporosity. The as-synthesized monolithic hierarchical CuO nanocomposite with high surface area exhibits superior oxidative degradation performance for MB in the presence of H2O2 than that of commercial CuO nanoparticles. The remarkable catalytic activity along with good reusability and stability during degradation make the as-prepared nanocomposite a promising candidate for purifying wastewater with organic dyes. The related work was published in Corrosion Science 126 (2017) 37-43. (3) Flexible grid structure with uniform mesh fabricated by plain weaving melt-extracted Fe80B20 MG micro-wires, and the produced wire grid with a dosage of 0.3 g/L can completely degrade 0.2 g/L DB 15 azo dyes for less than 30 min at room temperature. The calculated degradation efficiency of the sample is approximately 4.3 min, 2.1 times faster than that of the Fe80B20 glassy ribbons and 28 times for commercial pure Fe powders. The enhanced degradation performance is primarily attributed to the uniform grid structure with high internal surface area in addition to the intrinsic activity of MGs. This finding not only provides high-performance candidate for degrading and filtering wastewater with organic pollutant simultaneously, but also broadens the application ranges of MGs and enlightens the design of high-performance grid structured multicomponent metal catalysts. The related work was published in Material & Design.

511313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
511313.value: (1) The findings of the present project show that surface area has a great influence on the degradation efficiency of the catalysts. For the purpose of further boosting the degradation efficiency of the wire grid structure, more work is proposed to further improve the grid structure with even higher surface area by using thinner glassy wires, and to synthesize active nanostructured structure on the surface. (2) The present findings show that the Fe80B20 wire grid has great potential to be utilized as high-efficiency catalyst for purifying wastewater. Further investigations under industrial environment and broader comparisons are required to evaluate its value in industrial application. After completion of this project, a new Postdoctoral Fellow which is supported by the Hong Kong Postdoctoral Fellowship Scheme will further work on this topic.

511313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
511313.value: Metallic glasses with excellent catalytic properties have attracted much research attention in recent years. Extensive research efforts have been proposed to further improve the degradation efficiency and recyclability of the MG based catalysts. With the aim of addressing this issue, series of Fe80B20 and Fe72Si2B20Nb6 MGs and the MG films with porous surface were successfully synthesized by melt-spinning and dealloying in this work. Meanwhile, by melt-extraction and plain weaving of the MG Fe80B20 wires, novel flexible wire grid structures with tunable mesh sizes were firstly fabricated. The degradation experimental results showed that the surface dealloyed MG films and MG wire grids both exhibit superior degradation efficiency and working life than that of the bare ribbons and commercial pure iron powders. The degradation mechanisms were also investigated. Moreover, considering the effect of nanostructure on the degradation efficiency, novel CuO nanowire array integrated with nanoporous CuO nanocomposite with excellent degradation performance was also synthesized by dealloying and heat treatment of Cu60Zr35Al5 MG ribbon in this project. The results of the projects not only provide various high-performance candidates for degrading wastewater in industry, but also broaden the application ranges of MGs as functional materials.

511613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
511613.value: The conventional first-order linear elastic analysis is being replaced by the second-order analysis im many codes. The assumption behind a linear analysis after yielding and large deflection is no longer valid so it becomes invalid when members yield or grossly deform. Recent works on second-order analysis do not consider formation of plastic hinge along an element. This project is to extend previous works by the proposer for efficient 3-dimensional structural design using one element/member allowing for formation of a plastic hinge along the element length. The conventional cubic element is straight and cannot capture effects of changing curvature. The use of several elements along a member to capture the effect of plastic hinge along a member has been proved to be ineffective as these inter-nodes need to model the member initial imperfection that makes modeling unacceptably complicated for practical uses. Most importantly, using too many elements has been noted to lead to divergence problem during iteration for equilibrium, because of serious truncating errors for solving iteratively a large set of simultaneous equations. The initially curved element developed by the investigator has been noticed to have excellent performance against numerical divergence in practical design and it also contains member imperfection to code requirement. The work will be extended to 3-dimensional case considering plastic hinge along the element as well as lateral-torsional buckling and irregular cross sectional analysis by fibre model. Previous research findings and development by the proposer has, to a certain extent, generated an impact to the practice of structural engineers. The second-order and advanced analysis has been placed in the latest design steel code 2011 published by the Hong Kong government (see web http://www.bd.gov.hk/english/documents/code/SUOS2011.pdf ), in which the applicant is the first principal consultant, and nonlinear analysis and design without effective length has been used as the principal design method for member-sizing of major steel structures in Hong Kong and its neighbouring cities like Macau. Another remarkable advantage of using the second-order and advanced analysis is related to the consideration of elastic-plastic buckling for finding of true failure load of structures which can be made of steel or composite materials with any cross sectional shape. A unified design method accounting for buckling and yielding in structures is also proposed for ductility design in future code development which is currently mainly limited to failure of the first member as engineers only use second-order "elastic" analysis. 傳統的一階綫彈性分析正被二階分析所取代。綫性分析所隱含的不發生材料屈服和結構在小變形範圍內的假設，在構件産生塑性變形或者結構逐漸變形時將不再有效。最近在二階分析方面的研究幷沒有考慮到塑性鉸在一個單元內形成的可能。本項目旨在延續項目申請人以前的研究工作，使得可以在保持“一構件一單元”的優越性的同時，允許塑性鉸不僅可在單元兩端形成，也可在單元內任一位置産生，從而提出一種更爲有效的三維結構設計方法。傳統的三次梁柱單元是直的，因而不能模擬到單元曲率變化所引起的效應。采用若干單元去模擬一根構件去捕捉塑性鉸在一根構件內産生的效應已被證明是低效的，因爲這些內部節點需要調整坐標去反映構件的初始缺陷，這就使得結構模型變得複雜而不能接受，也就難于在實際結構設計中采用。更爲重要的是，采用太多的單元在非綫性分析的平衡迭代中常導致收斂問題，這是因爲在求解龐大的剛度方程中截斷誤差所帶來的數值問題更爲嚴重。項目申請人所發展的考慮初始缺陷的單元已被證明在對待數值發散方面擁有很高的性能，同時它所包含的構件缺陷是滿足規範要求，因此在實際工程中得到了廣泛的應用。本研究工作就是進一步延伸以前的工作至三維的情况，可以考慮塑性鉸在單元內形成，以及側向扭轉屈曲和采用纖維模型的任意截面分析。 項目申請人以前的研究工作在某種程度上已經給當前的結構工程師帶來很大的影響。二階及高等分析已經在香港政府所發布的最新的鋼結構設計規範2011中得到詳細闡述，見網頁http://www.bd.gov.hk/english/documents/code/SUOS2011.pdf。在該規範中，項目申請人是首要的諮詢人。不需要假設有效長度的非綫性分析和設計法已經作爲一種主要的設計方法，用于去確定香港已經毗鄰的城市如澳門的主要的鋼結構的構件尺寸。采用二階及高等分析的另一個顯著優點是，它可以考慮到結構的彈塑性失穩，因而可以準確預測任意截面形狀的鋼以及組合結構的失穩荷載。一種綜合考慮結構穩定性和材料屈服的一致性設計方法將提出，這將有利于以後規範往延性設計方向發展，而目前結構設計主要限于第一塑性鉸的形成。

511613.label: Realisation of objectives
511613.value: An one-element-per-member allowing for plastic hinge along the element length is developed and it allows a full plastic analysis carried out for steel structures. In the past, the one-element-per-member model can only be applied to elastic analysis which is limited to the first-plastic hinge design. Twisting and lateral buckling is allowed in the element and the member can be of irregular shape. In future, engineers could do a plastic hinge more easily. the outcome allows engineers to carry out a plastic design in a more simple way and the work in future could be extended to seismic design in addition to plastic design.

511913.label: Project Title(Chinese)
511913.value: 應用於三維視頻編碼的區域率失真優化

511913.label: Project Objectives
511913.value: MVD data consists of texture videos and the associated depth maps, where depth data is not directly viewed by users, and it only assists in making synthesized views. So far, rate-distortion optimization (RDO) is always designed based on the depth map itself. However, distortions in depth data will lead to pixels being warped to difference positions in the synthesized view, which causes position/geometry errors. This motivate us to adopt the new RDO framework which is based on the synthesized view instead of the depth map. Although the new RDO is the well-defined quantitative metric, it cannot be quantified on a single block basis, and causes macroblock dependency. To resolve this bottleneck and propose solutions to alleviate the dependency, we will explore a region-based RDO in which a macroblock grouping scheme is proposed to select collective set of encoding modes for a restrictive number of MBs by considering many factors such as the configuration of the camera setting, the distortion of the depth map, the local characteristics of the texture video, etc. Results of our preliminary study shows that the proposed region-based RDO provides impact gains compared with the Test Model of 3DV. It should be noted that the search space for the region-based RDO of collective mode decisions is N to the power of M, where M is the number of macroblocks in the region and N is the number of modes per macroblock. Since N is large in most video coding standards, the exhaustive mode decision is extremely high. In response such challenge, we are going to investigate a reduced set of inter/intra modes per macroblock in each region so as to migrate the complexity of the region-based RDO. To involve the region-based model in RDO, directly adopting the existing inter/intra modes of H.264/MVC/MVD is not sufficient. A further need for new modes, that are specifically designed for region-based RDO, for depth maps may arise. The purpose of the new modes is to optimize the overall trade-off between quality, bitrate, and complexity of depth map coding in the region-based RDO framework.

This motivate us to adopt the new RDO framework which is based on the synthesized view instead of the depth map.

Although the new RDO is the well-defined quantitative metric, it cannot be quantified on a single block basis, and causes macroblock dependency. To resolve this bottleneck and propose solutions to alleviate the dependency, we will explore a region-based RDO in which a macroblock grouping scheme is proposed to select collective set of encoding modes for a restrictive number of MBs by considering many factors such as the configuration of the camera setting, the distortion of the depth map, the local characteristics of the texture video, etc.

Results of our preliminary study shows that the proposed region-based RDO provides impact gains compared with the Test Model of 3DV. It should be noted that the search space for the region-based RDO of collective mode decisions is N to the power of M, where M is the number of macroblocks in the region and N is the number of modes per macroblock. Since N is large in most video coding standards, the exhaustive mode decision is extremely high. In response such challenge, we are going to investigate a reduced set of inter/intra modes per macroblock in each region so as to migrate the complexity of the region-based RDO.

To involve the region-based model in RDO, directly adopting the existing inter/intra modes of H.264/MVC/MVD is not sufficient. A further need for new modes, that are specifically designed for region-based RDO, for depth maps may arise. The purpose of the new modes is to optimize the overall trade-off between quality, bitrate, and complexity of depth map coding in the region-based RDO framework.

511913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
511913.value: 三維視頻提供了令人興奮的視覺體驗。它們並不限於應用在劇院中, 由於三維電視和藍光三維的快速發展, 三維視頻應用於家庭娛樂也變得越來越普及。在三維家庭娛樂市場中，預計在未來幾年將持續快速增長。由於用戶的習慣，家庭和影院中對三維視頻的要求有很大不同。在劇院裡，觀眾容易接受戴著眼鏡看立體內容, 此情況在家庭影院是比較難接受。有見及此,一種不戴眼鏡的三維顯示器專為家庭用戶設計，這種新穎的三維顯示器從傳統的二視點立體顯示發展成先進的自動立體顯示器, 這種三維顯示器能同時展現兩個或兩個以上的視圖。最近的三維顯示器能在同一時間顯示九個不同的視頻。我們相信，在不久的將來，自動立體顯示器將會成為主導三維家庭娛樂市場, 為了提供多個視頻到顯示器，或在深度圖的幫助下合成大部份視圖。許多研究者，包括我們, 提出了很多不同的多視頻的方法，但在一些有限的傳輸帶寬的環境下, 數量龐大的多視頻方法是不可行的。在三維視頻鏈的趨勢，特別是在家庭影院，它將使用有限的多視圖附加深度（ MVD ）的數據格式。本項目將基於MVD的數據格式而去探索一些相關於三維視頻編碼的技術。

511913.label: Realisation of objectives
511913.value: All four objectives mentioned in 5.1 have been achieved by using various rate-distortion optimization in 3D video coding. 3D video (3DV) brings viewers with the real 3D sensations of scenes. Efficient coding of these data is crucial for the success of these applications. Consequently, the Joint Collaborative Team (JCT) on Video Coding, which was formed by VCEG and MPEG standard committees, developed a new standard for multi-view video coding (MVC). However, a large number of camera arrays are impractical in video acquisition since the required bandwidth of MVC encoded video is proportional to the number of views. The achievable compression is not good enough to overcome bandwidth constraints. Owing to these limitations, only a limited camera input (two to three views) with associated depth maps are incorporated in the new 3D data format. With the depth information, an arbitrarily number of views from these limited views can be synthesized. This new format is referred to as multi-view video plus depth (MVD). This research work successfully investigate this emerging MVD data format that enables the reconstruction of an arbitrarily large number of views with bandwidth constraints. This is also the current activity under JCT. The major objectives of this project is to contrive a new coding strategy for mode decision in MVD, with major focus on depth coding. Previous studies gave much attention to depth coding, more specific to directly encoding depth maps by preserving edge boundaries in which rate-distortion optimization (RDO) was designed based on the depth map itself. However, distortions in depth data will lead to pixels being warped to difference positions in the synthesized view, which causes position/geometry errors. To evaluate our new idea, we have first implemented the novel rate-distortion optimization (RDO) framework, which considers both of the texture and depth map, in the reference software HTM-16.0 of the 3D-HEVC standard for 3D video coding (Objective 1). We have done some careful investigation of this direction in the project. It is found that the new RDO cannot be quantified on a single block basis, and it induces macroblock dependency. One straightforward approach is to consider the whole frame during mode selection. Even though this approach would guarantee the highest rate-distortion gain, it is computationally impossible since each MB has various inter and intra modes, in which each mode requires forward and inverse integer transforms, and variable length coding when RDO is computed. Consequently, our proposed scheme is to select collective set of encoding modes for a restrictive number of MBs, which forms a region/segment. The scheme then encodes depth map one group of MBs (region/segment) at a time rather than a single MB at a time, resulting in increase of computational complexity. Consequently, we have considered many factors such as the configuration of the camera setting, the distortion of the depth map and the local characteristics of the texture video in order to reduce the complexity of the new region-based RDO. Our experimental works have also shown that the proposed region-based RDO can achieve very good quality of the synthesized views with acceptable complexity increase after considering the aforementioned factors (Objective 2). The complexity of the proposed region-based RDO depends on the number of MB in the region (M) and the number of modes per MB (N). Then the search space for the region-based RDO of collective mode decisions is N to the power of M. To reduce the complexity, the large amount of modes per MB (N) is restricted to obtain precise options which are tailor made to the new region-based RDO for depth map coding by considering smooth MBs with completely flat pixels (SB_FLAT). When a block is identified as SB_FLAT, all pixels of the predicted block are just copied from neighbouring reference pixels. In MBs, the prediction directions such as horizontal, vertical, plane, etc, are therefore valueless for SB_FLAT, and can eliminate unnecessary computations to choose the best prediction direction since DC mode is used in each SB_FLAT. As a result, the number of modes per MB in each region can be reduced. We have already successfully incorporated the idea of SB_FLAT into the proposed region-based RDO with encouraging results (Objective 3). We also investigated whether it is possible for designing new merge mode of MBs with region such that it can further reduce the complexity. MB merging proposed in this investigation enables the creation of sub-regions in each region. The merged block is composed of MBs with identical local image characteristics. If two blocks are merged, the search space for the region-based RDO of collective mode decisions is reduced from N to power of M to N to power of M-1. This idea forms the basis for further migrating the complexity of the regions-based RDO scheme, and also integrated into the practical 3D video coding system (Objective 4).

511913.label: Major findings and research outcome
511913.value: We have witnessed the rapid developments of 3D video (3DV) technology in the past few years. The commercially available technology is based on stereo systems, which adopt stereo video coding for pictures captured by closely located two cameras. These two videos (left and right views) then show to left and right eyes simultaneously. Viewers wearing special 3D glasses can then have realistic 3D scene perception. With the recent advance in auto-stereoscopic multi-view displays that allow to show more than two views to facilitate 3D viewing for multiple viewers without wearing 3D glasses. To support this, a new multi-view plus depth (MVD) format that includes both videos and the corresponding depth maps is emerging. This MVD format enables to generate intermediate or virtual views. The research aim of this project is to develop an MVD coding scheme so that the high-quality reconstruction of synthesized views for auto-stereoscopic multi-view displays can be achieved. A number of novel region or segment-based rate-distortion optimization (RDO) frameworks for MVD were proposed and designed successfully (Part C Journal [2, 3], and Part C Conference [6]). We have incorporated the proposed region/segment-based RDO in the reference software HTM-16.0 of the 3D-HEVC standard. Even though this approach would guarantee the highest rate-distortion gain, it is computationally impossible for practical systems. Consequently, some efficient algorithms for region partitioning based on (a) configuration of the camera setting, (b) distortion in the depth map and (c) local characteristics of the reference texture video have also been derived and implemented (Part C Journal [1], and Part C Conference [2]). The proposed approaches give a significant improvement in quality of the reconstructed frames. We then designed several efficient and fast algorithms to limit block modes for each MB in a region options which are tailor made to the new region-based RDO for depth map coding (Part C Conference [1]). A number of new modes of MBs for depth maps have also been proposed and designed successfully for the new RDO framework in MVD (Part C Conference [3-5]). The proposed approach can further reduce the required complexity. We also found that all these proposed techniques are very easy to incorporate in the current 3D-HEVC standard. As a result, three journal papers and six conference papers have been published in this project.

511913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
511913.value: 3DV enables new immersive experience of viewing real-world environments. Applications include 3DTV, free-viewpoint TV, and 3D movies. Recent advances in 3D display technology have stimulated R&D, standardization initiatives and industry efforts in this area. 3D systems become an important part of entertainment industry, which is growing worldwide with rates of about 10%-20%. In order to support future auto-stereoscopic displays, JCT specified the new emerging MVD data format and finalized the new MVD coding standard last year. Our project coincides with this goal by designing a new depth coding scheme and it can make the MVD system become more practical. This project will have a remarkable impact on the advancement of future 3DV coding technology. The project also forms the basis for the 3D Holoscopic video coding – the next revolution of 3D video, which also requires RDO techniques for video coding optimization developed in this project.

511913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
511913.value: 3D video (3DV) provides illusion of depth perception, and the auto-stereoscopic display is expected to become dominant in the coming future. To support this, multiple views are synthesized with the depth maps at the display, and the trend for 3DV adopts multi-view plus depth(MVD) data format. It is noted that depth images are not viewed directly and depth coding artifacts only result in geometry distortions in synthesized views. Due to this fact, a completely new MVD coding scheme has been developed that optimizes the performance with respect to both video and geometry distortions and takes the quality of synthesized views into consideration. This requires addressing difficult rate-distortion optimization(RDO) that considers distortions from both of texture coding and depth map coding. An RDO based on synthesized views instead of depth maps was then adopted in accurate mode decision of MVD coding. We designed a region-based RDO to enhance the mode selection process. The proposed RDO, however, increases complexity significantly. To alleviate this, some factors are considered to restrict the number of macroblocks in each region. Through this research, we implemented a new RDO approach for MVD which lays down solid foundation for 3DV entertainment systems that require more than 2 views.

512013.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
512013.value: Digital halftoning is originally a process that uses bi-level pixels to simulate a grayscale image on a bi-level output device. It has been widely used for years to produce hardcopies of images. Nowadays display technologies have been advanced a lot and people may think that halftoning will soon be obsolete. However, though printed books could be replaced by e-books, we can still find applications of halftoning in some other domains. Organic light-emitting diode (OLED) is the most advanced display technology nowadays and is still under development. Advanced OLED displays are driven by pulse width modulation (PWM) as it can achieve precise grayscales and allows an easier compensation for the shift of the supply voltage. Recently, to further improve the display quality, Jang et al. suggested using delta-sigma modulation (DSM) to drive the OLED displays such that the false image contour artifacts can be reduced. No matter PWM or DSM is exploited to drive a full-color OLED display, in practice the OLED display behaves as a binary video display to play a time sequence of oversampled binary image frames. For example, when PWM is used to display an 8-bit monochrome image, the image is actually split into a sequence of 256 binary image patterns and the patterns are repeatedly displayed sequentially in a short period such that through the integration effect of eyes the displayed sequence appears as a 256-level image. When a 24-bit full-color image is involved, each binary image pattern is composed of three interleaved binary patterns, one for each of the color channels. The same situations also apply to playing videos. If displaying a full-color image is realized by playing a sequence of binary image frames (i.e. halftones), the question will be how to generate the halftone sequence based on the image such that the display quality of the image is optimal. A more fundamental question is what the desirable characteristics of the halftone sequence should be from quality point of view. Conventional video halftoning algorithms aim at producing binary videos to be played at a low frame rate. Their focus is on handling flickering and solving the problem accursed by conventional deflickering algorithms. No effort has been devoted to study the desirable noise characteristics of an ideal halftone sequence. The objective of the proposed project is to study this issue and develop a new approach to produce halftone sequences bearing the desirable characteristics. 半色調本是一種用雙階像素來模擬多階灰度的圖像處理手法,它被廣泛應用於圖像打印。當今的顯示技術己經十分先進,很多人會認為數字半色調將會被淘汰,這種想法並不正確,雖然印刷本可被電子書所取代,但我們仍然可以找到半色調在其它一些領域的應用。 有機發光二極管(OLED)是現今最先進的顯示技術,它仍處於開發階段。先進的OLED顯示器都使用脈沖寬度調變來驅動,為了更進一步提高它的顯示質量,最近有人提出使用三角積分調變來驅動OLED顯示器以有效地減少畫面上的偽輪廓。 不管我們使用脈沖寬度調變或三角積分調變來驅動OLED顯示器,實際上OLED顯示器都是以一個二值視像顯示器的工作模式去播放一串超頻的二值圖像幀。例如當我們用脈沖寬度調變來顯示一個八位元的灰階圖像時,驅動器實際上會把這個圖像分裂成一序列的二百五十六幅二進制圖像圖案,然後把這序列的圖案在極短時間內重複地順序顯示出來,在錯覺下我們的眼睛會誤以為所顯示的是一幅有二百五十六灰階的圖像。當要顯示全彩圖像或視像時,它的工作原理也是差不多,只是稍為複雜一點。 如果顯示全彩圖像只是通過播放一序列的二值半色調圖像幀來實現,那麼我們應用什麼方法來生成這序列圖像幀以產生最理想的顯示效果?另一個更值得我們思量的問題是:這序列的圖像應擁有什麼噪聲特性? 傳統的視頻半色調算法旨在如何在一些低端的慢速顯示器上播放視像,它們考慮的是如何解決閃爍和因解決閃爍而衍生的問題。目前還沒有人致力於研究何謂二值半色調圖像序列的理想噪聲特性,這個研究項目的目的是對這課題作出探討, 並嘗試開發出新方法來產生具有理想噪聲特性的二值半色調圖像序列。

512013.label: Realisation of objectives
512013.value: All objectives were addressed and achieved in the project. The connection between the halftone quality and the noise characteristics of a video halftone and the impact of various parameters on controlling the noise characteristics of a video halftone were heavily studied. Based on the results obtained, we explored some directions to effectively produce video halftones of desired noise characteristics at affordable implementation cost. Three journal papers and two conference papers were published based on the output of this project. They are summarized as follows. (1) Green noise video halftoning: Video halftoning is a technology used to render a video onto a display device that can only display limited number of levels. Conventional video halftoning algorithms produce blue noise video halftones which are prone to flickering. Dedicated deflickering processes are hence required to reduce flickering. These processes share a common approach in which pixels are artificially made stable subject to some quality constraints. Due to the difficulty to control the extent of stability, artifacts caused by overstability such as dirty window effect, subtle motion and residual shadow are easily found in video halftones. In this work, we suggest producing green noise video halftones instead of blue noise video halftones. By doing so, we can effectively reduce flickering and eliminate artifacts caused by overstability from the root simultaneously. (2) Blue noise digital color halftoning with multiscale error diffusion: A recent trend in color halftoning is to explicitly control color overlapping, dot positioning and dot coloring in different stages of the halftoning process. As feature-preserving multiscale error diffusion (FMED) shows its capability and flexibility in dot positioning in both binary and multi-level halftoning applications, naturally it becomes a potential candidate in the development of new color halftoning algorithms. We developed a FMED-based color halftoning algorithm based on the aforementioned strategy. In contrast to the algorithms that adopt the same strategy, the proposed algorithm has no bias on specific Neugebauer primaries in dot coloring and has no fixed scanning path to place dots in dot positioning. These features allow the algorithm to place dots of right colors on the right positions with less constraint and hence it is able to preserve image features in a better way. (3) Tone dependent error diffusion based on an improved noise model The conventional blue noise model that specifies the desired noise characteristics of an ideal halftone has been updated recently and simulation results showed that the updated model can serve as a better guideline for one to develop halftoning algorithms. At the moment only a FMED-based algorithm was developed based on the updated noise model. As the algorithm does not support real-time applications, we developed a tone dependent error diffusion (TDED) algorithm based on the updated noise model. To support the proposed TDED algorithm, we optimize a diffusion filter and a quantizer threshold for each possible input gray level based on the updated noise model such that the algorithm can adapt its diffusion filter and quantizer according to the input intensity value of a pixel to produce a halftone. Simulation results showed that the proposed TDED algorithm can successfully produce halftones bearing the desired noise characteristics as specified by the updated noise model. As a consequence, it provides better performance than conventional error diffusion-based algorithms in terms of various objective measures. When processing real images, it can eliminate directional artifacts, regular structure patterns and unintended sharpening artifacts. (4) The ideal driving signals for driving AMOLED to display videos We proposed an algorithm to generate a driving signal for displaying digital videos with an active-matrix organic light-emitting diode (AMOLED) display. The driving signal allows the AMOLED display to distribute noise both temporally and spatially according to the local characteristics of video content. Accordingly, it is able to produce video of much higher quality than the current systems that adopt pulse width modulation technology to produce the driving signal. We took the realization effort into account and investigated several techniques to lower the implementation complexity. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can provide better video quality than the other driving methods in terms of various measures. (5) Producing color-indexed images with scalable color and spatial resolutions Making the media content to be delivered over the Internet to clients of various capabilities scalable is crucial to improve the efficiency of various involved parties. GIF is one of the primary Web file formats used in Web applications nowadays and hence it is desirable to make them scalable as well. However, as GIF format is purposely designed for supporting clients of limited decoding capability, the scalability should be introduced with only a small increase in decoder complexity and bitstream overhead. We developed an algorithm that is able to produce color-indexed images with scalable color and spatial resolutions. Downscaled versions of an color-indexed image can be obtained by just bit-cropping and/or down-sampling the index plane of the image.

(2) We developed a FMED-based color halftoning algorithm in [8.1] to produce color halftones that bear optimal noise characteristics and preserve the color and texture features in a better way. (3) We developed a tone dependent error diffusion (TDED) algorithm in [8.2] based on the most updated blue noise model. (4) We proposed an algorithm in [8.3] to generate a driving signal for displaying digital videos of optimal noise characteristics with an active-matrix organic light-emitting diode (AMOLED) display. (5) We proposed a method in [9.2] to produce color-indexed images with scalable color and spatial resolutions such that they can be delivered over the Internet efficiently to support clients of various capabilities.

512013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
512013.value: The output of this work provides a direction to develop a new generation of OLED display products. Current OLED displays are still driven by pulse width modulation and their display quality is much lower than that can be achieved by our proposed driving technology. It would be a natural move to transfer the technology to the industry.

512013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
512013.value: Organic light-emitting diode (OLED) is the most advanced display technology nowadays. Its display quality heavily relies on how its pixels are driven. When displaying images or videos, the driving signal of the whole display unit is actually a video halftone and its noise characteristics determines the display quality. This project explores the ideal spatial and spectral characteristics of a video halftone for driving OLED displays from quality point of view. The fruitful results of the studies carried out in the project can be directly applied to design drivers for high quality OLED displays and it benefits the display industry.

512113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
512113.value: 過高的噪音水平為城市居民帶來了迫在眉睫的威脅。到 2050年，預計有百分之七十的世界人口會在城市居住，高噪音水平的問題將會更為普遍。高噪音水平不僅可能造成滋擾，更會影響人們的集中力，以及削弱生產力。更甚的是，這問題有機會影響人們的健康。 至今為止，相關研究主要集中在減低交通或其他噪音音壓強度的方法上。可是傳統減低噪音的方法（例如安裝隔音屏障或使用路面吸音材料）無法徹底解決噪音問題；這些方法也不一定適合在一個都市環境中使用。事實上，有很多因素同時影響噪音滋擾度，只考慮音壓強度並不能有效地解決噪音問題。減低噪音滋擾度應被視為達到一個可接受的聲學環境這一終極目標的唯一手段。 是故，我們需要一個別的方法去減低噪音滋擾度，以及改善住宅內的聲學環境可接受性。而是次研究計劃的主要目標，是制訂一套公園規劃和設計指引，利用額外的聲源以減低公園附近居民在住宅裡的噪音滋擾度，和改善相關聲學環境的可接受性。而制訂該指引成功的關鍵主要是額外的自然聲源能否減低噪音滋擾度和改善環境的可接受性；另一關鍵是能否利用科學觀察實驗的方法去開發一能預測混合聲源對居民影響的數學模型。 長遠來說，是項研究可以幫助城市規劃人員及設計師，利用一個新的方法去制定規劃或設計大綱，從而減低居民在住宅裡所感受到的噪音滋擾度，和改善聲學環境的可接受性。最重要的是，這個方法有助促進現代都市人在資源有限的社區內生活的質素及福祉。是項研究同時也可以為政策制訂者提供一個以科學證據為基礎的民居規劃及設計大網，以提升人們的生活質素。

512113.label: Realisation of objectives
512113.value: In order to attain the objectives in this study, two sets of controlled laboratory experiments were performed consecutively in a study room in the Department of Building Services Engineering of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University. For both sets of experiments, a series of audio stimuli were presented to participants through SENNHEISER HD 280 pro headphones. To mitigate the chance of degradation in the response quality, the entire series of experiments were divided into two parts: Part A and Part B. Each respondent took part in either one of these parts. Part A aims to elicit the effects on people’s annoyance responses when different types of natural sounds were added to road traffic noise (Objectives II & III). In the first task of this part, participants were asked to rate the preferences to stream and fountain sound (or bird sound in the 2nd experiment) at different sound pressure levels (SPLs) and annoyance responses due to road traffic noise at different noise levels. Participants were required to listen to 9 single sound source scripts (i.e. 3 stream sound scripts, 3 fountain sound scripts, and 3 traffic noise scripts in the 1st set of experiments or 3 bird sound scripts, 3 stream sound scripts, 3 traffic noise scripts in the 2nd set of experiments) in which the total SPLs were set to 55/60/65 dBA respectively. Each sound script was played for 30 seconds and a 10-second break was introduced between two consecutive scripts. During the experiments, participants were required to rate their preferences for individual stimulus on a structured questionnaire using 11-point verbal scale (-5 to 5; ‘-5’ denotes ‘Extremely annoyed’, ‘5’ denotes ‘Extremely pleasant’, and ‘0’denotes ‘Neutral’). The aim of the second task was to reveal the effects of water-traffic sounds on individuals’ noise annoyance responses. The total sound levels of the mixed scripts were set at either 55, 60 or 65 dBA level. 42 mixed sound scripts were divided into 3 groups and each group contained 14 scripts. Each participant was only required to listen to the sound scripts from one of the three groups in a random manner. They were asked to assign their noise annoyance ratings for each sound script using an 11-point verbal scale (i.e. 0 to 10; where ‘0’ denotes “Not annoyed at all” and “10” denotes “Extremely annoyed”). Besides, participants were asked to answer some general questions about their personal characteristics (e.g. gender and age) as well as their health status and noise sensitivity level. Part B aims to elicit the effects on individuals’ noise annoyance responses when water sound or bird sound was added to traffic noise (Objectives II & III). The first task was similar to that in Part A except that participants were asked to rate the preferences or annoyance of stream sound, bird sound and traffic noise at different levels. For the second task of part B, participants were asked to compare the effects on noise annoyance responses when bird or stream sound were added to traffic noise. Similar to the second task in Part A, 42 scripts were divided into 3 groups and each participant was only required rate the annoyance level of the scripts of either one of the groups. In addition, they were requested to identify the type of sound source they perceived to be dominant in individual sound scripts containing mixed sounds. In addition, participants were also asked to provide their personal details. Results The spectral distribution profiles of different types of sounds were first determined and analyzed. The psychoacoustic characteristics and the average preferences of different types of single sounds and mixed sounds were determined. In addition, the collected responses from both sets of experiments were analyzed with the aid of the statistical software SPSS version 20 and STATA SE version 12 for formulating econometric models. With the formulation of the above models, Objectives IV, V and VI could be addressed. For stream and fountain sounds Given the ordinal nature of annoyance responses, ordered logit models were used to predict the probability of occurrence of a particular outcome, e.g. the probability of assigning a high annoyance response in this study. Specifically, a logit function can be formulated from the ordered logit model estimates and used to predict the probability for an individual to assign a particular annoyance rating. The probability of assigning a particular annoyance rating can be estimated as follows: (1) where assumes different value at different sound pressure level i, µy is the threshold value for annoyance rating y estimated for the ordered logit model and y ranges from 1 to 10. The results of regression analysis are as follows (Objective I): Z=0.170×L_TN+0.100〖×L〗_WS-0.618×Threshold-0.457×Type+0.558×Gender+0.665×Sen (2) Where L_TN: Noise level of traffic noise in dBA; L_WS: Sound level of water sound in dBA; Threshold: Threshold, which takes the value of 1 when SNR, which is the difference between water sound level and traffic noise level (in dB), is equal to 0-3dB and the global SPL is lower than or equal to 70 dBA, otherwise 0. 512113.label: Major findings and research outcome
512113.value: The findings arising from this study have a number of aspects that can contribute to new knowledge in the area of adding natural sounds to acoustic environment containing road traffic noises. First, this study successfully formulated multivariate models to predict the probability of evoking a high total annoyance response due to exposing to combined road traffic noises and water sounds/bird sound (Objective I). To our best knowledge, this is also one of the pioneering studies that has successfully formulated models to predict the probability due to exposure to a combination of both wanted and unwanted sounds. The model forms successfully include not only acoustical factors (e.g. levels of two sound sources), but also personality traits (e.g. noise sensitivity). Tradeoff ratios (Objective IV) revealed from the models were used to develop a conversion metrics to translate the annoyance effect caused by a qualitative factor into an objectively measured dB level, e.g. noise sensitivity, which can be used to formulate guidelines for improving the acoustic environment within urban parks (Objective VI). Second, bird, stream and fountain sounds were all found to be able to enhance the pleasantness of the acoustic environment (Objective V). They were all found to be capable of moderating annoyance responses due to road traffic noises (Objective II). The capability to lower the probability of evoking a high total annoyance response varied with the type of natural sound added. While all the studied sounds could lower the noise annoyance ratings, bird sound was shown to be more effective than stream sound and in turn fountain sound when added to road traffic noise at 55-65 dBA (Objective III). However, due to multi-collinearity issues, psychoacoustic parameters had not been incorporated as proxies for the type of natural sounds in the final model forms. Finally, it was observed that there was a ‘‘combined sound region” in which human sound perceptions are considerably different from those outside the region (Objective III) when water sound was added to traffic noise. The combined region was observed to be present in this study when differences in SPLs of natural sound and traffic noise laid between 0 and 3 dB. Such combined region was only observed at global sound pressure levels of 65 dBA or 70 dBA but not at 75 dBA. The foregoing research outcomes have been reported in a journal paper and two international conference papers.

512113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
512113.value: It was concluded that different types of natural sounds will have different spectral properties and will affect the perception of pleasantness of the acoustic environment and their capabilities of moderating high annoyance responses. It is proposed to conduct further experiments to include different types of water and bird sounds to reveal their capabilities of moderating high annoyance responses. With these results, it is proposed to create a library of different types of natural sounds for facilitating urban planners and designers in enhancing the acoustic environment of parks.

512113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
512113.value: People in an urban environment are exposed to different types of natural and man-made sounds. Hitherto, there is a lack of multivariate models that can help predict the preferences or annoyance responses as a result of adding a natural sound to an unwanted sound. Accordingly, this study aimed at developing multivariate models to predict the probability of evoking a high noise annoyance response due to combined water /bird sound and road traffic noise exposure. Two sets of laboratory experiments were performed. Participants were asked to rate their annoyance responses to a series of acoustical stimuli. Results suggested that other than acoustical properties like sound pressure levels, types of natural sounds added to traffic noise and personality traits were found to exert considerable influences on the annoyance responses. The quality of the acoustical environment could be improved by adding water or bird sounds to road traffic noises at high levels. Bird sound was found to have a slightly stronger capability than stream sound and in turn than fountain sound in moderating noise annoyance. Results arising from this study should provide valuable insights on understanding how humans respond to the combined water/bird sound and traffic noise exposure and formulating guidelines for improving the acoustic environment in urban parks.

512313.label: Project Title(Chinese)

512313.label: Project Objectives
512313.value: For a lightning stroke, a TOA/MDF type LLN can report its location and occurring time with relatively high accuracy when the stroke is detected by at least 4 sensors in the LLN. Besides, a LLN also reports the amplitude and arrival time of LEMP of a stroke measured at individual sensors. Both the amplitude and arrival time of LEMP of a stroke measured at individual sensors in a LLN are due to the same LEMP but propagating over different earth surfaces for different distances to different sensors. With these in mind, the possible relationship between the information of a stroke reported by a LLN and the effect of earth surface on LEMP of the stroke will be analyzed and discussed. With above analyses, general equations that describe the relationship between the amplitude and arrival time of LEMP of a stroke measured at individual sensors in a LLN and the factors representing the effect of earth surface on LEMP of the stroke will be developed. Then, specific algorithm for estimation of the spatial profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP with the developed equations for a LLN will be proposed. Applying the proposed algorithm to an existing LLN, estimate the spatial profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP for all sensors in the LLN. There may be several values estimated from different data set for the factors presenting the effect of earth surface on LEMP for the same sensor in the same area. The extent of consistency of these values for the same sensor may be used to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. It is expected that the spatial profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP for a given sensor shall be a function of distance and azimuth to the sensor and shall be different for different sensors in a LLN. Meanwhile, digital earth surface information can be easily retrieved from geographic information systems such as Google maps. Aiding with knowing theory and digital earth surface information, analysis and interpretation of the estimated profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP will be tried and possible measures for improvements of the performance of a LLN will be proposed. Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) method is a discrete for numerical calculation of time-domain electromagnetic field in space and time. Starting with the FDTD discrete, modelling of the effect of earth surface on LEMP in 3-dimension under complicated earth surface conditions will be developed. Comparisons between the modelling and practical results will be good not only for mutual validation but also for well understanding of the insight of the issue.

512313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
512313.value: 摘要 基於磁環定向和時差技術的閃電定位網已經被廣泛用於閃電尤其是雲地之間放電的探測。這些探測資料主要用於雷電物理研究及雷電防護系統設計。在閃電定位網的資料中，有兩個重要的參量：閃電位置和閃電電流峰值。閃電位置是基於電磁脈衝在地表以光速傳播這一假定，根據雷電電磁脈衝(LEMP)到達不同探測站的時間差來確定的。閃電電流峰值則是基於電磁脈衝幅值和閃電與測站距離成反比而和閃電電流成正比這一假定，根據各個探測站記錄的電磁脈衝幅值來確定的。以上的假定，只在平整的擁有良好導電性的地表上成立，而實際的地面情況很複雜，會有高山，沙地以及湖泊。這會直接導致在計算雷電地理座標和電流峰值中出現大的誤差。其實，有些研究人員通過簡單的資料和理論分析，發現地表狀況確實對電磁脈衝信號的幅值和傳播時間有影響，只是他們都沒有給出行之有效的方法來確定和修正閃電定位網中地面對電磁場傳播的影響。 理論上，如果考慮到信號源與探測站之間的傳播路徑和站點的地理位置，閃電定位網中地表對電磁脈衝信號的影響對不同的探測站是不同的。本研究的目的之一是通過對定位網的海量資料的分析，發展出一種系統方法來即時估算地面對閃電電磁脈衝的影響。該方法的特別之處在於它能夠給出定位網中每個探測站周圍受地表影響的空間圖景。此外，作者會建立針對這種問題的理論模型並與實際的地面影響交互驗證。如果該模型與實際情況很相符，即使是沒有投入運行的閃電定位網，地表對雷電電磁脈衝的影響也能被提前獲取。

512313.label: Realisation of objectives
512313.value: The main purpose of the project to identify the interaction between the earth ground roughness and the lightning produced electromagnetic impulse based lightning data recorded with Lightning Location Network (LLN). Matching to the 5 specific project objectives, we have had 5 core tasks, they are: (1) to understand the physical nature of parameters of the LLN lightning data; (2) to identify the possible relationships between factors like the earth ground, ionosphere, lightning-produced electromagnetic impulse (LEMP), setting of a LLN and the data recorded by the LLN; (3) to develop a practical algorithm for retrieving the possible relationships from the real lightning data; (4) to apply the proposed models to real LLN data to examine the relationships between these factors; and (5) to explain the results of the relationships between these factors with adequate theory and with FDTD simulations. To achieve these tasks, we have had following step by step efforts. a) Starting from July of 2013 until the June of 2014, we had carried out a pre- and trial- study on Tasks (1) through (4). Based on a thorough review, we found that most existing LLN are using the TOA/MDF (time-of-arrival /magnetic-direction-finder) combine type sensors. Lightning parameters reported by this type sensor include the strength and arrival time of a lightning-produced electromagnetic pulse (LEMP). A basic hypothesis for doing this is that assume the LEMP propagates on a perfect conductive flat earth surface at the speed of light. However, this assumption has been challenged by the poor consistence in lightning parameters between different sensors for the same lightning stroke. To address this problem, we proposed a statistical approach for identifying the effect of earth path on the LEMP amplitude and arrival time based on LLN lightning data. A trial run and validation of this approach were done with a set of data from a Chinese regional LLN. Partial results of this work were presented at 2013 Annual Assembly of Nation Meteorology Bureau of China (ref.: M. Chen, Study of the influence of ground roughness on lightning electromagnetic impulse (LEMP) based on LLLN data, Annual Assembly of Nation Meteorology Bureau of China, Oct 22-25, 2013, Nanjing, China.). By this effort, we have achieved 70% of Tasks (1) & (2), 30% of Tasks (3) and 10% of Task (4). b) As the same time, we realized that the LEMP interacts with not only the earth surface on ground but also the ionosphere in sky, since it propagates in a waveguide formed by the earth surface and the ionosphere (EIWG). For well understanding of the relationship between LEMP and EIWG, we have begun to collect adequate lightning data from a six-station long-baseline VLF/LF lightning detection network in central China since June of 2014. By analyzing the full-waveforms of distant lightning strokes the daytime variations of the ionosphere D layer were retrieved and analyzed. Partial results of this work were presented at 2015 Asia-Pacific International Conference on Lightning (ref.: Z. Qin, B. Zhu, M. Chen, M. Ma and D. Ma, Configuration of a VLF/LF Lightning Detection Network in Central China and Its application, Asia-Pacific Int. Conf. on Lightning (APL2015), June 22-27, 2015, Nagoya, Japan.). By this effort, we have achieved 100% of Tasks (1), (2), 70% of Task (3), 50% of Task (4) and 20% of Task (5). c) As the continuation of the effort in a), we further accomplished the approach and algorithm proposed during that effort and practiced them with the lightning data from an LLN with DF/TOA (direction-finder/time-of-arrival) combined technique. We noticed that the accuracy of the lightning data from such a LLN has still been restricted by “site error”, especially for those detected only by two DF/TOA sensors. For this sake, we practiced a statistical approach for evaluation and correction of “site error” for DF/TOA type LLN based on its lightning data. By comparing lightning locations recorded by at least 4 sensors between DF and TOA techniques, the “site error” patterns for 23 sensors in Yunnan LLN were obtained. Features of these site error patterns were in good consistency with those in literature. Significant differences in lightning locations before and after “site error” corrections indicate that the proposed approach works effectively. Partial results of this work were published on the journal “Atmospheric Research” (ref.: T Lu, M. Chen, Y. Du, Z. Qiu, A statistical approach for site error correction in lightning location networks with DF/TOA technique and its application results, Atmos. Res., vol.184, p103-111, Oct. 2016.). By this effort, we have achieved 100% of Task (3), 70% of Task (4) and 50% of Task (5) d) As the continuation of effort b), we further accomplished and practiced the model proposed during that effort. We have practiced a newly improved ray theory and transfer matrix method-based model for a lightning electromagnetic pulse (LEMP) propagating in Earth-ionosphere waveguide (EIWG). The model involved the presentation of a lightning source, parameterization of the lower ionosphere, derivation of a transfer function representing all effects of EIWG on LEMP sky wave, and determination of attenuation mode of the LEMP ground wave. The model was then applied to several lightning sferics observed in central China during day and night times within 1000 km. The results showed that the model can precisely predict the time domain sky wave for all these observed lightning sferics. Both simulations and observations showed that the lightning sferics in nighttime had a more complicated waveform than in daytime. Partial results of this effort were published in 2017 on “Journal of Geophysical Research” (ref.: Z. Qin, M. Chen, B. Zhu, Y. Du, An improved ray theory and transfer matrix method-based model for lightning electromagnetic pulses propagating in Earth-ionosphere waveguide and its applications, J. Geophys. Res. Atmos., vol.122, p712–727, Jan. 2017). By this effort, we have achieved 100% of Task (4) and 70% of Task (5). e) Meanwhile, for understanding and validation of the results from above efforts, we have been trying on developing a FDTD -based approach for evaluation of the effect of rough ground on LEMP. During this effort, the propagation effect of lightning-produced electromagnetic pulse over a large mountainous region in southern-west China had been investigated with FDTD approach. The regional geometry data in the FDTD code were adopted from a global digital elevation model named GTOPO30 with a horizontal resolution of 30 arc seconds and vertical accuracy of about 30 m. With the FDTD code, LEMPs generated by lightning return strokes at various locations in the region were calculated. In comparison with a flat region, it is found that the topography of the region has large influences on not only the amplitude but also the propagation speed of the LEMPs. Partial results of this effort were presented at APEMC2016 (ref.: T. Lu and M. Chen, Modelling of Effect of Propagation of Lightning, 7th Asia-Pacific Int. Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility, May 18-21, 2016, Shenzhen, China). By this effort, we have achieved 100% of Task (5) and hence the purpose of the whole project.

Besides, a LLN also reports the amplitude and arrival time of LEMP of a stroke measured at individual sensors. Both the amplitude and arrival time of LEMP of a stroke measured at individual sensors in a LLN are due to the same LEMP but propagating over different earth surfaces for different distances to different sensors. With these in mind, the possible relationship between the information of a stroke reported by a LLN and the effect of earth surface on LEMP of the stroke will be analyzed and discussed.

With above analyses, general equations that describe the relationship between the amplitude and arrival time of LEMP of a stroke measured at individual sensors in a LLN and the factors representing the effect of earth surface on LEMP of the stroke will be developed. Then, specific algorithm for estimation of the spatial profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP with the developed equations for a LLN will be proposed.

Applying the proposed algorithm to an existing LLN, estimate the spatial profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP for all sensors in the LLN. There may be several values estimated from different data set for the factors presenting the effect of earth surface on LEMP for the same sensor in the same area. The extent of consistency of these values for the same sensor may be used to validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

It is expected that the spatial profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP for a given sensor shall be a function of distance and azimuth to the sensor and shall be different for different sensors in a LLN. Meanwhile, digital earth surface information can be easily retrieved from geographic information systems such as Google maps. Aiding with knowing theory and digital earth surface information, analysis and interpretation of the estimated profile of the effect of earth surface on LEMP will be tried and possible measures for improvements of the performance of a LLN will be proposed.

Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) method is a discrete for numerical calculation of time-domain electromagnetic field in space and time. Starting with the FDTD discrete, modelling of the effect of earth surface on LEMP in 3-dimension under complicated earth surface conditions will be developed. Comparisons between the modelling and practical results will be good not only for mutual validation but also for well understanding of the insight of the issue.

512313.label: Major findings and research outcome
512313.value: a) A statistical approach for identifying the effect of earth path on the lightning electromagnetic pulse (LEMP) amplitude and arrival time based on LLN lightning data has been proposed. With this approach, two coefficients that reflect the effect of the earth surface on the amplitude and propagation speed of LEMP respectively were defined and investigated with the data from an LLN. Reference: conference paper No.1 in Part C. b) As an extension of the outcome in a), we have further proposed a statistical approach for the correction of “site error” of DF/TOA type LLN based on itself data. With this approach, the “site error” patterns therefor the “site error” correction tables for the 23 sensors in a regional LLN were obtained. Significant improvements in lightning location accuracy were made with the use of the site error” correction tables obtained. Reference: journal paper No.1 in Part C. c) In addition, an approach for investigating the interaction between the LEMP and the earth-ionosphere waveguide (EIWG) has been proposed. With this approach and the full-waveforms of electric fields of lightning strokes detected by a long-baseline VLF/LF LLN during both day- and night- time, the diurnal variation of electron profile of lower ionosphere in that region were successfully retrieved. Reference: conference paper No.2 in Part C. d) As an extension of the outcome in c), we have further proposed an improved ray theory and transfer matrix method-based model for LEMP propagating in EIWG. The model can precisely predict the time domain skywave of all kind of lightning sferics. Particularly, the model predicts that when a LEMP propagates from east to west during nighttime, its skywave tends to be dispersed (double peak skywave), which was well consistent with observations. Reference: journal paper No.2 in Part C. e) Lastly, we have developed a FDTD-based approach for evaluation of the effect of rough ground on LEMP in a large space scale. With this approach, the propagation effect of LEMP over any a large mountainous region can be easily investigated. Reference: conference paper No.3 in Part C.

512313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
512313.value: There are two potential aspects for further development of the research. The first one is that, for an existing DF/TOA type LLN with large amount of raw lightning data observed, the statistical approaches for identifying the propagation effects of LEMPs over rough ground could be coded into the central analyzer of the LLN as a subroutine program for automatic error correction of the lightning location and strength data based on the accumulated raw data from the LLN concerned. The second one is that, for a newly planned DF/TOA type LLN or an existing one with no more raw lightning data observed, the developed FDTD-based approach for evaluation of the effects of rough ground on LEMPs in a large space could be adopted to evaluate the performance of the LLN in advance. The evaluation results could then be coded into the analyzer of the LLN to make correction of the lightning raw data observed. To achieve these, further validations of the statistical and FDTD-based approaches proposed in present project are necessary. Currently, the collection of raw lightning data from an LLN in a mountainous region in China are undergoing, which can be used for the validation purposes.

512313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
512313.value: Lightning location network (LLN) is widely used in the world for lightning hazards warning by providing the information of location, strength and occurrence time of lightning strokes detecting the lightning-produced electromagnetic pulse (LEMP). Most of LLN in operation is based on the so-called TOA/DF (time-of-arrival/ direction-finder) combined technique with the assumption that the LEMP propagates over flat conductive ground at the speed of light. But the fact is that the earth surface is not always flat and well conductive, leading to serious errors to the lightning data recorded by the LLN. In this project, we have proposed an approach for identifying and correction the effect of ground roughness on LEMP when the LEMP propagates over a rough ground surface. The approach has cases: a statistical method for an existing LLN with large amount of raw lightning data observed based on the usage of the lightning data itself, and a simulative method for a newly planned LLN based on the FDTD (finite-difference time-domain) method. Applications of the approach to an existing LLN showed good consistence between the statistical and simulative methods.

512813.label: Project Title(Chinese)
512813.value: 一般岩土工程問題的兩維及三維下限分析

512813.label: Project Objectives
512813.value: Development of lower bound/extremum principle for two and three-dimensional analysis by global optimization method : The project leader proposes to re-formulate the two and three-dimensional equilibrium differential equations and/or the yield criterion to a discretized format. Under the new equilibrium equations, the internal forces will be the control variables while the yield criterion will become the constraints in the optimization analysis. A problem will then be classified as bearing capacity, lateral earth pressure or slope stability problem according to the boundary condition and geometry. The discretization will be in form of complete and semi discretization. For normal engineering problem, a semi discretization scheme will be adopted and less than 50 zones will be formed in the analysis. The yield criterion will be checked at the sides of the relatively large domain. For the complete discretization which is more suitable for highly complicated problem, over thousands of sub-domains are formed, and the local yielding instead of the global yielding along a longer side will be checked. Development of adaptive mesh analysis for general two and three-dimensional problems : For a general problem where the failure mechanism is difficult to be predicted, it is very difficult to produce a mesh for the analysis. Most of the researchers rely on the use of an approximate initial solution to produce a good solution, even when adaptive mesh refinement is adopted. The project leader proposes a local adaptive mesh refinement procedure based on the deformation and yield function residual so that the mesh will gradually refine and adapt to the failure mechanism. The performance of unstructured linear triangular mesh combined with local mesh adaptation is considered as a conic programming problem. Applicability of the error estimators developed from finite element method is also experimented for comparison purposes. A very high accuracy will then be achieved by this approach. Unification of lateral earth pressure, bearing capacity and slope stability problems: The project leader views that the three classical geotechnical problems are actually the same, and the differences between them are just the choices of boundary conditions. It should be possible to derive one problem from the others from the basic governing plasticity equations. The three problems under two-dimensional condition will be unified under the context of the lower bound principle/slip line method for some cases. This part of analytical work will be based on the solution of the governing partial differential equations. The extremum of a system can be the ultimate stress or the factor of safety, and the project leader views that the extremum value or equivalently the variational principle solution will yield the same solution as the classical plasticity solution. For more complicated cases involving the self weight of soil and highly complicated geometry, the unification will be based on the works from (1) and (2) above.
