512813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
512813.value: The determination of the ultimate limit state and the failure mechanism are the key issues in many geotechnical problems. Over the last 100 years, there are many research works related to these aspects, and many principles and computational techniques are developed for these goals. Currently, there are massive construction works in Hong Kong, China and other countries, and the project leaders are also involved in some of the large scale National projects. There are also many problems associated with highway slopes, stability of hydropower stations, deep foundation and excavations works which are of interest to both the engineers and researchers. There is however a major gap between research and applications in this area. Virtually, most of the research works are not noticed or used by the engineers, and simplified methods targeted towards different types of problems are still used by engineers. The project leader has carried out many fundamental research works in these three major disciplines, and some of these research works are integrated in engineering softwares which are used by many engineers in many countries. Under the present project, the project leader aims to develop a general platform, under which the lower bound principle can be applied to general two and three-dimensional geotechnical problems. Based on the prescribed boundary condition, a problem will then be classified as slope stability, lateral earth or bearing capacity problem. The developed platform must be simple enough so that a fine-tuned mesh requiring high level of knowledge and judgment is not required. On the other hand, the developed tool must be able to give good solution even for very complicated problems with contrasting soil properties. The present work will be particularly important for the three-dimensional problem, as there are only limited lower bound solutions over the last 50 years. In views of the similarity between the three geotechnical problems, the project leader views that the unification of these problems can be developed which will be a major improvement to the basic theory. The unification will be based on firm foundation, which will require reconsideration of the basic problem and the use of the corresponding mathematical tools. Based on the present project, there will be advancement in both the basic theory as well as practical aspects in providing better solutions for two and three-dimensional problems which are useful for many complicated geotechnical problems. 確定極限狀態和失效機理是許多岩土工程問題的關鍵。在過去的100年裏，有許多這方面的相關研究工作，並以此為目標研發出許多原理和計算方法。目前, 香港、中國大陸和其他國家正在開展大量的基建工程，項目負責人也參與了其中一些國家級的大規模項目。在公路邊坡，水電站的穩定性，深基礎和基坑開挖等巖土工程中存在的許多問題均吸引了工程師和研究人員的關注。但這些領域的研究和應用之間存在很大的差距。實際上，大部分研究工作是沒有被工程師注意或使用的，而針對不同類型問題的簡化方法仍然在工程界廣泛使用。在這三個岩土工程主要領域中，項目負責人均展開了多項基礎研究工作，並將其中一些研究成果編譯進了工程軟件中, 被許多國家的工程師應用於解決實際工程項目中。本項目旨在建立一個通用平臺，基於此平臺，下限原理可以應用於一般的兩維和三維岩土工程問題。根據規定的邊界條件，一個岩土工程問題將被歸類為邊坡穩定、側向土壓力或承載力問題。此外，研發出的平臺必須足夠簡單，以便能不需要再借助高水平的知識和判斷來調整項目模型的網格。另一方面，研發出的工具必須能夠對工程問題提供良好的解決方案, 甚至能解決具有差異很大土層屬性的非常復雜的問題。目前的工作對於解決三維問題尤其重要，因為在過去的50年裏，只研發出了有限的下限理論解法。考慮到這三類基本岩土問題的相似性，項目負責人認為這些問題的基本理論可以統一，這將是對基本理論的重大改進。統一將基於堅實的基礎，需要重新分析考慮基本問題和使用相應的數學工具。本項目將會對基本理論以及實踐環節有推動及提升，能夠對二維和三維問題提供好的解決方案，使其能應用在許多復雜的岩土工程問題中。

512813.label: Realisation of objectives
512813.value: All the three objectives have been fully addressed and achieved. In particularly, there is a major breakthrough from the present project : Unification of lateral earth pressure, bearing capacity and slope stability problems. Three fundamental problems in geotechnical engineering have been unified under one formulation, and some long outstanding fundamental problems are solved. At present, all textbook and research works treat these three problems as separate and distinct. From the present project, the basic fundamental nature of these problems are reconsidered and refined. In theory, all textbook in geotechnical engineering can be rewritten in the future. The project leader has the confidence that this major breakthrough will be seen in all textbook in the future.

512913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
512913.value: 随着半導體光催化技術的不斷發展,特別是二氧化鈦有關技術,於自清潔紡織材料方面的應用有着顯著效果,得到廣泛關注及重視。不過,相關的物質普遍受制自身帶隙能量過寬的問題,在多數情況下,只能利用太陽光裏的UV光能轉化成能量提供反應,不能消耗其他佔約97%的可見光能量。這個項目的基本理念是開發新的技術來改善這問題,策略取向與大自然所用的相近,利用類似植物葉片裏含有的卟啉來捕獲光能。在太陽照射底下,有關的有機物質能取用可見光為光能源,製造出像二氧化鈦光催反應中釋出的高能量電子。除卟啉分子之外,我們還會研究一系列含卟啉或類似物的新型聚合物,它們的製造方法建基於超支化聚合技術上,設計為水溶性及具備纖維素化學反應性,這意味着所生產的聚合物擁有基本優點,如可容易地應用於紡織材料上(例如,簡單地通過傳統的軋烘焙加工工藝過程)、提供化學性鍵合(提升,例如,摩擦和洗水牢度)而無需使用有毒的有機溶劑/物料等。總結,我們的研究包括:1)設計及合成合適的卟啉或類似化合物,製造相關的棉織物;2)對合成的化合物和相關織物進行全面表徵;3)評估自潔效果在不同條件下的結果;4)調查不同因素對自清潔有效性和各種織物性能的影響;以及5)分析及理解各體系結構運作的機制。

512913.label: Major findings and research outcome
512913.value: It is known that metal phthalocyanines (MPcs) in monomeric form were experimentally proven to exhibit strong photocatalytic activities compared to their dimeric or aggregated forms. In this study, a number of copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) direct and reactive dyes mostly in their monomeric form were achieved on cotton fibres via exhaustion dyeing method, whereas when dissolved in deionised water, these dyes were typically in their dimeric or aggregated forms. When using Kubelka-Monk (K/S) values against the visible spectrum measured by reflectance spectroscopy, monomeric, dimeric, or aggregated forms on the dyed fibres can be easily detected. This finding was further proven by the photo-activated stain decolourisation tests. On the other hand, tetrasulphonated CuPc and C.I. Reactive Blue 14, which were found heavily aggregated in cotton fibre, demonstrated weaker photocatalytic decolourisation effects than other CuPc derivatives (e.g. C.I. Direct Blue 86 (DB86), Reactive Blue 21(RB21) and the chlorosulphonated CuPc) in cotton fibre. The research outcomes are generally in agreement to the previous studies concerning the effect of photocatalysis of phthalocyanine in dimeric or aggregated form. It also supports the reliability of using reflectance spectroscopy and K/S values to identify the monomer, dimer, or aggregated forms of MPc on cotton fibre. CuPc-dyed cotton piece was also compared with TiO2-coated cotton fabric, under exposure to energy-efficient fluorescent tube. The fabric dyed with DB86 demonstrated appreciably stronger photocatalytic decolourisation of Methyl Orange and C.I. Acid Yellow 49 with substantially less amount applied (~14 times less on weight ratio; ~140 times less on molar ratio) than TiO2. This advantage would become more dominant when CuPc reactive dye, RB21, was utilized, owing to its asymmetrical structures and steady grafting capability onto cellulosic polymer. CuPc dyes were rarely analysed with high-performance liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry. A relatively thorough analysis on various direct and reactive dyes was conducted. Those dye matrices were separated by advanced C18 reversed phase column in gradient elution method (eluent composed of water and acetonitrile) and further examined by electrospray-ionisation mass spectrometer. The interesting and significant results are worthy of publication.

512913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
512913.value: This study mainly focused on the application of MPcs to cotton fibre. However, CuPc and dyes with other MPcs candidates can be introduced to other types of fibres such as wool, jute, viscose rayon, polyester and nylon via modified dyeing methods to study the self-cleaning capability. Novel MPc photocatalysts synthesised with various metal ion cores and asymmetrical structures are the worthy of further study for the development of self-cleaning textiles based on the organic approach. In addition, in-situ formation of MPc pigment in cotton fibre is a suggested application route to impart photocatalytic self-cleaning functions to cotton fabric. The study also indicated that tetrasulphoated NiPc dye exhibited much weaker photo-induced self-cleaning performance than that of tetrasulphoated CuPc on cotton fabric. Further studies are suggested to determine the causes and mechanisms. A research paper “Study of self-cleaning cotton functionalised by a new class of photocatalysts: copper phthalocyanines” is under preparation targeting Journal of Material Chemistry A.

512913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
512913.value: The study is focused on using organic materials to achieve photocatalytic self-cleaning effect on cotton fabric. The use of organic meterials in general has the advantages of less adverse effect on fabric handle and improved washing and abrasion durability in comparison to inorganic materials such as TiO2. The study clearly revealed the effects of the metal phthalocyanine dyes, and their monomeric forms, molecular weights and chemical structures to the photo-activated self-cleaning properties when applied to cotton fibre. Certain copper phthalocyanines dyes with poor disaggregation due to relatively symmetrical structures tended to offer limited photocatalytic activity for self-cleaning. In comparison to titanium dioxide, a popular photocatalyst used for self-cleaning technology, the organic approach showed much less reliance on UV activation and much less amount required for the self-cleaning purpose. In addition, the copper phthalocyanine dyes as photocatalytic agents are capable of providing considerable and continuous stain decolourisation effect superior to that of TiO2 under visible light.

513713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
513713.value: An internal fire whirl is readily created in a vertical shaft with an open roof by the burning of a small fire. The fire environment in the vertical shaft is then very hazardous due to the extended flame length and fast rate of burning. Ventilation provision at the sidewall has been identified as a key point in onsetting a fire whirl as reported in a successfully completed research project funded by the Research Grants Council from 2007 to 2010. However, understanding of the fundamental characteristics of internal fire whirls is still inadequate and therefore proposed for further study in this project with the aim of providing better fire safety in tall buildings. A typical square vertical shaft structure of height 12 m will be considered in this study. Different widths for sidewall ventilation provision will be designed. Liquid pool fires will be created inside the model. Air flow patterns through the open roof and the sidewall gaps in the shaft models will be studied experimentally using scale models, initially in The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Schlieren photography will be applied to determine the locations for the inflow of cool air and the outflow of hot air so as to explore how oxygen is supplied higher up the shaft, enabling the burning of fuel vapour brought to upper levels by buoyancy. Full-scale burning tests with a tall rig will then be carried out on a remote site in China. Small omnidirectional cameras with appropriate optical fibre design will be installed to visualize the detailed flame swirling movement patterns in the experiments including flame precision and flame revolution using both scaled and large vertical shaft models. Observations of the regions of fire whirl and movement of the flame core centre will be used for further analytical studies of rotatory flame motion. The swirl number and Froude number will be used to study the physics of vorticity-buoyancy interaction characterizing internal fire whirls. Computational Fluid Dynamics fire models will be applied together with appropriate combustion models to study the air flow patterns and flame structure in the vertical shaft. Sources of vorticity such as the shearing effect and the baroclinic mechanism can then be better understood by combining all the physical model observations and numerical prediction. Results will be applied to area of fire hazards risk assessment in relation to the onset of internal fire whirls in the vertical shafts of tall buildings. 在頂部開口的豎井內，一個小火源就有可能形成內部火旋風。由於火焰高度加長及燃燒速率加大，豎井內的火災環境會變得更加危險。由研究資助局資助，於2007年到2010年成功完成的研究項目指出，側壁的通風狀態是觸發火旋風的關鍵因素。然而，關於內部火旋風的基礎特徵的研究仍然未足夠。因此，本研究致力於深入研究高層建築內部火旋風的特點，以提供更好的消防安全指標。本研究將採用一個高度為12米的典型方形豎井結構。側壁設計不同寬度的通風設施。模型將採用液體油池火。初步研究將應用小尺寸模型在香港理工大學進行。通過試驗研究經過頂部開口和側壁開口處的典型空氣流動模式。研究將應用紋影攝影技術確定冷空氣流入位置和熱空氣的流出位置，以進一步探討氧氣如何延豎井上升，及可燃蒸汽如何受浮力影響上升至高層。進一步的全尺寸實驗研究將在中國內地的試驗點進行。採用配備光纖的小尺寸全向攝像機可以詳細記錄火焰漩渦的旋轉模式，包括火焰精度和火焰變化過程。通過觀察記錄產生火旋風的範圍和火焰中心的移動範圍可以進一步分析研究火焰旋轉模式。分析旋轉數和傅裡葉數可以得出旋轉力和浮力共同作用下內部火旋風的特徵。選擇適當的燃燒模型，計算流體力學火災模型將用於類比豎井內的空氣流動模式及火焰結構。通過分析研究試驗和模擬結果，可以更全面的瞭解諸如剪切力和斜壓效應等產生漩渦的因素。研究結果可應用於高層建築豎井內部產生火旋風的火災風險評估。

513713.label: Realisation of objectives
513713.value: Fire whirls observed in big fires can release high amounts of heat within a short time. More fuel was burnt with higher temperatures. A vortex similar to a tornado was formed with the burning fuel moving up as a spiral to give a swirling flame. Associated works on fire whirls in a vertical shaft, known as Internal Fire Whirl (IFW) were studied in the project. Generation mechanism and flow structure were focused on. All the objectives proposed in the project were achieved as listed in the following: 1. To study the flow characteristics of internal fire whirls induced by pool fires in a model vertical shaft with different ventilation conditions. An IFW can be generated by burning a pool fire in a vertical shaft with appropriate sidewall ventilation provision. Characteristics of IFW generated in part of a 9 m tall real-size vertical shaft model were studied experimentally in this part of the project. With this square test shaft with adjustable side gap opening, the critical width of the gap to achieve the highest flame height was studied. The strongest burning of IFW was found among using different oil pool diameter and volume of fuel. The experiments studied the vertical and horizontal temperature, fuel burning rate, heat release rate and flame height of the fire whirl. Flame shapes in burning a gasoline pool fire inside the shaft model with different corner wall gap widths and tray diameters were observed. The flame swirling motion depends on the corner gap width providing ventilation. Fuel mass of the pool fire, flame height of the IFW, and transient air temperatures were measured. It is further confirmed that an IFW cannot be generated when the gap width is too wide or too narrow. An IFW is developed in five stages. The pool fire is burning in a way similar to burning in open air at stage I. The burning rate of pool fire increases at stage II. Swirling flame motion starts to develop at stage III. An IFW develops fully at stage IV. Stage V is the decay stage. Further, the created IFW can be divided into three zones. Zone I is at the lower part with the flame rotating violently. Zone II is in the middle part with a slower swirling rate. The upper part zone III has no flame rotation. Physical scale modeling experiments were also carried out to compare with the full-scale burning tests. Background-oriented Schlieren (BOS) technique was applied in the scale modeling tests to measure the neutral plane height across the corner gap. 2. To make progress in understanding the fundamental physics underlying the interaction between buoyancy and vorticity in the context of fires. The burning rate of an IFW depends on the nature of the vortex. An external source of angular momentum is required to produce buoyant whirls with large swirl velocity components while entraining air to the flame. Flame height of an IFW is therefore able to be expressed as a function of vortex parameters, including the circulation and the core radius of the vortex. A flame height correlation with key physical parameters was studied through physical experiments, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulation with FLUENT, and theoretical analysis. From the experimental data in the real-size shaft model, a rotating flame height coefficient was introduced to study the flame height in the IFW. Dynamic and thermodynamic corrections were made to derive a semi-empirical formula for flame height in the IFW analytically. A coefficient  was proposed to take care of the effect of the boundary and initial conditions of the experiment. Burgers vortex theory was applied for dynamic and thermodynamic corrections. Boiling of liquid fuel with combustion was observed in the oil pool during the evolution of fire whirl. Effects of thermal radiation and fuel vaporization were included to modify the calculation of the fuel burning rate. Boiling with combustion would increase the area of vaporization, which is the sum of the area of free surface and bottom of oil pool. This leads to the increase of unit area fuel consumption rate to over twice of that in free burning condition. This phenomenon is also verified by theoretical analysis. When carrying out dynamic correction on the flame height equation, the rotating flame height coefficient is expressed by another coefficient describing the burning and flow characteristics of fire whirl. Although the calculated flame height matches with the experimental result, burning of liquid fuel should be studied more thoroughly as the heat transfer process is very complicated. Further investigation on  is required. Experimental and numerical results for flame surface, temperature and flame length were in good agreement. IFW flame region and intermittent region were longer than ordinary pool fire. The modified centerline temperature empirical formula was derived. Variations of vertical and tangential velocity in axial and radial directions were shown. The vortex core radius was found to be determined by fuel bed size. 3. To enable assessment of internal fire whirl risks in tall vertical shafts. The extended flame height will cause severe damage. In fire hazard assessments for tall shafts, rooms with ceiling vent and ventilation duct of green buildings, the scenario with an IFW should be included. An IFW can be created in a vertical shaft for tall buildings with appropriate sidewall ventilation provision. It is very dangerous for firefighters staying nearby. Scale modeling experiment demonstrated that an IFW can also be generated even when the ceiling is partly open for smoke extraction. A shaft model of width 34 cm, length 35 cm and height 145 cm, with a 3.6-cm corner gap was constructed for the experimental study. Two fire scenarios in the shaft model were studied, with front-half covered roof and rear-half covered roof. Thermocouples were used to measure smoke temperature and to justify results from the BOS technique. Compared with the closed-roof model, IFW was generated at an earlier time, and fuel burning rate was higher in the partly opened roof scenarios. In addition, the smoke layer was kept at a higher level and had a lower temperature. Validation by comparing CFD-predicted results with experimental data demonstrated that an IFW can be simulated by CFD in fire hazard assessment. Aged structures are now widely repaired by combustible fibre reinforced polymer (FRP). IFW generated in a vertical shaft would act on the FRP repairing materials in a vertical shaft. Fire hazard was also investigated by scale model. Propanol pool fires were burnt in a vertical shaft model with an open roof under appropriate ventilation provided from the sidewall. FRP was installed at the model wall. Transient air temperatures at different positions were measured along the vertical direction. Vertical temperature at 20 cm above the flame can be 100oC higher than the case without an IFW, even in scale model. The air temperature near to the wall can be up to 150oC. FRP products are then subjected to higher temperatures and might be ignited with smoke coming out, or at least softened to reduce mechanical strength. From the scale modeling studies, FRP will be affected upon generating flame swirling. Further theoretical analysis would be reported.

513713.label: Major findings and research outcome
513713.value: IFW generation process, fuel burning rate and temperature were studied by experiments and numerical simulations. Typical transient experimental and simulated flame shape deduced from temperature were studied. The dynamic phenomena of IFW generation and development are then better understood. Major findings and research outcome are listed in the report and summarized as: 1. Generation of an internal fire whirl in an open roof vertical shaft model Effect of sidewall ventilation provision on creating an IFW in a 9 m tall vertical shaft was investigated. Experiments on generating an IFW by burning a gasoline pool fire in a vertical shaft with an open roof were carried out. Generation of an IFW is developed in five stages. There are three zones in the generated IFW. With respect to the fundamental equation of ordinary oil pool fire fuel mass loss rate and flame height calculation, correction has made on the parameters of such equations based on the condition of fire whirl. The result of the experiment provides reference for the verification of rotational flame numerical simulation and theoretical calculation. It also provides fundamental for the analysis of developing a rotational flame model and swirling flame dynamics. 2. Flame height of internal fire whirl Studying the flame height of an IFW is very important in fire hazard assessment of vertical shaft in tall buildings. The flame height of the IFW was found to increase with the burning rate of the pool fire. A semi-empirical formula for flame height in the IFW was derived using reported experimental data from full-scale burning tests. From the experimental data, a rotating flame height coefficient was introduced to modify the empirical formula for the flame height in the IFW. Effects of thermal radiation and fuel vaporization were included to modify the calculation of the fuel burning rate. Flame height was studied analytically with results compared using CFD in this project. 3. Velocity Patterns Across Sidewall Gaps in a Vertical Shaft Experiments were carried out in the tall vertical shaft model using liquid pool propanol fire. The vertical gap width of 3.6 cm able to generate an IFW was adjusted. Velocity patterns across the gap in the shaft model measured would be very useful to further model other characteristics of the generated IFW.

513713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
513713.value: Fire safety provisions in such tall shafts are based on existing codes, which were developed many years ago without proper fire hazard assessment for structures of this type. As an IFW is observed either inside an enclosure, in a vertical shaft or a room with appropriate ventilation, the scenario should be included in fire hazard assessments for atriums, internal building voids, lift shafts and any other similar vertical shafts such as solar chimney, storing large amounts of combustibles. The onset of IFW could be prevented with a better understanding of their initiating criteria and fire dynamics. Buildings with a vent at higher levels such as atriums, internal building voids and vertical shafts are more likely to experience the onset of flame whirling. Further studies on IFW therefore are necessary. Observed smoke layer in a partly open ceiling in this project suggested that the building satisfies the assumption of a fire zone two-layer structure model even when it is tall. A stable hot layer would also form when an IFW is created. A modified zone model with heat and mass transferred from lower layer to upper layer through IFW, instead of through a fire plume, is proposed to be investigated.

513713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
513713.value: Fundamental characteristics of internal fire whirls (IFW) were studied by physical experiments on a real-scale vertical shaft structure of height 12 m and a scale model in this completed project. Flame swirling movement patterns in the experiments including flame precision and flame revolution were observed for analytical studies of rotatory flame motion. Air flow patterns through the open roof and the sidewall gaps in the shaft models were studied experimentally in the scale model through Schlieren photography. The swirl number and Froude number were used to study the physics of vorticity-buoyancy interaction characterizing IFW. Computational Fluid Dynamics fire models were applied together with appropriate combustion models to study the air flow patterns and flame structure in the vertical shaft. The fire environment in the vertical shaft is very hazardous due to the extended flame length and fast rate of burning. Igniting the finishes would give smoke. Structural materials of the shaft will also be affected. Fire hazard assessment on the onset of IFW should be included in the vertical shafts of tall buildings including green design such as solar chimney. Appropriate fire safety management, safer passive building construction design and active fire protection systems can then be provided.

514013.value: 具有非常高的聲壓級聲源附近的噪聲控制的研究是常常在飛機發動機,建築機器,工廠運轉的機器設備可以發現。現有的噪聲控制技術主要依靠吸聲材料。但是，吸材料在低頻率吸聲能力比較低和其衛生的問題,實際上實施總是不可行。一種替代的解決方案可使用微穿孔板, 它們穿孔大小小過毫米, 而吸聲的聲頻率寬度相對較狹窄和實際 成本與製造相當昂貴,所以實行上也是困難,為了獲得更廣闊的聲頻率吸收帶寬, 最近一些研究人員引進特別設計的微穿孔板及不同深度的背腔並列安排, 特別的是穿孔的大小適中, 以前的研究已經表明，並列安排提供顯著較好的吸聲性能及更寬的頻段, 該性能改進主要歸機因它們微穿孔板並列 的互動作用。然而，到目前為止, 所有以前的研究的環境是低聲音壓, 小孔的聲學特性是線性。然而，在高聲壓級的飛機發動機和建築設備附近，小孔的聲學特性是非線性的，其結果是，聲之間的相互作用不同的吸收也發生變化，這可能會改變並列結構的微穿孔板聲學特性和吸聲能力 。這個建議研究的目的是研究特別設計的微穿孔板及不同深度的背腔並列安排在高聲壓吸聲的物理原理，為了實現這目標，建立一個理論模型徹底的分析和理解新的吸聲機制和新的物理現象背後的振動聲學耦合，並列安排的微穿孔板吸收高聲壓級激的原理。也將進行參數研究評估重要的設計參數和優化等新設備。成功結果將提供有用的吸聲板，不管在不利的環境中，在非常高的聲壓水平的環境中 也可實施。

514013.label: Realisation of objectives
514013.value: The four objectives stated above have been realized. More specifically: (1) A finite element model is established based on a two-dimensional configuration of the rectangular MPP absorber which is backed by three rectangular sub-cavities with different cavity depth. There is the acoustics coupling among the exterior sound field, the MPP and the sound field inside the backing cavities. The acoustic behaviors of the MPP absorber array with the local nonlinearity features of the perforations induced by moderate acoustic excitation range from 50 to 120dB was investigated. (2) A commercial software COMSOL MULTIPHYSICS finite element method (FEM) was employed. The numerical simulation was composed of acoustical domain for fluid to describe the sound wave propagation in the duct and cavity and the structural domain for the induced vibration of the MPP. As a result, the vibration response and sound pressure distribution in the duct and cavity were obtained. (3) The acoustic behaviors of the MPP absorbers under moderate acoustic excitation are significantly different from that in the linear regime due to the effect of local nonlinearity of orifice. The variation of the acoustic impedance and absorption performance of the MPP absorber at different sound pressure level excitation was studied. The range of sound pressure level for the linear and non-linear regime was found experimentally. (4) A parametric study was carried out to evaluate the effect of various design parameters on the absorption performance of the MPP absorber array in terms of absorption coefficient and bandwidth. Major parameters includes cavity depths, structural property of the panel and perforation property of MPP such as perforation ratio, panel thickness and orifice diameter. (5) The incident sound was generated by a loudspeaker via an amplifier and the signals from the microphones were acquired through an Analogy-to-Digital converter (National Instruments card). The processes of sound generation and data acquisition were controlled by Labview Programme. The programme was designed and developed to capture the signals with high signal-to-noise ratio automatically (6) The influence of the vibration on the performance of the MPP absorber array was investigated. The variation of sound reflection and sound absorption due to the vibration was analyzed. The optimal structural and perforation property for obtaining high sound absorption coefficient and bandwidth was determined in order to avoid the performance degradation induced by panel vibration.

514013.label: Major findings and research outcome
514013.value: The acoustic performance of micro-perforated panel absorber array subjected to high acoustic excitation was studied numerically and experimentally. The present work leads to the following conclusions: (1) The acoustic behaviors of the MPP absorbers under moderate acoustic excitation are significantly different from that in the linear regime due to the effect of local nonlinearity of orifice. Starting at incident sound pressure level 100 dB, there is a significant variation on the acoustic impedance and absorption performance of the MPP absorber from frequency around 300 to 1100 Hz. At the incident sound pressure beyond 100 dB, more than 10% increments of absorption and acoustic resistance induced by the local nonlinearity of orifice are observed by comparing with the results measured in linear regime. The variation of the acoustic properties of MPP absorber indicates that the local nonlinearity effect of orifice exists under acoustic excitation around 100 dB, at which the acoustic field is linear. (2) With appropriate structural and perforation property of MPP, the MPP absorber array in the non-linear regime has higher level and wider bandwidth of sound absorption than that in the linear regime under the moderate acoustic pressure excitation less than about 120dB. (3) When the sound pressure level is too high, the negative mass effect is too strong and it weakens the equivalent acoustics impedance match with ambient air. As a result, it diminishes the local resonance effects of the resonating component MPP absorber and lower sound absorption would be obtained at local-resonating frequencies. (4) The absorption performance of the MPP absorber array would be degraded due to the effect of panel vibration. The vigorous vibration of the panel leads to sound reflection such that less acoustic energy can penetrate and be dissipated by the MPP absorber array. To avoid the performance degradation induced by panel vibration, the optimal structural properties of MPP absorber array was determined as M=20, B=0.002, d=1.2mm, t=0.7mm and σ=2.8%, which can achieve half-absorption bandwidth 4.47 at moderate sound pressure level 120dB. (5) The finite element model of the MPP absorber array at moderate sound pressure is validated by experiment. The measured absorption coefficients of the MPP absorber array quite agree with the predicted results with relative error less than 10.5%. The half-absorption bandwidth of the MPP absorber array with t = 0.4mm, d = 0.65mm and σ = 1.76% can reach to 4.18 at SPL = 110dB.

514013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
514013.value: This study allowed the development of technology of MPP absorber array to control noise in an adverse environment with high sound pressure level. It opens the doors for numerous possible application such as controlling noise in factory with mass operation of machine and construction noise. For further application of MPP absorber array to suppress fan noise in the duct, MPP absorber is placed close to the fan or engine. When the fan is in operation, the whole piece of MPP experiences a non-uniform sound pressure excitation and grazing shear flow profile from near field to far field along the duct. In the presence of grazing flow, there is a strong interaction between vortical and acoustics flow at the orifice that leads to the change of acoustics impedance of the orifice. The acoustic behavior of the MPP device is totally different from the current MPP absorber array with uniform acoustic impedance. Therefore, further studies are needed in the following areas: (1) establishment of theoretical model to investigate the acoustics behavior of MPP with non-uniform grazing shear flow profile. (2) fluid-structure-acoustics interaction on the MPP absorber array with dipole sound source. (3) Parametric study of MPP absorber array with grazing flow excitation.

514013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
514013.value: Micro-perforated panel (MPP) is considered as an innovative fiber-free solution to the noise control problem. Aiming for broadband absorption, multiple MPP absorbers of different sub-cavity depth forming an MPP absorber array can be used. However, in many circumstances, the MPP absorber array is exposed to adverse environment at high sound pressure level. This will give rise to non-linear behavior on the orifice of MPP and hence the acoustic properties of the MPP absorber is significantly different from that in linear regime. This has not been studied previously. To study the performance of MPP absorber array in nonlinear regime, a theoretical model was established which allows a thorough analysis and understanding of the new sound absorption mechanism and new physics behind of the vibro-acoustic coupling of MPP absorbers array under high sound pressure level excitation. It was found that the MPP absorber array in the non-linear regime has higher level and wider bandwidth of sound absorption than that in the linear regime under the acoustic pressure excitation less than about 120 dB when the structural and perforation property are chosen properly. This study will be beneficial for noise control of engine, construction equipment and machinery in factory.

514313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
514313.value: With advances in steel production technology over the last two decades, in particular in China, high performance steel with yield strengths from 690 to 1000 N/mm2 are readily available at affordable costs nowadays. As the design strengths are at least doubled when compared with S355 steel materials, there are strong incentives for researchers and engineers to explore their effective use in building construction. It is envisaged that the structural benefits of S690 steel materials will be readily exploited as fabricated I-sections in long span composite beams under large imposed loads. If deflections of these composite beams are found to be critical, castellated composite beams may be used instead. Moreover, both ductility and fatigue problems are minimized. It is important to appreciate that the use of fabricated I-sections of S690 steel materials in composite beams will increase the structural demands in various components of the beams considerably owing to increased stress levels. Hence, new failure modes may occur, in particular, in the shear connections between the steel sections and the concrete slabs. Consequently, a scientific study through experimental and theoretical investigation into the structural behaviour of full-scale composite beams using high strength steel sections with deformable and non-ductile shear connectors is proposed in this project in order to provide physical evidence as well as definitive test data for calibration of numerical models and development of complementary design rules. Moreover, extensive tensile tests will be carried out to provide essential material data, and complementary standard push-out tests will also be carried out to provide load-slippage characteristics of shear connections with solid or composite slabs for direct adoption into the numerical models. Furthermore, supplementary analysis and design tools will also be developed for practical applications in modern highrise buildings. Hence, the project aims to generate important structural understandings and test data which are urgently needed by the construction industry for effective design and construction of composite beams with fabricated I-sections of S690 steel materials. Once the structural advantages of high performance steel in building construction are established in the project, it will provide important steering for strategic development to the steel construction industry in many parts of the world, in particular China, such as the structural adoption of S990 steel materials. Moreover, the findings of the project will be disseminated among the international research communities of structural engineering through conference presentation and international journals. 隨著鋼鐵生産技術的進步，在過去的二十年中，特別是在中國，高性能鋼的屈服强度從690到1000 N/mm2負擔得起的成本如今都一應俱全。由於設計的優勢是至少增加了一倍，相比S355鋼材料，有較强的激勵結構工程師及研究人員能够探索有效利用建築施工。 S690鋼的結構好處據設想，將很容易地利用捏造我在大的外加荷載下大跨度組合梁的截面。如果發現這些組合梁的撓度是至關重要的，堞形可用於I -部分。 重要的是要理解，使用的製造在大跨度的I字型斷面S690鋼組合梁增加相當大的跨度，由於增加的壓力水平的各個組成部分的結構要求在。因此，可能會出現新的破壞模式在橫梁，特別是，在複合材料中的剪切型鋼和深梯形鋼的存在下的混凝土板之間的連接。因此，通過實驗和理論研究，提出到滿量程的變形和非韌性剪切連接器采用高强度型鋼組合梁結構行爲科學的研究在這個項目中，以提供實物證據，以及最終的測試數據用於校準的數值模型和互補的設計規則的發展。互補的標準推測試也將開展提供負載滑動特性的複合剪切連接到的數值模型，可直接采用固體或複合板。此外，理性的分析和設計工具也將被開發，評估適合在現代建築大跨度組合梁的結構性能。 因此，該項目旨在産生重要的測試數據和結構的理解，有效製造I- S690鋼部分組合梁的設計和施工建造業急需。一旦被證實在項目的結構優勢的高性能鋼在建築施工時，它會通過官方行業協會在中國的鋼鐵業和建築業的發展戰略提供了重要的轉向。此外，該項目的結果將傳播作爲明確的引用通過出版物在國際期刊躋身國際社區結構工程。

514313.label: Realisation of objectives
514313.value: Objective 1 To establish the structural performance of S690 steel materials, and to characterize their strengths and ductility through advanced tensile tests. Advanced tensile tests on standard coupons of S690 steel materials will be carried out to establish the material curves for subsequent analysis and design. A total of 12 standard coupon tests were carried out on three S690 steel plates with different thicknesses (see Conference Paper 1). It was found that yield strengths of all these coupons ranged from 752 to 810 N/mm2 while their elongation at fracture exceeded 10%. Hence, all of these steel plates were demonstrated to satisfy material requirements stipulated in EN1993-1-1. Objective 2 To establish the structural performance of composite beams with S690 steel materials in building construction through advanced structural design and analysis. The effective use of composite beams with S690 fabricated I-sections will allow more efficient structures to be built with reduced materials, energy and resources. Advanced finite element models on long span composite beams with solid elements in both concrete and steel sections were established together with measured load-slippage curves of shear connections with solid slabs (see Journal Paper 1, and Conference Papers 2 and 4). The finite element models have been successfully calibrated, and a parametric study on various composite beams was presented. Objective 3 To quantify and itemize the effects of deformable and non-ductile shear connectors on the structural performance of composite beams using S690 steel materials through numerical investigation. The effects of deformable and non-ductile shear connectors are the keys to the effective use of S690 steel materials in composite beams, and hence, full-scale tests on composite beams reported in the literature should be reviewed and analyzed to provide data for subsequent design development. Based on the finite element models on long span composite beams calibrated and presented above, the models are further developed to incorporate composite slabs with shear connections having various degrees of deformation characteristics, in particular, reduced shear resistances at large deformations. A comprehensive parametric study on various composite beams with S355 and S690 and various concrete grades was conducted (see Journal Paper 1, and Conference Papers 3 and 4) for detailed comparison in terms of load-deformation curves and variations of slippages in shear connections along beam spans. Specific demands on slippage capacities of the composite shear connections in typical composite beams were quantified as representative results. In general, shear resistances of composite shear connections should be increased proportionally to the yield strengths of the steel sections. More importantly, these increased resistances of the composite shear connections should be maintained at large deformations so that the composite beams are able to deform sufficiently in order to mobilize their design moment resistances. In the past, many researchers are not completely convinced that this condition can be readily achieved in practice. Through this research study, it is demonstrated that both composite shear connections with ductile and semi-ductile deformation characteristics are able to achieve this. Objective 4 To develop effective analysis and design tools to assess the structural performance of composite beams with practical constructional features through advanced finite element modelling and design development. Based on extensive parametric studies, the structural performance of composite beams using S690 steel materials and deformable and non-ductile shear connectors will be formulated for practical use. Design results on long span composite beams with S690 welded I-sections (with both unperforated and perforated sections) obtained from current design rules presented in EN 1993-1-1 were compared with numerical results predicted by the proposed finite element models. Applicability of these design rules was successfully verified while specific limitations on this new form of construction together with minor modifications to these design rules were identified. In general, non-ductile shear connections should be used with cautions in construction with these composite beams because of severe demands on slippage deformations, when compared with current construction practice.

514313.label: Major findings and research outcome
514313.value: In this project, a numerical investigation into structural behaviour of long spanning composite beams with perforated I-sections was reported. Advanced numerical models were established to simulate full range deformation characteristics of long spanning composite beams, and these models were successfully calibrated against test data when measured geometrical dimensions and mechanical properties of various components of the composite beams were adopted. A systematic parametric study on effects of high strength materials and of stud shear connections with different levels of ductility were also conducted. It was found that a) The failure loads of various finite element models of long span beams with S690 welded I-sections and composite slabs with different concrete grades are found to be significantly increased by a factor of 1.5 to 1.7, when compared with those of similar composite beams with S355 welded I-sections. Such increases in the failure loads are highly desirable in term of structural adequacy for composite beams supporting large lateral loads. Moreover, the increases are considered to be reasonable as, for complex systems like composite beams, their failure loads do not simply increase proportionally to material strengths of their components. Other considerations, such as low degrees of shear connections and excessive end slippages, should also be made. b) It is also shown that composite beams with various types of shear connections have variations in their failure loads, though such variations are relatively small. A direct comparison on effects of ductility of shear connections shows that a composite beam with a ductile shear connections will have a large failure loads with a large ductility. This is expected as the ductile shear connections are able to mobilize their maximum shear forces under large slippages. Hence, failure resistances are attained when full plasticity has been fully developed in those I-sections. For composite beams with a semi-ductile and a non-ductile shear connections, the failure resistances of these beams were found to be reduced correspondingly, and these beams tended to exhibit moderate ductility. Moreover, the slippages developed in shear connections of these beams were significantly increased when compared with those beams with S355 welded I-sections. In short, it was shown that composite beams with high strength materials exhibited large deformations, and this imposed a severe demand on ductility of stud shear connections. Moreover, it was shown that stud shear connections with limited ductility often affected adversely mobilization of both resistances and ductility of composite beams.

514313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
514313.value: After successful completion of the research project with advanced finite element models for long span composite beams with S690 welded I-sections, it will be highly desirable to incorporate measured load-slippage curves of practical shear connections reported in the literature. It should be noted that only those curves with proper lateral restraints provided to shear connections in standard push out tests should be used as these tests are considered to be tested with boundary conditions similar to those in practical composite beams. It is also proposed to carry out some of these tests in order to obtain first hand experience on structural behaviour of shear connections in these push out tests as well as on data analysis of measured load-slippage curves. One of the key areas of interest of the proposed testing is to use a stud shear connection with a large diameter, such as 22 mm, or even 25 mm, so that these shear connections will have increased shear resistances and stiffnesses to match with those of S690 welded I-sections, when compared with those of S355 welded I-sections.

514313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
514313.value: Long spanning composite beams with perforated I-sections are popular in modern building structures. They are highly desirable owing to their structural efficiency, aesthetical appearance, and full integration with building services. Structural design of these composite beams with unperforated I-sections in building structures may be found in Structural Eurocode EN 1994-1-1 while extensive researches have been carried out to exploit structural advantages of composite beams with perforated I-sections made of high strength materials. In this project, a numerical investigation into structural behaviour of long spanning composite beams with perforated I-sections was reported. Advanced numerical models were established to simulate full range deformation characteristics of long spanning composite beams, and these models were successfully calibrated against test data when measured geometrical dimensions and mechanical properties of various components of the composite beams were adopted. A systematic parametric study on effects of high strength materials and of stud shear connections with different levels of ductility were also conducted. It was shown that composite beams with high strength materials exhibited large deformations, and this imposed a severe demand on ductility of stud shear connections. Moreover, those shear connections with limited ductility often affected adversely mobilization of both resistances and ductility of composite beams.

514313.value: This project provided opportunities for the PI to discuss with Dr Graham Couchman and Professor Mark Lawson of the Steel Construction Institute and Professor Dennis Lam of Bradford University, both in the U.K., on structural behaviour of long span composite beams with various degrees of shear connections in 2015 and 2016. It should be noted that during that period, Professor Lawson led a European research project on composite beams with multiple web openings for full integration with building services, and Professor Lam was responsible for conducting experiments on a total of six long span composite beams. The PI contributed to the project through comments on the experimental investigation as well as analysis on some of the test results, and finite element modelling of these beams with shear connections having different degrees of ductility. Based on the findings of the current project, both Professor Lawson and Dr. Couchman considered use of high strength steel materials in heavily loaded composite beams and columns highly beneficial, and it would be essential to establish a steady supply of quality high strength steel materials to the U.K. as well as Europe in order to realize any potential applications offered by these materials. Moreover, it was agreed that systematic experimental and numerical investigations into structural behaviour of high strength steel materials and members was very important for possible incorporation into Structural Eurocodes. Hence, it was agreed for both the SCI and the PolyU to collaborate on high strength steel structures. It should be noted that the Steel Construction Institute is the Technical Editor of Structural Steel Eurocode: EN 1993-1 while Dr. Couchman is Convenor of Structural Composite Steel-Concrete Eurocode: EN 1994-1. Moreover, this project provides further training to Ms. Stephanie SHEN Ming Hui under supervision of the PI. Ms SHEN was awarded a PhD in late 203, and the title of her PhD thesis is "Structural behaviour of shear connections in composite structures under complex loading conditions". Ms Shen worked as a Research Associate for the project.

514513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
514513.value: The use of externally bonded fiber reinforced polymer (FRP) composites for strengthening existing concrete structures has gained increasing popularity over the past two decades, due to their high strength-to-weight ratio and excellent corrosion resistance. However, FRP composites have their own weaknesses, such as the poor resistance of the organic polymer matrix to fire (flammability, smoke generation and rapid deterioration in its mechanical properties) and low compatibility between the epoxy bonding agent and the concrete substrate. These weaknesses compromise the attractiveness of FRP strengthening technology in many applications. Therefore, recent efforts have been made to use inorganic cementitious matrices to replace epoxy in the development of fiber reinforced inorganic polymer (FRiP) strengthening systems. The present project aims to develop an innovative FRiP strengthening system. In this system, a magnesium phosphate cement (MPC)-based paste, which has distinct advantages over other existing cementitious materials, is used as both the matrix and the binding agent in fiber sheets. A novel technique, PopTube technology, will be applied to grow carbon nanotubes (CNTs) on fiber sheets and fly ash. PopTube is a rapid and cost-effective method, and is similar to the way popcorn is made in the kitchen. The fly ash will be used as the micro fillers in the MPC matrix. CNT-coated fiber sheets are expected to significantly improve the bonding with the MPC matrix, thus leading to improvements in the mechanical properties of the formed FRiP composites. CNT-coated fly ash is expected to improve the strength and toughness of the MPC matrix, and the bond between the FRiP composite and the concrete substrate. Six issues will be addressed in the establishment of this innovative FRiP strengthening technique: (1) the workability and mechanical properties of the MPC matrix; (2) the bond between the PopTube technology-treated fiber sheets and the MPC matrix; (3) the tensile properties of the innovative FRiP composites; (4) the bond force transfer between the innovative FRiP composites and the concrete substrate; (5) the durability of the innovative bonded FRiP system in moist environments; and (6) the performance of the innovative bonded FRiP system at elevated temperatures. This project represents a significant step forward in the development of FRiP strengthening technologies for concrete structures by addressing the current deficiencies in such technologies. The project is expected to lead to an attractive new method with great potential for practical applications, which will have a major influence on the international scientific community. 由於FRP輕質、高強、耐腐蝕的特性，應用外貼纖維增強樹脂（FRP）復合材料加固混凝土結構技術已經獲得廣泛應用。但是由於有機樹脂的使用，FRP的耐高溫及耐火性能較差，尤其影響了外貼FRP加固技術在室內結構中的使用，近來較多的研究者進行了纖維增強無機樹脂（FRiP）技術的開發。本項目立足於研發一種新型的FRiP體系。在該體系中，環境友好的磷酸鹽水泥將做為FRiP中的基體及粘接材料；此外，一種叫做PopTube的新型碳納米管的制作技術將用來在纖維和粉煤灰上生長碳納米管；帶有碳納米管的纖維可增強和磷酸鹽水泥基體的粘結，而長有碳納米管粉煤灰可期待提高基體的韌性，從而顯著改善FRiP的力學特性。本項目將為FRiP技術的開發帶來突破，這種全新的技術可期待對混凝土結構的加固研究及應用領域帶來深遠影響。

514513.label: Realisation of objectives
514513.value: All the objectives set out for this project have been completely achieved. Magnesium phosphate cement (MPC) binder has been used as the matrix of carbon fiber sheets to form fiber-reinforced inorganic polymer (FRIP) composites. The physical and mechanical performance of the fresh mixed and the hardened MPC paste, the bond strength of carbon fiber sheets in the MPC matrix, the tensile strength of the carbon FRIP composites and the microstructure of the MPC matrix and fiber-reinforced MPC composites were investigated to achieve an optimal mix proportion for developing FRIP composites, which can be a promising alternative to externally-bonded fiber-reinforced polymer (FRP) composites for the strengthening of concrete structures. An in-depth understanding of the behavior of fiber-reinforced inorganic MPC composites has been achieved. The material formation mechanisms of MPC binder as well as its microstructures were also investigated in details through advanced measurement such as the X-ray computed tomography. The inorganic cementitious matrix was further enhanced by using micro-fibers to form an ultra-high performance engineered cementitious composite, which was then used for flexural strengthening of RC beams and demonstrated the its high efficiency. It is worth noting that a chemically bonded refractory castable based on the acid-base reaction between calcium aluminate cement (CAC) and polyphosphate-based reactant was developed and found to exhibit superior mechanical performance even after exposure to elevated temperatures up to 1000 °C. The bond performance between the developed FRiP was assessed under both the moisture environment and the elevated temperature. It was proved that the developed FRiP system exhibits much improved bond performance than traditional externally bonded FRP composites, indicating that the proposed FRiP strengthening technology is a more attractive alternative than the traditional FRP strengthening technology particularly for indoor applications (because of superior fire resistance) and marine environment applications (because of a high-moisture condition). The research project has lead to a major impact on the international scientific community as well as the engineering practice in Hong Kong, the Chinese mainland and the rest of the world.

514513.label: Major findings and research outcome
514513.value: The following findings and research outcome have been achieved: (1) A new method has been invented for better dispersion of CNTs into cementitious materials. (2) An optimal phosphate-based cement binder has been developed to form a new FRiP composite for the strengthening of concrete structures. The material formation mechanisms and the microstructures of the cement binder were clarified. (3) A calcium aluminate cement (CAC) modified polyphosphate-based cement binder was developed and found to exhibit superior mechanical performance even after exposure to elevated temperatures up to 1000 °C. (4) The durability performance of the bond between FRiP and concrete substrate was proved to be excellent under a moisture environment and elevated temperature. (5) The flexural strengthening effect of using the FRiP composites with a ductile matrix proved to lead to superior structural performance. (6) The developed strengthened technology will be implemented in Guangzhou through through the Hong Kong-Guangzhou Technology and Innovation Partnership Programme.

514513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
514513.value: The project is expected to lead to an attractive new cement-bonded fiber composite strengthening system with great potential for practical applications. The strengthening system has been well established through the project and will be realized in actual engineering practice through the Hong Kong-Guangzhou Technology and Innovation Partnership Programme, for which the PI has secured a funding support.

514513.value: The present project aims to develop an innovative fiber reinforced inorganic polymer (FRiP) strengthening system. In this system, a magnesium phosphate cement (MPC)-based paste, which has distinct advantages over other existing cementitious materials, is used as both the matrix and the binding agent in fiber sheets. The MPC paste is improved its toughness and bonding with the fiber sheets through the use of micro fillers, thus leading to improvements in the mechanical properties of the formed FRiP composites. The filler is also expected to improve the bond between the FRiP composite and the concrete substrate. The proposed system is studied from the following aspects: (1) the workability and mechanical properties of the MPC matrix; (2) the bond between the fiber sheets and the MPC matrix; (3) the tensile properties of the innovative FRiP composites; (4) the bond force transfer between the FRiP composites and the concrete substrate; (5) the durability of the innovative bonded FRiP system in moist environments; and (6) the performance of the innovative bonded FRiP system at elevated temperatures. This project represents a significant step forward in the development of FRiP strengthening technologies for concrete structures by addressing the current deficiencies in such technologies.

514713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
514713.value: 很多國家都建設了龐大的鐵路網絡。例如，截止到2011，中國的運營鐵路網絡約達到了93,000公里。鐵路網的很大部分處於山區，鐵路沿線存在大量邊坡及隧道。同時，為增加市區運輸效率，中國和其它國家的很多城市建設了地下鐵路系統。例如，上海建設了世界最長的地鐵網絡，達到425公里。香港建設了218.2公里的城市軌道交通系統，大部分處於隧道內。城市鐵路系統形成了一個複雜的鐵路隧道網絡。 很顯然，鐵路沿線的邊坡及隧道的穩定性對鐵路安全系統而言十分關鍵。如何結構失穩都可能破壞運行的火車或路軌，導致致命的火車事故。事實上，中國及其它很多國家都發生過此類事故。 除了建設穩定的邊坡和隧道及定期檢查及維護，監測鐵路邊坡及隧道隨時間的的變形有助於了解這些結構的穩定性及防止突如其來的結構失穩。確保鐵路邊坡及隧道的穩定性對於高速鐵路更加重要，因為高速鐵路事故會更加嚴重。 目前已有多種設備/方法用於監測邊坡及隧道變形。由於這些設備/方法的費用高昂或監測距離及精度有限，它們只能用於測量有限數量的邊坡或隧道。一些例如衛星雷達遙感的方法可以很容易同時覆​​蓋大面積地區及大量邊坡，但是由於受幾何失真等問題的影響，這些方法經常不能正常工作。另外一些方法只能在火車停運的情況下工作，因此很難在實際中應用。 這個研究項目旨在發展一個全新的鐵路邊坡及隧道變形監測技術- 車載雷達遙感系統。當一個成像雷達系統安裝於火車上，可以很容易對鐵路周圍的物體，包括邊坡及隧道等進行成像。通過對這些雷達影像進行處理及分析，可以確定這些物體的變形。因此，很容易地對大量邊坡及隧道的變形進行精確的測量。 此研究將產生先進的新技術，進而幫助包括香港及內地在內的國家和地區解決一個懸而未決的重要問題，即準確、可靠地檢查大量的鐵路邊坡及隧道的穩定性。此研究標誌著重要的科技進展及實用價值。

514713.label: Realisation of objectives
514713.value: We designed and optimizated an innovative train-based imaging radar system for acquiring quality radar images of objects that are along railways and within the measurement range of the radar system. Both simulation and experimental studies were carried out to investigate the performance of the technology in view of the field, atmospheric and observational conditions on the railway lines in Hong Kong and Mainland China. Methods, algorithms and software packages were developed for processing and analyzing data from the imaging radar system to determine accurately the deformation of the imaged objects. Datasets obtained from simulated experimental tests carried out on a test site at the university were processed with the software packages and satisfactory results were achieved. Investigation was carried out to examine the performance of the train-based imaging radar system under different conditions based on both computer simulations and experimental studies. All the objectives of the project were achieved.

514713.label: Major findings and research outcome
514713.value: We have investigated the capabilities of both ground-based and space-borne radar systems in monitoring deformation of structures such as slopes and long-suspension bridges as well as changes of ground covers such as changes in the volumes of mountain glaciers (journal papers 1-7). Optimization of ground radar systems and integrating such systems with global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) and inertial measurement unit (IMU) for realizing a train-based radar system have been investigated. A prototype of such an integrated system has been developed and tested on a short section of railway track set up on the university campus. A further publication based on the results is being prepared. The research has shown that the concept of a train-based radar system is feasible, and such a system could be used to monitor slope and structural stability along a railway line as envisaged in the project proposal.

514713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
514713.value: Since the concept of a train-based radar system has been proved in the project, it is very desirable to continue the work and develop a fully functional system for practical applications. It will be very useful to use such a system to monitor the operational environments of railways such as high speed railway lines. It is planned to apply for some further funding for such research and development work.

514713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
514713.value: Slopes and other structures along a railway line can cause significant safety hazards when they become unstable or even fail. Therefore, it is important to regularly check the stability of such structures. There are currently no very efficient technologies for performing such a task. This project aimed to carry out conceptual investigation of a train-based radar system for monitoring the stability of such structures. The research has demonstrated the capability of such a system and optimized the hardware and software designs. The research results may lead to some technological breakthroughs if further work is done.

514813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
514813.value: Mobile phones are becoming indispensable in our daily lives. They offer enormous advantages, such as added convenience, greater personal security, and doing business on the move. As mobile communication services continue to expand, more and more radio base stations are being constructed. These stations are tall structures and placed in remote locations. They are subject to lightning discharges. Any failure caused by lightning may result in large revenue losses and complaints from customers. Effective protection against lightning discharges is then essential for the design and operation of radio base stations. There is no effective method currently available for the evaluation of lightning surges in base stations. This project aims to develop modeling approaches for station equipment and components and to evaluate lightning surges in these stations. In this project the partial element equivalent circuit (PEEC) formulation will be developed to represent a permeable wire structure occurring in both air and layered dispersive and lossy media. Special techniques will be provided for analyzing transients in the frequency-dependent PEEC model with nonlinear components incorporated. The solution tool developed for lightning transient analysis will help practicing engineers in the design of effective protection against lightning and to evaluate the effectiveness of exiting protection schemes. The approaches and tools developed can be also applied to the analysis of lightning surges in networks used in power systems, buildings and electrified railway systems. The output of this project could be further extended and developed for the local lightning protection centers in China to underpin the ever-expanding businesses in those territories. 移動電話正成爲我們日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。移動通信技術向人們提供極大的生活上方便、 更大的個人安全，以及促進加强各地貿易往來等等。隨著移動通信服務不斷擴大，越來越多的無綫電基站正在興建。它們通常放置在高層建築的樓頂，或在山坡上，極易受到雷電閃擊。雷電閃擊會引起通信服務中斷，可能會導致客戶的巨額損失和投訴。因而雷電閃擊的有效保護是至關重要的。 當前還沒有有效的基站雷電閃擊浪涌的評價方法。此項目旨在研究基站設備和組件的建模辦法，來評估基站的雷電浪涌。在此項目中將采用部分等效電路方法 (PEEC) 來表示在空氣和有損大地中的導綫結構，及提出頻率依賴組件的瞬態分析技術。 無綫電基站閃電瞬態的分析工具將幫助工程師們在設計中提出有效的雷電防護方案。提出的建模方法和分析工具也適用于分析在電力系統、 建築物和電氣化的鐵路系統網絡的閃電浪涌。此項目的結果可以進一步爲各地雷電防護中心加强和擴展現有的業務。

514813.label: Realisation of objectives
514813.value: The objectives of this project have been achieved generally. (a) Radio base stations are usually located in remote areas, and are subject to lightning discharges. When radio equipment in a base station fails during a lightning flash, technicians may need to travel a long distance for equipment repairs. This certainly increases communication downtime, which may results in large revenue losses and complaints from customers. Modelling of radio base stations and computer simulation of lightning surges are indispensable for providing effective protection against lightning for radio base stations (RBS). An extensive survey of radio base stations was conducted in this project, with the logistic support from a large telecommunication equipment manufacturer. Both RBS configurations and devices adopted in industry have been collected, which include tower structures, cables, linear and nonlinear protective devices, electronic components and others. All these are considered essential for providing appropriate device modelling and surge simulation in the radio base stations. Generally speaking, the radio base station under a lightning strike can be represented by a wire structure connected to a set of lumped electrical/electronic devices. The general Maxwell’s equations were first applied to the wire structure above the ground or under the ground by using the Green’s functions. The partial element equivalent circuit (PEEC) method, which transforms the EM problems into equivalent circuits, has been developed for modelling these wires. Computer programs have been provided in the MATLAB platform to evaluate these complicated Green’s functions, and simplification to the Green’s functions were made in order to perform transient analysis efficiently. A significant mismatch of surge currents in a wire structure was found when making a comparison between theoretical analysis and laboratory experiment. A detailed investigation was carried out, and it was found later that it was caused by both the strong non-linear behavior and proximity effect in steel wires and power/single cables as well. In order to provide appropriate models for these wires and cables, both experiments and theoretical analysis have been extensively carried out. Several techniques have been proposed to overcome the difficulties in modelling and simulation of lightning surges in the radio base stations. These include (1) the linear model for the ferromagnetic steel components carrying lightning current, (2) the equivalent circuit approach for modelling skin and proximity effects of conductors, (3) the hybrid discretization PEEC (DPEEC) and artificial neural network (ANN) approach for efficient wire modelling, (4) the application of a vector fitting technique, and others. (b) The wire structure in the radio base stations are normally terminated with electrical and/or electronic devices including those low-voltage protective components. In this projects, it was found that the models of these devices available in the literature are not applicable to lightning transient analysis. The detailed investigation revealed that both inherent nonlinear behaviour and the effect of parasite parameters within the devices have to be considered in modelling and simulation. After a series of experimental tests and theoretical analysis, an experimental procedure for extracting the nonlinear and stray parameters has been worked out. The models for electrical and electronic devices have been provided. These include the models for MOV varisters, common-mode and differential-mode inductors and chokes, capacitors, gas discharge tubes, transient voltage suppressors, and others electronic devices. MATLAB codes have been developed to assist extracting circuit parameters of these devices efficiently for modelling and simulation. The procedure for wire modelling and lightning surge simulation has been worked out, and computer programs have been developed. The models for wire structures and electrical/electronic devices were set up in frequency domain generally. To facilitate the time-domain analysis, which is more efficient and appropriate for nonlinear devices, those frequency-dependent parameters were represented with frequency-invariant circuit components by using the vector fitting technique. Finally the whole system was represented with a set of interconnected and coupled frequency-invariant components. This network could be analyzed by using any conventional circuit analysis tool. (c) The modelling procedure and simulation tool have been applied to analyze lightning currents and voltages in radio base systems as well as other signalling and power supply systems. Before applying this procedure for solving practical problems, experimental validation has been performed in the laboratory. Several different setups have been constructed in the laboratory for testing. These include (a) parallel-connected aluminum tubes for investigating current sharing among cables, (b) a large wire structure made by steel bars and shielded power cables for checking the accuracy of ferromagnetic steel models, (c) the wire structure terminated with electrical, electronic, protective devices, finally (d) a scaled-down model of steel tower together power and signal cables. The validation was also made by comparing the simulation results with the experimental results available in the literature. This included the lightning surges in an underground wire structure. The soli ionization effect was taken into account in the simulation. The modelling and simulation software was developed to facilitate the design of effective lightning protection. The complete procedure has been applied to evaluate lightning transients in a complicated system. The system included the 40m tall steel tower, the power and signalling cables running along the tower on a steel cable ladder, the electronic and protective devices (surge protective devices) as well as antennas connected to the end of cables, the grounding grid as well. Simulations were also performed for the electrical supply system and signalling system in buildings and in railway systems when these systems were subject to either direct lightning strikes or indirect lightning strikes. The PEEC modelling approach was also applied to discuss the coordination of series connected surge protective devices. The optimal selection of surge protective devices was discussed.

514813.label: Major findings and research outcome
514813.value: The modern telecommunication networks are vulnerable to lighting transients. For effective protection, it is necessary to carry out transient current analysis in radio base stations. In the literature there was little information available about lightning modelling and simulation for RBS. This project provided a comprehensive procedure for modelling wire structures and electronic devices, and simulating lightning transients in the system [J3, C7] using the PEEC approach. The system consists of a 40m tall steel tower, coaxial cables, shielded power cables, steel cable ladders, protective devices, and grounding grids. This procedure makes it possible to design an effective lightning scheme in radio base stations. A software package was developed for device modelling and transient simulation with the C++ and matlab codes [C8]. Note that simulation of lightning transients is impossible if the steel structure is not appropriately modelled. The procedure for modelling ferromagnetic steels was provided. It was found that such material heavily saturates when carrying lightning current, and could be modelled as linear magnetic material [J4]. The experimental validation was provided, and a modelling procedure was given. The steel components and cables could not be simply modelled with filaments. Both skin and proximity effects have to be considered. Otherwise, significant errors were generated [J5 and C3]. A discretised PEEC model was proposed to overcome the difficulties in wire structure modelling [J5]. As these parameters are frequency-variant, a vector fitting technique was proposed to extract frequency-invariant circuit components for time domain simulation. This is necessary as there are non-linear devices in the system. For efficient modelling, a hybrid PEEC and artificial neutral network method was developed in [J6]. Good agreements have been observed. The PEEC model for the grounding grid was also provided and the model was validated by using the experimental results available in the literature [C7]. Protective and electronic devices were modelled for transient analysis by considering both nonlinear behaviours and effect of parasite parameters [J3 and C4]. Ignoring these effects can lead to significant errors in the lightning transient simulations. Computer simulations were also performed to study lightning transients in signalling systems and power supply systems in electrified railway and commercial buildings [J2, and C1-C3, C5]. Characteristics of lightning surges in these systems were provided. Coordination of surge protective devices were investigated as well [J1], and optimal selection of surge protective devices was discussed. Note: J* and C* represent the indices of journal papers and conference papers attached in the report.

514813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
514813.value: This project addressed the lightning transients in a wire structure during a direct lightning strike. The wires in the structures are relatively short compared with the wavelength of the lightning transients. The propagation effect within individual wire segments is not taken into account. In reality, such a structure may be connected to a long overhead line, such as overhead power supply network or overhead communication lines. Transmission line equations would be applied to these long wires. Therefore, the challenging question is how to link the PEEC model of short wires and transmission line equations for long wires. Again the lightning transients in the radio base stations subject to indirect lightning strikes have not been well addressed. These issues will be proposed to address in the coming research project proposal.

515313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
515313.value: 電機是機電能量轉換的主要設備。由於有大量電機的存在，即使能量轉換效率只是增加一小點，也能節省全球大量的能源資源。電機優化設計可以有效地增大其能量轉換效率並降低成本。優化設計算法利用數值計算方法，可以自動尋找最佳電機設計參數，這在實際中非常有用。只需點擊電腦的鼠標便可以快速地找到最好的設計方案的確是許多電氣工程師最終的夢想。 有限元法確保了電機設計中的目標函數可以被精確計算。然而，使用有限元法求解優化問題時，由於電磁場方程需要被成千上萬次地求解，會耗費大量的計算時間。更為嚴重的問題是，在優化過程中，每次幾何參數的更新都需要重新產生相應的有限元網格。因而網格生成的過程通常也需要重複成千上萬次，這同樣會耗費大量的計算時間，並且這種做法不是很穩定，尤其是對於復雜的三維應用來說。對於數值優化方法在工程界中的應用，這已經成為了瓶頸問題。在合理的時間內尋找最優設計成為了對於研究人員的一個挑戰。 本項目提出了一種新型的無需重建網格的參數化有限元法。該方法不但能保證高的計算精度，還可以加速電機的優化設計過程。該方法的優點是在幾何參數更新時不需要重新構建網格。新方法中節點坐標的數據結構中包含幾何形狀參數，在每一步優化過程中，網格中所有節點的節點坐標會隨著形狀參數的改變自動更新，並且參數變化的影響會平緩地擴散到內部節點中。在處理非線性問題時，前一步有限元的解也可以作為當前步解的良好初始值，從而加速非線性問題的收斂速度。 為了進一步加快優化問題的求解過程，本項目提出了一種新的多分辨率有限元算法。該方法在不同的優化階段，採用了不同尺度的自由度分佈以減少計算時間。該方法的一個特點是雖然有不同尺度的自由度分佈，但是只需要一套網格。在計算目標函數值的時候，提出了一種新的縮減基方法。對於一組選定的設計變量值，其目標函數值可以由已知解的多項式組合而得到。多項式的展開係數可以通過簡單代入快速計算得到。本研究計劃提出的縮減基方法可以自適應地確定樣本點，在保證計算精度的前提下大大縮小計算時間。 本項目的成功將為電機優化設計提供一個統一的框架。在香港，永磁電機普遍用於工業和家庭，因此，開發的方法將用於永磁電機的優化設計。

515313.label: Realisation of objectives
515313.value: The project objectives have been fully achieved. The theory of proposed remesh-free finite element method (FEM) has been developed. The possible applications for optimal design of EMs have been studied. The merits and demerits of these theories have been clearly figured out. The remesh-free FEM can speed up the optimal design process of EMs while ensuring the accuracy of the computed optimal solutions is high. In the parameterized remesh-free FEM the data structure of the node coordinates contains the geometric shape parameters. In optimization once the shape parameters and hence the geometric outlines are modified, the positions of all nodes in the mesh can be updated at the same time to regenerate the mesh. The influence of the parameters’ change can be assigned to each internal node smoothly in the updated mesh. If nonlinear iterations are needed on the updated mesh, the FEM solutions obtained on the previous mesh can also be used as good initial values for the next mesh in order to accelerate the convergence rate. The remeshing process is no longer needed when the geometric sizes are updated. Novel multi-resolution FEM algorithm has also been developed to further speed up the optimal design process. Different scales of degrees of freedom (DoFs) are used in different stages of the optimization process in order to reduce the total computing time. Only one basic mesh is required in the proposed method due to different scales of the DoFs. A novel and adaptive reduced basis method (RBM) has been developed when computing the objective functions using FEM. To a set of specific design parameters, its solution can be expressed as a polynomial of the solutions of other sets of design parameters whose solutions are already obtained. The coefficients in the polynomial can be quickly obtained by substituting the expression of the solution into the field equations. The proposed RBM can adaptively determine the sampling points, which significantly reduce the computing time as well as ensuring the accuracy of the solutions is high.
