522513.label: Major findings and research outcome
522513.value: We have been able to obtain the climatic datas from Guangdong climate stations that we could not obtain before as stated in the first progress report., and difficult to obtain from Hong Kong. This greatly enhanced the meaning of the thermal satellite images for converting land surface temperatures to air temperatures using the ground data for these stations for the last 3 decades The relationship between climatic data from ground stations in PRD region, and satellite images from Landsat and MODIS has been established and the PhD student on the project is currently submitting a journal paper on this aspect and will start writing her results soon. Also we have validated the impervious surface areas derived from Landsat, using high resolution images as the reference. Another journal publication on heat islands of Hong Kong and its relationship to the heat island of the whole PRD is being finalised

522513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
522513.value: In view of climate change and the observed projected increases in air temperatures in Hong Kong over the next 3 decades, predicted by our modelling, Planning Department will be interested to liaise with us on specific air-surface interactions and locations of key districts where action is required. The Research team will liaise with Hong Kong planners once the results have been written up

522513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
522513.value: The project permits understanding of how Hong Kong's urban climate, specifically the Urban Heat Island, is related to that of the expanding Pearl River Delta region. This has been accomplished using archived time-series of thermal and optical satellite images at two different resolutions- AVHRR-MODIS at 1km, and Landsat at 60m resolution. Relationships between land surface temperature and the proportion of Impervious Surface area surrounding major climate stations across PRD have enabled understanding of the impact of expansion of urban areas, on climate. This has implications for planning policies which should take into account city size, for mitigation of temperatures across urban areas. The project has trained one PhD student who is due to start writing up her dissertation in the next few months.

522613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
522613.value: Globally, building sectors consume around 30% of the primary energy. In this era of sustainability concern, raising building energy efficiency is considered the cleanest and lowest-hanging fruits of all available energy resources. On the other hand, a large window is a desirable architectural feature that gives occupants access to day lighting and pleasant views, especially in high-rise cities. A window is also, however, the major route for the unwanted solar heat gain in the air-conditioned season and substantial conduction heat loss in the winter season. These two conflicting effects pose a great challenge in this era of ever rising comfort requirement and pressing need of CO2-emission reduction for environmental protection. For cold climates, it appears that a solution is found and a low-E coating coupled with double glazing is very effective in reducing conduction heat loss while allowing desirable solar heat access, whereas for hot climates and areas like Hong Kong dominated by cooling requirements, such window systems would have minimal effects since solar heat gain is the major component contributing to air-conditioning loads, and window glazing systems with better thermal performance against both radiation heat gain and conduction heat gain is still very needed. External shading, while effective in blocking solar radiation, is not practical for high rise buildings for a number of reasons, especially external shading devices on high rises will be vulnerable to typhoon and can consequently cause human body injuries when typhoon strikes. This project aims to develop an advanced window system that can be "life-cycle energy" effective for cooling-dominant buildings in hot, humid climates. In particular, a specific category of materials, represented by silica aerogel, will be applied between glass panes. Compared with traditional double-layer glass or low-e glass, the new window system will block out infra-red and long wave thermal radiation and reduce conduction heat gain at the same time. The proposed research will consist of material property tests, window assembly performance tests and optimization analysis. Finally, it is expected that an evaluation of the life-cycle environment benefits for this state-of-the art design will be obtained, which will serve as a guidance for developing such sustainable products to meet the demand for low-energy, sustainable building design in the market. 建築能耗在社會總能耗中佔有很大的比重，全世界每年有30%的一次能源被消耗在建築物中。隨著人們環保和可持續發展意識的增強，建築節能作為最潔淨最易於實現的節能途徑而受到廣泛的關注。大面積的窗戶設計能夠給室內人員提供舒適的天然光和怡人的景色，因此是一類深受歡迎的建築設計元素，在類似香港的大都會城市尤甚。然而透過窗戶的傳熱同時也是夏季太陽輻射得熱和冬季室內散熱的主要途徑。鑒於這兩種相互衝突的考慮，如何在維持室內舒適環境的同時又能夠降低由建築能耗引起的碳排放是擺在屋宇設備工程師面前的一項極大的挑戰。在高緯度的寒冷地區，工程師們已經找尋到了一種很好的解決方案：採用low-e貼膜配合雙層玻璃窗。這種窗體形式可以在有效降低傳熱損失的同時保證室內能夠獲得適度的太陽輻射得熱。然而在類似香港這樣的低緯度炎熱潮濕的地區，採用low-e膜配合雙層玻璃的窗戶形式就無法獲得令人滿意的效果。在低緯度炎熱地區，太陽輻射得熱是建築物空調負荷的一項主要來源。因此在降低導熱得熱和輻射得熱兩方面都有良好表現的新型窗戶形式在低緯度炎熱氣候條件下具有非常大的應用潛力。尤其在類似香港這樣的位於亞熱帶季風氣候區的大都會城市，外遮陽設計受限於颱風因素無法在高層建築中廣泛運用的現狀也使得新型節能窗戶具有更加廣闊的應用前景。 本研究組將要進行的該項研究項目旨在開發一種新型的，能夠實現在低緯度炎熱潮濕氣候條件下全生命週期內節能的窗體裝置。該窗體裝置的主體結構採用的是雙層玻璃構造，並且在兩層玻璃之間的夾層中填充有以二氧化硅氣凝膠為代表的一類新型材料。同傳統的雙層玻璃、low-e玻璃相比，這種新型窗體裝置可以在降低導熱得熱的同時阻擋住大部份的紅外輻射即長波輻射得熱。本研究組的該項研究將包括對氣凝膠材料物性的測試，窗體裝置的性能測試以及建築圍護結構的最優化設計分析。此外，本研究組還將針對該新型窗體設計進行全生命週期的環境效益評估。最終形成的評估報告將作為本地市場上生產滿足低能耗可持續建築要求的該類型產品的指導性文件。

522613.label: Realisation of objectives
522613.value: 1. Manufacture a double glazing window system with silica aerogel between the two layers of glass. Obtain all necessary data during manufacturing for further improvement. A pack of silica aerogel product sample was obtained. The particle size range, pore diameter, porosity, density and surface area of the sample were collected. A series of Scaning Electron Microscope testing were conducted. A sandwich-type silica-aerogel glazing system sample was prepared, with two layers of 6mm thick single clear glazing on both sides and a silica-aerogel layer filled in between. Based on the research outcomes from other research groups, the edge sealing method was discussed and selected. The thermal conductivity of the glazing sample was measured as 0.13 W/m K. The optical features of the glazing sample, such as the transmittance, the reflectivity at front side and the reflectivity at back side along the wavelength were also measured. 2. Build up a physical model to describe the thermal processes involving simultaneous heat conduction, convection and thermal radiation. Integrate the model into existing whole building simulation software. Based on the measurement result of the silica-aerogel glazing sample, a glazing material calculation model in EnergyPlus software was produced. In the calculation model, the optical features under different wavelengths were considered. The thermal conductivity was transformed into U-value with the assistance of another popular simulation software - Window 7 developed by LBNL. 3. Utilize the simulation model to study the impact of different material properties and their combinations on the performance of the window system. A simulation study was conduced with the silica-aerogel glazing calculation model. the simulation was based on a typical commercial building model which was described in the Building Department's OTTV calculation instruction. The schedules of occupant, lighting, equipment as well as air-conditioning were defined strictly according to the design guideline of Hong Kong Government. The simulation result indicated that after utilization of silica aerogel glazing the cooling load was reduced. In the hottest months, the cooling load could be cut by 3.5 to 4%. From November to March, the cooling load reduction could be around 7%. Considering the cooling load caused by envelope heat gain, the application of silica-aerogel glazing could result in a reduction of nearly 60%. 4. Prepare experiment device for the on-site measurement for the cooling load reduction data under the application of silica-aerogel glazing sample. Two test boxes were prepared for the on-site measurement of the silica-aerogel glazing sample. The two test boxes were identical in size and shape so that a comparision can be made. The size of the test box was 1m* 1m* 1m. The boxes were made of 20mm thick plywood board. The outside surface of the boxes were insulated with 30mm thick insulation. One test box was equipped with single clear glazing and the other one box was equipped with silica aerogel glazing sample. 5. Conduct a comprehensive analysis on the performance of energy-efficient designs on window area in cooling-dominant climates. A comprehensive analysis on thermal and daylighting performance of glazing and shading designs on office building envelope in cooling-dominant climates was conducted. The analysis was aiming at finding a optimal solution for reducing the cooling load caused by building envelope heat gain. The result indicated that applying advanced glazing material should be the best way considering both thermal and daylighting performance of the window area in commercial buildings. It was also discovered that in the east and the west orientations, the performance of the energy-efficient design on windows was the best. 6. Analysis of the effect of the silica-aerogel glazing sample on indoor IEQ status control in commercial buildings in Hong Kong. An analysis on the IEQ performance of the silica-aerogel glazing was conducted via simulation. Two popular simulation tools, respectively EnergyPlus and Radiance were referred to study the thermal and visual comfort status of the indoor occupant with the application of the silica-aerogel glazing. Three different control strategies, respectively air temperature control, operative temperature control and PMV control were studied. The result indicated while considering thermal comfort of the occupant, the application of silica-aerogel glazing can achieve a 4% longer comfortable period than that of single clear glazing, while the energy consumption was reduced by 4% - 7%. While considering visual comfort issue, the application of silica-aerogel glazing can significantly reduce the glare effect and the near-window bright zone, while still retaining a qualified indoor illumination level.

522613.label: Major findings and research outcome
522613.value: One of the major research findings is that the particulates aerogel were relatively easier to be transported and assembled into a cavity between two window panes. This would greatly reduce the transportation coast of the assembled glazing system. The drawback is that the final assembly tends to be translucent rather than transparent. It has been recommended that this type glazing is best for sky-windows when the day lighting rather than then the view for the occupants is the major benefit.

522613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
522613.value: Further potential research would be the longitudinal observation of the aerogel fills in a double glazing system, to see if the performance would be affected by the infiltration of moisture from the sealed edge.

522613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
522613.value: Windows are the major routes for solar heat gains and the major causes of air-conditioning energy use in the summer, and applying the external shading to block solar radiation has been hindered by a number of practical actors for high-rise buildings, such as its being prone to wind damage and falls and difficult to operate. On the other hand, indoor occupants would find the view from a window a pleasant architectural feature. Therefore, in this project, a transparent insulation material called aerogel was investigated for its potential to block the solar heat gain in a double glazing window while not blocking any views. The energy saving is promising, as the aerogel layer indeed blocked the thermal radiation between the two layers, while introducing the conduction resistance in comparison with an air-layer. It is less expensive to be manufactured than the vacuum double glazing system. It is also found a comprise of transparency with translucent product would make the technology more applicable in terms of the ease to manufacture, transport and and assemble on site, and this is good for sky-window applications when the access to daylighting is the major purpose. The research provided solid scientific data for manufacturers to produce cost-effective energy saving building components.

522813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
522813.value: The design of high-speed and high-precision mechatronic systems with lightweight flexible structural members has become an increasingly prevalent trend to satisfy the application demands for operating performance and energy efficiency. However, “position-dependent, frequency-varying residual vibrations” excited by maneuvering the lightweight flexible structure-based mechatronic systems often limit their operating performance so that strategic absorption of these residual vibrations is crucial to the breakthrough of this technological challenge. In fact, there are great application demands and socioeconomic benefits, coupled with high scientific/scholarly merit and research impact, for new advances in vibration absorption technology, especially for new initiatives in industrial mechatronic systems. Traditional tuned vibration absorbers are simple and cost-effective, but their tuned natural frequencies and damping properties, together with narrow-band attenuation nature, prevent them from any frequency- and damping-varying applications due to the high risk of “detuning” during real-life service. Tunable vibration absorbers (TVAs), which utilize compact, fast-responsive, and high-accurate smart material-based actuators as the tuning means to provide the distinctive feature of tunable stiffness and hence tunable natural frequency via an external tuning signal, have recently emerged as a promising class of vibration absorbers. While featuring real-time tuning capability, the existing TVAs are incapable of self-sensing structural vibrations for facilitating real-time, closed-loop, collocated sensing-while-tuning, and their damping properties are not generally/independently controllable in real time. These deficiencies not only limit application flexibility but also increase control complexity. In this research, a novel vibration absorption approach based on the design and implementation of an innovative class of TVAs namely “Smart TVAs” (STVAs) is proposed. The STVAs possess the attractive functionalities of sensing-while-tuning and controllable damping by bringing together the physical advantages of piezoelectric-magnetostrictive sensoriactuation and magnetostrictive damping to provide real-time, closed-loop, collocated sensing-while-tuning and damping control in a simple, cost-effective, and reliable manner for advanced mechatronic system applications. First, various interesting STVAs will be designed and their operating principles will be devised. Second, analytical and finite-element modeling will be performed to obtain the parameter-dependent static and dynamic behaviors and the optimal/characteristic designs. Third, a semiactive control strategy and a controller will be established for real-time, closed-loop, collocated sensing-while-tuning and damping control. Fourth, STVA prototypes will be fabricated and their sensing, tuning, controllable damping, and semiactive vibration absorption performance will be characterized in the laboratory environment. Finally, the STVAs and controller will be deployed in real-life advanced mechatronic systems used for semiconductor manufacturing and their semiactive vibration absorption performance will be evaluated in-situ. 為滿足操作性能和能源效益上的應用需求,由輕質柔性構件組成的高速及高精度機電系統已成為一個日益流行的設計和發展趨勢。然而,因機動所激發、與位置相關及隨頻率改變的「殘餘振動」,往往限制了這類機電系統的操作性能。因此,如能戰略性地吸收這些殘餘振動,是突破技術挑戰的關鍵,不但具有極大的應用需求和社會經濟效益,而且存在極高的科學/學術價值和研究影響力,對吸振技術的新發展、尤其在工業機電系統的新舉措,至關重要。 傳統的調諧吸振器(Tuned Vibration Absorbers)雖然簡單和符合成本效益,但是它們的已調固有頻率和阻尼特性,連同窄帶衰減性質,在實際服役中容易引致高風險「失調」,阻礙了它們於頻率和阻尼變動的應用。由於可調變吸振器(Tunable Vibration Absorbers, TVAs)利用緊湊、快速回應和高精度的智能材料致動器,通過外部調諧信號作調諧,從而提供獨特的可調剛度和可調固有頻率特徵,最近被視為一類有前途的吸振器。現有的TVAs雖然具有即時調諧能力,可是它們不但不能自我感知結構振動,以促進即時閉環與並列的傳感而調諧,而且它們的阻尼特性不能通常/獨自地即時可控,這些不足不僅限制了應用的靈活性,並且增加了控制的複雜性。 本研究藉著設計與實現一類名叫「智能可調變吸振器」(Smart Tunable Vibration Absorbers, STVAs)的創新型TVAs,以提倡一種新穎的吸振方法。這類STVAs通過匯集壓電與磁致伸縮傳動以及磁致伸縮阻尼的物理優勢,達至引人注目的傳感而調諧和可控阻尼功能,為先進機電系統應用提供簡單、有效和可靠的即時閉環與並列的傳感而調諧和阻尼控制。首先,我們會對各種有趣的STVAs進行設計和探討其工作原理。然後,我們會執行理論和有限元建模,以求獲得與參數相關的靜態和動態行為以及最優化/特性的設計。接著,我們會建立半主動控制策略和控制器,以實現即時閉環與並列的傳感而調諧和阻尼控制。此外,我們會製造原型STVAs,並且在實驗室環境中表徵其傳感、調諧、可控阻尼和半主動振動吸收性能。最後,我們會部署STVAs和控制器於製造半導體的先進機電系統中,以現場評估其半主動吸振性能。

522813.label: Realisation of objectives
522813.value: The three project objectives have been fully achieved with the production of “13” good SCI journal papers and “1” prestigious international conference paper as the direct output. A PhD student has been successfully trained in the project. An extensive research collaboration network has also been established. The scope of realization of the project objectives is summarized as follows: (1) In line with Project Objectives 1–3, the key enabling technologies and scientific know-hows in relation to the design, modeling, optimization, fabrication, characterization, and evaluation of a novel smart tunable vibration absorption (STVA) approach and its associated devices were developed and captured, both by innovatively and practically advancing and realizing smart piezoelectric–magnetostrictive material-based heterostructures on millimeter scale to exhibit interestingly strong magneto-mechano-electric (or simply magnetoelectric) coupling and interaction effects for the advance of sensing, actuation, driving, tuning, damping, and/or control (involving sensori-actuation, driving, tuning, damping, control, etc.) in precision mechatronic systems. An impressive set of research publications, including “10” journal papers and “1” conference paper, was produced in this main thrust, covering the following four groups of key enabling technologies and scientific know-hows: (A) Three different types of piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures, which were in forms of concentric rings, long rods, and rectangular laminates, were developed to investigate the coupled, collocated, and controlled effects of direct magnetostrictive actuation, mediated mechanical vibration/damping, and direct piezoelectric sensing under AC/dynamic operating conditions. [3 journal papers] (B) Two different types of piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures, which were in forms of bilayers and sandwiches, were developed to obtain an improved insight into the coupled, collocated, and controlled effects of converse piezoelectric driving, direct magnetostrictive tuning, mediated mechanical vibration/damping, and direct piezoelectric sensing under combined DC/static and AC/dynamic operating conditions. [2 journal papers] (C) The two-phase piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures demonstrated in (A) and (B) were innovatively evolved to create two advanced types of multiphase magnetic–electromagnetic–piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures for further realization of novel bidirectional current–voltage conversion and resonance phase-sensitive DC magnetic field sensing. [2 journal papers] (D) An advanced magnetic field sensing, actuation, and tuning technique based on magnetic field gradients instead of magnetic field strengths was proposed and realized by specifically arranging and connecting some of the piezoelectric–magnetostrictive material-based heterostructures in (A)–(C). The introduction of the magnetic field gradient technique could effectively suppress ambient or common-mode noises as well as improve the noise-immunity ability and hence the overall performance of the heterostructures. [3 journal papers and 1 conference paper] (2) High-quality multilayer thin film-based lead-free piezoelectric heterostructures with enhanced piezoelectric sensing, actuation, transduction, and damping properties were developed. This type of heterostructures had improved integration ability with micro-/nano-electronics for the facilitation of novel micro-/nano-mechatronic systems with higher compatibility, performance, and multifunctionality. [1 journal paper] (3) A mesoscale STVA device, called trapezoidal active-passive sensory–actuation vibration absorber–isolator (TAPSAVAI), was developed by suitably utilizing and/or integrating the key enabling technologies and scientific know-hows developed and captured in (1) and (2). The basic form of TAPVAI consisted of a central saddle-like mounting seat, two piezoelectric smart slanting legs, and two basemounts. The saddle-like mounting seat had a pair of both amplifying levers and flexural links to increase the flexibility of the TAPVAI in the vertical direction even though it was firmly installed using the basemounts. The piezoelectric smart slanting legs had patterned electrodes to realize active sensoriactuation and damping controls. Actuation, sensing, and vibration absorption and isolation performance were modeled and predicted. Three characteristic prototypes were fabricated and characterized to demonstrate their collocated and controllable active sensoriactuation and passive vibration absorption and isolation performance. [1 journal paper] (4) An advanced control strategy was developed by using a sliding-mode controller with a least-squares-based system identification observer to achieve an improved position control performance in terms of shorter rise time and smaller steady-state error for use in medium-stroke motion and vibration control devices, especially for those reported in (3). [1 journal paper]

522813.label: Major findings and research outcome
522813.value: A total of “13” good SCI journal papers [Section 8] and “1” prestigious international conference paper [Section 9] have been directly produced from this project to adequately address the three project objectives. A PhD student has been successfully trained [Section 10] and a solid research collaboration network has been effectively built [Section 11]. The major findings and research outcome in relation to the project objectives are summarized as follows: (1) Four groups of key enabling technologies and scientific know-hows in relation to the design, modeling, optimization, fabrication, characterization, and evaluation of a novel smart tunable vibration absorption (STVA) approach and its associated devices were developed and captured by innovatively and practically advancing and realizing smart piezoelectric–magnetostrictive material-based heterostructures on millimeter scale to exhibit interestingly strong magneto-mechano-electric (or simply magnetoelectric) coupling and interaction effects for the advance of precision sensing, actuation, driving, tuning, damping, and/or control (involving sensori-actuation, driving, tuning, damping, control, etc.) technologies. This main research thrust led to “10” journal papers and “1” conference paper [Sections 8 and 9] as follows: (A) Journal Paper #1, 3, and 6: These 3 journal papers reported the novel coupled, collocated, and controlled effects of direct magnetostrictive actuation, mediated mechanical vibration/damping, and direct piezoelectric sensing in three different types of piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures having concentric ring, long rod, and rectangular laminate configurations and operating under AC/dynamic conditions. (B) Journal Paper #2 and 4: These 2 journal papers disclosed an improved insight into the coupled, collocated, and controlled effects of converse piezoelectric driving, direct magnetostrictive tuning, mediated mechanical vibration/damping, and direct piezoelectric sensing in two other different types of piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures featuring bilayer and sandwich configurations and operating under combined DC/static and AC/dynamic conditions. (C) Journal Paper #8 and 9: These 2 journal papers further realized novel bidirectional current–voltage conversion and resonance phase-sensitive DC magnetic field sensing in two advanced types of multiphase magnetic–electromagnetic–piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures evolved innovatively from the two-phase piezoelectric–magnetostrictive heterostructures in (A) and (B). (D) Journal Paper #7, 10, 11 and Conference Paper #1: These 4 journal and conference papers proposed and demonstrated the use of magnetic field gradient technique instead of state-f-the-art magnetic field strength technique to create an advanced magnetic field sensing, actuation, and tuning technique with enhanced abilities to suppress ambient or common-mode noises, to improve noise immunity and hence overall performance of the piezoelectric–magnetostrictive material-based heterostructures in (A)–(C). (2) Journal Paper #12: This journal paper reported enhanced piezoelectric sensing, actuation, and damping properties in high-quality multilayer thin film-based lead-free piezoelectric heterostructures suitable for integration with micro-/nano-electronics to facilitate novel micro-/nano-mechatronic systems with higher compatibility, performance, and multifunctionality. (3) Journal Paper #13: This journal paper described the development of a mesoscale STVA device, called trapezoidal active-passive sensory–actuation vibration absorber–isolator (TAPSAVAI), by suitably utilizing and/or integrating the key enabling technologies and scientific know-hows developed and captured in (1) and (2). This paper also disclosed the collocated and controllable active sensoriactuation and passive vibration absorption and isolation performance of three characteristic prototypes, besides modeling their actuation, sensing, and vibration absorption and isolation performance. (4) Journal Paper #6: This journal paper reported the development of an advanced control strategy by using a sliding-mode controller with a least-squares-based system identification observer to achieve an improved position control performance in terms of shorter rise time and smaller steady-state error for medium-stroke motion and vibration control devices, including those of (1)–(3).

522813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
522813.value: Precision and multifunctional devices, featuring collocated and controlled magneto-mechano-electric coupling and interaction effects for enabling sensori-actuation, driving, tuning, damping, and/or control, are crucial to today’s and new generation industrial mechatronic systems ranging from mesoscale to millimeter- and even nanometer-scale. It has been demonstrated obviously in the present project with proven research publications that multiphase smart piezoelectric–magnetostrictive material-based heterostructures possessing interestingly strong magneto-mechano-electric coupling and interaction effects with improved noise-immunity ability and performance are the main thrust for the advance of sensori-actuation, driving, tuning, damping, and/or control in precision and multifunctional mechatronic systems. Therefore, there exist great rooms to further invent/develop such an attractive class of heterostructures, devices, and their associated enabling technologies. In addition, the resulting devices can also be evaluated in-situ on advanced industrial mechatronic systems to further enable and advance other technologies such as control, automation, and computing technologies.

522813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
522813.value: Studies on the design, modeling, optimization, fabrication, characterization, and evaluation of a novel smart tunable vibration absorption approach and its associated devices are carried out in this project. Practical realizations of millimeter-scale two-phase and multiphase smart piezoelectric–magnetostrictive material-based heterostructures are performed to exhibit interestingly strong magneto-mechano-electric coupling and interaction effects with improved noise-immunity ability and performance for the advance of sensori-actuation, driving, tuning, damping, and/or control in precision mechatronic systems. High-quality multilayer thin film-based lead-free piezoelectric heterostructures with enhanced piezoelectric sensing, actuation, transduction, and damping properties are developed for improved integration with micro-/nano-electronics and formation of novel micro-/nano-mechatronic systems with higher compatibility, performance, and multifunctionality. Mesoscale devices are demonstrated with collocated and controllable active sensori-actuation and passive vibration absorption and isolation. Advanced control strategy is also created using a sliding-mode controller with a least-squares-based system identification observer to improve position control with shorter rise time and smaller steady-state error. The research output of this project, including the “13” SCI journal publications, the key enabling technologies and scientific know-hows, and the invented/developed materials/heterostructures and devices, will serve as good references for the related communities. It is also likely to strengthen our research profile and to find international markets and/or collaborations.

523313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
523313.value: 目前大多數損傷檢測技術依賴於整體結構振動或是局部彈性波信號的宏觀特徵改變。但是實際結構中的損傷多誘發于微小的疲勞損傷，而這些微小損傷一般不會引起較為明顯的信號宏觀特徵改變。定量評估微小疲勞損傷是一項具有重大工程意義但是又非常有挑戰性的研究課題。該研究利用由嵌入式主動傳感器網絡所採集到的超聲彈性波非線性特徵，對疲勞損傷進行定量檢測（包括多個疲勞損傷同時存在情況下，每個疲勞損傷所屬區域的位置、以及程度）。基礎研究包括（i）疲勞損傷所誘發超聲彈性波非線性特徵的建模技術；（ii）利用嵌入式主動壓電傳感器網絡採集超聲彈性波非線性特徵的機理及其優化；（iii）超聲彈性波非線性特徵與疲勞裂紋之定量關係。檢測結果將利用圖像加以表徵，便於對待檢結構整體健康狀況一目了然。所涉及的理論研究以及建模技術將利用實驗加以驗證。

523313.label: Realisation of objectives
523313.value: In this project, four objectives have been proposed, and all of them have been well accomplished by end of this project. This research project was proposed based on the recognition that the majority of existing damage detection techniques rely substantially on linear macroscopic changes in either global vibration signatures or local wave scattering; however, real-world structural damage initiates from imperceptible fatigue cracks which may not produce notable linear macroscopic changes. By exploring the extracted nonlinearities of acousto-ultrasonic (AU) waves, a damage characterization approach, in conjunction with the use of a built-in active piezoelectric sensor network, has been established, with the particular capacity of evaluating fatigue damage at a quantitative level (including the co-presence of multiple fatigue cracks, and their individual locations and severity). In order to achieve all these objectives, fundamental investigations were first carried out. This included (i) development of an enhanced modeling technique for delineating the nonlinearities of AU waves incurred by fatigue cracks; (ii) mechanism understanding of using piezoelectric wafers to generate and acquire nonlinearities of AU waves, and optimal selection of PZT wafers for this purpose; and (iii) establishment of the correlations between extracted nonlinearities and characteristic parameters of fatigue cracks. Subsequently, the approach was verified experimentally by evaluating multiple barely visible fatigue cracks in welded engineering structures. In conclusion, all the proposed research objectives have been successfully and fully accomplished. The direct outcome of this research is a damage characterization approach for evaluating fatigue damage quantitatively.

523313.label: Major findings and research outcome
523313.value: Upon completion of this GRF project, a damage characterization approach, in conjunction with the use of a built-in active piezoelectric sensor network, has been established, with the particular capacity of evaluating fatigue damage at a quantitative level (including the co-presence of multiple fatigue cracks, and their individual locations and severity). Compared with existing methods using nonlinearity of AU waves, the proposed approach features innovations including (i) the use of a built-in active sensor network comprising miniaturized sensors, accommodating SHM requirements; (ii) characterization of fatigue damage in a quantitative manner; (iii) applicability for detection of multiple fatigue damage zones; and (iv) visualization of the results in intuitive images. Important findings have been revealed including the interaction mechanism between AU waves and hairline fatigue damage. These findings have led to a number of important, new conclusions. A number of high level publications have been arising from this research project, including 15 papers in top-tier SCI journals, along with another 16 papers in the international conference proceedings (see Part C). Embracing a series of fundamental studies, this proposed project concerns a very interesting and significant research topic in the field of structural health monitoring and damage identification. Thus, this project served as an excellent research topic for a three-year PhD study. Two PhD students have been involved in this project and well trained. The developed approach/system has also attracted great interest from industrial partners, including MTR. The team has organised a series of seminars to introduce the developed technology and real-world applications to relevant companies (e.g., MTR Corporation, Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China, Ltd. (COMAC), high-speed train industry in China), to promote this new technique. The team will continue the promotion of the research achievements arising from this GRF project.

523313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
523313.value: Although all the proposed objectives have been well achieved, the team has also identified some potential directions along which deeper and broader research could be expanded. In particular, (i) the nonlinearity captured extracted from captured AU wave signals was observed extremely weak, and it was prone to measurement noise and uncertainties. This has entailed more effective signal processing methods to efficiently extract desired nonlinearities of AU wave signals. As the research and development of AU-wave-based damage identification is a key research focus in the team, the team will be working on the development of requested signal processing algorithms; and (ii) the use of miniaturized PZT wafers was observed to incur some technical problems in precisely extracting nonlinearities of AU waves due to reasons such as the interference from the adhesive layers. The team is now working on the development of a new kind of sensing devices based on nanocomposites (also under the generous support from RGC), which has potential to circumvent this problem.

523313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
523313.value: Engineering materials experience continuous accumulation of fatigue damage and gradual deterioration over their lifespan. It is of great significance but also a huge challenge to identify small-scale fatigue damage in a timely or real-time manner. Though attempts have been made for more than two decades to use the nonlinear properties of acousto-ultrasonic wave incurred by a fatigue crack, most approaches are at a qualitative level, capable only of indicating the existence of fatigue damage; applications to SHM are fairly hampered due to the use of bulky ultrasonic probes. There is an obvious lack of knowledge and techniques enabling quantitative, rapid and automatic evaluation of fatigue damage. Beginning with a series of fundamental investigations, this completed project has contributed a structural health monitoring (SHM)-oriented damage characterization technique, by exploring the nonlinearities of acousto-ultrasonic waves generated and acquired with a built-in active piezoelectric sensor network. Compared with existing approaches, this new approach has innovations including (i) utilization of a permanently built-in active sensor network, well accommodating SHM; (ii) characterization of fatigue cracks at a quantitative level; (iii) applicability for detection of multiple fatigue cracks; and (iv) intuitive display of identification results in images.

523413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
523413.value: Additive Manufacturing (AM – formerly referred to as Rapid Prototyping) techniques are predominantly used to fabricate prototypes for products produced in high value-added industries and applications including those for aerospace, automotive and biomedical products which require highly complex and customized designs at low volumes which are currently not effectively met by conventional techniques. In recent years, AM has experienced unprecedented development. The improvements and developments in AM techniques in terms of speed, accuracy, material properties, machine reliability and most predominantly the development of low-cost machines has widened the user base for this technology. Direct fabrication using AM technology is only just starting to be used and we can expect a rapid increase in output as we learn how to properly employ this technology as new markets develop. One area that would further enable this is the development of software tools which would allow the designer to incorporate novel features (i.e. undercuts, deep channels, encapsulated features, articulating features) whilst ensuring the resulting behavior is still feasible. Since AM parts are heterogeneous in nature software tools must take into account the nature of these processes. In addition, different processes would require different spacing etc. to ensure the same feature works if made on different AM techniques. In addition, if the required feature property is elastomeric, different geometric parameters relating length and thickness to the material would be required so that they deform in the required manner when applied. All this makes a case for a comprehensive study into the fundamentals of different processes, machines, materials and parameter settings so that a database of functionalities can be constructed. All these topics will be studied and included in the proposed research. 添加劑製造 (Additive Manufacturing 簡稱 AM)技術主要用於製造高價值產品原型應用，領域包括航空航天，汽車和生物醫藥產品。這是需要高度複雜的設計和定制，,而在低生產量的情況下，這是目前用常規技術不能有效地滿足。近年來，經歷了前所未有的發展。 AM技術的改善和發展，在速度，精度，材料的性能，整機的可靠性和低成本機主要是發展這種技術擴大了用戶群。直接製造技術才剛剛開始被使用，我們可以預期產量快速增加，我們學習如何正確地使用這種技術作為新的市場開發。一個區域，將進一步使這是開發的軟件工具允許設計者將新穎的功能，同時確保所產生的行為仍然是可行的。由於AM部分在本質上是異質的軟件工具，必須考慮到這些過程的性質。此外，不同的進程將需要不同的間距，以確保相同的功能。此外，如果所需的功能特性是彈性體，不同的幾何參數有關的長度和厚度的材料會被要求，以便它們應用時所需的方式變形。這一切都需要一個全面的研究，使數據庫的功能可以構造不同的工藝，機器，材料和參數設置的基本面情況。所有這些主題將進行研究，並建議研究。

524213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
524213.value: Video surveillance is getting more popular in recent years, due to its wide applications. It is extremely useful for scene monitoring, suspect detection, special ward monitoring in hospitals, child care, elderly tracking and exceptional detection. Even though the AVS-S standards (Surveillance Video and Audio Coding, or formerly the AVS-S standard) has been available since 2011 and the HEVC-SCE (High Efficiency Video Coding – Scalable Video Coding Extensions) will also be available in 2014, commercial video surveillance systems are always propriety design. This is due to a number of reasons, including privacy, competition and historical reasons. However there is an emerging need to enhance the available technologies such that it can meet ever demanding expectations. The objectives of a video surveillance system include video recording, object detection, tracking and analysis. Usually video signals are coded at the camera site or in a local station and most video signals are coded with hybrid video coding with both motion estimation and transform coding. Hence it is most convenient if we can analyze a scene with such as enlargement capability, and identify and track an object in the transform domain. In this proposal, we mainly work on the DCT domain, and make use of the novel relationship between the transform and spatial domains for algorithm development. We propose novel algorithms for video enlargement in the transform domain making use of non-iterative and iterative Wiener filtering techniques, with an initial pre-interpolation in the spatial domain. The non-iterative techniques are suitable for fast video enlargement for recognition, inspection, tracking and salable video coding in surveillance systems, whilst the iterative techniques are suitable for obtaining high quality enlarged videos which are suitable for some demanding applications, such as hospital and security applications. We will also propose novel ideas on object identification and tracking making use of techniques similar to HoG (Histogram of Oriented Gradient) in the transform domain. The wok should be extremely useful for scalable coding systems and should form a useful investigation for references to current and future surveillance standards development. 由於視頻監控應用廣泛，它在近年變得越來越受歡迎。視頻監控在現場監控，嫌疑人檢測，醫院的特殊病房監控，兒童看護，老人跟蹤以及一些特殊情況的檢測上都非常有用。雖然SVAC標準（安全防範監控數字視音頻編解碼技術標準）自2011年已經可用，並且HEVC-SCE (高效率視頻編碼的可伸縮視頻編碼擴展) 將要在2014年發布，商業的視頻監控系統仍多是專營的設計。原因是多方面的，包括隱私，競爭和歷史關系。然而，為了能滿足不斷增加的需求，現有的視頻監控技術亟待提高。視頻監控系統的目標包括視頻記錄，物體檢測、跟蹤和分析。視頻信號一般在攝像機端或者在本地的基站進行編碼，並且大部分的視頻信號都是通過運動估計和變換域編碼進行混合編碼。因此，如果我們能夠通過在變換域中放大，識別並且跟蹤物體來分析圖片，這將有極大的方便視頻監控的過程。在這個提案中，我們主要在DCT域中進行處理，並且應用變換域和空間域之間的新穎的關系來實現算法開發。我們提出一個先在空間域中進行初始預插值然後通過利用非疊代和疊代的Wiener濾波器來進行視頻放大的新穎算法。非疊代的技術適合在監控系統中快速放大視頻來識別、檢查、跟蹤和可伸縮視頻編碼，而疊代技術適用於高質量的放大的視頻，這些高質量的視頻適合於很多有迫切需求的應用，比如使用於醫院和安全方面的應用。我們也將提出一些物體鑒別和物體跟蹤的新想法，這些方法將應用在變換域中類似於HoG (方向梯度直方圖) 技術。這項研究將在可伸縮編碼系統中極具應用，並且將成為當今和未來監控標準發展的一個非常有用的參考研究。

524213.label: Realisation of objectives
524213.value: 1. To design a trained non-iterative filter set for interpolation ... in the spatial domain. Some good work has been done on the interpolation of image using the FIR Wiener-filter. The work has also been extended from image interpolation to super-resolution image and video. We have initially tried the non-iterative approach, and subsequently tried the iterative approach. The work in this part has been done on the spatial domain. In particular, for image interpolation, we have proposed a single-frame super-resolution algorithm using a finite impulse response (FIR) Wiener-filter, where the correlation matrices are estimated using the nonlocal means filter. The major contribution of this work is to make use of the nonlocal means-based FIR Wiener filter to form a new iterative framework which alternatively updates and improves the estimated correlation and the estimated high-resolution (HR) image. To minimize the mean square errors of the estimated HR image, we have tried to optimize several parameters empirically, including the hyper-parameters of the nonlocal means filter by using an efficient offline training process. Experimental results show that the trained iterative framework performs better than the state-of-the-art algorithms using sparse representations and Gaussian process regression in terms of PSNR and SSIM values on a set of commonly used standard testing images. The proposed framework can be used in image denoising, restoration and scalable video coding. The following papers have been accepted as a result of this work. (Publications: J3, C1 and C6) 2. Hybrid DCT-2D Wiener filter framework for High-Resolution (HR) image/video enlargement. The use of Hybrid DCT-2D Wiener filter framework for High-Resolution (HR) image/video enlargement is a key study of this research work. We have achieved much in this part of the research work. DCT-Wiener image up-sampling scheme is highly desirable since it makes use of the advantages of the information in both spatial and DCT domains. The idea is to combine the observed low-frequency DCT coefficients with the estimated high-frequency DCT coefficients obtained by the Wiener filters in the spatial domain. However, the available 1-D and 2-D Wiener filters that were proposed for high-frequency DCT coefficients estimation are block non-adaptive, mainly due to the limited information from the observed image. We have proposed a block-adaptive Wiener filter by utilizing the information from external training data. During the online estimation, for each image block, the k-nearest relevant DCT LR-HR block pairs are searched from the training data, in order to estimate the coefficients of the Wiener filter. Experimental results show that the proposed block-adaptive Wiener filter improves the PSNR value of the DCT-Wiener scheme by 1.5 dB compared with that using non-adaptive 1-D Wiener filter. This part of the work contributed to the publication of one conference We have proved that the hybrid DCT-Wiener-Based interpolation scheme using the learnt Wiener filter (during the interpolation) can significantly improve both objective and subjective performance. However, it needs a large database and relatively long processing time. We have simplified the process by using multiple learnt Wiener filters and combined the information from both the external training images and the original low-resolution image. The work tries to simplify the DCT domain representation to group simple blocks and makes us of the k-NN MMSE estimation for regression. The scheme requires less computation time. Experimental results show that the proposed dual MMSE estimators achieve around 1dB PSNR improvement compared to the original hybrid DCT-Wiener-Based scheme and provide more natural visual quality. One conference paper has been published as a result of this work. With the above experience on image up-sampling in the discrete cosine transform (DCT) domain which has the advantage of producing de-correlated DCT coefficients, and the use adaptive k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) weighted minimum mean squares error (MMSE) estimation framework, we tried to tackle the problem of making use of these techniques for estimating high-frequency DCT coefficients in the spatial domain in a dictionary form.We proposed a novel scheme making use of the information from pre-computed dictionaries to formulate an adaptive linear MMSE estimator for each DCT block. The scheme is able to estimate high-frequency DCT coefficients with very successful results. Experimental results show that the proposed up-sampling scheme produces the minimal ringing and blocking effects, and significantly better results compared to the state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of PSNR (more than 1 dB), SSIM, and subjective quality measurements. More papers has been published as a result of this part of the investigation. (Publications: J1 and J6, C12 and C17) 3. To extend the above ideas into non-dyadic interpolation. This is a relatively smaller part of the investigation, the objective of which is to enlarge proportionally an image to different sizes, with superior quality. This is particularly attractive for using the DCT doing the enlargement. An initial scheme of padding zeros to the enlarged part is an intuitive approach. The LR image should be interpolated with simple or bicubic interpolation approach in the spatial domain. The enlarged image can then be converted into DCT domain, and the high frequency of this transform domain signal can be used in our hybrid scheme. All techniques in point 2 can be used again in this part of the investigation. Some interesting results have been achieved and a demonstration have been obtained (Publication: C21) 4. To make use of the results in objectives 1 and 2 for video enlargement Video Coding.... For scalable video coding, the enhancement layer can be obtained by getting the difference between the interpolated frame (from the base layer) and the ground true video image. DCT domain residual signals are part of the results of the hybrid video coding, which are in line exactly with the theme of this study. Tests are made to apply the techniques in point 2 to help SVC in the transform (DCT) domain. This is extremely useful for future development video surveillance systems, and our novel techniques have been demonstration in our papers and in our demonstration package. (Publications: J2, J4 and J5, C4-C16) 5. To give an initial study on the identification and tracking of objects ... This is only a small part of the investigation, which involves an initial object identification and then tracking of an object in the temporal domain initially and possibly in the transform domain, an subsequent tracking can be done using the least effort, for on decoding is required and is done in the transform (or DCT) domain. A novel color based generalized Hough transform algorithm which initially generates a similar color map between the prototype object and a test image and uses a novel Large Color Local Binary Pattern (LCLBP) descriptor on the similar color map for feature extraction and object detection has been proposed. This new approach can efficiently capture the local structure of target object on the similar color map. According to the experiment results, the proposed algorithm can provide comparable accuracy with the state-of-the-art Hough algorithm, but ours is 27 times faster. The research work contributes to the publication of one conference as shown below. Initial results have also been obtained, with random forest (a learning approach) on detecting the pattern of motion vectors hence object movements. (Publications: C13)

524213.label: Major findings and research outcome
524213.value: In this work we had initially spent time almost equally on all parts, all with good analysis and remarkable internal reports. Parts 1, 2, and 4 are more academic, hence more papers have been published. Item 3 has been investigated thoroughly using DCT for non-dyadic grids which forms a package for variable sizes interpolation. Item 5 is to be investigated lightly as we said, but it has much industrial value. We are glad to report that results of this investigation produce 4 high quality journal papers and 7 international conference papers. Furthermore, as attached, we have two more journal papers being submitted, and we are also very grateful to report that one GRF proposal has been accepted in 2017 using this project as the starting point and over HK$500,000 has been secured for consultancy work on this subject.

524213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
524213.value: Video surveillance is getting more popular in recent years, due to its wide applications. It is extremely useful for scene monitoring, suspect detection, hospital ward monitoring, child care, elderly tracking and exceptional detection. However there is an emerging need to enhance its quality and speed. A scene can usually be coded by shrinking it to a much smaller size for storage and transmission. Image enlargement is used to resume the image with very little extra bits to obtain the original image quality. Super-resolution is used to enlarge an image for surveillance applications, such as object recognition, tracking and analysis. In this research, we have proposed novel algorithms for video enlargement in both spatial and transform domains, making use of non-iterative and iterative Wiener filtering techniques. We further made use of our novel initiation of using random forests for image interpolation. This creates a new research direction, which gives an image quality comparable, or even better than CNN deep learning approaches, with much faster speed for realization. We have also made use of new HoG (Histogram of Oriented Gradient) design and novel non-local means for formulations. This work should be extremely useful for modern video coding systems and visual surveillance.

524313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
524313.value: 作為一個環保和靈活的運輸方式，步行在最近幾年已越來越被受關注。從2000年開始，香港特區政府運輸署於香港各處實施各種與行人相關的計劃。由於大多數這些與行人相關的計劃/設施都是設置於露天或半露天的地方，惡劣的天氣狀況將直接影響到使用這些計劃/設施的行人的出行行為（如走路的速度和路線選擇等）。因此，為了確保一個可接受的設施服務水平（LOS），在設計行人設施時亦應考慮到惡劣天氣狀況所造成的影響。本項目旨在開發一個能考慮各種惡劣天氣影響之最優行人設施設計框架。 在開發這個最優的設施設計框架時，行人在惡劣天氣下的出行行為是其中一個須要解決的關鍵問題。在這個研究中，天氣條件將被量化為四個指標：降雨量、溫度、風速及風向。本研究將在不同天氣條件和人流情況下（如雙向流動）進行實驗或實地調查以收集不同情況下的人流特徵（如速度，流量等）及路徑選擇行為，收集到的數據將用以建立與天氣指標相關的步行速度與流量關係及路徑選擇行為。基於上述與天氣相關的行人出行行為，本項目將發展在惡劣天氣條件下的行人流動模型，本項目將通過結合動態連續人流模型及分層式路徑選擇策略以解決這個問題。使用分層式路徑選擇模型的原因是因其在模擬行人在惡劣天氣下路徑選擇的靈活性及直接性。上述的動態連續人流模型將制定為一組微分方程式並使用限體積法和快速行進演算法以求解。 本項目將利用動態人流模型以發展出在惡劣天氣下的最優行人設施設計模型。由於天氣條件和行人需求的隨機性，天氣指標和行人需求矩陣將假定遵循一定的分佈（例如正態分佈）。本項目將採用蒙特卡羅模擬法產生不同的天氣和行人需求矩陣從而評價連續人流模型所得到的人流特徵。在這項研究中，行人設施的設計模型將制定為一個約束優化問題，此優化問題將以從連續人流模型所得的預期行人設施表現作目標函數。由於控制變量的幾何特徵（如有蓋行人通道的形狀），本項目將使用一個經改良的水平集方法解決上述的行人設施設計問題。本項目將用模擬和真實案例對所建立的模型進行測試和驗證。儘管本項目有很重的理論成分，項目負責人將與運輸署的從業者合作以確保所提出的模型的可行性和實用性。

524313.label: Realisation of objectives
524313.value: In connection to the revised project objective 1, several image processing techniques were investigated to extract pedestrian flow characteristics from video records. In particular, the Time-Spatial Image (TSI) processing technique was studied and adapted for extraction of pedestrian flow, density, walking speed, etc. in this project (see publication nos. (7) and (10)). Apart from the pedestrian data extracted by TSI processing, Wi-Fi data available from the Wi-Fi devices of pedestrians have also been collected to estimate the walking time and to study the pedestrian behavior. Experiments have been conducted within the campus of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University (see publication nos. (6) and (9)). With a set of data fusion algorithms developed, the activity sequence and travel behavior of pedestrians can be extracted from the Wi-Fi connection records. In addition, controlled experiments were carried out in off-campus site to collect pedestrian flow and speed data under different rainy conditions (see publication nos. (8) and (11)). The data extracted from the video recorded in the controlled experiments were used to calibrate the pedestrian speed-flow relationship and pedestrian flow models as well as to validate the accuracy of the developed TSI system. In relation to the revised project objective 2, the effects of rainfall intensity on pedestrian walking behavior were studied using the observed data collected from the controlled experiments in both no-rain and rain conditions (see publication nos. (8) and (11)). The impacts of rainfall intensity and the effects of holding umbrella on the walking speed reduction are empirically investigated. A generalized pedestrian speed-flow function was proposed and calibrated, taking into account the effects of different rainfall intensities (see publication no. (11)). In addition, pedestrian crossing behavior, especially jaywalking, at signalized crosswalks were examined at seven selected junctions in Hong Kong. The contributory factors of pedestrian jaywalking behavior at signalized crosswalks were identified by various binary logit models (see publication no. (3)). In addition to the normal bi-directional flow of pedestrian movements at signalized crosswalks, pedestrian movements at crowd conditions, such as carnival events, were also studied. Using the pedestrian flow and speed data collected at the Lunar New Year Market in Hong Kong, pedestrian speed-density and flow-density relationships were calibrated by the Bayesian approach (see publication no. (5)). With respect to the revised project objective 3, a cellular automation-based simulation model was developed to investigate the pedestrian walking behavior at signalized crosswalks under rainy condition, such as pedestrians’ lifting or lowering their umbrellas, which resulted in the umbrellas overlapping during the pedestrian crossing process (see publication no. (4)). Another model was also developed to simulate pedestrian route choice decision at signalized crosswalks at microscopic level (see publication no. (1)). This model was formulated in two-tiers. In the first tier, a discrete choice model was proposed to predict the choices of walking direction. In the second tier, an exponential model was calibrated with the step size of the individual pedestrian in the chosen direction. In addition, a dynamic macroscopic network loading model was proposed for modeling the multi-directional congested pedestrian flows (see publication no. (2)). The proposed model explicitly considers anisotropy, i.e. the speed of pedestrians may differ depending on their walking directions. As far as the revised project objective 4 is concerned, two case studies, one in Hong Kong and another in Berlin, Germany, were conducted for testing the performance of the developed macroscopic pedestrian flow model (see publication no. (2)). The results of the case studies show that the consideration of anisotropy significantly improves the accuracy of the proposed model. The proposed two-tier pedestrian route choice decision model was also validated with the use of an independent set of observation data at a selected signalized crosswalk in Hong Kong. The results show that the proposed two-tier model can effectively reproduce the observed routes and destination of pedestrian movements (see publication no. (1)). Regarding the performance of the proposed cellular automation-based simulation model, the simulation results indicate that the proposed model succeeds in reproducing the phenomenon of quick-forming streams at congested signalized crosswalks with consideration of pedestrians’ lifting or lowering their umbrellas, particularly when the pedestrian bi-directional flow is imbalanced (see publication no. (4)). Remark: Prof. SUMALEE Agachai (Professor, Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University) was the Ex-Principal Investigator (PI) of this RGC project. He took the no-pay leave after the commencement of the project and left the University in February 2015. Change of the PI was approved by the RGC on 20 May 2015. The Ex-PI has however continuously contributed to the remaining works of this project and has rejoined the University in April 2016.

524313.label: Major findings and research outcome
524313.value: With regard to the revised project objective 1, controlled experiments were conducted (see publication nos. (8) and (11)) and video records and Wi-Fi data of pedestrians were collected for studying the pedestrian flow characteristics under different weather conditions. TSI approach was adopted to transform the video stream into images for data extraction. It was found that the TSI is quite promising for extraction of pedestrian flow data when the camera height and angle is high and steep (see publications no. (7) and (10)). In addition, with the use of Wi-Fi data, the walking time/speed and the activity patterns of pedestrians can also be estimated (see publication nos. (6) and (9)). In relation to the revised project objective 2, it was reported that, based on the calibrated generalized speed-flow functions, the average walking speeds and the free-flow speeds decrease as rainfall intensity increases. The walking speeds under rainy conditions decrease greater than that in no-rain condition with increasing pedestrian flows (see publication no. (11)). Regarding the pedestrian crossing behavior, it was found that the signal when a pedestrian arrives at the crosswalk is critical for decision making, and the jaywalking of surrounding pedestrians also influences the pedestrian’s decision to cross (see publication no. (3)). The calibrated free-flow walking speed at carnivals was also found to be significantly lower than that at signalized crosswalks in urban area. The walking speed is also less sensitive to changes in pedestrian density (see publication no. (5)). With respect to the revised project objective 3, a simulation model was calibrated to investigate walking behavior at signalized crosswalks under rainy conditions. The simulation results show that rainfall intensity, bi-directional pedestrian flow and flow ratio have various effects on walking speeds (see publication no. (4)). Pedestrian route choice decision at signalized crosswalks were modeled by a two-tier approach. The results indicate that the pedestrians would probably walk along the most desired target direction. However, if conflicting pedestrians were encountered, they would rather give way than move on in a deviated direction. The estimated spacing change between the pedestrians surrounding also influences the choice of walking direction and their walking speeds (see publication no. (1)). Multi-directional congested pedestrian flows were also modeled by a dynamic macroscopic network loading model. The anisotropic specification of the proposed pedestrian network loading model was found to be superior to those based on the traditional fundamental diagrams (see publication no. (2)). In connection to the revised project objective 4, the performance of the proposed pedestrian models has been validated based on the video records collected at the controlled experiments or the selected signalized crosswalks in Hong Kong. The results show that the proposed cellular automation-based simulation model can reproduce the phenomenon of quick-forming pedestrian streams for pedestrians with umbrellas at signalized crosswalks (see publication no. (4)); the proposed two-tier model can effectively reproduce the observed routes and destination of pedestrian movements (see publication no. (1)); and the proposed macroscopic pedestrian flow model can reproduce the observed walking time distributions in congested areas (see publication no. (2)).

524313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
524313.value: In this project, TSI technique was adopted for extraction of pedestrian data from video records, where the cameras are installed at high side. Further investigation is required for capturing the TSI of pedestrian flow characteristics in different angle cameras. In addition, with an increasing use of smartphones and Wi-Fi enable devices, Wi-Fi data becomes a promising data sources for studying pedestrian flow characteristics and activity patterns. Further research can be conducted to develop efficient algorithms for pedestrian activity pattern generation based on multiple sources of data such as Wi-Fi and video data. In the calibration of pedestrian speed-flow relationship, the effects of the proportion of umbrella usage on pedestrian walking behavior are ignored when studying the effects of varied rainfall intensity. The effects of proportion of umbrella usage should be examined in further study. Moreover, the proposed pedestrian models only consider the walking behavior of individual pedestrians. Other pedestrian activities, such as group walking and waiting which would significant influence crowd dynamics, should be considered. Different sizes of crosswalk and traffic controls (both signalized and non-signalized) and different sizes of umbrella should also be considered in the future study so as to investigate empirically their effects on pedestrian walking behavior at crosswalks in various rainfall intensities.

524313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
524313.value: Walking behavior under rainy conditions is very different from that without rain. This research project aims to study the impacts of different weather conditions on pedestrian walking behavior for optimal pedestrian facility design. In particular, signalized crosswalks are essential facilities for both pedestrians and drivers. A better understanding of pedestrian walking characteristics at crosswalks is useful for design of intersections. Thus, in this project, pedestrian flow characteristics were mainly collected at signalized crosswalks. The impacts of rainfall intensity on the reduction of walking speeds have been empirically investigated together with the pedestrian crossing behavior. Several models have been developed to model or simulate the pedestrian walking and route choice behaviors at signalized crosswalks. The output of the research can be used for the planning and design of walking facilities under different weather conditions. This research project provides insights for pedestrian behaviors at signalized crosswalks under different weather conditions. It also provides the framework for the study of pedestrian movements and other pedestrian behaviors under different environment and weather conditions. This can be helpful for development of people-oriented signalized control system and walkable city for Hong Kong.

524513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
524513.value: 在该计划中，我们概述了对SnSexS(2-x)薄膜以及基于SnSexS(2-x)的异质结的研究项目。该研究的动力是该结构在全光谱太阳能电池领域的巨大的应用潜力。该计划的关键目的是:i)对在合算且易弯曲的层状基板上实现高质量的SnSexS(2-x)的范德瓦耳斯外延生长的理论和实验调研，层状基板可以是石墨烯/镍金属薄片和云母片等；ii）SnSexS(2-x))能带带隙工程；iii)基于不同能带带隙的SnSexS(2-x)异质结的制造和量测；和iv) SnSexS(2-x)及基于SnSexS(2-x)的异质结的结构及光电性能量测，并且评估开发基于SnSexS(2-x)的三界面全光谱高转换效率的太阳能电池的潜力。 SnSexS(2-x)是具有层状结构的范德瓦耳斯外延材料。理想状况下，因为非常弱的层间范德瓦耳斯相互作用，基于范德瓦耳斯外延材料的异质结界面可以完全没有界面缺陷。PI的科研组最近在石墨烯/镍金属薄片及云母片等层状基板上生长SnS的实验工作显示了在结晶度方面的戏剧性的提高，具有非常小的振荡曲线半峰全宽。初步结果表明在层状基板上生长范德瓦耳斯材料能极大的促进低界面缺陷态密度的高质量异质结的发展，这对于高转换效率的太阳能电池的制造非常重要。 然而，到目前为止，范德瓦耳斯外延材料的原理性生长机制仍没有被很好的理解，没有这些，将实验延伸到其他材料就变得很困难。在该研究中，我们会实现对层状基板上SnSexS(2-x)的生长机制的第一性原理研究和实验验证。当x从2到0变化时，SnSexS(2-x)的能带带隙会从0.9eV上升到2.2eV，这能促进全光谱太阳能电池的发展。N型和P型的SnSexS(2-x)都会用MBE生长，然后对材料的结晶度和光电性能进行量测。能带带隙计算和材料的掺杂会通过CASTEP编码的第一性原理能带仿真实现。该结果会跟通过共蒸法掺杂原子以及能带带隙工程的实验结果相比较，能带带隙为1.0eV,1.4eV和1.8eV的SnSexS(2-x) 会通过实验生长。这跟三界面全光谱太阳能电池的光学禁带宽度相对应。具有这些能带带隙的异质结的成功生长能够促进全光谱太阳能电池的发展。同样地，会对p+p-n结构进行调研，这能够促进背面电场的建立以及通过提高光生载流子的收集效率来极大的提高短路电流。异质结界面特性也会被详细地测量。 该材料系统与传统的基于GaAs的三界面太阳能电池相比具有很多优势：i) SnSexS(2-x)生长在低成本且易弯曲的基板上，极大地提高它的成本效益；ii)一旦光学条件确定，SnSexS(2-x)的生长可以用一般的蒸镀设备实现。

524513.label: Major findings and research outcome
524513.value: We have performed theoretical (based on interface model) and experimental investigations in the growth of p-type SnSexS(2-x) thin films on mica substrates by molecular beam epitaxy technique. Mica was chosen as the substrate due to its flexibility, ability to withstand high temperature as well as its 2D nature. Excellent 2D layered structure and strong (001) texture were observed with a record low rocking curve full width at half maximum of about 0.101 degree for the SnSexS(2-x)(004) diffraction. The nucleation of SnSexS(2-x) on mica was investigated by the interface model which indicates the co-existence of six pairs of lateral growth orientations and is in excellent agreement with the experimentalΦ-scan measurements indicating 12 peaks separated by 30 degree from each other. To control the lateral growth of the SnS epilayers we investigate the utilization of a thin SnSe buffer layer deposited on the mica substrate prior to the growth of the SnS thin film. The excellent lattice match between SnSe and mica enhances the alignment of the nucleation of SnS and suppresses the minor lateral orientations along the mica[110] direction and its orthogonal axis. Detailed low-frequency noise measurement was performed to characterize the trap density in the films and our results clearly demonstrate substantial reduction in the density of the localized states in the SnSexS(2-x) epilayer with the use of an SnSe buffer layer. We have further improved the quality of SnSexS(2-x) thin films with good crystallinity deposited on two-dimensional (2D) mica substrates. It is believed that the 2D nature of SnSexS(2-x), with strong intralayer covalent bonds and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions, is responsible for its relative insensitivity to lattice mismatch. We also investigated the reduction of Sn vacancies in the material using Sn-compensation technique during the material growth process. The experimental results clearly demonstrated substantial enhancements in the electrical and structural properties for films deposited using Sn-compensation technique. A mobility of 51 cm2 V−1 s−1 and an XRD rocking curve full width at half maximum of 0.07 degree were obtained. Sn-compensated SnSexS(2-x)/GaN:Si heterojunctions were fabricated and significant improvement in both the I-V characteristics and the spectral responsivities of the devices were characterized.

524513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
524513.value: We have successfully demonstrated the growth of high quality SnSexS(2-x) thin films by molecular beam epitaxy technique. Fundamental investigation on the growth mechanism had led to a much better understanding on the factors that affect the film quality of the material. This understanding is crucial to our work on the enhancement of the crystallinity of the SnSexS(2-x) thin films using: i.) a thin layer of SnSe buffer layer; and ii.) Sn compensation technique during growth of SnSexS(2-x) thin films on both mica and n-type GaN substrates. Using this technique we were able to fabricate working photo-detector sensitive up 1 um in wavelength.

524613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
524613.value: Optical fibre sensor technology based on fibre Bragg gratings (FBGs) is perhaps the most versatile sensing system and it possesses many important advantages over electronic sensors. FBG sensors are small, immune to EMI, multi-functional and suitable for the most extremely hostile environments on earth. FBG are intrinsic sensing elements that can be written inside the 9-µm core of standard optical fibres. The optical fibres in FBG sensing networks serve as both the sensing elements as well as the data links and can offer multipoint sensing along a single (common) optical fibre that could be ten’s of kms long. More important, FBGs can be used to measure temperature, strain, pressure, vibration and flow, etc. FBG sensor technology offers a truly integrated system and potentially a low-cost sensing solution for wind turbine monitoring to ensure safety and operation stability, and for the oil and gas industry where there is a demand to measure temperature, pressure and flow to obtain a complete picture of downhole reservoirs. This proposal concerns the development of a novel FBG-based flow sensor that employed laser-heated fibres to measure flow based on convective heat transfer principles. The novel fibre sensor is less than 1-cm long with an FBG written in its 9-µm diameter core. The sensor is a short length of optical fibre, doped with light-absorption materials such as Cobalt, heated by a laser source via an optical fibre and its temperature is determined by the reflection wavelength of the FBG using another light source. Both light sources can be located many kilometers away from the sensor, allowing flow measurement from a long distance – essential for downhole reservoir monitoring. An interesting feature of the sensor is that its sensitivity and response time can be adjusted during operation. The novel flow sensor does not contain any electronics or mechanical parts. The key issues to be addressed in this proposal are firstly to extend the sensor’s measurement range and multiplexing capability. Secondly, to design and fabricate a light-absorption fibre to investigate its use for liquid flow measurement where heat loss is much more rapid than that in air and to study its suitability to measure flow at high temperature to extend the use of the novel sensor in demanding applications such as downhole monitoring where flow measurement at temperature up to 225°C is needed. Finally, the long-term reliability of the FBG written in cobalt-doped fibre will be investigated. 基于光纤光栅（FBGs）的光纤传感技术可能是最具多元化的传感系统，其拥有许多电子传感器所不具有的特性。光纤光栅传感器因其体积小，抗电磁干扰及多功能性的特点而适用于地球上极端的恶劣环境。FBG是一种可以写在9µm纤芯的普通光纤上的内嵌传感单元。组成FBG传感网络的光纤既用作传感的单元也用于数据的传输，同时也可实现沿着几十公里长的单一（普通）光纤进行多点传感。更重要的是，FBG能用来测量温度，应变，压力，振动以及流速等。光纤传感技术提供了一个完整的系统和低成本的传感解决方案，可在风涡轮机监测中确保其安全和操作的稳定性，也可为要求测量温度、压力和流速的油气产业获得完整的井下储藏量图。 该计划旨在开发一种新型的基于FBG的流速传感器，该传感器利用激光加热的光纤通过对流热交换原理来测量流速。由一个写在9µm纤芯的光纤光栅所组成的新型光纤传感器仅有不到1cm长。此传感器是一小段掺有光吸收材料(譬如，钴)的光纤，可以通过导入光纤的激光进行加热，并通过另一光源利用FBG的反射波长来确定其温度。两种光源都可以放置于离传感头几甚至几十公里外的地方，从而允许长距离的流速测量，这对于深井石油储存量的探测是很有必要的。 此传感器的一个有趣的特征是其灵敏度和响应时间是可以在操作的过程中进行调节的。这种新型的流速传感器并不含有任何的电子或者机械部分。 该计划需要特别强调的关键问题，首先是扩展传感器的测量范围和多路复合测量的能力。其次，设计并制备一种光吸收光纤以用于热损耗远快于空气的流体的流速测量，同时研究该新型传感器在测量高温流体流速的可行性，从而满足在深井里测量温度高至225˚C的流体流速的需求。最后，对于位于掺钴光纤里的光纤光栅，其长久的可靠性也会进行探究。

524613.label: Realisation of objectives
524613.value: All objectives were realized and the results were published in 8 technical papers, and 1 US patent was granted. Further theoretical analysis and simulation works were conducted and successfully established the theoretical relationship between the central wavelength of FBG and flow speed of the sensors. The reported theory is based on “hot-wire” anemometer, which is widely used for the electrical flowmeters. In this work, more precise relationship between these two key parameters was derived according to the theories of hot-wire anemometer and the FBG. The mode propagation in the specialty optical fibers used in the research was also simulated using COMSOL, which is based on well-known finite element method. The absorption of Co2+-doped fiber is different at various pump wavelengths, the pumping efficiency was investigated by using two types of pump lasers at the wavelengths of 980 nm and 1450 nm. 980 pump lasers with SMF and MMF pigtails were used, and only 1450 pump laser with SMF pigtail was used in the project. The lasers with SMF pigtailed were used to pump single mode Co2+-doped fiber, whereas lasers with MMF pigtail is for pumping the multimode Co2+-doped fiber that has larger dopant area and has better light-heat conversion efficiency. The highest output power of 980 laser used is up to 6 W, and it is ~1.5 W for 1450 laser. The investigation found that higher output power with larger mode area could heat the sensor up to 200 Celcius degree even placed in hot oil with temperature of 130 Celcius degree. The higher thermal efficiency is, the better sensitivity and resolution can be achieved to measure volume flow rate of up to 30L/min. Novel single mode fiber with Co2+-doped in the cladding was designed and fabricated to increase the light-heat conversion efficiency. To achieve this, a Co2+-doped SMF preform was designed by the PI and fabricated by OptaCore. The experimental results of the flowmeter based on this fiber were not so good due to the small cobalt doped area and dopant clustering. A novel approach using multimode Co2+-doped fiber to realize a high heat capacity flow-rate sensor was successfully developed. The Co2+-doped has a diameter of 50 µm, which is much larger than that (~8 µm) of SMF. The larger doping diameter leads to about 40 times higher dopant area and was successfully used to measure oil flow rate. The preliminary experiments were conducted at PolyU to characterise the sensing performance in terms of sensitivity and thermal efficiency. To study the temperature response, the flowmeters were placed in an oven, which can be heated up to beyond 100 Celcius degree. The flow-rate sensor was also submerged in an oil (water) bath and its temperature response was measured by increasing the temperature of the oil (water). Two types of pump lasers at different wavelengths were used to increase the flowmeter temperature when the flowmeter were placed in oil/water at a certain temperature, to demonstrate the capability of measurement of flow-rate in hot fluids. The measurement of oil flow was conducted in a test rig at TNO, The Netherlands, as proposed in the project. TNO has a very good and complete measurement system for oil/water/brine at large mass flow speed. Several samples of FBGs written Co2+-doped were prepared and kept for long time. Good thermal efficiency was obtained even after over one month. From this perspective, the proposed objectives are completed very successfully. After the preparation of the novel optical fiber flowmeters at PolyU and good preliminary results were achieved, the field test was carried out at TNO. We shipped the flowmeters and the necessary components to TNO, and conducted the test together with the Co-I (i.e. TNO researchers) in one week. The air, oil and water flow were measured during the field test. The setup includes a precise controlling system of the liquid flow and three large containers for water, oil, and brine, which makes it possible to conduct high flow speed. During the test, the mass flow of oil and water was up to 1750 kg/hr. The results of the field test show good repeatability and discrimination for small flow speed. Meanwhile, as a comparison, the actual flow speed was monitored by a commercial electrical flowmeter. As a result, our proposed flowmeter based on “hot-fiber” principle exhibit a good correlation coefficient of 0.9974 compared with the commercial flowmeter, which indicates that the proposed flowmeter function well to measure oil flow rate.
