538213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
538213.value: Last century has seen a steady increase in man's ability to control and manipulate quantum mechanical phenomenon. Numerous technological advances now owe their existence directly or indirectly to quantum mechanical effects. From transistors, lasers, compact disc players, optical fibre communications, magnetic resonance imaging to scanning tunneling microscopes, the quantum technology has effected every aspect of our life. Recent advances in the science of quantum information, has added a new dimension to the applications of control of quantum mechanical phenomenon. There is now an increasing emphasis on harnessing quantum dynamics for the purpose of computing, communications and information storage. All these technologies involve exercising control over quantum mechanical phenomenon, and a central challenge in building scalable quantum information processing devices and the control of quantum mechanical in general is the loss of coherence (decoherence) in system dynamics, due to unwanted couplings to the environment. This issue of decoherence arises in almost all potential implementation of quantum information devices and control of quantum systems in general. Motivated by these problems we propose to develop a mathematical theory of optimal control of quantum networks that minimizes decoherence effects in quantum information processing. In particular, our focus is on optimal control of network of coupled spin-1/2 particles (acting as qubits). The goal of the proposed research is to develop geometric methods for computing fundamental bounds on the controlled evolution in a network of quantum systems and find optimal control laws that achieve these bounds. Our approach is to trace these problems back to the reachability question, e.g., to the question where the system can be steered to at any given time. Such characterization of reachable set will give the physical limits of controlled evolution of quantum systems and provide optimal control strategies achieving these limits. These results will be of theoretical interests to both control theory community and quantum physics community, as well as practical interests to experimentalists working on various quantum systems. The problems that are formulated in addressing the described issues are of independent and fundamental interest. 從上世紀開始人類控制和操縱量子效應的能力穩步上升，眾多的技術進步直接或間接的受益於量子效應，從晶體管，激光，光盤播放器，光纖通信，核磁共振成像，掃描隧道顯微鏡，量子技術的影響已涉及到生活的各個方面。現在諸多領域如核磁共振成像，電子共振光譜， 激光相干控制，固態物理學等領域的進展都依賴於對量子效應的控制。量子信息科學的進展也為量子控制的應用增加了新的維度，現在國際學術界越來越重視利用量子效應來進行信息的處理，傳輸和存儲，而所有這些技術的實現都依賴於對量子系統的精密控制。量子信息處理器件和一般的量子控制系統中最關鍵的問題是退相干導致的信息的損失。退相干是由系統和環境的耦合作用產生，幾乎所有可能實現的量子信息設備都會出現，限制了這些系統的應用。本項目會發展一套量子優化控制理論來最大限度地減少自旋系統的退相干效應，主要在兩個方向：1）針對噪聲的來源和性質不明的情況，發展時間最優的量子控制；2 ）對噪聲的來源和性質了解的情況，發展最小退相干控制。這兩個方向的研究會在對量子系統可達集刻畫的統一框架下進行。

538213.label: Realisation of objectives
538213.value: We developed geometrical control methods to characterize the reachable sets for both the single and multiple coupled spin system, which addressed the theoretical objectives(1,2,3). To ease the characterization of multiple spin system, we also developed tools to characterize the quantum correlations among the spins. These developed methods can be used to obtain optimal controls for steering the spin systems. For the application, we have used these tools to obtain the optimal controls for the parameter estimation of the spin system, the polarization transfer of the spin system as well as time optimal generations of quantum gates on multiple spins system. These optimal protocols have been experimentally implemented to realize Objective 4.

538213.label: Major findings and research outcome
538213.value: By combining the controls on the single spin system and the multiple spins with the developed methods, we are able to improve the coherence time of multiple spins systems by a few orders, the result is published as a journal paper: Haidong Yuan, Van D. M. Koroleva and Navin Khaneja, “Reduced coupling with global pulses in quantum registers”, New J. Phys. 16, 105013(2014). The developed methods have also been used for the efficient synthesis of quantum gates on spin system (Haidong Yuan, Daxiu Wei,Yajuan Zhang, Steffen Glaser and Navin Khaneja, “Efficient synthesis of quantum gates on indirectly coupled spins”, Phys. Rev. A 89, 042315, 2014), and the optimal polarization transfer of spin system (Phys. Rev. A 92, 053414, 2015). We also developed methods to ease the characterization of the quantum correlations in the spin system, which are summarized in a few published papers: New Journal of Physics 17 (9), 093007; Physical Review A 94 (2), 022110; Physical Review A 94 (4), 042325. In particular, the developed methods have been used to obtain the optimal controls for the parameter estimation of the quantum system, which has helped to improve the precision limits in quantum metrology. These have resulted in several papers: Physical review letters 115 (11), 110401; Physical review letters 117 (16), 160801; Physical Review A 96 (1), 012310;Physical Review A 96 (1), 012117;Physical Review A 96 (4), 042114;New Journal of Physics 19 (6), 063023.

538213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
538213.value: The developed methods can be applied to various other quantum technologies, such as quantum computing and quantum communication, which can be explored in future researches.

538213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
538213.value: In the project, we have developed systematic methods to characterize the limits of controlling the spin system, which can be used to obtain the optimal controls for various applications. These optimal controls have been used to improve the polarization transfer of the spin system, reduce the time of building quantum gates, and increase the measurement precision for metrology.

538613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
538613.value: 目前香港的飲用水主要依賴東江輸水，然而珠三角地區的用水需求不斷增加，因此我們需要加強香港的供水及產水能力，以確保下一代能享有可持續使用及可靠的水資源。從道路及其他不透水表面收集的雨水是城市景觀中可利用的水資源，或可替代飲用水以用作沖廁，工業冷卻和綠地灌溉等。生物滯留池可從源頭收集及處理雨水，是一種依靠自然的被動處理技術。其中，除了小部分雨水通過蒸騰作用返回大氣，其餘大部分可被收集和儲存起來，最終用於非飲用用途。生物滯留池內的土壤過濾層，可以對所收集的雨水進行物理化學處理（吸附和過濾），處理過程毋需添加化學品，並且對能源及維護的需求很少。 雖然雨水回收利用的概念越來越多被應用於城市建設，但是有關雨水中有毒金屬和致病細菌的轉化過程的資訊卻十分有限。在亞熱帶城市地區中，生物滯留池或需要處理較高的流量，並且處理後雨水中所含重金屬和細菌濃度需要非常低，以滿足非飲用用途的要求。對淡水供應潛在污染的擔憂為回收利用雨水帶來重大挑戰。因此，有必要研究生物滯留池是否可以及如何去除水中污染物。此外，雨季初期的高污染物濃度，以及降雨日之間生物滯留池的乾濕循環可能會增加雨水處理過程中的不確定性。此研究目的是通過在不同條件下進行實驗室規模的土壤柱實驗，促進對重金屬和細菌在生物滯留池內遷移轉化現象的基本理解。數學遷移模型將用於預測生物滯留池的效用和衡量其成果。相關結果將會通過試驗台規模的生物滯留池進行驗證和修訂。此項目將有助於識別和解決雨水收集過程中的污染問題，並改善工程設計以開展可持續城市水管理的新策略。

538613.label: Realisation of objectives
538613.value: Low impact development (LID) systems are increasingly used to manage stormwater, but they have limited capacity to treat stormwater—a resource to supplement existing water supply in water-stressed urban areas. To enhance their pollutant removal capacity, infiltration-based LID systems can be augmented with natural or engineered geomedia that meet the following criteria: they should be economical, readily available, and have capacity to remove a wide range of stormwater pollutants in conditions expected during intermittent infiltration of stormwater. Biochar, a carbonaceous porous co-product of waste biomass pyrolysis/gasification, meets all these criteria. Biochar can adsorb pollutants, improve water-retention capacity of soil, retain and slowly release nutrients for plant uptake, and help sustain microbiota in soil and plants atop; all these attributes could help improve removal of contaminants in stormwater treatment systems. This project discusses contaminant removal mechanisms by biochar, summarizes specific biochar properties that enhance targeted contaminants removal from stormwater, and identifies challenges and opportunities to retrofit biochar in LID to optimize stormwater treatment. Bioretention systems have been recommended as one of the best management practices for low impact development for water recycling/reuse systems. Although improvement of the stormwater quality has been reported regarding pollutants eliminations such as suspended solids and heavy metals, a substantial removal of indicator bacteria is required for possible non-potable reuse. This study investigated the efficiency of wood biochar with H2SO4-, H3PO4-, KOH-, and amino-modifications for E. coli removal from synthetic stormwater under intermittent flow. The H2SO4-modified biochar showed a specific surface area of 234.7 m2 g−1 (approximately double the area of original biochar), whereas a substantial reduction in surface area was found with amino-modified biochar. The E. coli removal (initial concentration of 0.3–3.2 × 106 CFU mL−1) by modified biochars as filter media was very promising with, for example, over 98% removal efficiency in the first 20 pore volumes of stormwater infiltration and over 92% removal by the end of the second infiltration cycle. Only a small portion of E. coli attached on the modified biochars (<0.3%, except KOH- and amino-modified biochars) was remobilized during the drainage phase of intermittent flow. The high removal capacity and stability against drainage were attributed to the high surface area, porous structure, and surface characteristics (e.g. hydrophobicity and O-containing functional groups) of the biochars. Thus, the H2SO4-modified biochar appeared to give the best treatment performance. Moreover, the mobilization of As(V) and Se(VI) in wastewater and selected soils from different locations were investigated using column experiments and synthetic wastewater whose quality was representative of waters arising at different times after well creation. Temporal effects of wastewater on metal/metalloid transport and sorption/desorption were investigated by using HYDRUS-1D transport modelling. Rapid breakthrough and long tailings of As(V) and Se(VI) transport were observed in Day 1 and Day 14 solutions, but were reduced in Day 90 solution probably due to the elevated ionic strength. The influence of wastewater on the hydrogeological conditions (i.e., change between equilibrium and non-equilibrium transport) was evidenced by the change of tracer breakthrough curves before and after the leaching of wastewater. This possibly resulted from the sorption of polyacrylamide (PAM (-CH2CHCONH2-)n) onto soil surfaces, through its use as a friction reducer in fracturing solutions. The sorption was found to be reversible in this study. Minimal amounts of sorbed As(V) were desorbed whereas the majority of sorbed Se(VI) was readily leached out, to an extent which varied with the composition of the wastewater. These results showed that the mobilization of As(V) and Se(VI) in soil largely depended on the solution pH and ionic strength. Understanding the differences in metal/metalloid transport in wastewater is important for proper risk management. In addition, this project investigated the potential impact of wastewater on four representative soils in different locations. The effects of solution composition of wastewater on soil ecosystem were assessed in terms of metal mobility and bioaccessibility, as well as biological endpoints using Microtox bioassay (Vibrio fischeri) and enzyme activity tests. After one-month artificial aging of the soils with various wastewater solutions, the mobility and bioaccessibility of As(V) and Se(VI) decreased as the ionic strength of the wastewater solutions increased. The results inferred a stronger binding affinity of As(V) and Se(VI) with the soils. Nevertheless, the soil toxicity to Vibrio fischeri only presented a moderate increase after aging, while dehydrogenase and phosphomonoesterase activities were significantly suppressed with increasing ionic strength of wastewater solutions. On the contrary, polyacrylamide in the wastewater solutions led to higher dehydrogenase activity. These results indicated that soil enzyme activities were sensitive to the composition of wastewater solutions. Therefore, holistic assessment of engineering designs and environmental implications of LID (i.e., SuDS) is required in the future, for which pilot-scale trials based on the findings of this RGC project are subsequently funded by ECF (~$2.5M for 2.5 years in 2018-2020).

538613.label: Major findings and research outcome
538613.value: As summarized in Part C, 8 SCI journal papers (of which 7 are considered Top 10% by CiteScore) and 2 book chapters have been produced by this project. In order to safeguard the water security and resilience for sustainable development, there is an imminent need to develop blue-green infrastructures to cater for the environmentally friendly drainage networks for New Development Areas (NDAs) in Hong Kong. This project conducted bench-scale study to verify the feasibility and evaluate the performance of bioretention system, a simple and passive measure for surface runoff treatment and flow attenuation, for stormwater harvesting in NDAs for non-potable reuse. In view of the insufficient contaminants removal in typical bioretention systems, an engineered filter media mixed with biochar and/or food waste compost was developed to improve the harvested stormwater quality to the local authority standards and provide additional removal capacity of bacteria, heavy metals, and herbicides. These findings will provide valuable information for establishing pilot-scale/full-scale investigations and unprecedented local technical guideline for design and operation of sustainable drainage system in the future.

538613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
538613.value: In order to safeguard the water security and resilience for sustainable development, there is an imminent need to develop blue-green infrastructures to cater for the environmentally friendly drainage networks for New Development Areas (NDAs) in Hong Kong. This project evaluated the feasibility of blue-green infrastructure (e.g., biofiltration basin) for sustainable surface water management and the performance of bioretention system in the local context. This project investigated the mechanisms of contaminants removal (bacteria and heavy metals) in the laboratory-scale bioretention cell, which provided a solid and scientific foundation for future pilot-scale/field-scale projects. The field-relevant findings of our project will be expected to deliver indispensable information for facilitating the future design and operation of blue-green infrastructures in forthcoming new town developments in Hong Kong.

538813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
538813.value: 本項目主要研究目的是開發研制新一代應用於插電式混合動力電動汽車（PHEV）的電氣能量分配式電動無級變速系統（E-CVT）。統計數據表明，人為的全球變暖主要是由礦物燃料的過度使用，兩項措施可以減緩這一過程。其一是，在全球範圍內減少煤炭，石油，天然氣等燃料的消耗，以降低二氧化碳排放。另一種方法是提高能量轉換效率。 PHEV可以方便地由電網充電，能量轉換效率高。而功率分配傳輸系統即E-CVT是PHEV的核心技術。這個項目旨在探討E-CVT系統的先進技術，提高能源轉換效率以及促進混合動力汽車節能環保技術的發展。 E - CVT最先由豐田Pruis混合動力汽車引入市場（圖1）。E-CVT通常是由一個行星齒輪和兩個電機構成。如何避免機械故障，簡化結構設計，控制能量分配，是E-CVT迫切需要解決的問題。在本項目中，無齒輪無刷的雙饋雙轉子永磁電機（ DFDR - PM ）的提出，将成功解决上述问题，并實現能量的合併與分配（圖2）。 DFDR永磁電機是一個新型電力驅動的概念，它具有結構緊湊的優點，轉矩密度高，在寬的運行範圍內有均衡和高效的能量輸出的优点。本設計的優點顯著，主要总结为：首先，結構緊湊。兩套繞組都裝在一個定子上和並連接外部能量存儲系統，兩個轉子都集成在一臺永磁電機內，並連接到發動機和最終連接驅動PHEV的車輪。其次，巧妙地採用磁通調制作用，實現連續可調變速比，提高了控制的靈活性。最後，雙機械端口和雙電氣端口，特別適用於功率分配式E-CVT系統。 DFDR永磁電機進行設計，以滿足以下要求：轉矩（ 0-50NM ） ，轉速（~4000rpm） ，重量（<15kg） ，體積（<6000cm3） ，效率（90-92 ％） ，成本（< $ 1000/臺 ） 。本項目設計目標包括針對轉子設計（高可靠性的轉子結構，優化的磁路設計，鐵心損耗最小化） ，定子設計（最佳齒槽設計結構） ，以及先進的能源管理優化策略的研究。

538813.label: Realisation of objectives
538813.value: 1) A totally new brushless and gearless DFDR-PM machine for E-CVT system has been proposed, analyzed and simulated, which is compact, has improved torque density and high efficiency over a wide operational region. The topology of the gearless DFDR-PM machine is totally a revolutionary new idea presented by the PI. The relationships between internal physical quantities and design parameters of the DFDR-PM machine have been analyzed through the flux-modulating principle. This principle also provided the design guideline for three potential designs of machines.This machine is based on the magnetic flux modulation to operate at higher harmonic working component instead of fundamental one. The operating principle and basic theory which relies on the flux-modulating principle have been be fully developed and published in several journal papers. 2) Develop potential topologies of DFDR-PM machine and use FEM and global optimization coupled method to optimize the structures and performance of these machines. Improved FEM program package has been developed to simulate two rotors integrated in one machine and operating at different speed ratios. Two stator windings could be directly or indirectly coupled with external control circuits. This machine is efficiently operated at generator/motor motor/motor generator/generator modes. During idling, the excrescent power from engine is absorbed through primary winding and stored in battery. During downhill or braking, a portion of the mechanical power from wheels will be converted into electrical power through secondary winding and stored in battery. During uphill or acceleration, the battery can be discharged to provide additional energy to drive the driveline. 3) Construct and test the prototype to verify the design concept against FEM simulation results. A 2 kW, 800 rpm prototype DFDR-PM machine has been designed and fabricated. The mechanical structures of three machines has be extensively investigated. The concept of machine has been fully verified by prototyping and rigorous experiment.

538813.label: Major findings and research outcome
538813.value: Magnetic gear based flux-modulating effect can explain the operation of machine . The harmonic distributions and spectra of magnetic fields are especially important to improve torque performance of machine [C8.1,2,6,7]. Radial flux structure with two consequent pole rotors and axial flux structure with two disk type consequent pole rotors, as well as an innovative axial and radial flux coupled sandwich design can realize the E-CVT function in hybrid electric vehicles. The main merit of this design is that the radial flux and axial flux hybrid PM machine windings can be independently designed and continuously controlled. The magnets are innovatively arranged in a flux-concentration configuration to provide radial and axial magnetic excitations that interact with both stator windings as well as improving the torque density [C8.5]. These machines are designed with different rotating speed ratios, with different topologies, with different combinations of poles and slots. Four different magnetization patterns of permanent magnets (PMs) are considered and quantitatively compared in terms of the torque and torque ripple problem. Calculation results obtained using finite-element analysis demonstrate that with exactly the same usage of magnets and copper windings, the proposed machine with fewer rotor poles can offer significantly higher electromagnetic torque than that with fewer stator poles, and the torque ripple of the proposed machine with fewer rotor poles is lower than that with fewer stator poles. Another finding is that proposed machines can offer satisfactorily high-torque capability only when the two sets of PMs are with the same magnetization directions. [C8.3] Optimal method coupled with FEM method are used to reduce the computation time and minimize numerical error. Optimal design method can be used to find the optimized parameters of machine. The control strategy of the DFDR-PM machine has been developed basing on the highest operating efficiency at different speeds and in different control modes.

538813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
538813.value: With the advent of high-temperature superconducting (HTS) materials, increasing attention is given to HTS machines, which have good application potentials in large wind turbine systems. In future, HTS material based E-CVT machines can be designed with much more compact than conventional machines, by virtue of the large excitation current and high efficiency of the former, because the losses in the superconducting wires are virtually zero. E-CVT based energy split system can also be extended to wind power system, with the flexibly controllable excitation current, the generator can have a constant voltage output when the wind speed varies. The dual rotor and two set of windings are unique for the design of electric machine. This application should be a potential research direction.

538813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
538813.value: E-CVT is firstly introduced into the market by the Toyota HEV. It is usually comprised of one planetary gear and two electric machines. How to avoid the mechanical problem, simplify the design, improve the control of power-split transmission are urgent problems to be solved. In this project, a brushless and gearless double-fed dual-rotor permanent magnet (DFDR-PM) machine has been proposed to realize power efficient combination and split in PHEV. DFDR-PM machine is an innovation electric drive concept. This machine has the merit of compact structure, improved torque density, a balanced and high energy efficiency contour over a wide operational region. The advantages of this proposed design are salient. Firstly, structure is compact. Two sets of windings are housed in one stator and connected to external energy storage systems, and two rotors are integrated in one machine and linked to the engine and final wheels of PHEV respectively. Secondly, this machine ingeniously employs magnetic flux modulating effect to achieve continuously changeable speed ratios, improved control flexibility. Finally, two mechanical ports and two electrical ports and compact structure benefit this machine to be especially suitable for power-split E-CVT system in PHEV.

538913.label: Project Objectives
538913.value: Model a botnet’s capability of evading the detection based on two types of traffic anomalies in different scenarios. We will propose novel evasion algorithms against detection systems relying on (a) traffic similarity among bots; (b) traffic dissimilarity between bots and normal applications. Depending on a botnet’s knowledge of a defender’s detection method and a defender’s awareness of a botnet’s evasion strategy, we will consider six scenarios listed in Tab. 1 when devising those algorithms. Furthermore, we will design and implement BotCloak, an application-independent traffic manipulation system comprising those evasion algorithms. We will use BotCloak to evaluate ten representative botnet detection systems. Propose new methodologies to throttle botnets intending to evade the detection and characterize the competitive interaction between a botnet and a detection system. We will devise new strategies to force botnets to change their traffic on the cost of high implementation complexity and low utility. We will implement such strategies into BotScope, a new network-based detection system, and evaluate it using BotCloak and real botnet traffic. Moreover, we will model the interaction between a botnet and a detection system as Stackelberg games and investigate the equilibrium. Devise novel traffic watermarks to locate botnets’ hidden servers and investigate the games between a botnet and a trace-back system. We will design original traffic watermarks tailored for tracing a botnet’s hidden servers. They could tolerate the effect of network noise and circumvent botnets’ detection. We will realize them into BotXRay, a new traffic watermarking system for botnet trace-back, and tackle several challenging issues raised in the deployment of such system. Moreover, we will investigate the Stackelberg equilibrium in the games between a botnet and a trace-back system. We will keep looking for botnets using fast-flux network and proxies and employ BotXRay to locate their hidden servers.

538913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
538913.value: 僵尸网络利用互联网上被控制的机器来进行各种恶意行为。Symantec报道去年81.2%的垃圾邮件来自僵尸网络。臭名昭著的僵尸网络Zeus及其变种从上百万受害者处偷窃商业信息。不断涌现的移动僵尸网络更是收集用户的私人信息并通过收费短信和电话来获利。香港也不能幸免。最近，McAfee报道香港是亚太的确排名第4的包含恶意网站的地区，这些恶意网站常用于感染用户并使它们成为僵尸网络的一份子。Microsoft也发现了Zeus僵尸网络在香港的主要服务器。与此同时，香港电脑保安事故协调中心将摧毁僵尸网络作为其发展计划的首要任务。 虽然近年不少僵尸网络防御系统被提出，但新的僵尸网络还是不断涌现。这个局面是由两个悬而未决的问题导致的：（1）如何检测不断演变的僵尸网络？；（2）如何定位僵尸网络的主要服务器来摧毁它们？虽然近来有研究来尝试解决这两个问题，但它们还远未被解决因为现在的方案在设计的时候很少详细地考虑僵尸网络的逃逸策略。例如，现在的检测系统依赖从已知或相似僵尸网络中提取特征或者异常，但僵尸网络可以利用加密来防止特征匹配并通过改变网络行为来消除异常。另外，现在僵尸网络跟踪系统只考虑可以访问到的僵尸网络的服务器，但僵尸网络可以利用代理来隐藏主要的服务器。虽然，有些系统讨论了僵尸网络可能的逃避策略和对应的策略，但据我们所了解，尚未有对它们的系统研究。 在这个项目中，我们从对抗性流量分析的角度来尝试解决这两个问题。对于检测问题 ，我们首先分析僵尸网络可能的逃避策略，其次设计新的防御方法来限制它们。对于追踪问题，我们首先研究僵尸网络在使用代理时在鲁棒性和可用性间的取舍，然后设计一种新的、鲁棒以及不容易检测的网络水印来追中僵尸网络的隐蔽服务器。对上述两个问题，我们都将对僵尸网络和防御者之间的竞争关系建模成Stackelberg博弈并研究其平衡解。 这个项目将对僵尸网络的检测和追踪提供理论支持和实用的系统。这个研究将获得对僵尸网络的逃逸策略和抑制方法更深入的理解。新的网络水印将更有效的追踪僵尸网络。博弈理论将助我们更加理解攻防双方将会采用的最优策略。除了包含真实僵尸网络的网络行为的数据集，本项目还将实现三个系统：（1）BotCloak，一个通过改变网络行为来评价现有网络检测方法的系统；（2）BotScope，一个新的基于网络行为的僵尸网络检测系统；（3）BotXRay，一个新的网络水印系统来追踪僵尸网络的隐蔽服务器。

538913.label: Realisation of objectives
538913.value: We have realized the three objectives. 1. Model a botnet’s capability of evading the detection based on two kinds of traffic anomalies under six scenarios. We have proposed new evasion algorithms against the detection based on flow similarity. These algorithms introduce randomness into network traffic based on data complexity metrics. The corresponding paper is being revised according to the comments and will be submitted for publication. We have also designed a new DNS-based covert channel that exploits the combinations of items to deliver information and evade the detection. This work involved two undergraduate students. We have proposed new evasion algorithms against the detection relied on flow dissimilarity. These algorithms make the flow similar to that of legitimate applications. More precisely, we proposed exploiting the message push services for the communications of mobile botnet to evade the detection, and published a paper, entitled “MUSE: Towards Robust and Stealthy Mobile Botnets via Multiple Message Push Services”, in ACISP’16. We further extended this approach by leveraging ubiquitous cloud services to circumvent the detection, and published a paper, entitled “CloudBot: Advanced mobile botnets using ubiquitous cloud technologies”, in Elsevier Pervasive and Mobile Computing. Furthermore, we proposed a novel approach that exploits the emerging IFTTT services to bypass the detection, and published a paper, entitled “AutoFlowLeaker: Circumventing Web Censorship through Automation Services” in SRDS’17. We designed the traffic manipulation tool (i.e., BotCloak) for most Linux platforms so that we could also investigate the emerging mobile botnets, most of which target on Android. In particular, we developed a kernel module named kTRxer for manipulating and generating traffic, and base BotCloak on top of it. The paper on kTRxer appeared in IWQoS'14. Moreover, we have constructed a test-bed for testing our tools and evaluating whether various botnet detection systems can be circumvented. The experimental results showed that the traffic manipulated by our tool could evade these detection systems. 2. Propose new approaches to throttle botnets intending to evade the detection and model the competitive interaction between a botnet and a detection system. We have explored the design space of network traffic features for increasing a botnet’s evasion cost and limiting its utility. In particular, we analyzed the traffic from both botnet and legitimate applications for designing detection and defense mechanisms. By examining network traffic features of P2P botnets and P2P applications, we proposed a new detection system against P2P botnets and published the paper, entitled “Building a Scalable System for Stealthy P2P-Botnet Detection”, in IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security(TIFS). Moreover, we have investigated application-layer network traffic of malicious activities, because bot master makes profits by instructing bots to conduct malicious activities (e.g., DDoS attacks), and published two papers in TIFS, including “SkyShield: A Sketch-Based Defense System Against Application Layer DDoS Attacks” and “Modeling the Vulnerability of Feedback-Control Based Internet Services to Low-Rate DoS Attacks”. Moreover, we analyze and model the network traffic from legitimate applications, and published four papers, including “Can We Learn What People Are Doing from Raw DNS Queries?” in INFOCOM’18, “Is What You Measure What You Expect? Factors Affecting Smartphone-Based Mobile Network Measurement” in INFOCOM’17, “I Know Where You All Are! Exploiting Mobile Social Apps for Large-Scale Location Privacy Probing” in ACISP’16, and “Characterizing mobile ∗-box applications” in Elsevier Computer Networks. Knowing the features of the traffic from both botnet and legitimate applications is critical to design effective detection mechanisms. Besides examining network traffic features, we have investigated how to improve the detection algorithm. For example, we proposed a multi-view based approach to reduce false alarms of detection methods, which leverages semi-supervised learning algorithm to construct two-view items and automatically exploit both labeled and unlabeled data. We also designed new detection approach based on ensemble algorithms, which combine the results from a set of detection algorithms for achieving better performance. Based on the results from objective 1 and 2, we have examined how to model the competitive interaction between a botnet and a botnet detection system as Stackelberg games. Since the feature space is huge for general botnets and detection methods, it is very difficult to find the equilibrium. Therefore, we focused on modeling the competitive interaction between the link flooding attacks launched by botnets and the corresponding detection methods as Stackelberg games, and employed a series of techniques to find the equilibrium. The corresponding paper, entitled “Randomized Security Patrolling for Link Flooding Attack Detection” is under review by IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing(TDSC). Moreover, by further investigating the detection approaches based on ensemble algorithms, we found that bot master could evade these detection approaches by cheating one algorithm within the ensemble. The corresponding paper has been submitted to CCS’18. During the analysis, we observed that besides network traffic features, detection system should also employ features related to program and system. Therefore, we spent time in building systems for analyzing malicious apps that try to compromise smartphones and turn them into mobile bots, and published several papers on the analysis in IEEE Micro Magazine, IEEE Computer, DSN'14, ACSAC'14, and IWQoS'15. 3. Invent novel traffic watermarks to locate botnets’ hidden servers and characterize the competitive interaction between a botnet and a trace-back system. We have proposed new traffic watermarks that employ error correcting code and leverage inter-flow features to trace a botnet’s hidden servers behind proxies. We found that using error correcting code could improve the robustness of traffic watermarks so that the impact of traffic watermarks on original traffic could be reduced and the watermarks could be distributed to several flows. Consequently, the stealthiness of traffic watermarks also increases. The corresponding paper is under preparation. We have also designed a new algorithm to detect proxies and collect their information. Besides using the connection steps to determine common proxies, our algorithm further exploits the congestion control mechanism of TCP and the round-trip-time(RTT) patterns to infer transparent proxies. Moreover, we proposed a new server-side non-cooperative measurement method, which is deployed in the server side and could also be employed to detect proxy. The paper on the new measurement method appeared in IEEE ICNP'14. To investigate how to deploy the decoder of traffic watermarks, we have analyzed network topology and BGP routes. The paper on selecting and monitoring critical links, which may be the target of DoS attacks launched by botnets, appeared in USENIX LISA'14. Such links are also potential places for accommodating decoders. We have further extended this work by proposing more traffic metrics and improving the detection algorithms, and published a paper entitled “LinkScope: Toward Detecting Target Link Flooding Attacks” in TIFS. When studying BGP data, we noticed that some links are not stable and thus the network topology should be modeled as a probabilistic graph, which needs new algorithms to examine its features. We formally define the possible-shortest-paths-based betweenness centrality for probabilistic graphs and design new algorithms to estimate the betweenness centrality. The corresponding paper, entitled “Towards Efficient Betweenness Centrality Estimation of Uncertain Graphs based on Possible Shortest Paths”, is under review by Elsevier Information Sciences. Using the techniques in our TDSC paper submission, we model the interaction between a botnet and a trace-back system in the ideal situation as Stackelberg games and examine the equilibrium.

538913.label: Major findings and research outcome
538913.value: We found that advanced botnets can evade the existing detection mechanisms based on flow similarity or flow dissimilarity. In particular, botnets can either inject randomness into their network traffic according to the data complexity metrics or exploit application-layer protocols to construct network covert channels for circumventing the detection. The former intends to maximize the intrinsic indistinguishability of the manipulated network traffic while the latter exploits various public services to impede traffic tracing and change traffic patterns. To throttle botnets intending to evade the detection, we found that it is important to strategically select features that can increase a botnet’s evasion cost and limit its utility. The former forces the botnet to spend great efforts in making its traffic very similar to that of legitimate applications while the latter limits the type and the frequency of malicious activities that can be performed by the botnet to make profit. To achieve this purpose, security researchers should carefully investigate the traffic from both legitimate applications and malicious activities for extracting important features and associate these features with semantic information, which could be obtained by analyzing the executable files of legitimate applications and bots. Moreover, our research suggested that in the ideal situation certain attacks (e.g., DDoS attacks) launched by a botnet and the corresponding detection methods may reach the equilibrium in a Stackelberg game. Traffic watermarks are useful for tracing the network traffic from bots to the botnet’s hidden servers. We found that using error correcting code can improve the robustness and stealthiness of traffic watermarks and exploiting the congestion control mechanism in TCP and RTT patterns can detect transparent proxies. Moreover, we suggested using traffic watermarks to locate the stepping stones employed by the bot master one by one, because the botnet may adopt various approaches (e.g., change traffic patterns, etc) in the stepping stones to remove the traffic watermarks at the cost of high implementation and deployment effort and low utility. In this project, we have published 8 journal papers and 11 conferences papers. Two journal papers and one conference paper are under review. Two papers are under preparation and will be submitted later. We trained one Ph.D. student, two M.Sc. students, and several undergraduate students. Moreover, we have been collaborating with the researchers in a number of Universities on this research.

538913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
538913.value: Since the massive success of app economy and the rapid growth of smartphone penetration pose lucrative and profitable targets for attackers, one direction for further development of this research is to leverage the information from network traffic and app behaviors to discover mobile botnets. In particular, we could combine both host-centric investigation, which uses various static bytecode analysis, dynamic behavior analysis and traffic analysis to identify suspicious mobile malware, and network-centric inspection, which employs traffic anomalies to detect mobile malware and determines their signatures from a large volume of network traffic of many mobile devices, for achieving this purpose. Another direction for further development of this research is to design and test machine learning algorithms that are robust to various attacks. Recent research demonstrated that software based on Deep Neural Networks (DNN) may result in unexpected behaviors and dangerous consequences due to manipulated input. How to design robust machine learning algorithms is still an open problem attracting great attention. A possible alternative approach is to leverage software testing and program analysis methods to locate the code responsible for those unexpected behaviors and identify the root cause.

538913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
538913.value: Botnet keeps plaguing the Internet by instructing enormous compromised hosts to carry out various malicious activities. Our research enabled a deep understanding of botnets’ capability of evading the detection and preventing the trace-back along with the corresponding costs. It revealed that existing detection approaches can be circumvented by botnets that can arbitrarily change their traffic patterns and make advantage of various public online services. This project also led to new approaches to thwart advanced botnets by detecting compromised hosts and locating the stealthy servers. The principle behind these new approaches is to significantly increase a botnet’s evasion cost and limit its capability of making profit. Our findings are expected to stir more research efforts into botnet defense and have ramification in a potentially broad range of areas, such as intrusion detection, network privacy and anonymity, traffic classification, etc.

539013.value: 由於再生能源和分佈式發電系統的逐漸普及，採取傳統的中央能源管理模式也隨之變得不合時宜。因此，未來的分佈式發電系統需具備高級的智能系統，通過與同類系統之間的互動及協調，實現自動化的能源管理。本研究項目的主要目的為建立一個具備上述自動化能源管理能力的微型分佈式發電系統。在所述系統中，再生能源、直流-直流變換器、逆變器彼此之間透過直流母線和交流母線實行信息傳輸和進行能源控制，從而擺脫使用普遍被視為不可靠的通訊裝備的需要。爲了達到這個目的，本項目所要建立的系統包括三個不同層次的Droop控制（有差調節）方法。第一層為傳統的P/f和Q/E控制，目的是讓並聯在同一交流母線上的多個逆變器可以透過調節頻率和幅值的微差進行功率分配。第二層和第三層控制為本項目所提出。第二層控制透過檢測直流母線上的電壓來調節第一層控制的P/f和Q/E參數，讓第一層控制能夠從直流母線電壓的變化來決定所允許輸出的最大功率。第三層控制類似第一層控制，區別在於讓並聯在同一直流母線上的多個直流-直流變換器可以透過直流母線互相交換信息。基於使用直流和交流母線作為信息傳輸的可靠渠道，新增能源可以隨時被添加至系統當中而不影響系統整體的穩定性，而且也不需要人為地改變系統的設置。除此之外，此控制方法同時也能夠將分佈式發電系統與中央電網進行無縫連接和隔離。

539013.label: Realisation of objectives
539013.value: All projects objectives have been successfully achieved. In this project, a two-inverter (1.5-kW + 1.5-kW) microgrid system has been developed to demonstrate the proposed droop control strategy for achieving fully autonomous operation of microgrid without dedicated communication link. Both inverters use the ac bus voltage as the communication link where changes in the ac bus voltage are used to signal power imbalance between the total power delivered by the inverters and the total ac load, and both inverters are programmed to share the load power proportionally according to some pre-defined ratio. This is the first-level droop control. The second-level droop control uses the changes in the dc bus voltage internal to each inverter system to modify the first-level droop-control coefficient, which determines the ratio of the total ac load that the inverter contributes in relation to the adjacent inverter, so that the inverter will share power according to its available power capacity. When the dc bus voltage is found to decrease continuously, this situation will cause the second-level droop control to output a signal (proportional to the total change of dc bus voltage) that modifies the first-level droop-control coefficient and causes it to lower its output power until the dc bus voltage stabilizes and power balance between the dc micro-sources and inverter's output is restored. The third-level droop control applies a similar concept as the first-level droop control except that it is applied to the dc bus voltage internal to each inverter system. As multiple dc micro-sources, such as batteries, super-capacitors, fuel cells, etc are expected to be tied to the same dc bus, the ability of these dc micro-sources to share the total load power can be defined by programming them to have different droop-control coefficients. All of them use the changes in the dc bus voltage as an indication of power balance and react accordingly to stabilize the dc bus voltage. This is the third-level droop control. The three-level droop-controlled two-inverter microgrid system described above has been constructed and tested under various test conditions (see the attached publication for more details). The two inverters are found to be capable of working cooperatively and autonomously without relying on the commands received through a dedicated communication link. The effectiveness of the proposed autonomous microgrid system and the proposed decentralized control strategy are therefore proven both theoretically and experimentally. By utilizing the developed two-inverter microgrid system, we further conducted researches on the impact of double-line frequency ripple on the dc bus voltage arising from the pulsating inverter's input power at twice the line frequency. The occurrence of double-line frequency ripple is known to have detrimental effects on the lifetime of electrochemical devices such as batteries and fuel cells. They will also introduce higher harmonics to the inverter's output ac voltage and thus affect the quality of the ac bus voltage. The study of the problems arising from double-line frequency ripple is therefore of critical importance to the reliability of microgrid systems which are commonly fed by dc sources loaded by single-phase inverters. In this project, the efforts to mitigate the double-line frequency ripple on the dc bus have been addressed from the perspective of output impedance design / shaping of the dc-dc converters tied to the dc bus, which resulted in a systematic derivation of a family of output impedance shaping methods (proportional-resonant control, load-current feed-forward, virtual output impedance) that are capable of reducing the output impedance of dc-dc converters. The combinations of these methods in different configurations have led to various degrees of reduction in the output impedance of dc-dc converters as verified by the experimental results reported in the attached publications. To illustrate the flexibility of these methods, a case study was conducted on a fuel cell + single-phase inverter system, wherein the output impedance of dc-dc converter is shaped by means of adding a second output voltage feedback loop to the dc-dc converter. Three basic modes of virtual output impedance shaping are derived and the resulting closed-loop output impedance characteristics are discussed and analyzed in detail. For this specific application, output impedance shaping using virtual resistance + inductance is found to be the most effective configuration, leading to 85% reduction in the double-line frequency ripple on the dc bus. The availability of the laboratory-scale microgrid system has also provided the opportunity to explore some interesting load-side issues, such as improving the dynamic response of power-factor pre-regulator by means of ripple cancellation method, research on single-stage bidirectional ac-dc converter based on dual-active-bridge topology and modulation method that enables flexible active and reactive power transfer, and research on multi-port bidirectional ac-dc converter and modulation method to achieve decoupled power control and flexible active and reactive power transfer for V2G application. Over the course of the proposed research, four journal papers have been published on the IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics and four conference papers were accepted and presented at major international conferences, including European Power Electronics Conference, Vehicle Power and Propulsion Conference, and Power and Energy Conference.

539013.label: Major findings and research outcome
539013.value: 1. A fully functional, 3-kW laboratory-scale two-inverter (1.5-kW + 1.5 kW) microgrid system was constructed and thoroughly tested. 2. A three-level droop control strategy was implemented on a two-inverter microgrid system to achieve fully autonomous operation. 3. A family of output impedance shaping methods for power converters were systematically derived and experimentally verified. 4. A case study on the application of output impedance shaping methods for mitigating the double-line frequency ripple on the dc bus voltage in a two-stage single-phase inverter system was carried out and their effectiveness was experimentally verified. 5. Specific load-side issues, such as improving the dynamic response of power-factor pre-regulator (which interfaces dc loads to ac microgrid), research on new two-/three-port single-stage bidirectional ac-dc converter topologies and modulation methods to achieve flexible active and reactive power transfer between ac microgrid and energy storages such as batteries, super-capacitors, and on-board batteries of electric vehicles. 6. The works done above were reported in four journal papers (IEEE Transactions on Power Electronics) and four conference papers.

539013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
539013.value: The two-inverter microgrid system developed in this project can be further expanded by including more sources/loads of different nature. Due to the autonomous microgrid's operation, the system is easily scalable in power capacity and complexity to facilitate various microgrid-related researches in the future. The works done so far have focused on ac microgrid only where dc micro-sources are interfaced to the ac bus via inverters. One possible extension of the research is to develop a droop-controlled dc microgrid which is interfaced to the ac microgrid via interlinking converters. The new two-port and three-port single-stage ac-dc converter topologies and modulation methods developed in this project can be used as the stated interlinking converters for realizing bidirectional power transfer between the dc and ac microgrids.

539013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
539013.value: A fully functional, 3-kW laboratory-scale two-inverter ac microgrid system was developed. A new decentralized control strategy based on three-level droop control was proposed and implemented to realize a microgrid system that is fully autonomous and flexibly scalable. Since it does not rely on a dedicated data link for communication between inverter systems, its operation is expected to be more reliable and robust against one-point failure. A decentralized microgrid is also able to self-adapt to the constantly changing environment due to sources and loads being added or removed from the microgrid. In this project, the laboratory-scale microgrid is also used as an experimental platform for studying a number of related topics, such as mitigation of double-line frequency ripple on the dc bus of a two-stage inverter system, improving the dynamic response of power-factor pre-regulator for enhanced power quality delivered to dc loads, development of new two-/three-port bidirectional converter topologies for realizing single-stage (hence lower component count and higher power density) ac-dc power conversion and new modulation methods to achieve flexible active and reactive power transfer between ac microgrid and energy storages.

539113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
539113.value: Road traffic noise has long been known as a major environmental pollution source, especially in highly urbanized cities, such as Hong Kong. Among the many approaches adopted to minimize the traffic noise effect, using crumb-rubber modified (CRM) asphalt mixtures in road surfaces has proven to be effective in directly reducing noises at the source, i.e., tire-pavement interfaces. In addition, CRM mixtures provide good durability and allow appropriate recycling of rubber from waste tires. However, to achieve the workability of the high-viscosity rubberized asphalt, CRM mixtures must be heated to higher temperatures for appropriate compaction, which in turn causes fumes and odors during construction. Recently, warm-mix asphalt (WMA) has emerged as a sustainable paving technology, which may effectively reduce the construction temperatures of conventional hot-mix asphalt (HMA) mixtures without compromising their mechanical performance. Correspondingly, it is an ideal technology to address the high construction emission concern of CRM mixtures and produce low-noise mixtures which are also low-emissive during construction. However, the interaction mechanisms of rubber and different types of warm-mix additives within asphalt have not been clearly understood yet, and very limited information is currently available on the mechanical and acoustic properties of the CRM mixtures containing warm-mix additives. In this Early Career Scheme study, the mechanism of the compound modification of asphalt mixtures with crumb rubber and warm-mix additives will be systematically investigated from both microscopic and macroscopic perspectives. Various microscopic morphology and chemical composition analysis tools will first be employed to study the mechanisms of the physical and chemical interactions between rubber and different types of warm-mix additives within asphalt. Based on the microanalysis results, the viscoelastic properties of the rubberized asphalt binders with and without warm-mix additives will be characterized and analyzed. The mechanical and acoustic performances, as well as the construction emissions of selected CRM mixtures with and without warm-mix additives will then be assessed through both laboratory testing and trial pavement monitoring. Finally, integrated life cycle cost analysis (LCCA) and life cycle assessment (LCA) will be conducted to identify the optimum low-noise mixture with balanced economic and environmental performance. It is anticipated that a significant amount of information of high academic and application values, particularly on sustainable paving materials and technologies, will be generated during the course of this study. The potential benefits of this study to Hong Kong include both a quiet and durable road system and a “greener” pavement construction process. 道路交通噪聲很長時間以來都被認爲是一個重要的環境污染源，尤其在像香港這樣高度城市化的地方。在衆多的减小交通噪聲影響的方法中，在瀝青面層中使用橡膠粉改性瀝青（CRMA）已經被證明了是一個可以直接降低輪胎與路面界面處噪聲的有效辦法。此外，橡膠粉改性混合料不僅具有良好的耐久性能，還提供了一個回收利用舊輪胎橡膠的途徑。然而，由于橡膠瀝青的高粘度，橡膠粉改性瀝青混合料施工溫度很高，導致在施工過程中容易産生烟霧和氣味。 近來，溫拌瀝青技術正逐漸成爲被大家認可的可持續路面鋪裝技術。和傳統的熱拌瀝青相比，溫拌瀝青可以在不影響材料力學性能的前提下有效降低施工溫度。基于這個特點，溫拌瀝青是一個解决橡膠粉改性瀝青施工時高排放問題的理想方法。但是，關于橡膠和不同種類的溫拌添加劑在瀝青中的相互作用機理目前還缺乏一個比較清晰完整的解釋。此外，當前對于溫拌橡膠瀝青混合料的力學和聲學性能的認識仍非常有限。 該課題將對含有橡膠粉和溫拌添加劑的瀝青混合料的複合改性機理從微觀和宏觀兩方面進行系統研究。首先，使用不同的微觀形態學和化學組成分析工具來研究橡膠粉和不同溫拌添加劑之間的物理和化學反應機制，幷在微觀分析的基礎上，對溫拌和非溫拌橡膠瀝青的粘彈性質進行測試分析。其次，通過室內實驗和試驗路檢測對溫拌與非溫拌橡膠瀝青混合料的力學性能，聲學性能，及施工排放情况進行評估。最後，利用全壽命周期成本分析（LCCA）和生命周期評估（LCA）方法得到一個綜合經濟和環境表現的最優溫拌橡膠瀝青混合料。 可以預見，該課題將在可持續道路鋪裝材料和技術方面産生較多具有高學術價值和應用價值的研究成果，幷爲香港的低噪音耐久道路系統及更環保的道路施工過程作出貢獻。

539113.label: Realisation of objectives
539113.value: Objective 1 was completely achieved through chemical and microscopic analysis on the separated crumb rubber and liquid asphalt from various types of warm asphalt rubber binders, using tools such as TGA, FTIR, GPC, etc. The separation of rubber and liquid asphalt from asphalt rubber binder is a special technology which had been seldom used in previous studies. It allows for evaluate the composition change of rubber and asphalt separately, therefore providing more clear insight in the chemical/physical interaction between them. By synthesizing various chemical and microscopic analysis results, it was found that the interaction between crumb rubber and asphalt is mainly physical component exchange, and no obvious chemical reaction was identified. Light components will be absorbed into rubber, while rubber will release some heave components into asphalt after the rubber and asphalt interaction. Using warm mix additives promotes such component exchange. Objective 2 was completely achieved through conducting various types of rehological property tests at different temperatures, such as rotational viscosity tests, dynamic shear rheometer tests, and bending beam rheometer tests, on various types of warm asphalt rubber binders. It was found that all five warm mix additives (chemical-type Evotherm-DAT, chemical-type Evotherm-3G, conventional paraffin wax, wax-type Sasobit, and foaming-type aspha-min) selected in this study are effective in reducing the viscosities within construction temperature range, but their effects on the performance properties varied depending on the type of warm mix additive, and the wax-type additive, Sasobit, provided the best overall effects, and it's the only type of additive which can further enhance the rutting resistance of asphalt binder. Objective 3 was completely achieved through conducting on-site close proximity (CPX) noise measurement of asphalt rubber mixture trial sections using conventional asphalt mixture pavement section as reference. It was concluded that the smaller aggregate size, gap-graded aggregate structure, high elasticity of asphalt rubber, can all help reduce tire-road noise, while the effect of warm-mix additives was minimal. It was also found in the trial section construction site that the warm mix additive, Sasobit, was effective in reducing the construction temperature and emission of asphalt rubber pavement construction. Objective 4 was completely achieved through conducting workability and mechanical property tests, such as stiffness, rutting resistance, fatigue resistance, moisture resistance, and dynamic modulus tests, on various types of warm asphalt rubber mixtures. In general, the testing findings on mixtures were consistent with the binder property tests. It was found that all warm mix additives selected in this study could reduce the construction temperature of bituminous mixtures by at least 16C without compromising their overall mechanical performance. Among various types of warm asphalt rubber mixtures, the one with Sasobit provided the best overall performance.

539113.label: Major findings and research outcome
539113.value: 1. Incorporation of non-foaming additives significantly reduces the viscosity of AR binder. 2. The selected WMA additives affect the rheological properties of AR binder in different ways: 1) Sasobit results in superior high-temperature performance and slightly poor fatigue and cracking resistance. 2) Evotherm-DAT results in reduced rutting and fatigue resistance. 3) 56# paraffin wax produces minor negative effects on the rheological properties of AR at different temperatures. 4) Combined WMA additives, 1.5wt% Sasobit and 2.5wt% Evotherm-DAT, significantly compromise the rutting, fatigue and cracking resistance of AR. 3. The incorporation of WMA additives leads to variance in FTIR spectrum. The variance is mainly ascribed to the chemical nature of WMA additives instead of complex chemical interaction among asphalt, CRM and WMA additives. 4. Thermal analyses show that natural rubber is more easily released and mixed with asphalt molecules than other components in CRM. Asphaltene in base binder does not move into CRM or attach to CRM surface during AR mixing. 5. During the mixing process, WMA additives penetrate into CRM particles like asphalt fractions. Moreover, they promote the dissolution of CRM particles in base asphalt. 6. Incorporating Evotherm-DAT at an earlier stage helps to decrease the preparation temperature of AR without compromising the performance of WAR binder. 7. Addition of wax additives at an earlier stage insignificantly affects the performance of WAR binders. However, the rheological and chemical analyses on L-WARs demonstrates less wax in L-WAR when wax additives were incorporated during the mixing of CRM and asphalt. 8. All WAR mixtures mixed at 160 °C achieve a compaction level similar to that of hot AR mixture mixed at 176 °C. Evotherm-DAT provides the most obvious effect in enhancing the workability. 9. All WAR mixtures display acceptable moisture susceptibility, rutting resistance and fatigue resistance. Especially, Sasobit brings the most satisfying performance to AR mixture. It further enhances the rutting resistance and has limited negative influence on the other mechanical properties. 10. The results of the mixture mechanical analyses are consistent with those of rheological analysis, except for the fatigue resistance. 11. The ME pavement modelling shows that all WAR mixtures have superior rutting resistance and surface smoothness compared to traditional wearing course with Pen 60/70 binder during the 20 years’ service life. The influence of WMA technologies is insignificant. 12. Among the selected WMA additives in this research, Sasobit works best with AR binder and mixture. It effectively enhances the workability of AR without obviously compromising its engineering performance.

539113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
539113.value: 1. Only one mixture gradation (SMA 10) was considered and studied in this research. Since WAR binders may perform differently in other mix gradations, the application of WAR binders in mixtures with other gradations (such as porous asphalt) and other types of aggregates should be further studied to generalize the findings of this study. 2. Considering that ductility test and rotational viscosity test are not quite suitable for AR and WAR binders due to the heterogeneity caused by CRM particles, new tests are suggested to be adopted or developed as more reliable methods to characterize binders with CRM. 3. More chemical analysis methods are suggested to be applied to investigate the component interaction mechanism of AR and WARs. 4. ITFT test results in this study indicated that Sasobit led to poorer fatigue resistance of AR mixture, which contradicts to the results of ARS binder test. Thus, it is recommended that additional tests, such as four point beam test for mixture and linear amplitude sweep test for binder, should be conducted to further evaluate the fatigue performance of the WAR mixture with Sasobit. 5. Local database is suggested to be developed for future implementation of MEPDG for pavement performance prediction in Hong Kong.

539113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
539113.value: This study aims at investigating the working mechanism of asphalt mixtures collectively modified with waste tire rubber and various types of warm mix asphalt (WMA) additives for low-noise, low-construction-emission and durability purposes. Three common warm mix additives: Sasobit (wax-type), Evotherm-DAT (chemical-type), and Aspha-min (foaming-type), were evaluated, and the dosage for crumb tire rubber is 18% by weight of binder. Both chemical and rheological characterizations were conducted on various types of modified binder, followed by mixture engineering performance testing and field evaluation. The outcome of this study revealed the interaction mechanisms among different types of WMA additives, crumb rubber, and bitumen, and identified the optimum type of WMA additive to be used in asphalt rubber mixture. In addition, this study revealed the effects of mixture production procedure on the final mixture’s performance, and identified the optimum procedure. Based on the identified optimum WMA additive type and warm asphalt rubber (WAR) mixture production procedure, guidelines on designing and constructing WAR pavements. This research project promoted the wider and more appropriate application of WAR as a “green” pavement material and enhanced the sustainable development of pavement infrastructure in Hong Kong.

539213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
539213.value: With increasing pressures worldwide on the global challenges of water shortage, energy security, and climate change, it leads to consider sewage as a resource than a waste to be treated with costs, as well as the consideration of greenhouse gas emission during treatment. However, the conventional sewage treatment system, designed unlike this concept of mining resources from sewage, is Anoxic and Oxic (A/O) system via aerobic oxidation and nitrification followed by denitrification for organic and nitrogen removals, respectively. Its disadvantages include: (1) high energy intensity for aeration; (2) significant sludge production; (3) greenhouse gases emission (CO2 and N2O); (4) no water reuse implementation from treated effluent. In this project, we propose a staged fluidized-bed membrane bioreactor (SF-MBR) system via anaerobic organic treatment followed by autotrophic nitrogen removal (coupling nitritation and anaerobic ammonium oxidation, short for Anammox). In this SF-MBR system, an anaerobic fluidized-bed bioreactor (AFBR) in the first stage converts organics into methane, a valuable biofuel and one of greenhouse gases, and a fluidized-bed membrane bioreactor (F-MBR) integrating biofilm and membrane design configuration for autotrophic nitrogen removal in the second stage transfers a half portion of ammonium to nitrite, the precursor of nitrous oxide (another powerful greenhouse gas), which is then used for anaerobic oxidation of the remaining ammonium to nitrogen gas via Anammox. It, therefore, ensures less nitrous oxide formation due to fast consumption of the produced nitrite through Anammox reaction, along with good effluent quality by membrane filtration. On the other hand, the microorganisms associated with anaerobic organic treatment and autotrophic nitrogen removal have the feature of low yield, guaranteeing in a significant cost saving of sludge management. In effect, a quadruple benefit of this SF-MBR system is obtained from methane collection and usage, minimization of nitrous oxide emission, reduction of sludge yield and enhanced in effluent quality for water reuse. Results will, thus, advance the fundamental knowledge of fast biofilm formation, bacterial metabolism, microbial community, and developing new membrane fouling control approach. It should be recognized as intellectual property that will lead to patent applications. The broader impacts include incorporated research and education along the theme of biorecycling from sewage by integrating research discoveries into graduate and undergraduate curricula, and transferring this system to publicly-owned treatment plants that will open up a new sewage treatment business opportunities in process design and construction as well as remediating the global issues of water shortage, energy security, and climate change. 因應現階段全球的環境挑戰，包含水資源短缺、能源危機、氣候暖化，讓我們思考如何將都市汙水資源再利用，與其再利用的同時同時並考慮到減少溫室氣體。 現在的傳統都是汙水處理系統的設計卻跟這個理念背道而馳。它的缺點包含: 1) 曝氣所需的高耗能；2) 高汙泥產量的負荷；3)溫室氣體的伴隨產生；4) 出流水無法再回收利用。此計畫利用流體化薄膜反應器做厭氧產甲烷和厭氧氨氧化去處理都市汙水。所以此計畫可以將有機物轉化為甲烷以及較有經濟法除氨氮並降低N2O的產生，並同時經過薄膜過濾能讓出流水再利用。另外，流體化的載體可以增加微生物質量，並降低薄膜阻塞率。此計畫可進行基礎環境生物菌種的探索，更可做為一可放大利用的業界實用的都市汙水反應器，進而解決水資源短缺、能源危機、氣候暖化。

539313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
539313.value: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) is an efficient near-surface geophysical (NSG) and nondestructive (NDE) method to unfold internal condition of engineering structures, such as underground constructions, slopes, infrastructures and buildings. However, excessive water in these structures often cause disturbing and even fatal consequences, for example, heavy rainfall and leaks in water-carrying pipelines may trigger landslides. A classic case is Kwun Lung Lau landslide that killed 5 people (Morgenstern, 1994). This research studies the effects of water in the above-mentioned structures in terms of electromagnetic (EM) wave properties of porous soil and concrete. Apart from metal, water is the single most influential factor affecting GPR’s EM wave properties because of its dipolar molecular structure which couples with EM wave’s polarization. Water distribution can be simplified into two types: homogeneous (HWD) and inhomogeneous (IWD). HWD refers to even distribution of water in a bulk mass, while IWD means water gradient over the bulk mass. HWD only exists in small laboratory samples, can be measured and modeled by time domain reflectometry, coaxial line and other EM methods. In contrast, IWD exists in field, but the measurement techniques and EM modeling are rare. The deliverables will have long term impacts from theoretical and practical perspectives. The theoretical side refers to the formulation of inverse model linking GPR parameters to material properties under IWD. The practical side is the potential IWD mapping of water leak on pipes buried in the above-mentioned structures. This research will study the IWD in soil and concrete using high frequency GPR (>1000MHz) through training dataset in scale-down experiments in a laboratory. Higher GPR frequency (>1000MHz) offers high resolution but limited penetration, and vice versa for lower GPR frequency. For example, antenna of 200-400MHz is suitable to study objects in scale of meter, 400-900MHz for thinner infrastructures in tens of centimeter scale, while 1000-2000MHz for the thinnest building structures in centimeter scale. This methodology allows very detail study of IWD in soil with high frequency GPR, which is not possible in the field. Through the training dataset, this research will contribute to the understanding of IWD and formulation of inverse models. Through the validation dataset in the field, the accuracy of the inverse model will be evaluated. With such contributions, the deliverables would be used to study the potential use of water leak mapping in the engineering structures, and characterization of unsaturated zone in soil strata. 透地雷達是一種高效律的近地地球物理探測和無損檢測的方法，用於透視工程結構的內部狀態，例如地底建築，斜坡，基建和建築物。但是，在這些結構裡面過多的水分會產生困擾甚至致命的後果，例如大雨和水管滲漏可能導致山泥傾瀉。一個經典例子是1994年的觀龍樓山泥傾瀉，導致五人死亡 (Morgenstern, 1994)。 這項研究探討水在上述結構（尤其是泥土和混凝土裏）對電磁波特性的影響。除了金屬，水對透地雷達電磁波特性影響最大，這是因為水的雙極性分子結構會對透地雷達電磁波產生有效的連合。水的分佈可以簡單地分成兩種：均勻和不均勻。均勻分佈（HWD）指水平均分佈於材料裡面，反之即為不均勻分佈（IWD）。HWD只存在於小型的實驗室樣本，可以以時域反射計，雙芯傳輸線模型和其他電磁波方法量度和模擬。反之，IWD存在於真實世界，但是量度方法卻很少。這項研究將會有理論上和實際應用的長遠影響。理論上的影響指建立反向模型，聯繫在IWD的情況下，透地雷達的量度參數和材料特性的關係。實際應用方面則指探測在上述結構中水管滲漏的情況。 這項研究將會探討在IWD情況下，高頻（＞1000MHz)透地雷達電磁波在泥土和混凝土的反應。方法是以縮小規模的實驗結果作為訓練數據庫。對於較低頻的透地雷達電磁波，頻率較高會提高解像度，但可探測範圍卻減少。舉例來說，200-400MHz的天線適用於探測以米為單位的探測範圍，400-900MHz則以物件的米到厘米為單位（例如基建組件），1000-2000MHz更以厘米為探測範圍的單位（例如樓房）。此方法容許很仔細的泥土IWD對高頻透地雷達的研究。 通過訓練數據庫，這項研究將會對IWD增加了解，和建立對其情況的反向模型。再通過實地實驗的數據庫，反向模型的準確性將會被評估。研究成果將會被用作工程結構中的漏水檢測，和泥土中水不飽和層的描述。

539313.value: The work of this project has led to a better understanding how inhomogeneous water distribution in materials reacts to electromagnetic wave in the range from 100 MHz to 2000 MHz. From fundamental perspective of science, an algorithm of wave velocity's estimation governed by water content (and associated frequency-dependent inversion) has been further validated through a series of experiment carried out by researchers and BSc students. From practical perspective, the work provides an important means on how water content in materials can be estimated non-destructively, or in other words, leading to real-life applications of water seepage/leak imaging by GPR in concrete and underground.

539613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
539613.value: Modification of functional movement patterns has been practiced in many clinical settings with gait retraining being one of the most common functional motor modification strategies. Gait retraining has been successfully applied to patients with neurological conditions e.g. stroke and cerebral palsy. In the recent decade, emerging evidence supports the application of gait retraining for patients with orthopaedic conditions, such as knee osteoarthritis, patellofemoral pain, and tibial stress fracture. Previous studies have demonstrated that a two week eight-session retraining program using real time visual feedback is temporarily able to control implicit biomechanical risk factors, such as excessive amount of peak positive acceleration (PPA) of the tibia. However, the extent of motor learning after gait retraining remains unclear. First of all, the modified gait pattern after training was not examined under distracted or dual cognitive task conditions. Participants may resume the original motor pattern when attention is diverted from their motor performance by a competing cognitive demand. More importantly, the mental process during the training was not evaluated. Walking is a lifetime automatic activity that requires dynamic interaction between supraspinal locomotion centers, central pattern generators, and peripheral sensors. It is therefore questionable that a permanent change could be induced by a two week eight-session gait retraining program. Better understanding of the learning mechanism in subjects before and after gait retraining is critical. Such information will facilitate the optimization and enhancement of the existing rehabilitation protocols. In addition, it will provide critical insight into the neural mechanisms of gait disorders and corresponding rehabilitation for a wider spectrum of patients. Recent studies have demonstrated that electroencephalography (EEG) can be used to record the intra-stride electrocortical dynamics during human locomotion. It has been shown that activities in the sensorimotor, posterior parietal, and dorsal anterior cingulate cortex exhibited significant gait-event specific changes in spectral power. Such power increases indicate specific cortical involvement at different gait events during constant speed locomotion. Examination of the intra-stride electrocortical activity before and after gait retraining may provide a novel insight for better understanding of the motor learning using biofeedback. Therefore, the aim of this study is to evaluate how gait adaptation affects both cerebral activity and motor performance in young adults before and after a course of two week gait retraining using visual feedback, with and without an additional non-motor task. 步態訓練是臨床最常見的運動功能修正策略之一。步態訓練已成功應用於神經系統疾病患者，如中風及大腦麻痺病人。在最近的十年中，新的證據支持步態訓練運用於不同的骨科疾病，如膝關節炎，髕股關節疼痛，脛骨應力性骨折。有研究發現，為期兩週的步態回饋訓練能有效控制脛骨的正加速度最大值（ PPA ）。過量的脛骨PPA可引致脛骨應力性骨折。然而，步態訓練之基礎理論，特別是學習行走訓練後的人體力學表現與大腦學習程度仍不清楚。首先，之前發表之實驗並沒有在分散注意的情況下測試參與者。注意力轉移時，參與者有可能會恢復原本的運動模式。更重要的是，在培訓期間的大腦學習過程沒有被評估。了解步態訓練的學習機制將有利於優化和提升現有的康復療程。因此，本研究的目的是評估步態回饋訓練如何影響人體力學表現及大腦活動。

539613.label: Realisation of objectives
539613.value: All the experiments were conducted as described in our original plan. However, we received very constructive comments from “Neuroscience” during the first round of review. The reviewers suggested additional experiment to substantiate our findings. Specifically, our previous experimental design did not have a control condition (we did have arranged "walking exercise" as a control condition. In this control condition, the subjects did not receive any feedback.) and so we could not tell if the brain signals were responsible for the visual feedback as a motor cue or just a visual stimulus. We therefore conduct an experiment with same type of visual feedback but they are totally irrelevant to the motor performance. Preliminary data (n=5) indicates that alpha-band event-related desynchronization in the extrastriate cortex and theta-band event-related synchronization in the anterior cingulate cortex and posterior parietal cortex are not observed with random visual signals, but they appear with the relevant visual feedback. We plan to resubmit the revised paper in the 1Q of 2017 after completion of data collection and analyses.

539613.label: Major findings and research outcome
539613.value: Experiment 1 Before gait retraining, individuals were able to demonstrate a better loading control with real time biofeedback during walking. Similar to previous studies, gait retraining was shown to be effective in controlling landing kinetics, even when the subjects are distracted. However, additional visual feedback was only able to enhance the gait performance before and after training under distraction. Experiment 2 Significant alpha-band event-related desynchronization (ERD) was spotted at 40%-60% of gait cycle in extrastriate cortex (EC) and posterior parietal cortex (PPC) when visual feedback was provided. Anterior cingulate cortex (ACC), EC and PPC showed contrast theta-band oscillation patterns when feedback were provided. In ACC, significant theta-band event-related synchronization (ERS) was observed at 65%-80% of gait cycle when a negative feedback was received. Under the same condition, EC and PPC exhibited an earlier ERS, at 30%-45% of gait cycle and 35%-40% of gait cycle, respectively. We observed significant difference in event-related spectral perturbation (ERSP) between mono and dual task before gait training lied in alpha-band at premotor cortex (PMC). Prominently weaker alpha-band ERD was shown in PMC at 25%-35% of gait cycle when the subjects were requested to count while walking. After training, alpha-band oscillation in PPC exhibited a similar pattern as in pre-training sessions. ERD was shown at 35%-45% of gait cycle when visual feedback was provided. Unlike in pre-training sessions, the premotor cortex behaved substantially robustly in alpha-band after gait training, regardless of whether mono task or dual task was requested. The average ERSP curves for mono and dual task conditions across the entire gait cycle were largely coherent with each other. Experiment 3 This part of study examined the effects of real time visual biofeedback on the loading control during running before and after a course of gait retraining. Similar to the result in experiment 1, gait retraining is an effective way to control the running kinetics. The beneficial effect of the real time biofeedback not only occurred before training, but also maintained after training. The second part of study examined the effects of real time biofeedback and training on the loading control during distracted running. The participants were able to control the landing kinetics during distracted running. Similar to the first part of study, additional visual feedback was able to enhance the performance of landing kinetics control before and after training.

539613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
539613.value: We believe more interesting neurophysiological phenomenon and clinical implications would be discovered from a functional connectivity analysis using these EEG data. Several algorithms of this kind, such as Granger’s Causality Analysis and Small-Worldness analysis, would be tried in the coming year. Besides, we may also attempt to manipulate the brain signals elicited from the brain regions we have pinpointed from this project, such as premotor cortex, extrastriate cortex, anterior cingulate cortex, and posterior parietal cortex, in order to facilitate patients with neural disorder diseases to have a more efficient and effective rehabilitation progress. Transcranial magnetic stimulation might be a promising tool for such purpose, which we would research on in the near future.

539613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
539613.value: This project identifies several brain regions, such as posterior parietal cortex, extrastriate cortex, and anterior cingulate cortex, are functionally connected in a visual-augmented gait training program, which is shown to effective in controlling landing impact in healthy young adults. However, distraction during walking or running gait may affect the landing loading control. Additional feedback during distracted walking or running may enhance the performance, in terms of kinetics control. Such findings will improve the existing gait retraining protocols, which provide alternative method for injury prevention and rehabilitation in runners and patients with knee osteoarthritis.

540113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
540113.value: This study is aimed at creating quality stylish fashion textile and apparel by means of developing innovative three dimensional (3D) fabrics for fashion and textile application. Such design innovation and engineering include calibration of weaving structures, and the synchronization of the tactile surface texture, colors, patterns and graphics that are necessary to achieve 3D lenticular effect – the ability to change as the image is viewed from different angles. The key issues to be investigated are: (1) new design concept and innovative methods for 3D textile woven structure to create textile with dynamic textural and graphic effects; (2) design parameters of 3D woven structures and modeling of yarn arrangement for 3D woven fabrics; (3) characterization of 3D woven structures; (4) synchronization of woven structure, color and graphic to achieve 3D woven textile with dynamic changeable graphic effects; (5) calibration of yarn properties and fabric parameters to achieve morphing effects to textile material. The proposed study is unique and challenging as it involves the design of 3D woven structure to create lenticular effects for fashion textile and rather than of motionless visual effect. The proposed design concept and technique will be a tremendous breakthrough in textile design, and a new approach to fashion design and fashion visualization. The application of lenticular changeable graphics not only will create a new platform in textile creation, but will also becomes a new essence in future fashion and textile design. Apart from making a significant progress in liberating the traditional substituting 2D surface textile construction, this advancement will open a new boundary in innovative 3D textile and apparel design. Such technology can also advocate such innovation in interior and decorative homeware dimensions. The creativity and innovative process include the calibration of weaving construction and synchronization of textile materials, colors, patterns and graphics to achieve 3D woven structure design. Furthermore, the proposed lenticular technology and prototypes will be highly valuable to visual display which utilizes the 3D changeable effects to enrich the representation. In addition, the proposed innovation is a sustainable physical process, with no chemical addition and additional processing such as printing, finishing and lamination. It will be beneficial to both human and environment. Besides, this innovation demonstrates that fashion design and textile technology will no longer be incompatible with each other. Last but not least, the 3D structure based changeable graphic effect is considered a high technology and high value added product. N/A
