559213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
559213.value: Systematic use of observational pain tools has been advocated as a means to improve pain management for care home residents with dementia. Pain experts suggest that any observational pain tool should be used as part of a comprehensive pain management protocol, which should include score interpretation and verification as well as suggestions regarding appropriate pain treatment according to the pain score. The Observational Pain Management Protocol (Protocol) was therefore developed. A pre and post study design was used to evaluate the effectiveness of the Protocol in managing pain among 30 residents with diagnoses of dementia and pain. Preliminary results suggest that the Protocol can improve pain management practice in a care home. Therefore, a 2-group randomized controlled trial with a larger sample size is proposed to examine the effect of the Protocol on improving pain management as compared to a control condition of usual pain management practice in long-term care homes. The aim of this study is to investigate whether regular use of the Protocol can improve the management of pain for residents with dementia as manifested by the increased use of pharmacological and non-pharmacological pain treatments. As a consequence, pain scores will be lower due to better pain management. 126 care home residents will be recruited based on the sample selection criteria from 6 care homes. A similar number of participants from each home will be randomized to the control or experimental condition. Participants from the same care home will be placed in their home’s corresponding condition to avoid a “contamination” effect. This study will take 16 weeks (i.e. baseline assessment X 4 weeks and Protocol implementation X 12 weeks). After the training for care home staff in the experimental condition, the Protocol will guide the pain management of the participants for 12 weeks. Meanwhile, the control care homes will continue their usual pain management strategies. Intervention effects will be measured weekly and compared with the baseline measurements as well as between the experimental and control conditions. Research assistants, who will be blinded to the study hypothesis and group allocation, will be responsible for all subject assessment measures. The effectiveness of the Protocol will be evaluated by a) the use of pharmacological pain treatments, measured by the Medication Quantification Scale III; b) the use of all non-pharmacological pain treatments; and c) pain-related behaviours exhibited by participants, assessed by an observational pain tool, the Chinese-Pain Assessment IN Advanced Dementia (C-PAINAD). 有系統地使用觀察疼痛行為工具已被提倡為改善護理院裡患有癡呆症院友之疼痛管理方法。疼痛專家建議，任何觀察疼痛行為工具應用於全面疼痛管理草案中的一部份。草案應包括詮釋和驗證疼痛程度，以及根據疼痛程度而建議適當的疼痛治療。有見及此, 本研究團隊制定“疼痛行為觀察評估及管理草案（草案）”。一個比較草案引入前和後的研究，曾用作評估草案為30 位患有疼痛和癡呆症院友管理疼痛的成效。初步結果顯示，草案可以改善護理院疼痛管理的做法。因此，一個樣本數目較大的兩組隨機對照試驗將用作檢測草案在改善疼痛管理的成效。這項研究旨在檢測在草案引入後，護理院能否有效地應用藥理和非藥理的疼痛冶療，從而改善癡呆症院友的疼痛管理，令院友之疼痛程度得以減低。 以本研究訂立的樣本選擇標準為基礎，126 位患有癡呆症及疼痛的院友將會在護理院中招募。來自相同護理院的參加者將會被隨機分配到其所屬院舍的相應組別--“對照組”或 “實驗組”。這項研究將為期16 周 (即基礎評估 為期4 周和實行草案為期12 周)。被隨機分配到 “實驗組”的護理院, 其工作人員完成培訓後，草案會為參加者作為期12 個星期之疼痛管理作指引。同時，被隨機分配到 “對照組” 的護理院會繼續使用其慣常疼痛管理方式。每週均會評估介入效果，介入效果不但會與基礎評估的結果作比較，而且還會用於實驗組與對照組之間以對比疼痛管理的效果。為免期望偏差影響結果，研究助理不會得知研究詳程和組別分配的資料，他將負責估量所有參加者的疼痛改善情況。草案的效能評估會基於 甲)藥理疼痛冶療之應用 ； 乙)非藥物疼痛治療之應用 ；和 丙)參加者之疼痛相關行為表現程度,。

559213.label: Realisation of objectives
559213.value: The objectives of this project have been completely achieved, as evidenced by the completion of a cluster-randomized controlled trial in 17 local nursing homes from June 2014 to August 2015. The findings support the view that the systematic use of the Observational Pain Management Protocol (Protocol) is of clinical utility in enhancing the use of non-pharmacological pain-relieving interventions among residents with advanced dementia (Objective 1), leading to a reduction in their observational pain-related behaviors (Objective 2). Additional, we have also identified the underlying factors associated with the suboptimal pain management for nursing home residents with dementia (Objective 3). In addition, this study has illustrated that after frontline staff in nursing homes have been given some simple training, the Protocol can be easily and effectively incorporated into the daily routine of the nursing homes. This will make frontline healthcare providers more sensitive to the behavior of residents with dementia and more able to recognize those behaviors as symptoms of pain or other unmet needs. They will then be able to increase their efforts to treat the underlying causes of the pain. Thus, the overall aim of this project, which was to improve pain management for residents with dementia by implementing the Protocol, has been achieved. The current study also showed that because the use of non-pharmacological interventions in the experimental homes increased, there was a reduction in the participants’ observational pain scores (Objective 1). This finding supports the argument that non-pharmacological interventions should be promoted in this population. The administration of appropriate non-pharmacological interventions should be an essential component of good pain management among nursing homes, because such interventions are more cost-efficient and involve no side-effects from the use of medication. However, the use of the Protocol did not have any effect on pain medications (Objective 1), a result similar to the findings in several previous studies. As we did not require nursing home staff to report the participants’ observational pain scores to the participants’ physicians, nor did we monitor whether they had done so, we could not evaluate whether the participants’ observational pain scores had been reported to their physicians. Given the relatively low use of pain medications, it is believed that communication between nursing home staff and physicians regarding the observational pain scores was limited in the current study. It is possible that the nursing home staff did not regard the observational pain scores as strong enough evidence of pain to need to be reported. Thus, the physicians may have been unaware of those pain scores. Alternatively, the physicians may have been informed, but might have decided not to take them into account. In view of this, a pathway for communication between nursing home staff and physicians about the participants’ observational pain scores should be embedded in the Protocol, and another study can be conducted in the future to determine whether or not this would affect the use of pain medications among nursing home residents with advanced dementia. A major challenge to realizing the objectives of the study was to implement the Protocol, which involves refining an existing care flow, in such a way as to ensure cooperation and consistency among different nursing homes. To achieve this purpose, firstly, training workshops and a simple test were conducted by the PI at the experimental homes so as to ensure that all nursing home staff understood and followed the Protocol correctly. Secondly, each experimental home identified either a physiotherapist or a nurse-in-charge to form a steering committee together with the research team to supervise the process of implementing the Protocol. The steering committee met several times during the preparation stage to discuss strategies for incorporating the steps in the Protocol into the daily routine of each nursing home, so as to minimize the additional work involved for the frontline staff. Thirdly, nursing home representatives were included in the monitoring of the implementation process. They were encouraged to inform the research team immediately whenever they encountered any problems related to the implementation of the Protocol. Finally, frequent monitoring, a reminder system, and informational feedback, particularly in the first few weeks of the implementation phase, were also likely key factors in determining whether the Protocol could be implemented in the nursing homes in a consistent manner. To realize the objectives of the study, it was also necessary to ensure the fidelity of the study by training all of the research assistants and study helpers on how to collect data, particularly on how to use the observational pain assessment method, as well as instructing them to use a checklist to determine whether the experimental homes had followed the Protocol correctly, especially during the first few days of the implementation of the Protocol in each home. The major questions that were raised during the first two weeks of the implementation mainly concerned the interpretation of the observational pain scores and the timing of the re-assessment after the administration of pain treatments. Informational feedback was immediately provided to clarify the questions. In addition, monthly to bi-monthly quality-control meetings with the experimental homes were held to evaluate the implementation of the Protocol. A simple reminder system was used throughout the implementation stage to improve adherence to the Protocol. Another challenge to realizing the objects of the study was recruiting a sufficient number of nursing homes to take part in the study. Originally, 16 homes accepted our invitation and were randomized to the control or experimental conditions. As several control homes had a relatively small number of participants who met the criteria for inclusion, one more control home was recruited to meet the required sample size for the control condition. Eventually, eight homes were allocated to be the experimental homes, and nine to be the control homes.

559213.label: Major findings and research outcome
559213.value: Major findings 1: The findings support the view that the Protocol is of clinical utility in enhancing the use of non-pharmacological pain-relieving interventions among residents with advanced dementia, leading to a reduction in their observational pain-related behaviors. However, the Protocol did not have any effect on the use of pain medications. Major findings 2: A cross-sectional analysis at baseline of the main study was conducted to identify factors associated with the use of different pain treatments by nursing home residents with dementia and impaired communication. From the findings, it can be concluded that suboptimal pain management was common among this population, with only 23 (17.2%) and 35 (26.1%) having received pharmacological or non-pharmacological pain treatments, respectively, although all of the participants (n=128) had a confirmed pain condition. Severe impairment in the ability to communicate is a major reason for the under-use of pain medications. The research outcomes based on this project: Three articles have been published for publication in scientific journals: A manuscript that was prepared based on the main clinical trial has been published in the Journal of the American Geriatrics Society, a study protocol has been published in BMC Trial, and a manuscript reporting the cross-sectional analysis has been published in the journal Pain Medicine.

559213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
559213.value: The following are three potential areas for further development after this clinical trial: • This study showed that the use of non-pharmacological interventions increased, leading to a reduction in the participants’ observational pain scores. This supports the argument that non-pharmacological interventions should be promoted in PWD. Incorporating the steps suggested in this Protocol may help in the effort to identify effective non-pharmacological interventions for PWD. • A similar protocol can be adopted for use in acute settings to manage acute pain for people who cannot verbalize their pain, such as those with dementia, the mentally challenged, or those with problems speaking. • The results of current study show that the Protocol did not have any effect on the use of pain medications. This may be partly due to the fact that we emphasized the importance of communicating the pain scores to the physicians. Thus, a pathway for nursing home staff and physicians to communicate the participants’ pain scores should be embedded in the Protocol, and future study conducted to determine whether or not this would affect the use of pain medications. Several feasibility/ pilot studies are planned, with the aim of incorporating the above three ideas in the Protocol to extend its utility.

559213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
559213.value: It has frequently been reported that nursing home residents with advanced dementia (RWD) receive suboptimal pain management. In response, an Observational Pain Management Protocol (Protocol) was developed to guide the flow of pain management in a nursing home setting. This study aims to evaluate the effects of implementing the Protocol on pain management for nursing home RWD. The Protocol was implemented in eight nursing homes for 12 weeks on 64 participants with advanced dementia and pain problems. A significant increase in the use of non-pharmacological interventions was identified after the implementation of the Protocol for 12 weeks when compared with another 64 nursing home RWD who received only the usual care for their pain problems. However, no significant difference in the use of pain medications was observed. With the increased use of non-pharmacological interventions, a significant reduction in the observational pain score was also obtained. To conclude, this study supports the clinical utility of the Protocol, as it can easily be incorporated into the daily routine of nursing homes after staff training. Afterwards, it can enhance the use of non-pharmacological pain-relieving interventions among RWD, leading to a reduction in their observational pain-related behaviors.

559313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
559313.value: Human emotions have always been a driving force behind significant market movements. As reflected in a report titled ‘Wall Street traders mine tweets for investing clues’ in the newspaper USA Today, mining and analyzing users’ shared updates on social-networking sites can be just as valuable for business as tracking corporate profits and interest rates. People are increasingly eager to share their views on contemporary issues with millions of site users, where trends and opinions help to form a ‘large-scale emotional thermometer for society as a whole’. Emotion automatic mining and analysis of these media channels would be greatly beneficial to market predictions and analysis. Previous research on emotion analysis has focused on monolingual contexts for emotion representations. However, in an informal setting such as the blogosphere, emotion is often expressed as a mixture of different natural languages, especially in multilingual communities such as Hong Kong. This mixture of languages is called code-switching. Despite the important implications of code-switching for emotion analysis, existing automatic emotion extraction methods fail to accommodate for the code-switching contexts commonly found on social-networking sites. Thus, it can be seen that there is an urgent need for analyzing emotions in code-switching texts in emotion analysis. This project proposes to fill the gap by investigating Hong Kong bilinguals’ use of Chinese and English in expressing emotions in online social-mediated texts. We will account for emotion representations in terms of various interesting and challenging linguistic issues, i.e. the correlations between emotions and other variables such as language choice and topic domain in relation to code-switching context. We will also analyze the roles and functions of each language, and discuss how the relation between emotion and language choice may impact social values and attitudes. The findings of linguistic studies will inform our computational model and experiments in automatic emotion detection and classification. In addition to simulating and verifying the results of our linguistic studies, such a computational modeling has potential applications for mining emotions and classifying various genres of informal texts in Chinese-English code-switching contexts in the future and can be extended to tracking public emotions on current issues, to detect implicit information of emotion based on the textual and/or the symbolic language representations, and to mine such information as input for predicting market trends.

559313.label: Realisation of objectives
559313.value: The seven objectives proposed in the project have all been achieved. Details are given below: Objective 1: A Chinese-English code-switching corpus has been constructed and annotated with emotion-related information. We retrieve our data set from Weibo.com. A total of 2,716,197 posts were extracted from these users’ profiles. Five basic emotions were annotated, namely happiness, sadness, fear, anger and surprise. Two languages, Chinese and English, were annotated as caused languages. The denomination of caused languages refers to the language(s) which express the emotions in the post. Since emotion can be expressed through the two languages separately or collectively, as well as through mixed phrases, we thus need to annotate four kinds of causal situations for each emotion, i.e. English, Chinese, Both, and Mixed. An annotation tool is designed to facilitate the annotation process for better consistency. To verify the quality of the annotation, two human annotators were asked to annotate 1,000 posts in parallel. The inter-annotator agreement (using Cohen’s Kappa coefficient) on emotion annotation is 0.692 while the agreement on caused language is 0.767, which indicates the high quality of annotation. We then randomly extracted 15,123 posts for annotation, of which 8,687 posts included emotions. Moreover, 81.4% of the posts express emotions in Chinese. Although English is in the minority, comprising only a few words in each post, 43.5% of posts still express emotions in English. The statistics indicate that English is very important in expressing emotions. Objective 2: We proposed a well-defined method for constructing and analysing a code-switching corpus from social media. The corpus was constructed and analysed using the following steps. First, code-switching posts were extracted from the large-scale dataset by removing monolingual and noise posts. Second, an annotation scheme was proposed to annotate both emotions and the language(s) that were used for emotion expressions in the dataset. Third, an inter-annotator agreement was calculated to verify the quality and reliability of the annotation and effectiveness of the proposed scheme. Finally, a multi-view learning framework was proposed to annotate the unlabeled data automatically by considering both monolingual and bilingual information. By doing so, the time required for automatic annotation was reduced, and mitigated some of the difficulty in annotating emotions in code-switched text. Objectives 3, 4 & 5: We analysed both the statistical and linguistic phenomena of code-switching texts based on the corpus data. We have examined the syntactic, semantic and pragmatic characteristics of the emotion representations in the code-switching texts. We specifically investigated the linguistic correlation between emotion types, topic domain, and code-switching behaviours. We have demonstrated that code-switching patterns reflect how emotion is represented. Statistical results showed that insertion code-switching is the most frequently used pattern in the data while alternation and congruent lexicalisation code-switching are more closely related to emotion expression. Insertion and alternation code-switching are contextualisation cues applied by writers to highlight emotions. Congruent lexicalisation regulates emotion flow by indicating emotion changes, i.e. the emotion type expressed before and after the congruent lexicalisation switching is different. In general, the emotion type shifts from negative to positive with this pattern of code-switching. We demonstrated that the pattern of code-switching changes the way in which emotion is represented. In addition, we have provided quantitative results on how code-switching patterns are distributed in relation to emotion expression. We believe that the results will contribute to numerous aspects of emotion analysis, including enhancing future automatic emotion detection and classification systems. Objectives 6 & 7: To simulate and verify the results of our linguistic studies (objectives 3, 4 & 5), we proposed a uniform framework to predict emotions in code-switching text by considering both bilingual and emotional information. In particular, the factor functions were proposed to connect different emotions within a single post by considering the emotional relations. The attribute functions were proposed to connect the Chinese and English texts by considering the bilingual information between them. Finally, the factor graph model was proposed to incorporate both factor and attribute functions to a uniform framework to learn the emotion prediction model collectively. The empirical studies demonstrate that our model significantly improves emotions prediction in bilingual text.

To simulate and verify the results of our linguistic studies through computational modeling and experiments.

To propose a supervised classification method for detecting emotions in code-switching texts based on the annotated corpus data and the obtained linguistic cues, as well as a semi-supervised classification method in conjunction with the large amount of unlabeled data to improve the performance.

559313.label: Major findings and research outcome
559313.value: Major findings 1. A Chinese-English code-switching corpus, heretofore unprecedented in scale and scope, was constructed and annotated with emotion-related information. 2. A multi-view learning framework with both monolingual and bilingual information has been introduced to annotate the unlabeled data automatically. The framework has been proven effective. 3. The linguistic phenomena in code-switching texts in social media have been examined and statistically analysed. Emotion types, topic domains, language choices were shown to be correlated. 4. An automatic emotion detection model (the factor graph model) has been developed based on the linguistic analysis of emotion-language interaction in the code-switching texts. The empirical studies demonstrated that our model significantly improves emotions prediction in bilingual text. Research outcome This study, which has lasted for three years in duration, has achieved a significant number of research outcomes. Official publications as a result of this project include one research book (#17), one article in a top-tier research journal (#13), and five book chapters in reputable publishers such as Springer and Routledge (#5, #11, #12, #18, #19). Moreover, the study has been made the topic of twelve conference proceedings including top-tier computational linguistics conferences such as ACL and COLING (#1, #2, #3, #4, #6, #7, #8, #9, #10, #13, #14, #15, #16). In addition to the above, one top-tier journal article is currently under review (#20), and two journal articles (one on the linguistic model, and the other on the computational model) are being prepared for publication.

559313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
559313.value: There are a number of ways in which this research can be developed further. A multi-pronged approach is recommended, on the basis of three different contexts. First, the results from the project can be extrapolated to different bilingual code-switching texts utilizing different language mixes, e.g. Cantonese-English, French-English, etc. Plans for this are already underway, as an internal grant for a project on Cantonese emotion corpus construction has been obtained by the PI of the current study. Second, the methodology used can also be extended to multilingual (i.e. more than two languages) texts. This will require more of a collaborative and cross-cultural effort, but the field stands to gain much knowledge and insight. Finally, select code-switching features of emotion can be incorporated into the emotion model for analysis, broadening and expanding the depth of previous researches on the topic.

559313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
559313.value: This project has aimed to explore emotion-language interaction in code-switching contexts in Hong Kong, as well as develop a computational model for multilingual detection and classification model of emotion. Through the completion of this research, we have made headway in several key areas. First, by setting up a better, more efficient way of collecting and studying code-switching emotion language from social media, we have opened the door to developing a linguistic corpus which incorporates both language choice and emotion types behind users’ posts. This allows for fresh perspectives on linguistic accounts of emotion expression and code-switching texts, and provides a novel approach for training of natural language processing tools in detecting and classifying emotions. The code-switching nature of the study and the annotated corpus has also resulted in a new research methodology for analysis of emotion expression using a mix of languages in texts. Finally, the computational model we have constructed can be used in the future to classify and analyze further informal texts in social contexts with a strong bilingual aspect, such as Hong Kong and other multilingual cities/regions.

559713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
559713.value: 本計畫主要探討「半跏思惟像」在公元六世紀河北地區庶民佛教中的物質、社會和宗教意涵。公元五、六世紀，中國佛教徒與工匠大量製作了一種特殊的菩薩像，其單手指頤做思惟狀，並通常將右腳置於左腿上，故被學界稱為「思惟像」或「半跏思惟像」。在其發展初期，約公元五世紀初，以脅侍的角色陪襯於主像身側，但其地位在圖像傳播的過程中逐漸提高；六世紀中，它開始以主角的姿態占據佛教神祇群像的中心位置，成為一個具有獨立身分的菩薩，是信眾膜拜的主要對象，這現象在河北地區尤為明顯。儘管思惟像的數量龐大，關於它的佛典文字或歷史記錄卻非常稀少，圖像與文字數量上的巨大差異指出這尊菩薩可能盛行於庶民佛教，它的崇拜者絕大多數是一般百姓，不具有高度的文字讀寫能力，但熱衷於禮拜儀式和造像活動。本研究對思惟像在五六世紀的發展進行視覺元素與結構分析，同時針對河北地區出土的思惟造像記進行結構和語法的檢視，以了解思惟像在庶民佛教中的意義及其信仰成立的背景。

560113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
560113.value: Our major aims are to: determine the vitamin D status of a group of young, apparently healthy adults in Hong Kong; examine inter-relationships between vitamin D status and biomarkers of DNA damage and repair, oxidative stress, inflammation and endothelial health; investigate effects of improvement in vitamin D status on these biomarkers and other measures of well-being in those young adults shown to be deficient in vitamin D. Around half the people in the world lack adequate vitamin D. Vitamin D most clearly associates with musculo-skeletal health, but vitamin D deficiency elevates risk of various disorders including cancer, cardiovascular disease, depression and diabetes. Therefore, vitamin D deficiency is an important public health concern. Some vitamin D is obtained from food, but most is synthesized in the skin. This requires exposure to sunlight. The major cause of vitamin D deficiency in otherwise healthy people is lack of adequate exposure to sunlight. This is common in northern latitudes, especially in winter, but occurs even in sunny countries due to avoidance of sunshine and to the modern ‘indoor living’ lifestyle. Young people in Hong Kong spend most of their time indoors. Furthermore, air pollution is high in Hong Kong. Haze blocks the sunlight needed for vitamin D synthesis. We hypothesize that vitamin D deficiency is common in our young adults. Further, we hypothesize that vitamin D deficiency associates with ‘hidden’ but deleterious biological changes, including poor DNA repair, increased DNA damage, inflammation, oxidative stress, and endothelial dysfunction. These form a ‘common soil’ for the development of chronic diseases. We also hypothesize that improvement in vitamin D status will improve these biological changes. The long term impact of DNA damage, inflammation, oxidative stress and endothelial dysfunction on health is not clear cut, but it is reasonable to believe that the more severe these hidden biological effects are and the longer they exist, the more severe will be their long-term impact on health, and that their amelioration will benefit health. If vitamin D deficiency is indeed highly prevalent in our young adults, if it associates with detrimental biological changes, and if improvements in vitamin D status ameliorate these, a public health policy to drive early detection and correction of vitamin D deficiency will be supported by science-based evidence. Vitamin D deficiency and its effects are of global importance as well as locally relevant. Therefore the findings of this study will be of wide interest and value. 摘要: 我們主要的研究目標為:測定看來健康且年輕的香港成年人其體內維生素D的量值 藉此探討維生素D與多種生物標誌間的關係, 如: 去氧核醣核酸的損害及修復, 氧化壓力, 發炎反應及表皮細胞的健康等; 並進一步研究增加維生素D的攝取對上述生物標誌的影響以及維生素D缺乏者的健康改善程度。 在世界人口當中約有半數人口缺乏足量的維生素D。目前已知, 維生素D與肌肉骨骼的健康有密不可分之關係; 但維生素D的缺乏也會增加多種疾病的患病風險, 如: 癌症、心血管疾病、憂鬱症及糖尿病的發生。由此可知, 維生素D缺乏症是個重要的大眾健康議題。部分維生素D可由食物中攝取, 但大部分是經由人體皮膚來生成; 而這生成過程需要太陽光的曝曬。在全世界的健康人口當中, 維生素D缺乏最主要的成因是因為接觸太陽光的時間不足。因此, 維生素D缺乏的問題多半出現在北緯度的國家, 尤其是在冬季; 但現今許多低緯度且長年多日照的國家也出現此問題, 主要是因為人們避免日曬且因為現代的室內生活模式所造成。現今多數香港年輕族群多在室內活動, 再加上香港空氣汙染的問題, 使得霧霾阻擋陽光, 進而影響人體內維生素D的生成。 我們因此假設維生素D缺乏是現今年輕族群的常見問題。再者, 我們假設維生素D缺乏與多種潛在且有害人體健康的生物性變化有關, 如: 較差的去氧核醣核酸修復能力、 增加去氧核醣核酸的損害、發炎反應、氧化壓力及表皮細胞官能不良等。這些因素的積累成為發展成慢性疾病的最大誘因。我們由此假設改善體內維生素D缺乏可以改善上述有害的生物性變化; 雖然, 長期的去氧核醣核酸損傷、發炎、氧化壓力及表皮細胞官能不良對健康的影響未有明確的關聯性。但有理由相信嚴重且長期積累的生物性變化對人體健康產生有害影響; 且改善這些生物性變化將有益於健康。如果維生素D缺乏確實普遍存在香港的年輕族群中, 又如果維生素D的缺乏確實與這些潛在的有害生物性變化息息相關, 而增加維生素D的攝取就可以有效改善且減少這些危害因子; 那麼大眾健康政策勸導早期檢測並改善維生素D缺乏將有科學的研究結果為依據。維生素D缺乏症的影響對香港及世界人口都有其重要性, 因此, 本研究計劃的發現將有其廣泛的價值及重要性。

560113.label: Realisation of objectives
560113.value: Objective 1. Achieved. The target number of subjects (200) of young, apparently healthy adults for Part 1 of the study was reached. Vitamin D status (as plasma 25(OHD) concentration) was measured on these samples by LC-MS/MS as planned, realising this objective 100%. Objective 2. Achieved. The planned comprehensive biomarker panel was measured, with the exception of DNA repair, for which we lacked adequate resources and time (and as noted in a previous report). Inter-relationship were examined between biomarkers and vitamin D status. It is noted that a complete biomarker panel could not be performed on all 200+ subjects for various reasons, as follows. Blood collection from some subjects resulted in less than the 20ml sample planned and some samples were haemolyzed and not suitable for testing, though our final number of viable samples collected and stored was 196, very close to our target number of 200, and we did not recruit additional new subjects due to time limits on the project. Some samples of cryopreserved lymphocytes for DNA damage testing were lost due to storage problems (freezer failure), other had been stored too long (>3months) before we could test them due to the fact that we lost a key reagent (FPG) in the freezer failure and had difficulty obtaining a replacement, and we experienced a complete failure of the computerized image capture and analysis used for the comet assay for DNA damage and repair (also as noted in a previous report). A new system was purchased by the department, but it took some time to obtain this and for us to become familiar with the new system. Without this key reagent and without an image capture and analysis system, the comet assay work had to be halted for several months. When the FPG-assisted comet assay work resumed, it became clear that many of our samples of cryopreserved lymphocytes collected at the beginning of the Part 1 sampling period were no longer viable for testing. Furthermore, the sensitivity of the new system was greater, giving higher DNA damage results as compared to the old system, and meaning that those data already collected on Part 1 samples using the old system prior to its crash could not be combined with those from the new system, This in effect meant that data previously collected could not be used. This unfortunate chain of events, which could not have been anticipated, meant that DNA damage results were available from 121 subjects. For some biomarkers measured by immunoassay kits (e.g. OxLDL, which is expensive), we had to take the approach of testing a sub-set of sample selected from across the spectrum of vitamin D status (also as mentioned in a previous report), as we had insufficient resources to test all 196. Still, we obtained results on most (120) samples. There were also serious problems with several other pieces of key laboratory equipment, and this led to a significant delay in completing Part 1 testing. Most importantly, this included breakdown of the LC-MS/MS system needed to measure several biomarkers - including vitamin D (plasma 25(OH)D), and without these results we could not identify suitable potential volunteers for Part II of the study (for which deficiency of vitamin D was a key inclusion criterion). This delay did not in the end impact on Part I of the study, which achieved its objectives, and which has resulted in output of several conference papers and three SCI indexed journal articles. However, it did lead to problems with Part II of the study, as unfortunately the long delay meant we lost contact with some of our suitable, vitamin D deficient volunteers, while others lost interested in continuing to participate in the study (Part II). This delay led to an approved 6m extension (from Fe-Aug 2016) of the project. This time was used to good effect in completing the study. Objective 3. Achieved, though Part II was a scaled down supplementation study (as explained in a previous report, and due to the difficulties outlined above). This was unfortunate, but nonetheless the smaller version of Part II was completed successfully, with data collected on 15 and 10 subjects completing 12 weeks of vitamin D or placebo treatment, respectively. A paper with data from this part of the study has been submitted for publication to an SCI journal (European Journal of Nutrition). Overall, despite being smaller than planned due to delays caused by extensive and serious technical problems that could not have been anticipated in their scale and duration, this objective was addressed to the best of our ability and within the time frame permitted, has generated new, interesting and potentially valuable data. Objective 4: Achieved. We saw no effect of improvement vitamin D status on mood or muscle strength but saw some evidence of improvement in balance. This information was presented at a local conference and a paper is in preparation for submission. Overall, the project has been completed successfully, with interesting and novel findings, and has generated very good output in terms of SCI journal articles and conference papers. Reasons for the 'under-achievement' (85%) for objective 3 are described above. The technical problems were overcome, but this took time, perseverence and great effort, and the unforseeable delay in proceeding to Part II that was forced by these problems resulted in a smaller (but nonetheless successfully completed) supplementation study than was initially planned.

560113.label: Major findings and research outcome
560113.value: Major findings: 1. Deficiency of vitamin D (generally agreed as plasma 25(OH)D concentration <50 nmol/l) was found in 75% of 220 young (18-26y), apparently healthy, non-smoking, non-obese young adults living in Hong Kong; 7% were severely deficient in vitamin D (25(OH)D <25 nmol/l); only 2 subjects had plasma 25(OH)D in the suggested optimal range of 75-110 nmol/l. 2. There was evidence of a poorer cardiometabolic (glycaemic control and lipids) biomarker profile in those with lower vitamin D status (p<0.05) 3. There was a weak but statistically significant (r = 0.252; p<0.05) direct association between vitamin D status and total antioxidant status in plasma (assessed using the FRAP assay), and those in the lowest 25(OH)D quartile and group had significantly lower FRAP values (p<0.05). 4. No significant association was seen between vitamin D status and DNA damage in the observational arm 5. 12 weeks of supplementation with 2400 IU/day vitamin D3 was adequate to correct deficiency in all subjects, with a doubling of the average plasma 25(OH)D concentration (p<0.001). 6. Correction of deficiency resulted in a significant decrease in lymphocytic DNA damage (4.4% absolute/18% relative decrease in % DNA in comet tail; p<0.05); plasma PTH also decreased (p<0.01) 7. There was some evidence of a decrease in lipid peroxidation (assessed by plasma oxidized LDL concentration) after 12 weeks of vitamin D supplementation, but this did not reach statistical significance when compared to the placebo treatment. 8. There were no significant supplementation-related effects observed on biomarkers of antioxidant status, oxidative stress, glycaemic control, endothelial activation, inflammation or lipids, but a longer period of follow-up after correction of deficiency has been achieved is recommended. 9. The results of this study add to a growing database of vitamin D status from various parts of the world, and reveal very high prevalence of deficiency in a group of young, apparently healthy adults in Hong Kong. In addition, this study has demonstrated that 12 weeks of 2400 IU/day vitamin D3 is well tolerated, is sufficient to correct vitamin D deficiency in otherwise healthy young adults, and that this may have potentially beneficial effects on DNA damage and, possibly, lipid peroxidation. 10. The findings of this study provide support for public health strategies to address a very high prevalence of vitamin D deficiency in young, apparently adults in Hong Kong, and will support further research on vitamin D deficiency as a modifiable risk factor for noncommunicable diseases (NCDs), such as cancer, cardiovascular disease and diabetes.

560113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560113.value: There is large potential for further development of this research. Healthy young adults are a little studied but valuable group for preventive healthcare. NCD is generally diagnosed at an advanced stage, when it is generally incurable and difficult and expensive to treat. Intervention addressing risk factors at an early stage is key to managing the huge and increasing NCD burden worldwide. NCD risk is a composite of many different factors. Vitamin D deficiency may be one and, importantly, is both common and easily corrected. While intervention that addresses an individual factor may result in only a small decrement in overall risk, given the size of the NCD burden in our ageing populations and the very high prevalence of vitamin D deficiency, the overall impact on public health could be substantial. The results of this study will help guide future studies, of larger size and longer duration/follow-up, into the effects of correction of vitamin D deficiency in otherwise still-healthy young subjects, with focus on the early, reversible changes associated with NCD developing in later life, and using a comprehensive panel of sensitive and specific biomarkers. However, no specific course of action is planned as the PI (Prof Iris Benzie) has retired.

560113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560113.value: Vitamin D, the 'sunshine vitamin', is needed for bone health, but low vitamin D is associated with increased risk of non-skeletal diseases, including cancer, diabetes and heart disease. Vitamin D deficiency is common in many areas of the world, but previously we lacked information on young, apparently healthy adults in Hong Kong. Also, we lack understanding of how vitamin D deficiency links to underlying biochemical changes (risk factors) in blood or cells that signal increased risk of disease developing in later life. In this project we found that 75% of over 200 young healthy adults studied were deficient in vitamin D. We saw evidence of a poorer blood plasma risk factor profile in those with the lowest vitamin D status, saw an association between vitamin D status and plasma antioxidant status, found that taking 2400IU/day of vitamin D3 for 12 weeks is adequate to correct deficiency, and saw significantly lower DNA damage in white blood cells after correction of deficiency. These findings provide support for public health strategies to address the high amount of vitamin D deficiency observed in young adults in Hong Kong, and will help guide further research on vitamin D deficiency and its links to disease.

560513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
560513.value: Short-sightedness (i.e. myopia) is the most common refractive error in the world, especially in Asia. Inappropriate elongation of the eyeball is the main cause of myopia. Emmetropization is a process to adjust the eye growth to compensate the refractive power of eyeball in order to achieve clear vision, the factors involved in the emmetropization are the keys to control myopia progression. Apart from heredity, previous studies reported that the eye growth process is regulated by visual stimuli with different optical defocus (i.e. blur). Recently, numerous studies suggested that this visually guided eye growth to different refractive errors is highly related to the peripheral optical blur rather than central optical blur. However, we recently discovered that the retinal activity between myopic adult and myopic children is very different. As compared to the low myopic groups, the high myopic adults and children showed subclinical weaker activities in the peripheral retina and central retina (i.e. fovea) respectively. In addition, we also noticed that the children with higher myopia progression would have subclinical weaker foveal function but it is not shown in adults. Therefore, we speculate that poor subclinical foveal function found in myopic children is not the result of myopia because this function is not found in myopic adults. The peripheral optical defocus is the key to trigger myopia and the poor foveal function together is likely a factor to determine the end point of myopic development. This study aims to investigate the interactive effects among family history, peripheral refractive errors, foveal function (including retinal and cortical functions) on emmetropization by a 4-year longitudinal study in myopic children. This would help to understand how the peripheral defocus and foveal activity contribute in the eye growth in terms of myopia progression and this would benefit the prediction of myopia onset and the rate of myopia progression. 近視是最常見的屈光不正, 尤其是在亞洲。不適當的眼球增長是造成近視的主要原因。正視化是一個調整眼球發育的機制，用來補償眼睛的折射功率以達到清晰的視力。涉及正視化過程的因素是控制近視進展的主因，除了遺傳，眼睛的生長過程是受光學離焦(即模糊) 的視覺刺激所影響。許多最近的研究認為，這視覺引導的屈光不正變化高度與周邊的而不是中央的光學模糊相關。 然而，我們最近發現，近視的成年人之視網膜的生理活動與近視的孩子有很大的不同。相比淺近視組，深近視的成人在視網膜周邊呈較弱的亞臨床功能，但深近視的兒童則在視網膜中央呈較弱的亞臨床功能。此外我們也注意到孩子們有較弱的亞臨床黃斑功能便呈現較高的近視增長。因此，較弱的亞臨床黃斑功能估計不是近視的孩子出現近視的結果，我們推測周邊光學模糊是引發近視的關鍵，而較弱的亞臨床黃斑功能是一個確定近視發展終點的因素。本4年縱向研究旨在通過調查家族史，周邊屈光不正，黃斑功能之間在兒童正視化機制的相互關係。這將有助於了解眼球增長與近視進展，並有利於預測近視進展的速度。

560513.label: Realisation of objectives
560513.value: In this study, we achieve all the listed objectives by a 4-year longitudinal study to investigate how the foveal function influences the myopic progression in children. We finally recruited 120 non-myopic subjects who had 9 visits (1 baseline exam and 8 follow-up visits) during this 4-year period. In the eye exam, we obtained the clinical data including family myopic history, central and peripheral refractive errors, central retinal structure measurement via optical coherent tomography and foveal functional evaluation via visual electrophysiological measurement. Upon the collected data from the 1st and the 2nd year, we started to analyse the separate effect of foveal function; family history; peripheral refractive errors on myopia development in this group of initial non-myopic children. We discovered that only foveal function from inner retinal layer has a significant correlation with the myopia development in children. Those with subclinical weakened foveal function would have relatively fast myopia progression. But the family history and peripheral refractive errors cannot show any correlation with myopia progression in this group of children. However, we accidently found that the environmental constrict is associated with myopia development. In addition, we could not find out any relationship between family history and foveal functions or between peripheral refractive errors and foveal function in myopia development. Therefore, we also started to evaluate how the foveal retinal structure relates to the foveal function in myopic development. Moreover, we also used another approach to re-evaluate the peripheral refractive errors and myopia development and found that peripheral astigmatism may associate with myopia development. Currently, the sensitivity and specificity of myopia progression prediction based on our findings of foveal function are up to about 70-75%. Hence, we now are trying to evaluate the interactive effects among age, refractive errors, family history and foveal function after obtaining 4-year data and hopefully we will develop a new algorithm to achieve nearly 90% to predict the myopia development for individual child. Throughout the experiment of 4-year study, the objectives of this study were achieved.

560513.label: Major findings and research outcome
560513.value: 1. We found that under low SF, outer retinal responses were different with myopic or hyperopic defocus, suggesting that the retinal region around fovea may be the site for the decoding of defocus. In addition, the inner retinal response change in differentiating optical defocus was also noticed. Sign-dependent retinal activity was observed for the low spatial frequency (SF) stimulus. This suggests that the retina is more effective in extracting defocus under low SF than under high SF. The human retina seems to have a decoding system for optical defocus, which was tuned for low spatial frequency. The outer and inner retina have different characteristics in processing spatial details under optical defocus. This enrich the understanding of emmetropization and the mechanism in myopia progression. 2. By evaluating the living details from each subject, ocular axial length was found to be significantly longer among those living in districts with a higher population density and those living in a smaller home. Axial length in children and childhood refractive error were associated with high population density and small home size. A constricted living space may be an environmental threat for myopia development in children. This showed that family history is not a contributing factor in myopia development, but the environmental influence is important. This initiates the next step to investigate the interaction between the retinal decoding system and the environmental input. 3. The inner retinal response from fovea measured at low contrast level from the emmetropic children was found to be significantly correlated with the subsequent refractive error change in the following years. Based on this finding, emmetropic children with subclinical decreased inner retinal function may be more likely to subsequently develop myopia. The prospective changes we have shown are believed to derive from central inner retina. These changes appear to precede myopia which has the sensitivity and specificity over 70-75% and could be a potential reference for juvenile myopia development. This important finding will help us to develop a new algorithm to predict the myopia development for individual child.

560513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560513.value: 1. We are planning to use a mammalian myopia model to investigate the possible mechanism how the central inner retina dictates the myopia development. 2. We are also planning to apply ITF for the development of a customized visual electroretinogram unit with a new algorithm to achieve nearly 90% to predict the myopia development for individual child. 3. We are also planning to apply GRF to dissect the role of spatial-defocus interaction in regulation of eye growth using a mammalian myopia model and to determine if modification of this attribute can reduce myopia progression. 4. If we are successful to find out the role of spatial-defocus interaction in eye growth regulation, we may apply ITF to develop the special visual stimulus for myopia retardation.

560513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560513.value: This study is to investigate how different factors, including retinal function, family history, refractive error and environmental factors, involve for the short-sightedness development or progression. Our results showed that retinal function and environmental factors significantly contributed to development or progression of the short-sightedness . We found that the visual details received by the eyes would interact with the optical defocus which may be associated with the short-sightedness development or progression. In addition, the retinal function is also significantly associated with the short-sightedness development or progression. We found that children with subclinical decreased retinal function may be more likely to subsequently develop myopia in the following years. Lastly, we also showed that restricted living environment is significantly correlated with the prevalence of short-sightedness. A constricted living space may be an threat for myopia development in children.

560813.label: Realisation of objectives
560813.value: Both objectives have been completed. For objective 1, we have designed, synthesized and characterized 50 new flaovnoid monomers for their anti-leishmanial activities. These novel flavonoid monomers form the basis of our filed patents which can be used for future clinical development. The lead optimization process also allows us to study the structure activity relationship of the flavonoid monomers as anti-leishmanial agents. This will allow us to further optimize the potency and oral bioavailability in the future. For objective 2, we have optimized the flavonoid monomers in terms of metabolic stability and oral bioavailability. The metabolic stability can be improved in compound FM09h over its parent compound of FM09. The methoxy substitution at FM09h increased the metabolic stability as well as oral bioavailability. For the compound FM05b, the oral bioavaility as measured in 30-minute single time point pharmacokinetic experiment was very high at more than 90%. The overall F is 8%. The liver accumulation of FM05b is superior with its liver and spleen accmulation level higher than its in vitro IC50 at 24 hours post oral administration. Both FM09h and FM05b are non-toxic when administered either in intralesion or per oral route. We discovered that FM09h and FM05b are particularly potent towards cutaneous and visceral leishmaniasis. FM05 is of particular interest because of its high oral bioavailability. The major achievement of this project is that FM05b was found to be accumulating to the target organ of spleen and liver. The in vitro potency is at sub-micromolar concentration. This is by far the only potent and bioavailable flavonoid compounds that can be used to treat visceral leishmaniasis. This can be used as an alternative to miltefosine which is currently the only oral antileishmanial drug. FM05b will be of particular interest to treating miltefosine-resistant cases.

560813.label: Major findings and research outcome
560813.value: We have designed, synthesized and characterized a library of 50 novel flavonoid compounds and demonstrated that they are potent in vitro against Leishmania parasites that cause leishmaniasis, a tropical disease endemic in 80 countries worldwide. They have an IC50 of 0.4 – 1.1 µM against promastigotes and IC50 of 0.4 – 1.1 µM against amastigotes, effective against sodium stibogluconate-resistant parasites, safe (IC50 against mouse fibroblasts = 33 – 100 µM and caused no toxicity in rodents), orally bioavailable (F = 60%), metabolically stable with 91.5% and 83.1 % FM05b remaining 30% after incubation with human and rat liver microsomes; can accumulate in spleen and liver (target organs of visceral Leishmania) at a level (0.8 and 1.8 µM respectively) above its in vitro IC50 of 0.7 uM at 24 hours after oral administration of FM05b 50 mg/kg. In vivo efficacy study demonstrated that intraleision administration of FM09h and FM05b (intraleision 10 mg/kg, every 4 days for 8 times) could reduce the foot pad lesion thickness in cutaneous model of Leishmaniasis (L. amazonensis LV78) by 73% and 50% respectively compared with saline group. In addition, oral administration of FM05b (oral 50 mg/kg; daily for 14 days) can reduce parasite burden of visceral model of leishmaniasis (L. donovani LdHU3) in liver by 33% with no toxicity observed.

560813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560813.value: Patents for the novel flavonoid monomers have been filed. Given the fact the there is only one oral antileishmanial drugs available, we can seek for further clinical development of FM05b in the future as an alternative oral antileishmanial drug.

560813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560813.value: We have used medicinal chemistry approach to develop new drugs against a parasitic disease, leishmaniasis. We found that we can improve the efficacy by modification of the flavonoid structure. The potency of these new flavonoids in treating leishmania is at micromolar concentration. They are non toxic and can be administered orally. This is of particular importance because leishmaniasis is a disease affecting developing countries. An oral drug is desired. This is the first time we demonstrate that flavonoid can be administered orally to treat leishmaniasis. In the future, we can develop this class of new antileishmanial compounds as an alternative treatment protocol for miltefosine which is currently the only oral drug but suffers from drug resistance problems and its mutagenic effect on pregnant patients.

560913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
560913.value: Glaucoma is a severe ocular disease that ranks as the second leading cause of blindness in the world. It is often associated with an increased intraocular pressure (IOP). Until now, glaucoma remains incurable although its onset and progression can be delayed by interventions that reduce IOP. Lowering IOP remains the mainstay for glaucoma treatment and is the only approach proven to effectively retard the progression of vision impairment. Physiologically, aqueous humor is produced by a dual-layered ciliary epithelium comprising the pigment ciliary epithelium (PE) and non-pigmented ciliary epithelium (NPE). Transepithelial Cl- secretion across the ciliary epithelium is recognized as a major force for driving aqueous humor production. However, the precise mechanism(s) controlling aqueous humor secretion are still unclear. Cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) is an intracellular second messenger that modulates aqueous humor secretion, however, its precise physiologic significance remains controversial. For example, beta-adrenergic agonists which stimulate endogenous cAMP production as well as beta--adrenergic antagonists cause parallel hypotensive effect in both experimental animals and human. Clinically, beta-adrenergic antagonists have been commonly used to treat patients with glaucoma. Whether or not the effects of these antagonists are mediated through a cAMP-dependent pathway is unknown. The complexity of the responses reported in the literatures can be due to variations among animal species, as well as multiple effects elicited by agonists and antagonists on the aqueous humor dynamics. The major focus of this proposal is to examine how cAMP and beta-adrenergic modulation affect aqueous humor dynamics in porcine eyes. This question will be addressed by using physiologic approaches to study the effects of beta-adrenergic agonists and antagonists, as well as other cAMP-stimulating agents on aqueous humor secretion using ciliary epithelial cell couplets, isolated ciliary body preparations and arterially-perfused eyes. This information is fundamental to the understanding in this field and devising new clinical approach for glaucoma therapy. 青光眼是一種嚴重的眼病，在世界致盲性眼病中排名第二。青光眼通常與高眼內壓（IOP）有關。直到現在，雖然透過降低眼壓可以延緩青光眼的發病及進展，但青光眼仍然是一種不可治愈的疾病。降低眼內壓是治療青光眼的主要方法，而且是唯一被證實可以有效延緩視功能受損的方法。從生理學方面來看，房水分泌源於雙層結構的睫狀體上皮，包括睫狀體色素上皮細胞（PE）和無色素上皮細胞（NPE）。睫狀體上皮的氯離子轉運被認為是促進房水分泌的主要動力。然而，怎樣調控房水的分泌機制仍然不清楚。環磷酸腺苷（cAMP）是一種細胞內第二信使，可以調控房水分泌，然而其確切的生理意義還有待確定。例如，在動物和人體試驗中，β-腎上腺素受體激動劑（能刺激內源性cAMP的產生）和β-腎上腺素受體拮抗劑都能產生對應的降壓效應。臨床上，β-腎上腺素受體拮抗劑已經普遍用於青光眼的治療。但是，這種拮抗劑的治療效應是否受cAMP的調控仍然還不大清晰。這可能是由於β-腎上腺素受體拮抗劑對房水動力學的影響在不同物種間的反應變異以及自身的反應多效性導致複雜不清的結果。本研究計劃的重點是檢驗在豬眼中cAMP和β-腎上腺素對其調控房水動力學的影響。研究計劃運用生理學方法，選用睫狀體上皮細胞對、離體睫狀體組織以及動脈灌注豬眼探究β-腎上腺素受體激動劑和拮抗劑，以及其他cAMP激動劑對房水分泌的影響。本研究對於增進對於房水分泌機制的理解以及臨床治療青光眼的研究提供重要資料和數據。

560913.label: Realisation of objectives
560913.value: Objective 1: Effect of cAMP on transepithelial fluid flow and electrical measurements Experiments completed. We have demonstrated that addition of cAMP to the aqueous side causes a simultaneous stimulation of short-circuit current (Isc) and transepithelial fluid movement across excised porcine ciliary body preparations. When added to the stromal surface, however, the stimulatory effect of cAMP on Isc is subtle. Similarly, forskolin, a direct activator of adenylate cyclase, has been shown to increase Isc and fluid secretion across the isolated preparations, indicating the presence of an intact adenylate cyclase system in excised ciliary epithelium. Like cAMP, forskolin is found to trigger a larger stimulation of Isc when added to the aqueous surface. In addition, the effects of both cAMP and forskolin can be abolished by Cl- channel blockers and/or bathing Cl- substitution, indicating that cAMP acts primarily through transepithelial Cl- secretion. Pretreatment of protein kinase A (PKA) blockers significantly inhibits the cAMP-induced Isc stimulation. Objective 2: Effect of cAMP on gap junction permeability using ciliary epithelial cell couplets Experiments completed. We have investigated the effects of cAMP/forskolin on intercellular gap junction permeability in porcine ciliary epithelium using Lucifer Yellow (LY) dye transfer technique. Consistent with transepithelial measurements, our results show that cAMP/forskolin increases dye (solutes) movement across isolated porcine PE-NPE cell couplets, potentially leading to an increased Cl- transport and aqueous humor secretion rate. Pretreatment with PKA inhibitors has no effect on cAMP-induced changes in gap junction permeability between PE and NPE cells. Objective 3: Effect of cAMP on whole-cell Cl- currents using patch clamp technique Experiments completed. Using whole-cell patch clamp techniques, the effects of cAMP/forskolin on whole-cell Cl- currents in NPE cells were examined. Our results demonstrate that cAMP and forskolin stimulate the swelling-activated whole-cell Cl- currents of native porcine NPE cells. The administration of PKA inhibitor significantly blocks the cAMP-activated Cl- channels. In parallel with electrophysiological measurements, cAMP is found to decrease the intracellular Cl- concentration in NPE cells. This is possibly mediated by an enhanced Cl- efflux from NPE cells to the posterior chamber.

560913.label: Major findings and research outcome
560913.value: Our results show that both cAMP and forskolin cause a dose-dependent increase in Isc when added to the aqueous side of the preparation (i.e. facing the posterior chamber). In addition, we have for the first time shown that aqueous administration of cAMP and forskolin trigger a concomitant increase in fluid flow in the stromal-to-aqueous direction, supporting the important role of cAMP in facilitating aqueous humor secretion (IOVS, 2016). The stimulatory effect of cAMP/forskolin can be abolished by bathing Cl- substitution and Cl- channel blockers, suggesting that cAMP possibly acts by stimulating Cl- transport across the ciliary epithelium. Moreover, pretreatment of H89, a PKA inhibitor, significantly blocks the cAMP-mediated Isc stimulation, suggesting that the cAMP-mediated Isc stimulation is PKA-dependent (IOVS, 2016). Based on the results obtained from transepithelial measurements, it is possible that cAMP acts by stimulating Cl- channels in NPE cells. We have demonstrated that cAMP stimulates the outwardly rectifying, swelling-activated whole-cell Cl- currents in NPE, but not PE cells (IOVS, in preparation). Concomitantly, cAMP triggers a reduction of intracellular Cl- concentration in native NPE cells, supporting the notion that cAMP enhances Cl- efflux into the eye, thereby potentially increasing the rate of aqueous humor secretion. Likewise, pretreatment with PKA blocker significantly inhibits the cAMP-activated Cl- currents (IOVS, in preparation). In addition to Cl- channels, cAMP is found to modulate the gap junction permeability between PE and NPE cells. Our results show that heptanol pretreatment abolishes the cAMP-mediated Isc stimulation, suggesting that gap junctions linking PE and NPE cells may be a potential target for cAMP-mediated responses. Recently, we have characterized that the expression of connexin in porcine ciliary epithelium. Our results demonstrate that Cx43 is the major gap junction protein present at the apical membrane linking PE and NPE cells and is primarily responsible for transferring fluid and solutes across the ciliary epithelium (ARVO, 2016; IOVS, 2018). Using LY dye transfer technique, we have shown that cAMP triggers a sustained increase in gap junction permeability across porcine PE-NPE cell couplets, potentially leading to an increase in aqueous humor formation. Given that the measurements of transepithelial parameters including Isc are subject to PKA modulation, the functional significance of PKA pathway in regulating gap junction coupling was also evaluated. Unlike transepithelial measurements, the stimulatory effect of cAMP on gap junctional permeability is shown to be independent of PKA signaling cascades (IOVS, in preparation).

560913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
560913.value: Our results support the notion that cAMP is functionally significant in regulating aqueous humor secretion. In particular, the stimulation of Cl- and fluid transfer by cAMP administration to the aqueous surface indicates that Cl- efflux by NPE cells may play an important role in mediating cAMP-induced responses. Recently, our efforts are directed towards understanding the role of melatonin in regulating aqueous humor dynamics. Melatonin is a natural hormone and has been proposed to play a vital role in governing the diurnal variation in IOP and aqueous flow. Our preliminary results show that melatonin stimulates the endogenous production of cAMP in porcine ciliary epithelium. Similar to cAMP/forskolin, melatonin is shown to stimulate the Isc when added to the aqueous side. Apart from Isc stimulation, melatonin is also found to increase the fluid transfer across the intact ciliary epithelium (ARVO, 2018). Currently, we are trying to characterize the involvement of different melatonin receptors in mediating the stimulatory response.

560913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
560913.value: Glaucoma ranks as the second leading cause of blindness worldwide and is often referred as ‘silent blinder’ because of the absence of noticeable symptoms at the early stage of the disease. Glaucoma is frequently associated with elevated eye pressure which subsequently results in profound loss of retinal neurons. Currently, lowering eye pressure is the most effective treatment to delay the progression of vision loss. cAMP is an intracellular second messenger that involves in eye pressure regulation, however, its precise physiologic significance remains controversial. We show that cAMP stimulates the ion and fluid secretion across the ciliary epithelium, potentially resulting in an increased aqueous humor secretion. The stimulatory response is possibly mediated by the modulation of Cl- channel activities and gap junction permeability. Our results may contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of the regulation of transport mechanism and aqueous humor formation, and potentially aiding the development of anti-glaucoma drugs.

561013.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
561013.value: 在香港，80%的儿童在离开学校时已患有近视。这类儿童可以随时通过佩戴眼镜，角膜接触镜或是接受准分子屈光矫正术来矫正模糊的视力。 然而，从长远来看，考虑到视网膜脱离、青光眼、白内障等近视并发症，近视患儿发生不可逆视力损害甚至失明的风险相对增高。因为在每一代人中，由近视相关性眼病所引起的不可逆视力丧失的情况越来越多，以致近视在香港、台湾、新加坡及其他亚洲城市中逐渐被认为是导致视力损害和失明的首要危险因素。 目前人们已经尝试过多种方法来延缓近视加深的速度。然而，没有哪种方法能长期有效地控制近视加深的进程，同时许多目前的治疗手段，尤其是长期应用后，存在一定的潜在的副作用。因此，我们迫切需要研发一种安全、全面有效的近视治疗方案。 遗传学及其相关研究技术的进步，对深入研究疾病作用的分子通路产生了重要影响。这同时也引出了一些更好的治疗方案，如针对ERBB2基因扩增型的转移癌症的治疗。根据假设：基因-环境相互作用对决定哪类人群易患近视而哪类人群不易患近视起到了重要的影响，我们将应用最先进的遗传学和转录组学技术来确定近视进展的分子通路 有强有力的证据显示，基因易感性及环境暴露因素都可诱发近视。在一群近视眼模型动物中，通过一个选择性培育实验，我们发现，动物之间对环境诱导近视所表现出的易感性差异，有56% (95% C.I. 49 - 64%)归因于遗传因素，这揭示了一个重要的基因-环境相互作用法则。这个发现恰巧印证了一个流行病学研究：即使暴露在导致大部分儿童患近视的环境中，有的儿童自身仍然能抵抗近视的进程。 要想确定人类基因-环境相互作用的引发近视的分子极具挑战，因为需要检测成千上万的DNA变异序列，而且不同个体暴露于环境中的危险因素也各不相同。因此，依照实验计划，我们将通过我们的动物模型确定调控近视视觉易感性的主要基因，然后在儿童身上检测新筛查出的候选基因。这项工作的主要意义在于发掘新的抑制近视进程的治疗靶点。

561013.label: Realisation of objectives
561013.value: (1) We have completed the creation of a biological resource for mapping gene-environment interaction loci (Objective 1: 100% Achieved). In total, 1000 chicks were form-deprived for 4 days, carefully phenotyped using retinoscopy and high-resolution A-scan ultrasonography, and blood samples and retina samples collected. Progress in this part of the project (months 0-24) was slower than expected, which meant that we had to reduce the target sample size from 2000 chicks to 1000 chicks. The reasons for the slower than expected progress were as follows. (a) The GRF award was 33% lower than requested, meaning we could not employ a technician to prepare animals for ocular measurements and assist with recovery after anaesthesia, which are time-consuming steps that are important regarding the ethical welfare of the animals. (b) Avian flu outbreaks meant that chicks could not be used for several months. We should have revised this objective in due course. However, the original PI and a current co-I (Jeremy Guggenheim) did not told the new PI (myself) until a very late stage. (2) We have mapped the strongest gene-environment interaction loci in the above experimental animals (Objective 2: 100% Achieved). We extracted DNA samples from the 1000 chicks studied, and sent DNA samples from 384 animals for high-density SNP genotyping (these 384 animals represented the 192 with the highest level of environmentally -induced myopia and the 192 with the lowest level of environmentally -induced myopia). Chicks in the phenotype extremes were selected for genotyping because of reduced budget (also see above). We carried out a genome-wide association study (GWAS) for susceptibility to environmentally-induced myopia in the 384 genotyped chicks. This identified one genome-wide significant locus on chromosome 1 and a second suggestive locus on chromosome 12 of the chick genome. These are the first ever genetic loci for environmentally-induced myopia susceptibility in an animal model. These findings were presented at a UK conference (UK Eye Genetics Group Meeting, 2016) and the ARVO conference in the United States in May 2017. We also examined the GWAS candidate region in 3 human cohorts: Consortium for Refractive Error and Myopia (CREAM; n=44,192), UK Biobank (n=95,505) and Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC; n=4,989). In these 3 datasets, the human homologues were also enriched for strongly associated markers. (3) We have successfully evaluated the role of corresponding gene variants in a cohort of children with detailed information on myopia development and environmental risk exposures (Objective 3: 100% Achieved). For ALSPAC participants (n=4,989), refractive development had been followed from age 7.5 to 15.5 years old. In addition, their information on time spent reading and time outdoors was available. To reduce the extent of multiple testing, only the 3 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) most strongly associated with refractive error in the 3 adult GWAS (see above) were evaluated. In ALSPAC cohorts, one SNP had an age-dependent association with refractive error and a nearby variant showed evidence of a gene x environment (GxE) interaction with time spent reading.

561013.label: Major findings and research outcome
561013.value: The overall aim of the project was to test the hypothesis that genetic analysis of susceptibility to visual experience-induced myopia in an animal model would identify novel GxE interaction loci. Chicks (n=987) were monocularly deprived of form vision for 4 days. A genome-wide association study (GWAS) was carried out in the 20% of chicks most susceptible and least susceptible to form-deprivation (n=380). In total, 304,963 genetic markers were tested for association with the degree of induced axial elongation in treated versus control eyes (A-scan ultrasonography). A GWAS candidate region was examined in 3 human cohorts: CREAM consortium (n=44,192), UK Biobank (n=95,505), and Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC; n=4,989). A locus encompassing the genes PIK3CG and PRKAR2B was genome-wide significantly associated with myopia susceptibility in chicks (lead variant rs317386235, P=9.54e-08). In CREAM and UK Biobank GWAS datasets, PIK3CG and PRKAR2B were enriched for stronglyassociated markers (meta-analysis lead variant rs117909394, P=1.7e-07). In ALSPAC participants, rs117909394 had an age-dependent association with refractive error (-0.22 D change over 8 years, P=5.2e-04) and nearby variant rs17153745 showed evidence of a GxE interaction with time spent reading (effect size -0.23 D, P=0.022). In conclusion, this work identified the PIK3CG-PRKAR2B locus as a mediator of susceptibility to visually-induced myopia in chicks and suggests a role for this locus in conferring susceptibility to myopia in human cohorts.

561013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
561013.value: Only about 38% of the collected chick DNA samples were genotyped using genome-wide chip because of limited budget. Future studies with larger sample sizes would be expected to discover a greater number of candidate loci for follow-up. Fine-mapping of the PIK3CG-PRKAR2B locus with large human cohorts should be followed up to identify the causal variants and subsequently the underlying biological mechanisms.

561013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
561013.value: Myopia (nearsightedness) is a leading cause of visual impairment and blindness worldwide, especially in Asia where its prevalence has reached 80-90% in some populations. There is evidence that time spent outdoors in childhood and years spent in education are causal risk factors for myopia, and numerous common genetic variants associated with myopia have also been discovered. Nevertheless, most of the inheritance characteristics myopia remains unexplained, suggesting that gene-environment interactions may play a role. Gene-environment interactions have proven difficult to identify: few examples relevant to myopia have been reported, and fewer still have been replicated. In the current work, we took a novel approach by carrying out a genome-wide association study in an established animal model of environmentally-induced myopia – with the aim of identifying genetic variants associated with susceptibility to environmentally-induced myopia. This led to the identification of a single genome-wide significant locus that harboured two genes related to PI3K signalling: PIK3CG and PRKAR2B. Turning to human genetics studies, we found that the PIK3CG-PRKAR2B locus was associated with susceptibility to myopia in 2 large adult GWAS datasets, and in a child cohort, in which we also found evidence of a gene-environment interaction with time children spent reading.
