589413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
589413.value: Primary nephrotic syndrome (PNS) is a kidney problem that is hallmarked by the damage of podocytes and leakage of protein into the urine (proteinuria). Podcytes are complex, highly differentiated cells that guard the filtration barrier. They are able to repair themselves but, unfortunately, they have limited ability to divide and replace the damaged cells. Progressive loss of podocytes leads to end stage kidney diseases, posing a heavy burden to the family and society. Therefore, it is important to identify effective therapeutic strategies to control the development and progression of PNS. Two highly regulated cell death mechanisms in our body are called apoptosis (self killing) and autophagy (self eating). Apoptosis is a vital component of normal cell turnover for proper development and functioning of our body. However, inappropriate cell death will cause functional decline in various organs. Autophagy is an adaptive response to stress, involving the clearing of damaged proteins/organelles to provide the cells with energy for repair. Recently, the induction of autophagy in neurons protects them from apoptosis suggesting the potential therapeutic value of autophagy in neurodegenerative diseases. What about PNS? Can we harness the protective effect of autophagy in apoptotic podocytes? In renal diseases. the study of autophagy is scanty and the mode of activation and its potential protective role remain unclear. In this project, we focus on studying the role of autophagy in apoptotic podocytes. Based on our preliminary experiments, we hypothesize that both apoptosis and autophagy may be triggered by common signals and involved similar downstream signalling molecules. The crosstalk between the cell death pathways may contribute to the functional link between autophagy and apoptosis. We reason that by modulating the molecules involved in podocyte autophagy, the effect of apoptosis will be ameliorated. In our experiment, we will use a PNS cell model to evaluate the effect of autophagy and determine the mechanisms involved. We will determine the effect of manipulating autophagy on podocyte apoptosis. As a proof of principle, we will manipulate autophagy in rat models of PNS and measure the progression of proteinuria, renal function, histopathology and structural changes in the rat kidneys. Ultimately, we hope to translate our findings into clinical use. The knowledge gained in podocyte autophagy will provide insights for the design of drugs to enhance podocyte survival in PNS and be extended to other kidney diseases involving podocyte pathology. The molecules identified may also become biomarkers for disease diagnosis and prognosis. 足細胞損傷及蛋白尿的產生是原發性腎病綜合征的顯著特徵。足細胞是一種複雜的高度分化的細胞，在腎小球濾過屏障中發揮著關鍵作用。足細胞具備自身修復的能力，但是他們自我分化進而取代受損細胞的能力十分有限。進行性的足細胞脫落可導致終末期腎病，給社會及患者家庭帶來沉重的負擔。因此，為原發性腎病綜合征尋找新的治療方案十分重要。 細胞凋亡和細胞自噬是人體內兩種高度調控的細胞死亡機制，細胞凋亡是人體生長發育及發揮正常功能必不可少的一種細胞更新方式。然而，異常的細胞死亡將影響器官的正常功能。自噬是機體對應激的一種適應性反應，可以有效清除損傷的細胞器或蛋白，並為修復損傷提供能量。近來研究發現神經元自噬的誘導可有效抵抗細胞凋亡，這提示在神經退行性病變中細胞自噬具有潛在治療的作用。它可應用於腎病綜合征嗎？我們能有效地駕馭這種保護性作用而防止足細胞凋亡嗎？ 在腎臟疾病中，自噬的相關研究甚少，其啟動的模式和其潛在的保護性作用仍然不清，在本專案中，我們著重於研究細胞自噬對足細胞凋亡的影響。基於我們的預實驗結果，我們假設一些共同的細胞信號作用於細胞自噬和凋亡的啟動，並涉及一些相似的下游蛋白分子。這些細胞死亡通路的串話調控可能影響細胞自噬和凋亡。因此，我們有理由相信，通過調控一些細胞自噬的的相關蛋白分子，將有利於降低細胞凋亡的比率。 在我們的實驗中，我們使用原發性腎病綜合征的模型來評估細胞自噬的作用，並研究相關的機制。為了證明我們的假設，我們將調控原發性腎病綜合征大鼠模型的細胞自噬，並檢測蛋白尿，腎功能，免疫組化和腎臟亞微結構的變化。 最終，我們希望轉化我們的研究成果，應用於臨床。該課題的開展將有利於未來腎病綜合征治療藥物的研發，並延伸至其他腎臟疾病的治療。該課題所發現的一些的蛋白分子也將可能成為腎臟疾病診斷及預後評估的分子標記物。

589413.label: Realisation of objectives
589413.value: With reference to the Mid-term Progress Report, we had already completed 80%, 100% and 50% of Objectives 1, 2 and 3 respectively in June 2015. In this completion report, we have achieved 100% of all objectives and extended our study of autophagy into toll-like receptor (TLR) expression and lupus nephritis. New achievements have been added: Objective 1 to evaluate the effect of autophagy and determine the mechanisms involved in human podocyte model of nephrotic syndrome Autophagy is a ubiquitous catabolic process involving degradation of damaged organelles and protein aggregates. It shows cytoprotective effects in many cell types and helps to maintain cell homeostasis. Puromycin aminonucleoside (PAN) which induces podocyte apoptosis in vitro and in vivo is widely used for studying the pathophysiology of glomerular diseases. In this study, we demonstrated that PAN induced autophagy in human podocytes (peak at 24hr) prior to apoptosis (peak at 48hr). PAN induced autophagy was featured with the activation of mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) and its substrates. When the PAN-induced autophagy was inhibited by 3-methyladenine (3-MA) or chloroquine (CQ), podocyte apoptosis increased significantly along with the elevation of active caspase-3. Under such circumstance, the podocyte cytoskeleton was also disrupted. Our results suggested that the observed induction of autophagy may be an early adaptive cytoprotective mechanism for podocyte survival after PAN treatment. Objective 2 to determine the effect of manipulating autophagy on podocyte apoptosis in human podocyte model of nephrotic syndrome Since autophagy induction is beneficial for podocyte survival, it is reasonable to utilize this mechanism to attenuate podocyte injury. The effect of rapamycin, an autophagy inducer which acts via mTOR inhibition, has been widely studied. Hence, we focused on more novel reagents for induction of autophagy. Trehalose, a natural disaccharide, is an mTOR independent autophagy inducer. It is unclear whether trehalose alleviates podocyte injury. Therefore, we investigated the efficacy of trehalose in PAN-treated podocytes. Human podocytes were treated with trehalose with or without PAN. It was shown that trehalose induced podocyte autophagy in an mTOR independent manner and without reactive oxygen species involvement. PAN-induced podocyte apoptosis significantly decreased after trehalose treatment, while the inhibition of trehalose-induced autophagy abolished its protective effect. Additionally, the disrupted actin cytoskeleton of PAN-treated podocytes was partially reversed by trehalose, accompanied by less lamellipodias and diminished motility. These results suggested that trehalose induced autophagy in human podocytes and showed cytoprotective effects in PAN-treated podocytes. We further explored the effect of autophagy on human podocyte model of nephrotic syndrome. In particular, the effect of autophagy in some known pathways in podocyte signalling. Recent reports suggested that the toll-like receptor (TLR) signalling pathway plays an important role in damaging the cytoskeleton of podocytes when they are treated by endotoxins such as lipopolysaccharide. Since there are common molecules in both autophagy and TLR pathways, we hypothesize that the crosstalk between these pathways may contribute to the functional link between autophagy and cytoskeletal damage in podocytes. Therefore, we induced autophagy in podocyte by PAN or trehalose, which represents the mTOR dependent and mTOR independent pathways respectively, and measured the change in TLRs expression by real time PCR. Results showed that similar to PAN, trehalose alone did not stimulate specific TLR expression. However, inhibition of trehalose-induced autophagy by 3MA led to significant upregulation of TLR3, TLR4, TLR5, TLR6, and TLR10. We postulate that the trehalose-induced autophagy play an important role in maintaining the TLR expression at low level. Further exploration is needed to determine the specific pathway involved. Objective 3 to determine the in vivo effects of autophagy on renal function and ultra-structure in the rat model of nephrotic syndrome For confirming the efficacy of trehalose in vivo, PAN nephrosis rat model (15mg/100g BW) was established and treated with 2% trehalose in drinking water ad libidum. It was shown that trehalose induced autophagy in rat glomeruli with increased LC3-II expression. However, trehalose did not alleviate PAN-induced renal injury including proteinuria and hypoalbuminemia. Podocyte effacement in rat kidneys after PAN treatment was also not alleviated by trehalose. The inconsistency between in vitro and in vivo study may suggest that autophagy has the limited capacity to cope with severe PAN induced podocyte injury. Careful optimisation of dosage and time points for inducing an optimal level of autophagy is necessary, as over-activation may lead to the detrimental effects. We conclude that the podocyte damage caused by PAN in vivo may be too strong to be relieved by trehalose alone. To overcome the problem, we reduced the dose of PAN to 10mg/100g BW and tested the effect of 2% trehalose. The results were similar to that of the standard dose (15mg/100g BW PAN). Proteinuria was induced between Day 8 to Day 12 but the induction was not as stable as in that of the standard dose. Hence, we did not test lower dose of PAN but look for alternative method of inducing podocyte damage by intra-peritoneal injection of 0.1mg/100g BW lipopolysaccharides (LPS) in mice. LPS was expected to induce transient proteinuria within 24-48hrs post injection. The drawback of this trial was that ~25% of the mice died within 24hrs of LPS injection possibly due to sepsis. Another major drawback is the difficulty in detecting proteinuria in the small volume of urine samples collected every 12 hrs. The protein contamination from food particles made it impossible to use dipstick or usual albumin/creatinine assays for urine analysis. We used special assay kits for the detection of microalbumin and only very mild microalbuminuria was detected in ~50% of the mice injected with LPS. Due to the limited budget, we have to teminate the animal trials. We further reviewed the role of autophagy in acute kidney failure and chronic kidney diseases and concluded that autophagy affects different cells in different disease models. Autophagy is an important process that may play destruction and protection roles in renal diseases. In different studies, the relative expression of autophagy related protein (such as LC3-II, Beclin-1, p62 and phospho-mTOR) and autophagy related genes (such as Atg3, Atg7 and Atg12) are important parameters to be measured. Further studies may explore other specific biomarker related to the process of autophagy. Alternatively, high throughput whole genome analysis may be performed to explore the specific autophagy related gene expression. The development of tissue specific autophagy gene knock-out animals will further reveal the important role of autophagy in the development of kidney diseases. Extended studies The maintenance of glomerular filtration integrity requires the proper function of podocytes and glomerular endothelial cells (GECs), which lie on either side of the glomerular basement membrane. Therefore, we shifted our focus towards GECs. Since lupus nephritis can lead to permanent renal damage and is the major cause of morbidity and mortality in lupus patients, we reviewed the role of autophagy in lupus nephritis and established an in vitro model using immune complexes and human GECs. We demonstrated that immune complexes affected endothelial cells functions, including suppression of autophagy via the mTOR dependent pathway. Other compromised functional changes in cell morphology, cell viability, nitric oxide (NO) production, and angiogenesis were also detected.. Since renal injury is the most important predictor of mortality in SLE patients, it is important to translate these findings to drug development and treatment strategies to improve the prognosis of LN.

[Part C Section 10 PhD thesis #2; Section 8 Peer –reviewed journal published#2 & under review #4; Section 9. Recognized international conferences #3]

589413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
589413.value: In the kidney, the study of autophagy is increasing but the mode of activation and its potential protective role remain unclear. Based on this project, we have gained a lot of experience in studying podocytes and glomerular cells, so in the future; we may design co-culture experiments to study their interactions. For the PAN nephrosis rat model specimen stored, we may further determine the effect of kidney diseases and the role of trehalose in osteoporosis. In addition, we may establish different disease models using small animals (such as unilateral ureteric obstruction, diabetic nephropathy in mice or rats) to determine whether autophagy plays protective roles in different cell types in different kidney diseases.

589413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
589413.value: Metabolic waste is excreted in the kidney by filtering blood across the filtration barrier, which is composed of podocytes, glomerular basement membrane and glomerular endothelial cells (GECs). Progressive loss of cells in this tripartite barrier leads to end stage kidney diseases, posing heavy burdens to the family and society. Therefore, it is important to identify effective therapeutic strategies to maintain its integrity. Autophagy (self-eating) is an adaptive response to stress, involving the clearing of damaged proteins/organelles to provide the cells with energy for repair. In this project, we first demonstrated the cytoprotective role of autophagy in podocytes. We also showed that trehalose, a natural disaccharide and mTOR independent autophagy inducer also protect podocytes from structural damage. However, trehalose did not alleviate PAN-induced proteinuria in our animal model. We further studied the effects of trehalose-induced autophagy in toll-like receptor expression in podocyte. The maintenance of filtration barrier requires the proper function of both podocytes and GECs. Thus, we next investigated the role of autophagy in endothelial cells in our lupus nephritis model. We concluded that immune complexes suppressed autophagy and compromised GEC functions. Taken together, autophagy plays an important role in kidney diseases and further investigation is needed for drug discovery.

589913.label: Project Objectives
589913.value: We aim to examine whether perceptual processing-related N170 component or familiarization-related N250r component is more affected in aMCI. Due to memory impairment is more prominent in aMCI, it is hypothesized that N170 component will be less diminished in aMCI subjects when compared with healthy counterparts. On the other hand, N250r will have slower decline in amplitudes across repeated face viewing in aMCI subjects due to less effective binding of new face-related information to long-term memory. It is aimed to investigate whether the familiarization processes during encoding could predict success of face recognition. It was hypothesized that the amplitude of the frontal N250 component, rather than N170, of later viewed face would be a significant predictor for successful face recognition in MCI individuals.

589913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
589913.value: Background and Objectives Remembering unfamiliar faces is an important social skill. Those with amnesic mild cognitive impairment (aMCI) are expected to have declining related functions (Saavedra et al., 2012a). The effectiveness of cognitive interventions for maintaining their deteriorating functions appeared to be equivocal for aMCI people due to lack of understanding of altered neural processes. Previous studies revealed disrupted perceptual processing of novel faces and slow familiarization effect by repetitive face viewing among people in different stages of Alzheimer’s disease (Cheng et al., 2010; Saavedra et al., 2012b). How much these two neural processes are altered among those with aMCI requires more investigation for directing cognitive training approach. This study will focus on effects of visual processing of facial configuration (N170 component) and familiarization effect by repetition viewing (N250r) related to recognition performance in those with aMCI . Methods Twenty elderly subjects and 20 elderly with aMCI will be recruited for this study. Twenty healthy adults will also be recruited as control. The identification of aMCI will be based on the Petersen’s criteria (Petersen et al. 2001) and Clinical Dementia Rating score (CDR) (Reisberg et al., 2007). Data Collection and Procedure They will be invited to participate in an experiment with repetition priming paradigm (Xue et al., 2011). Each subject will first study 120 emotionally neutral new Chinese faces for 2s under spaced learning manner. Each one-third (40) of faces will be viewed either (1) four times (control), (2) eight times and (3) four times with configuration judgment in nine blocks. After a half-hour break, the subject will be presented with 240 faces (for 2s) with half have been presented. At the end of the trial, the subject determined if the face had been viewed and rated the confidence level of the response by pressing a button. The 128-channel electroencephalogram (EEG) was concurrently recorded . Two-way ANOVA will be used to compare the accuracy of face recognition among three groups/conditions. For EEG data, repeated-measures ANOVA will be used to examine the main and interaction effects of group, memory effect, number of repetition and cortical electrode sites on the amplitudes and latency of N170 and N250r components. The results from this study would allow better understanding of the neural processes of face encoding in aMCI individuals. This would direct whether future cognitive strategy for them would gear toward visual configuration approach or repetitive approach to enhance face recognition performance . 背景 記憶新面孔乃社交技巧的重要一環。對患有初期認知障礙的人士而言，有關的功能有不斷下降的傾向（Saavedra et al., 2012a）。由於一直對面孔記憶背後的神經操作過程欠深入的了解，因此有關認知功能的干預功效仍未有確實的証據支持。過去有文獻指出非連貫的新面孔的感知加工及重複性的面孔記憶對患有阿茲海默症人士有正面的影響（Cheng et al., 2010；Saavedra et al., 2012b）。但這兩種思維策略如何對患有初期認知障礙的人士的影響仍需進一步的研究，以改善思維訓練的方法。本研究項目探討面孔結構的視覺的感知加工（和N170成份有關）和重複策略下對面孔的熟識（和N250r成份有關）對患有初期認知障礙的人士的面孔辨認表現的影響。 研究方法 二十位認知功能正常的長者和二十位患有初期認知障礙的長者將被邀請加入本研究項目。研究員以Petersen評定標準及臨床腦退化症評分標準（Clinical Dementia Rating Score） 確定參加者初期認知障礙的証狀。所有參加者將參與一個以重複提示的模範設計的實驗。每一位參加者先需記下120個以分散模式出現2秒的表情中立的中國人面孔。其中他們需分別觀望40張面孔將4次、40張面孔8次及用感知加工策略下觀望40張面孔另外4次。所有的面孔刺激分為9組給參加者學習。經過半小時的休息後，每位參加再觀望240張面孔（同樣出現2秒）。每個面孔出現後，參加者需以按鍵的方式決定有否在較早前見過該面孔，並決定有其信心程度。實驗進行間，腦電波的活動情況將以128道的電極記錄下來。數據分析面，二維ANOVA用作分別三組參加者的面孔辨認的正確率。Repeated-measures ANOVA用作分析N170成份和N250r成份波輻和出現時間的記憶效果、重複效果和電極位置的主效應和交互效應。 本研究的結果有助進一步了解患有初期認知障礙的人士面孔記憶編碼的神經過程。有關數據可反映出視覺感知加工或重複性的記憶策略可更有效提升認知障礙的人士的面孔記憶及辨認。

589913.label: Realisation of objectives
589913.value: The study objectives have been achieved as planned. Two electrophysiological and two behavioral studies have been conducted in order to examine the neural processes related to face encoding and the effect of perceptual strategy on face encoding and recognition performance. For Objective 1 to investigate the underlying neural processes of face encoding under a spaced learning manner, 19 cognitively intact participants were recruited to participate in an experiment with an event-related potential (ERP) design. EEG signals were concurrently recorded using NeuroScan software. They were required to first view 120 faces for four times in a space learning manner in the encoding phase. Subsequently they were required to recognize these faces from a series of 240 faces with a confidence rating in each trial. Repeated measures ANOVA revealed that, in hit trials, the amplitudes of N250r at F4 and C4 electrodes, respectively, were more negative-going than those of F3 and C3 electrodes in the second repetition of exposure. The N250r and P600 amplitudes were found to be more correlated in the missed trials. This study showed that the N250r amplitude appeared to be larger when a new face recognition unit starts developing and becomes diminished when the long-term representation of the face is established. The N250r component appeared to be more associated with subsequent memory recognition of forgotten faces, signified by P600. This suggests that the association between these two components is stronger when a face recognition unit has yet to be established. For Objective 2 to examine the effect of configural processing on face encoding in the aging population and the subsequent face recognition performance. One behavioral and ERP experiment was conducted to achieve this objective. In the behavioral study, 43 older and 42 younger adult subjects were first recruited. Of 35 older subjects (mean age (SD) = 56.7 (5.2)) and 34 young subjects (mean age (SD) = 21.6 (1.6)) were included in the subsequent data analysis. 8 older and 8 younger subjects obtained the discriminability index, i.e. d’prime, < 0.2. Each subject was randomly allocated into two groups to learn different face perceptual strategies in preserving face encoding ability: vertical relation strategy on eye ratio and horizontal relation strategy on nose-mouth ratio. There were 60 trials in a control condition, containing a 1-second fixation followed by an emotionally neutral Chinese face stimulus (2s). The subject needed to press a button while detecting blank screens. Each face was presented 4 times under spaced learning manner (ITI = 1500–2500ms). Another set of 60 faces were presented in an experimental condition with the same presentation timing as in the control condition, except that the subject was instructed to compare the length of eye-level or nose-mouth features in the 3rd and 4th face exposures and randomly asked to press a button to indicate which features were longer. There were 60 faces in five blocks for each condition. After a half-hour break, each subject was presented with 240 faces for 2s half of which were previously presented. At the end of the trial, the subject determined if the face had been previously viewed and rated the confidence level of the response (low, moderate and high). A three-way repeated measure ANOVA with strategy (perceptual and freestyle), region (eye and nose/month), and group (younger adults group and older adults group) was conducted. The result showed significant interaction effect between strategy, region and group [F(1,65) =7.150, p=.009]. Post-hoc comparisons showed significant interaction effect of strategies and regions [F(1,33) = 11.134, p=.002] in older adult group but not in younger adult group [F(1, 32)=1.380, p=.249]. For the older adult group, hit rate in freestyle strategy (mean = 41.31, SD = 7.031) was found significantly higher than that in perceptual strategy (mean = 33.69, SD = 8.815) in nose/mouth region (t(15)=4.361, p=.001). No significant difference in hit rates was shown between freestyle strategy and eye-region processing (t(18)=.617, p=.545). Furthermore, no significant differences in hit rates were shown in the younger adult group when encoding used either nose/mouth or eye region strategies. In contrast, there is significant difference in hit rates between elderly and young group when encoding using eye-region strategy (t(35)=2.032, p=.050) though insignificant group difference obtained in correct count of freestyle strategy (t(35)=.767, p = .448). When using nose/mouth region strategy, there is significant difference between elderly and young group in hit rates of freestyle strategy (t(30)=2.598, p = .014), but not in hit rates of perceptual strategy (t(30)=-.405, p = .689). The elderly group showed significant difference between eye and nose/mouth region of hit rates of perceptual strategy (t(33)=2.038, p=.050), but not in freestyle strategy (t(33)=-.282, p=.779). The young adult group did not show significant result in different region of both freestyle (t(32)=1.198, p=.240) and perceptual strategy (t(32)=-.306, p=.762). In the ERP experiment, which examined the neural processing of configural processing of face at eye-level or month/nose level during encoding, 10 MCI (mean age (SD)=22.2 (4.0); MoCA (SD)=21.6 (2.5)), 12 elderly (mean age (SD)=60.8 (5.7); MoCA (SD)=28.4 (1.1)) and 13 adult (mean age (SD)=72.3 (9.7)) subjects were recruited. One younger adult and 1 adult with MCI were excluded due to undesirable EEG signals. The same experimental design was adopted. EEG signals were concurrently recorded using NeuroScan software. To compare the N250 component (190-300ms) amplitudes between younger adults and older adult, 4-ways repeated measures ANOVA was used (group: younger adults and older adults, strategy: freestyle and perceptual, site: eye and nose/mouth, and midline sites: F, C and P). A significant group × strategy × site interaction effect was found in lateral sites [F(1,20)=4.864, p=.039]. Post-hoc analysis showed more negative-going N250 amplitudes at left electrodes in eye comparison task of elderly group (p=.065). Another 4-way repeated measures ANOVA was used (group: older adults and adults with MCI, strategy, site and region) was conducted on N250 (190-300ms) component amplitude, group x strategy x site interaction effect was found to be marginally significant in midline sites [F(1,18)=3.064, p=.097]. Post-hoc analysis showed a trend with more negative-going N250 amplitudes in eye comparison task of adult group with MCI (p=.282). For Objective 3, to examine the sequence of holistic and second-order face perceptual processing affects face encoding and subsequent recognition, 32 cognitively intact adults (mean age = 21.79; SD =1.86) were divided into 2 groups to encode face stimuli by either holistic-then-second-order processing or second-order-then-holistic processing during the experimental session. Also, both groups would encode face stimuli by holistic encoding only during the control session. Their performance in recognition task was compared concerning accuracy and response time. The results revealed a faster response in recognition when holistic information was presented prior to second-order relation (p<0.05). This provided the evidence for the possible configural sequence to be first-order relation, then holistic information, followed by second-order relation. Also, lower accuracy and longer time in recognition were found when stimuli were learnt with second-order relation emphasized, suggesting that additional emphasis of second-order configural processing during novel face encoding could impede the first-order and holistic information processing (p<0.05). This would in turn have an adverse effect on the subsequent face recognition. The results from this study confirmed the paradigm design of the ERP experiment adopted to fulfill Objective 2 previously reported.

589913.label: Major findings and research outcome
589913.value: The first ERP study showed that the familiarity effect in the course of repetitive viewing novel faces as reflected by the increase in N250 component amplitude was enhanced through repetitive viewing in a space learning manner. N250’s association with P600 component suggests that N250 component could be a neurophysiological marker for indicating whether the long-term representation of a certain face stimulus has been established in the memory system. Consistent with the literature, in the course of encoding novel faces, holistic processing and first-order of a face stimulus needs to occur prior to the second-order processing of facial features to facilitate subsequent face recognition in the younger adults. Additional top-down configural processing would actually impede the encoding processing and storage of novel faces. On the other hand, due to decline in eye processing of eye-level attention in the elderly and MCI adults, top-down configural processing at eye-level region would facilitate the encoding of the novel faces as compared to nose-month-level configural processing. At the neurophysiological level, the N250 component amplitude appears to increase in MCI adults during the eye-level region configural processing during novel face encoding, suggesting additional neural effort was induced when MCI individuals applied configural processing. Besides, this also implies that N250 component has the potential biomarker to indicate the decline in neural processing in facial encoding using holistic and configural processing of novel faces.

589913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
589913.value: The findings of this series of studies provides a new understanding of the effect of neural processes on configural processing of facial features during the encoding phase. The findings provide the basis for further studies. First, a longitudinal study could be conducted to investigate the changes in face recognition performance and the key neurophysiological markers N250 component, which indicates the familiarity level of face encoding, across an extended period of time, for example one- to three-year period when elderely individuals with and without MCI learn to encode novel face using configural processing. The results could provide insight on the significance of the N250 component in detecting MCI-related cognitive declines. Furthermore, in order to examine the longitudinal effect of configural processing of novel face, a clinical trial could be conducted to examine the effect of face recognition performance and changes of neurophysiological marker N250 component among elderly with and without MCI across different periods of time. The results could shed light on the impact of the continual application of configural processing of face on face-related memory functions and the neurodegeneration that are related to MCI.

589913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
589913.value: An increase in aging populations globally means there is a consequent increase in adults with mild cognitive impairment (MCI). Face-related memory decline would be one of the commonest manifestations reported by people with MCI. Obtaining evidence from behavioral and ERP studies pertaining on the beneficial effects of cognitive strategies would be important for those with aging brain or MCI to maintain face-memory functions This study findings have shown that repetitive and holistic viewing would induce a familiarity effect (signified by the increase in N250 component amplitude) when younger adults learn new faces. Additional attention effort at the facial features after holistic viewing would enhance face remembering and later face recognition. The findings further showed that paying additional attention at the eye-level region during face learning is particularly beneficial among elderly with and without MCI (signified by increased N250 component amplitude), when comparing additional attention at the nose-mouth-level region. These results from this study suggest that top-down control of configural processing during face encoding could be therapeutic for elderly with and MCI to maintain or facilitate face-related memory functions. The N250 component could serve as the biomarker to detect cognitive decline and to reflect the neuroplasticity changes due to cognitive training.

590213.label: Project Objectives
590213.value: We want to find out whether the allegations of GAAP violations without restatements prior to filing of lawsuit have merits. We will infer the merits of these allegations through their levels of earnings management, whether they have institutional lead plaintiffs, whether CFOs/auditors are named as a defendant, and whether a restatement is made after the lawsuit filing. If these non-restatement allegations do have merits, what type of firms did not restate their financial statements prior to the lawsuit filing? We will examine four determinants: the strength of financial monitoring system, litigation and reputation risk, executive entrenchment, and firm performance. Do these firms with meritorious GAAP violation but did not make restatements prior to the lawsuit filing have more or less penalty? We examine the penalty from three perspectives: litigation outcomes, manager and auditor turnover, and aggregate effect on shareholder wealth.

590213.value: 美國集體訴訟中違反公認會計準則的指控個案日增，本研究旨在探討其理據與後果。本文集中研究被指違反公認會計準則但訴訟之前沒有重整賬目的訴訟個案。沒有重整賬目的指控可能沒有理據。由於訴訟（特別是瑣屑無聊的訴訟）對社會造成淨損失，因此重要的是探討這類訟訴背後的理據，也有可能是毫無理據。另一方面，這些指控也許是有理據的，但公司選擇不重整賬目，因為管理層憂慮公佈賬目錯誤會觸發訴訟。在這些情況下，訴訟可作為重要的監察工具，提供社會價值。 對於可能賬目錯誤的公司，本文指出哪類公司選擇不公佈賬目錯誤（例如以重整賬目的方式公佈），並指出這類行為會否觸發較高懲罰。一旦重整賬目，公司可能被控告，而不重整賬目則可能受到嚴厲懲罰，管理層便需要在兩者之間權衡。研究顯示，重整賬目可能觸發訴訟，但至今沒有研究指出，公司選擇不重整賬目會否招致嚴厲懲罰。本文的研究便是彌補這個缺陷。 我們計劃以人手搜集1996年至今，美國聯邦私人證券集體訴訟中指控違反公認會計準則的個案，藉以建立一個全新的數據集。首先，將指控違反公認會計準則的訴訟個案分為兩類：入稟前有重整賬目和沒有重整賬目。然後，採用文獻中制定的各種度量方法，評估沒有重整賬目的指控是否具有理據。對於具有理據的指控，考察哪類公司選擇在入稟前不重整賬目，並以抗辯公司的管治制度、訴訟和聲譽風險、高管利益掠奪和企業績效為基礎，建立一個決定因素模型。最後，我們考察公司的整體財富效應、訴訟結果、管理層和審計師的流失率，以檢測在訴訟前不承認錯誤的公司是否受到更嚴厲的懲罰。 優質會計數據是維持資本市場穩健的重要元素。指控違反公認會計準則的訟訴個案增加，可能反映出盈利管理日趨嚴重。本文的研究對美國通過集體訴訟保護投資者權利提供重要的證據。

590213.label: Realisation of objectives
590213.value: All three objectives have been completely achieved. The essential things that we did since the last report include the following: (1) Revise the working paper following the feedbacks from the conference discussants and audiences (2) Using (voluntary) restatement as proxy for financial reporting quality and managerial opportunistic decision, we extend our investigation on the complex relationship between legal environment and financial reporting behaviors to a wider range of accounting and finance variables, including 10-K readability, crash risk, CEO compensation, R&D investment, and bank loan patterns. These findings lead to supervised PhD thesis and multiple working papers at different stage. (3) Our sophisticated understanding of the securities litigation data across US courts opens the avenue for a predictive study of firms’ securities litigation risk using machine learning approach. We trained PhD students this new skill set using litigation risk as primary subject.

590213.label: Major findings and research outcome
590213.value: This study provides the first evidence that the district court pleading standards, which are measured by case dismissal rate, affect the propensity of misreporting firms to admit their accounting mistakes through voluntary restatements. We find strong and robust evidence that a more stringent legal environment deters rather than prompts voluntary restatements. Using Supreme Court’s Tellabs decision as an exogenous shock to securities litigation environments, we find that an increase in court stringency leads to a decrease in headquartering firms’ voluntary restatement propensity. Our results are robust to different samples of misstating firms and alternative court dismissal rate measures. Our results complement existing studies on the driving forces of voluntary restatements. Our novel, court-based measure on firms’ ex ante security litigation risk opens new avenue to study the long-debated question of how the security litigation environment affects managerial decisions, such as disclosure. Importantly, we warrant researchers on the complex relationship between legal environment and financial reporting quality. Stronger legal environment, on the one hand, might deter firms from misreporting. On the other hand, it deters misreporting firms from admitting their mistake to the extent that public and private enforcement on security fraud are costly. Our evidence informs regulators on the hitherto under-investigated role of courts in motivating self-policing behavior, such as voluntary restatements.

590213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
590213.value: For the current project, we will revise it by modifying our theory development with a clear focus. Once done, we plan to submit it to Journal of Accounting and Economics (JAE) or The Accounting Review (TAR). The district court pleading standards that we developed serve as an innovative measure of litigation risk across districts. Studies investigating litigation risk can use this measure. We plan to apply this measure and investigate if litigation risk affects other corporate decision makings.

590213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
590213.value: Firms that have misreported their accounting numbers face the need of restatements. When the ‘needed’ restatements are known to the managers, managers may choose to voluntarily disclose these restatements to avoid the potentially higher penalty due to hiding the truth. Alternatively, managers may choose not to disclose these restatements with a hope that the misstatements will not be discovered. It is not clear if stringent legal environment will deter or prompt these misreporting firms’ voluntarily disclosure of their restatements. If mangers will voluntarily disclose their restatements, it is likely that managers believe that if they hide the truth, they will be penalized more. On the other hand, if managers choose not to voluntarily disclose their restatements, it is likely that they believe that hiding the truth has a benefit of not being discovered. Our findings that stringent legal environment actually deter managers’ desire to not disclose their restatements (i.e. not to admit their mistakes) implies that higher penalty if hiding the truth is not strong enough to trade-off the higher possibility of not being sued if hiding the truth. For the stringent legal environment to act effectively, increasing the ‘higher penalty if hiding the truth’ deserves attention.

590313.label: Project Objectives
590313.value: Develop and empirically implement a methodology that decomposes alpha into managerial skill and idiosyncratic volatility. Derive the time-series implications of the alpha decomposition, which are then used to evaluate the persistence of dispersion-adjusted skill and its predictive power for future fund performance. Derive the cross-sectional implications of the alpha decomposition, which are then used to evaluate the importance of idiosyncratic volatility in explaining the difference in fund performance across markets, sectors, and investment styles. We also use the alpha decomposition to quantify the potential payoff to actively investing in these various market segments.

590313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
590313.value: 本研究項目旨在提供一個創新的方法,在考慮了風險後,把互惠基金的「非正常回報」分解為兩部份: (一) 基金經理之管理能力; 和 (二) 個別股票之波覆。 本項目也會利用此方法去評估投資者在不同類形(投資於不同國家、不同行業、或運用不同投資風格)的主動性互惠基金的潛在回報,特別是在扣除基金收費後,回報是否仍具吸引力。

590313.label: Realisation of objectives
590313.value: In examining how idiosyncratic volatility varies over time, we uncover its relationship with investor sentiment. To characterize this time-series relationship, we calculate stock return synchronicity (the fraction of stock return variation that is not idiosyncratic) - and find that it significantly increases at times when investor sentiment is extreme. We then investigate if there are cross-sectional variations in this time-series relationship, and find that the relationship between investor sentiment and stock return synchronicity is especially pronounced for small, young, volatile, non-dividend-paying, and low-priced stocks. This “difference in difference” suggests that stocks with these characteristics are affected more by sentiment. Although previous research has shown that this effect holds for the first moment of stock returns, we demonstrate that it is also present in the second moments (stock return volatility and comovement). Next, we evaluate mutual fund performance by their stock picking and market timing, and find that mutual funds focus less on stock selection relative to market timing at times when aggregate investor sentiment is extreme (and return synchronicity is high and idiosyncratic volatility is low). Kacperczyk, Van Nieuwerburgh, and Veldkamp (2014a, b) show that mutual fund managers allocate more attention to aggregate (relative to firm-specific) signals and focus more on market timing (relative to stock selection) during recessions. We find that fund managers behave similarly—focusing more on market timing and less on stock selection—at times when aggregate investor sentiment is extreme. This shift in relative focus from stock selection to market timing can be rational (as the relative payoff to stock selection declines with a higher stock return synchronicity and lower idiosyncratic volatility) or behavioral (as fund managers who are prone to aggregate investor sentiment become less discriminant among individual firms).

590313.label: Major findings and research outcome
590313.value: We find that U.S. stock return synchronicity tends to increase when aggregate investor sentiment is either extremely bullish or extremely bearish. This U-shaped relationship between sentiment and synchronicity is robust to the inclusion of the growth rate of real GDP and fundamentals synchronicity as controls. As further support that the time-variations in stock return synchronicity are driven by investor sentiment, we show that the sentiment-synchronicity relationship exhibits a cross-sectional pattern. Firms that are small, young, volatile, non-dividend paying, low-priced, and with more extreme valuation ratios experience more substantial increases in stock return synchronicity following periods of extreme investor sentiment. On the implication of investor sentiment for the stock selection versus market timing behavior of money managers, we find that mutual funds indeed focus less on stock selection relative to market timing at times when aggregate investor sentiment is extreme. In an exercise that gauge the relevance of our findings for portfolio diversification, we find that the level of variance reduction that can be attained by increasing the number of stocks held in a portfolio from one to ten during normal sentiment periods can only be achieved by diversifying to 30 stocks when sentiment is extreme (and return synchronicity is high).

590313.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
590313.value: By examining the portfolio holdings of mutual funds more closely (e.g. the quality/alpha of their stock picks) in different states of investor sentiment, we can shed light on whether their shift in focus from stock selection to market timing during extreme sentiment periods is driven by rational or behavioral reasons.

590313.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
590313.value: We show that aggregate investor sentiment affects the extent to which individual stocks comove with the aggregate stock market. Comovement increases when investor sentiment becomes more extreme. This effect is disproportionately stronger for stocks that are more difficult to arbitrage - and hence more prone to the effects of investor sentiment. Although previous research has also shown that the effect of sentiment is stronger for difficult-to-arbitrage stocks' mean returns, we show that this pattern also holds for their volatility and comovement with the aggregate market. We find that mutual fund managers' behavior is also affected by investor sentiment. They focus more on market timing and less on stock selection at times when aggregate investor sentiment is extreme. This shift in relative focus from stock selection to market timing can be rational (as the relative payoff to stock selection declines with a higher stock return synchronicity and lower idiosyncratic volatility) or behavioral (as fund managers who are prone to aggregate investor sentiment become less discriminant among individual firms). Further research is required to distinguish between these two possibilities.

590613.label: Project Objectives
590613.value: Examine the impacts of two major sources of workplace ostracism, supervisor ostracism and coworker ostracism, on employees’ service performance and outcomes (i.e., effectiveness of coproduction with customers, customer repurchase intention, and employee job performance). 590613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
590613.value: 在不斷變化的商業環境裡，企業已經意識到合作對於創造和保持競爭優勢的重要性。最近，戰略與市場行銷學的學者們致力於研究與顧客的合作，並以此作為共同創造價值的一種方式 (Lusch and Vargo 2006; Prahalad and Ramaswamy 2000)。儘管有相當多的有關與顧客合作提供服務的重要性和結果的證據（例如Auh等， 2007；Chan, Yim和Lam ，2010；Yim, Chan, 和Lam，2012），但關於服務型員工到底如何處理與顧客的合作任務卻知之甚少，特別是當那些員工遭遇負面的工作經歷（例如在職場遭受過排斥）。尤其是職場排斥源（比如上司或同事），解釋這一過程的心理機制，以及與顧客合作的效果還沒有被研究過。本提議專案運用市場行銷學、心理學和組織行為學領域知識，旨在調查服務型員工職場排斥對與顧客合作工作效果的影響，以此解釋職場排斥與員工服務績效的聯動圖。以Williams（2001, 2007）排斥的需求與威脅論作為理論框架，本提議專案將完成以下目標： 1. 調查兩種主要的職場排斥源（上司排斥和同事排斥）對員工服務績效和產出的影響（例如與顧客合作的效果、顧客再購買意願、員工工作績效）。 2. 調查功效型需求（控制和有意義的生活）和關聯式需求（歸屬和自尊）在上司排斥和同事排斥分別對員工服務績效造成影響的過程中作為仲介變數的作用。 3. 探索和檢驗潛在的可能改變職場排斥影響員工工作績效產出的邊界條件。 此提議項目的研究成果將有利於理解員工負面工作經歷、與顧客合作提供服務、隱藏的調解機制和潛在的邊界條件之間尚待研究的關係。該成果還會對有職場排斥特徵的企業的管理人員提供有意義的指導。無論是源于上司排斥還是源于同事排斥，管理人員必須重視員工可感知到的職場排斥的發生概率及其顯著的影響，以及它對員工服務績效和產出的作用。相應的，他們還必須尋找方法來維持更加有效的和令人滿意的與顧客的合作。

590613.label: Major findings and research outcome
590613.value: 1. We have successfully conducted a large-scale survey with dyadic data collected from an international insurance company to investigate the effect of employees' workplace ostracism. 2. To further enhance the rigorous and validity of our findings, we also conducted a total of three laboratory experiments to testify our hypotheses. Specifically, we invested great efforts to build an online platform so as to simulate the real interaction environment between employees and their supervisors as well as their peers and so as to investigate their true effects on customers' perceived coproduction value. 3. our findings enrich the existing literature by revealling a doubleedged sword effect of workplace ostracism and its contingency such that (1) supervisor ostracism reduces customers’ perceived control value in customer–agent coproduction through threatening service agents’ efficacy needs when the agents experience low servicing empowerment; (2) coworker ostracism enhances customers’ perceived relational value in coproduction through threatening service agents’ relational needs when they expect a long-term relationship with customers; and (3) customers’ perceived control and relational values increase their perceived service performance, and customer relational value also increases the amount of purchases. Our findings reveal that service agents’ workplace ostracism may actually help or harm customers’ service perceptions, depending on the source of ostracism. 3. Our work had submitted to Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science (JAMS) and after three rounds of revisions with concerted efforts in addressing the reviewers' constructive comments, our manuscript was accepted for publications in 2016. (Wan, Echo Wen, Kimmy W. Chan, Rocky Chen (2016), "Hurting or Helping? The Effects of Service Agents' workplace ostracism on Customer Service Perceptions", Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science, 43(6), 746-769) 4. Besides the journal paper, we also actively share our work among colleagues as well as in international conference, including EMAC. "Wan, Echo Wen, Kimmy W. Chan, Rocky Chen (2015), "Does Workplace Ostracism Hurt Service Agents' Value Coproduction with Customers? A Different Sources and Needs Explanation", 44th Annual Conference of the European Marketing Academy (EMAC)"

590613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
590613.value: Our work generates several directions for future research and potential course of actions. For instance, ostracism might result from internal causes, such as the service agent’s personality traits (e.g., being withdrawn and non-sociable), or external factors such as a competitive work environment. Additional research should explore the impact of different causes of workplace ostracism on service performance. Fourth, we differentiated workplace ostracism by its source (supervisor versus coworker); it also might be interesting to examine how different forms of ostracism, such as active criticism versus passive neglect, influence service agents’ threatened needs differently. Fifth, additional research should examine the impact of workplace ostracism using respondents from different cultures. Social exclusion could be a more relevant factor in countries marked by high collectivism, because collectivist cultures tend to emphasize close interpersonal relationships

590613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
590613.value: Findings from this research offer significant insights and implications to firms in which coproducing services with customers plays a major role in the service employees’ job task. First, firms should provide proper training to supervisors to help them detect whether their behaviors unintentionally make employees feel ostracized. Second, Managers can set up training programs to elevate service agents’ sense of control. Moreover, managers could redesign employees’ job scope to provide them with more autonomy and discretion in handling service tasks. Allowing employees to enjoy a high degree of autonomy and power could reduce their desire to obtain control in their interactions with customers and thus enhance customers’ perceived control value. Third, managers should emphasize that any customers can potentially be long-term customers, which will prompt employees to behave in a friendly and cooperative manner in their coproduction with customers for the purpose of building long-term bonds.

591413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
591413.value: Although there is ample evidence showing that momentum strategies are profitable in a large number of countries, the cause of momentum profits is still a puzzle. There are rational and behavioral explanations of this phenomenon. Rational explanation proposes that momentum profits are driven by macroeconomic risk factors or risk factors related to the real options and existing assets of the firms. Regardless of the types of risk factor, recent winners have more systematic risk than the recent losers and hence the winners have higher expected returns relative to the losers. On the other hand, the behavioral explanation attributes momentum profits to the cognitive biases of investors. Because of these biases, investors may overreact or underreact to the same piece of information which, in turn, generates a positive relation between past and future returns. These two explanations give similar predictions making them difficult to be distinguished empirically. Hence, distinguishing these two explanations empirically is always a challenge to financial economists. Companies in Mainland China upon meeting certain requirements can issue three types of shares: A-share, B-share, and H-share. Both A- and B-shares are trade in the Chinese mainland and H-shares are traded in Hong Kong. While A-shares are pre-dominantly traded by local domestic investors, foreign institutional investors are major participants in the B- and H-shares market. This institutional feature in the Chinese stock market provides us with a natural setting to distinguish the rational explanation from the behavioral explanation. Since A-share and Foreign-share (B/H-shares) were issued by the same company, they are exposed to the same economic environment and having the same cash flows. Therefore, according to the rational explanation, momentum strategies should generate the same profits in these two markets. One should be noticed, however, that the investor compositions in these two markets are very different. It is plausible that Chinese domestic investors are different from the foreign institutional investors in both the degree and types of cognitive biases. That is to say, the Chinese and foreign investors may process information differently. As a result, the behavioral explanation posits that the momentum profits in the A-share and Foreign-share markets could be different. This study aims to address these issues. 動能策略指在股票市場上同時買進往績贏家及沽出往績輸家。過去經驗指出這策略在不同市場均可為投資者帶來可觀盈利。本研究旨在探索動能策略可帶來盈利的原因。過往研究對此問題提出兩項解釋: 理性理論及行為理論。因這兩解說提出相似的預測，過往實証不能分辨這兩項解釋。本研究指出可透過在中國發行A股及B股的公司去分別這兩項解釋。因A股及B股是由同一公司發行，理性理論指出它們應有相似的動能策略盈利。相反，行為理論就沒有這預測。因此，透過比較A股及B股的動能策略盈利就可以分別這兩項解釋。

591413.label: Realisation of objectives
591413.value: Objective 1 is 100% achieved: We document a strong and robust profits to the momentum strategy implemented on the B-shares. However, the corresponding A-shares counterparts do not exhibit any notable momentum effect. The same result remains regardless whether the winners or losers are classified by the past returns on A-shares or B-shares. According to the rational explanation of the momentum effect, the winners should be riskier than the losers and hence they are commensurate with higher returns. The winners are relatively riskier because of the cash flows risk, dividends shocks, or the fluctuations of the value of the real options of the underlying company. Since the A-shares and B-shares are issued by the same companies, the momentum effects on these two types of shares should be similar. The finding that the momentum effect on B-shares substantially larger than that on A-shares rejects the rational explanation of momentum effect. Objective 2 is 100% achieved: When we rank winners/losers by the past returns on the B-shares, we find that the momentum profit on the A-shares is positive and marginally significant at the 10% level. Result from the regression analysis confirms this finding. Further analysis, however, indicates that this finding is not robust and is mainly driven by the A-shares with their prices being closed to the prices of their B-shares counterparts. In sum, there is no strong evidence indicating that momentum effect spill-over the markets of twin stocks.

591413.label: Major findings and research outcome
591413.value: Major findings: 1. For those firms only issue A-shares, return to the momentum strategy among them is insignificant. We also document that the profit to the 52-week high momentum strategy among them is also insignificant. 2. We document a strong and robust profits to the momentum strategy implemented on the B-shares. However, the corresponding A-shares counterparts do not exhibit any notable momentum effect. The finding that the momentum effect on B-shares substantially larger than that on A-shares rejects the rational explanation of momentum effect. We have similar result even after controlling for dollar trading volume. We can conclude that momentum effect is caused by investors’ behavior. 3. We document the return to the 52-week high momentum strategy is positive and significant among the B-shares while it is not significant among the A-shares counterparts of the same companies. This finding further confirm that the behavior bias for the B-shares investors is not the same as the A-shares investors. In the regression analysis, we find that the profits to the price momentum strategy co-exists with the profit to the 52-week high momentum strategy or it subsumes the profit to the 52-week high momentum strategy. This finding is inconsistent with the findings from the US market. 4. Results from our regression analysis show that the investment strategy based on the B-share price discount is profitable. Specifically, when the discount is large, investors can make profits by taking short positions in the A-shares. On the contrary, when the discount is small, investors can make profits by taking short positions in the B-shares. Even after taking into account for the effect of the B-share price discount strategy, we still find that momentum profits are strong among the B-shares. Research outcome: A working paper has completed and will be submitted for publication after editing.

591413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
591413.value: 1. Effort should be put on why the price momentum strategy works only in the B-shares market. Our findings indicate that the investors in B-shares market underreact to news while A-shares investors overreact to news. More evidences should be found to sustain this claim. 2. There is a trend that Chinese companies cross-listed in the stock markets overseas. We expect to find similar results in those H-shares and N-shares issued by the companies listed in China. 3. If the investors in B-shares market indeed underreact to news while A-shares investors overreact to news, then there should be a lead-lag effect on the stock level. This lead-lag effect deserved investigation.

591413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
591413.value: Price momentum strategy refers to the investment strategy of buying past wining stocks and shorting past losing stocks in recent months. This strategy is proven to be profitable over a six- to twelve-month holding periods in a number of countries, including Hong Kong. Chinese companies can issue both A- and B-shares and these shares have the same cash flow rights. We find that this strategy is only profitable among the B-shares and it does not exist among their A-shares counterparts. Hence, we can conclude that the profit to momentum strategy is not caused by the risks of the underlying companies and it is caused by investors’ behavior. It seems that A-shares investors overact to news while B-shares investors underreact to news. We also find that trading strategy based on the B-share price discount is profitable. Specifically, when the gap between A-share price and B-share price of a company is large (small), investors can make profits by taking short positions in the A-shares (B-shares). Furthermore, the strategy of buying stocks close to their 52-week high price and shorting stocks far away from their 52-week high price entails notable profits in the B-share market. However, this strategy cannot work among the A-shares.

591513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
591513.value: Recent audit failures have raised concern over the role of audit partners, who take responsibility on behalf of the audit firm for the quality of audit engagements (FRC, 2000; PCAOB, 2010). Audits are of higher quality when led by highly skilled and independent partners (Francis, 2011). One key issue in audit firm governance is thus ensuring that competent candidates are elected to partnership. Doing so may not only help audit firms to achieve success in the client service marketplace, but may also serve as a necessary precursor to preventing future occurrences of audit failure. While both regulators and practitioners indicate substantial interest in the governance of partner promotion, an empirical investigation of this issue has been precluded due to the lack of data on internal governance of audit firms. The objective of this study will be to examine the promotion to audit partnership decision using a novel dataset of audit firms in China that disclosed their rosters of associated auditors and names of engagement auditors from 2007 to 2011. This dataset will allow us to trace engagement auditors’ career paths to partnership. In particular, we will ask whether audit firms value engagement auditor’s audit quality (Gul, Wu and Yang, 2011) and client importance in the promotion process. We hypothesize that individual auditors who demonstrate higher audit quality in previous engagements are more likely to experience career advancement. This relationship will be stronger for auditors in large or limited liability partnership (LLP) firms than their counterparts in small or limited liability firms because of reputation and/or litigation concerns. This study will shed light on the internal governance of audit firms, in which the key input of professional workforce is unobservable. Its findings will help us to understand whether partner promotions depend on individual auditors’ past performance, and whether the size and organizational form of an audit firm affects its promotion policy. This study will also add to the literature on individual auditors by examining the promotion opportunities of engagement auditors and help us to understand why and how auditor-level audit quality affects firm-level quality. In addition, we will extend the literature of career concerns to the accounting profession, in which moving upward to partnership is the central long-term incentive offered by audit firms. Finally, our findings in the Chinese context will be of interest to policy advocates who argue for increased emphasis on the disclosure of audit firm governance. 近年来的一系列审计失败案例引发了公众对会计师事务所合伙人的关注。合伙人是会计师事务所审计质量的主要责任人（FRC, 2000; PCAOB, 2010）。Francis (2011) 指出合伙人的审计技能和独立性直接影响审计质量。因此，事务所管理的一个关键决策就是如何选拔贤能担任合伙人，使事务所既能在审计市场上保持竞争力，又能降低审计失败几率。 虽然监管者和业界对合伙人选拔有浓厚兴趣，但因受数据局限相关的实证检验一直难以进行。本研究计划利用中国会计师事务所披露的注册会计师个人信息，考察中国会计师事务所合伙人的晋升决策。我们预期审计质量高的注册会计师更可能晋升为会计师事务所合伙人。相对于小规模和有限责任公司制事务所，这种预期在大型和有限责任合伙制事务所尤为明显。 由于事务所在人力资本方面的投入通常不对外披露，本项研究的研究发现将有助于探讨会计师事务所的内部治理问题。本研究也将有助于理解个人层面的审计质量如何影响事务所层面的审计质量。我们的研究发现不仅可能扩展对于注册会计师职业规划的研究，也可对增强会计师事务所的治理和披露提供相关的实证证据。

591713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
591713.value: The proposed project will be the first study on the convergence of China’s regional financial development and economic growth that incorporates the interaction of the two sectors and allows the possibility of time-varying and regime-switching causality. Unlike traditional analyses on income convergence, the project’s statistical model allows the steady-state growth paths of financial development and per-capita income to be simultaneously determined. The project has the following objectives: (1) Conducting statistical analyses on China’s regional convergence in financial development and economic growth, which allow the real and financial sectors to interact; (2) Investigating the possibility of time-varying and regime-switching causality between finance and growth in China, (3) Identifying regional-specific factors determining the steady-state rates of financial development and economic growth in China, which determine the steady-state growth rates of per capita income and financial development; and (4) Using the statistical framework developed in the project, the investigators will quantify and evaluate the effectiveness of existing policies (such as credits quota and central bank credits, progressive financial liberalization, and RMB internationalization) in promoting financial and economic development at both regional and national levels in China. The level of financial development will be measured by: (i) Quantities of bank credits and deposit money; (ii) Broad money minus narrow money (M2-M1), and; (iii) Capital market development. 這項目將是第一個研究有關中國區域金融發展與經濟增長的結合和互動，這結合和互動可因體制轉換而隨時間變化。不同於傳統的分析收入趨同，這項目的統計模型可同時推測區域經濟發展和人均收入的穩態增長路徑。這項目有以下目標: (1）對中國的區域金融發展和經濟增長進行統計分析，這分析包括實體經濟和金融部門的互動銜接; （2）調查中國區域金融發展與經濟增長隨時間變化的因果關係;（ 3）調查中國區域金融發展與經濟增長的具體確定因素; （4）量化和評估現有政策（如區域信貸配額，漸進金融自由化，人民幣國際化等）對提高中國金融發展的有效性。這項目會用以下數據去量度中國區域金融發展情況:（I）銀行信貸和存款數量; （II ）廣義貨幣減去狹義貨幣供應量（M2 - M1 ）;及（iii）資本市場的發展。

591713.label: Realisation of objectives
591713.value: The research project has investigated the interaction of the financial and real sectors along the convergence paths among China’s provinces (Objective 1). Our data set was taken from China Data Online, China Statistical Year Book. The sample period run from 1978 to 2010. The level of financial development is measured by the amount of bank credits. We have examined two schools of thought on the causal relationship between financial development and economic growth. One suggests that the increase in the demand for financial services resulting from economic growth is the major driving force behind financial development. Another emphasizes a proactive role for financial development in promoting economic growth. Without ruling out either of these two schools of thought, the relationship between financial development and economic growth has been considered as an interactive one (Objective 1). The test for convergence in financial development and economic growth has been conducted by incorporating the interaction between the real and financial sectors into an otherwise traditional test for convergence. We have set up a regime-switching model to show that the finance-growth causality is unstable across regions and time (i.e., unstable growth paths) (Objective 3), and have considered the roles of government policies including the status of special economic zones and coastal development area, policy expenditure on infrastructure, and state banking, in explaining our major findings (Objective 4). Region-specific socio-economic factors such as education, openness, inflation, and industrial output share have also been included in our empirical analysis (Objective 2).

591713.label: Major findings and research outcome
591713.value: This project examines the relationship between financial development and economic growth across Chinese provinces with switching causality. Four states are considered: bi-directional causality (state 1); one-way causality from growth to finance (state 2); one-way causality from finance to growth (state 3); and non-causality (state 4). Our findings suggest that, while state 3 dominates in developed regions, states 1 and 3 occur intermittently in other regions. This implies that the demand for financial services induced by local economic growth plays a stronger role in driving financial development in under-developed regions. Consistent with prior research, bank loans negatively affect economic growth in China. The findings also show that education, inflation, and real per-capita GDP, consistently exhibit positive marginal effects on the persistence of or switching to states 1 and 3. On the other hand, the same three socio-economic factors consistently show negative marginal effects on the probability of switching to states 2 and 4. The observed intermittent switches of the finance-growth causality regime between states 1 and 3 at the province level could be caused by province-specific factors such as policy shocks and how far the local banking sector responds to funding demand in developing regions. The finance-to-growth causality observed in China is partly the consequence of profound state interventions such as the policy-oriented lending practices of state-owned banks. The research findings have been refereed and published in the following article: Chow, William W, Fung, Michael K, and Leung, Man-kwong (2018), ‘Finance–Growth Nexus in China from an Endogenous Switching Perspective’, Journal of International Trade and Economic Development, 27(4), March, 443-462.

591713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
591713.value: Past studies on financial development and economic growth suggest two manifestations: economic growth induces the demand for financial services and drives financial development, and; financial development channels funds to investment and thus plays a proactive role in promoting economic growth. Without ruling out either of these two possibilities, our empirical model allows the direction of causality to switch over time. Our time-varying regime-switching model considers four possible states (regimes), namely, bi-directional causality (state 1), one-way causality from growth to finance (state 2), one-way causality from finance to growth (state 3), and no causality (state 4). Consistent with previous studies, findings from our project suggest that bank loans are negatively related to economic growth. This finding may be attributed to the adverse effect of state interventionism. The findings also suggest that socio-economic factors like education, inflation, and per-capita GDP, increase the persistence of states 1 and 3, but decrease that of states 2 and 4. While state 3 is more frequently and persistently observed in prosperous regions, states 1 and 3 are observed intermittently in economically backward regions. These findings imply that the causality from growth to finance, as an element of state 1, is more likely to emerge in under-developed regions.

591813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
591813.value: 美國公眾公司會計監督委員會（PCAOB ）的建立，標誌著會計和審計專業的監管格局的一個重大轉變。其重要性不僅影響美國的資本和審計市場，亦延伸到其他國家。一批學者（如DeFond and Francis 2005; Palmrose2006; Lennox and Pittman 2010）呼籲學界研究及評估的PCAOB對審計師質量檢測規定的成效。此項研究對美國和國際監管機構對了解適當的監管模型亦提供協助。 首先，我們計劃硏究PCAOB對與PCAOB註冊的非美國審計師的審計質量（AQ） 。這種監督的存在是因為PCAOB要求所有SEC註冊的美國上市公司的審計師受PCAOB監管及檢查，當中包括許多非美國境內的審計公司（截至2011年，共有900多間）。更重要的是，儘管最近的研究（如Carcello et al. 2011; DeFond and Lennox 2011; Abbott et al. 2012）顯示美國審計師的AQ因為PCAOB的質量檢測而提高，我們尚未清楚這樣的檢測會否惠及非美國審計師的AQ。一方面，美國監督的價值對非美國的審計師理應更大，因為美國監管制度相對更嚴格；但另一方面，美國的監督未必有所成效，因為（1）檢測的質量對美國和非美國審計師可能有所不同；（2）因為語言障礙影響到PCAOB的檢測工作；和（3）PCAOB對非美國審計師檢測在執行上存在著一定困難。因此，我們首先利用美國的數據去硏究非美國審計師的審計質量會否受惠於PCAOB的監督，並硏究這樣的好處會否取決於非美國審計師原來地區的會計師責任標準。 其次，我們利用國際數據去硏究那些源於美國監督的質量優勢會否經由那些在美國註册的非美國審計師傳遞給他們的本國（非美國）客戶（溢出效應），因為理論上，經由美國檢測的非美國審計師會整體地提高其質量控制機制、審計方法等，而此改進是可能惠及其所有客戶，而非只是美國客戶。此溢出效應在過去研究主要集中在審計師的非審計服務如何惠及同一客戶的審計質量（如Simunic 1984; Krishnan and Yu 2011），而此硏究則以監管為媒體去硏究質量相關的溢出效應如何惠及同一審計師的所有其他客戶。 最後，因為一些國家（包括中國大陸和香港）基於一些主權和法律問題，不允許PCAOB檢查其審計師，我們硏究以上的溢出效應是否較少出現在這些國家。是項硏究的結果亦將提供了PCAOB努力尋求與國外監管機構的合作的理由，並幫助各國的監管機構了解及評估允許PCAOB檢查其審計師的利弊。

591813.label: Realisation of objectives
591813.value: The objectives are realized up to 100%. Upon examining the data, we find that all the three hypotheses are supported by the data. In particular, using data from 55 countries for a period of 2003-2011, we find that (1) in the US market, PCAOB inspections improve audit quality (AQ) of non-U.S. auditors for their U.S. clients, and such improvements are stronger for auditors from countries with lower liability standards for accountants; (2) in the international markets, we find that the higher audit quality of PCAOB-registered non-U.S. auditors extend to their non-U.S. clients in their home countries (The spillover hypothesis), and such effects is stronger in countries with lower liability standards for accountants; and (3) in the international markets, we find that The spillover effects to PCAOB-registered non-U.S. auditors’ clients are stronger after the implementation of the PCAOB inspection program, but weaker in countries that do not allow PCAOB inspections. In the journal review process, we also find a number of extended findings, including (1) we find that the improvements in actual audit quality is over and above the threat of such inspections; and (2) the spillover effects varies across different factors, such as (a) substantive improvements in financial reporting enforcement in the foreign auditor’s home country, (b) the proximity (in terms of geographical distance, culture and language) of the foreign auditor’s home country to the US, (c) the importance of the foreign auditor (and the foreign auditor’s home country) to the US equity market, (d) earlier vs. later PCAOB inspections, and (e) whether the foreign auditor is affiliated with one of the six global audit firm networks. Taken together, the objectives should be considered as fully achieved.

591813.label: Major findings and research outcome
591813.value: Major findings: Using data from 55 countries for a period of 2003-2011, we find that (1) in the US market, PCAOB inspections improve audit quality (AQ) of non-U.S. auditors for their U.S. clients, and such improvements are stronger for auditors from countries with lower liability standards for accountants; (2) in the international markets, we find that the higher audit quality of PCAOB-registered non-U.S. auditors extend to their non-U.S. clients in their home countries (The spillover hypothesis), and such effects is stronger in countries with lower liability standards for accountants; and (3) in the international markets, we find that The spillover effects to PCAOB-registered non-U.S. auditors’ clients are stronger after the implementation of the PCAOB inspection program, but weaker in countries that do not allow PCAOB inspections. (4) the improvements in actual audit quality is over and above the threat of such inspections; and (5) the spillover effects varies across different factors, such as (a) substantive improvements in financial reporting enforcement in the foreign auditor’s home country, (b) the proximity (in terms of geographical distance, culture and language) of the foreign auditor’s home country to the US, (c) the importance of the foreign auditor (and the foreign auditor’s home country) to the US equity market, (d) earlier vs. later PCAOB inspections, and (e) whether the foreign auditor is affiliated with one of the six global audit firm networks. A working paper is drafted and submitted to Journal of Accounting and Economics, one of the top tier journals in Accounting, and it is under the second round revision with positive comments. This should be considered another research outcome. Another outcome is that the research has been of interest to the academia and it is accepted for presentation in various schools, different parts of the world, and different internationally recognized academic conferences (see the documentation available in Part C). The PCAOB also approached the author to obtain an earlier version of the working paper for their consideration.

591813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
591813.value: The paper is still under review and the future work for the investigators is to address all the comments raised by the JAE editor and reviewer, and have it published in the journal. It may take some more time for the final outcome (acceptance for publication at JAE) to be realized but the PI intends to submit the completion report at this stage because the PI has resigned from his current position at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and will work in an overseas university. As such a closure of the project at this point might be deemed more appropriate.

591813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
591813.value: We examine whether the PCAOB international inspection program improves audit quality for a sample of non-US-listed foreign public companies from 55 countries audited by foreign (i.e., non-US) auditors. Specifically, for a sample of non-US-listed foreign clients of PCAOB-registered foreign auditors, we find the initial (actual) PCAOB inspections to have a salutary effect on audit quality over and above the threat of such inspections. Our findings suggest that the PCAOB international inspection program has a positive externality, i.e., actual PCAOB inspections improve audit quality not only for foreign audit firms’ US-listed clients but also for their non-US-listed foreign clients. Our findings are of potential interest to the Board (as well as audit regulators overseas) in documenting the benefits of PCAOB international inspections for foreign investors in non-US-listed foreign companies thereby increasing the acceptability of the PCAOB’s international inspection program abroad.

592213.label: Project Title(Chinese)
592213.value: 定性資訊對股票價格與盈利公告關係之影響：香港和中國內地比較研究

592213.label: Co - Investigator(s)
592213.value: Dr CHUI, Chun Wai Andy Prof Gul, Ferdinand A.

592213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
592213.value: 由上市公司和市場中介機構提供的非結構化定性資訊，有助於正確理解定量財務資料，並構成有關企業當前和未來盈利能力的持續信息源。鑒於目前尚缺乏有關定性資訊在股市（尤其是在新興股票市場）中之作用的系統性證據，本研究項目將集中探討體現於眾多公共信息源的定性資訊如何影響股價盈利反應係數（ ERC ）和盈利公佈後漂移（ PEAD ），目標市場為中國內地及香港。這兩個市場的體制環境和信息環境不僅有別於美國，而且彼此之間也各有差別。研究中港兩地既能驗證之前的美國研究結果（該等先前研究表明，定性資訊相對定量財務資訊具有增量信息含量），也有助於研究環境因素對定性資訊特征所產生的作用，及其對股價與盈利公告關係之影響。本研究有別於現有文獻，除了從國際比較的角度來探討相關問題，我們也研究體現於多個信息源的多種定性資訊，並且同時檢查定性資訊對ERC和PEAD的影響。 由於現有基於字典的內容分析法不適合於金融研究，並且也不能輕易地移植到中文語言環境，所以我們用SAS Enterprise Content Categorization程序開發一套適用於中文的大樣本金融文本分析法。我們首先用源於每個信息源的培訓文檔反復驗證程序，然後用該程序來測量公司盈利公告前后在報紙新聞報道、分析師報告和企業公告中所體現出來的語體音調、確定性和意見分歧度。我們將由此所得的定性資訊和與盈利相關的其他信息以及企業特徵配合使用，研究其如何影響股價對年度盈利公告的反應。我們要驗証的中心假設是：發布更翔實的公共信息（例如傳送更清晰的語體音調，更一致的看法，和更具確定性的公共信息），有助於投資者更好地了解盈利數字以及其他方面的企業信息環境，從而增強投資者的信心，最終使得股價對盈利公告產生較強較快的反應。 我們的研究為下列重要問題提供實證證據：什麼類型的定性資訊有增量的價值相關性；什麼類型的信息來源更獲投資者信任；什麼類型的企業和市場環境/條件產生更為翔實的（即高品質）公司特質信息。該等研究成果具有重要的理論、政策和實務意義。我們的文本分析方法可以大規模提取定性資訊；同時分析多種公共資訊不僅可以減低前人研究由於通常專注於單一信息渠道而產生的潛在遺漏變量偏差，而且還能開闢出許多有意義的未來研究機會。

592313.label: Project Title(Chinese)
592313.value: 從認知不協調理論及潛在成長模型來理解知識傳遞的時序過程及其對分析型客戶關係管理系統使用者對系統評價的影響

592313.label: Co - Investigator(s)
592313.value: Dr Li, Xixi Prof RAI, Arun

592313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
592313.value: With the growth of the “big data” phenomenon, service organizations are increasing their investments in analytical customer relationship management systems (referred to as ACRM) that enable business personnel to generate insight from large volumes of data. Once organizations implement ACRM (i.e., the post-ACRM-implementation stage), business personnel’s utilitarian evaluations of ACRM are crucial in driving their effective system use. Toward this end, managers need to ensure that business personnel possess the needed complex knowledge for ACRM evaluations. However, while we know that complex knowledge can be transferred through ongoing interactions among colleagues, it is unclear how to manage this knowledge-transfer process over time and how transferred complex knowledge affects business personnel’s ACRM evaluations in the post-implementation context. Drawing on cognitive dissonance theory and the learning literature, we conceptualize knowledge transfer as a temporal process with an initial status and ensuing change over time. Considering that ACRM integrates advanced marketing concepts and information system (IS) functionalities, we further identify domain and system knowledge as most needed for ACRM evaluations. With this backdrop, we develop a model for the post-ACRM-implementation context that explains the 1) difference in the initial status of domain-knowledge transfer (DKT) and system-knowledge transfer (SKT), 2) the relative changes in DKT and SKT over time, 3) the differential impacts of the initial status of DKT and SKT on business personnel’s ACRM assessments, and 4) the shift in the differential impacts of DKT and SKT over time. To test the model, we will collect data from two retail, two telecom service, and two financial service firms that plan to implement ACRM. The participants are business personnel who will use ACRM for analytical works. Having been granted data access by these firms’ top management, we plan to employ a rich multi-wave, multi-source, and multi-firm research design. We will use the latent growth modeling (LGM) technique to represent and analyze the temporal process of knowledge transfer and its effects on users’ ACRM evaluations. In terms of contributions, we expect to develop a rich conceptualization of knowledge transfer in the post-implementation stage, identify the most needed knowledge for ACRM evaluations, and arrive at a holistic understanding about the dynamic relationship between knowledge transfer and system evaluations in the post-ACRM-implementation context. Methodologically, this study would be one of the first IS studies applying LGM to examine the temporal model. We also expect to develop insights for managers to formulate effective interventions to better leverage ACRM for desired outcomes 伴隨著大數據時代的到來，服務型組織正增加他們對分析型客戶關係管理系統（ACRM）的投資以期使其業務人員能夠從大量的數據中產生有價值的信息。一旦組織實施了ACRM之後，業務人員對系統的評價是他們能否有效使用系統的關鍵。因此，管理者需要確保業務人員具有足夠的知識來對ACRM進行評價。雖然我們知道知識可以透過同事之間的互動進行傳遞，但是在ACRM系統實施後的場景中，我們並不清楚如何隨著時間的變化來管理知識傳遞的過程、以及知識傳遞會如何對業務人員對ACRM的評價產生影響。 基於認知不協調理論及相關的學習文獻，我們將知識傳遞概念化為一個時序的過程；這個過程包含了起始狀態以及後續的改變。考慮到ACRM整合了先進的行銷概念及複雜的系統功能，我們進一步提出業務知識及系統知識為評價ACRM所需要最相關的知識。在此基礎上，我們為ACRM系統實施後的場景發展了一個模型來解釋1）業務知識傳遞與系統知識傳遞在起始狀態上的差異，2) 隨著時間的推移，業務知識傳遞與系統知識傳遞在後續的差異性改變，3）業務知識傳遞與系統知識傳遞的起始狀態對使用ACRM業務人員的系統評價的差異化影響，及4）上述差異化影響如何隨著時間的推移而改變。 我們計劃從即將實施ACRM的兩個零售商，兩個電信服務商，及兩個財務服務商進行調研並蒐集數據以對模型進行測試。調研的對象為使用ACRM進行分析型工作的業務人員。我們已經取得這幾個公司高層管理的支持並計劃施行一個多波段、多信息源、多公司的研究設計。我們會採用潛在成長模型來分析知識傳遞的時序過程及其對ACRM使用者對系統評價的影響。 關於理論貢獻，我們期望豐富對知識傳遞的概念，指出對ACRM評價最需要的相關知識，並發展出對知識傳遞如何動態影響ACRM系統評價的完整理解。這篇同時是少數最早使用潛在成長模型來研究時序過程的信息系統研究。我們也期望能從研究的發現當中找出幫助管理人員有效利用ACRM的洞見。
