599313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
599313.value: In recent decades, global trade has grown significantly due to the increasing global sourcing activities and diffusing production sites. Shipping activities is responsible for the transportation of approximately 90% of global trade volume. Due to the imperative role in facilitating global cargo flow, the sustainable development of shipping operations has attracted increasing attention. The urgency of encouraging environmental management improvements within the shipping industry has been identified as a key issue in the World Wildlife Fund (WWF). WWF introduces the sustainable shipping initiatives which refer to “innovative schemes that encourage shipping to go beyond standard compliance of environmental behavior and become exemplary in their approach to shipping operations and the environment”. The keynote speaker of the International Forum on China’s Economy and Policy (organised by the Central Policy Unit of the HKSAR Government and the National Academy of Economic Strategy of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences on 12 September 2012) also stated that pressures from customers to produce and deliver products in a sustainable manner are increasing dramatically. It is essential for business enterprises to adopt green operations to meet their customer requirements. In the shipping community, increasing number of shipping firms adopt green shipping practices (GSP) for the development of environmentally sustainable shipping operations. The importance of environmental governance in GSP adoption has been recognized by all stakeholders in the shipping community. Although environmental governance plays an essential role to promote the adoption of GSP, the shipping literature is lacking knowledge on relationship between GSP and environmental governance. This project proposes and empirically validates an integrated model to examine how various environmental governance mechanisms (i.e., contractual mechanism, relational mechanism, and organizational mechanism) enacted by shipping firms affect the GSP adoption and their linkage with firm performance. There are several contributions of this study. From the managerial perspective, this research will contribute to the understanding of the environmental governance issues and helps to reframe debates surrounding the use of environmental governance mechanisms to intensify the adoption of GSP. It will provide managerial guideline to facilitate shipping firms to adopt GSP to enhance their economic performance and environmental performance. Academically, the findings of this study will provide insights on the development of environmental governance structure and its linkage with GSP adoptions. Furthermore, a theory to predict and explain the relationship between environmental governance mechanism and GSP adoption, and the linkage with performance outcome will be established and empirically tested. 近幾十年來，全球貿易增長顯著，主要是受全球採購活動及生產基地擴大影響。而全球貿易約九成的交易量是透過航運進行貨物運輸，所以航運業對貨物流通扮演不可或缺的角色，航運的可持續性發展亦因此備受關注。世界自然基金會認為航運業需要急切改善環保管理，並針對可持續航運推出一系列措施，鼓勵航運業在遵守現行環保規則之外，採用創新的手法提升航運業的環保水準。香港特別行政區政府中央政策組及中國社會科學院財經戰略研究院在2012年9月12日合作舉辦的「中國經濟運行與政策國際論壇」上，其中一名講者亦指出客戶對生產及貨物運送的可持續性亦要求越來越高。為迎合客戶要求，採用環保的營運手法對企業益發重要，越來越多的航運商相繼採用綠色航運實務(Green Shipping Practices)，追求業內的可續性發展。環保監管的重要性在航運業界已有共識，亦有利促進綠色航運實務的推行，但綠色航運實務與環保監管兩者之間的關係尚未有文獻記載。本研究旨在提出及驗證一個綜合的模式，檢視航運業界盛行的環保監管機制的每一個環節如何影響綠色航運實務的落實，以及與營商表現的關係。本研究可在多方面做出貢獻。在管理層面，本研究有助進一步理解環保監管的問題，促進綠色航運實務的實施，調整環保監管機制討論焦點，從而向航運商提供管理守則建議，提升業界的經濟及環保表現。在學術層面，研究結果可就環保監管機制的發展提供線索，及明白綠色航運實務與監管機制兩者的關係。另外，本研究可助建立及測試提出的理論，對環保監管機制及綠色航運實務兩者的關係作出預測及解釋。

599313.label: Realisation of objectives
599313.value: The project identified environmental governance mechanism (i.e., contractual, relational, and organizational mechanism) in the shipping industry that can be employed by shipping firms to implement green shipping practices effectively. Then, hypotheses were formulated to build a theoretically integrated model to examine how various environmental governance mechanisms enacted by shipping firm influence the extent to which GSP is implemented. Data was collected to empirically validate the model. This project also used the concept of greening propensity to examine the environmental and economic performance implications for shipping firms as a result of their implementation of green shipping practices. A book (entitled Green Shipping Management) was also published to provide managerial implications for shipping mangers to develop effective environmental governance structure for managing green shipping practices.

599313.value: A growing number of shipping firms seek to improve their environmental performance in the hope of developing environmentally sustainable shipping operations. Although environmental governance plays an essential role in leading shipping firms to improve their environmental performance, there is scant knowledge on the relationship between environmental governance and environmental performance in the shipping literature. This study proposed and empirically validated an integrated model to study how various environmental governance mechanisms (i.e., contractual, relational, and organizational) are enacted by shipping firms and their influence on shipping firms' environmental performance. Stakeholders in the shipping/logistics industry have growing concern about the damage caused by operations to the environment. This study defined greening propensity (GP) as "involvement of customers to perform logistics activities to achieve environmental performance". The PI analyze survey data collected to examine the categories of greening capability, and the performance outcomes greening capability.

600113.label: Project Objectives
600113.value: Experimentally investigate small angle lattice rotations in graphene grown on metal surfaces using low energy electron microscopy and micro-low energy electron diffraction, in order to (a) document the pervasiveness of this rotational microstructure and (b) develop fabrication methods that suppress its formation. Investigate controversial aspects of the structure of graphene on Ru(0001) using micro-low energy electron diffraction, including the lateral periodicity of graphene that is free of small-angle rotational microstructure and the possibility of biaxial lattice distortions. These investigations will either contribute to resolving the controversy over the graphene/Ru(0001) structure or bring new experimental insight that must be considered in the development of theoretical understanding of the exceptional structure in this system. Explore bottom-up approaches for controlling the formation of large angle rotational variants as a means of engineering grain boundaries during the growth of graphene on metals.

600113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
600113.value: Since the isolation of free-standing, single-layer graphene was achieved by mechanical exfoliation several years ago, this exciting material has attracted great attention owing to discoveries of its unique electronic, mechanical and optical properties. Interest in graphene on metal surfaces has been driven concurrently by the need to make metallic contacts in graphene-based devices. Growth of graphene directly on metals also overcomes the severe limitations of exfoliation to produce single-layer graphene over large areas, although problems with structural uniformity remain. One approach that is being explored for manipulating the properties of graphene, particularly electronic transport, is grain boundary engineering. Therefore, knowledge of the structure and morphology of graphene supported by crystalline substrates is important for developing schemes for producing graphene that could underpin future applications. We will investigate the growth, structure and morphology of graphene on metal surfaces using low-energy electron microscopy (LEEM) and micro-low energy electron diffraction (micro-LEED). Spatially-resolved measurements using LEEM and related microscopies have made notable contributions to the understanding of local properties in graphene layers that are customarily spatially inhomogeneous when prepared on supporting substrates. For example, these techniques have been used to examine aspects of micron-sized graphene grains that are rotated relative to one another by large angles, up to 30 degrees, which are commonly called rotational variants. We will focus instead on the more challenging problem of understanding defect structure on much smaller length and angular scales. In particular, we will examine small-angle lattice rotations (~0.2°) of the type that we recently discovered on the sub-100 nanometer length scale in graphene on the Ru(0001) surface using LEEM and micro-LEED. The small-angle grain boundaries that accompany this rotational microstructure could in fact contribute to the well-known degradation of electron mobility in graphene grown on supporting substrates compared to exfoliated graphene. Now that their existence is known and powerful methods for characterizing small-angle lattice rotations are in hand, we intend to ascertain their prevalence in other graphene/metal systems. One outcome of our work may be to identify new graphene fabrication methods that suppress the formation of small-angle microstructure. We will also examine whether lattice rotations, small and large, impact on structural properties, such as long-range periodicity. A related line of investigation will be to explore methods for exploiting large-angle rotational variants to engineer grain boundaries. Gaining control over grain boundary orientation, position and density is essential for developing this scheme as a method to manipulate electronic transport. 自從人們在幾年前實現通過機械剝離的方法來隔離自由無束縛、單原子層的石墨烯之后，其獨特的電學，力學和光學性能方面的發現讓人感到興奮，並引起高度重視。以石墨烯為基礎的器件中与金属接触的需求，同時驅動了人们對石墨烯在金屬表面上的研究興趣。而且直接在金屬上生長石墨烯克服了剝離帶來的眾多侷限而能夠生長成較大面積的石墨烯，雖然仍存有結構不均勻的問題。人們正在通過晶界工程來探索一種操縱石墨烯的屬性，尤其是電子輸運的方法。因此，關於石墨烯在晶態襯底上的結構和形態方面的知識對規劃製造石墨烯、為未來應用奠定基石起著至關重要的作用。 我們將使用低能量電子顯微鏡（ LEEM ）和微米低能電子衍射（micro-LEED ）研究石墨烯在金屬表面上結構和形態。LEEM及相關顯微鏡的空間分辨測量有效地幫助我們理解了石墨烯在襯底上生長時通常產生的空間分佈不均的局部特性。舉例來說，這些技術已被用來研究微米尺寸石墨烯晶粒之間的大角度相對旋轉，最大可達到30度，通常稱之為旋轉變種（rotational variants）。於之不同，我們將重點放在更具挑戰性的問題上，即研究在小得多的長度和角度範圍內的缺陷結構。我們將著重檢測小角度（ 〜 0.2°）晶向旋轉的一種類型，這是我們最近用LEEM和micro-LEED研究Ru（0001）表面上生長的低於100納米尺度的石墨烯時發現的。眾所週知，相對于被剝離的石墨烯，生長於襯底上的石墨烯有電子遷移率退化現象，這是由伴隨著上述旋轉微觀結構的小角度晶粒邊界導致的。既然我們知道這種現象的存在，而且表徵小角度晶格旋轉的有力方法也已在手，我們打算確定它在其他石墨烯/金屬系統中的存在。我們的研究目標之一可能是探尋抑制形成小角度的微觀結構的新的石墨烯製備方法。我們亦會研究晶格旋轉（無論角度大小）是否影響結構特性，如長程週期性。一個相關的研究路線是探索利用大角度旋轉變種來設計晶粒邊界的方法。作為操縱電子輸運的方法，本規劃著重於控制晶粒邊界的方向，位置和密度。

600113.label: Realisation of objectives
600113.value: We investigated the growth, defect structure and strain of graphene (g) on metals using low energy electron microscopy (LEEM) and micro-low energy electron diffraction (micro-LEED). Our investigations addressed the formation, characterization and control of defects and strain. The defect structures that were investigated included small-angle rotational domains and large angle rotational grains, disclination point defects, and grain boundary and nano-wrinkle line defects. Metal substrates that were investigated included Ru(0001), Rh(111), Ir(111), Cu(111). Local structural characterization was made by exploiting a powerful new method that was developed in this project. This structural characterization exploited micro-LEED measurements from very small selected areas (~250nm). Furthermore, structural information that was obtained at many positions on the sample by scanning the micro-LEED beam in a two-dimensional array could be compiled into a scanning micro-LEED image. Detailed structural information was obtained by evaluating the positions of coincidence or moiré superstructure diffraction peaks produced by the lattice mismatch between graphene and metal substrate. The graphene lattice constant and the relative orientation of graphene and substrate lattices were determined from the geometrical relationship between these structural parameters and experimentally measured quantities, i.e. the coincidence lattice and substrate lattice periodicities and relative orientation of the coincidence latter and the substrate. The precise quantitative information provided by this approach complemented qualitative information present in conventional LEEM images. In addition to LEEM imaging in conventional bright-field and dark-field modes, a novel shadow dark-field LEEM imaging method was also utilized in our work to assess structural non-uniformity. This method transforms the defect structural information contained in the diffraction spot shape to conspicuous image contrast features. These complementary diffraction and imaging measurements exposed previously unknown details of small-angle lattice rotations, incommensurability, polymorphism and strain of graphene on metals. We determined that small-angle rotational domains form in graphene when point defects consisting of five-fold and seven-fold member ring disclination pairs are randomly introduced during growth by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) at elevated temperature. Variability of the angular distribution and rotational domain size that comprise the small-angle rotational mosaic with graphene growth temperature was observed on the Ru(0001) surface. This indicates that the point defect density can be controlled to some extent by the choice of growth temperature. Although the mosaic was diminished using higher growth temperature, this approach to producing an ideal graphene layer with no mosaic was not successful. It failed because the growth rate decreases with increasing temperature due to the diminishing adsorption of ethylene. Taking a new approach, we discovered that rotational mosaic could be eliminated using a hybrid growth method that combined CVD with bulk segregation of carbon. However, the graphene produced by this method exhibited incommensurability and polymorphism. In particular, the graphene lattice constant exhibited a continuous distribution between peaks corresponding to 25-on-23 and 12-on-11 commensurate structures. In order to understand these observations, we used the Keating model to evaluate the elastic deformation energy arising from compressive/tensile strain, shear strain, and bending. This analysis demonstrated how the lateral strain may couple to the corrugation of the graphene layer. This work may shed light on the controversies over the lateral periodicity and corrugation of g/Ru(0001) determined by different experimental methods. Complementary investigations of Ru, Dy, Gd nanoparticles embedded under a graphene monolayer at the surface of graphite were performed in collaboration with Prof. Pat Thiel’s group at Iowa State University. Exploiting our understanding of the coincidence lattice formed between graphene and metal, we evaluated coincidence lattice features observed in real-space using scanning tunneling microscopy to determine metal lattice constant and rotational relationship with the graphene overlayer. This evaluation revealed unstrained bulk-like structure of closed-packed Ru(0001) nanoparticles, but 20% contracted lattices of Dy and Gd with respect to bulk structure. Moreover, small-angle rotations of Ru nanoparticles were observed that are consistent with the results of our observations of graphene on macroscopic Ru(0001) samples. Other experiments also revealed the presence of similar small-angle rotational mosaic in graphene on Rh(111) and Ir(111). We also investigated nano-wrinkles in g/Ir(111). These line defects form during cooling from the growth temperature to relieve strain that arises from the differential thermal expansion properties of graphene and metal substrate. Two-dimensional strain mapping provided by scanning micro-LEED measurements clearly show inhomogeneous strain relief by wrinkles. Wrinkles only facilitate localized strain relaxation spanning ~20% of the mean wrinkle spacing. This observation suggests that it may be possible to strain engineer the properties of graphene by a bottom-up approach if wrinkling can be brought under control to form desirable wrinkle networks. In support of these investigations, we compared Fourier Optics (FO) and Contrast Transfer Function (CTF) theories of LEEM image formation. This work identified a method to determine the morphology of wrinkled graphene quantatively, i.e. its period and amplitude, by modeling a focal image series. It also revealed the shortcoming of the CTF method for performing this evaluation and the necessity to use the FO method. This theoretical understanding of image formation can facilitate investigation of graphene wrinkles using LEEM in the future. Our attention turned to graphene grown on Cu substrates because Cu is widely used to fabricate large-area graphene with transferability to arbitrary substrates for use in industrial applications. Our efforts to translate this research to Cu substrates were initially hindered because of the difficulty to grow graphene on Cu under conditions consistent with ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) in the LEEM. One approach that took employed rapid cooling under our most aggressive CVD growth conditions. This yielded some graphene growth, but this was too meager to make more progress. We also attempted to grow graphene on modified Cu(111) surfaces, including the oxidized surface and the surface covered with an Cu2Sb surface alloy. Although both of these modified substrates proved unsuitable for graphene growth, this work yielded supplementary scientific discoveries. We discovered a new Cu surface oxide structure that exhibits several interesting phase transitions. We also identified novel ordinary and supernumerary resonant scattering effects in very low energy electron diffraction from the Cu2Sub surface alloy. After the failure of our attempts to grow graphene on Cu and modified Cu surfaces under UHV-compatible conditions, we turned to graphene/Cu prepared ex-situ in high pressure furnaces by two external groups, at Chongqing University lead by Prof. Wen-Xin Tang and at lead by Prof. Rodney Ruoff. This collaborative work produced several interesting results in line with the project objectives. Our measurements in collaboration with Prof. Tang contributed to an understanding of the growth highly-oriented graphene with minimal rotational domains and line defects on twinned Cu substrates. Our measurements in collaboration with Prof. Ruoff provided crucial evidence of adlayer-free single layer graphene growth on Cu(111). They also yielded an important breakthrough for this research project. Namely, we observed the formation of a one-dimensional nano-wrinkle morphology on a vicinal Cu(111) substrate. This effect is attributed to the uniaxial strain relaxation provided by atomic steps and facets on a vicinal Cu(111) substrate. Using facet diffraction analysis, we identified the presence of inclined (11-1), (122) and (212) facets at the vicinal Cu(111) substrate surface. This result finally ties together our project by identifying a method to control defect morphology. Publication of the results obtained through collaborative work will be made as soon as possible on a time-line that is mutually agreeable with our external collaborators.

600113.label: Major findings and research outcome
600113.value: This project provided new insights about the formation, characteristics and control of point, line and rotational domain defects in graphene on metals. Small-angle rotational domains form when point defects are randomly introduced during graphene growth by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) at elevated temperature on Ru(0001) and Rh(111) surfaces. The rotational domain size and angular distribution that characterize the rotational mosiac, hence the point defect density, in graphene on Ru(0001) depended upon and could be controlled to some extent by growth temperature. The rotational mosaic could only be totally suppressed using a hybrid growth method that combined CVD with bulk segregation of carbon. However, graphene formed under these conditions exhibited incommensurability and polymorphism. This behavior is attributed to the coupling of lateral strain and vertical corrugation of the graphene layer. Complementary investigations of Ru nanoparticles embedded under a graphene monolayer at the surface of graphite revealed small-angle rotations of Ru nanoparticles with unstrained bulk-like structure [3]. Investigations of graphene/Ir(111) revealed inhomogenous strain relief by nano-wrinkles that form due to the differential thermal expansions of graphene and metal substrate. This suggests that it may be possible to strain engineer the properties of graphene if wrinkle line defects can be controlled to form desirable networks. Publication of these results will be made now that we have achieved our goal to control wrinkle morphology as outlined below [4]. The development of LEEM image formation theory and its demonstration to characterize wrinkled graphene provides us with a new tool to study strain effects [1]. Efforts were made to translate these investigations to the study of graphene on Cu substrates of industrial relevance. These efforts were initially hindered because of the difficulty to grow graphene on Cu under ultrahigh vacuum conditions. We attempted to overcome this difficulty using a Cu(111)-Sb surface alloy substrate. Although this was not successful, we discovered new ordinary and supernumerary resonant scattering effects in electron scattering at very low energy [2]. Investigations of graphene prepared by collaborators on Cu substrates in high pressure furnaces produced two key findings: (1) growth on twinned Cu substrates offers a route to fabricate highly-oriented graphene with minimal rotational domains and line defects [5], (2) uniaxial strain relaxation provided by atomic steps and facets on a vicinal Cu(111) substrate facilitates the formation of a one-dimensional nano-wrinkle morphology [6]. Publication of collaborative research will be made as soon as possible with timeline consented to by our collaborators [3,4,6].

600113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
600113.value: There are several routes for further development of the project. 1) Nanowrinkle morphology - The observation that nano-wrinkle morphology can be controlled using vicinal substrates stimulates further investigations of this effect. A complete understanding and development of this effect requires experimental investigations of the dependence of wrinkle morphology on vicinal angle and direction, i.e. atomic step density and orientation, respectively. We will try to pursue this direction of research by extending our collaboration with Prof.Ruoff’s group at Ulsan University. 2) Small-angle lattice rotations - The proliferation of small-angle lattice rotations that we observed in graphene on several metals in this project suggests that this may in fact be a very common effect that has been overlooked in the past. Further investigations should be made to investigate rotational mosaic using the powerful techniques we developed in this project. We intend to continue this work by characterizing graphene prepared on Ge surfaces by Profs. M Lagally and co-workers at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. 3) Elastic properties of graphene – We plan to use capabilities to evaluate graphene wrinkle morphology using the new understanding of LEEM image formation theory gained in this project to investigate the elastic properties of graphene.

600113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
600113.value: This project provided new insights about the formation, characteristics and control of small-angle rotation domains, point and line defects and strain inhomogeneities in graphene on metals. These structural features are important because they may be detrimental to the exceptional properties of ideal graphene that attract wide interest. Alternatively, these features may be harnessed to manipulate the graphene’s properties, if they can be controlled. Our investigations revealed that the random introduction of point defects induces the formation of small-angle rotational mosaicity during graphene growth on several metals. Although this phenomenon could be controlled by careful adjustment of growth conditions, elimination of small-angle rotational mosiac resulted in the appearance of incommensurability and polymorphism. These observations shed light on controversies over the lateral periodicity and corrugation of graphene on the Ru(0001) surface. Inhomogeneous strain relaxation by nano-wrinkle line defects in graphene on Ir(111) and Cu(111) surfaces was also detected. Interestingly, the random nano-wrinkle network that forms on flat substrates contrasts with the one-dimensional nano-wrinkle morphology that is induced by uniaxial strain relaxation at atomic steps on vicinal substrates. The project results demonstrate the proliferation of structural inhomogeneities and identify viable strategies that may be exploited for controlling them and possibly enhancing graphene’s functionality.

600413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
600413.value: Atmospheric aerosols have impacts on different scales from climate to human health. Our understanding of those impacts is impeded by the complex and dynamic features of atmospheric aerosols. Characterization of atmospheric aerosols, especially organic aerosols, on their chemical compositions and physical properties by traditional approaches are limited by either the lack of comprehensiveness or low time-resolution. Recent developments in aerosol instrumentation have provided tools for real-time characterization of atmospheric aerosols with sufficient comprehensiveness and time-resolution to capture the fast-changing characteristics of atmospheric aerosols. In the proposed study, we will investigate ambient aerosols in Hong Kong by using a High-Resolution Time-of-Flight Aerosol Mass Spectrometer (HR-ToF-AMS) and a Hygroscopic Tandem Differential Mobility Analyzer (HTDMA) to measure the chemical composition and aerosol hygroscopicity, respectively. Four-month of worth real-time measurements were made at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) Air Quality Supersite from 2011 to 2012, with one month in each season. Analyses of these data will be performed to understand the source and transformation of atmospheric aerosols, especially organic aerosols. Correlations between chemical characteristics of organic aerosols, such as degree of oxygenation, and aerosol hygroscopicity indicated by growth factors or growth curves as measured by HTDMA will also be explored to obtain parameterization for prediction of hygroscopic behaviors of atmospheric aerosols. Additional measurements at the same site and by the same instruments will also be conducted to obtain another dataset for seasonal trend comparisons. Furthermore, we will confirm the hypotheses from the preliminary results of the four-month data utilizing this new dataset. 大气气溶胶对人类健康及气候等方面具有重要的影响。大气气溶胶自身的复杂性及其动力学特征是阻碍气溶胶研究的重要因素。传统方法对大气气溶胶，尤其是有机气溶胶的，化学成分和物理特性的表征缺乏全面性，并且受到了低时间分辨率的限制。近年来，气溶胶仪器的发展为气溶胶的实时监测提供了新的手段；捕捉了瞬息万变的大气气溶胶特征，弥补了气溶胶研究在全面性和低时间分辨率方面的不足。在此项研究中，我们利用高分辨率的气溶胶质谱仪（HR-ToF-AMS）和吸湿串联微分迁移率分析仪（HTDMA）分别对气溶胶的化学组分和吸湿性进行研究。从2011年到2012年间的四个季节，我们分别在香港科技大学大气环境监测超级站进行了四个月有效的实时监测。通过对现有数据的分析，有助于理解大气气溶胶尤其是有机气溶胶的来源及其演变机制。对有机气溶胶的化学特性（例如，氧化程度）及吸湿性（例如，吸湿性生长因子及生长因子曲线）之间的相关性进行探索，获得相关的参数以实现对大气气溶胶吸湿性行为的预测。为了探索比较气溶胶理化特征季节变化的趋势，我们将在相同的地点利用相同的仪器进行另一组监测。利用所获得的新一组数据，对以上四个月的分析结果得出的假设进行验证。

600413.label: Realisation of objectives
600413.value: The objectives are realized to the full extent. Objective 1 was achieved by making measurements with an HR-ToF-AMS at (i) the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) Air Quality Research Supersite and (ii) the urban roadside in Hong Kong. Detailed analyses were conducted on the AMS data in the aspects of (1) species concentrations, (2) size distributions, (3) degree of oxygenation of organics, and (4) positive matrix factorization (PMF)-resolved organic factors. In the field campaign at the HKUST Supersite, concentrations of organic sulfur compounds were further estimated based on the high-resolution fragmentation patterns of methane sulfonic acid and organo-sulfates (including alkyl, phenyl, and cycloalkyl sulfates) obtained in laboratory experiments. Objectives 2 and 3 were achieved by conducting simultaneous aerosol hygroscopicity and composition measurements using a Humidified Tandem Differential Mobility Analyzer (HTDMA) and the HR-ToF-AMS at the HKUST Supersite. Growth factors (GF) of ambient aerosols at fixed 90% relative humidity (RH) were measured to achieve objective 2 while dehydration (decreasing RH) and hydration (increasing RH) cycles of aerosols at 10% to 93% RH were measured to achieve objective 3. Detailed analyses on the HTDMA data for different hygroscopic modes at fixed and varying RHs, as well as their relationship with chemical composition and air mass origins were conducted.

600413.label: Major findings and research outcome
600413.value: We have published six papers (items 1 to 6 listed in Section 8, Part C) based on the HTDMA and AMS data at HKUST and urban roadside in Hong Kong. Key findings are described below: i) The non-refractory PM1 (NR-PM1) at the HKUST Supersite was highly aged, with a high sulfate content and highly oxygenated organic components. The relative fractions of different species showed dependence on season and air mass origin. In terms of percentages of species in the NR-PM1 mass, sulfate was highest in summer (56%) and lowest in winter (40%). Nitrate was highest in winter (10%) with the low temperatures. Organics were high in autumn (38%) and winter (33%), with the air originating mainly from the continent. The diurnal pattern of the degree of oxygenation was more pronounced in the periods when the air masses originated from the ocean, while it varied little in the periods when the air masses originated from the continent with long-range transport. (Publication: Item 3 in Section 8, Part C) ii) In contrast to the dominant secondary organics at HKUST, fresh primary organics represented two thirds of the total measured organics in the Mong Kok roadside measurements. Organics were also generally more abundant than sulfate, making up more than 50% of measured mass concentration. Cooking contributions in organic aerosol exceeded those related to vehicles although traffic was still the major PM1 source when elemental carbon was included. Springtime NR-PM1 concentrations were about double of those in summer, due to a strong seasonal transition which affected meteorological conditions and street-level circulation. (Publication: Item 6 in Section 8, Part C) iii) Hygroscopic growth factors (GF) at fixed (90%) and varying (10–93%) relative humidity were measured at HKUST. Bi-modal GF distributions with a dominant more hygroscopic mode was observed. The average ensemble mean GF of oceanic aerosols at 90% RH was higher than that of continental aerosols. Over 90% of the measured data at 90% RH and predictions based on the Extended Aerosol Inorganics Model with a constant GF of the organic fraction of 1.18 were within 10% closure. In GF measurements at 10–93% RH, the hygroscopic parameter, κ, increased as RH decreased yet the differences yielded insignificant changes in the GF-RH curves. GF predictions using the empirical correlation of κ with AMS mass fractions were within 10% of additional measurements. (Publication: Items 1 and 5 in Section 8, Part C)

600413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
600413.value: In this project, two aerosol properties, namely chemical composition and hygroscopicity, were parameterized. In the future, more aerosol properties should be characterized simultaneously (e.g. volatility, composition and hygroscopicity) in order to have a better understanding on the link in between. Laboratory studies are also recommended to better understand the formation mechanisms and properties of secondary organic aerosols in Hong Kong.

600413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
600413.value: The project aims to better understand the chemical and physical properties of air pollutants in Hong Kong. Real-time measurements were carried out for the first time in Hong Kong at two places, namely HKUST and Mong Kok, to study the properties and sources of suburban (HKUST) and urban (Mong Kok) aerosols. Measurements made at HKUST characterized both chemical composition and water uptake ability of aerosols in different seasons, whereas the campaign in Mong Kok studied aerosol composition and their sources (e.g. cooking, traffic) in an urban roadside environment. The water uptake ability of aerosols, which can affect particle size and hence the light scattering ability, was parameterized with aerosol composition at fixed and varying relative humidity. We have successfully developed parameterized equations that can describe the water uptake ability of ambient aerosols based on their chemical characteristics.

600513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
600513.value: 飛行時間二次離子質譜是一種非常有用的聚合物表面分析手段，不僅可提供聚合物的表面結構信息，而且還可提供不同化學組份在表面的分佈。但是，二次離子的形成機理十分複雜，聚合物在離子束轟擊下的裂解機理到现在還沒有完全建立。所以，要擴展飛行時間二次離子質譜在聚合物領域的應用，就必須要更進一步理解二次離子結構和聚合物分子鏈結構的關係。 眾所周知，聚合物的裂解過程和聚合物內不同元素之間的化學鍵強度有關，聚合物在高溫下化學鍵可被破壞並解聚。所以，一個探討二次離子形成機理的有效方法便是通過分析聚合物在不同溫度下的裂解碎片。實驗上可通過備有加熱台的二次離子分析器來實現。我們相信升溫可能會促進一些離子的形成。所以，通過對二次離子在不同溫度下的祥細分析，我們便可對裂解機理有更好的理解。 大家知道，聚合物在接近它的玻璃化溫度或溶點時，它的流動性可產生巨變。我們從聚苯乙烯在常溫到160度的飛行時間二次離子質譜的初步数据中发现兩個轉化溫度。低的和高的轉化溫度分別同聚合物的玻璃化溫度和降解溫度有關。另外，對無定形聚合物的理論和實驗研究顯示，聚合物分子鏈在表面比在體相有更大的流動性。的確， 很多實驗證明聚合物的表面玻璃化溫度比體相低。所以，我們將探討是否可從飛行時間二次離子質譜数据来確定聚合物的表面玻璃化溫度。

600513.label: Realisation of objectives
600513.value: In order to develop a better understanding of the time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (ToF-SIMS) fragmentation processes, we studied the fragmentation process of poly (2, 3, 4, 5, 6-pentafluorostyrene) (5FPS) [1], polystyrene (PS) [1.2], poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) [3] graphite [4-6] and graphene [4-6]. The results of 5FPS, PS and PMMA studies clearly support the view that the abrupt changes in the normalized principal component 1 value were caused by the surface reorientation of the polymer and not by a change in the ion fragmentation mechanism at temperatures above its surface transition temperature which may be related to its surface glass transition temperature. The fragmentation process was shown to be independent of the temperature range (from room temperature to the glass transition of the polymer) we studied. We also studied the fragmentation mechanisms of graphite and graphene surfaces which have very well-defined structures. In order to prepare samples for this study, we developed a method to produce a clean graphene surface by first washing it with acetone and then annealing it at 500 C [4]. XPS and ToF-SIMS were used to characterize the surface chemical composition of graphene under different conditions [4,5]. XPS and ToF-SIMS spectra of a clean graphene surface can be obtained via a 500 C heat treatment. The C1s spectrum obtained at 500 C had three components, namely sp2 carbons, sp3 carbons and the π-π* shake-up peak. The atomic ratio of the sp3 carbons to the sp2 carbons obtained on a clean graphene surface was used to estimate the amounts of sp3 defect in graphene. In the ToF-SIMS spectra obtained at 500 C, CxH2+• as well as Cx+ and CxH- as well as Cx- were identified as the graphene characteristic positive and negative ions, respectively. A Raman study confirmed that the graphene surface changed little after the 500 C heat treatment. To determine the origin of the CxH2+• ions, defects were created on the surface of nearly defect-free highly oriented pyrolytic graphite (HOPG) by bombarding it with a Cs+ ion beam at various sputtering doses. A detailed examination of the positive ion spectra of ion-bombarded HOPG surfaces revealed the presence of CxH2+• ions, confirming that these CxH2+• ions, which came from the defects created on the sputtered HOPG surfaces, are similar to the defects present on graphene surface. A sp3 carbon peak at 285.3 eV, representing sp3 defects appearing in the XPS spectra of sputtered HOPG samples, confirms that the surface of the sputtered HOPG is similar to that of graphene. Fragmentation mechanisms of selected ions in the ToF-SIMS spectra of graphene and HOPG were proposed. In order to investigate the nature of the surface transition temperatures of polymers, the spin-cast films of 5FPS, which had been annealed at different temperatures were, analyzed using ToF-SIMS. Principal component analysis (PCA) of the ToF-SIMS data revealed a surface transition temperature at which the surface structure of 5FPS was rearranged. A comparison between the results of the PCA of ToF-SIMS spectra obtained on 5FPS and PS indicate that the pendant groups of 5FPS and PS moved in exactly opposite directions as the temperature increased [1,2]. More pendant groups of 5FPS and PS migrated from the bulk to the surface and vice versa, respectively, as the temperature increased. These results clearly support the view that the abrupt changes in the normalized principal component 1 value were caused by the surface reorientation of the polymer and not by a change in the ion fragmentation mechanism at temperatures above the surface transition temperature. Contact angle measurement, which is another extremely surface sensitive technique, was used to monitor the change in the surface tension as a function of temperature. A clear surface transition temperature was determined by the contact angle measurements. The values of the surface transition temperature determined by contact angle measurements and ToF-SIMS were very similar. The surface chain conformations of PMMA at different temperatures were extensively studied by ToF-SIMS [3]. Similar to our experimental studies of PS and 5FPS, a surface transition temperature could be identified through the PCA of the ToF-SIMS spectra obtained from the PMMA samples annealed at different temperatures [3]. Interestingly, our results show that the surface transition temperature depended on molecular weight and was about 50–60 C below its bulk glass transition temperature and therefore could be related to the surface glass transition temperature of the polymer. The results were confirmed by contact angle measurements. ToF-SIMS results showed higher peak intensities of several low-mass oxygen-containing ions and hydrocarbon positive ions and OCH3- negative ions at higher temperatures, which can be interpreted by a higher surface concentration of methoxy groups. We developed a unique method to produce a clean graphene surface by first washing it with acetone and then annealing it at 500 C [4]. Using XPS, we developed a scheme to estimate the amounts of sp3 defects in clean graphene. In the ToF-SIMS spectra of clean graphene a unique series of CxH2+• peaks was detected. A detailed study of ion bombarded defect-free highly oriented pyrolytic graphite (HOPG) reveals the presence of CxH2+• ions which were not detected on the control HOPG samples, confirming that these CxH2+• ions were from the defects created on the sputtered HOPG surfaces [2]. 600513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
600513.value: We developed a unique method to produce clean surfaces of graphene and graphite which are important for the studying of the structures of these materials In addition we also developed a reliable method using XPS and ToF-SIMS to detect defects and determine concentrations of the defects in graphene and ion-sputtered graphite. Guo et al. (Nano Lett. 2010, 10, 4975–4980) created defects on a graphene surface by irradiating it with 30 keV N+ ions and subsequently introduced N atoms in the irradiated graphene by annealing it in NH3 at 1100 C. This is a very interesting finding but they have not provided any detailed mechanisms showing the insertion of the N atoms in the graphene structure. It would be of great fundamental interest to determine the reaction paths between NH3 and the irradiated graphene and the consequent reaction mechanisms for the insertion of the N atoms in the graphene structure using the XPS and ToF-SIMS methods we developed (Carbon 94, 740-748 (2015) and Carbon, 112, 192-200 (2017)).

600513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
600513.value: This study was designed to reveal whether ToF-SIMS fragmentation processes are affected by temperature by studying the fragmentation processes of poly (2, 3, 4, 5, 6-pentafluorostyrene) (5FPS), polystyrene (PS), poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) at various temperatures. We found that the fragmentation mechanisms did not affect significantly by the temperature. The phase transition of materials is one of the most interesting topics in materials science. For example, the glass transition temperature of a polymer is associated with the change from the solid to rubber phase. We successfully demonstrated that ToF-SIMS can be used to detect the surface transition temperature of PS (Anal. Chem. 2013, 85, 10725−10732) and wanted apply the same technique to other polymers. To investigate the nature of surface transition temperatures of polymers, the spin-cast films of 5FPS and PMMA, which had been annealed at different temperatures, were analyzed using ToF-SIMS and contact angle measurement. Our results clearly indicated that there is a surface transition temperature, which may be related to the surface glass transition of the polymer. The values of the surface transition temperatures determined by contact angle measurements and ToF-SIMS were very similar.

600713.label: Project Title(Chinese)
600713.value: 旋轉恒星核中的過輻對流

600713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
600713.value: Convective overshooting is the spread of fluid motion from a convection zone into a neighboring stable region which is normally quiescent. This process is a critical uncertainty in stellar evolution theory. Current stellar models handle it with only primitive treatments. In order to give our understanding of stars a more solid foundation, we propose to study this process with numerical experiments. Since analytical techniques cannot handle the complexities and laboratory experiments cannot deal with the highly stratified conditions inside stars, numerical simulation is the only viable approach for exploring the phenomenon and verifying the physical understanding. The primary focus of our study is overshooting in stellar cores where effects on the structure and evolution of stars are most significant. The dynamical influence of rotation will be of key interest due to its ubiquitous presence and the lack of such investigation in existing literature. 在分層結構中,不穩定層會產生對流現象,是熱傳播的一個重要機制。但對流層中的運動,往往溢出不穩定層的範圍,侵入了附近的穩定層,此稱為「過輻對流」。這個現象對恒星演化有極重要的影響。「過輻對流」把恒星對流核中的廢料與外面的物質交換混合,補充了核反應的原料,可以大輻提升對流核的壽命,而且改變了外層的元素成份,直接反映於觀測。這是一個很複雜的過程,實驗室亦無法處理深的分層結構,提供不出可用的認識。我們將會用數值模擬的方法研究這個過程,目標是找出在不同的情況下有多少物料被混合,為恒星演化提供一個可靠的計算方法。我們的研究其中一個特點是考慮到恒星旋轉對「過輻對流」的影響。以前的研究從未處理此問題,但由於所有恆星都有自轉,這是必須考慮的題目。

600813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
600813.value: As of 30 November 2011, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange had 1,477 listed companies with a combined market capitalization of HKD16.99 trillion. Facing such a vast number of stocks, an investor's primary task is to form a reliable and profitable portfolio. More than half a century ago, Markowitz laid the ground-breaking mean variance principle for portfolio management. Although the principle has been playing the leading role in the investment arena, the past decades have seen enormous practical difficulties in implementing the rule. A major risk, coined as estimation risk, arises from the estimation errors when the future mean and variance are estimated empirically. For example, as early as in the 1980's, Robert Merton pointed out the inaccuracy in estimating the mean returns using empirical data and its possible adverse consequences. This problem is greatly amplified when one faces a choice of a vast number of assets. For instance, with 1477 stocks, the number of parameters to estimate, including means and variances, is 1091503. The possible accumulation of errors could easily distort the empirical optimal portfolio far away from the theoretical optimal portfolio. Because of the apparent theoretical and practical importance, a rich literature has developed following the mean variance principle and its variants. This project focuses on the statistical aspect of the NP problem: large P, the number of targeting assets, relative to N, the number of recent historical observations. The modern statistical theory has provided us powerful tools towards solving this type of problems. In particular, the shrinkage and regularization techniques, including LASSO, have been fast developing in this century. Evidence is reported in the literature that, with regularization and/or constraints, particularly on short sales, the resulting portfolio could be sparse and robust. A sparse portfolio with a reasonable number of stocks also has the advantage of reducing the costs of monitoring, trading, rebalancing and researching. More importantly, the estimation risk may be substantially minimized for sparse portfolios. With the newly developed statistical methodologies and the ever-increasing computing power, it is pertinent to discover and apply the cutting-edge statistical techniques to dynamic portfolio selection and management. It is promising that new and effective strategies of portfolio construction could be found under the mean variance framework and its variants. The results of this research will provide the practitioners state-of-the-art statistical techniques for their portfolio management. 截至2011年11月30日，香港联交所有1,477家上市公司，总市值HKD16.99万亿。面对如此大量的股票，投资者的首要任务是要形成一个可靠和有利可图的投资组合。超过半世纪前，马科维茨奠定了突破性的均值方差组合管理原则。虽然已原则上在投资领域发挥主导作用，在过去的几十年里已经看到了实施该规则的巨大的实际困难。一个主要风险是估计风险，它是在对未来的均值和方差凭经验作估计是产生的估计误差。例如，早在1980年默顿就指出，使用经验数据进行估计平均回报的不准确性和其可能产生的不利后果。当一个人面临着一个庞大的资产选择，这个问题被大大放大。比如，当有1477只股票时， 需要估计的参数，包括均值和方差，的数目是1091503 。可能的错误积累可以很容易地扭曲经验的最佳组合，使之远离理论上的最优投资组合。由于明显的理论和实践的重要性，均值方差理论及其类似的理论已有丰富的文献。这个项目的重点是统计方面的NP问题：针对资产的大P及相对于最近的历史观测数N 。现代统计理论为我们 解决这一类的问题提供了强大的工具。特别是，收缩和正规化技巧，包括套索，已在本世纪快速发展。文献中的研究表明正规化和/或限制，特别是对沽空， 而产生的投资组合可能是稀疏和稳定 。稀疏合理数量的股票组合还具有其他优势：降低了监测，交易，平衡和研究的成本 。更重要的是，估计风险可能因大幅稀疏组合最小化。随着新开发的统计方法和不断增加的计算能力，现在是发现和应用尖端的统计技术，以动态资产组合选择和管理 的合适时机。找到新的投资组合构建和有效的战略下的均值方差框架及其变种是极其有希望的 。这项研究成果将提供从业者自己的投资组合管理的最先进的统计技术。

600813.label: Realisation of objectives
600813.value: Markowitz’s mean-variance portfolio, despite its popularity, relies on the assumption about the statistical stationarity of the asset returns as well as the knowledge of the underlying distribution (mean and covariance matrix). In practice, one first estimates the mean and covariance from historical data and then plugs in the resulting estimators. It has been found that Markowitz’s mean-variance portfolio in practical implementation as well as in numerical simulation usually underperforms its theoretical expectation and even behaves worse than the naive 1/N rule. One of the main reasons is the estimation risk, as reported in the finance literature; see, for example, DeMiguel et al. 2009 and Tu and Zhou 2011. It is therefore much desired to find new methods of portfolio management that can bypass and/or overcome the risk caused by the estimation error. Surprisingly, the naive 1/N rule, also called the Talmud rule, which dates back to thousands of years ago, is empirically documented to be highly effective. And this naive approach, which always distributes wealth equally to the N available assets, indeed does not need any statistical estimation procedure, and thus avoids the estimation risk. Spinning off from this basic rule, there is a large class of portfolio management methods that are well explored and analyzed in the literature. Among them, Cover's universal portfolio (Cover, 1990) and the successive constant rebalanced portfolio (Gaivoronski and Stella, 2000) are two of the popular methods. The aggregate algorithm (Vovk,1990) contains the 1/N rule, the universal portfolio and the successive rebalanced portfolio as special cases. All of them avoids the estimation risk under the mean-variance method and the gross-exposure level is controlled by a parameter. We propose a novel approach called the binary switch portfolio (BSP). This approach switches between two opposing and simple investment strategies: one momentum based and the other mean-reverting oriented. The momentum approach follows the leader and the mean-reverting approach follows the Talmud rule. Moreover, the mechanism of switching is based on a carefully designed machine learning algorithm, motivated by the intuition that there exist blocks of periods in which either momentum based or mean reverting approach is preferred and that the blocks may be identified through suitable supervised learning algorithms or reinforcement learning algorithms. We provide theoretical justification as well as empirical evidence to show the superiority of our method. Extensive comparisons are made against the existing methods including Markowitz's mean-variance rule, 1/N rule, the universal portfolio and the successive constant rebalanced portfolio. The influence of the estimation risk on all portfolios is investigated under various frameworks. We applied the BSP to a number of datasets, including the famous Fama French 30 Industry Classification data covering years from 1926 to 2011, the New York Stock Exchange data from 1962 to 1984, and the Hang Seng index constituent stocks data from 2008 to 2013. The application to the real data not only demonstrates the superiority of the proposed methods versus existing methods but also provides strong evidence to support our theory. These results are summarized in the paper "Binary Switch Portfolio", which is published in the journal Quantitative Finance.

600813.label: Major findings and research outcome
600813.value: The main finding of this research is a novel portfolio management method called binary switch portfolio (BSP). The method does not involve statistical estimation of future mean and variance of returns and thus avoids the estimation risk. It is based on building blocks of both momentum and mean reverting strategies and thus has appropriate financial interpretation. Our major contribution is the delicate combination/switching mechanism based on a machine learning algorithm. We prove mathematically the optimality of the BSP and demonstrate its performance using a number of real datasets. These findings are published in a paper "Binary Switch Portfolio".

600813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
600813.value: There are two directions for further development of this research: Apply the new reinforcement learning algorithm to the switching mechanism. Our past research focused on a supervised learning approach, as reported in our paper. In the past two years, the deep reinforcement learning has proven to be very powerful in games, such as go. We think there is a great potential to apply these algorithms, particularly the new A3C algorithm, to find new and more effective switching mechanism. In practice, there may exist related macro and micro variables. It would be interesting to see how such variables can be incorporated into the learning algorithms. Furthermore, our analysis here does not take into account transaction costs. In future research, we shall investigate along these two directions.

600813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
600813.value: Portfolio management is a long-standing problem in history. The Talmud rule or 1/N rule was documented in the Babylonian Talmud as early as the 5th century AD. The increasing complexity and scale of financial trading in modern days make portfolio management an ever more important and difficult problem in both academia and industry. The well known Markowitz's mean-variance principle suffers from the estimation risk and has been known to underperform. Other portfolio management methods in the spirit of Talmud rule has been explored and studied in the literature. They include the relatively simple universal portfolio and the follow-the-leader rule. In our search for a new portfolio management method to avoid the estimation risk, we discovered a method that we call binary switch portfolio, that switches between a momentum method and a mean-reverting method, with the switching determined by a machine learning algorithm. The BSP is well interpreted in finance, has a solid mathematical background and is empirically shown to be superior to existing methods.

600913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
600913.value: Small molecule natural products produced by marine organisms are an important source of therapeutic agents such as anticancer agents. After the selection process during evolution, small molecule natural products are made through biosynthesis pathways to possess rich forms in the carbon skeleton (skeletal diversity) for delivering unique functional roles. It has been recognized that rich skeletal diversity among a collection of natural product-like compounds generated by chemical synthesis in laboratories should offer rich molecular shape diversity as featured by the volume of space and surface electrostatic potential map. The latter collectively lay down the structural basis for selective interaction of small molecule natural products with biological macromolecules (targets) through non-covalent bond interactions. During the last decade, collections of natural product-like compounds have become increasingly in demand for exploring biology and chemical genetics, leading to a rapid advancement in an emerging research frontier in diverted total synthesis of natural products and analogues. The main aim of this proposed study focuses on development of synthetic strategies and key transformations required for generation of a collection of compounds structurally related to the marine natural products, amphidinolide C1–C3 by applying the principles of diverted total synthesis. This forms the first stage of a research program aimed at understanding the essential pharmacophore for the powerful antineoplastic activity observed only for amphidinolide C1 (IC50 = 5.8 and 4.6 ng/mL against L1210 murine leukemia and human epidermoid carcinoma KB cells, respectively) but not for its C29-OAc and C29-keto forms, i.e. amphidinolide C2 and C3, respectively. Particular attention will be directed toward the modification of the two tetrahydrofuran subunits, i.e. the C1–C8 and C18–C25 fragments for editing the non-essential substituent(s) or stereochemical requirement for the antineoplastic activity. On the other hand, the 1,3-diene side chain attached to the macrolactone core at C24 will be replaced by selected sub-structural units for studying the structure-activity relationship. These requisite analogues with different side chains will be efficiently synthesized from a common 25-membered macrolactone core via a palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling reaction. Successful results from this study should contribute new chemistry knowledge to the area of diverted total synthesis and would offer opportunities for establishment of the structure–activity relationship and for understanding the mechanism of action of amphidinolide C1–C3. With the developed synthesis capability and knowledge on the pharmacophore, structurally simplified yet highly reactive therapeutic agents could be designed, produced, and evaluated in the next stage of the research program. 由海洋生物産生的小分子天然産物是治療試劑如抗癌劑的重要來源。經過進化過程的選擇，生物合成途徑産生的小分子天然産物具有豐富的碳骨架（骨架多樣性），從而能夠發揮各自特有的功能。對實驗室化學合成製備的類天然産物化合物庫的研究也表明，化合物所具有的豐富的骨架多樣性能夠增加分子的形態多樣性，后者表征為空間體積和表面靜電勢能圖。這些特性共同奠定了分子的結構基礎使得小分子天然産物能夠通過非共價鍵選擇性地作用于生物大分子（或目標分子）。近十年來，類天然産物化合物庫被廣泛用于探索生物學和化學基因組學，與日俱增的需求使得多樣性全合成天然産物和類似物成為一個新興研究前沿，並得到了快速發展。本研究計劃將主要集中于多樣性全合成原則的應用、開發合成策略和關鍵化學轉換、並用于製備海洋天然産物amphidinolide C1–C3的結構類似物。這是一個研究項目的初始階段，以期最終能找出基本藥效團，以便解析為什么amphidinolide C1具有很強的抗腫瘤活性（殺死L1210鼠白血病和KB人表皮癌細胞的IC50值分別為 5.8 和 4.6 ng/mL），而其C29乙酸酯和C29酮基化合物，即 amphidinolide C2和C3側沒有活性。通過重點修飾C1–C8和C18–C25兩個四氫呋喃片斷的結構，簡化與抗腫瘤活性沒關聯的取代基或立體化學。而另一方面，計劃將大環內酯骨架C24上的1,3-二烯側鏈置換成其他次要結構單元，用于建立構效關繫。這些含不同側鏈的類似物將從一個共通的25元環內酯通過鈀催化的偶聯反應來高效製備。本研究的預期結果，將豐富多樣性全合成領域的新化學知識，並有助于建立構效關繫和理解amphidinolide C1–C3的作用機理。開發的合成技術及藥效團的建立，將有利于后一階段設計、製備、及評價結構簡化的高活性治療試劑。

601013.value: 循環碼是線性碼的一個子類。由於循環碼有很好的代數結構，它們的編碼和譯碼可以用簡單的移位寄存器來快速實現。因而，循環碼被用在許多實用系統中。在廣播系統中循環碼用在數字圖像廣播及ATSC標准中。在計算機應用方面循環碼用在RAID6系統中。循環碼也用在碼分多址通信系統，深空通信，密碼系統，和消費電子產品（例如，CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray Discs)。 循環碼也是數學的一個分支，並且與數學的一些其它領域緊密相關。例如，循環碼與代數，代數函數域，代數幾何，代數數論，結合方案，組合設計，有限幾何，有限域，數論和半域有密切聯系。 本項目的任務是構造有限域上即有非常好的代數結構又有很好的糾錯能力的循環碼。預期本項目的研究成果對糾錯碼的理論和工程應用有一定貢獻。

601013.label: Major findings and research outcome
601013.value: We developed general results on permutation polynomials over finite fields, constructed permutation polynomials of special forms over finite fields, and determined when Dickson polynomials of the second kind permute Z_m. These resulted in two papers published in "Finite Fields and Their Applications", and two papers published in "SIAM J. Discrete Mathematics". We employed monomials and trinomials to construct many classes of cyclic and linear codes. These results are published in "Finite Fields and Their Applications", "Discrete Mathematics", "IEEE Communication letters", and "IEEE Trans. Information Theory". Many of the codes constructed in this project are optimal or almost optimal.

In this project, we have constructed a number of classes of linear and cyclic codes, which have very good parameters. These codes would have interesting applications.

601113.label: Project Objectives
601113.value: To study nondegenerate four-wave mixing (FWM) with electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) in cold atoms. We will control and determine the FWM parametric gain spectrum with EIT in cold atoms, and verify the theoretical predictions. To demonstrate nondegenerate, mirrorless optical parametric oscillation (OPO) with EIT-FWM in cold atoms. To demonstrate nondegenerate OPO in cold atoms with an external ring cavity. Making use the external ring cavity, we aim to further reduce the threshold pump-coupling laser powers and narrow the output linewidths. To demonstrate mirrorless OPO in a degenerate configuration. In this case, the generated fields interfere with each other when they propagate in opposing directions in the medium. It is interesting to explore what effect this spatial interference has on the OPO operation. To demonstrate degenerate OPO with an external cavity.

601113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
601113.value: Optical parametric oscillators (OPOs) have been playing important roles as coherent light sources in recent decades beyond the traditional laser wavelengths. The phase-matching arising in the nonlinear optical processes makes their output wavelengths tunable over a wide range, which is not accessible with lasers based on stimulated emission. However, the standard OPOs using nonlinear crystals and three-wave mixing typically have wide bandwidth and high threshold pump power. Here we propose a plan for experimental research of studying OPOs using counter-propagating four-wave mixing (FWM) in a high dense cold atomic ensemble with mirrorless or mirror (cavity) configurations. We aim to achieve narrow-linewidth tunable OPO coherent light source with weak input pump light power (< 1 mW). The inherently distributed feedback mechanism of the backward FWM makes oscillation possible without an external cavity using mirrors. Our research will have applications in high precision nonlinear optical spectroscopy and quantum nonlinear optics at low light levels. 近幾十年來，光學參量振蕩器為在傳統激光波長范圍外提供相干光源扮演了重要的角色。通過調整非線性光學相互作用中的位相匹配條件，其輸出光波長可調諧在很寬的范圍內，而這恰恰是基於受激輻射原理的傳統激光器所缺乏的。然而，現在標准的光學參量振蕩器採用的是非線性晶體，其三波混頻輸出通常是高帶寬的，並且需要很強功率的泵浦光驅動。在這裡我們提出一個實驗研究方案，利用在高光學厚度冷原子介質中的反向傳播四波混頻來實現無鏡式或鏡式光學參量振蕩。我們志在運用極低功率（小於1毫瓦）的泵浦光獲得窄帶寬光學參量振蕩相干光輸出。反向傳播四波混頻中的內秉分布式反饋機制可自發實現光學參量振蕩，而無需利用鏡子形成的外部反饋腔。我們的研究成果在高精度非線性光譜學和弱光下的量子非線性光學中有重要的應用。

601113.label: Realisation of objectives
601113.value: All the objectives have been successfully realized and fully achieved: (1) We have studied four-wave mixing (FWM) with electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) in cold atoms in both theory and experiment. On the theoritical side, we formularized the theory in both the interaction and Heisenberg pictures for spontaneous FWM with EIT in cold atoms in the group delay regime [Phys. Rev. A 93, 033815 (2016)]. On the experimental side, we demonstrated frequency-induced phase-tunable polarization-entangled narrowband biphotons from FWM process with EIT in cold atoms [Optica 2, 505 (2015)]. We have also developed a temporal quantum-state tomography (TQST) for measuring the biphoton temporal complex wave function with polarization-dependent and time-resolved two-photon interference [Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 010401 (2015)]. We further demonstrated a technique for shaping the temporal wave function of biphotons generated from spatially modulated spontaneous FWM in cold atoms [Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 193601 (2015)]. (2) We have successfully demonstrated mirrorless optical parametric oscillation (OPO) with EIT in cold atoms [Phys. Rev. Lett. 119, 150406 (2017)]. (3) We have demonstrated narrowband OPO with tunable threshold. The pump threshold can be tuned by varying the operating parameters. We achieve the oscillation with a threshold as low as 15 uW and a narrow bandwidth of 16 kHz . [Phys. Rev. Lett. 119, 150406 (2017)] (4) We have studied the degenerate configuration in the mirrorless OPO experiment [Phys. Rev. Lett. 119, 150406 (2017)]. The degenerate configuration has been also used to produce frequency-induced phase-tunable polarization-entangled narrowband biphotons [Optica 2, 505 (2015)] and test the temporal quantum-state tomography (TQST) [Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 010401 (2015)]. (5) In the mirrorless OPO, we demonstrated an efficient intrinsic feedback through the nonlinear FWM process, with the same effect as an external cavity. Driven by two classical laser beams, the generated Stokes and anti-Stokes fields counterpropagate and build up efficient intrinsic feedback through the nonlinear FWM process. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 119, 150406 (2017)] Summary: Objective 1 has leaded to a series publications in both theory and experiment. The main achievement of objectives 2, 3, 4 and 5 is summarized in our recent publication in Physical Review Letters [Phys. Rev. Lett. 119, 150406 (2017)].

601113.label: Major findings and research outcome
601113.value: In this project, we have made a systematical investigation on the four-wave mixing (FWM) with electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) in cold atoms in both theory and experiment, and realized the narrowband mirrorless optical parametric oscillation (OPO) with tunable threshold. We have achieved the following major findings and research outcome: (1) Theory of narrowband biphoton generation in the group delay regime using spontaneous FWM with EIT in cold atoms. We have formularized the theory in both the interaction and Heisenberg pictures for describing narrowband biphoton generation in the group delay regime using spontaneous FWM with EIT in cold atoms. Representative Publication: [1] Phys. Rev. A 93, 033815 (2016). (2) Frequency-induced phase-tunable polarization entanglement We have produced narrowband polarization-entangled biphotons from spontaneous FWM in cold atoms and demonstrate a new method to tune the phase of the polarization entanglement by varying the frequency of one of the classical driving lasers. Our result represents a precision control of polarization entanglement from the frequency domain. Representative Publications: [1] Optica 2, 505 (2015). (3) Temporal quantum-state tomography For measuring the complex temporal wave function of the narrowband biphotons, we have developed a method of temporal quantum-state tomography (TQST) with polarization-dependent and time-resolved two-photon interference. This method can also be applied to narrow-band biphotons generated from cavity-enhanced spontaneous parametric down-conversion. Representative Publications: [1] Phys. Rev. Lett. 114, 010401 (2015). (4) Parallel-to-series quantum conversion We have realized parallel-to-series quantum conversion using FWM in cold atoms. We implemented this technique to demonstrate shaping the temporal wave function of biphotons generated from spatially modulated four-wave mixing. The result will have important application in photon quantum state engineering. Representative Publications: [1] Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 193601 (2015). (5) Mirrorless OPO with tunable threshold in cold atoms We have successfully demonstrated a mirrorless OPO with a tunable threshold in laser- cooled atoms with FWM using EIT. Driven by two classical laser beams, the generated Stokes and anti-Stokes fields counterpropagate and build up efficient intrinsic feedback through the nonlinear FWM process. The pump threshold can be tuned by varying the operating parameters. We achieve the oscillation with a threshold as low as 15 μW and a bandwidth as narrow as 16 kHz. Our work is the first experimental demonstration of mirrorless OPO in cold atoms with intrinsic feedback purely from the nonlinearity without periodical spatial modulation. Representative Publications: [1] Phys. Rev. Lett. 119, 150406 (2017).

601113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
601113.value: Potential for further development of the research and proposed course of action may include: (1) Extend the mirrorless OPO with EIT to the systems other than cold atoms, such as hot atoms and solid-state systems. (2) Application of the mirrorless OPO in quantum metrology.

601113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
601113.value: Optical parametric oscillation (OPO) using nonlinear optical-wave mixing process has some unique properties beyond the traditional light sources, such as wavelength range and power. The standard OPO using nonlinear crystal and three-wave mixing typically have wide bandwidth and high threshold pump power. In this research project, we have investigated the OPO using four-wave mixing (FWM) in cold atoms. We have formularized the theory of spontaneous FWM with electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) in both the interaction and Heisenberg pictures, demonstrated the frequency-induced phase-tunable polarization-entanglement, developed a Temporal quantum-state tomography technique, and realized the parallel-to-series quantum conversion of FWM. We have achieved narrowband OPO with tunable threshold in cold atoms, with a threshold as low as 15 uW and bandwidth as narrow as 16 kHz. Our system provides an ideal platform for studying the quantum interactions of the mirrorless OPO in a resonant atomic medium, and our research will have applications in high precision nonlinear optical spectroscopy and quantum nonlinear optics at low light levels.

601413.label: Realisation of objectives
601413.value: This research project aimed to elucidate the reaction mechanism of the two-step catalysis of o-succinylbenzoyl-CoA synthetase (MenE). Firstly, we determined the steady-state kinetics of three MenE orthologs from Escherichia coli, Bacillus subtilis, and Staphylococcus aureus, and found that these enzymes adopt an ordered Bi Uni Uni Bi ping-pong mechanism involving a conformational change typical of the 'domain alteration' catalysis. This kinetic study fully realized the first objective by successfully confirming the domain alteration mechanism for the catalysis of MenE. Next, we attempted to crystallize the three MenE orthologues in the adenylation conformation but found that these enzymes undergo spontaneous cleavage to a high extent during crystallization incubation. It took us almost a year to find a special buffer in which Bacillus subtilis MenE is stable during the entire period of crystal growth of up to 10-day incubation at room temperature. In this buffer, we obtained single crystals of Bacillus subtilis MenE in the apo form and in complex with Mg2+/ATP or AMP and successfully determined their structures 1.98, 2.50 and 2.60 angstrom, respectively. These structures are all in an adenylation conformation and reveal the tight gripping interactions of the phosphate-binding loop (P-loop) with the ATP triphosphate moiety and an open-closed conformational change to form a compact adenylation active site in an adenylate-forming enzyme. For the first time, these structures reveal a structural role of ATP binding in configuration of the adenylation active site and identify more than 30 residues critical for substrate recognition and catalysis. The catalytic roles of 8 most important active site residues were firmly established by site-directed mutagenesis and rigorous steady-state kinetic characterization of the resulting point mutants. In addition, we have also determined the crystal structure of MenE in complex with the adenylation product, o-succinylbenzoyl-adenosine monophosphate (OSB-AMP), in a post-adenylation state before release of the C-domain in its transition to the thioesterification conformation. By comparison with the ATP-bound pre-adenylation conformation, structural changes are identified in both the reactants and the active site to allow inference of how these changes accommodate and facilitate the adenylation reaction and to directly support an in-line backside attack nucleophilic substitution mechanism for the first-half reaction. This adenylate-bound structure also allows us to propose a release mechanism of the C-domain in its alteration to form the thioesterification conformation. All together, we obtained four crystal structures of MenE in various states and gained important mechanistic insights into the adenylation half-reaction to fully achieve the objectives set for this adenylation step (Objectives 2, 4, and 5). We encounter major difficulties in attempt to crystallize MenE in the thioesterification conformation. We first attempted to crystallize it with natural ligands including, OSB-AMP, coenzyme A, AMP, and CoA analogs but were unable to obtain good crystals with satisfactory diffraction quality. We then chemoenzymatically synthesized o-succinylbenzoyl-amino-CoA (OSB-NCoA) after 11-step chemical synthesis of a precursor. This product analog was found to induce MenE to form large crystals with diffraction resolution up to 1.8 angstrom on an in-house diffractometer. Unfortunately, these crystals were severely twinned and could not be used for structural determination. After several rounds trial and errors, we eventually introduced site-directed mutation into two residues far from the active site and successfully crystalized the double mutant protein and determined its structure in complex with OSB-NCoA and a combination of OSB-NCoA and AMP in a thioesterification conformation at 1.76 and 1.90 Ångstrom resolution, respectively. These structures reveal a 139.5° rotation of the C-domain around a hinge residue (Ser384) in transition from the adenylation to thioesterification conformation and a thioesterfication active site specifically conserved among MenE orthologues. In addition, these structures also reveal a substrate-binding mode distinct from those of many other acyl/aryl-CoA synthetases. Using site-directed mutagenesis, we identified several residues that specifically contribute to the thioesterification half-reaction without affecting the adenylation half-reaction. Moreover, we observed a substantial movement of the activated succinyl group in the thioesterification half- reaction. These findings provide new insights into thioesterification half-reaction to fully achieve the objectives for the thioester-forming half-reaction (Objectives 3, 4, and 5). In summary, we have captured all the main conformational states of MenE along its long catalytic pathway involving a large domain alteration and fully achieved all the objectives of the research project. Results from this research provide a structural basis for the domain alteration catalysis and allow us to better understand the catalytic mechanism for the development of new antibiotics against MenE.

601413.label: Major findings and research outcome
601413.value: This research project has captured all the important conformational intermediates of o-succinylbenzoyl-CoA synthetase, or MenE, and gained novel insights into its domain alteration catalytic mechanism. Firstly, the substrate ATP was found to configure the adenylation active site through tight gripping interactions of the phosphate-binding loop (P-loop) with the triphosphate moiety of ATP and an open-closed conformational change involving a large-angle rotation of the small carboxy domain (C-domain). Secondly, a new post-adenylation was determined in complex with the adenylate product to reveal the adenylation reaction is accommodated and facilitated by structural changes in both reactants and the active site and to directly support an in-line backside attack nucleophilic substitution mechanism for the first-half reaction. Thirdly, a conformational change of the adenylate product was found to likely trigger the release of C-domain after adenylation in an encrypted C-domain control mechanism, in which the strongest interaction affecting the C-domain orientation occurs at the β-phosphate of the bound ATP to allow easy disassemble of the adenylation conformation to facilitate transition to the thioesterification conformation. Fourthly, a 139.5° rotation of the C-domain around the Ser384 hinge was observed during the structural change from the adenylation to thioesterification conformation, the latter of which was determined at 1.76 Ångstrom resolution in a complex with a product analog. Fifthly, MenE orthologues were found to bind the coenzyme A substrate in a conserved mode distinct from those of many other acyl/aryl-CoA synthetases. Moreover, a strained product conformation was again found to likely drive the disassemble of the thioesterification conformation into the ligand-free open conformation of MenE to finish a catalytic cycle. Finally, the catalytic roles have been corrected or established for a number of conserved active site residues, including the stabilization of the adenylation transition state by a conserved lysine residue and desolvation of the active site by a conserved histidine residue (His196) rather than stabilizing the transition state of the adenylation reaction. These new mechanistic insights allow us to much better understand the MenE catalysis to facilitate the development of new antibiotics against the essential vitamin K biosynthetic enzyme.

601413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
601413.value: The structural and mechanistic insights gained from this research project can be explored for the development of new antibiotics against the essential enzyme in vitamin K biosynthesis. For example, the U-shaped adenylate intermediate trapped in the crystal structure could be used as a model for design of analogs that would bind tightly to the adenylation active site. These analogs can be combinatorially synthesized and subjected to activity screen to find a potent inhibitor, which would then be used as a lead compound for optimization and eventual development as a drug candidate to kill microbial pathogens such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

601413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
601413.value: o-Succinylbenzoyl-CoA (OSB-CoA) synthetase (MenE) is an essential enzyme in bacterial vitamin K biosynthesis and an important target in the development of new antibiotics. Its utility as a drug target is hampered by the lack of our understanding of its catalytic mechanism. In this research project, we used a combination of protein crystallography, site-directed mutagenesis and steady-state enzyme kinetics to fully elucidate the domain alteration mechanism of its catalysis. We have successfully used small molecule ligands to trap the enzyme in various active conformations and revealed many structural changes critical in the enzymic catalysis, such as a 139.5° domain rotation in the structural transition from the adenylate-forming conformation to the thioester-forming conformation. In addition, we have identified all the conserved active site residues and determine their catalytic roles in both adenylation and thioesterification reactions. Structural and mechanistic insights gained from this research will not only facilitate the development of new antibiotics against MenE in pathogenic microorganisms such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis, but also allow us to better understand the domain-alternation catalysis other members of the ANL enzyme family encompassing acyl/aryl-CoA synthetases, non-robosomal peptide synthetase A domains and luciferases.
