693613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
693613.value: This study will investigate the relationship between cross-country accounting standards differences and firms' oversea listing decisions, and how the recent worldwide accounting harmonization via the adoption of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) affects such decisions. I expect that the convergence between the accounting standards used in a firm’s home country and the accounting standards required at foreign stock exchanges, such as simultaneous adoption of IFRS at both countries, can reduce firms’ economic costs arising from conforming to different accounting standards, and thus encourage firms to list on foreign stock exchanges. More specifically, I hypothesize that (1) accounting standard differences between two countries are negatively associated with the number of firms in one country to cross-list on the stock exchange of another country before IFRS adoption; (2) Firms are more likely to list overseas after mandatorily adopting IFRS, and they are more likely to list on foreign exchanges that also mandated IFRS adoption. To evaluate the above propositions, I will collect cross-listing events between 1999 and 2010 from the Capital IQ for stock exchanges of 25 countries that are found to host the vast majority of foreign firms worldwide (Sarkissian and Schill 2004, 2008). I will examine (1) the association between the number of country-pair cross-listings and the corresponding accounting standard differences between the hosting country and the home country before mandatory IFRS adoption; (2) changes in the volume of foreign listings from the pre-IFRS period to the post-IFRS period in the 25 hosting stock exchanges, conditional on whether the hosting stock exchange and the home countries of foreign firms mandated IFRS adoption or not. My study will be important to policy-makers, business corporations and all other parties involved in oversea financing arrangements. Hong Kong has become one of the hottest IPO markets for oversea companies, ever since the US has has experienced the wave of accounting frauds and subsequently mandated a series of accounting regulations after 2002. Hong Kong has also mandated IFRS adoption since 2005. Therefore, my proposed study will be especially significant in understanding the importance and impact of converging with global accounting standards for Hong Kong stock exchange. 该论文将研究国别会计准则的差异与公司海外上市决策的关系，以及近期强制采用国际会计准则是如何影响公司海外上市的决策。我预测，公司所在母国所采用的会计准则和海外上市国家所采用的会计准则的趋同，比如两个国家同时采用国际会计准则， 可以减少因国别会计准则差异而产生的上市成本，从而鼓励去海外上市。具体而言， 我预测（1）两个国家之间的会计准备差异与两个国家之间相互跨国上市的公司数量呈现负相关关系；（2）一旦公司采用国际会计准则后，它更倾向于去海外上市，尤其是那些同时采用国际会计准则的海外证券交易所。 为了评估上述预测，我将从Capital IQ 收集全球最大的25家证券交易所在1999年到2010年的海外公司上市数据。 我将测试（1）两个国家之间的会计准备差异与两个国家之间相互跨国上市的公司数量的关系； （2）采用国际会计准则后，海外上市公司数量的变化，取决于上市公司的母国和海外上市国家是否同时采用国际会计准则。

693913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
693913.value: Financial reporting quality is one of the key questions studied by accounting researchers. However, regardless of the fact that a corporation is managed by executive teams and information consolidated into the financial reports are generated at different levels of the corporation, current literature has solely focused on the role of CEOs and CFOs in determining financial reporting quality, largely ignoring the role of other executives in the process. The question that naturally arises is whether subordinate executives influence the quality of financial reports? If yes, to what extent do those executives matter and why? In this project, we attempt to investigate whether subordinate executives, important insiders with knowledge of operations influence financial reporting quality. We expect they are mostly influential when they are less likely to collude with top management to cook the books. To test this research question, we examine the tendency of collusion among managers measured by executive pay disparity. Kale, Reis and Venkateswaran (2009) suggest that executive pay disparity measures the alignment of incentives between executive teams and the shareholders and has important implications for agency problems in a firm. Specifically, high pay disparity captures tournament incentive which motivates executives to compete for promotion. A stronger incentive for promotion aligns the incentive of the subordinate executives with that of the shareholders and improves firm performance. In this project, we expect that the incentive alignment with shareholders reduces management collusion and mitigates the agency problem of opportunistic reporting. Pay disparity is therefore negatively associated with earnings management and improves accounting quality. We further propose to use other empirical proxies, e.g., dispersion of executive characteristics as alternative measures of collusion and expect high dispersion is associated with lower collusion and better reporting quality. This project has important academic and practical value. Academically, if we can show that executive team dynamics is an important determinant of earnings management, it suggests a need to reassess the overall impact of subordinate executives in financial reporting quality. Practically, it also suggests room for regulatory enforcement, such as broadening of the current coverage of financial reporting responsibilities beyond CEO and CFOs, and also coverage of other insiders. 财务报告质量是会计领域重要的研究议题之一。 虽然说公司管理是由整个管理团队来实施，而公司财务报表也是整合公司各个部门的信息的结果，但目前的文献，大多只关注CEO(或CFO)在决定财务报告质量中的作用，至于其他高管在决定财务报告质量中的角色则很少被涉及。在这一研究项目中，我们将填补这一空白。我们将研究CEO/CFO以外的高管是否影响财务报告的质量，以及通过什么途径影响财务报告的质量。 我们推断，由于其他高管能接触到很多的内部信息，由CEO/CFO所主导的盈利操纵很难不被其他高管觉察。因此，大多说情况下，CEO/CFO需要同其他高管共谋或串通才能进行盈利操纵，否则，其他高管可能会将这一信息泄露出去，而这会使得CEO/CFO面临很大的职业及法律风险。 在我们的研究中，我们计划考察高管之间的薪酬差距是否会影响他们共谋的倾向并进而影响公司财务报表的质量。Kale, Reis and Venkateswaran (2009)认为，高管薪酬差距对统一管理团队和股东之间的利益以及减少公司代理问题具有重要的意义。具体来说，高薪酬差距促进高管之间的竞争，从而提高企业绩效。我们预测，由于降低了代理问题并且增加了共谋的难度，高薪酬差距将有助于降低盈余管理，并进而提高会计信息质量。 该项目具有重要的学术和实用价值。在学术上，如果我们证实高管薪酬差距是影响盈余管理的一个决定因素，这意味着我们有必要重新评估下属人员的整体影响财务报告质量。这一研究对监管人员也将有很重要参考价值，我们的研究结果将有助于帮助监管层衡量是否应当将应该对财务报告质量负责的人员从目前的CEO和CFO扩大到其他高管。

694013.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
694013.value: In the literature of options pricing, jumps refer to large changes in asset prices and the jump intensity measures the likelihood for such large changes. The frequency of realized jumps appears to be changing from time to time, implying a time-varying jump intensity. An option is a financial asset whose future payoff depends on the value of another asset (the underlying asset) before or at the expiration date of the option. Whether and how likely the underlying asset may experience jumps in its value affect the valuation of the option. In standard options pricing models that include jump components, the conditional jump intensity is typically specified as an increasing function of the diffusive volatility, i.e., the magnitude of small changes. To examine such a specification, I plan to use a nonparametric jump detection test to identify jumps, using simulation to compare several estimators of diffusive volatility proposed in the literature, and find one which produces the least bias in testing the relation between jump intensity and diffusive volatility. I plan to apply the method to several stock indexes and many individual stocks to examine whether the jump intensity depends on diffusive volatility. The result has important implications in the development of options pricing modeling. 在期权定价的文献中，跳跃是指资产价格的大幅变动，而跳跃强度刻画这种大幅变动的可能性。实现了的跳跃频率显示出随时间变化的倾向，意味着跳跃强度是时变的。期权是其价值随另一标的资产在到期日（或之前）的价值变化的金融资产。标的资产的价格是否会经历跳跃，经历怎样的跳跃影响到期权的定价。在含有跳跃的期权定价模型中，时变的跳跃强度通常被假设为是扩散波幅（即微小变动的幅度）的递增函数。为了检验这样的假设，我计划用非参数的跳跃检测检验来确认跳跃，用模拟方法来比较文献中已有的扩散波幅估计方法，从而找出检验跳跃强度与扩散波幅的关系时产生最小偏差的估计方法。 我计划将这一方法应用到若干股指期权和众多个股期权上，来检验跳跃强度与扩散波幅的关系。 这个结果会对期权定价模型的进一步发展有重大的影响。

694013.label: Realisation of objectives
694013.value: In this project, we conducted model-free estimation and tests of the relationship between jump intensity and diffusive volatility. First, we conducted simulation analyses to examine the performance of jump detection tests based on various diffusive volatility estimators and how accurately the relation between the conditional jump intensity and diffusive volatility can be identified. The data are simulated from the discretized version of a simple jump-diffusion model, with parameters calibrated to the actual data from S&P index. The jump detection tests we examined are classified according to how the diffusive variance is estimated. They include the bipower variation (BV), the truncated realized variance (TRV), the realized variance using nearest neighbor truncation (MRV), and the exponentially weighted moving average with truncation (EMT). Second, we compare these tests for their size and power and found that EMT has the best size-and-power trade-off. The simulation analysis we did confirms that the tests have power to reject the null hypothesis of no relationship if data are generated with the relationship. We then applied the methodology to a few stock indexes and 30 individual stocks. We found little evidence that jump intensity positively depends on diffusive volatility as a general property of the jump intensity. This finding can provide impetus to improving the specification of jump dynamics in options pricing models. We did certain robustness checks and reconciled the results with the findings reported in other related studies. We wrote a paper based on this important finding and submitted it to the Journal of Empirical Finance and got accepted. The paper was published in 2016.

This finding can provide impetus to improving the specification of jump dynamics in options pricing models. We did certain robustness checks and reconciled the results with the findings reported in other related studies. We wrote a paper based on this important finding and submitted it to the Journal of Empirical Finance and got accepted. The paper was published in 2016.

694013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
694013.value: The pattern we found in conducting this research made us to think why the otherwise appealing hypothesis that the jump intensity increases with diffusive volatility does not hold. One of my conjectures is that firms have different information disclosure policies and various practices in complying insider trading regulations. The news about firms’ future cash flows may be released to the market in different ways across firms. Some takes the form of diffusive volatility, while others take the form of stock prices jumps. We will continue to investigate this and its policy implications.

694013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
694013.value: We found evidence rejecting the commonly believed claim that the intensity of stock price jumps (i.e., the likelihood of large changes) is high when its diffusive volatility (i.e., the magnitude of its small changes) is high. This task is not easy because this division between small changes and large changes is not in absolute terms. The finding prompts more analyses into what firm characteristics, corporate disclosure policies, and insider trading compliance policies determine the pattern of stock price changes.

694213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
694213.value: Investigating information asymmetry between insiders and outsiders in capital markets is economically important because it has significant implications on market efficiency. Prior literature has proposed three sources of information that outsiders can use: financial statements, analysts, and news. The information environment for investors, however, has been significantly changed by new forms of information channels. Social media offer a way for uninformed investors to obtain information and can potentially reduce the information gap between insiders and outsiders. In this project, we aim to examine the impact of social media and use information arrivals (new content added) on Wikipedia, a representative social media platform, to proxy for the informativeness of social media. We will evaluate the impact of social media on information asymmetry and specifically study how insider trading profitability can be influenced by Wikipedia. We will construct a data set of listed firms that had insider trades and had a Wikipedia entry in the 2002-2011 time frame. We will examine how information arrivals on Wikipedia about a listed firm can be associated with the profitability of the firm’s insider trading. Our pilot study suggests that social media can reduce information asymmetry between insiders and outsiders, thus limiting insiders’ ability to trade profitably on private information. The PI and Co-I’s have worked together before on related topics and have been successful in publishing research in this area. We expect this study to make significant contributions to the literature. The research is also likely to offer important implications to market regulators, investors and firm managers. 資本市場裡研究內部和外部交易的信息不對稱是非常重要的，因為這對市場有效性有重大影響。以前的研究指出了三種普通投資者可以使用的信息來源：財務報表，分析師和新聞。這種投資者的信息環境在最近一段時間由於新的信息通道的建立而改變。社會媒體給普通投資者提供了一個獲得信息的途徑，十分可能由此改變公司內部人員和外部人員交易的信息環境。 這個項目主要研究以維基百科為代表的社會媒體對金融市場的影響。我們將衡量社會媒體對信息不對稱的影響，並具體研究維基百科的改動和公司內部交易的關系。 我們收集到一個2002到2011年上市公司內部交易和它們維基百科改動的對應數據。通過觀察維基百科上信息更新的情況，我們可以看到社會媒體如何影響公司內部人員如何進行內部交易。我們初步的研究表明社會媒體能夠降低公司內部和外部人員的信息不對稱，從而限制公司內部人員利用他們的信息優勢而獲利的可能。 本項目的研究團隊曾經在相關研究問題上有過合作，並發表過論文。我們認為這個研究可以對這個領域做出非常顯著的貢獻。

694213.label: Major findings and research outcome
694213.value: We empirically examined comprehensive social media and financial data and investigated the role of social media in the financial market. We compared and contrasted social media with traditional media in their respective roles in distributing information. When doing so, we studied contextual environments (e.g., corporate governance, analyst following, institutional holdings, etc.) in which social media play a more or less significant role. We were able to find some interesting results. First, we find that social media has a significant impact on management disclosure. Social media updates on Wikipedia significantly reduced the disclosure lag. Second, we find that investors are better informed. When there is bad news, investors are not as surprised when social media updates can better inform them. Third, we find that social media has a significant effect on insider trading profitability. When there are a lot of social media updates, owners’ and managers’ information advantage is weakened. Finally, we find that firms are actively using social media channels such as Twitter to manipulate how information is disseminated. We met many conceptual and technical problems. For example, given the large dataset, we solved some technical challenges before we could process the Wikipedia modification data. We also had to reconsider the initial model and introduced additional datasets to improve the research implications. We do not have many deviations from the original plan. Some models are changed because we wanted to improve the rigor of them.

694213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
694213.value: We seek to generalize this research in several ways. First, we can develop theoretical works to further the insights we obtained from this project. We have working papers developed along this line. Second, generalizing beyond Wikipedia, we also plan to study Twitter and other social media's impact on the financial market. To this end, we also have several working papers. Please see "research output" for details.

694213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
694213.value: Information is the backbone of financial markets, as managers are well aware. They tend to time the release of news to their advantage, which plays up the fact that they know more than investors. With Wikipedia, however, that imbalance is getting upended. This research shows that Wikipedia has significantly enriched the information environment and is therefore helping to reduce some of the information asymmetry between managers and investors. This is even helping managers, too, by alleviating their litigation concerns. The findings have implications for investors, managers and regulators. For investors, Wikipedia provides a channel that is more extensive and less susceptible to biases than newspapers and analysts. For managers, Wikipedia is making it necessary for them to change their mindset about private information and embrace Wikipedia’s benefits, in particular reducing litigation concerns. And for regulators, the information transparency introduced by Wikipedia and other social media should be welcome, particularly in the wake of the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Act. Although the study focused on public companies, if Wikipedia can improve the information transparency of privately-held companies, given SOX does not apply to them, then our results suggest technology-enabled information aggregation by individuals plays a broader role than the legal mechanisms in enhancing companies’ information environment.

694413.label: Project Objectives
694413.value: To understand whether and how the asset prices are affected by political uncertainty. To measure the value of political connections. Firms with political connections are more likely to benefit from favorable government policies, but are also more likely to be affected by the uncertainty of losing this special benefit. 694413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
694413.value: Recently, the impact of political uncertainty on asset pricing has attracted a lot of attention. Theoretical models have predicted that increase of political uncertainty should cause stock prices to fall, especially to firms that are policy sensitive. Empirically, researchers have tried several different methods to construct the index of political uncertainty. In this proposal, we take advantage of an unexpected political event which happened in China this year - Bo’s scandal, and use it as a natural experiment to identify the impact of political uncertainty on asset pricing. This event provides an ideal laboratory for testing the impact of political uncertainty on asset pricing, because there is a definitive date when the political uncertainty unexpectedly increased, and then there is also a date when people expect that this rising political uncertainty will be resolved. The 18th National Congress of Communist Party of China, to be held in Beijing in November this year, represents power transfer in China. This long-expected peaceful and smooth transfer of power was overshadowed by the outbreak of Bo’s scandal, which surfaced early this year. We argue that Bo’s event increases the political uncertainty, while the upcoming commencement of 18th Party Congress represents the resolve of this uncertainty. Theory predicts that the stock price should drop around the day when political uncertainty increases and should rise around the day when political uncertainty decreases. In addition, theory also predicts that the effects should be larger among firms that are more policy-sensitive. We propose three measures to capture policy sensitiveness of firms. The first one is the event return around the announcement of RMB 4 trillion (US$ 586 billion) stimulus package announced by the central government of China on November 9th, 2008. A larger announcement return implies higher policy-sensitiveness. The second measure is the proportion of government expenditure as of total expenditure in fixed assets in each province. Firms in the province with high proportion of government expenditure will be more policy sensitive. The third measure is a direct measure of whether a firm’s management team and board of directors have political connections. Politically connected firms are more policy-sensitive. Our preliminary results show that the stock market drops around days when political uncertain increases, and using the first two measures, the magnitudes are larger among firms that are more policy sensitive. 近來，政治面的不確定性對資產價格的影響備受關注。各種理論模型紛紛預測，政治不確定性增加會導致股價下跌，特別是對政策敏感度高的企業。實證研究人員試過多種不同方式來建構政治不確定性指標。 在本提案中，我們把今年在中國發生的一件突發政治事件，即薄熙來醜聞，當作辨識政治不確定性對資產價格影響的自然實驗。該事件為測試政治不確定性對資產價格的影響提供了理想的實驗環境，此乃由於政治不確定性之突然增加有一明確日期，且民眾亦預期由該事引發起的政治不確定性會在特定日期獲得解決。 今年 11 月將在北京舉行的中國共產黨第十八次全國代表大會代表了中國政權的移轉。然而，年初爆發的薄熙來醜聞卻為這場期盼已久的平穩政權移轉蒙上了陰影。我們認為，薄熙來事件增加了政治不確定性，而即將展開的中國共產黨第十八次全國代表大會則將會化解該事件所帶來的不確定性。 理論預測，政治不確定性增加日的前後，股價會跌，而政治不確定性降低日的前後，股價會漲。此外，理論還預測，政治不確定性對政策敏感度高的企業的股價影響更甚。我們以三種方式衡量企業的政策敏感度。首先是中國中央政府於 2008 年 11 月 9 日發布的四兆人民幣 (相當於 5,860 億美元) 刺激經濟方案之投報率；投報率越高之企業，對政策必然越敏感。其次是衡量政府開支佔各省固定資產總支出的比例；省政府開支比例越高，該省企業對政策越敏感。第三是直接衡量企業的管理團隊與董事會是否具有政治關聯；有政治關聯的企業對政策越敏感。 我們初步的研究結果顯示，政治不確定性增加日的前後股市走跌，而使用前兩種衡量方式時就發現，對政策越敏感之企業，受政治不確定性影響的程度越大。

694413.value: The major objective of this project is to test the predictions of political uncertainty models that increases in political uncertainty cause stock prices to fall, especially for politically sensitive firms. We use the event of the Bo Xilai political scandal in 2012 in China as an exogenous shock to identify the impact of political uncertainty on asset prices. We document that the Bo scandal caused a significant drop in stock prices, especially for firms that are more politically sensitive. Further analysis shows that the stock price drop is mainly driven by a change in discount rate, providing strong support for the existence of priced political risk. The results are summarized in a paper, which has been accepted publication at the top-three finance journal, Journal of Financial Economics. 694413.label: Major findings and research outcome
694413.value: This project has generated the following paper that has been accepted for publication at Journal of Financial Economics, which is one of the top-three finance journals The major findings are as follows: 1. Liu, Laura Xiaolei, Haibing Shu, and K.C. John Wei, 2016, “The impacts of political uncertainty on asset prices: Evidence from the Bo scandal in China,” Journal of Financial Economics, forthcoming. Models of political risk predict that increases in political uncertainty cause stock prices to fall, especially for politically sensitive firms. We use the event of the Bo Xilai political scandal in 2012 in China as an exogenous shock to identify the impact of political uncertainty on asset prices. We document that the Bo scandal caused a significant drop in stock prices, especially for firms that are more politically sensitive. We also rule out the possibility that the drops in share prices is due to decreases in expected cash flows. Moreover, we also document a large increase in stock volatility right after the Bo scandal for all groups of policy-sensitive firms, especially for firms that are more sensitive to policy changes. Finally, we find that firms connected with Bo through government agencies in Chongqing did experience significantly more drops in share prices. However, our results still hold even after controlling for or deleting these firms. All these results show that the stock price drop is mainly driven by a change in discount rate, providing strong support for the existence of priced political risk.

694413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
694413.value: The impacts of political uncertainty on the real economy and the capital markets have attracted a lot of attention in recent years, as evidenced by the surprising outcomes that Briton votes to leave EU (Brexit) and the U.S. citizens vote Donald Trump as the US president in 2016. Since my first paper co-authored with YC Chan that examines and finds that that political news related to the Sino-British confrontation on the future status of Hong Kong increases stock volatility, especially for stocks of local firms. Now, Professor YC Chan and I are currently working on a project that extends the current study to other aspects of capital markets. Our initial finding shows that the political uncertainty does affect firms’ cost of capital.

694413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
694413.value: In this paper, we use the Bo Xilai political scandal event as an exogenous shock to the political uncertainty in China and show that increases in political uncertainty causes share prices to drop and volatility to increase, especially for politically sensitive firms. The finding suggests that the political stability in any country is very important for its economic development and the prosperity of its society.

694513.value: 共存的貨幣和債券的研究

694513.label: Project Objectives
694513.value: Develop a general-equilibrium model to demonstrate that coexistence of money and bonds is beneficial. Examine how robust the result in the above general-equilibrium model is, both analytically and numerically.
rows: Develop a general-equilibrium model to demonstrate that coexistence of money and bonds is beneficial.
Examine how robust the result in the above general-equilibrium model is, both analytically and numerically.

694513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
694513.value: This project contributes to the study of coexistence of money and risk-free, interest-bearing, and physically and legally liquid government bonds, a long-standing puzzle in monetary economics. There are two aspects to this puzzle: (a) how such coexistence can be possible, and (b) why such coexistence may be socially desirable Aspect (a) is essentially a rate-of-return dominance problem. As is best articulated by Hicks [5], "This [coexistence], as I see it, is really the central issue in the pure theory of money. Either we have to give an explanation of the fact that people do hold money when rates of interest are positive, or we have to evade the difficulty somehow." A solution to (a), on top of being a contribution to pure theory of money, helps to better understand necessary conditions for effective monetary policy as well as other rate-of-return dominance problems. Aspect (b) also bears significant policy implications. Friedman [4] has gone so far as to propose "Government would not issue interest-bearing securities to the public; the Federal Reserve System would not operate in the open market." This sort of policy proposal ought to be evaluated in a model where the roles of money and bonds are not ad hoc and, in particular, are built on some explicit frictions. Our study of aspect (a) is built on the existing literature, which shows that in a decentralized-trade model, coexistence can emerge in an equilibrium that is immune to coalition defection in each pairwise meeting. For aspect (b), we will first identify a critical driving force for the beneficial role of coexistence. Specifically, the interest-bearing bonds provide (partial) insurance to agents who are short of nominal-income inflow opportunity. Then we will demonstrate that this driving force can be dominant in general equilibrium. In terms of methodology, we will take a mechanism-design approach. As a novel piece, we will allow the social planner to invest in some costly technology with which he can possess some minimal implementation capacity to prevent off-equilibrium renegotiation. With this treatment, we can strength the notion of implementation so that an equilibrium with coexistence is immune to renegotiation in each pairwise meeting while the equilibrium outcome in the meeting need not be a solution of some specific bargaining (e.g., Nash bargaining). To summarize, we aim to demonstrate that coexistence is socially desirable and implementable with a strengthened notion of implementation. 該項目有助於研究货币和無風險且有流動性的政府債券的共存難題。這個難題有兩個方面： （一）共存是如何可能的，及（二）為什麼這樣的共存可能是对社會有利的。 方面（一），引用希克斯的闡述[5] ， “這样的共存是純貨幣理論中的核心問題，要么我們解釋人們为什么持有现金當利率是正的时候，或者我們以某種方式逃避困難。” 方面（二）還承擔著重大的政策含義。弗里德曼[4]建議“政府不应發行附息證券向公眾而且聯邦儲備系統不应进行公開市場操作。 ”這種類型的政策建議---它是否支持政府發行附息證券或---應該在一個货币和債券不是任意假定的模型中被評估。 我們的研究对方面（一）是建立在現有的文獻上。 对方面（二），我們會先找出共存的有益作用的一個關鍵驅動力。具體來說，附息債券提供部分保險作用代理。然後，我們將證明，該驅動力可以是一般均衡中佔主導地位。 總結一下，我們的目標是證明共存是对社会有利的和可實行的。

694513.label: Realisation of objectives
694513.value: The two objectives in the original application have been largely realized. As demonstrated by the illustrating example in the application, nominal bonds have two opposite effects on welfare: the insurance effect and the inflation effect. For the bonds to be socially beneficial, the insurance effect must dominate the inflation effect; that is, we need some force not only to break down the Friedman rule but also to make a positive money growth favorable. The force we focus on in this project is nondegenerate distribution of wealth. After all, for the insurance effect to be a factor, the model must have some nondegenerate distributions of wealth in equilibrium. We learn from the research process in this project that we need the distribution to be sufficiently nondegenerate unless we make some very special assumptions (e.g., these assumptions in the general-equilibrium model in the original application). Given this learned lesson, we work with an off-shelf model that is able to easily generate sufficiently nondegenerate models. The model is the familiar Trejos-Wright-Shi model with general holdings of indivisible money. Given the nature of the model, we rely on numerical analysis. The novel finding is that interest-bearing bonds improve welfare when interest payments are taxed progressively; that is, the optimal interest rate is positive. Moreover, because interest payments are financed by inflation, it follows that the optimal inflation rate is positive. This finding is quite robust for a variety of specifications of the model.

694513.label: Major findings and research outcome
694513.value: The most important finding is that interest-bearing bonds improve welfare when interest payments are taxed progressively. In other words, the optimal interest rate is positive and the optimal inflation rate is positive. As we were only be able to reach this finding recently, we are still working on a suitable version of the paper.

694513.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
694513.value: At this stage, there is an issue we intend to address but have not yet found a satisfactory answer. The issue is whether nominal bonds may outperform lump sum money transfers. Our present finding is that welfare with nominal bonds can be very close to but slightly less than welfare with lump sum money transfers (but without bonds). There are two possibilities. One is that varying some parameters or specifications in the model, bonds can do better than lump sum transfers. Another is that we need to introduce something new into the present model. The most promising new factor is some means for poor agents to finance a money payment to the government at the stage when old bonds mature and new bonds are issued. With such a means, it may be incentive compatible for all agents to equally and voluntarily contribute some money to the government for the interest payments., eliminating inflation and enabling bonds to redistribute wealth evener than lump sum transfers of money. We are intensively working on this issue now.

694513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
694513.value: When the government taxes interest payments progressively, it redistributes wealth in favor of the relatively poor people. While this redistribution reduces aggregate output (GDP), it improves the social welfare (overall happiness of a society).

699113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
699113.value: In this project, I plan to study how family infighting affects family firms. My work will consist of both theoretical and empirical analyses. First, I plan to study how the anticipation of family conflicts affects the ownership distribution in the family firms, i.e. how retiring founders allocate the control of the firm between their heirs. In the primarily theory work, I plan to look into when dispersed and when concentrated control between family members is optimal by linking the solution to how likely the heirs are to disagree over the corporate policy. I expect the potential disagreement to also affect the dividend (and thus the investment) policy of the firm. I plan to support the theoretical predictions with the empirical analysis based on a unique micro-level dataset that links all Swedish firms to their owners, the family members of these owners, and their characteristics such as occupational status, wealth, education level, income, and residences. Second, I want to dig deeper in finding the solutions to the family infighting and analyzing the corporate governance arrangements between family members in the family firms. Some of the corporate governance structures are very specific to the family firms, for instance, family trusts, councils and constitutions, and I plan to study under which circumstances these types of arrangements are present in the firms. Third, my research will include studying conflicts between different families. In particular, I plan to look into whether family firms are more inclined than non-family firms to enter into cartels or on contrary they are less likely to agree with each other because of personal ambitions and conflicts. This part of analysis would consist of the cross-country study that would look at whether the changes in antitrust law (in particular relating to cartel prohibition such as new competition law regime in Hong Kong) affect family or non-family firms more. In addition, proprietary data on international cartels between 1995 and 2012 will allow me to study whether the discovered cartels are more prevalent among family or non-family firms and whether family firms behave differently when engaging in price fixing than non-family firms. 在这个项目中，我计划结合理论和事实来研究家庭内讧对家族企业所造成的影响。 首先，我计划研究人们对家庭冲突的预期如何影响家族企业所有权的分布，例如即将退休的创始人如何在继承者间分配公司的控制权。在最主要的理论方面，我打算深入研究企业最优控制权分配（离散型或者集中型）与继承者对公司管理政策的分歧程度关系。我预期潜在的分歧会影响公司的股息政策乃至投资方向。 我计划通过对某微观层面的数据库进行实证分析来支撑理论模型的预测。该数据库涉及所有瑞典企业的微观层面资料， 包括企业的所有者，所有者的主要家庭成员 以及他们的特征，如职业地位，财富，教育程度，收入和住所等。 其次，我要深入挖掘解决家族内讧的最优方案，并分析家庭成员与公司治理规划的关系。一些法人治理结构只适用于某些特定的家族企业，例如家族信托、议会和宪法，我打算研究在不同情况下，企业如何运用不同的治理结构。 第三，我计划研究不同家庭企业之间的冲突。尤其是家族企业是否会因为某些个人野心或冲突因素而相对于非家族企业更倾向于建立卡特尔组织关系。这部分研究将分析不同国家之间，反托拉斯法的变化（尤其会涉及禁止卡特尔的法律，例如香港的新竞争法制度）是否会对家庭或非家族企业造成不同程度的影响。此外，1995年至2012年的国际卡特尔专有数据能够使得我研究卡特尔现象是在家族还是在非家族企业中更盛行。以及家族企业与非家族企业在从事固定价格时是否会有不同的表现

699213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
699213.value: Several television networks—for example, Fox Broadcasting Company—have recently attempted to condense or remove commercial breaks during TV shows. They hope to improve the consumer viewing experience and, more importantly, keep viewers from switching to other channels. The rationale behind such a strategy is the widely-recognized truism that consumers are averse to commercials and prefer to watch TV shows without them. In line with this wisdom, some public policy makers even restrict commercials for the sake of enhancing consumer welfare. For instance, in January of 2012 China banned in-show commercials for all TV series. But do commercials really only have negative effects on consumer welfare? Is it possible that, under some circumstances, commercials may even have a positive impact on consumers? This research project proposes that commercial breaks may enhance consumers’ overall television-viewing welfare by allowing consumers time to search for alternative TV shows that may better fit their tastes. In other words, commercial breaks provide consumers with a time window during which they can search for a better show at a low search cost. As a result, the TV market becomes more efficient in the sense that consumers with heterogeneous viewing preferences are better matched to their chosen TV shows. To assess the hypothetical welfare-enhancing effect of commercials, we have collected individual-level TV viewing data and channel-level rating data over a two-month period. We aim to develop an empirical search model in the context of TV watching to test this welfare-enhancing effect. The marketing literature focuses on consumers’ aversion to commercials, but ignores the positive impact of commercials on welfare and market efficiency. The proposed research, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to empirically assess the influence of commercials on overall consumer welfare using real-world individual TV viewing data. The results of our research will expand the understanding of the consequences of commercials and guide public policy makers’ decisions around advertising regulations. Furthermore, we aim to model and predict an individual consumer’s search and channel switching behavior in the presence of commercial breaks. The results will help advertisers target commercial viewers more precisely, and will allow TV networks to better schedule programs and commercial breaks. 常理認為觀眾反感電視廣告，不少電視臺也試圖縮短或者去除電視節目中的廣 告。但廣告對觀眾只有負面效應嗎？這項研究提出：廣告會提高觀眾的消費者福利，因為廣告轉臺的觀眾可能搜索到更符合其口味的節目。進而，電視收視市場也會 變得更有效率，因為頻道節目和觀眾的匹配變得更加有效。我們收集了個體觀眾兩個月的收視數據來驗證這個理論。本研究將會拓展公共政策以及廣告界對廣告的認 識，也有助於電視臺更好地安排電視節目和廣告。

699213.label: Realisation of objectives
699213.value: We have fully achieved the project objectives. Using TV reviewing data, we investigated consumer welfare implication of breaks that interrupt product consumption. The conventional wisdom dictates that consumers prefer watching TV shows without the disruption of commercial breaks. However, we found that the breaks may improve the welfare of consumers under certain conditions. In particular, when there is uncertainty such that the consumer is unclear about the exact utility levels of different products, she has to engage in costly search to resolve the uncertainty before choosing a product. In the context of TV programming, for example, the breaks lower the opportunity cost of search, allowing the consumer to sample alternative channels without (further) interrupting the viewing experience on her current channel. Using data from Chinese TV market, we estimate a sequential search model to evaluate our conjecture. The data contain a natural experiment, where the Chinese government banned all in-show commercial breaks for episode-based TV series on January 1, 2012. This new policy on commercial breaks created exogenous variations in the data that allow us to separately identify heterogenous consumer preference and search cost. Based on the analyses, we have found evidence that the intended improvement in TV viewing experience was limited. Many consumers were worse off due to the ban on commercial breaks because they could no longer sample alternative channels that were more preferable than their current product choices. We also investigated how the timing of breaks affect TV channels' viewerships, which offers managerial insights about how firms should adjust the timing of breaks so as to improve their sales.

699213.label: Major findings and research outcome
699213.value: Based on this project, we published a research paper, titled "TV Channel Search and Commercial Breaks,” at Journal of Marketing Research, the top journal in the field. We investigate time lapses that interrupt product consumption. Preeminent examples are commercial breaks during television or radio programming. We suggest that breaks facilitate consumers searching for alternatives. Specifically, when there is so much uncertainty that consumers are unclear about utility levels of different products, they engage in costly search to resolve the uncertainty. For TV programming, breaks lower the opportunity cost of search, allowing the consumer to sample alternative channels without further interrupting the viewing experience on her current channel. Using data from the Chinese TV market, we estimate a sequential search model to understand consumer TV channel choice behavior. The data contain a quasi natural experiment due to the Chinese government's policy change on commercial breaks. The natural experiment created exogenous variations in the data that enable the empirical identification of heterogeneous consumer preference and search cost. The data patterns support that viewers search alternatives during commercial breaks. Based on the estimates, we investigate how the timing of breaks affects TV channels' viewership, offering insights about how to strategically adjust the timing of breaks.

699213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
699213.value: Further research could investigate consumer's TV viewing in the group setting, for example, husband and wife. Such research would require fine individual level TV viewing data.

699213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
699213.value: Our project proposes a search model and uses it to measure consumers' choices of TV channels. The model provides a more realistic characterization of TV-viewing behavior. We advance the TV-viewing choice literature by allowing uncertainty in consumers' knowledge about upcoming programming. We apply the model to a unique dataset of the Chinese TV market. In our data, the market experienced a policy change where the government banned all in-show commercial breaks for episodic programs. We find that low-rated channels will benefit from synchronizing their breaks with high-rated competitors so as to prevent their own viewers from searching and leaving after the search during commercial breaks. High-rated channels should try to differentiate their breaks from competitors. When a high-rated channel differentiates its timing from competitors, it can capture churning viewers from competing channels during their breaks. Meanwhile, when the high-rated channel has commercial breaks itself, its viewers are on average less likely to search because of lower expected net return of the search.

699513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
699513.value: Forecasters are often strategic in making forecasts. In particular, they may herd (or anti-herd) on some consensus forecast. The herding behavior of economics forecasters has important implications on information transmission and quality of forecasts. This proposal aims to empirically investigate whether macroeconomic forecasters and financial analysts herd or anti-herd. The existing methods often rely on the strong assumption that the decision model is perfectly known. In this proposal, we develop a nonparametric test to test whether this important assumption holds in real data. Moreover, we provide new testing methods for herding behavior that does not rely on the assumption of perfect knowledge of the decision model. We apply our new methods to (i) a new comprehensive macroeconomic forecasting dataset and (ii)I/B/E/S company earning forecasting dataset. 經濟預測者在做預測時經常是帶有策略性的。特別是他們可能故意靠近或故意遠離某些大眾的預測。預測者的從眾行為對於信息的傳遞和預測的質量有重要的影響。本項研究的目的是實證地研究宏觀經濟預測者和金融預測者是否有從總或反從總地行為。目前這方面的研究依賴於很強的假設，其假定決策模型是完全知道的。本項研究發展了非參數方法來檢驗這個假設在實際中是否成立。進一步，我們提供新的檢驗方法，新方法不需要決策模型是完全知道的假設。我們將新的方法應用到一個新的宏觀數據和一個公司盈利的數據(I/B/E/S)中。

699513.label: Realisation of objectives
699513.value: The two objectives are fully realized, despite the fact that only about half of the budget proposed was approved. 1. The first objective is achieved. In a working paper (in preparation for submission) with Chadha and Sabourian (Chadha, Lu and Sabourian, 2017 (CLS, hereafter)), we develop a specification test to test the assumption that the forecasting decision model is perfectly known. We also propose a instrumental variable estimation method that is robust to the violation of this assumption. In a published paper jointly with Su (Lu and Su, 2017, Quantitative Economics, forthcoming), we develop a general panel data method that allows heterogeneity in the slope coefficient. This method can be applied to test for herding behavior to allow different forecasters to have different herding behavior. 2. The second objective is also achieved. In CLS, we apply the new method to a comprehensive panel dataset, which contains forecasting data of 27 major macroeconomic variables. We find that forecasters herd. This is in sharp contrast to the results based on existing methods, which conclude that forecasters anti-herd.

In CLK, we also propose an instrumental variable estimation method that takes into account the errors in the forecasting models. We find that forecaster herd rather than anti-herd in sharp contrast to the results based on the existing methods. 3. In Lu and Su (2017), we develop a general method in panel data that allows flexible forms of unobservable heterogeneity.

It would be interesting to provide more empirical applications of this new method. I am exploring these topics in ongoing works.

699513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
699513.value: Economic forecasting provides important information for various decision makers. Forecasters can be strategic in making forecasts. In particular, they may herd (or anti-herd) on some consensus forecasts. This project investigates whether macroeconomic forecasters herd or anti-herd in forecasting. We develop a new method that takes into account the possible errors made in the forecasting process. We apply the new method to a comprehensive forecasting dataset of macroeconomic variables, such as non-farm payrolls and unemployment rates, and find that macroeconomic forecasters herd.

699613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
699613.value: How private information is shared among parties with diverse interests is a question of fundamental importance in modern microeconomics. In this paper, we utilize the unique environment of laboratory experiments to explore empirically the limit of information transmission envisioned in the Crawford and Sobel (1982) framework, where an informed, biased sender transmits information represented by a continuous variable to an uninformed receiver. We aim at implementing several optimal communication protocols recently proposed by the theoretical cheap talk literature in the laboratory. The major objectives of our experimental investigation are 1) to provide laboratory evidence regarding the performance of these communication protocols, whether they can achieve the same performance as predicted, and 2) to generate practical guideline for the design of optimal communication protocols. 自Crawford and Sobel (下文以 CS簡註) 於1982發表有關無成本的策略性私人訊息傳遞的核心論文後，此項目廣受博奕論學者關注。在此論文, 我們運用獨特的實驗室環境進行實證研究, 模擬CS框架下提出的資訊傳遞的邊界。於此實驗，有偏見的及有訊息群向無訊息群發出連續變量資訊。 這實驗測試數個於文獻內優化訊息傳遞協議的理論研究, 以填補CS框架下的空白。此實驗的主要目的如下：1) 提供關於訊息傳遞協議的實驗性證據，及能否達到預期成效；2) 為設計優化訊息傳遞協議制定實用性指導

699613.label: Realisation of objectives
699613.value: We consider, in addition to a standard communication channel with no noise (or no mediation), two different mediation schemes with different languages used by the mediator. In our first "mediation" channel, the sender's message space is the type space and the channel generates action recommendations. The channel operates by taking in declaratives to generate directives. In contrast, the second "noise" channel uses declaratives on both sides. The sender's message space is the type space and so is the message space from which the mediator/noisy channel draws its outputs. 1. Relying on the simple experimental design mentioned above, we were able to show that introducing a noise into a communication channel can significantly improve the welfare of players in the laboratory. 2. We show that the way we introduce the noise into the communication channel matters. The mediation channel that takes declaratives to generate directives performs significantly better than the noise channel that uses declaratives on both sides. 3. Our findings show that designing a better communication protocol should be based not only on the theoretical guideline provided by the literature of optimal communication design, but also on other practical factors that include the languages used by the mediator.

699613.label: Major findings and research outcome
699613.value: We experimentally document the efficiency-enhancing role of communication design. Two communication channels are considered: a noisy channel, in which a noise process maps the sender's message space into itself, and a mediated channel, in which the received messages are framed as action recommendations under the same noise process. We find that both channels improve communication efficiency relative to the benchmark of direct communication. Despite the strategic, theoretical equivalence of the two communication environments, the mediated channel outperforms the noisy channel in the laboratory.

699613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
699613.value: It is worthwhile to point out that all the different settings we examined correspond to different mediation schemes with different languages used by the mediator. In our mediation channel, the sender's message space is the type space and the channel generates action recommendations. The channel operates by taking in declaratives to generate directives. In contrast, the noise channel uses declaratives on both sides. The sender's message space is the type space and so is the message space from which the mediator/noisy channel draws its outputs. Apparently, we did not go through all the possible permutations of sender and receiver languages, and we believe the case of declaratives on both sides might be promising. Also, one could think of looking at strategy correlation in the communication channel. We leave these topics for future research.

699613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
699613.value: In the theoretical literature of communication design, it has been shown that more information can be transmitted from a privately-informed but self-interested agent to an uninformed decision-maker when a mediator is introduced in the communication channel. The role of the mediator is to listen to the privately-informed agent and produce either action recommendations to the decision-maker or descriptions about the state of nature. Whether action recommendations are made or descriptions of the state of nature are provided does not matter in the theoretical environment. However, our experimental data show that the language used by the mediator matters a lot. When the action recommendation is made according to the theoretically optimal scheme, the performance of information transmission is significantly better than the other case in which the mediator provides descriptions of the state of nature. Our finding has a significant policy implication. When a policy maker in a government receives an advice from an expert about optimal tax policy, for example, it is useful 1) to introduce a mediation device and 2) to make sure that the mediator chooses a proper language to communicate.

699713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
699713.value: Companies actively manage their employees’ online communities of practice as part of the formal structure of the organization by establishing communities based on existing functional domains. In this proposal, we study work-focused online communities, in a company, open to all interested employees. For knowledge to be shared across communities, management often encourages inter-community collaboration and community membership overlap. Communities collaborate on common problems by sharing particular discussion threads through cross-posting so that members of different communities can participate in shared discussion. Also, employees are free to join and participate in multiple communities of interest, thus causing communities to share overlapping members. The benefit of IT-enabled inter-community collaboration lies in the performance potential of diversity: advice seekers can learn significantly by receiving diverse inputs from members of different communities. Yet, empirical evidence suggests that advice seekers find it difficult to benefit from the expertise diversity of discussion participants. How should participants from different communities be engaged in knowledge sharing so that advice seekers can benefit? Drawing on cognitive elaboration theory, we propose that discussion participants should engage in collective elaboration by articulating their inputs in relation to other providers’ inputs, instead of merely compiling individual ideas. Furthermore, how can a discussion participant understand another’s reply, if both are from communities specialized in different domains? Community membership overlap has been mainly assumed to create competition between respective communities. Drawing on knowledge boundary theory, we take a complementary perspective, proposing that membership overlap is necessary for effective inter-community collaboration. The project sheds light on the conditions under which advice seekers benefit from the diverse expertise provided through inter-community collaboration by focusing on the roles of discussion participants’ knowledge elaboration and their community membership overlap. We design a field study to collect both archival and primary data via multi-methods: a survey to measure inter-community collaboration effectiveness; content analysis of discussion threads to measure collective elaboration; secondary data analysis of various constructs including diversity and membership overlap. The study will provide several theoretical/practical implications. We unearth the understudied relationship between diversity and discussion outcomes by proposing moderating conditions. We advance online community research by studying inter-community knowledge sharing. Much research remains at the individual and within-community levels. Also, the field study provides a rare opportunity to understand how online communities are leveraged in an organization. Findings will guide practitioners as to what to advice employees to have effective online dialogue with others from different communities. 公司通過基於現有職能分工構建網絡社區，同時積極管理雇員在網絡社區中的活動，並將其作為組織正式構成的一個部分。在本研究中，我們將公司內部的網絡社區作為研究對象，該網絡社區以工作內容為核心而構建，並對全體雇員開放。為了促進知識在不同社區間的分享，管理者鼓勵不同社區之間的合作和不同社區間的成員重疊現象。通過對特定討論主題在不同社區中進行交叉發帖，來自不同網絡社區的成員可以參與到同一個討論主題中，從而實現不同社區之間的合作。此外，雇員可以根據其興趣自由選擇加入或參與一個或多個網絡社區，這就使得不同社區擁有重疊的社區成員。 由IT技術所驅動的不同社區之間的合作受益於潛在的專長多樣性：在網絡社區中尋求建議者通過接收來自不同社區成員意見能夠學到更多。然而，經驗卻顯示尋求建議者難以從參與討論者的多樣性專長中獲益。來自不同社區的參與者應該如何投入到知識分享的過程中才能夠使得尋求建議者真正有所收穫？基於認知精製理論，我們提出參與討論者應該在投入合作式闡釋的過程中強調其觀點與他人觀點的聯繫，而非僅僅闡述個人想法。進一步地，如果雙方都來自於不同專業領域的網絡社區，參與討論者會如何理解他人的回復？不同社區之間的成員重疊一直被認為會引發不同社區間的競爭。然而基於知識邊界理論，我們提出一個與之互補的觀點，即不同社區之間的成員重疊對於不同社區之間的有效合作是必須的。 本研究聚焦於參與討論者的合作式闡釋以及不同社區之間的成員重疊，旨在于闡明何種條件下尋求建議者能從不同社區間的合作所帶來的專長多樣性中獲益。我們採用實地研究方法，並通過多種方式收集原始數據和歷史數據：通過調查問卷來衡量不同社區之間合作的有效性，通過對討論主題的內容分析來衡量合作式闡釋，並通過歷史數據來分析包括專長多樣性及不同社區間的成員重疊在內的多個構念。 本研究既具有理論貢獻，亦提供實踐價值。通過提出一些調節性條件，我們發現了以前未被研究的專長多樣性以及網絡社區中討論結果之間的關係。我們通過研究不同網絡社區之間的知識分享來推進當前的網絡社區研究，目前許多相關研究仍停留在對個體和網絡社區內部的研究層面。此外，實地研究給我們提供了一個極為難得的機會去理解網絡社區如何影響組織/公司。我們的發現可以幫助實踐者更好地引導雇員與來自不同網絡社區的成員進行有效溝通。

699713.label: Realisation of objectives
699713.value: I collected a rich dataset from a global energy company known for its successful online community of practice initiative and produced two papers until now. In the first study, building on and extending the knowledge collaboration theory of online communities, I examine the network conditions that enable the generative effect of member time and attention spent externally on community responsiveness. Sharing members with other online communities can be problematic for community responsiveness, as less member time and attention become available for the focal community. However, member time and attention spent externally have the potential to generate knowledge that bolsters the focal community’s responsiveness. Little is known about when member time and attention spent externally become such generative resources. I proposed a contingent model wherein a focal community’s external bridging (the extent of bridging non-redundant communities) and internal bonding (the extent of cohesion among members) jointly moderate the effects of member time and attention spent externally on community responsiveness. I theorized that external bridging provides the opportunity to access novel external knowledge and that internal bonding improves the motivation to share knowledge to assist others. Our results show that member time and attention spent externally have a positive effect on community responsiveness only in the presence of both external bridging and internal bonding. In the second study, using mixed methods including survey, interview, content analysis, and secondary data analysis, I examine the conditions under which advice seekers realize the benefits of the diversity of advice providers in the context of inter-online community joint discussion. Although the information benefits of online discussion joined by people from different communities are clear, previous research suggests that advice seekers find it difficult to benefit from the expertise diversity of discussion participants. Results suggest that a seeker learns the most, when discussion participants are not only diverse but also have overlapping community memberships, and the least when participants are diverse but have no co-membership. This is because discussion participants with diverse expertise can engage in relational elaboration, or articulating the difference and relevance of one another’s inputs, when they share common ground as a result of co-membership, which in turn enhances the advice seeker’s learning. 1. To advance OC research by studying knowledge sharing and collaboration at the inter-community level, not at the individual level within a community. Online communities are no longer viewed as isolated collectives but rather as groups embedded in a broader online ecology. In an inter-community context, one community influences another community. One way that this influence may occur is through shared members who split their finite time and attention across communities (Gu et al. 2007). The prevailing view in the online community literature suggests that sharing members with other communities will harm a focal community’s responsiveness because less member time and attention will be available for the focal community. However, this view overlooks the possible generative effect of member time and attention spent externally, which can bolster community responsiveness and discussion effectiveness through the sharing of externally acquired knowledge within the focal community. Both studies explore knowledge sharing in the inter-community context. 2. To understand how online communities are run and leveraged in an organization setting. The research provides a unique opportunity to understand how organizational online communities operate. Most studies up to date have examined public online communities. In this project, the data were collected from a global energy company with a highly skilled workforce spread across more than 100 work sites worldwide. At the time of the data collection, more than 10,000 employees (or nearly 75% of the employees that the company identified as knowledge workers) participated in approximately 100 organizational online communities. The average community had 162 (SD=196) members, with numbers ranging from fewer than 10 to more than 1,900. What is unique about the organizational online communities I studied is that each community was organized around a specific topic with an explicit link to the organization (e.g., chemicals, pipeline and subsea systems integrity, defect elimination, well optimization, and geomodeling). 3. To develop an advanced conceptual model for examining the conditions under which expertise diversity promotes an advice seeker’s learning and performance through inter-community collaboration. The second study achieved this objective. Drawing from the theories of workgroup diversity, knowledge boundaries, and common ground, I developed a mediated moderation model; overlapping membership overlap moderates the effect of expertise diversity on discussion outcomes (learning and performance), and this moderation is mediated by relational elaboration. In the first study, the objective was extended to explore the conditions under which member time and attention spent externally become generative resources and facilitate greater community responsiveness. The study extends the theory of online knowledge collaboration by combining it with a social network perspective to highlight the contingencies of the generative effect of member time and attention spent externally. 4. To empirically test the model via mixed methods including archival data analysis, interviews, survey, and content analysis. In the first study, I tested a set of hypotheses using both the survey and archival data. I collected nearly 200 survey responses from the employees identified to have recently sought advice online. The corresponding discussion threads initiated by their inquiries were then analyzed with respect to the characteristics of discussion participants and the contents of reply postings. To test the proposed mediation effect of relational elaboration, I examined, through a content analysis, how discussion participants actually communicated, elaborating their domain-specific knowledge, in the discussion threads. In the second study, I relied mainly on the archival data related to community membership and posting activities. 5. To guide practitioners how to best leverage the collective intelligence of employees through inter-community collaboration. The practical implications of the findings of the first study are that it is not so much the abundance of knowledge contribution per se, but instead the way knowledge is communicated and elaborated that produces information benefits for advice seekers. Evidence suggests that advice seekers can learn the most or the least, depending on how discussion participants communicate their knowledge when composing their messages. Online discussion should be a “dialogue,” in which people relate their messages to and build upon others’ messages, not just a compilation of individual ideas. Discussion participants should learn how to become a good “elaborator” for their knowledge contribution to create value. Community managers are advised to provide members an online discussion protocol on relational elaboration and offer incentives for providing elaborated explanations so that the collective intelligence of discussion participants can be leveraged to the greatest effect. The second study suggests that caution should be exercised with respect to the recommendation of Wang et al. (2013) that community managers should restrict, via policy or technological means, their members from participating in other communities. Given the limited availability of time and attention, community managers may want their members to spend all of their available time and attention within the community. The current study demonstrates that a community can actually benefit from the member time and attention spent in other communities. A community will gain a positive return on member time and attention spent externally when it is internally cohesive and shares members with non-redundant communities. Resources would be wasted if members devoted their time and attention to multiple redundant communities or lacked the motivation to share externally acquired knowledge with peers.

699713.label: Major findings and research outcome
699713.value: The major findings of the first study are that a focal community’s external bridging and internal bonding jointly enable member time and attention spent externally to become generative resources. Only when external bridging and internal bonding are both high will member time and attention spent externally improve community responsiveness because members have not only abundant opportunities to acquire novel external knowledge but also strong motivation to share it with others within the community. By contrast, when external bridging or internal bonding is low, member time and attention spent externally will reduce community responsiveness because members fail to acquire novel knowledge or do not share the knowledge that they have acquired. This work has been recently accepted at MIS Quarterly. The major findings of the second study are that the expertise diversity of discussion participants promoted an advice seeker’s learning when participants had a high level of community membership overlap, but did not promote when they had a low level of community membership overlap. The interactive effect of expertise diversity and community membership overlap on an advice seeker’s learning was accounted for by the mediating role of the participants’ relational elaboration in the discussion. Taken together, the findings suggest that expertise diversity translates into improved learning through relational elaboration, which participants are capable of doing when they have overlapping community membership. The finding that expertise diversity did not promote relational elaboration in the absence of community membership overlap provides some evidence for the difficulty of developing common ground in online discussion. The paper was submitted to and rejected by MIS Quarterly but invited for resubmission.

699713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
699713.value: I plan to explore the “organizational” side of online communities internal to organizations – a research area that is greatly understudied. I want to examine how a boss’s formal and informal online community leadership interact with community-level factors, specifically community heterogeneity and community hierarchy, in affecting a subordinate’s community participation. Preliminary results show that the positive effects of the boss’s formal and informal leadership on the subordinate’s participation are contingent on the community’s heterogeneity and hierarchy but in opposite directions. I am looking for the right theoretical lens to make sense of the findings.

699713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
699713.value: Many organizations nurture organizational online communities, each with a distinct topic and specific business objectives, to assist productive interactions among distributed workforces with similar interests. Going beyond nurturing knowledge sharing and collaboration within single communities, much interest has been given to the tremendous informational benefits of inter-community knowledge sharing and collaboration facilitated by communities sharing members. However, previous research suggests that sharing members with other communities can harm individual communities due to the limited availability of member time and attention and that, even when inter-community knowledge sharing occurs, it is difficult to realize the potential benefit of the diversity of expertise held by members of different communities. The current research makes significant theoretical and practical contributions by finding the answers to the questions of how (by which process) and when (under what conditions) communities can realize the informational benefits of inter-community knowledge sharing and collaboration.

700613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
700613.value: In this proposal, we propose to synthesize different series of functional homo- and block copolymers that can function as dispersing agent for carbon nanotubes. Carbon nanotubes are highly interesting nanomaterials that exhibit promising application potentials in the field of optoelectronics. However, pristine carbon nanotubes are very difficult to process and disperse into solution phase because of the very strong interaction between individual tubes. The target polymers/copolymers in this project consist of functional units that form strong interaction with the surface of carbon nanotubes, which can facilitate the dispersion of them into homogeneous solution. The block copolymers will be synthesized by controlled radical polymerizations. In these copolymers, one of the block contain "anchoring groups" that help to dispersed carbon nanotubes, while the other block contain other functional units such as photosensitizers, ion sensing, or photochromic units. The structure of these "anchoring groups" will be systematically modified so that their electronic properties can be varied. We will perform ultrafast spectroscopic measurements on the polymer-carbon nanotube composites obtained. By these experiment, the properties of their short-lived excited states can be studied and the rate of electron transfer between the anchoring units and nanotube can be evaluated. These results will be very important in helping us to design new polymer-carbon nanotube composites for novel optoelectronic devices. 碳納米管在光電學具有非常高的潛在應用價值。 本研究計劃包括合成和表徵一系列的多功能高分子–碳納米管復合物。該些高分子是建基於多功能單段和坎段聚合物， 並可作為碳納米管的分散劑。高分子的合成方法主要是可控自由基聚合反應，分子裡一些功能團和碳納米管有很強的非共價引力，而其他分子裡的功能團則具有特別的光電特性（例如光敏效應丶發光丶或傳感特性）。我們希望利用這些復合物來組裝不同的光電器件，並且研究它們背後的基礎科學，例如激發態壽命和電子及能量的傳導。研究結果可幫助我們發展新的碳納米管材料的發展和把它們應用在器件組裝。

700613.label: Realisation of objectives
700613.value: Objective 1 We have developed a new approach to synthesize polyheterocyclic aromatic compounds with pyrazinopyrazine unit as the core. The synthesis was carried out by the reaction between an aromatic diamine and dioxidimate under a mild condition. Compared to the procedures reported in the literature, this is a new and versatile approach for the construction of pyrazinopyrazine based molecules with different substituents. These molecules were initially designed for being used as photosensitizers in the near IR region, as they exhibit low energy of absorption due to the intramolecular charge transfer transition. Later, it was found that some of the molecules obtained were able to disperse carbon nanotubes in common organic solvents. Because of this, the photophysical properties of some molecules were studied by using ultrafast time-resolved transient absorption spectroscopy. In addition to block copolymers, we have also synthesized a regioregular polythiophene incorporated with ionic pendant groups by Grignard metathesis polymerization. Due to the presence of cationic quaternary ammonium groups, the functional polythiophene was able to disperse carbon nanotube in polar organic solvents. A platinum containing conjugated polymer was also synthesized. The Pt complex exhibit square planar geometry and is also a potential dispersant for carbon nanotubes. The photophysical properties of the polymer was thoroughly studied by transient absorption spectroscopy, by which an efficient triplet exciton diffusion process was observed. Objective 2 We have successfully synthesized a multifunctional triblock copolymers by control radical polymerization. Homopolymers that contain pendant terpyridine units were synthesized in the first step, and the homopolymers were used as the macroinitiators for the synthesis of the target triblock copolymers. A difunctional chain transfer reagent was used in order to obtain A-B-A type triblock copolymers. The copolymers were functionalized with pyrene anchoring groups and the photosensitizers were based on ruthenium bisterpyridine complexes. Homopolymers with only one functional unit were also synthesized as the model compounds, of which the photophysical properties were studied for comparison purpose. For the optimization of the block size ratio, only two block copolymers were synthesized, of which one of them showed excellent performance in dispersing carbon nanotubes. Therefore, extensive studies on the electronic and photophysical properties of the polymer-carbon nanotube hybrids were carried out based on one polymer only. Objective 3 All the polymers obtained were able to disperse carbon nanotube, forming dispersions that were stable up to few months without precipitation. The stability of the dispersions allowed us to carry out extensive characterization of the polymer-carbon nanotube hybrids. It is also interesting to note that the type of solvents used for dispersion depends on the functional units on the polymer. For the model compounds with neutral pendant units, nonpolar organic solvents were used. While for the polymers with quaternary ammonium or ruthenium complex pendant groups, DMF was used as the solvent instead. The formation of polymer-carbon nanotube hybrids was confirmed by AFM, TEM, and EDX analyses. Objective 4 The materials obtained were subjected to extensive characterization by different experimental and computational techniques. The photophysical properties of the homopolymers, functional triblock copolymers, and polymer-carbon nanotube hybrids were studied by femto second-time resolved transient absorption spectroscopy. It was observed that there was significant change in the growth and decay of the excited states after the formation of the hybrids. This suggests a strong electronic interaction between the polymer and the carbon nanotube. In addition, for the hybrid based on the triblock copolymer, a very fast photoinduced electron transfer process was proposed between the sensitizer and carbon nanotube. The dynamics of such electronic transfer process could be monitored by TA absorption spectroscopy. The interaction between different functional units on the polymer and carbon nanotube surface was simulated by molecular dynamics computation. Results obtained suggest that the ruthenium complexes tend to stay away from the nanotube surface, forming an antenna like conformation. The photocurrent response of the polymer-carbon nanotube hybrid obtained was studied by photoconductive atomic force microscopy. We also demonstrated the use of rigorous statistical method to analysis the photocurrent data measured by the AFM system. This is very important to the analysis of experimental data obtained from AFM measurements, as the variation of the tip geometry and substrate in may affect the data in different measurements. In addition, the use of electrostatic force microscopy was employed to study the distribution of charge and charge density of the hybrid, which was covered with a layer of pendant ionic groups. There were only few reports in applying such technique for studying organic-inorganic hybrid nanospecies, and the technique demonstrated will be useful to confirm or to investigate the electronic properties of functional nanomaterials.

700613.label: Major findings and research outcome
700613.value: We have successfully developed both metallopolymers with both conjugated and non-conjugated main chains. The polymers serve as efficient dispersing agents for carbon nanotubes (both single and multi walled) due to the presence of planar aromatic units, which have strong pi-pi interaction with the surface of the nanotubes. Due to such strong interaction, the polymers also have strong electronic interactions with the carbon nanotube, resulting in strong perturbation of the electrionic excited states of both the polymers and carbon nanotubes. We have employed ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy to study and monitor the formation and decay of various excited states in these polymers. By using such characterization techniques, the dynamics of the photoinduced electron transfer process between the sensitizing complexes and carbon nanotube can be studied. The presence of metal complexes does play a very important role to the behavior of the resulting polymer-carbon nanotube hybrid materials. Understanding the details of these photophysical processes allows us to design new materials for light harvesting applications.

700613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
700613.value: We have carried out extensive studies on the photoinduced electronic transfer processes in various polymer-carbon nanotube hybrid materials. Such charge transfer is only the very first step in a light energy harvesting process. In order to construct efficient light harvesting devices, it is also important to understand the fundamental details of the subsequent charge transport and exciton recombination processes. The hybrid materials developed by us in this project may also serve as models for the investigation of subsequent optical/electronic processes. It is definitely a very interesting project to be carried in the future, in both fundamental and practical perspectives.

700613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
700613.value: The development of efficient and long-lived organic solar cells is of great importance because they can serve as alternatives to conventional silicon-based solar cells. Basically, an organic solar cell convert light (photons) to electricity (electrons) upon light irradiation (also called a light harvesting process). However, many scientific, technological, and engineering problems need to be solved before efficient light harvesting devices can be developed. In this project, we focused on studying one of the fundamental processes (charge generation) occurred in a typical organic solar cells. Generally speaking, this is the process by which free electrons are generated by the molecules (sensitizers) that absorb light. Knowing the details of this process enables us to design more efficient light harvesting devices and to minimize other undesired processes that may occur in the devices. We have employed a state-of-the-art technique (ultrafast transient absorption spectroscopy) to monitor the generation and decay of the very short lived species involved in the charge generation. We were also able to measured the life times of these species, some of which exhibited lifetime of sub-pico second to pico second. The molecules developed by us may serve as good model to help us to understand the fundamentals of these processes.

700813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
700813.value: 在相对温和的反应条件下，将碳氢化物/烷烃类化合物选择性转化为有用的化工原料，不仅对工业催化有着深远的影响，而且还可以发明基于地球上廉价易得的有机原料的化学合成新方法。鉴此，选择性碳-氢键官能化反应被广泛探索：开发新型金属催化剂/新型化学反应，用于选择性高效率地官能化碳氢化合物中相对不活泼的碳-氢键，生成新的官能团。由于碳-氢键离解能甚高，开发可用于实用型有机合成的高选择性高效率的官能化碳-氢键反应，仍是一个未解难题。在生物体系，无论是血红素型还是非血红素型酶催化剂，都可以在温和条件下用空气选择性氧化碳氢化合物，哪怕是甲烷（最难氧化的碳氢化合物）也不在话下。为解决选择性碳-氢键官能化这一难题，我们开发新型反应，将碳-氢键选择性官能化为碳-氧键或者碳-氮键，并开展仿生型金属催化的原子/官能团转移反应。该类反应经由高活性的金属-氧和金属-亚胺/氮宾中间体，研究表明，这些高活性的金属-氧和金属-亚胺/氮宾物种与碳-氢键反应一般是经过氢原子攫取或者协同性碳-氢键插入反应途径。 在设计分子金属催化剂用于氧化性碳-氢键官能化反应中，首先要清楚如何高效率地产生金属-氧和金属-亚胺/氮宾活性中间体，并将其纳入随后的与有机底物反应中去。在溶液中，这些活性中间体一般寿命较短，致使鉴定和表征它们也相当困难。设计氧化稳定的配体来稳定活泼的金属-氧和金属-亚胺/氮宾活性中间体并不降低它们的反应活性，是我们的研究兴趣所在。最为理想的仿生型金属催化的碳-氢键官能化反应是那些采用基于自然界丰度比较高的金属的催化剂的反应，铁既是本研究的首选金属之一。最近，生物无机化学的发展大大推进了人造铁(IV)-氧配合物的氧化化学，但铁(V)-氧和铁-亚胺/氮宾配合物的化学仍发展缓慢。其他非铁催化剂，例如本研究中的钌催化剂，虽然价格相对昂贵，生物适应性差，但稳定性相对较好，在溶剂中不易去金属化，这在设计新型金属催化剂用于对映选择性碳-氢官能化和用于实用性工业催化仍是一个重要标准。 本提案描述的研究主要涉及高活性金属-氧和金属-亚胺/氮宾活性中间体的氧化化学，尤其是铁和钌的氧化化学；以及这些金属活性中间体参与的碳-氢键官能化反应；探索将碳-氢键官能化反用于实现新型碳-氮键构建反应与实用性有机合成反应。本研究的重点还包括使用环保型氧化剂例如氧气和过氧化氢，和使用光子来产生高氧化性中间体。确定性的研究成果包括：阐明新型活性铁、钌的氧化物和亚胺/氮宾化合物的合成策略和反应活性；开发出新型高催化活性的铁、钌催化剂，可选择性高效率地官能化碳-氢键，用于有实际意义的有机合成反应。 本提案是基于项目主持人已成功完成的香港研究资助局资助的课题“活性金属-配体多重键配合物”和“过渡金属催化的氧化反应”的再发展。本提案的精髓部分包括：【1】设计和使用氧化稳定的螯合配体来制备和表征高活性的金属-氧和金属-亚胺/氮宾活性中间体，【2】高氧化性的d3金属铁-氧、钌-氧和铁-亚胺/氮宾、钌-亚胺/氮宾活性中间体的氧化化学，【3】新型钌-亚胺/氮宾活性中间体的合成与反应活性研究，及新型碳-氮键构建反应，【4】选择性碳-氢键氧化性官能化反应的应用研究，【5】和利用光子与空气来实现氧化性碳-氢键官能化反应。 本提案所涉及的研究将会带来重要的新发现，可用于设计新型金属催化的碳-氮键构建反应和金属催化的有合成意义的选择性碳-氢键官能化反应。虽然是基础研究，但本研究成果对发展精细化工行业所需的工业实用性反应仍具有指导意义。本研究继续是香港无机化学界、包括金属催化的原子/官能团转化/插入反应研究领域的传统卓越课题。
