716713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
716713.value: 低頻無線傳輸引起了學術界和工業界的廣泛關注。精確的近場/遠場預測對獲取最大的能量傳輸效率至關重要，特別是對於一個多輸入多輸出的多層或陣列的線圈。低頻無線傳輸因其高效而受到歡迎，當選取的頻率高時，接收端可以很小。在低頻，當感應耦合占主導，靜態場求解器可以很好的預測這類靜磁場問題。如有多個線圈很密的排列或者在高頻時，邊緣的電容耦合也能夠傳輸能量。因此，電耦合和磁場耦合在獲取電路物理現象時變得同等重要，因此動態場的求解器比純粹的靜態場求解器更可取。然而動態場求解器在低頻或者剖分很密時不夠精確。 目前的低頻求解器主要集中在散射問題或互連模型。沒有應用於真實的低頻系統的設計，低頻系統近場和遠場的精度都很關鍵，需要對其做充分的研究。 因此，我們提出一個針對低頻無線傳輸和近場多進多出的傳輸的新型適用於濾波的全波工具，並同時考慮了理論和實際，具有以下明顯特徵： 1） 第一次用有限元混合積分方程解決低頻問題。混合有限元和積分方程的零空間將會被仔細的研究。基於微擾法，我們同時獲得有限元計算近場的優勢，同時表面積分可以有效地捕獲遠場。 2） 發展一種新型的基於濾波器理論的局部預條件，這一預條件可以清晰定義可忽略和不可忽略的物理條件。求解大規模的線圈陣列或矩陣時，迭代方法不可避免的要取代直接法。一個有效的預條件可以改善矩陣的譜分佈加速收斂。發展一種新型的加速求解微擾場收斂的3維低頻分解方法。準靜態-亥姆霍茲分解將會被採用，新型基函數展開的求解方法會有效的改善求解器的性能。 3） 採用提出的方法設計一種多進多出傳輸的低頻微波輸能係統。基於濾波器理論，近場和遠場的貢獻將會同時被詳細的研究和匹配，以獲取最大傳輸效率。 本方法不同於以前的方法，具有方法性，綜合了電路、波動物理和精確的近場和遠場預測。我們的長遠目標是為功率和電磁界提供一種快速有效低頻波動求解器

716713.label: Realisation of objectives
716713.value: Objective 1: To overcome the low frequency issues in FEM solvers, we proposed the A-Phi formulation with generalized-Lorenz gauge, which is free of catastrophic breakdown in low-frequency regime. In the formulation, A and Phi are completely separated and Maxwell’s equations are reduced into two independent equations pertinent to A and Phi. This, however, leads to more complicated equations in contrast to the traditional E formulation. The numerical dicretization of the equations is challenging, especially for the equation pertinent to A. By virtue of the differential forms theory and Whitney elements, the direct action of divergence operator on A is bypassed. Thus, the equations can be discretized compatibly using regular finite element method. The condition of the resultant matrix system is much better than that of the E formulation as frequency becomes low, and even approaches to zero. The generalized-Lorenz gauged A-Phi formulation is verified to be accurate and efficient for low-frequency circuit problems during this project. We also proposed for this project the double curl equation with generalized Coulomb gauge based on the vectorial representation of the magnetic vector potential. Finally, the original equation can be rewritten in a generalized form and solved in a more natural and accurate way using finite-element method. Objective 2: To develop a low frequency FEM-E solver with perturbation method, we propose the computation of the perturbation based electric field integral equation of the form R^{n−1}, n = 0, 1, 2, . . . , and its acceleration by using fast Fourier transform (FFT) technique. As an effective solution of the low-frequency problem, the perturbation method employs the Taylor expansion of the scalar Green’s function in free space. However, multiple impedance matrices have to be solved at different frequency orders, and the computational cost becomes extremely high, especially for large-scale problems. Since the perturbed kernels still satisfy Toeplitz property on the uniform Cartesian grid, the FFT based on Lagrange interpolation can be well incorporated to accelerate the multiple matrix vector products. Because of the nonsingularity property of high-order kernels when n ≥ 1, we do not need to do any near field amendment. The efficiency of the proposed method has been validated in an iterative solver in this project. The FFT technique has also been adopted to accelerate the expanded integral equation kernels in the A-EFIE with perturbation method. It makes the perturbation method possible to efficiently solve the complicated real world problems with over one million unknowns without using a parallel computer. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method has been verified by the given numerical example. The nullspaces of the magnetic field integral equation (MFIE) operators applied to toroidal surfaces at low frequencies are also investigated. Due to the existence of global loops, MFIE operators have been proven to have nontrivial nullspaces for toroidal surfaces at the static limit. This nullspace effect is found to be trivial for both far-field radiation and current solution under the plane-wave excitation. By enforcing simple testing points, the magnetic flux due to the global loop currents can be effectively suppressed. There would be no projection of these global loop currents on the magnetostatic nullspaces. Numerical results show that the zero singular values of the system matrix have been eliminated, thus accelerating the convergence in the iterative process. Objective 3: To develop a filter-oriented localized perconditioner and improve the convergence of iterative solving system, a Calderón preconditioner is developed for the analysis of electromagnetic scattering of perfect electrically conducting (PEC) objects embedded in a layered medium. The electric field integral equation (EFIE) is formulated with the kernel of layered medium Green’s function to account for the effects from the multilayered background. The Calderón projector is derived based on the general source-field relationship and the extinction theorem for inhomogeneous environment in electromagnetic theory. The Calderón identities can be naturally deduced based on this projector, which is then leveraged to precondition the EFIE with layered kernel. An alternative implementation is then proposed to make the implementation of the preconditioner as efficient as the one in free space. Different numerical examples are designed to show the performance of the preconditioner, where the objects are located in different positions with respect to the layered medium, or different types of excitation are adopted. It is shown that the proposed effective and robust preconditioner makes the EFIE system converge rapidly in all cases, independent of the discretization density. The convergence of the electricfield integral equation (EFIE)-based matrix systems with the right hand-side effect is investigated. The role of the right-hand-side excitation in determining the convergence rate of the iterative solvers is found to be important or even crucial at low frequencies. The weighted contributions from different singular vectors are decided by not only the corresponding singular values but also the right-hand side. Based on this understanding, we investigate the low-frequency stabilized form of both EFIE and Calderón multiplicative preconditioner EFIE (CMP-EFIE) on capacitive problems. For the parallelplate capacitor excited by the delta-gap source, the singular vectors with small singular values cannot be excited, and the charge currents on the capacitive surface dominate. Thus, the stability of the EFIE-based system can be achieved at low frequencies. Detailed spectral analysis and convergent results are carried out in order to capture the physical nature of the problems. Objective 4: To design and model a MIMI WPT system based on proposed approaches, a synthesis of wideband parallel- coupled line bandpass filters with controllable non-equiripple frequency responses is proposed. Different from the traditional Chebyshev transfer function filters, the reflection lobes of the proposed non-equiripple filters can be redistributed within the operating passband. As a result, the proposed filters have a reduced sensitivity to manufacturing errors and exhibit good tolerance control for maximum in-band reflection loss. By deriving the transfer functions, a synthesis approach with a set of nonlinear equations can be established according to the specifications such as the bandwidth and predetermined reflection lobes. Without performing any post optimization in the full-wave simulation, the non-equiripple synthesized results have less sensitivity in comparison with those obtained from traditional Chebyshev transfer functions with equi-ripple frequency responses. Then we proposed a full-wave semi-analytical solution to calculate the self and mutual impedances of two coupled spiral inductors with rectangular cross sections. In low-frequency electromagnetism, the self and mutual impedance of planar spiral inductors can be obtained based on the eddy current approximation, where the displacement current is disregarded. As the frequency increases, the size of the system can be designed to be smaller. However, the displacement current becomes more important in inductively-coupled systems. By directly deriving the Maxwell’s equations without the eddy current assumption, the obtained full-wave model could be applied to both homogeneous and planarly layered media for wireless power transfer systems. Compared to the traditional methods, the newly derived impedances show a considerable discrepancy at GHz frequencies for millimeter-sized inductors, indicating the significance of the displacement current if the operating frequency of wireless power transmission reaches the GHz-range.

716713.value: The A-Phi formulation for low frequency applications including WPT has a lot of potentials discovered through this project. 716713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
716713.value: Low-Frequency Wireless-Power-Transfer (LF-WPT) needs accurate near/far-field prediction to achieve maximum energy transfer efficiency, especially for a multilayered winding matrix/array like a multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) environment. Both magnetic- and electric-couplings are equally important in capturing circuit physics, where the dynamic-field solver is always preferable to pure-static solvers. However, dynamic solvers suffer from inaccuracy problem in low-frequency/dense-discretization regime. In this project, we propose a novel filter-oriented full-dynamic methods for LF-WPT and near-field approaches to address both theoretical and practical challenges with the following distinct features: The methods proposed in this project are different from previous ones because of its generality, comprehensive circuit and wave physics, and accurate near-field and far-field predictions. It is our long-term goal to develop a fast-and-efficient low-frequency dynamic solver for both power and EM communities.

716813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
716813.value: The spectral element method in computational mechanics has dual meaning. Here, it refers to a high-order finite element method in which non-uniform nodal spacing is employed. It is different from the hierarchical element method where the enrichment of the trial function basis is achieved by hierarchical nodeless functions. Trial functions in spectral elements are nodal and they are formed as the tensor products of their one-dimensional counterparts. To suppress the growth of the condition numbers of the element matrices with the element order, non-equidistant nodes known as Chebyshev and Lobatto nodes are used. Accordingly, they lead to the Chebyshev and Lobatto elements. Spectral element method originated in computational fluid dynamics and has gained widespread acceptance in wave-related analyses of solids and structures. Typical areas of application include structural dynamics/acoustics, damage detection, seismology, medical imaging, etc. Owing to the vast amount of degrees-of-freedom needed to capture the wave effect, explicit time integration is employed. Advanced spectral elements with improved accuracy have double implications in explicit time integration. Firstly, they can deliver the same level of accuracy at a reduced number of dofs. Secondly, reducing the number of dofs in global level is very effective in lowering the highest eigen-frequency of the problem domain being modelled and thus lengthening the stable time increment of the explicit time integration. In this project, advanced spectral quadrilateral and hexahedral elements for plane, axisymmetric, solid, plate and shell analyses will be formulated. The new elements will not only deliver higher accuracy but also enable a larger time increment which is of practical significance in view of the vast numbers of degrees-of-freedom and time increments involved in explicit time integration analyses of wave-related problems. The improvement to be yielded will benefit the pertinent research communities and industries that employ the reliable and user-friendly spectral element method. 計算力學中的譜單元法具有雙重含義。本專案中的譜單元（spectral element）指的是一類基於非等距結點的高階有限元列式。有別於階譜單元（hierarchical element），譜單元採用了結點插值基函數，高維基函數可由一維基函數的張量積構成。為了減緩單元條件數隨單元階數提高而增大的趨勢，譜單元的結點通常按非等距的Chebyshev點或Lobatto點分佈，導出相應的Chebyshev單元和Lobatto單元。 譜單元法起源於計算流體力學，目前亦被廣泛應用於固體和結構的波動問題分析中，其應用范疇包括結構動力及聲學分析、損傷識別、地震波動、醫學成像等。由於捕捉波動效應需要大量的系統自由度數，時間積分多採用顯式演算法。在顯式時間積分計算中，高等譜單元對效率的提高主要體現在兩個方面。第一，能減少在同等精度要求下所需的系統自由度數；第二，系統自由度數的減少能降低系統的最高特徵頻率，從而增大顯式時間積分的穩定臨界步長。 本項目將導出適用於平面、軸對稱、三維實體和板殼分析用的高等四邊形及六面體譜單列式。新單元列式在提高精度的同時允許更大的時間積分步長，這對於大規模波動問題的顯式積分計算具有實際工程意義。

716813.label: Realisation of objectives
716813.value: Objectives 1 and 2 have been achieved by generalizing the hybrid-stabilization method. In the method, the assumed stress (or strain) is ﬁrst decomposed into the low and high order modes. In the absence of the high order modes, the low order modes contain the same lowest order uncoupled monomial terms for all stress components such that the resulting element would be identical to the pertinent reduced integrated element. The assumed contravariant high order stress modes are then selected with respect to the compatible zero energy modes of the reduced-integrated geometrically regular element. The physical assumed high order stress modes are obtained by transformation from the contravariant modes. To achieve the needed orthogonality between high and low order modes, the former ones are scaled with the reciprocal of the Jacobian determinant. Each row in the leverage matrix arising from the high order modes then plays the role of a stabilization vector which eliminates a compatible zero energy mode from the reduced-integrated element. For the plane and axisymmetric spectral elements, the number of compatible zero energy modes is two for all n>1 where denotes the element order. Hence, the computing cost of the stabilized elements is minimal compared with elements formulated by other advanced formulation such as enhanced assumed strain methods and various hybrid/mixed methods in which large numbers of assumed modes are needed in high order elements. For the hexahedral spectral element, the number of compatible zero energy modes are identified to be 3(3n+1). The afore-mentioned stabilized plane, axisymmetric and hexahedral elements have been tested. When the material is far from incompressible, the stabilized elements are often markedly more accurate than the conventional spectral elements in the displacement prediction yet they yield similar errors in the energy norm. When the material is nearly incompressible, the stabilized elements are often markedly more accurate in both the displacement prediction and energy norm than the conventional elements. The proposed elements possess good immunity to dilatational locking, see [Publication 1 & Student thesis]. Objectives 3 to 4 have been achieved by both the hybrid-stabilization and the assumed natural strain (ANS) methods. The number of compatible zero energy modes possess by the reduced-integrated degenerated-plate element is identified to be three for all n > 1. In the ANS, the optimal points for the directional derivative and, thus, the natural transverse shear strain are first identified. For Lobatto nodes, they are found to be sampling points of the n-point Gaussian Quadrature along the nodal line. The natural transverse shear strain is then interpolated at the optimal points. Using the Lobatto quadrature whose sampling points are the Lobatto nodes, the computation consuming task of the two-dimensional interpolation of the natural transverse shear strain can be avoided. The numerical examples reveal that both the stabilized and ANS elements possess good immunity against shear locking. They are also more accurate than the conventional spectral elements. The ANS elements yield the most accurate result in rotation and energy errors whilst stabilized elements produce the best deflection in most cases. The ANS elements are less susceptible to mesh distortion than the stabilized elements and the behaviour can be explained by the fact the ANS elements possess less constraints in the constraint index count for shear locking. In problems with boundary layer effect under which the field variables change abruptly, the accuracy of the two element kinds are similar to that of the conventional spectral elements when the thickness is moderate. However, the accuracy of the conventional spectral elements deteriorates considerably for smaller thickness whilst the proposed elements do not [Publication 2 & Student thesis]. Objectives 5 to 6 have been achieved by generalizing the stabilization and ANS schemes devised for the degenerated plate elements to the degenerated shell and solid-shell elements. The number of compatible zero energy modes possess by the reduced-integrated degenerated shell element is identified to be five for all n > 1. Two assumed natural strain schemes are devised. Both schemes sample the normal membrane and transverse shear natural strain components at the optimal n-point Gaussian quadrature rule along the nodal lines. The difference, however, is that the ﬁrst and second schemes sample the membrane natural shear strain at the Lobatto nodes and the two-dimensional reduced-order Gaussian quadrature points, respectively. All the other natural strain components in both schemes are obtained by one-dimensional interpolation along the nodal lines. In other words, the first scheme employs only one-dimensional interpolation whilst the second one employs also the two-dimensional interpolation scheme and, thus, is less efficient. For moderately thick-shell problems, all proposed elements show good immunity to shear and membrane lockings. In most problems, they yield similar results which are considerably more accurate than those of the conventional spectral elements. For thin-shell problems dominated by bending energy and modelled by distorted meshes, the second ANS and the stabilization schemes are close in accuracy and signiﬁcantly more accurate than the ﬁrst ANS scheme. For thin-shell problems dominated by membrane energy and exhibiting boundary effect, oscillations occur in the predictions of all the proposed elements when coarse meshes are employed. At ﬁner meshes, the oscillations disappear and the proposed elements often become more accurate than the conventional spectral elements. Whilst the ﬁrst ANS scheme is least accurate in bending-dominated thin-shell problems among the three schemes, it is essentially the most accurate one in problems dominated by membrane energy and exhibiting boundary effect. Solid-shell elements often possess two layers of node on the top and bottom surfaces of the shell whilst each node is equipped with 3 translational dofs but no rotational dofs. It is straight forward to extend the present Stab and ANS schemes for degenerated-shell elements to solid-shell elements. With the plane stress condition enforced in the elasticity matrix, Stab and ANS solid-shell elements have also been implemented and tested in this study. However, their predictions are practically identical to their C0 shell counterparts. On the other hand, solid-shell elements would possess thickness vibration modes in which the transverse separation of the two layers of nodes varies. The relevant eigen frequencies are similar to the maximum eigen frequencies in the degenerated shell elements [Publication 2, Student Thesis]. The main reason why wave-related problems were specified in Objectives 2, 4 and 6 is that locking phenomena manifest themselves as excessively stiff response of the related elements and rectification of the locking behaviours would reduce the excessive stiffness. It was hoped that the critical or maximum stable time step allowed in explicit time integrations popularly employed by the spectral element method can be lengthened. It is known that the critical time step 2/W_max, in which W_max is the maximum eigen frequency of the system, is bounded by the maximum element eigen frequency W_max. Eigen analyses of the elements indicate that the stabilization and ANS schemes can effectively lower a considerable portion of eigen frequencies but fail to lower W_max. Hence, the proposed elements cannot lengthen the critical time step [Publication 1, Publication 2 and Student Thesis].

716813.label: Major findings and research outcome
716813.value: Plane, axisymmetric, three-dimensional, degenerated-plate and degenerated-shell and solid-shell spectral elements of order n > 1 were formulated by the hybrid-stabilization method. Unlike other advanced formulations in which large numbers of assumed modes are expected in spectral elements, the stabilization approach is particularly efficient in which the number of explicitly assumed stress modes grows slowly in hexahedral elements and does not grow at quadrilateral elements with the element order. When the material is far from incompressible, the stabilized elements are often markedly more accurate than the conventional spectral elements in the displacement prediction. When the material is nearly incompressible, the stabilized elements are often markedly more accurate in energy norm. Degenerated-plate, degenerated-shell and solid-shell spectral quadrilateral elements of order n > 1 were also devised by the assumed natural strain method. In applying the method to spectral elements, the optimal directional derivative points were derived. The first assumed natural strain scheme does not require any two-dimensional interpolation and, thus, the computational advantage of the spectral element can be retained. The second assumed natural strain scheme requires two-dimensional interpolation for the natural membrane shear strain. Locking tests were conducted for all elements devised by the proposed schemes as well as the conventional spectral elements. It can be noted that the former elements show marked immunity against the pertinent locking phenomena. Wave-related problems were specified in some objectives because locking phenomena manifest themselves as excessively stiff response, which leads to high eigen frequency, and rectification of the locking behaviours would reduce the excessive stiffness. It was hoped that the critical time step allowed in explicit time integration popularly employed by the spectral element method can be lengthened. While the proposed schemes can effectively lower many eigen frequencies of the element, they fail to lower the highest element eigen frequencies. In other words, the proposed elements cannot lengthen the critical time step.

716813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
716813.value: This project dealt with linear element formulations. Extension of the proposed advanced formulation schemes to nonlinear element formulation can be pursued. Another worth investigating problem is the oscillations encountered in curved shell problems with strong boundary layer effects. While all the proposed elements possesses much better immunity to shear and membrane lockings than the conventional elements, the former elements are prone to oscillation. Advanced shell elements in prestigious commercial finite element software were also tested and oscillations also occur. The plausible dilemma is that lock-free elements are prone to oscillation. A possible solution is to develop an adaptive scheme in which the conventional elements will be employed in a region where oscillation is encountered. A criterion to judge oscillation needs to be developed. Some positive results have been gained by using this approach and if the overall effectiveness is satisfactory, a research paper will be prepared.

716813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
716813.value: The spectral finite element method often refers to the high-order finite element method in which the one-dimensional Chebyshev or Lobatto nodes are employed to generate the Lagrange two- and three- dimensional finite element models. Unlike the equi-spaced nodes, Chebyshev and Lobatto nodes are non-uniformly distributed. They are effective to reduce the condition number growth of the system matrix with the problem size and, thus, the numerical error in solving the system equation. The method was originated in computational fluid dynamics and has gained widespread acceptance in wave-related analyses in such as structural dynamics, damage detection, seismology, medical imaging, etc. While there have been numerous advanced ﬁrst and second order elements in the literature, advanced high order elements are rarely seen. In this project, advanced spectral quadrilateral and hexahedral elements for plane, axisymmetric, solid, plate and shell analyses have been formulated by stabilization and assumed natural strain methods. They possess better accuracy and immunity against various locking phenomena than the conventional spectral finite elements. The practical point of view, they can deliver the same level of accuracy at a reduced and sometimes significantly reduced number of elements or nodes.

716913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
716913.value: Taxi services play an important role in transportation systems by providing 24-hour door-to-door services. However, they contribute significantly to congestion and air pollution problems, especially when they circulate on roads searching for customers. It is thus necessary and important to properly model how taxis navigate on road networks to develop effective transport policies and management schemes to mitigate these problems. However, this issue is rarely considered in dynamic traffic assignment models. Static taxi network models consider circulation, but were developed without explicitly considering the cumulative probability of successfully finding a taxi customer when cruising along a path. They also ignore changing taxi customer demand over time. The proposed study aims to develop a dynamic traffic assignment model to address these issues. Based upon the cell transmission model, the continuum approximation approach, and the theory of macroscopic fundamental diagram, the model will consider the congestion effect and multiple classes of traffic. The properties of the model will be analyzed and illustrated. A solution method will be developed, and its computational performance will be tested and compared with the method of successive averages. It is expected that the study will introduce a new way of modeling taxi traffic that will span the existing macroscopic fundamental diagram theory, the continuum modeling approach, and the cell transmission model. The proposed model can be used as a tool for identifying critical congestion locations and polluted regions, evaluating the level of service of taxis in each district, quantifying the environmental and congestion impacts of taxis, determining the induced social cost, and evaluating the effectiveness of transportation planning policies, traffic management schemes, and taxi regulations. 出租車服務提供二十四小時門到門服務，在運輸系統中扮演着重要的角色。但出租車卻是交通擠塞及空氣污染等問題的主要成因之一，特別當出租車在道路間巡行搜尋乘客時，問題更為嚴重。要舒緩這些問題，確實有需要去正確地建造一個模擬出租車在道路間巡行規律的模型，以制定有效的運輸政策及管理計劃。雖然如此，這議題在動態交通分配模型的研究中很少被探討。靜態交通網路模型只考慮出租車在道路間的巡行行為，並沒有考慮到出租車在巡行其間成功找到乘客的累計概率。靜態交通網路模型亦沒有考慮出租車乘客需求隨着時間之轉變。此研究之目的是要建立了一個動態交通分配模型以解決上述問題。該模型會基於元胞傳輸模型、連續逼近方法及宏觀基本圖理論，以將擠塞效應及多種交通模式納入考慮。本文將分析及闡明模型的特性。本文亦會發展出一套算法，並測試其計算表現及與相繼平均法的計算表現作比較。本研究將為模擬出租車交通帶來新方法，並超越現今常用的宏觀基本圖理論、連續逼近模型及元胞傳輸模型。所提出之模型可用作辨識臨介擠塞位置及污染地區、評估每區之出租車服務水平、量化出租車所帶來的環境影響及擠塞水平、測定所導出的社會成本及評估運輸規劃政策、交通管理計劃及出租車規管之成效。

716913.label: Realisation of objectives
716913.value: To achieve objective 1, a logit model was developed to depict the local customer-search movements of vacant taxi drivers [J3]. This model was further extended to a static cell-based model [J4] to incorporate the cruising behavior of taxi driver using the concept of intervening opportunity [J1] and enhanced sequential logit model [J6]. To capture the response of taxi customers and develop a demand model for the development of a dynamic taxi model, another logit model was developed [J7] and presented at an international conference in the US [C1]. This demand model was improved to a nested logit model [J2]. A dynamic taxi model [J5] was eventually developed based on the models mentioned earlier. To achieve objective 2, the cell-based model in [J1] was analyzed, calibrated and validated using the global positioning system data of 460 Hong Kong urban taxis. Results were provided and analyzed to illustrate the properties of the model and whether they agreed with actual situations. Moreover, an analysis was performed to confirm the need for a dynamic model. For this purpose, an analysis was conducted in [J3], which reveals that the cross-district search behavior of vacant taxi drivers is strongly related to passenger demand over time and space. The drivers of vacant taxis tend to travel to high-demand districts during the mid-night period when overall demand is low, but they avoid crossing districts during high-demand peak hours. This confirms the necessity of extending the static model to a dynamic one. Moreover, [J1] shows that the taxi drivers’ local search decisions are significantly affected by the cumulative probability of successfully picking up a customer along the search route and that the drivers do not search their customers under the random walk principle [J1]. The analysis in [J3] further reveals that cross-zonal travel distance, intra-zonal circulating distance, relative passenger demand and rate of return affect the customer-search decisions of the drivers of vacant taxis and that their searching behavior varies with the time of day. These properties were captured in the dynamic taxi model [J5]. To achieve objective 3, a paper was written to propose a solution method to obtain solutions to the static cell-based model. The paper was presented at the 21st International Symposium on Transportation and Traffic Theory (ISTTT) [C2] and was published in Transportation Research Part C [J4]. The solution method was extended to solve the dynamic taxi model [J5].

716913.label: Major findings and research outcome
716913.value: The research outcomes (in forms of the modeling framework, submodels, solution method, and properties of studied problems) and major findings were published in seven journal papers [J1-J7] and were presented in two international conferences [C1-C2]. One of the journal papers was published in a prestigious transportation journal – Transportation Research Part B. Six of the journal papers were published in Science Citation Index or Social Sciences Citation Index journals. The following summarizes the major findings of the journal papers. The statistical test of [J2] shows that searching districts, traveling distance from the customer’s drop-off location to the designated taxi stand, the congestion level on the way of cruising as well as the preference for traveling towards taxi stands are found to be significant factors of the decision on whether to travel to one of the nearest taxi stands after customers are dropped off. [J2] also confirms that the queue lengths of both taxis and passengers at taxi stands, the expected customer-searching distance after leaving taxi stands, and the preference of vacant taxi drivers for staying at taxi stands significantly influence the decision on whether the drivers join the queue at the nearest taxi stand once they arrived there. The likelihood ratio tests for market segmentation analysis demonstrate the variations in preferences of taxi drivers operated in different taxi shifts and service areas. [J5] shows that a more congested system leads to a higher customer search time. [J5] also shows that shortening information update interval can effectively improve traffic mobility as measured by the average travel time of private cars and taxi customer-search efficiency as measured by the average customer waiting time, but lead to a longer computational time for solving the whole dynamic taxi assignment problem. [J7] shows that the walking time to and the waiting time at the location for hailing taxis, the extra travel time to the destination because of local circulation for finding a way from the pickup location heading to a passenger’s destination, as well as the taxi customers’ perceptions for walking to and waiting at taxi stands were found as significant factors to influence their decisions. In addition, the results of market segmentation analysis in [J7] illustrate the variations in taxi-search strategies of taxi customers in different districts and regions.

716913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
716913.value: In this research, the developed taxi model includes the modeling of the route choices of car drivers. Their route choices were modeled based on the classical dynamic user optimal principle, in which the main factor that affects their route choices is travel cost. In reality, a car driver may consider other factors such as distance and number of signalized junctions when making route choice decisions. Moreover, a car driver may not always have precise information on traffic conditions. Nevertheless, the route choice principle of car drivers in the developed model can be replaced with more sophisticated and realistic principles without encountering fundamental difficulties. This generalization is left to future studies.

716913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
716913.value: Taxi services play an important role in transportation systems by providing 24-hour door-to-door services. However, they contribute significantly to congestion and air pollution problems, especially when they circulate on roads searching for customers. It is thus necessary and important to properly model how taxis navigate on road networks to develop effective transport policies and management schemes to mitigate these problems. However, this issue is rarely considered in dynamic traffic assignment models. Static taxi network models consider circulation but were developed without explicitly considering the cumulative probability of successfully finding a taxi customer when cruising along a path. They also ignore changing taxi customer demand over time. This study aims to develop a multi-class dynamic traffic assignment model to address these issues. The model properties were analyzed and illustrated. A solution method was developed, and its computational performance was tested. The study introduces a new way of modeling taxi traffic. The developed model can be used as a tool for identifying critical congestion locations and polluted regions, evaluating the level of service of taxis in each district, quantifying the environmental and congestion impacts of taxis, determining the induced social cost, and evaluating the effectiveness of taxi policies and regulations.

717113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717113.value: Transit-oriented development (TOD) is widely regarded as a desirable urban form in reducing urban sprawl, alleviating auto-dependency and achieving sustainable growth of modern cities. Policy leaders and urban planners are often keen to invest in metro railway systems with a view to promoting compact development, enhancing low carbon travel and achieving smart urban growth. However, past research has suggested that such investment does not necessarily bring forward the intended urban outcomes. Compared to London, New York and Tokyo, Hong Kong operates a relatively new mass transit railway (MTR) system of only about three decades old. The MTR has not only impressed riders with its efficiency, cleanliness, affordability and convenience, but it is also worldly famous for being capable of accomplishing commercial profits in its operation. What makes this uniquely possible attributes much to its business philosophy, aggressive property development around railway station areas, and government policy support. The MTR is said to have changed the travel behaviour of Hong Kong people and have transformed the development pattern of the city. While there is a huge body of research literature about TODs in many western cities, there is a paucity of systematic studies that comprehensively evaluate the experiences of Hong Kong’s metro rail on urban spatial development. This research aims at providing an in-depth and rigorous evaluation of the impacts of Hong Kong’s metro system on land development along its urban rail corridor. It directly complements an earlier study completed by the Principal Investigator on the characteristics of MTR’s own real estate development projects. This study turns to explore the external influence of rail transit (and its associated urban planning strategy) on the surrounding landed properties. Based on a set of longitudinal and cross-sectional disaggregate data, this research combines quantitative modeling and expert consultations in examining the real impacts of rail transit in configuring the land use structure of old urban districts of Hong Kong. The study findings will enrich the research literature about the effects of rail transit on urban spatial structure and urban regeneration. Furthermore, the Hong Kong government has continued to build new metro lines under its “Railway Development Strategy”, and has actively sought various means of promoting urban rejuvenation and brownfield redevelopment under its “Urban Renewal Strategy”. It is timely and crucial to carry out this investigation so as to identify useful insights in informing policy making about the link between rail transit and urban redevelopment. 公交導向發展（ TOD ）被廣泛認為是減少城市擴張，減輕汽車的依賴和實現可持續發展的現代城市的理想形態。政策領導和城市規劃者往往熱衷於投資地鐵系統，以便促進緊湊發展，加強低碳出行和實現智能城市的增長。然而，過去的研究已經表明，這種投資並不必然帶來預期成果。 相比倫敦，紐約和東京，香港經營一個相對較新只有約三十年的集體運輸鐵路系統（地鐵）。地鐵給乘客留下了深刻的印象，不僅效率高，清潔，可負擔，方便，它也是世界上能夠完成商業利潤的經營運作。地鐵的經營理念，積極圍繞鐵路站區的物業發展，和政府政策的支持，都是主要的原因。港鐵也改變了香港人的出行和城市的發展格局。 雖然TOD在許多西方城市研究文獻有不少報導，但對香港的地鐵軌道和城市空間發展就缺乏系統的研究。 本研究旨在深入和嚴格的評估香港的地鐵系統在城市軌道交通走廊沿線土地開發的影響。這項研究基於對縱向和橫截面數據分解，結合量化模型與專家諮詢研究軌道交通，評估軌道交通對周邊物業和在香港舊區的土地利用結構配置的影響。 研究結果將豐富了軌道交通對城市空間結構和城市再生的研究文獻。此外，香港特區政府已根據其“鐵路發展策略” ，繼續建立新的地鐵線路，並積極在“市區重建策略”下尋求各種手段促進城市復興和棕地重建。這項調查工作，有利於提供論點，幫助在軌道交通聯繫和市區重建的政策決策。

717113.label: Realisation of objectives
717113.value: Project Objective #1 has been achieved. The PI has assembled individual project data of all new private development projects completed between May 1981 and May 2017 in the 37 rail catchment areas of the three urban metro lines. A total of 2672 new development projects were identified and categorized into commercial, office, commercial-office, mixed apartment-commercial uses, pure residential uses, industrial, hotel or serviced apartment uses and so on. Project development particulars such as GFA, building height, number of carparks and so on from their Occupation Permits in the monthly Building Digests provided by the Buildings Department have been collected. Their locations and geographical coordinates were ascertained using GeoInfoMap (www.map.gov.hk) provided by the Lands Department of the government. The relevant planning and development regulations have also been collected to support data analysis. Project Objective #2 has been achieved. Metro station catchment areas are found to exhibited distinctively diverse land use characteristics. The stations (35 are included for analysis. 2 are excluded due to single land uses.) can broadly be classified into two major clusters. The first cluster (16 stations) includes the housing districts or mixed-use areas largely dominated by residential development. The second cluster (19 stations) is more differentiated and includes the conventional office districts and employment centres with emerging commercial development. All the off-centre industrial districts constitute a sub-group in this second cluster. This analysis confirms that the land use characteristics of metro station catchments are not identical. In Hong Kong, domestic and non-domestic uses are the two typical land uses, and their varying mixes work to differentiate the defining features of these catchment areas. Please refer to the journal paper for further details. Project Objective #3 has been achieved. Please refer to the written research outputs for details. In summary, the research has found that commercial, office and business floor space were the highly preferred land uses of new private development within the metro station catchments, especially in close proximity to the traditional central business districts and spreading along the northern coast of Hong Kong Island. Residential uses and composite housing development, in contrast, were increasingly shifted to areas outside the urban metro catchments, due to market competition, land availability and government planning policy of urban decentralization and new town development. Sensitivity analysis has been carried out to evaluate how land use decisions may change in relation to proximity of the land parcel to metro station and other development variables. As expected, commercial-office uses are found to be relatively more sensitive than housing to the distance-decay effect of a metro station. Hotel/serviced apartments and industrial uses are found to be insensitive to this proximity factor. Furthermore, land use decisions are heavily mediated by planning strategies and regulatory factors. Industrial or related development was isolated and concentrated in a few off-centre industrial districts served by the metro transit under the town plans. The recent relaxation of plot ratio for hotel/serviced apartment development has affected the land use decisions of developers and investors. New development of hotel and serviced apartment projects was found to have crowded out business land uses which used to occupy station-proximate sites. Such spatial transformation reflects the dynamism of the Hong Kong’s property development industry in responding to changes in development control regulations. Although planning regulations and government spatial policies are highly instrumental to the success of integrated property development above metro stations by the MTR Corporation, this study has identified the lessons and potential pitfalls of this transit-oriented development model in Hong Kong. Please refer to the written book chapter for details. In summary, these problems relate to land shortage, rising housing unaffordability, environmental pressure of highly-dense development, privatization of public space, urban fragmentation and the demand for spatial equity. These are lessons that other cities may learn from the experiences of the Hong Kong model. In addition to the achievement of above Project Objectives and dissemination of the research findings in the written outputs, the PI has presented the preliminary findings at the Asian Planning School Association Conference in Malaysia. A Master of Urban Planning student was trained to complete her dissertation about this topic focusing on a case study area in the Western District, which is served by a new metro line but falls outside the geographical scope of this research. Furthermore, the PI has sought to expand the local, regional and international impacts of this research. The PI was invited by esteemed institutions to give presentations on this topic not only in Hong Kong but also in other mainland Chinese cities including Shenzhen, Macao, Beijing, Hangzhou and Shenyang. These institutions included the MTR Corporation (Shenzhen), the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors, the Renmin University of China, Zhejiang University and the China Society of Urban Planning. The number of participants in each of these presentations ranged between 50 and 200. Another highlight was the PI's invited presentation at the Plenary Session of a World Bank Workshop organized for the officials of the national treasury of South Africa at Johannesburg. The presentation was about explaining the effects of Hong Kong's metro development on urban growth and how to leverage real estate values arising from metro development in order to support its construction and operation. Furthermore, the PI was interviewed by an international magazine, Monocle, to talk about his views about the uniqueness of the Hong Kong's metro on urban development. The story was recorded in the June 2018 issue of the magazine. Finally, the PI has also been invited by Massey University's School of Economics & Finance to be a keynote speaker to give a presentation on this research topic at a Property Foundation launch to be held tentatively at Auckland, New Zealand in October 2018. Please refer to Section 11 of the Report for details.

717113.label: Major findings and research outcome
717113.value: The main purpose of this study is to identify and explain the characteristics of land use transformation within the metro station catchments of the first three metro lines from 1981 to 2017. This study has the following major findings. First, commercial, office and business floor space were the highly preferred land uses of new private development within the metro station catchments, especially in close proximity to the traditional central business districts and spreading along the northern coast of Hong Kong Island. Residential uses and composite housing development, in contrast, were increasingly shifted to areas outside the urban metro catchments, due to market competition, land availability and government planning policy of urban decentralization and new town development. This study estimates that our metro station catchments continued to contribute, on average, 58% of the total commercial/office floor area, but only about 10% of domestic floor space, in the city. Distance of land parcel to a metro station is identified as a highly influential factor affecting the selection between housing and business land uses. Second, land use decisions are heavily mediated by planning strategies and regulatory factors. Industrial or related development was isolated and concentrated in a few off-centre industrial districts served by the metro transit under the town plans. Public housing also monopolizes the land use around a few other stations. Hence, there is a clear land use differentiation of station catchments along the metro corridors. In terms of land use distribution, inter-station differences appear to be stronger than intra-station variations. Property market shocks arising from the Asian Financial Crisis are found to have more severely affected the development of hotel and serviced apartments relative to the other land use categories in our case study area. Finally, altering the regulatory “rules” of the property development game has led to some unexpected spatial consequences. The study confirms the theoretical expectation that business, commercial or office property development tended to occupy land with closer proximity to a metro station. Under normal circumstances, this land use can out-compete other land uses in taking up the prime spots. But, the recent relaxation of plot ratio for hotel/serviced apartment development has affected the land use decisions of developers and investors. New development of such projects was found to have crowded out the business land uses. Spatial ecology of land development in the metro station catchments is a delicate outcome of the interplay between planning and market forces.

717113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
717113.value: Vibrant cities rely on an efficient and effective transport system. Investment in rapid transit infrastructure is expected to bring spatial changes in cities. This study explores the land use characteristics and geographical distribution of new private land development within urban metro station catchments of Hong Kong’s first metro network over the past 37 years. A total of 2672 development projects, completed between May 1981 and May 2017, were found to be built within a 500m radius (walking distance) of these urban stations. Metro stations continued to attract new commercial, office and business development, especially within and near traditional CBD districts, but they gradually spread to the outer industrial areas. Housing uses were being pushed and pulled out of the urban core. Planning policies have played a strong role in influencing the land use selection of private developers, leading to a high inter-station differentiation of land use mixes. Recent relaxation of development regulations, coupled with changes in market circumstances, caused a wave of construction of new hotels and serviced apartments which tended to out-compete commercial-offices in taking up prime station-proximate locations. Therefore, the relationship between metro transit and spatial changes is more complex than it is commonly expected.

717613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717613.value: 在过去的一个世纪里，人类曾享有丰富而廉价的石油资源；然而在本世纪，能源已然成为人类面临的最重要问题。如今我们使用的能源80%以上，都是以热的形式存在或通过热转换得以实现。面对巨大的能源需求挑战，设计高导热性能的传热流体因而显得异常重要。 水和油是两个最重要的传热流体。于此，我们建议发展一项高效的技术来设计水和油，使其具有超高导热系数（高于水油混合物的Hashin-Shtrikmans边界上限）。这项技术的关键在于用纳升或纳升以下的分散液滴来替换传统纳米流体中的纳米固体颗粒；这些液滴中还包覆着更小的液滴。我们建议的技术，利用微流控技术能精确操控微量流体的优点，精准控制内部液滴与外部液滴的尺寸以及每个外部液滴所包含的内部液滴的数量；从而实现连续、一步、高精控地制造高质量的纳米流体。该项目将精准控制水基和油基的两种纳米流体的微结构，准确地建立合成参数，纳米流体微结构与其导热系数之间的相关性，以确立这项合成技术的潜能。 我们建议的这项技术也可用以水和油以外的亲水性或疏水性流体，大幅提高其热传导能力。 这个项目的成功将会改变传热流体的设计制造，赋予其可控的高导热能力，对精准合成和发展高质量纳米流体产生重大影响。项目的研究发现会促进纳米流体的创新，包括设计与剪裁其微结构，以满足特定需求的应用。同时，该项目也会产生出未来所需的革新型传热流体，从而为解决人类面临的能源与环境问题提供技术支撑。

717613.label: Realisation of objectives
717613.value: All objectives have been successfully achieved. An effective technique has been developed for engineering water and oil with ultra-high thermal conductivity. Its main feature is replacing nanometer-sized solid particles in conventional nanofluids by dispersed nano/subnano-liter droplets that contain smaller droplets inside. The technique is a microfluidic, one-step and continuous process that has exploited the microfluidics-offered capability of precisely handling small fluid volume and thus allows an accurate control of inner and outer droplet sizes as well as the number of inner droplets encapsulated in each outer droplet. The project has defined the potential of this promising synthesis technique and the two innovative high-conductive nanofluids against important targets of controlling nanofluids microstructures accurately and correlating synthesis parameters, nanofluids microstructures and their thermal conductivities reliably.

717613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
717613.value: An effective technique has been developed for engineering water and oil with ultra-high thermal conductivity. Its main feature is replacing nanometer-sized solid particles in conventional nanofluids by dispersed nano/subnano-liter droplets that contain smaller droplets inside. The technique is a microfluidic, one-step and continuous process that has exploited the microfluidics-offered capability of precisely handling small fluid volume and thus allows an accurate control of inner and outer droplet sizes as well as the number of inner droplets encapsulated in each outer droplet. The project has defined the potential of this promising synthesis technique and the two innovative high-conductive nanofluids against important targets of controlling nanofluids microstructures accurately and correlating synthesis parameters, nanofluids microstructures and their thermal conductivities reliably. The project will change the way heat-transfer fluids are engineered for a tunable, superior thermal conductivity and the way for precise synthesis and development of high-quality nanofluids. The project’s findings should also lead to the progress in both creating nanofluids by design and tailoring their microstructure to suit a desired application. The project has also offered innovative heat-transfer fluids of future and thus bears significant impacts on energy and environment.

717713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717713.value: Many medical conditions are untreatable or cannot be treated effectively using the treatments or methods currently adopted in the medical field. Tissue engineering has emerged to provide new means for treating human tissue loss or organ failure. Over the past two decades, tissue engineering has made significant advances in the regeneration of relatively simple tissues such as skin and bone. But there are no major breakthroughs in the regeneration of complex tissues such as gastrointestinal tracts. A tissue engineering strategy can be cell-, factor- or scaffold-based, and different strategies can be combined to achieve the best clinical outcome. In scaffold-based tissue engineering, the scaffold plays a crucial role in providing a microenvironment for cells and a structural framework for new tissue formation. Most scaffold fabrication techniques can only produce simple scaffolds which are not suitable for regenerating complex tissues such as gastrointestinal tracts which have a multilayered structure. Electrospinning is a very attractive method for constructing scaffolds. Through good scaffold design and by combining different electrospinning techniques, forming complex scaffolds with hierarchical structures for the regeneration of complex body tissues can be achieved. This project will investigate the use of the multi-source multi-power electrospinning approach to form complex, multilayered fibrous scaffolds which can be used for gastrointestinal tissue engineering. According to scaffold design, different layers in the multilayered scaffolds will have different architectures for fulfilling their respective function. Different types of cells will be placed into different scaffold layers, resembling the cellular arrangement in the native tissue. Different growth factors will be incorporated into fibers in different scaffold layers, and their controlled in vitro or in vivo release will stimulate the cells in different scaffold layers to proliferate and grow. This project will study the formation, structure and properties (including in vitro biological performance) of various fibrous scaffolds, from simple to complex, which will be electrospun at different stages of scaffold development, with cell- and growth factor-incorporated, multilayered fibrous scaffolds being the ultimate structure to achieve. The research will address issues (1) in science: first, the formation, structure and properties of novel scaffolds and correlations of scaffold fabrication processes and processing parameters, scaffold structures and properties; second, in vitro scaffold degradation mechanism and kinetics and in vitro release behaviour of growth factors; third, influence of growth factor on cells; and (2) in engineering and medicine: developing the technology for fabricating complex scaffolds for the regeneration of complex body tissues. 當今世界醫術發達，但仍有許多疑難雜症難以治愈，組織工程可提供一個治療人體組織缺失或器官衰竭的新途徑。在過去的二十多年中，組織工程應用於皮膚和骨頭等一些簡單人體組織的再生，取得了長足的進步。但在復雜人體組織（例如胃腸道）的再生領域，組織工程迄今仍未取得重大突破。人體組織再生可運用細胞、生長因子或組織工程支架進行，亦可將它們組合起來以取得最好的療效。以支架為基礎的組織工程中，支架具有非常重要的作用。組織工程支架可創造細胞生長所需要的微環境，並能提供組織再生所需要的起始結構支持。現今大多數的支架製備技術僅能構建簡單的支架結構，因而這些支架不能應用於具有層狀結構的複雜人體組織（如胃腸道）的再生。靜電紡絲是一種製備高性能支架的有效方法。通過對支架的精心設計，並綜合多種電紡技術，將能形成具有多層級結構的組織工程支架，以進行複雜人體組織的修復。 本項目計劃應用多源多電壓(Multi-source Multi-power)電紡技術構建有多層級結構的組織工程支架，並將其應用於人體胃腸道組織的再生。通過對組織工程支架的設計和製備，多層級結構支架的每一層均具有特定的結構從而實現其特定功能；同時，亦將不同種細胞置於多層級結構支架的特定層中，以重建與人體原始組織相同的組織結構；並將不同的生長因子負載於支架的各特定層中，利用其體外或體內緩釋，刺激細胞增殖和生長。本項目將對從簡單到復雜的組織工程支架的製備、結構和性能（包括體外的生物性能）進行研究，以成功研製出載有細胞和生長因子的多層級纖維支架作為最終目的。本項目將探討這些支架的結構和性能以及它們和製備技術和製備參數的關係，並研究支架的降解動力學和降解機理、生長因子的釋放規律、生長因子對細胞增殖和生長的影響等。本項目將開發出製備這類新型組織工程支架的技術，以促進複雜人體組織的再生。

717813.value: 关于三维物体中轴面的研究

717813.label: Project Objectives
717813.value: Representation--We go beyond the stability issue to emphasize on producing simple approximations to the medial axis surface together with the radius function of the medial spheres. Specifically, we propose two new stable and concise representations that radically reduce the size of geometric data required to approximate a medial axis surface. First, we introduce the medial mesh, which is a simplified and optimized triangle mesh surface, to approximate the medial axis surface of a 3D object. The medial mesh supports linear interpolation of medial spheres to achieve significantly more efficient shape approximation than the existing approach that relies on the union of sampled medial spheres. Computation--Efficient and robust methods will be developed for computing these two new approximate representations. To compute the medial mesh, we will develop a new mesh decimating and remeshing method that converts an initially unstable and densely sampled medial axis surface to a highly simplified and stable mesh with optimized mesh connectivity, with the simplification process guided by the difference between the reconstructed object and the original object Shape modeling--Intuitive methods will be developed for interactive 3D shape editing and deformation by leveraging the new medial axis representations. These methods will allow one to create and deform a 3D object by interactively manipulating and edit its medial axis surface, as well as the medial radius function. Furthermore, we will use the medial mesh as the basis to define an embedding space for efficient volume-preserving shape deformation. Shape analysis--We shall study the spectral properties of medial axis surfaces, which is again enabled by the availability of the new medial axis representations. Our introduce a new shape indicator based on the spectrum of an adapted Laplace operator defined on the medial axis surface equipped with a Riemannian metric to properly account for the medial ball radius function. We argue that this new shape descriptor is more efficient to compute and more powerful in distinguishing different shapes than previous spectral methods. Our initial experiments with 2D shapes have shown promising results of the new approach.

Our introduce a new shape indicator based on the spectrum of an adapted Laplace operator defined on the medial axis surface equipped with a Riemannian metric to properly account for the medial ball radius function. We argue that this new shape descriptor is more efficient to compute and more powerful in distinguishing different shapes than previous spectral methods. Our initial experiments with 2D shapes have shown promising results of the new approach.

717813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717813.value: 我们通过研究三维物体的中轴面，从而推广中轴面在自由曲面三维建模及分析中的应用。三维物体的中轴面，也称中轴，是一个包含中心内切球球心的骨架结构。这里中心内切球是指包含于物体内部并与物体边界相切于至少两个点的球体。中轴的概念由Blum于1960年提出，是一个包含了如物体的对称性、局部厚度及结构等一些有用的形状特性的本质形状表示。它在模式识别、计算机图形学、机器人技术、计算机视觉、医学图像等领域中有广泛的应用。 中轴面的不稳定性与几何表达的低效性，阻碍其在3D物体建模与分析中的应用。中轴面具有本质上的不稳定性。物体表面的微小变化，亦会引发中轴产生较大改变，甚至产生具有复杂拓扑结构的非流形中轴面，而这样的中轴面却难以使用。此外，中轴面缺乏简洁高效的几何表达。现有方法算得的中轴面，往往是以过采样而得。这使得中轴面在用于三维物体建模等应用时，显得十分低效。目前已有大量研究着力于解决中轴面的不稳定性，相较之下，有关简化中轴面几何表达的研究却较为匮乏。我们计划研究中轴面的表达、计算和应用方面的问题，以致力于解决以上提到的种种问题，进而拓展中轴面的应用。

718113.label: Realisation of objectives
718113.value: Objective 1: We derived a geometric constraint similar to the well-known epipolar constraint in stereo vision and implemented a SIFT-Flow based matching method for establishing dense correspondences between a direct image and a refracted image of a scene. We also designed and trained a semantic correspondence network for establishing dense correspondences between a direct image and a refracted image of a scene . Objective 2: We derived a closed-form solution for recovering the pose of the transparent plate used in capturing the refracted image from the correspondences, and a closed-form solution for producing a depth map from the correspondences given the pose and refractive index of the transparent plate. Given multiple refracted images of the scene, we introduced an iterative approach to estimate the refractive index of the transparent plate. Objective 3: We implemented an optimization method for generating a depth map from correspondences established between a direct image and multiple refracted images of a scene. Objective 4: We studied the possibility of recovering a depth map from multiple refracted images of a scene only, but found this being an ill-conditioned problem. We developed an iterative algorithm for optimizing the correspondences between the multiple refracted images and the unknown direct image by enforcing the geometric matching constraint. Experimental results, however, were not very promising. Objective 5: We deployed an iPad as a reference plane placed behind a transparent object, and captured an image sequence of a white line sweeping horizontally and vertically on a black background on the iPad screen. We implemented an automatic method for establishing dense correspondences between the image and the reference plane by identifying the frames at which a pixel attains a peak intensity during the sweeping of the line. Objective 6: We designed and trained a deep convolutional neural network for segmenting a transparent object from an image. We implemented a method for calibrating the poses of the reference plane from the correspondences established between the image and the uncovered part of the reference plane. Objective 7: We introduced a simple setup to alter the light paths between the reference plane and the surface of the transparent object by filling the space with water. We implemented a method for recovering such light paths in air and water, respectively, from the correspondences established between the image and the reference plane under 2 distinct poses. We then recovered the surface (reference plane facing side) of the transparent object through light path triangulation.

718113.label: Major findings and research outcome
718113.value: We introduce a method for depth acquisition based on refraction of light. A scene is captured directly by a camera and by placing a transparent medium between the scene and the camera. A depth map of the scene is then recovered from the displacements of scene points in the images. Unlike other existing methods, our method does not require prior knowledge of the pose and refractive index of the transparent medium, but instead recovers them directly from the images. By analyzing the displacements of scene points in the images, we derive closed-form solutions for recovering the pose of the transparent medium and develop an iterative method for estimating the refractive index of the medium. This work was published in the paper "Depth from Refraction Using a Transparent Medium with Unknown Pose and Refractive Index" in IJCV. Besides, we develop a semantic correspondence network for establishing dense correspondences between images. This work was published in the paper "SCNet: Learning Semantic Correspondence" in ICCV. We introduce a fixed viewpoint approach to dense surface reconstruction of transparent objects based on refraction of light. We present a simple setup that allows us to alter the incident light paths before light rays enter the object by immersing the object partially in a liquid, and develop a method for recovering the object surface through reconstructing and triangulating such incident light paths. Our proposed approach does not need to model the complex interactions of light as it travels through the object, neither does it assume any parametric form for the object shape nor the exact number of refractions and reflections taken place along the light paths. It can therefore handle transparent objects with a relatively complex shape and structure, with unknown and inhomogeneous refractive index. We also show that for thin transparent objects, our proposed acquisition setup can be further simplified by adopting a single refraction approximation. This work was published in the paper "Dense Reconstruction of Transparent Objects by Altering Incident Light Paths Through Refraction" in IJCV and in the paper "A Fixed Viewpoint Approach for Dense Reconstruction of Transparent Objects" in CVPR. Besides, we develop a transparent object matting network for segmenting a transparent object from an image. This work has been accepted for publication in CVPR in 2018.

718113.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
718113.value: The method developed for recovering the pose of a transparent parallel-planar-plate from the displacements of scene points may be exploited for estimating a normal map of a thin transparent surface. It may be possible to approximate a local patch of the thin transparent surface as a parallel-planar-plate. This implies that the pose of such a patch, and hence the surface normal, may be inferred from the displacements of the scene points observed in the patch. However, estimating the poses of local patches independently cannot take full advantage of the information embedded in the neighboring patches. Further investigation may be needed to design an algorithm for estimating a normal map of a thin transparent surface from the displacements of scene points.

718113.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
718113.value: In this project, we first develop a depth from refraction method using a transparent parallel-planar-plate. By simply putting a transparent plate between a camera and a scene, and analyzing the displacements of scene points in the images, our proposed method can estimate both the pose and refractive index of the transparent plate, as well as a depth map of the scene. Unlike other existing methods, our method does not require prior knowledge of the pose and refractive index of the transparent medium, but instead can recover them directly from the input images, making our approach more flexible. Next, we develop a method for shape recovery of transparent objects. By observing a reference pattern placed at 2 distinct poses behind a transparent object under air and liquid, respectively, our proposed method can reconstruct two incident light paths for each surface point from which we can recover the surface point through triangulation. Our approach does not need to model the complex interactions of light as it travels through the object, and can handle transparent objects with a relatively complex shape and structure.

718213.label: Project Objectives
718213.value: To derive highly compact projector matrices for high-order Volterra transfer functions to produce slim yet accurate nonlinear ROMs; To efficiently compute the PSS trajectories in nonlinear circuits through a totally analytic and deterministic autonomous reformulation; To embed the above algorithms with stochastic spectral methods for fast process variational analysis from device to system levels. Long-Term Impact: The long-term impact of this project is ensured by the growing importance, alongside with emerging difficulties, in designing analog/RF blocks under the intensifying nonlinearities and process uncertainties. The success of the above goals and their streamlined integration will lead to an advanced analog/RF toolkit permitting speedy transient and steady-state simulations, as well as robust designs taking into account process uncertainties. The project can also provide students and research assistants with the necessary knowledge to contribute to the EDA industry and academia. Research components of this project can be readily combined with university graduate trainings and courses.

718213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
718213.value: 現代混合信號芯片設計對關鍵非線性部件（包括模擬和射頻(RF)模塊）的高效仿真有著迫切的需求。與對線性部件的仿真相比，非線性建模和仿真問題更加復雜和具有挑戰性。例如在模擬/射頻仿真中，傳統的瞬態和穩態SPICE仿真通常需要數量極大的採樣點來模擬劇烈的輸入信號變化。非線性模型降階（NMOR）技術，盡管可以大大提高瞬態分析的速度，通常需要特設的輸入訓練或最終生成過大的降階模型。對於在許多周期性激勵的非線性電路中需要的周期性穩態(PSS)分析來說，最常用的PSS方法通常是迭代性，數值性的，並依賴於一些特殊策略和初始條件。此外，在納米芯片的制造中，器件層面的工藝偏差往往會傳播到更高的層面。模擬這些工藝偏差在系統層面NMOR和PSS分析中的影響需要大量基於傳統蒙地卡羅分析的隨機仿真，從而使整體計算量很快到達一個無法接受的程度。因此，對高效NMOR, PSS和工藝偏差分析算法的研究是電子設計自動化(EDA)中的重要課題。 本項目的目的在於提出創新的，並有高效計算機實現的解析方法來解決以上問題。關鍵是以一個新的角度在時域和頻域中利用非線性Volterra理論。簡單而言，在NMOR中，我們把高階傳輸函數中的頻率變量“集中”到一起，從而把NMOR幾乎簡化成如同線性MOR一樣容易。而在PSS中，我們把周期性時域激勵“集中”成非線性系統的一部分，使整個系統變成自主的（自我運行）的系統，從而使優雅的確定性的矩陣方程可以用於求解系統穩態。這種方法的優點是很明顯的：它具有解析的理論和閉合的公式，因此可以不再需要初始條件。這些新的解析算法接下來會被自下而上地整合到變量化分析的譜方法中。具體的項目目標如下：1）建立高度精簡但准確的非線性降階模型；2）以完全解析和建設性，無需初始條件的方法來求解非線性電路的穩態問題；3）發展對從器件到系統隨機變化量傳遞的量化方法。在每一個目標下發展的方法都會以工業例子做驗証。 本項目的成果可以直接嵌入現有的EDA工具，用以對非線性模擬/射頻模塊進行快速的變化感知的建模和仿真，從而縮短混合信號芯片進入市場的時間。研究中產生的新的解析認識以及實現方法會對其他研究者和實踐者有幫助。本項目同時也會鞏固香港和美國兩個活躍的EDA研究組的長期合作關系，並培養能對EDA領域有貢獻的學生和工作者。

718213.label: Realisation of objectives
718213.value: Objective #1: To derive highly compact projector matrices for high-order Volterra transfer functions to produce slim yet accurate nonlinear ROMs This objective has been FULLY ACHIEVED. Our team is among the first in the literature to employ the associated transform (namely, analytically unifying the multi-frequency variables in the multivariate Laplace transform of nonlinear Volterra transfer functions), thereby resulting in projector subspace computation of nonlinear systems with similar ease as in the linear scenario. Objective #2: To efficiently compute the PSS trajectories in nonlinear circuits through a totally analytic and deterministic autonomous reformulation This objective has been FULLY ACHIEVED. This goal has been elegantly achieved by an innovative means of reformulating the periodic steady-state (PSS) problem as a system of polynomial equations. The polynomial equations are subsequently solved by a newly proposed linear algebraic Macaulay-matrix-based solver that finds roots of polynomial equations numerically. Compared to traditional ways of polynomial equation solution based on computational geometry (via the so-called Groebner basis), our proposed linear algebraic root finder enjoys much more robust numerical accuracy and much better scalability. Objective #3: To embed the above algorithms with stochastic spectral methods for fast process variational analysis from device to system levels. This objective has been FULLY ACHIEVED. A major breakthrough in this regard is the PI’s discovery of tensor arithmetic and its use in multi-dimensional modeling which captures parametric variations neatly. Specifically, the tensor representation is the natural generalization of scalar (0-d), vector (1-d), matrix (2-d) formats to their n-d (n>2) counterparts. By turning to tensor-based algorithms (which is catching a lot of attention in the signal processing and computational algebra research communities), the PI’s & Co-I’s teams have found that many nonlinear circuit models can be compactly modeled, and their corresponding simulation complexity and memory storage largely reduced. This translates into a new paradigm for nonlinear circuit modeling and simulation. In fact, the PI and Co-I appear to be the pioneering team to promote tensors in electronic design automation (EDA). Objective #4: The long-term impact of this project is ensured by the growing importance, alongside with emerging difficulties, in designing analog/RF blocks under the intensifying nonlinearities and process uncertainties. The success of the above goals and their streamlined integration will lead to an advanced analog/RF toolkit permitting speedy transient and steady-state simulations, as well as robust designs taking into account process uncertainties. The project can also provide students and research assistants with the necessary knowledge to contribute to the EDA industry and academia. Research components of this project can be readily combined with university graduate trainings and courses. This objective has been FULLY ACHIEVED since it is the direct integration of the results from the previous three objectives.

718213.label: Major findings and research outcome
718213.value: -- Top-tier journal papers and conference papers stemming from this project have been published, addressing the objectives stated above (cf. Part C of this completion report). -- Several students (MPhil & PhD) have been trained. All of them have ended up working in EDA-related fields. -- When realizing the project according to the objectives and research plans, the PI and Co-I have found the huge benefits of tensor arithmetic in capturing nonlinearities and multi-dimensional data structures, as well as their efficient processing. In other words, a powerful tool has been found that effectively tackles the long-standing, difficult & challenging topic of nonlinear circuit modeling and simulation. -- A series of tensor-based EDA algorithms and design procedures are in the pipeline of publication.

718213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
718213.value: As noted above, a significant finding by the PI and Co-I is the huge power of utilizing tensor arithmetic in electronic design automation (EDA) algorithms. In fact, simply by re-expressing the data structure in existing EDA algorithms (e.g., model reduction, system identification, transient and periodic simulation) into their tensor structures, remarkable efficiency can be already be gained due to the more natural way of handling multi-dimensional data (versus the “flattened” matrix structure in most developed algorithms and computer codes). Such findings have directly led to the successful granting of the following GRF project: "Novel Tensor-Based Circuit Modeling and Simulation" GRF Code: 17212315 (Project Period: 01 Jan 2016 - 31 Dec 2017 (24 months)) Research efforts are now being made along the direction of tensor-based EDA.

718213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
718213.value: Modern mixed-signal chip design have brought about heavy needs for efficient modeling and simulation algorithms for nonlinear circuits. In particular, numerically robust and efficient schemes are required for simulating the transient and periodic steady-state behaviors of critical analog and radio-frequency (RF) blocks in integrated circuits. Meanwhile, as the device feature sizes continue to scale down, statistical circuit simulators have become increasingly important for quickly quantifying the performance variations induced by device-level uncertainties. This project has been successfully completed with the development of various fast and effective nonlinear circuit modeling and simulation algorithms addressing all the aforementioned needs. New research ideas and directions have spun off from this project. In particular, the PI and Co-I have pioneered the novel use of tensor arithmetic in electronic design automation (EDA), both at the theoretical and implementation levels. The huge potential of tensor-based EDA algorithms has warranted a sustainable and promising research topic, and has resulted in the successful granting of a subsequent GRF project. The routines and algorithms derived from this project are also readily welcome by the industry.
