789713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
789713.value: The cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) is an anion channel located in the apical membrane of epithelial cells. CFTR conducts chloride and bicarbonate ions for regulating epithelial pH homeostasis, salt movement and fluid absorption and secretion. CFTR also acts as a regulator to modulate the activity of other proteins. It is well-known that dysfunction of CFTR by genetic mutations causes a lethal disease, cystic fibrosis (CF). In addition, other epithelial diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and cholera toxin-induced severe diarrhea are also associated with abnormal CFTR activity. Therefore, investigating how epithelial cells control CFTR activity is very important for understanding the pathogenesis of these diseases and for developing new treatments for the patients. CFTR is activated by cAMP-dependent PKA phosphorylation on the regulatory domain (R domain). Because the R domain is a large peptide of over 200 residues with 10 PKA phosphorylation sites and no prominent secondary structures, it is very difficult to study how phosphorylation causes CFTR activation. Early studies have found that some phosphorylation sites are inhibitory and some stimulatory to CFTR activities, possibly due to conformational changes inside the R domain or multiple interactions between the R domain and other regions of CFTR. Without a systematic examination on the function of different R domain regions, these studies have a limitation in constructing a CFTR activation model by phosphorylation. By using mutants with deletions or alanine replacements, we have performed a systematic screening on the function of the different R domain regions. Our data have identified two small inhibitory regions and one stimulatory region in the middle and C-terminus of the R domain. In this proposal, we want to further identify the specific residues in these regions and also explore the possible specific residues in the N-terminus of the R domain. Moreover, we will investigate how phosphorylation on these specific regions initiates CFTR activation. Finally, we will examine whether these specific regions play a role in the CFTR inhibition by AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK). Our study will elucidate the molecular mechanisms of CFTR activation by phosphorylation on the R domain. Our findings may lead to the development of new treatments for modulating CFTR activity in patients with CF or CFTR-associated diseases. 囊性纖維化跨膜傳導調節蛋白（cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator, CFTR ）是一種位於上皮細胞頂膜的陰離子通道。 CFTR藉由運輸氯離子和碳酸氫根離子來調節上皮的pH值平衡，鹽分傳送和水分吸收和分泌。 CFTR也是一個調節者，影響其它蛋白質的活性。CFTR的功能因突變而缺失會導致廣為所知的的致死性疾病，囊性纖維化（cystic fibrosis, CF）。此外，其他的上皮細胞疾病，如慢性阻塞性肺疾病（chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, COPD）和霍亂毒素引起的嚴重腹瀉同時與異常的CFTR活性有關。因此，為了解這些疾病的發病機制及開發新的方法去治療這些疾病的患者，研究如何控制上皮細胞CFTR的活性是非常重要的。 CFTR的活化是經由cAMP激活的蛋白激酶A (PKA) 在R domain 造成磷酸化而產生。由於R domain很大超過200個氨基酸殘基且有10 個PKA磷酸化位點，加上沒有特別的二級結構，想要研究磷酸化導致CFTR激活是很困難的。早期研究發現，一些磷酸化位點是具有抑制或興奮CFTR的活性，其可能是由於R domain內部的結構產生變化或與其他CFTR結構域產生相互作用。由於沒有詳細研究R domain不同地區的功能，這些早期研究對了解CFTR因磷酸化而激活的機制有所受限。 藉由缺失突變和丙氨酸替代突變，我們已經對不同R domain區域的功能進行了系統的研究。我們的結果已經確認了兩個抑制區域在R domain的中間和一個興奮區域在R domain的C末端。因此在這個研究計畫中，我們要進一步確定個別的作用點在以上已知區域中及其他可能的R domain區域如N末端。此外，我們將探討磷酸化如何在這些特定區域控制CFTR活化。最後，我們將研究這些特定區域是否與AMP激活蛋白激酶（AMP-activated protein kinase, AMPK ）產生抑制CFTR的作用有關。我們預期研究結果可用以闡明CFTR被R domain磷酸化而激活的分子機制。我們研究結果也可能對發展新的治療方法用於CF病患或與CFTR相關疾病的患者有所助益。

789913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
789913.value: Corals are in the midst of a global decline, resulting from anthropogenic perturbation of climate, nutrient cycles, and fisheries. Future projections for increasing sea surface temperatures alone yield dire predictions for the future of corals and the ecosystem services they provide to both developed and developing nations. Despite this prognosis, some reefs may be resilient to climate change if other localized anthropogenic stressors are reduced. Nutrient pollution, in the form of nitrogen-rich agricultural and urban effluents is one such stressor that has been linked to reef decline. The historic paradigm is that nutrients induce shifts in predominantly autotrophic coral communities to an alternative ecosystem state favoring benthic and suspended algal blooms. This eutrophication reduces light availability and increases competitive interactions between corals and suspension feeders while promoting bioerosion of the reef structure. Moreover, recent modeling efforts have identified that corals exposed to chronic nitrogen pollution have a higher susceptibility to coral bleaching during high temperature or light stress. This finding suggests a compelling synergy between global climate change and regional water quality management. However, the spatial and temporal scale over which nutrient pollution has impacted many reefs around the world is unknown, and there is a lack of data distinguishing anthropogenic from natural nutrient sources. The inability to identify major anthropogenic nitrogen inputs from point and non-point sources hinders effective policymaking and environmental management. Stable isotope analysis of corals and other benthic organisms has become an important tool for quantifying major nitrogen sources and monitoring their change through time. However, this method has not yet been applied to the study of coral communities around Hong Kong. Indeed, Hong Kong represents a unique system for the study of nitrogen impacts on coral community health as these habitats are exposed to high nitrogen concentrations from a myriad of sources over a strong environmental gradient exerted by the Pearl River. This gradient decreases to the Northeast where coral cover remains remarkably high. Which nitrogen sources are the most pervasive in these ecosystems? How do these sources vary over time? How do they affect coral health? How does nitrogen pollution shape benthic biodiversity? This proposal seeks funding to conduct a stable isotope and biodiversity survey of Hong Kong’s coral communities to 1) determine which coral species are best suited for monitoring efforts, 2) identify important sources of anthropogenic nitrogen and their effect on coral health, and 3) relate anthropogenic nitrogen pollution to benthic biodiversity. 因為人為因素造成干擾的氣候, 養分循環和漁業, 珊瑚正處於一個全球性的衰退之中 未來預測單是海洋表面溫度增加，對珊瑚及生態系統為發達國家及發展中國家提供的作用已造成極為嚴重之威脅 儘管有如此之預測，如果本地化人為因素造成對環境之壓力能夠減少， 一部份極具有彈性的礁石, 是有可能適應氣候變化之特質 富含氮的農業和城市污水的造成的營養污染,就是其中一個牽連到珊瑚礁衰退減少之因素 。歷史悠久的範式就展示了從作為主導自養珊瑚社羣,轉變為一個有利於底棲生物和暫停藻類大量繁殖的替代社區生態系統. 此富營養化減少光的可用性, 不僅增加珊瑚和懸掛進食者之間的競爭性. 並且同時促進生物侵蝕珊瑚礁之結構. 此外, 最近的建模工作已經確定暴露於慢性氮污染之珊瑚, 相比於受到高溫及少光吸收造成的珊瑚漂白化之珊瑚羣,有相對更高的敏感性. 這一發現表明一個引人注目的在全球氣候變化及區域水質管理之間的協同作用. 然而, 對已經影響了世界各地許多的珊瑚礁的營養物污染在時空尺度及暫存之等級範圍方面仍然未知, 加上缺乏所需用作分辨人為或自然營養來源的數據. 因無法識別人為從源點和非點源之氮輸入, 而阻礙有效地實施相對政策和環境管理。 正因如此，針對珊瑚和其他底棲生物的穩定同位素分析,成為一個作為主要氮源定量化, 及監測其通過時間的變化的一個重要工具. 然而，這種方法尚未被香港的珊瑚群落研究中 應用到. 事實上, 由於香港的珊瑚社區暴露於由珠江投入高傾斜度之無數 高濃度的氮來源, 香港為一個獨特系統研究對象. 在東北, 這下降投入傾斜度令到珊瑚覆蓋率仍然非常高, 到底那種氮源是最普遍地影響到這些生態環境系統？

789913.label: Realisation of objectives
789913.value: The ECS funding supported a series of field research expeditions and more than 120 SCUBA dives were conducted to collect samples of corals and potential sources of nitrogen pollution across Hong Kong. 4 field cruises were undertaken (Nov. 2013, March 2014, July 2014, and Nov. 2014). During each cruise, hundreds of samples of corals were collected in total, from ~40 sites across Hong Kong, from as far west as Lamma Island, and to the north western portions of Mirs Bay (Kat O). In the laboratory, coral samples were separated into coral and algal fractions and analyzed using stable isotope ratio mass spectrometry (IRMS). In addition to corals, samples of seawater and particulate organic matter therein were obtained where possible. Filtered water samples were screened for Enterococcus concentration (a proxy for sewage pollution), and nutrient concentrations measured using flow injection analysis. Nitrogen source information was gained through the analysis of δ15N using the denitrifier method in collaboration with Prof. SJ Kao at Xiamen University. This method has also been applied to samples of wastewater effluents and precipitation in order to identify major sources of nitrogen to the coastal marine environment. At the conclusion of the project, all objectives were completed. The findings have been disseminated in at least 6 publications and 8 international conference presentations and trained to date 1 MPhil student and 1 undergraduate student. Notably, Mr. Cheong Wai Martin WONG was the recipient of the HKU Outstanding Postgraduate Student award, one of ten given annually for his work on this project. Mr. Arthur CHUNG will continue his studies as a postgraduate student at HKU. Partial staffing funding was used to support and train a postdoc (Dr. Nicolas DUPREY) and several research postgraduate students. The data generated from the studies have been shared with relevant government officials, notably in AFCD and EPD and garnered their support for future research in aid of policy within the HKSAR.

789913.label: Major findings and research outcome
789913.value: Pollution indicators in Hong Kong - The δ15N values of corals and their symbionts are indicative of widespread sewage pollution in Hong Kong. All recorded values are >4‰, and maximum values exceed 12‰, which are equivalent to the δ15N of human-derived N (Fig. 1). The human signal increases along a gradient from southern to north-eastern waters suggesting an important dynamic between human-derived nitrogen inputs from urban areas, water retention time and natural denitrification and tidal flushing with the South China Sea. We determined the seasonality of this pattern driven by N discharges from the Pearl River which increase in the summer monsoon. (Wong. et al. 2017, Env. Sci. Tech.). Nitrogen sources - The source of such enriched nitrogen is clearly sewage, which in all treatment types sampled in Hong Kong (including preliminary, primary, secondary, tertiary, and CEPT) exhibit the production of a high δ15N effluent. All wastewater samples were characterized by very high ammonium and nitrate concentrations, as well as high δ15N values. δ15N increased predictably with treatment type, with tertiary treatment (only measured from Ngong Ping, had very high values. We can therefore conclude that the high δ15N values of coral tissues in Hong Kong is caused by the abundance of enriched, sewage-derived nitrogen in nearly all coastal habitats. (Archana et al. 2016, Mar. Poll. Bull) Pollution and Biodiversity - Using specimens collected through this project, we were able to report on the first survey of coral-hosted Symbiodinium biodiversity in Hong Kong. The results revealed that within the SAR, three major sub-clades of Symbiodinium are present with some unique clades specific to only a single host species. We also obtained data from government sources to test the hypothesis that water quality has a strong influence on coral species richness. Datasets on coral biodiversity (AFCD) and water quality (EPD) were entered into a geographic information system (GIS) to examine spatial patterns of several co-varying factors, and to assess the strength of bivariate associations (Fig. 3). These data illustrate that coral species richness is strongly negatively correlated with chlorophyll a (a measure of productivity) which is driven by nutrients including total inorganic nitrogen and phosphorus sources. These results also identify several coral biodiversity hotspots in Sai Kung, Port Island, and Crescent Island, which may represent future areas for additional conservation measures. (Duprey et al. 2016 Global Change Biology; Wong et al. 2016 Reg. Studies Mar. Sci.)

789913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
789913.value: Collectively, this research has revealed that anthropogenic nutrient pollution is widespread in Hong Kong, and that areas with relatively better water quality host a surprising diversity of corals - foundational species for other marine life. Moreover, we have shown that reintroduction of corals to areas where they have been historically extirpated has a high chance of success as water quality has greatly improved since the 1990s. Future efforts should be invested in understanding the relationship between water quality - foundational species richness - and associated biodiversity therein. To that end, in 2017 our group was awarded $3.2M HKD from the Environment and Conservation Fund to launch MarineGEO-Hong Kong. This project is utilizing Autonomous Reef Monitoring Structures for biodiversity assessments starting in Tolo and expanding to most of Hong Kong’s SAR. The results of the ECS provides a strong foundation for our understanding of water quality and sewage pollution with which we will link to these modern biodiversity assessments. MarineGEO - Hong Kong is a legacy project and will require long-term funding. We will continue to apply for RGC’s CRF while seeking a private donor for this ongoing research.

789913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
789913.value: Coral reefs are sensitive to nutrient pollution, especially the nitrogen and phosphorus which is abundant in human sewage. Therefore, Hong Kong’s dense urban population generates a major stressor on local coral communities through the discharge of wastewater. Our research has shown that sewage pollution is widespread, and that local sources of pollution are relatively more abundant than those discharged from the mainland via the Pearl River. Although the nutrients in sewage can be used by corals to grow, too much pollution destabilizes their symbiosis and reduces biodiversity. This process eliminates sensitive species such as staghorn corals which show a very strong reliance on their symbionts for nutrition. Moreover, these corals are key habitat forming species for other marine life. Yet, there is cause for hope as reintroductions of staghorn corals to Tolo Channel (an area lacking species-rich coral communities) was very successful. This suggests that active ecosystem management and restoration coupled with Hong Kong’s commitment to improving marine water quality through advancements in municipal wastewater treatment is timely and effective.

790213.label: Project Title(Chinese)
790213.value: 住房狀況對勞動力市場結果的影響

790213.label: Project Objectives
790213.value: To analyze the effect of home ownership and housing tenure on labor market outcomes.
rows: To analyze the effect of home ownership and housing tenure on labor market outcomes.

790213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
790213.value: In the past, urban planning has often favored strict zoning, segregating residential areas from commercial-industrial areas. One unanticipated negative consequence of this strategy is a possible link between unemployment and home ownership, suggested by Oswald in an important and controversial 1997 paper. He believes that home ownership reduces labor mobility, thereby creating disequilibrium and unemployment in regional labor markets if wages are not very flexible and the government fails to redirect labor demand across localities. Compared with European countries and the United States-- the foci of most empirical studies on the topic-- Hong Kong is decidedly more compact. Much of the city is covered by a rather efficient transportation system, making it an unlikely setting in which to test the Oswald hypothesis. However, over the years, a combination of factors, including escalating property prices in the congested urban core and restrictive zoning, have led to the development of new satellite towns in outlying areas, with subsequent negative impacts on the worker mobility. The situation is exacerbated by the structure of the public housing system that currently accommodates almost half of the population in Hong Kong. Program requirements for public rental units effectively prohibit households from changing their assigned units, while restrictive conditions on the resale of subsidized public sector “Home Ownership Scheme” units cripple the secondary market for such properties. These barriers mean that residents in the public housing system face more severe limits on their access to economic and employment opportunities than those living in private housing. Indeed, in recent years, there has been no shortage of media coverage on the economic hardship and social deprivation within the walls of large public housing estates in outlying towns where job opportunities are scarce. Despite these problems, the impact of residential choices on the regional and overall labor markets has seldom been rigorously analyzed in Hong Kong. We intend to fill this gap in the proposed study. Using General Household Survey and Census data, we will estimate the effect of public housing tenure on the unemployment and labor force participation behavior of workers compared to tenants in the private market, controlling for individual characteristics and macroeconomic conditions. In addition to contributing to the expanding literature on the Oswald controversy, our findings can have important implications for a coherent long-term development strategy for housing, transportation and labor resources in Hong Kong. 在過去，城市規劃傾向把土地嚴格分區: 即住宅與商業-工業區分隔。在1997年奧斯瓦爾德(Oswald)發表一個重要而富爭議的論文，這分區策略導致失業與置業之間可能存在一個意想不到的負面效果。他認為若工資不靈活，而政府未能在各地之間的勞動力需求從中引導，自置居所會減少勞動力的流動性，從而引致了區域勞動力市場的不平衡和失業增加。 針對這個問題的實證研究，焦點一般都在歐美國家。相對於這些國家，香港社區及人口無疑集中得多。香港的大部分地區覆蓋了一個相當高效的運輸系統，因此，香港表面上並不適合測試奧斯瓦爾德(Oswald)的假說。然而，多年來，各種因素的組合，包括在擁擠的城市核心區樓價不斷攀升和限制性分區措施，導致新的衛星城市要建設在邊遠地區，這發展隨後對工人的流動性造成負面影響。目前香港幾乎有一半人口住在公共住房裡，這情況導致勞動力的流動性進一步惡化。租住公屋單位的住戶無法改變他們分配的單位；而資助出售的“居者有其屋計劃”單位的業主因轉售限制削弱了這些物業在第二市場中轉售。這些障礙意味著在公共房屋制度的住戶較私人樓宇的住戶面臨更為嚴峻的限制，他們的經濟和就業的機會都會比那些居住在私人房屋的居民差。事實上，近年不少的媒體都會報導住在邊遠新市鎮的大型公共屋邨的居民正處於經濟困難、社會隔離以及就業機會稀少的的圍城中。 儘管這些問題在香港一直存在，住房選擇對區域與整體勞動力市場影響的課題卻很少被嚴格地分析。建議中的研究項目將填補這一空白。我們會利用綜合住戶統計調查和普查數據，在控制了個人特徵和宏觀經濟情況下，評估公共房屋不同使用權相對於私人樓宇租戶對勞工的失業與勞動參與行為的影響。除了有助於增加奧斯瓦爾德(Oswald)爭議的文獻外，研究結果的重要意義是有助香港構思一個房屋、交通和勞動力資源具連貫性的長遠發展策略。

790213.label: Realisation of objectives
790213.value: In this project, we use an empirical model to estimate the impact of housing status on labor market outcomes. Regressing labor force participation and unemployment on housing status, individual characteristics and social and macroeconomic variables, we try to identify whether tenants in public rental housing estates fare worse than their counterparts in private housing because of their increased geographic immobility. A negative coefficient on the public housing variable would confirm the hypothesis. The primary problem in this estimation exercise is the potential endogeneity of housing status. In the literature, this is sometimes addressed by the use of instrumental variables, or by full-information simultaneous estimation of housing choices and unemployment duration, taking into account the non-independence between them. Due to limitations of data in Hong Kong, neither approach can be used. Instead, we take advantage of the fact that since 1976, the Hong Kong Census has included information on whether a household has moved in the past five years. Because of immobility of tenants within the public housing system, the housing status is likely to be exogenous to current labor market decisions for those who have not moved. This obviates any need for instruments for housing status, and the housing status effect can be identified by a simple OLS or limited dependent variable model. Our results provide the first quantitative measure of the negative impact of public housing on the labor market performance in Hong Kong. As a robustness test, we also estimate the model using General Household Survey data.

790213.label: Major findings and research outcome
790213.value: Using Hong Kong Census (1976-2011) data and focusing on prime-aged male workers who were household heads or their spouses, we find that male renters in the public housing system do tend to participate significantly less in the labor force compared to private renters, which is consistent with the suggestion that public housing tenancy reduces mobility and discourages labor force participation. The difference of almost 3 percentage points is certainly non-trivial. If we consider the subsample of individuals who had not moved in five years and for whom housing status is more likely to be independent of their employment decisions, public renters have an even lower rate of labor force participation compared to private renters (by 3.27 percentage points). Nevertheless, the small difference in the estimates suggests that there are no structural differences between the recent movers and stayers, as the decision to move is probably dictated more by other factors (such as affordability of housing) than proximity to the work place. Similar results are found in our analysis of unemployment behavior. Regardless of whether the individual had moved in the past five years, public renters consistently show higher unemployment rate than private renters. After controlling for other observable characteristics, public renters have a 1.2 percentage point higher unemployment rate. Considering that the average unemployment rate in the data is 3.5 percent, the magnitude of this effect is substantial. This is also qualitatively consistent with the findings of most empirical studies that analyzed the impact of public housing on unemployment in the literature. As a robustness test, we also repeat the analysis using General Household Survey (GHS) data. Although GHS does not contain any information on recent moves so that we cannot control for potential endogeneity of housing decisions, the estimated impacts of public rental status on labor market performance are quite similar: public renters have a 2.38 percent lower participation rate than private renters in the GHS data set, compared to 2.81 percent in the census data. By comparison, the unemployment effect is even stronger than before, with the public renters showing a 2.41 percent higher unemployment rate, almost doubling the earlier estimate. The findings of this research have been reported in a number of conferences, and a paper summarizing the results is now under review at the Journal of Urban Economics.

790213.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
790213.value: As is often the case with empirical research, the primary constraint in this project is the availability and quality of data. Even though we believe the potential endogeneity of housing status can be adequately addressed by considering only those who had not moved within five years of the census, the lack of appropriate instruments in public surveys and the absence of broad-based panel data in Hong Kong mean that it is difficult to completely control for unobservable characteristics. Therefore, until richer data sets become available, we doubt that this line of research can be pursued much further in the empirical context of Hong Kong. Nevertheless, in our original proposal, we did suggest that we can possibly look at the effectiveness of the Transport Subsidy Scheme recently introduced by the government to address the problem of increasing cost of commuting. Although that objective has subsequently been dropped because we wanted to focus our resources on the central issue of the impact of housing status, we believe it is worthwhile to explore whether the scheme can alleviate the negative effects of the rigidity of the public housing system.

790213.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
790213.value: Urban housing development is one of the most important issues in economic development. How society chooses to supply housing to meet the needs of urban dwellers has enormous long-term consequences that impact every facet of economic, social and political life. Hong Kong’s primary response has been the development of a large public housing program over the past decades. However, because of rigidity in program requirements, Hong Kong public housing residents are likely to stay in the same unit permanently -- even when moving out would allow them to capture more favorable labor market opportunities in another district. Public housing residents are therefore far less mobile than private renters. This study tries to identify and quantify the impact of public housing tenancy on labor force performance. Using long data series from both census and General Household Survey, we find that male heads of households who are public renters show higher unemployment and lower labor force participation than their counterparts in private households, even when the comparison is restricted to those for whom housing status is relatively exogenous. This shows that even in “the best city in the world for commuters,” geographic immobility can have significant negative impact on labor market performance.

790613.label: Project Objectives

790613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
790613.value: 在这项研究中，实地访谈获取有价值的信息。研究问题的动机是双重的。首先，金融分析师在资本市场上重要的信息中介。然而，文献不能很好地理解他们是如何通过信息采集活动获得信息优势。此前的研究一般采用间接变量衡量，如预测频率和企业数量，举办投资者会议，参加电话会议等。其次，RegFD禁止选择性披露，结果导致分析师不能依靠个人关系从管理信息，在RegFD之后，select access对分析师更为重要。 在美国证券交易委员会的圆桌讨论会主席皮特评论数次，公司应该允许进行实地考察，即让投资者参与进来，他们的总部或分部，使经营管理者回答问题。到今天为止，没有经验证据表明实地考察如何能够让分析师获益。此研究通过检查现场考察和分析师的信息优势，旨在填补这一空白。具体来说：实地考察之后分析师是否更频繁的修订预测，这种修订是否准确，是否能导致较强的市场反应。 在美国，实地考察是高度机密的事件：公司要么根本没有实地考察的档案记录，或禁止分发该信息。在中国深圳证券交易所，自2009年以来，公司年报强制性披露“接待机构投资者实地调研”，包括来访者姓名，来访机构名称，具体的日期，地点，活动的简要内容。这个强制披露从而为我们提供了一个独特的研究环境，检验分析师如何从实地访谈中获益。这项研究需要手工收集数据， 2009至2011年的超过1000个在深圳证券交易所上市的公众公司。

790613.label: Major findings and research outcome
790613.value: This study examines the impact of corporate site visits on analysts’ forecast accuracy based on a sample of such visits to Chinese listed firms during 2009–2012. We find that analystswho conduct visits (‘‘visiting analysts’’) have a greater increase in forecast accuracy than other analysts. Consistent with the notion that site visits facilitate analysts’ information acquisition through observing firms’ operations, we find that the results are stronger for manufacturing firms, firms with more tangible assets, and firms with more concentrated business lines.Moreover, we find that the effect of a site visit is greater when the site visit is an analyst-only visit, when the current visit is preceded by fewer visits, and when visiting analysts are based far from the visited firms. Furthermore, we find that site visits partially mitigate nonlocal analysts’ information disadvantage. Collectively, these results indicate that site visits are an important information acquisition activity for analysts.

790613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
790613.value: some analysts conduct site visits to firms that they do not cover. It would be interesting to examine the benefit of the visits to these analysts. Are they obtaining information on the peers, customers, or suppliers of the firms they cover? Many analysts offer site visit services to their buy-side clients. It would also be interesting to examine how exactly analysts benefit from offering such services. Do they obtain more commissions for their brokerages? Do they obtain more votes as the top analysts? Starting from 2013, the detailed meeting minutes of site visits are available on the SZSE website. A textual analysis of these meeting transcripts could enrich our understanding of the information acquisition process during the site visits. We leave these interesting questions to future research.

790613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
790613.value: Based on prior research and in-depth interviews with investor relations (IR) managers, sell-side analysts, and fund managers, we expect that analysts can improve their earnings forecast accuracy through site visits. In a typical visit, the analysts engage in face-to-face talks with IR managers and divisional managers and then tour the firm’s operating and production activities.1 The face-to-face talks can help analysts to gain additional details about and insights into a firm’s performance. Observing a firm’s operations and its factories and business units allows an analyst to better understand its production process, corporate culture, and employee morale, potentially leading to more accurate forecasts.

790813.label: Project Title(Chinese)
790813.value: 公司盈利预期数量化与其归因数量化的相互作用

790813.label: Co - Investigator(s)
790813.value: Dr CHEN, WEI Prof TAN, HUN-TONG

790813.label: Project Objectives
790813.value: To investigate the interaction effect between quantifying management earnings guidance and quantifying the attributions on investor confidence. To demonstrate that quantitative earnings guidance encourages investors to adopt a peripheral information processing route, whereas qualitative earnings guidance encourages them to adopt a central information processing route.

To demonstrate that quantitative earnings guidance encourages investors to adopt a peripheral information processing route, whereas qualitative earnings guidance encourages them to adopt a central information processing route.

790813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
790813.value: Management has discretion over the form of earnings guidance, that is, whether it is quantitative or qualitative, and over whether to quantify the effects of the attributed factors on the guided earnings. The objective of the proposed study is to investigate the effect of quantifying both management earnings guidance and the attributions that accompany that guidance. Psychology research (Witt 1976; Yalch and Elmore-Yalch 1984) suggests that when quantitative information is provided, investors are less motivated to scrutinize earnings guidance carefully. In other words, investors tend to accept numerical earnings guidance at face value. When the management earnings guidance is qualitative, in contrast, investors are more motivated to attend to its details, and attributions are therefore likely to play a role in investors’ reactions. Hence, we propose that in the case of quantitative earnings guidance, investors do not differentiate between quantitative and qualitative attributions, whereas they do tend to do so in the case of qualitative earnings guidance. The prior literature on management earnings guidance forms suggests that guidance precision (or form) affects investors’ confidence but not their earnings estimates (e.g., Hirst, Koonce, and Miller 1999). It also suggests that the information provided in the supplementary disclosures with management earnings guidance tends to supplement earnings guidance (e.g., Han and Wild 1991; Hutton, Miller, and Skinner 2003). Hence, we predict an interaction effect between management earnings guidance quantification and attribution quantification on investor confidence. More specifically, we expect investor confidence to be greater for quantitative than qualitative attributions when the earnings guidance is qualitative. However, when the earnings guidance is quantitative, we expect no difference in investor confidence between quantitative and qualitative attributions. We intend to use a 2 x 2 between-subjects lab experiment with MBA students as participants to test our hypotheses. The two variables will be guidance quantification (qualitative versus quantitative) and attribution quantification (qualitative versus quantitative). The proposed study will contribute to three streams of the literature. First, it will contribute to the literature on management earnings guidance forms by comparing qualitative and quantitative guidance. Few prior studies have examined the former. Second, it will contribute to the literature on the supplementary disclosures in management earnings guidance by suggesting an interactive pattern between earnings guidance quantification and attribution quantification. Finally, it will contribute to the quantification literature by suggesting that quantification affects investors’ information processing routes. 公司管理层可以决定是否量化其盈利预期.管理层同时可以决定时候量化盈利预期的归因.我们希望研究盈利预期及其归因是否量化之间有何相互作用. 心理学研究表明,量化信息会减弱投资者仔细研读该信息的动力. 在量化信息下,投资者倾向于接受公司提供的盈利预期而不予以深究.相反,当盈利预期非量化时,投资者反而会更有动力研究盈利预期的细节. 在这种情况下,盈利预期的归因就显得很重要.因此我们预测当盈利预期量化时,投资者对于归因量化与否无明显差别反应.相反,当盈利预期非量化时,投资者对于归因量化与否的反应是不同的. 对于公司盈利预期采用形式的研究表明,预期精确度影响投资者的信心但不影响投资者对于盈利前景的看法.研究也表明伴随公司盈利预期的其他信息都会对投资者决策有一定的作用.因此我们的假设是,当盈利预期量化时,投资者对于归因量化与否无明显差别反应.当盈利预期非量化时,归因量化时的投资者信心会高过归因非量化时的投资者信心. 我们准备采用2x2的试验方法来验证我们的假设.第一个变量是公司盈利预期量化(量化与非量化).第二个变量是归因量化(量化与非量化).我们准备招聘MBA学生参加我们的实验. 我们的研究结果会对三个领域有贡献.第一,我们的研究对于公司盈利预期量化与否的领域有贡献.之前很少有关于非量化公司盈利预期的研究.第二,我们的研究也对于伴随公司盈利预期的其他信息的研究有启发.我们预期公司盈利预期量化与否与归因量化与否有相互影响. 最后,我们对于量化研究也有启示.我们的研究表明信息量化与否会影响投资者采用不同的信息处理模式.

790913.label: Project Title(Chinese)
790913.value: 企業創新效率與效果之決定因子

790913.label: Project Objectives
790913.value: We plan to construct a panel dataset comprising firm-level innovation efficiency and influence, managerial characteristics, firm characteristics, shareholder composition, and government policy changes. We plan to examine the correlation between firm-level innovation efficiency or influence and managerial characteristics, firm characteristics, shareholder composition, and government policies. We plan to use empirical regression models to further examine the separate effects of managerial characteristics, firm characteristics, shareholder composition, and government policies on the efficiency and influence of firms’ innovative activities. We will pool all significant explanatory variables for innovative activities in one regression model to investigate the relative explanatory power of each factor. This analysis will help us to understand each determinant’s relative importance. Finally, we plan to investigate various determinants’ conditional effects on innovation efficiency and influence. For example, we will interact one factor with another in the regression model, and then discuss the statistical and economic significance of the coefficient on the interaction term.

790913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
790913.value: 企業必須要投資於技術創新以維持市場競爭力與發展競爭優勢. 因此, 如何改善創新效率與效能事一項重要的研究課題. 有鑑於過去文獻忽略了相關的研究, 本計畫將對此一課題進行完整的研究. 根據我們的文獻回顧, 我們發現以下的假說尚未被完全實證: (i) 給予管理者的工作保障鼓勵他們進行革新性的研發計畫; (ii) 公司治理對於鼓革新性的研發計畫有正向作用; (iii) 企業執行長之自信心與選擇權報酬鼓勵投資於風險大之研發計畫; (iv) 風險容忍度較高之股東鼓勵革新性的研發計畫; (v) 政府研發稅負優待對效率性的研發計畫有正向作用, 但對革新性的研發計畫有負向作用; (vi) 財務槓桿對效率性的研發計畫有正向作用, 但對革新性的研發計畫有負向作用; (vii) 於集中性產業中, 企業比較不進行革新性的研發計畫. 在我們實證研究中, 創新效率可以定義為企業專利數量除以其研發支出, 而創新效果可以定義為企業專利被引用數除以其專利數量. 我們初步的研究成果為下: (i) 給予管理者的工作保障鼓勵他們進行革新性的研發計畫, 並造成較高的創新效率與效果. (ii) 公司治理對於鼓革新性的研發計畫有正向作用. (iii) 美國的一項研發稅負優惠計畫減低了美國企業的創新效率但是增加了創新效果. 如果本研究能獲得相關研究資源, 我們將能對所列示的假說進行大規模的實證研究. 本研究之研究成果將對有助於企業, 投資者, 債權人, 與政府對企業創新策略之瞭解.

790913.label: Major findings and research outcome
790913.value: 1. Using a unique data set of corporate philanthropic activities, we find that direct giving activities are positively associated both with higher levels of innovation and innovation that is more influential, collaborative, and original. 2. We find a positive relation between innovation efficiency and inventory turnover ratio, and such a relation is strengthened by technology spillovers. 3. We find that firms with better employee treatment schemes produce more and better patents through improving employee satisfaction and teamwork. 4. We find firm-level innovation performance to be an important determinant of corporate creditworthiness in bond pricing. 5. Our study shows that direct contributions by large pharmaceutical companies have been used with considerable success to facilitate relationships with academia and thereby increase their innovative capabilities and output. 6. We find that R&D cuts related to earnings management lead to fewer patents, less influential patent output, and lower innovative efficiency, compared to other R&D cuts.

790913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
790913.value: 1. We may consider collect more detailed data of corporate philanthropic activities to investigate the value of these activities. 2. To better understand the relation between innovation performance and inventory turnover, we may consider looking into the employee-level data. 3. Our results that firms with better employee treatment schemes produce more and better patents have managerial implications for corporate and government. 4. Our results that innovation performance determines corporate creditworthiness in bond pricing have general implications for bond investors. 5. How pharmaceutical companies use direct giving to establish connection with universities to enhance innovative capabilities deserve more investigation if micro-level data are available. 6. Our findings that R&D cuts related to earnings management hurt firms' innovation suggest the cost of managerial myopia in making earnings targets.

790913.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
790913.value: 1. Companies can use direct giving to establish connection with universities to increase their innovative capabilities. 2. Firms that are more efficient in innovation have also better operational performance in terms of turnover ratio. 3. Firms treating their employees better will be rewarded with better innovation performance. 4. Bonds issued by firms with better innovation performance are more valuable. 5. When managers have to make earnings targets, they may sacrifice firms' long-term value by cutting R&D.

791013.label: Realisation of objectives
791013.value: All objectives have been achieved. We developed and refined a threat-reaction framework by developing five conference presentations and three journal version papers. We further developed the threat perspective to voice by considering different types of threats, including threats from coworkers, threat to one's territory and threat to empowerment. Base on these ideas and data, we presented the first conference paper on coworker ostracism (as a form of threat) and voice, the second conference paper on voice as a territorial behavior (protection against threat to one's territory) based on a social exchange perspective. After presenting and digesting our ideas and findings, we devoted major effort into conceptualizing what theory-based management research is. Our proposed stated that we were adopting a theory-based approach. We realized that the OB field actually did not have too many truly theory-based publications. We were drawn to develop a deeper understanding of what theory-based management research means. We developed a conference and a journal version paper on this and the conference paper received a Best Paper Award. We also applied our own approach to conceptualizing the action identity theory of empowerment and voice and presented a conference paper on this. We presented the fifth conference paper on voice as a territorial behavior (reaction to threat) based on a temporal perspective. Last but not least,we found that different forms of threats did moderate the effects of voice on supervisor reactions. We also developed a manuscript on this and plan to submit this to a journal after examining how to combine these results and the results on another data set we collected for this grant. We conceptualized, developed and tested a supervisor reaction to subordinate voice measure and found three stable dimensions across three data sets: denial, silent and endorsement. We also developed and validated the threat to supervisor scales, including threat to supervisor effectiveness and threat to supervisor organization-based self-esteem. We examined the effects of threat on the voice-reaction relationship and found mixed results when tested all the variables in the same statistical models. Towards the end of the grant, we decided to collect one more set of two-wave, two-source dyadic data to test our empirical model. We found that the potential of long-term, open-ended social exchange could have important effects on voice. We also considered to include future prospect and other temporal constructs as important opportunity variables that would affect voice and reaction to voice.

791013.label: Major findings and research outcome
791013.value: The major findings pertaining to our main proposed model yielding both promising and interesting results. We found that the there were three stable forms of supervisor reactions to voice: denial, silent and endorsement across a pilot and two full data sets. We found that different forms of threat to supervisor had effects, including problem solving effectiveness and neuroticism. The combination of types of threat, however, yielded mixed results. This indicates that more conceptualization and testing of how threat functions would be important. All together, we collected a pilot data set and five sets of two-wave, two-source matched dyadic data and generated five conference presentations and three journal-version papers based on this grant. There were important ideas for voice research that we generated when working on our conceptual model. In the first three data complete data sets, we did not find significant effects of supervisor reactions. We found, however, that different forms of threats, for example, coworker threat in the form of coworker ostracism, threat to one's territory that triggered a form of voice that aimed at protecting one's territory, and positive exchange outlook that presented future exchange opportunities affected voice. We proposed a theory-based approach to studying voice and adopted the threat-reaction approach. In the process of fine tuning our theoretical approach, we found that a much deeper understanding of what entails theory-based research should be an important contribution to the management literature. Specifically, we conceptualized and detailed the logic and specific rules and conditions for research to be qualified as theory-based. We prepared and submitted a manuscript on this to a referred journal. We also tried to work out an action identity theory of empowerment and voice conceptual paper and presented in a conference. While we have submitted two papers to journals, the journal version paper that we plan to submit has most of the conceptual model that included voice, reaction to voice, threat factors and employee outcomes. The results from the second complete two-wave, matched dyad data set were mixed. We prepared a draft manuscript but are withholding submission to a journal because we are targeting top journals. We collected a another complete data set with two-wave, matched dyadic data and are optimizing the findings from these two data sets to package together in one manuscript to enhance the chance of publication in a top journal.

791013.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
791013.value: We suggest that supervisor reactions are likely to relate to employee and coworker perceptual and behavioral outcomes and this may be a fruitful line of future research.

791013.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
791013.value: The proposed project has important impact on the study of employee voice in particular and on understanding organizational effectiveness in general. Voice has been recognized as a very important form of employee contribution to organizational effectiveness. When employees see problems and voice out, organizational effectiveness can be improved. Understanding how supervisors react to subordinate voice has important implications on managing voice effectively and have further implications on organizational effectiveness. In particular, a threat-reaction approach to conceptualize how supervisor would react to subordinate voice provides both theoretical and practical insights into management of employee voice. This project offers a conceptual tool for understanding the specific psychological drivers of supervisor reactions to voice and insights into situations in which supervisors would react positively or negatively to voice. We also developed a measure of supervisor reaction to voice and supervisor's perceived threat to their problem solving effectiveness. Both measures can have wide application in the OB literature as both are important constructs.

791113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
791113.value: Internal labor markets are characterized by salary tiers and different degrees of promotion possibilities. Some firms prefer to use discretionary promotion, in the sense that the firm may promote the employee in the future if he/she works hard but without specifying explicitly within the terms of the employment contract when this may take place. Others prefer more explicit promotion guidelines, in the sense that the firm specifies precisely in the employment contract the circumstances under which the employee will be promoted. To take the case of university tenure as an example, some universities have clearer rules than others. In this project, we try to explain why different kinds of promotion coexist in reality and how different kinds of promotion, together with monetary compensation, affect agents’ incentives in a firm’s internal labor market. We consider an employment relationship between a principal (the owner) and an agent (a manager) using the standard principal-agent model with verifiable output and unverifiable inputs (called efforts). As in reality, the employment relationship in our model includes a salary package, but in addition the principal also has a control option (the promotion). The principal may choose to write the promotion option into a contract or leave it out. If the promotion option is in the contract, the principal commits to the promotion rule; if the promotion option is not in the contract, the principal is allowed to offer a promotion at his discretion (discretionary promotion). In addition, in our model the promotion option is tied in with the salary package in that the promotion has a direct bearing on the salary structure. We will focus on two issues: the optimality of a salary system with promotion and the conditions under which discretionary promotion is better than a promotion rule, and vice versa. Our model will allow for various risks within internal labor markets, including the risk of a high switching cost and the risk of a low-ability agent. Our model will also be effective in investigating what effects these factors may have on the employment relationship and, as a result, be helpful in understanding the role of promotion in labor contracts. 分级工资和晋升规则是内部劳动力市场的两大基本特点。有些企业喜欢使用酌情决定的晋升规则，因此这些公司不会在雇佣合同中详细的列出在何种情况下雇员一定可以得到晋升机会。有些公司则倾向于更明确的晋升规则，因此这些公司会在就业合同中指出在何种情况下，雇员将得到晋升机会。例如，一些大学较其他大学关于终身教职有更清晰的规则。在这个项目中，我们试图解释为什么现实世界里各种不同的晋升规则可以并存。在现实中，各种不同的晋升规则，加上工资激励机制，影响雇员的工作热情。

791313.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
791313.value: Organizational citizenship behavior (OCB)is a kind of voluntary behavior that is discretionary, not directly or explicitly recognized by the formal reward system, and that in the aggregate promotes the effective functioning of the organization. Although researchers have often found positive relationships between OCB and performance rating, very few studies have scrutinized the team contexts in which such relationships exist. This study aims to examine how OCB influences performance rating decision by supervisors under different team cultures. The study has two distinct features that are novel to the previous research. First, unlike previous studies which were conducted from a single-level analysis, this study adopts a multilevel perspective to explain how team level cross cultural variables (team collectivism and team individualism)moderate the relationship between individual OCB and performance. culture within team plays a crucial role in shaping employee performance and different team culture is likely to impact of individual OCB behavior. Second, unlike most of the research works which treat OCB as an unidimensional construct when studying the effects between OCB and moderating variables, this study looks at the two sub-dimensions of OCB (OCB-I and OCB-O)and proposes that these two forms of OCB are associated with a distinct set of behaviors and consequences. OCB that targets individuals (OCB-I) and OCB that targets organizations (OCB-O). Although both OCB-I and OCB-O can contribute positively to performance rating, their relationships may be differentially influenced by different cross-level moderators. This study thus aims to make an important contribution to the OCB literature. The study will add to the multilevel perspective of OCB by examining how two team cultural contexts (collectivism and individualism) moderate the relationship between the two distinct aspects of OCB (OCB-I and OCB-O)and job performance ratings. Data will be collected from an international bank. Findings of this study will have important managerial implications in how can managers better promote OCB or to select job candidates to fit the team culture. 組織公民行為（ OCB ）是一種自發性的行為。這行為本身是無條件的，在公司的獎勵制度裡不會被直接或是公開地嘉許。然而，這行為能夠整體上促進公司的有效運作。 雖然研究人員經常發現OCB與表現評級之間的正面關係，卻很少有研究在團隊裡面詳細檢驗這種關係的存在。這研究的目的， 是在不同的團隊文化裡， 細察OCB如何影響上司/督導決定下屬的表現評級。本研究有兩個明顯的特徵， 是過往的研究沒有的。首先，它脫離以往的單一層面分析， 採用了多層面觀點來解釋團隊裡的跨越文化變數（團隊的集體主義和團隊的個人主義）如何調節 個人的組織公民行為和表現之間的關係。團隊裡的文化起著至關重要的作用，它塑造員工的表現； 並且， 不同的團隊文化有可能影響個人的OCB行為。第二點，當研究OCB與調節變數之間的效應時， 大多數的有關研究是將OCB看作單一指標的構念來處理。 這項研究不同之處， 是觀察OCB之下的兩個子維度（ OCB -I和OCB- O），並提出這兩組OCB行為都有它們各自不同的行為模式和後果。 OCB以觀察個人做目標的是（ OCB -I）和OCB以觀察公司/機構做目標的是（ OCB -O ） 。雖然OCB -I和OCB – O同時對表現評級有正面幫助，兩者之間的關係可能會不同程度被不同的跨層面調節變數所影響。 本研究旨在對OCB研究文獻作重要貢獻。這研究將會增加組織公民行為的多層面觀點分析， 透過檢察兩個團隊文化（集體主義和個人主義），如何調節組織公民行為中的兩個重要方面（OCB-I和OCB-O）與工作表現評級之間的關係。數據將會從一所國際銀行收集得到。這項研究的結果將會對公司/機構的管理具有重要的意義，研究結果會幫助管理階層更有效的促進OCB ， 另一方面是選擇合適的應徵者以適應公司/機構的團隊文化。

791413.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
791413.value: 創新已成為節省成本（例如流程創新）以及從競爭對手贏得訂單（例如產品創新）的一個關鍵。一般來說，企業能經由以下三種方式獲得創新的知識：（１）自身研發投資，（２）學習競爭對手的創新（產業知識外溢），及（３）學習同地理位置的企業的創新（地理知識外溢）。本計畫建議供應鏈知識外溢作為另一個重要的知識來源，及探討在供應鏈中的知識交換如何影響供應鏈的績效。 首先，我們利用專利信息來研究供應鏈的知識交流活動的原動力。供應商不僅可以向他們的客戶學習，客戶亦可以受益於他們的供應商的專業知識來創造創新的產品。具體來說，我們計劃研究是何因素推動這兩個方向（從供應商到客戶及從客戶到供應商）的知識外溢。 第二，我們研究供應鏈知識外溢如何影響企業和供應鏈上的表現。在現今競爭激烈的環境中，買家需要與供應商合作以提高產品質量，而供應商亦需分享其知識來贏得訂單。然而，雙方也感到如此知識交流背後的威脅。供應商可以運用所學知識提供貨品給其客戶的競爭對手。另一方面，在客戶學習到供應商的核心技術後，也可以轉單給其他成本更低的供應商。因此，本計畫的第二個步驟是調查這樣的知識交流活動對供應商、客戶、以及供應鏈的運籌及財政績效的影響。 最後，我們討論知識共享在戰略供應鏈的重要。雖然信任可以紓緩知識洩漏可能性，但它通常需長期的來建立如此的信任關係。於此，我們將使用交易歷史來找出戰略供應鏈，並研究如此的戰略供應鏈如何造福或傷害的供應鏈績效。研究本步對企業極為重要：企業需要了解的利弊，才可以做出理性的知識共享決策。 總而言之，本計畫預期找出供應鏈中知識流動的驅動力，研究知識交換對供應鏈績效影響，並最終確定此對戰略供應鏈的影響。經濟學文獻多半側重於產業或地理的知識外溢，本計畫提出並研究另一可能的知識外溢－供應鏈外溢。另一方面，供應鏈管理文獻側重於供應鏈的產品、財務、和信息流如何對協調產業鏈的影響，本計畫則致力於通過引入供應鏈知識流的概念來調查其原動力及影響。此外，就研究方法來看，大部分的供應鏈管理文獻皆採用理論模型為其研究之根本，本計畫以不同的角度切入，利用實證方法來探討供應鏈創新管理，並來達到對於供應鏈管理更深入的理解。

791413.label: Realisation of objectives
791413.value: During this period, we have complete the areas that were denoted as areas to be done in the previous periods. We have completed a paper, Supply Chain Knowledge Flow, Innovation, and Profitability, to submit to the M&SOM special issue on Innovations in Supply Chain Interfaces and Structure. Unfortunately, this first draft is rejected because of two main reasons—hypothesis development and performance measure. In particular, our original model with a mediation-moderation relationship is too complicated and hence cannot be explained by one cohesive theory. Moreover, the patent data as well as firm financial performance seem not to be relevant enough to the channel we proposed in our paper and using all patent citations may not correctly capture knowledge flows. Therefore, we have revamped the entire paper according to the reviewers comments: we have gathered more data to enhance the data availability concerns, we have redeveloped the hypotheses by using absorptive capacity as the main theory to motivate the empirical models, and we have included many tests to ensure the robustness of the empirical results. We detailed our new development as well as how it is relevant to the realization of objectives. First, supply-chain dataset that was completed in the last period gave us a good starting point to study Objectives 3 to 5. In particular, as mentioned in the to-do-areas in the previous report, we obtained another data source to identify supply-chain pairs—IHS supply-chain network for automotive industry. So we exerted significant efforts in identifying the supply-chain and corporate structure in understanding the effect of spillovers. The additional data serves as case studies for the specific industry. However, from the comments collected from conference and institutional presentations as well as from reviewers, the pure citation data suffers from one drawback. Not all citations are voluntarily added by firms; some are actually added by patent examiners in USPTO. These examiner-added patents cannot be seem as the knowledge flow that motivate supplier inventions. Therefore, to be more previous on the key knowledge flow variable, we collect and clean the patent application data so to identify these examiner-added patens, and exclude them from the flow measures. With this additional effort, we complete Objective 1 and partly fulfill Objective 4. Second, with this supply-chain dataset and the previous performance measures we collected in the previous review period, we identified how spillovers influence corporate performance. As mentioned, we were challenged by reviewers that patent outputs may not serve as a good indicator for corporate innovation performance, as more patents do not mean higher firm values. Therefore, to complete the analysis, we further collect innovation performance data, e.g., new product introduction numbers and new product value (measured by stock returns around new product announcement date). This step required extensive efforts to code through millions of new development announcement by public firms, and then to screen which is new product announcement, and whether the announcement is a follow-up announcement or not. Then we followed a new JPE paper (Kogan et al. 2017) that proposed a new way to evaluate the value of new patents by constructing competition-based stock portfolio to evaluate the value of a new product to firms. In addition to these efforts, we update patent and spillover (knowledge flows) data to 2014 so to include more data. With these additional new measures, we complete Objective 2. Third, we study the drivers and implications of the two knowledge flows on firm performance. Using absorptive capacity as the main theory, we hypothesize that we hypothesize that learning by supplying will positively impact a supplier’s product invention, as such learning provides suppliers with targeted and potentially profitable information they may use to acquire, assimilate, transform, and exploit new technologies central to new product development. More importantly, we explore how buyer concentration (i.e., supply chain sales dependence of a focal supplier on its major customers) moderates the effect of learning by supplying. When a supplier depends more on a few major customers, then that supplier tends to cater to them in ways that overlook other technology opportunities, which weakens the positive learning effect. For this moderator, we further developed the channel test—through a reduced technology scope because of over-catering buyers’ needs. Moreover, we have adopted instrumental variables as well as matching as supporting methods to support these causal relationships. We also provide a second moderator (can be found in the PhD dissertation)—supply-chain duration, measuring how long this supply chain has been established, that positively moderates the supply-chain learning. Because of data limit, we focused on the flow from buyers to suppliers, and keep the flow from suppliers to buyers as a control to offer strong supports. With these efforts, we complete Objective 3 and the remaining part of Objective 4. Finally, we investigate supply-chain strategic behaviors by comparing the strategic and non-strategic supply chains. We approach this by separating the strategic buyers from non-strategic buyers, and found that the spillover effects we identified previously is weakly significant for strategic buyers than the non-strategic ones, thus completing Objective 5. However, because this part of analysis is weaker than the other part, and is not as cohesive for our current positioning, we did not include it in the paper for submission.

791413.label: Major findings and research outcome
791413.value: Thanks to the support from this GRF projects, we managed to collect a significant amount of data that can be used for multiple related papers. With the innovation measures (e.g., patents) and firm performance measures, we have successfully published two related papers (please see Part C point 8, output 1 and 2) studying how innovation enhances corporate performance. These two papers lay a foundation to motivate why firms should be more innovative, and explain why patents and citations are appropriate measures for innovation and knowledge flows. These two papers published on Decision Support Systems and Journal of Corporate Finance, respectively, which both are very decent journals in Operations Management and Finance areas. These two outputs also show that this work is indeed interdisciplinary and can create impact to a wider audience. Second, with the supply-chain pairs data we collected in this paper, we are able to complete another paper (see Part C point 8, output 3) published on MSOM. This paper studies how supply-chain collaboration via financial flows can improve supply chain performance, for both suppliers and buyers. But such a positive relation can have negative impact if the supplier is too aggressive in offering financial support via trade credits. This paper helps to (1) provide a support for the data (supply-chain pairs), (2) identify some related moderators that will affect supply-chain relationship, such as the buyer concentration (how much a supplier relies on its major buyers), and supply-chain relation duration (how long have these two parties worked together. Third, with the first two parts, we confidently finalized another paper that is submitted to Strategic Management Journal (see Part C point 8, output 4). In this paper, we show that supplies do learn from their buyers, but such a positive, collaborative relationship can be negatively affected by buyer concentration. Also, this paper serves as the bone for my PhD student, Ms. Haiping Hui’s dissertation (see Part C point 10). She is expected to defend in August 2018. In her dissertation, we further study how the other moderator, supply-chain duration enhances the positive effect of learning from buyers. In addition to that, she also studied how this learning behavior affects supply-chain contracts in her second paper in the dissertation, and how supply chain relationship should be carefully managed to avoid corporate social responsibility crisis.

791413.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
791413.value: We plan to extend this work by using a finer data. The supply-chain pairs from Compustat Segment dataset capture only the large buyers, and it is constructed from supplier disclosure. Therefore, we can only ask questions from supplier perspectives. However, supply chains consist of two-sided relationships. There needed to be a better way to help buyers/customers using empirical data. Therefore, as mentioned in 5.3, we have also constructed a data set in the automotive industry with a more comprehensive, buyer based data set. We currently used this data in the way of case study to support some of our arguments. But with this data, we can ask questions from the other side and to complete the loop.

791413.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
791413.value: In today’s economy, firms cannot operate their business along, but need to work with others in their supply chains. Not only products, information, or even finances, knowledge also flows within supply chains. As innovation becomes an essential component for firms to strive against fierce competition, we provide an answer to how this knowledge flow impacts firm performance and how to better manage supply chains so to maximize the benefits from this flow. We find that firms can learn from their buyers, for these buyers are closer to consumers and hence can target more precisely what and how to innovate. However, firms also compete with their buyers for supply chain profits. Therefore, over-learning from their buyers may reduce their capability in innovation, as they focus too much on their buyers’ need. These frictions may be eased for supply chains with longer relationships, as learning is not easy, and it takes some time to really absorb what buyers have to offer in their innovation. In sum, supplier firms need to understand that supply-chain initiated R&D projects can be a great source for new products with higher value, but need to carefully manage the relationship to fully reveal the benefits.

791613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
791613.value: We will apply specialized textual analysis software to transcripts of earnings conference calls. This technique produces variables capturing conference call participants’ levels of optimism/pessimism, which can be separated as proxies for management confidence and investor confidence. Equipped with these proxies, we can investigate: 1) whether aggregate management confidence revealed during the earnings conference calls could be one of the driving forces underlying the investor sentiment index of Baker and Wurgler (2006); 2) whether the market's reaction to high (or low) management confidence measures is significantly influenced by the investor sentiment index; and 3) whether there is a co-movement of investor sentiment in the US and Hong Kong, as proxied by investor confidence revealed during conference calls in Hong Kong. We propose to conduct an empirical study to investigate our research questions. We will collect and process transcripts of earnings conference calls in the US and Hong Kong. For each transcript, we will separate the information from management and the information from investors (classified as institutional investors, sell-side financial analysts, buy-side analysts, and individual investors) so that we can apply textual analysis to each group separately. By so doing, we can define the revealed sentiment/optimism level of each specific group. We propose measuring the investor sentiment on an aggregate level in order to construct a time-series analysis. Next we will correlate this variable with the Baker and Wurgler (2006) investor sentiment index, which is a time-series but not firm-specific measure. In addition, we will further investigate the market reaction to management optimism given different investor sentiment periods, controlling for other correlated variables in the multivariate regressions, such as earnings surprises and the information environment. We will also generate a conference call-based investor confidence measure for Hong Kong and examine its association with Baker and Wurgler’s investor sentiment index. This project aims to contribute to the literature on investor sentiment in the following three ways. First, we will explore one potential driver of the investor sentiment index – revealed management confidence level (as measured by a confidence-based textual analysis of management discussion during conference calls). Second, we will gain insights into how the market processes information during conference calls, conditional on the existing market mood. Third, we will provide evidence of whether Hong Kong investor sentiment is correlated with US investor sentiment. 我们将申请专门的文本分析软件的盈利电话会议的成绩单。该技术生产出捕捉电话会议参与者的乐观/悲观相差指数水平，可分开管理层的信心和投资者的信心代理变量。配备这些代理，我们可以进行调查： 1 ）是否盈利会议通话期间透露总管理层的信心可能是决定相关的投资者情绪指数贝克和吴各勒 （2006）; 2 ）无论是市场的反应，以高（或低）管理信任措施显着影响投资者情绪指数，以及3）是否有运动在美国和香港的投资者情绪代理在香港召开电话会议时透露了投资者的信心。 我们建议进行了实证研究，调查研究问题。我们将收集和处理的盈利电话会议在美国和香港的成绩单。对于每个成绩单，我们将单独的管理层信息和投资者的信息（归类为机构投资者，买卖双方的金融分析师，买方分析师，投资者和个人投资者） ，这样我们就可以运用文本分析各组分别。通过这样做，我们可以定义显示乐观情绪/每个特定组水平。我们建议投资者情绪测量的总体水平上，以构建一个时间序列分析。下一步，我们将与贝克和吴各勒 （2006）投资者情绪指数关联变量，这是一个时间序列，但不坚定的具体措施。此外，我们将进一步调查给予不同的投资者情绪周期，控制其他相关变量的多变量回归模型，如盈利惊喜和信息环境管理的乐观情绪对市场的反应。我们也将产生一个电话会议基于香港投资者信心的措施，并检查其与贝克和吴各勒的投资者情绪指数。 该项目旨在促进在以下三个方面的文献对投资者情绪。首先，我们将探讨投资者情绪指数的一个潜在驱动 - 显性管理信任级别（由管理层讨论在基于信任的文本分析电话会议） 。其次，我们将深入了解市场如何处理信息，在电话会议期间，在现有的市场情绪条件。第三，我们将提供证据显示香港投资者情绪是否与美国投资者情绪关联。

791713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
791713.value: The perennial debate on the role of short sellers on financial markets has been reignited due to the short sale bans imposed during the financial crisis in the years of 2008 and 2009. On the one hand, financial authorities state that short sellers could destabilize the financial markets. On the other hand, academic studies suggest that short sellers could detect firm managers’ misbehaviors and then capitalize on the information. This would help stock prices to reflect firms’ true values, thereby improving the information efficiency. This project aims to analyze the role of short sellers from an innovative perspective by exploring the discipline effect of short sellers on managerial misbehaviors. Specifically, we explain the extent to which the presence of short sellers might deter mangers from engaging in two value-destroying behaviors, namely empire building and real earnings management. Following the literature, we use both hazard model estimation and abnormal capital investment to gauge the extent of empire building. We measure abnormal levels of cash flows from operations, discretionary expenses, and production costs, to capture the extent of real earnings management. Our project contributes to two strands of literature. First, along with Bond, Edmans, and Goldstein (2011), this project helps to enhance understanding of the real effect of financial markets in terms of the degree to which the presence of short sellers could impact managerial real economic decisions. In other words, short selling may not only help to improve price efficiency ex post but also poses a valid deterrence to managerial misbehaviors ex ante. Second, our study differs from and yet complements the work of Massa, Zhang, and Zhang (2012) by providing evidence on the discipline effect of short selling on empire building and real earnings managements, other than accrual-based earnings management. 2008年金融危機期間實行的賣空禁令，又重新點燃了學界對金融市場賣空者的角色定位的辯論。一方面來說，金融當局認為，賣空者可能加深金融市場的動盪。而另一方面，學術研究卻也表明，賣空者有偵測公司經理人的不當行為的能力。透過賣空交易，公司真實價值的信息將如實反映公司的股價，從而提高了股市的信息效率。因此，該項目旨在分析賣空者在對於公司經理人的不當行為的監察效果。具體來說，我們將探索，一個完善的賣空市場，是否真對於公司經理人的過度投資與盈餘操縱行為，產生嚇阻的效果，進而提高公司的價值。

791713.label: Major findings and research outcome
791713.value: We examine the disciplinary effect of short-selling threat on deterring managers from conducting value-destroying M&As. Using lending supply data as the proxy for short-selling threat, we document a positive association between lending supply and the M&A announcement returns of acquiring firms between 2002 and 2011. We also identify two economic mechanisms through which short-selling threat disciplines managerial behavior. We find that the disciplinary effect is significant only for firms with managers with high wealth-performance sensitivity. We also find that the disciplining effect is more effective for firms in an industry in which a hostile takeover has occurred. To mitigate endogeneity concerns, we use quasi-index ownership and Russell 2000 inclusion as our instrumental variables, and we find that our main findings are robust to endogeneity concerns. Using residual lending supply also yields consistent results indicating that our findings are robust to controlling for various firm characteristics. Moreover, we use the SEC regulation SHO-PILOT Program, which lifted the price restrictions on short selling for a set of randomly selected firms. The multivariate difference-in-difference results indicate that lending supply has a stronger disciplining effect on firms that are exempted from short selling price restrictions. All four sets of tests support our hypothesis that lending supply has a disciplining effect on managerial M&A decisions. Moreover, we show that the disciplinary effect is stronger for stock-financed merger and acquisition deals and for firms with fewer financial constraints. Finally, we find that firms with higher lending supplies have higher firm values and profitability in the following year, which provides complementary evidence to our hypothesis in a more representative sample that managers facing higher short-selling threat perform better.

791713.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
791713.value: We intend to extend the disciplining effect of short selling threat to bank loan decisions. If an active short selling market disciplines the managers from conducting value-destroying activities, banks might be less exposed to the default risk of their borrowers. This would in turn reduce the bank loan spread. Therefore, the disciplining effect of short selling threat might actually be beneficial to firms' cost of private debt.

791713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
791713.value: We explore the disciplining effect of short-selling threat, proxied by the value of shares available for short sellers to borrow, on merger and acquisition (M&A) decisions. Our results indicate that acquiring firms with more stock lending supply have higher announcement returns. We also find a stronger disciplining effect when managers’ personal wealth is more linked to the stock price and when the firm is more likely to be the target of a hostile takeover. In addition, the disciplinary effect exists only for non-financial-constrained firms and non-all-cash M&A deals, and we find that the short-selling threat improves firm value and profitability in general.

791913.label: Project Title(Chinese)
791913.value: 模型不确定性和新兴市场经济周期

791913.label: Co - Investigator(s)
791913.value: Dr Nie, Jun Prof Young, Eric

791913.label: Project Objectives
791913.value: The main objective of this project is to study how model uncertainty induced by the interaction of the preference for robustness and productivity shocks affects consumption, investment, and the current account in an otherwise standard SOE-RBC model featuring two productivity shocks: trend growth shock and cyclical level shock. To approximate and solve the benchmark robust SOE-RBC model using the robust linear-quadratic (LQ) dynamic programming method. To follow the same Bayesian estimation procedure and data sets used in Garcia-Cicco et al. (2010) to estimate the model parameters governing the stochastic process of the two productivity shocks, and then use the detection error probability to calibrate the parameter of robustness. To quantitatively evaluate the model's predictions on the joint dynamics of consumption, investment, and trade balance along the following dimensions: (i) the relative volatility of consumption and investment to real GDP; (ii) the persistence and volatility of the trade balance-to-output ratio; and (iii) the correlation between GDP and trade balance. To examine the relationship between macroeconomic uncertainty caused by productivity shocks and trade balance. To extend the benchmark model by considering the possibility that the agents cannot distinguish the two productivity shocks and adopt filtering techniques to extract true signals about the shock to trend growth.
