791913.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
791913.value: Recently, a number of studies have adopted the neoclassical business cycles model featuring no market failures and no distortions to explain aggregate fluctuations in emerging economies. For example, Aguiar and Gopinath (2007, henceforth AG) argued that a real business cycles (RBC) model driven primarily by shocks to trend growth can explain well the observed emerging market business cycles. In particular, they showed that introducing this trend shock generates strongly countercyclical current accounts, volatile consumption, and sudden stops observed in emerging economies. In contrast, Garcia-Cicco, et al. (2010) showed that when using a long sample data over the period 1900-2005, the small-open economy (SOE)-RBC model driven by the same shocks used in AG (2007) does a poor job in explaining the observed business cycle fluctuations in Argentina and Mexico along a number of dimensions. Specifically, the model cannot generate (1) low autocorrelation of the trade balance-to-output ratio, (2) high relative volatility of consumption to output and highly volatile investment, and (3) realistic trade balance. They therefore argued that permanent productivity shocks gives little support to the hypothesis that the cycle is the trend proposed in AG (2007). Hansen and Sargent (1995, 2008) first introduced model uncertainty due to robustness into economic models. Agents with this preference are concerned that their model is misspecified in a manner that is difficult to detect statistically; consequently, they make decisions as if the subjective distribution of the model was chosen by a malevolent nature to minimize their welfare. As shown in Luo, et al. (2012) using the permanent income hypothesis, given the degree of robustness, greater income uncertainty leads to greater induced model uncertainty; consequently, consumption reacts more aggressively to income, consumption is more volatile than income, and income and current accounts are less correlated in an environment with greater income uncertainty (e.g., emerging economies). Given the failure of the SOE-RBC model in matching the important dimensions of data mentioned above, the feature that model uncertainty increases the sensitivity and volatility of variables could possibly improve the model's predictions on the joint behavior of investment, consumption-saving, and current accounts in emerging markets. In this project, we plan to incorporate model uncertainty into the full-fledged SOE-RBC model with shocks to trend growth and cyclical level, and then examine how this induced uncertainty introduces additional propagation and saving-investment channels that can improve the model's predictions on emerging market business cycles. 最近，许多研究都采用了新古典主义特色的市场失灵和无扭曲解释在新兴经济体的总波动的商业周期模型。例如，Aguiar and Gopinath（2007年，从此AG）认为，一个真正的商业周期（ RBC ）模型主要增长趋势的冲击可以很好地解释观测到的新兴市场的商业周期。特别是，他们发现，引入这种震荡走势产生强烈的反周期的活期账户，挥发性消费和资本流入的突然停止在新兴经济体中观察到。相反，Garcia-Cicco, et. al. (2010) 表明，一旦使用很长的样本数据(1900至2005年期间), AG（2007)的RBC模型不能解释所观察到的阿根廷和墨西哥的经济周期波动。具体来说，该模型无法产生（1）低自相关贸易平衡产出比，（2 ）消费量比产量更为波动，投资高波动性，及（3）现实的贸易平衡。因此，他们认为，AG（2007）提出长期生产率冲击提供很少的支持周期现实。 Hansen and Sargent（1995年， 2008年）首次引入由于模型的不确定性转化为经济模型的鲁棒性。这个偏好的可能性，他们的模型是来年的方式，是很难检测统计，因此，他们选择他们的决定，如果一个恶毒的性质，以尽量减少其预期效用冲击的主观分布被选为代理。Luo and Young (2009) 和Luo, et. al. (2012)在永久收入模型中证明较强的鲁棒性的偏好会使更多的消费最初响应收入冲击。由于标准化ICA模型的主要问题是，给定收入过程中，该模型会导致不切实际的顺周期的活期账户，敏感的消费反应可能提高模型的预测经常账户下的鲁棒性。此外，鲁棒性偏爱是特定背景下，也就是说，在新兴经济体中的消费者可能比发达经济体的消费者面对更模型的不确定性强，这可能有助于解释两个经济体的消费相对波动的差异。 然而，鲁棒性本身不能提供一个强有力的，必不可少的，以产生持续电流的帐户传播机制。因此，我们考虑的另一个重要信息：理性的疏忽（ RI ） 。Sims（ 2003年）第一次引入RI经济学，并认为，这是一个合理的方法把呆滞，随机性，延缓引入经济模型。鉴于这些特点，鲁棒性和RI ，我们计划要研究如何结合两种类型的信息摩擦能产生正确的消费动态，反周期波动的经常账户，和积极的不确定性和经常账户之间的关联。

791913.label: Realisation of objectives
791913.value: All of the objectives proposed for this project are realized. The project has generated five papers. The two major papers are entitled "Model Uncertainty and Emerging Market Business Cycles" and "Robust Control, Informational Frictions, and International Consumption Correlations", respectively. The former is in preparation for submitting to a macroeconomic journal, and the later has been published in European Economic Review (2014) as a lead article. In the former paper, we introduce model uncertainty due to robustness (RB) into an otherwise standard small open economy (SOE) - real business cycles (RBC) model with both cyclical (transitory) and trend (permanent) productivity shocks proposed in Aguiar and Gopinath (2007) and Garcia-Cicco, Pancrazi, and Uribe (2010). Specifically, we fully explored how RB can improve the key predictions of the SOE-RBC model for the joint dynamics of consumption, investment, output, and the current account in emerging economies for plausibly estimated trend and cyclical shock processes. The key step in this paper is to solve the robustness version of the SOE-RBC model explicitly using the robust dynamic programming. Using the explicit expressions for consumption and investment, we can analytically inspect how RB affects the stochastic properties of the joint dynamics of consumption, income and the current account in emerging small open economies. In the published EER paper, we examined the effects of model misspecification (robustness or RB) on international consumption correlations and the joint dynamics of consumption and income in an otherwise standard small open economy model with endogenous capital accumulation. We showed that in the presence of capital mobility in financial markets, RB lowers the international consumption correlations by generating heterogeneous responses of consumption to productivity shocks across small open economies facing different macroeconomic uncertainty. In addition, we showed that RB can also improve the model's predictions in three other moments of consumption dynamics: the relative volatility of consumption to income, the persistence of consumption, and the correlation between consumption and output. After calibrating the RB parameter using the detection error probabilities, we showed that the model can explain the observed international consumption correlations as well as the other consumption moments quantitatively. Finally, we showed that the main conclusions of our benchmark model do not change in an extension in which the agent cannot observe the state perfectly. The other three papers generated from this project are closely related to the major paper and have been published in peer-reviewed economics journals: Management Science (forthcoming), Journal of Economic Theory (2016), and Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control (2015).

791913.label: Major findings and research outcome
791913.value: In the paper entitled "Model Uncertainty and Emerging Market Business Cycles", we introduced model uncertainty due to robustness (RB) into an otherwise standard small open economy - RBC model with both cyclical and trend productivity shocks proposed in Aguiar and Gopinath (2007) and Garcia-Cicco, et al (2010). Specifically, we examined how RB can improve the key predictions of the SOE-RBC model for the joint dynamics of consumption, output, and the current account in emerging economies for plausibly estimated trend and cyclical shock processes. We found that for plausibly calibrated values of robustness, the otherwise standard SOE-RBC model did a good job in explaining the key moments of the joint dynamics of consumption, income and the current account. In the related paper, "Robust Control, Informational Frictions, and International Consumption Correlations", we examined the effects of model misspecification (robustness) on international consumption correlations in an otherwise standard SOE model with endogenous capital accumulation. We showed that RB lowers the international consumption correlations by generating heterogeneous responses of consumption to productivity shocks across countries. After calibrating the RB parameter using the detection error probabilities, we show that the model can explain the observed international consumption correlations as well as the other consumption moments quantitatively. In the four publications related to this paper, we have the following research outcome: (1) "Elastic Attention, Risk Sharing, and International Comovements," JEDC 79, 1-20. (Lead Article). Inspired by the major papers, the effects of elastic information-processing capacity (or elastic attention) proposed in Sims (2010) on international consumption and income correlations in a tractable SOE model. (2) "Robustly Strategic Consumption-Portfolio Rules with Informational Frictions (2016)." Forthcoming in Management Science. This paper provides a tractable continuous-time CARA-Gaussian framework to explore how the interactions of fundamental uncertainty, model uncertainty due to a preference for robustness, and state uncertainty due to information-processing constraints affect strategic consumption-portfolio rules and precautionary savings in the presence of uninsurable labor income. (3) "Induced Uncertainty, Market Price of Risk, and the Dynamics of Consumption and Wealth (2016)." JET 163, 1-41. (Lead Article). This paper examines the implications of model uncertainty or robustness for consumption and saving and the market price of uncertainty under limited information-processing capacity. (4) "Attention Misallocation, Social Welfare, and Policy Implications." JEDC 59, 37-57. This paper examines how agents allocate attention between private and public signals to reduce the uncertainty about observation noises when coordination is an important concern

791913.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
791913.value: This paper examines the importance of model uncertainty due to preferences for robustness in explaining the observed joint behavior of consumption, income, and the current account in emerging small open economies. In the future, it is promising to apply this idea in other important macroeconomic settings: How does this type of induced uncertainty affect the equilibrium interest rate and optimal investment behavior at both the individual and aggregate levels? Once we can successfully incorporate this information friction into the optimal investment setting, we can address some very important issues in macroeconomics. For example, how robustness affects optimal investment decision and the investment volatility in an otherwise standard Abel-Eberly investment model with uncertainty, and what is the key differences between the traditional adjustment costs hypothesis and the informational friction hypothesis?

792113.label: Project Objectives
792113.value: To develop an abnormal working capital model that incorporates demand and productivity shocks, a production function, and a dynamic investment decision over the infinite horizon. To test the validity of our model compared with that of existing accrual models using empirical data.
rows: To develop an abnormal working capital model that incorporates demand and productivity shocks, a production function, and a dynamic investment decision over the infinite horizon.
To test the validity of our model compared with that of existing accrual models using empirical data.

792113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
792113.value: Over the past two decades, a number of accrual models have been developed to test earnings management hypotheses (for example, Jones (1991), modified Jones (Dechow, Sloan and Sweeney 1995), performance matched Jones (Kothari, Leone, and Wasley 2005), Dechow and Dichev (2002), and Dechow and Dichev augmented with Jones (McNichols 2002)). However, these models have been criticized for their potential misspecifications or measurement errors in explanatory variables. Thus, researchers continue to call for improvement to the accrual model. In the proposed project, we will develop a stochastic dynamic model of a real economy and estimate the effects of optimal capital investment decisions on working capital accruals. The model will incorporate demand and productivity shocks, a production function, and a dynamic investment decision over the infinite horizon. Normal working capital accruals will be endogenously determined through rational expectations. Combining the equilibrium solutions, which are latent, and a measurement equation of actual working capital accruals, which are observable, we will estimate abnormal working capital accruals. We will estimate and test the validity of our model using sample firms that have or have not been subject to the SEC's enforcement actions. We expect that our model to provide more powerful tests for earnings management hypotheses. 在过去的二十年间，许多应收应计模型被建立用来检验盈余管理假说（例如，Jones（1991）， 改进的 Jones模型 （Dechow，Sloan and Sweeney 1995），业绩配比的Jones 模型（Kothari, Leone, and Wasley 2005）， Dechow and Dichev （2002），用Jones模型扩展的Dechow 和Dichev 模型（McNichols 2002））。然而，这些模型都因有潜在的解释变量误设（misspecifications）和计量错误（measurement errors）而被批判。因此，研究人员仍在呼吁对应收应计模型的改进。在这个提交的计划中，我们将建立一个真实经济的随机动态模型，并估计营运资本应收应计的最优资本投资决策的影响。这个模型将包含需求和生产力冲击、一个生产函数和一个在无限期上的动态投资决策。正常的营运资本应收应计将通过理性预期内生地确定。我们将结合潜在的均衡解和一个可观测的实际营运资本应收应计的计量等式去估计异常的营运资本应收应计。 我们将用受到和没有受到SEC起诉的样本公司来估计并检验我们模型的有效性。我们预计我们的模型将为盈余管理假说提供更有力的测试。

792213.label: Project Title(Chinese)
792213.value: 信用價差動態的實證研究以及在歐元區的影響

792213.label: Co - Investigator(s)
792213.value: Dr Bhattarai, Saroj Dr Lee, Jae Won

792213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
792213.value: In the wake of the global financial crisis in 2007-2009 the sovereign debt crisis that followed engulfed European nations, which confronted economists with a number of challenges. The financial crisis calls for an extension of the standard framework for monetary policy analysis to allow for disruptions of financial markets. Moreover, the European debt crisis brings about an urgent need to model the heterogeneity of member states in a currency union and in particular explain the difference of interest rates across member states (or interest rate spreads). The proposed research project aims at establishing stylized facts about the dynamics of interest rate spreads on government and private debt (or sovereign and private credit spreads) in the euro area and the differential transmission mechanisms of economic shocks across the euro area. We fit a dynamic factor model (DFM) and a panel vector-autoregression (VAR) model on the data of the euro area after the introduction of the euro in 1999. A DFM is well-suited for our purpose as we use a large dataset of ten member states as well as the euro area as an aggregate economy. However, since the DFM has an issue with structural shock identification and imposes strict restrictions on the cross-border effect of country-specific shocks, we complement the DFM with a panel VAR model that can address these issues. Most of the previous analyses of monetary policy in the euro area abstract from the heterogeneity of the member states and focus on the aggregate economy of the euro area. With the new developments in financial markets however, building a multi-country model is necessary. The stylized facts that the proposed research would find will help to improve the standard framework for monetary policy analysis in a currency union, as the VAR literature guided the development of the New Keynesian model for monetary policy analysis. Methods for structural shock identification that will be explored and applied in the proposed research would provide a useful starting point for similar research in the future. 在 2007 年至 2009 年全球金融危機之後,主權債務危機席卷歐洲以致經濟學家遇到許多挑戰。 金融危機要求對貨幣政策分析的標准框架進行擴展,允許金融市場的崩潰。此外,隨著歐洲債務 危機到來,迫切需要對貨幣聯盟成員國的異質性進行建模,尤其是要解釋成員國之間的利率差(或 利率價差) 。 該研究旨在建立典型事實,這些事實是關於歐元區政府和私人債務(或為主權和私人信用利差) 的動態利率價差以及歐元區經濟衝擊的不同傳導機制。我們用動態因子模型(DFM)和面板向量自回 歸(VAR)模型對歐元區引入歐元後(1999 年)的數據進行擬合。當我們使用十個成員國的大數據 集以及把歐元區作為一個整體經濟體的數據時, DFM 模型是非常適合。然而,由於 DFM 也是有 問題,即結構性衝擊的識別問題和對國家特有的衝擊的跨境衝擊效應的嚴格限制,我們用能解決 這些問題的 VAR 模型進行補充。 之前的大部分歐元區貨幣政策的分析從會員國異質性開始的,主要集中於歐元區的整體經濟。 隨著新的金融市場發展,構建多國模型是必要的。當 VAR 引導貨幣政策分析中的新凱恩斯主義模 型的發展時,本研究提出的典型事實將會將有助於改善貨幣聯盟中貨幣政策分析的標准框架。結 構衝擊識別方法的探索和在該研究中的應用,將為未來類似的研究提供一個有用的起點。

792513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
792513.value: 最近在资本主义市场的失败(例如，2008年金融海啸)和中国国有企业的强劲表现，引发了一些问题, 特别是有关决策者和管理者的利益关系 。自由市场资本主义是否被贪婪和不负责任治理打破？中国的国有企业的成功有什么独有贡献？国有与资本主义的组合能否继续影响市场? 能否引进新的企业未来呢？ 这个项目是以组织和制度因素为重点，来评估中国国家资本主义的有效性。该项目延伸了现存研究中国和国有企业的文献，来确定国有企业的企业效益，和社会影响。核心假设是，中国的国有企业，由企业和市场在国家改革的不同阶段的扶植。通过这些自由市场的力量，中国的国有企业转化为企业的能力和经济效益。 该项目用 Hoskisson ，Eden，Lau 和 Wright （2000）的建议，并结合从代理理论和制度理论的见解，形成总体概念框架。分拆代理理论描绘状态（关注社会目标和社会目标）和国有企业（追求经济目标）之间复杂的相互作用，而体制的理论有助于我们理解中国的体制特征如何影响国有企业表现。 该研究利用在中国28个制造业全面的企业数据库。该数据库包含约20万企业（包括25,000家国有企业） 1998年至2009年。通过使用计量经济模型的滞后项，该项目将验证所提出的命题。 该项目在以下四个方面有供献： （1）研究机构薄弱的体制环境中的方案; （2）评估合并的体制和自由市场力量的影响; （3）证实如何中国的国有企业和国家政府彼此交互，以满足其社会和经济目标，及（4）提供国有企业的管理者和公共决策者新的见解。

792513.label: Realisation of objectives
792513.value: The PI has fulfilled 100% of the study’s designed objectives through three papers. The first paper is published in Journal of Management (impact factor 6.0) in 2015 by two former PhD students (Caleb Tse and Linhui Yu). They made use of the database that grant purchased. The paper examines how China’s SOEs improve their Productivity through Learning-by-Exporting. It entitled, “A Multimediation Model of Learning by Exporting: Analysis of Export-Induced Productivity Gains.” The second paper entitled, “Understanding State Capitalism through China’s SOEs: How Strategic Opportunism and Resource Exploitation Deliver Their Opposing Goals,” is under review in Journal of Management. It is co-authored by the PI together with three of his PhD students – one current and two former). It explored the core postulates of China’s State Capitalism by assessing how China’s SOE use their capabilities (in production and innovation) to deliver social and economic goals, thus fulfilling Objectives 1 and 3. The paper also confirmed the salient moderating effects of Globalization and Government Ownership (as stated in Objective 2). Most important of all, the findings offer theory insights towards building a theory of state-owned enterprises, an attempt also taken by several top scholars in Chinese firms, including Meyer, Peng, Eden, Hitt etc. Thus it fulfills Objective 4. The paper has been revised for submission. The third paper entitles, “Counterfiet Reduction in Emerging Markets: a New Institutional Perspective.” It is being invited for a revision (risky) at the Journal of Management. It receives partial support by the grant.

792613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
792613.value: 市场营销中常使用拟人化手法推广产品,在产品描述中赋予产品人类的特性和情绪。有时品牌会塑造一个人物形象来代表它（例如米其林轮胎人）。有时品牌把描述人类的词语用在表现产品上。心理学研究认为人们把非人类当作人来描述源于他们追求社会交往的动机。我们常常看到孤独的人更有可能把他们的宠物或者物品当作人。以往的研究发现临时被操纵感觉社会排斥会让人们用更积极的语言来描述他们的宠物（例如他们的宠物很有心）。但直今关于拟人化在市场营销中的效应还没有系统性的研究，这是本研究项目的重点。 在日常生活中消费者常会碰到被家人，朋友，同事等等拒绝，忽视的事情。这些经历威胁了人类追求社会关系的需求，加强了人们对建立新社会关系的动机。品牌研究指出人们可以和产品建立类似于人与人之间这样的关系。本研究建立在拟人化，社会排斥，品牌研究的基础上，着重研究产品营销拟人化会经历社会排斥的消费者有什么影响。 经历社会排斥提高了消费者对社会交往暗示的敏感性，鼓励他们去追求新的社会联系。当这类消费者从产品中看到人的特质时，会对和这个产品建立社会关系更感兴趣。因此，本研究项目提出以下假设：经历社会排斥的消费者，比起没有经历社会排斥的消费者，更喜欢用拟人化手法来营销推广的产品。我们进一步假设，这种效应会受产品个性所影响。 以往的研究指出，受到社会排斥的消费者会避免和他们看来会拒绝他们的个人或社会团体交往。因此本项目推测，当这个产品展示出比较强硬的个性时，社会排斥不会提高消费者对拟人化产品的喜爱。 以往的研究提出在消费者-品牌关系中，产品可能被视为消费者的合作者-和消费者共同完成某项任务，也可能被视为消费者的仆人-代替消费者完成某项任务。本研究项目假设把产品拟人化成合作者还是仆人会对受不同性质社会排斥的消费者有不同的影响。具体来说， 当消费者被直接明显的拒绝，他们的关系性需要受到威胁，因而他们会更喜欢合作者类型的拟人化产品因为这种产品提供机会给他们弥补关系性需求的缺失。 当消费者被冷落忽视，他们的自我效能需求（例如控制力，权力）受到威胁，因而他们会更喜欢仆人型的拟人化产品因为这种产品提供机会给他们弥补效能效需求的缺失。 本研究项目将使用实验室实验和田野实验来验证我们的假设和效应机制。 本研究的成果将会对拟人化，社会排斥，品牌关系等文献的理论发展做出贡献，并且为市场营销策略和消费者福利提供建议。

792613.label: Realisation of objectives
792613.value: The current research proposes five research objectives. All the five objectives have been achieved. Objective 1 is to examine whether experiencing social exclusion (vs. inclusion) will enhance consumers’ preference for products communicated in an anthropomorphized manner. I conducted a series of laboratory experiments, using participants from Hong Kong and U.K. The results from these studies support our proposition. That is, consumers exhibit greater preferences for products marketed in the anthropomorphized manner (vs. nonanthropomorphized manner) when they feel socially excluded (vs. socially included). Our studies also confirm that this effect is driven by social exclusion rather than inclusion, in comparison with a baseline condition. Objective 2 is to examine the boundary conditions of the effect, such as brand personality. In a series of experiments conducted in Hong Kong and U.K., we find that anthropomorphism enhances socially excluded consumers’ product preference only when the product has a warm/friendly personality but not when it has a cold/tough personality. These results identified boundary conditions for the effect of social exclusion on consumer preference for anthropomorphized brands. Objective 3 is to examine the mechanism underlying the effect of social exclusion on anthropomorphized products. In a series of experiments conducted in Hong Kong, I find the following mechanism evidences: 1) The effects are mediated by the desire to affiliate with products that provide the chance of successful social affiliation and that offering participants; and 2) The effects are alleviated when socially excluded participants engaged in social interaction with another person before being exposed to the anthropomorphized products. Objective 4 is to examine how different types of social exclusion will influence the effectiveness of using different types of anthropomorphism. A series of experiments conducted in Hong Kong and North America show that social exclusion with different attribution affects consumers’ preference for different types of anthropomorphized products. Specifically, participants who blamed the incident of social exclusion to self (e.g., “I got excluded from the group activities because of my own weakness/fault) became more favorable towards anthropomorphized partner brands, whereas participants who blamed the incident of social exclusion to others (e.g., “I got excluded from the group activities because other people in the group were not nice”) became more favorable towards anthropomorphized fling brands. Objective 5 is to examine the mechanism underlying the effects proposed in objective 4. I conducted a set of research experiments. My studies show that participants’ negative self-view versus negative other-view mediated the impact of self-blame versus other-blame social exclusion in their preferences for partner versus fling brand. Moreover, my study identifies that participants’ feeling of empty also drive socially excluded consumers’ attitudes and preference in their perceptual preference of pictures and images.

792613.label: Major findings and research outcome
792613.value: Findings from this project are reported in two journal publications and two conference presentations (see Part C). The first set of studies document the following findings, using research participants in Hong Kong, UK, and US. A manuscript based on these findings is accepted for publication in Journal of Consumer Psychology. Part of these findings is presented at the 43rd European Marketing Academy Conference (EMAC) in Leuven, Belgium, 2015. • Experiencing social exclusion (vs. non-exclusion) increases consumers’ preferences for products marketed in the anthropomorphic form (e.g., having the human-like physical feature, being introduced in humanized tone). • The effect of social exclusion on preference for anthropomorphized products is mediated by consumers’ motivation for social affiliation. • Providing participants the opportunity to engage in social interactions with another human being diminishes socially excluded participants’ preference for anthropomorphized products. • Consumers would prefer anthropomorphized products that play different social roles, depending on consumers’ attribution of their social exclusion. Specifically, consumers who blame the exclusion to self prefer partner brands because they wish to have a long-term committed relationship, whereas consumers who blame the exclusion to others prefer fling brands because they wish to have a short-term exciting relationship. The second set of studies document the following findings, using research participants in Hong Kong, China, and US. A manuscript based on these findings is published at Journal of Consumer Research. Part of these findings is presented at the Association for Consumer Research, North America Conference in New Orleans, USA, 2015. • Anthropomorphizing products increases consumers’ preferences for products with superior appearance features (vs. superior functional features). • This effect is driven by consumers’ belief of “what’s beautiful is good” in human judgment. • This effect is robust whether the appearance is about the product itself or about the packaging design. • This effect is eliminated when consumers’ belief of “what’s beautiful is good” in human judgment is challenged. That is, when consumers are led to belief that both people with beautiful or non-beautiful physical appearance can be successful in their life, consumers will not increase their preference for anthropomorphized products with superior appearance attributes.

792613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
792613.value: One potential extension for this research is to further examine the impact of attribution of social exclusion on consumers’ responses to products with mixed appeals. For example, consumers may attribute their being socially excluded to social reasons (e.g., their being excluded is due to their social class, their geographic profile, their racial profile) or personal reasons (e.g., their being excluded is due to their own personal habit, style, taste). How would the difference in their attribution of social exclusion affect their attitudes toward a brand with appeals favoring a mixed group of associative group and dissociative group.

792613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
792613.value: In marketing communication, marketers often anthropomorphize their brands by visually and verbally describing them as human-beings with personalities, intentions, and emotions. For example, some brands create human representations as the spokesperson, such as the Michelin Man or the M&M’s guys. Other brands promote their products as if these products have humanlike intentions and actions, such as the “I am Nikon" campaign by Nikon camera. How would marketers target consumers for promoting products with anthropomorphic features? Our studies show that consumers who felt lonely, rejected, or ignored in their social life are particularly vulnerable in response to products with anthropomorphic features. This is because these socially excluded people may use the anthropomorphized brand as the target for social affiliation. In other words, they are motivated to build social relationship with products and brands with humanized features. Moreover, if they feel that they themselves are to be blamed for social exclusion, they would prefer partner brand which looks like a person with a long-term commitment. If consumers feel that others should be blamed for social exclusion, they would prefer fling brand which looks like a person with a short-term exciting personality.

792813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
792813.value: Optimal capital allocation is critical for wealth creation in a free-market economy. Efficient information flow within a multi-segment firm contributes to the allocation efficiency of internal capital market. Based on a sample of multi-segment U.S. firms, we propose to examine how the efficiency of diversification is affected by the internal information asymmetry between corporate headquarters and divisional managers. In our research proposal, we gauge the internal information asymmetry within a multi-segment firm by the differential insiders’ trades between the divisional managers and top executives, including the difference in their trading profitability, frequency, and trading volumes. A higher level of divisional managers’ trading profitability (frequency or volume) compared to that of top executives indicates a higher level of internal information asymmetry. We gauge the efficiency of diversification using diversification discount as developed by Berger and Ofek (1995) and empirical measures of internal capital allocation efficiency as developed in prior studies (e.g., Rajan, Servaes and Zingales 2000; Billett and Mauer 2003). We hypothesize a negative relation between diversification efficiency and internal information asymmetry within a multi-segment firm. This negative association would be consistent with prior theoretical studies which argue that information asymmetry coupled with moral hazards impedes efficient internal capital allocation and results in value destruction (e.g., Antle and Eppen 1985; Harris and Raviv 1998; Bernardo, Cai and Luo 2004). We further propose to examine whether the hypothesized relation between diversification efficiency and internal information asymmetry is accentuated for firms with poorer corporate governance, less transparent corporate disclosure, a lower level of institutional ownership, and more diversified segments. Last, we propose to examine whether internal information asymmetry increases the likelihood of a corporate refocusing its business (i.e., reducing the number of segments) in future periods. 在自由市場經濟中,最優化的資本配置是創造財富的一個重要因素。對於多元化企業來說, 內部資訊的有效流通能夠有助內部資源的有效配置。通過利用美國多元化企業樣本, 我們計畫研究企業多元化經營效率如何受到企業內部的資訊不對稱影響。多元化企業內部資訊不對稱是指公司總部高層管理人員與各個分部管理人員之間的資訊不對稱。這種內部的資訊不對稱可以用各級管理人員的內幕交易來衡量,包括用他們的交易獲利程度的區別,以及交易頻率和交易量的區別來衡量。 如果企業分部經理的內幕交易獲利(或者交易頻率和交易量)要比公司總部高管的獲利(或者交易頻率和交易量)還要高,這家企業就被認為是有較高的內部資訊不對稱。另一方面, 我們根據Berger and Ofek (1995) 的方法計算多元化企業價值折扣, 並採用過往文獻中的內部資本配置效率的實證計量 (例如 Rajan, Servaes and Zingales 2000; Billett and Mauer 2003) 來作為多元化經營效率的實證衡量。 我們預期 多元化經營效率跟企業內部資訊不對稱是存在負相關的。這種負相關是跟以往理論研究中的論點是一致的: 資訊不對稱以及道德風險問題會妨礙有效的內部資本配置, 因而會導致企業價值損失 (例如Antle and Eppen 1985; Harris and Raviv 1998; Bernardo, Cai and Luo 2004) 。我們計畫進一步考察是否這種負相關會更加顯著當企業的公司治理比較差, 公司的披露不透明, 機構持股比例比較小，或著是公司的多元化程度比較高的時候。最後, 我們預期這種內部資訊不對稱會增加將來公司減少分部數目, 提高業務集中度的可能性。

792813.label: Realisation of objectives
792813.value: We successfully accomplished all the research objectives and felt very happy about the acceptance of our paper in the top journal of The Accounting Review in 2017. In our paper, "Clarity Begins at Home: Internal Information Asymmetry and External Communication Quality", we first develop a novel measure to capture the internal information asymmetry (IIA) between divisional managers and top corporate managers. We find that the higher value of IIA is associated with higher diversification discount of multi-segment firms' value. This finding achieves the research objectives #1 and #2 of the GRF application. In addition, we show evidence that higher IIA is associated negatively with the accuracy, bias, specificity and frequency of management forecasts. Further evidence indicate that the likelihood of error-driven accounting restatements increases with IIA. These evidence answer the questions contained in the research objectives #3 and #4 in the application.

792813.label: Major findings and research outcome
792813.value: In this GRF project, we successfully develop a high-quality paper, "Clarity Begins at Home: Internal Information Asymmetry and External Communication Quality." This paper is now forthcoming in the top A+ international accounting journal - The Accounting Review. Using differential insider trading profits (DIFRET) to capture internal information asymmetry, we find that DIFRET is associated negatively with the accuracy, bias, specificity and frequency of management forecasts. Furthermore, the likelihood of error-driven accounting restatements increases with DIFRET. Our results thus suggest that external communication quality suffers when the information asymmetry between divisional managers and top managers is more severe. In the additional analyses, we extend the prior literature by showing that the multi-segment firms with higher DIFRET are subject to larger diversification discount in firm value than other firms.

792813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
792813.value: We develop a novel measure to capture IIA between divisional managers and top corporate managers, computed as the difference in their respective trading profits on their own company’s stock (DIFRET). Numerous validation tests indicate that DIFRET indeed captures the information asymmetry between divisional managers and top managers. I believe this IIA measure could be used for many future research projects. For example, how and whether does the internal information asymmetry affects the internal capital allocation among different subsidiaries. To explore this research opportunity, we might consider to collect the division-level data.

792813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
792813.value: In this project, we show that when the divisional managers know more than headquarters managers (i.e., CEOs and CFOs), the firm will suffer from a couple of negative consequences. First, the top managers cannot provide reliable earnings forecasts and hence the firm reputation will be damaged. Second, the poor external communication quality causes the investors to impose a value discount on this firm's stock. Collectively, our findings suggest that good corporate governance practices have to take care of the internal information asymmetry.

793013.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
793013.value: 這項研究調查經歷了首次公開發行(IPO)的公司,他們在籌集營運資金、參與國際併購時所會遇到的問題。這些新上市公司往往擁有許多成長機會，並嘗試進行戰略投資，以提升他們的競爭力。然而，並非所有的公司都能夠獲得足夠的資源來發展其企業。在這種情況下, 信息起著重要的作用以解釋為什麼有些無法公司實現他們的成長機會。 鑑於新上市公司的公開信息不足，以及企業往往比他們的投資者更認識自己的營運狀況及前景。因為公司有誘因透過釋放正面的信息、隱匿負面的信息，以呈現自己最好的一面給資本市場上的投資者。因此，投資者在評價新上市公司的未來成長前景時會面臨很大的不確定性。為了減低逆向選擇(即，過度評價)的風險，投資者可能會貶損其報價或遠離此類交易。因此，在信息不對稱的情況下，新上市公司要承擔較高的外部融資成本。 尤其當涉及無形資產時，如研究與開發(R&D)，新上市公司的信息不對稱問題將特別嚴重。無形資產經常影響著企業的績效，但其不容易為外人所觀察及評價。為了確保無形資產所創造的競爭優勢，企業不太願意透露有關這些資產的具體信息。綜合上述因素，不僅投資者在決定對哪一企業進行投資時面臨困難，同時也新上市的公司無形資產也使得其需以更昂貴的成本獲得外部融資。 通過將訊號理論(Signaling Theory)應用在企業募資及國際併購活動，我們為解決上述問題，提供一個新的視角。例如，之前的研究提出，投資者可分階段提供資金，以降低他們逆向選擇的潛在風險，並從中審視企業所聲稱的成長前景。我們建議，分階段融資更有可能發生在研發密集的新上市公司，而他們與其他組織間的關係（即，富有聲譽的承銷商、創業基金投資者、戰略聯盟合作夥伴的隸屬關係），及公開發行折價有助於新上市公司在首次公開招股過程中，獲取更多的資金。此外，我們認為，高研發支出的新上市公司較不可能從事國際併購活動。因為他們在募集併購資金及取得被併購公司的信任上將面臨著困難。然而，新上市公司與其他組織間關係所形成的市場訊號，將可向外部投資者及被併購公司可信地傳達其資源和成長前景，從而提高其在國際併購活動上的部署能力。因此本專案論證企業傳遞的市場訊號，將有助於企業在資本市場和併購市場上的交易。

793113.label: Project Title(Chinese)
793113.value: 多維性任務與獎酬制度：實地實驗研究

793113.label: Co - Investigator(s)
793113.value: Dr Chen, Clara Xiaoling Prof Wu, Anne

793113.label: Project Objectives
793113.value: We will examine whether a more complete compensation contract that rewards both quantity and quality of output engages the attention of employees and leads to higher performance levels in both dimensions, compared to a partial incentive contract that rewards either kind of output. Our research design will allow us to examine whether a partial incentive contract causes a disparity effect or a spillover effect on the unrewarded dimension of performance. If the disparity effect dominates the spillover effect, we will observe lower performance on the unrewarded performance measure compared to the baseline treatment. By contrast, if the spillover effect prevails, then the unrewarded performance will improve compared to the baseline treatment, even under a partial incentive contract. We will investigate whether the effect of partial/complete incentive contracts differs under an individual- versus team-base setting. Several recent studies, such as Chen et al. (2012), show that the design and impact of incentive systems might differ significantly between an individual and a group setting. When working as a team, members’ prioritizations regarding the various dimensions of a task may significantly deviate from, or even conflict with, each other, the lack of consensus impeding the overall performance (Ho et al. 2012). Therefore, incentive compensation for multidimensional tasks may play a more significantly role in a team setting since it aligns team members’ goals, thereby promoting group cohesion and improving performance. We would like to examine whether the difficulty of performance targets significantly alters effort allocation and performance in multi-dimensional tasks. Holmstrom and Milgrom (1991) suggest that incentive compensation directs employees’ attention and effort allocation among different dimensions of a task. Nevertheless, the difficulty of attaining the performance target may vary across the different dimensions. The difficulty of performance targets would similarly alter employees’ effort allocation in multidimensional tasks.

793113.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
793113.value: Multi-dimensional tasks are ubiquitous in the business world. However, economics literature and psychology literature provide conflicting predictions on the use of compensation in a multi-dimensional task setting. On one hand, economic theory suggests that completeness of contracts is important to help individuals effectively allocate their efforts among multiple dimensions of a task. On the other hand, psychology research highlights the difficulty individuals may experience when facing conflicting incentives and the resulting challenge for individuals to successfully complete a task when given a compensation contract tied to multiple dimensions. In this proposed study, we seek to shed new light on incentive compensation in a multi-dimensional task setting by conducting a multi-period field experiment to capture the dynamic effects of incentive system design on worker performance. Specifically, we examine whether a more complete compensation contract that rewards both quantity and quality of employees’ output would direct employees’ attention and lead to higher performance level on both dimensions, compared to a partial incentive contract that only rewards quantity or quality of output. In addition, we investigate whether the incentive effect of partial/complete incentive contracts would differ under an individual- versus team-base setting. Lastly, we examine whether the difficulty of performance targets would significantly alter effort allocation and performance in multi-dimensional tasks. 傳統經濟學與心理學理論對於多維性任務(multidimensional tasks)有獎酬設計存在不同的見解, 本研究之目的在於透過實地實驗研究對此一重要議題提供實證研究的結果. 本研究將以某台灣半導體製造公司的基層員工進行實驗研究, 實驗中我們將改變獎酬制度對於產出數量以及產出品質之計算方式, 藉以探討不同獎酬制度設計對產出績效的影響.

793213.label: Project Title(Chinese)
793213.value: 反馈效应能否解释股票动量交易与回报?

793213.label: Project Objectives

To derive analytical expressions for each investor’s optimal equilibrium trading strategies and equilibrium prices. To solve the model numerically and investigate stock returns and investors’ trading behavior. To extend the model in several directions to investigate the robustness of the results. To derive analytical expressions for each investor’s optimal equilibrium trading strategies and equilibrium prices.
To solve the model numerically and investigate stock returns and investors’ trading behavior.

793213.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
793213.value: It has been widely documented that both individual and institutional investors tend to follow momentum strategies over the medium horizon (about 3-12 months), that is, they buy after prices rise and sell after prices fall. Correspondingly, stock returns exhibit positive autocorrelation over medium horizons. It is difficult to understand these findings in standard theoretical frameworks, and existing theories often rely on investors’ various behavioral biases to account for them. These theories either investigate trading strategies and return dynamics separately, or seldom differentiate between individual and institutional investors. In the proposed project, we will introduce the so-called “feedback effect” to a standard trading model in which asset prices both reflect and affect a firm’s future cash flows because prices contain information that facilitates the firm’s real investment and resource allocations. For instance, a firm’s stock price influences the way in which its stakeholders, including customers, suppliers, employees, capital providers, managers or even regulators, perceive it, and it thus affects their purchase, supply, investment, and policy decisions, which ultimately have an effect on the firm’s future cash flows. Empirical findings have provided strong support for the feedback effect and a number of recent theoretical models have incorporated it to examine the real effect of prices. However, none of them has considered the implications for momentum trading and returns. Our preliminary findings show that the feedback effect per se cannot generate momentum trading and returns. Rather, we posit that both arise endogenously when either informed or uninformed investor holds moderately positive beliefs about the strength of the feedback effect relative to market liquidity providers. Our aim is to show that our results are consistent with cross-sectional evidence, and we will extend the model in several dimensions to test its robustness. 大量研究发现在股票市场，个人和机构投资者通常在约3-12个月的中期时间内采取动量交易策略，也就是说，他们在股票价格上升后买入，在价格下跌后卖入。相应地，股票回报率在中期时间内表现出正向相关性。基于理性假设的标准的理论框架很难解释这些发现，现有的理论往往依赖于投资者的各种行为偏差去解释。但即使这些理论也通常把交易策略和股票回报率分开来研究，同时把个人和机构投资者也分开来进行研究。 在本研究项目里，为了解释上述发现，我们将在标准交易模型内引入“反馈效应”，这一效应指的是资产价格不仅能够反映，而且还能影响公司的未来现金流，因为价格中包含的信息可以引导公司的真实投资和资源分配。例如，一家公司的股价影响利益相关者（包括客户，供应商，员工，资金提供者，管理者以及监管机构）如何看待该公司，从而影响到他们的采购，供应，投资和政策决定，这最终会对公司未来现金流产生影响。实证研究为“反馈效应”提供了强有力的支持，一些最近的理论模型已考虑股票价格对公司的实际影响。但是，他们没有考虑反馈效应对于动量交易和回报的影响。 我们的初步结果表明，反馈效果本身不能产生动量交易和回报。相反，我们发现只要有信息的机构投资者或者缺少信息的个人投资者对反馈效应的估计适度超过市场流动性提供者，那么模型产生出的动量交易和回报就会和我们观察到的现象一致。我们研究的目的是要表明该发现是与股市截面数据相吻合，另外我们将在几个方面扩展基本模型来强调该发现的稳健性。

793513.label: Project Title(Chinese)
793513.value: 资源依赖结构对风险投资停止投资的关系研究

793513.label: Project Objectives
793513.value: Extend the boundary of resource dependence theory by examining the influence of firms’ dependence structures on their strategic behaviors Contribute to the venture financing literature by providing the missing piece regarding when and why VC firms terminate their investments in new ventures Offer insights regarding how VC firms interact with their invested companies and other key stakeholders such as other VC firms

Contribute to the venture financing literature by providing the missing piece regarding when and why VC firms terminate their investments in new ventures
Offer insights regarding how VC firms interact with their invested companies and other key stakeholders such as other VC firms

793513.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
793513.value: Venture capital (VC) is crucial for fostering entrepreneurial activities and nurturing new venture growth. Thus far, studies in this field have primarily focused on how and why VC firms invest in certain types of new ventures and the performance consequences. Relatively little research has examined the flipside: when and why do VC firms terminate their investments in new ventures, particularly in the context of emerging economies such as China? VC firms constantly balance their investment portfolio and hence make investment termination decisions. Such terminations are integral to VC firms’ strategy and often critical to the invested companies. The proposed research aims to address this critical research gap by taking a resource dependence perspective. Going beyond the conventional wisdom that an investor will terminate an investment based on the investment performance, we assert that whether a VC firm will terminate its sequential investments in a given company hinges on its vertical dependence on the invested company, its horizontal dependence on other VC firms, and the interaction between the two. To the extent that the invested company is no longer a critical component of the focal VC firm’s investment portfolio along key dimensions such as location and industry, a termination will be likely to occur. A VC firm’s partnerships with other VC firms in the focal invested company and its network position among the population of VC firms will further shape the dependence relationship, as the VC firm pursues a balance in power between its vertical dependence and horizontal dependence. 创业投资（VC ）对于促进创业活动，培育新企业的增长是至关重要的。到目前为止，在这一领域的研究主要集中在如何以及为什么风险投资公司会投资于新企业及其后果。研究相对较少的是：为什么风险投资公司终止其在新企业的投资，尤其是在像中国这样的新兴经济体的背景下？风险投资公司不断地平衡自己的投资组合，并因此作出终止投资决策。这样的决策对风险投资公司是不可或缺的，对它们的战略和绩效往往是至关重要的。本研究旨在通过采取资源依赖的观点来解决这个关键的研究空白。我们的理论假设是一个VC公司是否将终止其顺序在一个给定的公司取决于其是否垂直依赖其投资的公司，它的水平依赖于其他VC投资公司，以及两者之间的相互作用。当被投资公司不再是风险投资公司的依赖重点，投资终止将可能发生。与其他创投机构间的网络位置将会进一步修正这两者之间的关系。

793513.label: Realisation of objectives
793513.value: We have collected and cleaned the China VC data into a comprehensive database for the current research as well as future studies. In fact, the PI has submitted another GRF grant application to exploit the data collection work and new research opportunities emerging from this GRF grant. We have been working on the theory development by interviewing more than 30 VC investors and other stakeholders during the past two years. we have gained valuable insights into the VC firms operation in China, particularly regarding our research topic. We have utilized the thoughts gleaned from our interviews, as well as our own theorizing and integrated them into a high quality manuscript elaborating how resource dependence conditions might influence the discretion of VC firms when it comes to investment termination. 793513.label: Major findings and research outcome
793513.value: Our event history analyses of approximately 12,000 VC deals made in China between 2001 and 2012 reveal that when a VC firm has a greater number of investments in an industry, it is more likely to terminate subsequent investments on a portfolio company in that industry. Moreover, such effect on termination is moderated by the focal VC’s embeddedness with its syndicate partners and collaboration opportunities with other VC firms outside the immediate access of the syndicate partners. Our study provides unique insights and important implications for resource dependence theory and the emerging interest in VC industry in emerging economies. Our research resulted in a high quality research manuscript, presented at universities such as Singapore Management University, Tsinghua University and Peking University. 793513.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
793513.value: A VC firm is a professional firm that makes equity investments in high-risk and high-return companies. A typical VC investment will go through multiple stages from initial investment, follow-up investments, until an exit via an initial public offering (IPO), an acquisition, or a write-off. In most studies based on VC industries in established economies such as in the U.S., a VC firm is modeled as an agent who collects and analyzes all information (e.g., market volatility or quality of entrepreneurs) up to the current time and forecasts future payoff. A VC firm will therefore discontinue an investment if the future expected payoff is not worth the investment. This perspective assumes that a VC firms should have superb information processing capability and make sophisticated calculation. However, we propose a resource dependence perspective on VC investment termination decision. When a VC firm has a greater number of investments in an industry, it is more likely to terminate subsequent investments on a portfolio company in that industry. Moreover, such effect on termination is moderated by the focal VC’s embeddedness with its syndicate partners and collaboration opportunities with other VC firms outside the immediate access of the syndicate partners. Statistical analyses of around 12,000 VC deals made in China between 2001 and 2012 support our hypotheses.

793613.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
793613.value: Contracting is central to governing interfirm exchanges, yet the drafting of detailed contracts involves substantial costs and resources. The primary focus of existing research is on the safeguarding function of contractual design: by specifying concrete clauses that delineate each party’s role and responsibilities, contracts provide a framework for minimizing opportunities for deceit, manipulation and haggling, and thus safeguard the interests of exchange parties. More recently, an emerging literature redirects the focus of contracting research towards the coordinating function of contracts: by specifying information needs, shared goals, resolution processes and guidelines for unexpected contingencies, contracts coordinate ongoing exchanges. Despite such growing interest in contracting, we still lack a good understanding of the safeguarding and coordinating facets of contracts. First, empirical studies have tended to focus on the degree of contractual formalization, overlooking the nature or content of the contractual clauses. As a result, how to differentiate between safeguarding and coordinating facets of contracting remains a significant gap to be filled. Second, there is a lack of research into the ways in which contracts function in emerging markets, which tend to be characterized by weak legal institutions. The fundamental premise of contractual design is that strong legal institutions support effective contract execution. Where such legal institutions are lacking, how to ensure the proper contract execution poses severe challenges for firms. To address these gaps in the literature, we distinguish between contractual safeguarding and coordinating and incorporate institutional factors into prior contractual governance research. Our research context is buyer-supplier exchanges in China and our research questions are as following: 1) How could the safeguarding and coordinating facets of contracts be distinguished, both conceptually and empirically? 2) When facing exchange hazards, how do firms draft the safeguarding and coordinating clauses of contracts? 3) What are the performance implications of contractual safeguarding and coordinating in the context of legal institutional development in China? 4) How does guanxi importance, a critical cultural institutional factor in China, affect the performance implications of contractual safeguarding and coordinating? 5) How do monitoring and socialization, two popular formal and informal managerial practices, moderate the effects of contractual safeguarding and coordinating on exchange performance? By addressing these research questions, our results will not only enrich the literature on contracting, but also provide important implications for multinational companies, including Hong Kong firms, to understand how to contract with their suppliers and achieve better performance in China. 合约在交易中极其重要，但详细合约的制订成本很高。传统研究着重于合约的保护作用：制订详细的合约能减少机会主义并保护交易双方的利益。最近的研究则指出，合约不仅有保护作用，还具有协调作用。因为合约制订了信息需求，共同目标，问题解决的流程和方法，所以合约能协调交易。 尽管合约的重要性吸引了极大的注意，我们对合约的保护与协调功能还缺乏深入的理解。第一，现有研究没有清晰地界定和测量合约的保护与协调功能。这是一个很显著的研究差距。第二，在中国这个新兴市场，法制的不完善对合约的执行产生极大挑战。合约如何在法制不完善的环境下发挥作用呢？ 在这个项目里，我们将分析合约在中国的角色。我们将区别并测量合约的保护与协调功能，并考虑制度因素的影响。具体的四个问题是： 1．如何在理论上和实证上区分合约的保护与协调功能？ 2．在面临交易危险时，企业如何去制订合约的保护与协调功能？ 3．法律制度的变化对合约的保护与协调功能的绩效有何影响？ 4．关系的重要性对合约的保护与协调功能的绩效有何影响？ 本项目的研究结果不仅会丰富合约的文献，还会对跨国公司（包括香港公司）了解如何与中国供应商制定合约并取得佳绩提供重要的指导。

793613.label: Major findings and research outcome
793613.value: Major findings: 1) Contracts have two distinct facets: safeguarding and coordinating. In contractual clauses, task specificity serves as safeguards in regulating interfirm transactions, and contingency specificity plays a coordinating role by offering response blueprints for uncertain events. 2) Task specificity fosters supplier performance, whereas contingency specificity has no significant impact on supplier performance. As exchange uncertainty increases, the role of task specificity declines, but the role of contingency specificity increases. Contingency specificity also exerts a stronger impact when exchange tacitness is high. 3) As the legal institution improves, task specificity has a stronger, whereas contingency specificity has a weaker, impact on supplier performance; conversely, when guanxi importance increases, task specificity is less effective, whereas contingency specificity is more effective. 4) Task specificity has a stronger impact on exchange performance when monitoring is high, whereas contingency specificity has a stronger effect when socialization is high. 5) Trust has two distinct facets: calculative and relational. Calculative trust has a stronger impact on exchange performance than relational trust. Moreover, exchange hazards significantly and differentially moderate the relationships between calculative/relational trust on performance. 6) Government support as a formal institutional benefit and social legitimacy as an informal institutional benefit mediates the effect of green management on product innovation. Business and political legitimacy mediate the effect of environmental corporate social responsibility on firm performance, and such mediating effects are strengthened by legal incompleteness weakens and legal inefficiency. Outcome: four papers published in peer-reviewed journals. 1) Poppo L, KZ Zhou, and JJ Li (2016), “When Can You Trust ‘Trust?’ Calculative Trust, Relational Trust, and Supplier Performance,” Strategic Management Journal, 37(4): 724-741. 2) Zhang Q, KZ Zhou, Y Wong, W Hai (2017), “Untangling the safeguarding and coordinating functions of contracts: Direct and contingent value in China,” Journal of Business Research, forthcoming. 3) Wei Z, Shen H, KZ Zhou, JJ Li (2017), “How Does Environmental Corporate Social Responsibility Matter in a Dysfunctional Institutional Environment? Evidence from China,” Journal of Business Ethics, 140(2): 209–223. 4) Shu C, KZ Zhou, Y Xiao, S Gao (2016), “¬¬How Green Management Influences Product Innovation in China: The Role of Institutional Benefits,” Journal of Business Ethics, 133: 471–485.

793613.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
793613.value: One potential way is to examine the interplay between contractual and relational governance. It is still unclear whether they function as complements and substitutes during institutional changes. We could develop a model to examine, for example, how legal development and guanxi importance moderate the interplay between contracts and relational governance.

793613.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
793613.value: This project advances a framework to study the effects of contracts and trust in China. In particular, we have the following major findings: 1) Companies in China devise contractual clauses with safeguarding and coordinating functions. 2) Firms should employ more contingency clauses when exchange uncertainty increases and when exchange tacitness is high. 3) Firms should devise more task clauses when the legal institution improves and when guanxi importance is low. 4) Firms should match their use of task and contingency clauses with alternative management practices such as monitoring and socialization. 5) Firms need to match their use of calculative and relational trust with different types of exchange hazards. 6) Firms should understand the importance role of business and political legitimacy in fostering performance. The findings of this project not only enrich our understanding of the roles of contracts and trust in China, but also provide important managerial implications for both foreign and local companies on how to employ proper governance mechanisms to deal with dynamic institutional transitions and industrial uncertainties in China.

793813.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
793813.value: 网上（包括手机）购物和实体店购物以不同的方式吸引消费者。网上购物让消费者更方便地搜索产品信息和评论，比较价格，获得个性化的建议和促销活动，并提供反馈。实体店则通过音乐，样品，产品展示，促销活动，以及娱乐事件给消费者提供更好的感官体验。另外，可以当场试用产品，并可以马上带回家，以及面对面的客户服务和店内产品回报，这对有些客户也是很重要的。 几乎所有的零售商都同时拥有这两个销售渠道。大多数传统的零售商有网上店，而许多传统的虚拟零售商也纷纷建立一个实体销售网络。这种双渠道战略面临着营销，定价和客户服务的挑战。同样重要的是，这些策略也会面临供应链方面的困境。许多现有的供应链的设计是基于尽可能高效地将货物交付给零售商店的物理信道的基础上。当零售商添加网络渠道时，往往另加一个单独的供应链并复制现有存储模型的设置。两者之间的供应链缺乏整合：客户是否可以在网上订购，在店内取货？如果是这样的话，商品该从实体店出货，还是另从网上仓库送到实体店？客户退货如何处理？ 零售商已经尝试过各种供应链模型来处理双通道销售。梅西将不再另加网上销售的专用仓库，而是将更多地由附近实体商店发货。联华超市以前用附近的超市零售店来满足网上订单，但最近改由其在上海地区最大的零售商店之一来满足所有网上订单。沃尔玛有网上销售的专用仓库，但在繁忙的假日购物季节，它已经在几个城市开始直接从附近的实体超市店来满足一些网上订单，以实现当日发货的目标。显然，没有一个双通道的供应链战略能适合所有的零售商。在确定其最佳的供应链战略时，每个零售商必须考虑多种因素，包括顾客的购物喜好，需求模式，成本参数（库存、销售流失、运输、等等） ，以及公司现有的基础设施。 在此提出的项目，我们想要了解调查一些最常用的双渠道供应链战略的关键决定因素。首先，我们将建立一些新的库存模型来捕捉各种双渠道供应链策略的本质。下一步，我们将为每个模型寻找最优的库存和分配政策，并利用这些结果来回答上面提出的有关供应链混乱的问题。当最优政策的结构复杂时，我们会寻找简单和良好的启发式算法，以方便实施。然后，我们将那这些政策与文献中现存的模型比较和对比，探讨它们适用于其他供应链系统的可能性。最后，我们会评估这些库存政策对顾客的购物体验（如填充率，交货时间）的影响，以及其对公司的营运及财务表现的影响。这将使我们能够在不同的情况下比较各种供应链战略，并确定零售商在探索其双渠道供应链战略时必须考虑的关键因素。

793813.label: Realisation of objectives
793813.value: Thanks to the support of GRF, we have achieved all the objectives in this project. We have completed a paper, and have submitted it to Management Science. We elaborate how we achieve the project objective below: First, we build a model to capture the dual-channel supply chain structure. Specifically, we study the fulfillment strategies of an omni-channel retailer that would like to leverage its established offline retail channel infrastructure to help its online sales. We consider a single newsvendor-type product that is sold in both online and offline channels to non-overlapping markets with independent Poisson demand. The offline store can fulfill online demand at an additional handling and fulfillment cost, k, but not vice versa. The retailer makes decisions at three different levels: 1) at the strategic level the retailer must establish a fulfillment structure between the two channels in terms of where to stock inventory in the two channels, 2) at the tactical level, the retailer decides how much inventory to have for each channel before the season starts, 3) at the operational level throughout the season, as demand unfolds and inventory depletes, the retailer makes rationing decision about whether to use offline inventory to fill online order at any moment. We build separate and integrated models to study these decisions. Please see Section 3 in the paper for the detailed description of the model. Second, we are able to characterize the optimal inventory stocking policy for both channels without rationing. Proposition 1 in the paper presents the results. In this case, we also find that the offline inventory is higher in the inventory pooling structure (P structure) than in the channel-specific inventory structure (NP structure), because the offline inventory is used to satisfy both online and offline demand, and thus must increase accordingly. We also show that the total inventory is lower in the P structure, which is consistent with standard pooling results. Third, we have characterized the optimal dynamic inventory allocation policy when one channel runs out of inventory and the other channel still has inventory (the inventory rationing problem). We find that the optimal rationing decision has a threshold-based structure that depends critically on k and the mix of demand between the two channels. Two simple rationing heuristics (Single Threshold Heuristic and Newsvendor Thresholds Heuristic) are proposed and shown to be effective. Fourth, we derived various operational and financial performance measures. Besides profit and inventory measures, we also derive a measure called O2O (online-to-offline) fulfillment, defined as the percentage of online orders handled by each offline store. Fifth, comparing all the supply chain strategies, we are able to show conditions under which each strategy works best. We first compare the P structure with NP structure assuming that there is no rationing. Figure 3 in the paper depicts a typical dominance map of the P and NP structures. There is a monotonically decreasing switching curve in the - space. Below the curve, inventory pooling (P structure) is preferred and above it channel-specific inventory (NP structure) is preferred. We next consider the impact of rationing on performance. We find that the rational policy is always better than the no rationing one. Broadly speaking, rationing offers benefits at both the operational level and the strategic level. On the operational level, it helps the retailer to better utilize its limited offline inventory, in much the same way the expected marginal seat revenue (EMSR) model helps airlines to sell tickets in the RM literature. By differentiating the two types of customers and rejecting the lower-margin online customers at the appropriate time, the retailer can achieve a higher margin and better inventory utilization. This is how rationing helps in the inventory pooling (P) structure. On the strategic level, rationing allows the retailer to combine the benefits of both pooling and NP as it can now place some inventory in the online store, in order to minimize cross-channel fulfillment costs caused by k. The retailer can choose this amount to be suitably low to minimize leftovers, knowing that it can always use offline inventory and rationing to handle any excess online demand. This is how rationing helps in the NP structure. For any fixed stocking level(s), either benefit (operational or strategic) could dominate. However, when the retailer sets its inventory level(s) optimally, we expect the operational benefit to be minimized, and the strategic benefit to dominate. Therefore, rationing should offer bigger profit improvement to a retailer that uses the NP fulfillment structure than to one that uses the P fulfillment structure. In addition to achieving the project objectives, the research team was also inspired to think about another follow-up research question, which is the incentive issues in managing an omni-channel supply chain. We are still in the process of conducting the analysis and writing a draft. The preliminary result of studying the incentive issues in omni-channel has been presented at international conferences twice (one at INFORMS 2015 annual conference, and the other at POMS 26th annual conference).

793813.label: Major findings and research outcome
793813.value: In this project, we study the fulfillment strategies of an omni-channel retailer that would like to leverage its established offline retail channel infrastructure to help its online sales. We consider a single newsvendor-type product that is sold in both online and offline channels to non-overlapping markets with independent Poisson demand. The offline store can fulfill online demand at an additional handling and fulfillment cost, k, but not vice versa. The retailer makes decisions at three different levels: 1) at the strategic level the retailer must establish a fulfillment structure between the two channels in terms of where to stock inventory in the two channels, 2) at the tactical level, the retailer decides how much inventory to have for each channel before the season starts, 3) at the operational level throughout the season, as demand unfolds and inventory depletes, the retailer makes rationing decision about whether to use offline inventory to fill online order at any moment. We build separate and integrated models to study these decisions, and find that the optimal rationing decision has a threshold-based structure that depends critically on k and the mix of demand between the two channels. Two simple rationing heuristics are proposed and shown to be effective. Furthermore, integrating the rationing policy into higher-level decisions, we show that it can have significant impact on the retailer’s stocking and fulfillment structure decisions. As a result, we propose an integrated policy, where the retailer builds separate inventory stocks for each channel but can use the offline inventory to back up online sales, subject to a rationing heuristic, is proved to be simple, effective, and robust. We discuss the various practical implications of our findings. The outcome of this project is summarized as paper, which has been submitted to Management Science for review.

793813.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
793813.value: The current project focuses on the store fulfillment approach, where inventory backup is uni-directional; it would be interesting and important to extend the study to bi-directional backup and rationing. This requires the retailer to invest in store staffing to actively capture potential lost sale in the store. This trend is slowly taking hold in practice so a rigorous analytical study would offer guidance. Another important topic is cross-channel product return. Many retailers now allow customers to return items bought online to offline stores. To the extent most such returns are resalable, this makes the inventory decisions much more complicated, and interesting. Finally, we consider a retailer that owns both channels, so the decisions are centralized to maximize total profit. Practically, however, each channel may have its own profit target and consideration, even within the same retailer. In such a case, one must consider incentive issues: for example, when an offline store fills an online order who gets the credit and how much credit? Getting a good handle on this is essential to the success of an omni-channel approach. We plan to continue studying the incentive issues in omni-channel management.

793813.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
793813.value: Almost all the retailers provide customers with the convenience of shopping online and offline, but they differ greatly in how their supply chains support such dual-channel sales. Our research is the first one to comprehensively study the corresponding dual-channel supply chain strategies. We develop new inventory distribution models to capture the essence of dual-channel distribution. We also develop new way of analyzing such models and provide new theories regarding inventory ordering, priority allocation when multiple customer classes compete for a same pool of resource, and transshipment. With our model, retailers can better plan inventory across locations and channels, thus reducing inventory overstocking.

799713.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
799713.value: 社會網絡和社會影響的研究已成為一個社會科學的主要研究區域。它涵蓋了許多主題，例如教育、社交網絡和求職、鄰里效應和房地產市場、貧困和收入不平等、社會網絡對肥胖、吸煙和快樂的影響。所以許多社會科學家對關於社會網絡和社會影響的計量經濟學很有興趣。 這項目處理許多從事實證研究的社會科學家在硏究社會交往和網絡遇到的一個基本問題：怎樣去識別不同類型的社會影響。在一個典型的社會相互作用模型，不同類型的社會影響會混雜在一起，難以分開。社會影響分兩種，外生特徵的社會影響叫外生影響，內源行為的社會影響叫內生影響。例如，在鄰里效應和房地產市場的背景下，個人可能關心他的鄰居的人口學特徵（外生影響），也關心他的近鄰的住房需求（內生影響）。從數據分開這兩種類型的社會影響並不簡單。 雖然這問題在一九九三年已經有學者提出，學者間一直沒有對這問題有一個透徹了解。這項目的目的是對這問題作一個深入的普遍分析，而且針對一個普遍線性模型類。所硏究的模型比文獻中的更普遍。所硏究的模型有間接的社會互動（間接連接個人之間的相互作用）和不同類型的相互作用有不同的社交網絡。這種類模型還在文獻中還沒有被硏究。

799713.label: Realisation of objectives
799713.value: In the research paper "Identification methods for social interactions models with unknown networks", I developed a set of methods for identifying linear social interactions models with unknown networks and with various assumptions on the network structure. In the paper, social interactions models are interpreted as systems of simultaneous equations. Such an interpretation allows us to analyze the relationship between the problem of identifying social interactions and the classical identification problem of simultaneous linear equations. The paper is a general analysis of the problem of identifying different types of social interactions. Three situations are considered: there is no fixed effect, there are fixed effects (group-level unobservable variables), and there are multiple equilibria. The models in the paper have different types of social interactions (endogenous and exogenous). The identification conditions for the above situations are provided. The network properties from the mathematical identification conditions are derived. The network properties are represented by the number of distinct eigenvalues. The identification conditions cover some previous results as special cases. Thus the paper is a general framework which includes some existing results as special cases.

799713.label: Major findings and research outcome
799713.value: In the research paper "Identification methods for social interactions models with unknown networks", the major findings are some identification methods for linear social interactions models with unknown networks. Linear social interaction models with known networks have been used in the literature of social interactions and spatial econometrics for more than 20 years. But, if the networks are misspecified, the estimation results could be biased and unreliable. In particular, some research results may be used for public policies analyses and suggestions. Therefore, developing methods for identifying and estimating linear social interactions models with unknown networks are very important. The paper has been well-received in conferences in various countries. The paper was presented in Australia, New Zealand, Taiwan, China, and Finance. The detailed of the presentations are in part C.

799713.value: In the research paper "Identification methods for social interactions models with unknown networks", a set of identification methods for linear social interactions models with unknown networks is developed. First, an important further developement is the estimation method corresponding to the identification methods developed. Second, another direction of further development is empirical research. Linear social interaction models with known networks have been used in the literature of social interactions and spatial econometrics for more than 20 years. But, if the networks are misspecified, the estimation results could be biased and unreliable. Therefore, applying the new methods to estimate social interactions models and obtain new results will be very important.

799713.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
799713.value: I wrote a paper "Identification methods for social interactions models with unknown networks". The paper has a set of new identification methods for linear social interactions models with unknown networks. Linear social interactions model has been used in various empirical contexts, example, socioeconomic inequality, intergenerational mobility, job search and social network, housing and neighborhood effects, peer effects in classrooms, and social influence on happiness, obesity and smoking. But most of the existing works assume that the networks are observable to the researchers. This may not be a good assumption. The proposed methods in the paper will help getting more reliable estimation results for empirical research and policy analyses.
